devanagari: पङ्गुं लङ्घयते शैलं मूकमावर्तयेच्छ्रुतिम् ।
यत्कृपा तमहं वन्दे कृष्ण - चैतन्यमीश्वरम् ॥1॥
cc-antya-1.1.translation: I offer my respectful obeisances to Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya Mahāprabhu, by whose mercy even a lame man can cross over a mountain and a dumb man recite Vedic literature.

devanagari: मध्य - लीला - मध्ये अन्त्य - लीला - सूत्र - गण ।
पूर्व - ग्रन्थे सड्क्षेपेते करियाछि वर्णन ॥10॥
cc-antya-1.10.translation: I have briefly described the Antya-līlā in codes within the Madhya-līlā.

devanagari: श्लोक शुनि हरिदास हइला उल्लासी ।
नाचिते लागिला शलोकेर अर्थ प्रशंसि’ ॥100॥
cc-antya-1.100.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu chanted this verse, Haridāsa Ṭhākura, upon hearing the vibration, became jubilant and began dancing and praising its meaning.

lines: nāmera mādhurī aiche kāhāṅ nāhi śuni
devanagari: कृष्ण - नामेर महिमा शास्त्र - साधु - मुखे जानि ।
नामेर माधुरी ऐछे काहाँ नाहि शुनि ॥101॥
cc-antya-1.101.translation: One has to learn about the beauty and transcendental position of the holy name of the Lord by hearing the revealed scriptures from the mouths of devotees. Nowhere else can we hear of the sweetness of the Lord's holy name.

devanagari: तबे महाप्रभु दुँहे करि’ आलिङ्गन ।
मध्याह्न करिते समुद्रे करिला गमन ॥102॥
cc-antya-1.102.translation: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu embraced both Haridāsa and Rūpa Gosvāmī and left for the seaside to perform His noontime duties.

devanagari: आर दिन महाप्रभु देखि’ जगन्नाथ ।
सार्वभौम - रामानन्द - स्वरूपादि - साथ ॥103॥
cc-antya-1.103-104.translation: On the next day, after visiting the temple of Jagannātha as usual, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu met Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya, Rāmānanda Rāya and Svarūpa Dāmodara. They all went together to Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī, and on the way the Lord greatly praised his qualities.

lines: dui śloka kahi' prabhura haila mahā-sukha
devanagari: दुइ श्लोक कहि’ प्रभुर हैल महा - सुख ।
निज - भक्तेर गुणा कहे हञा पञ्च - मुख ॥105॥
cc-antya-1.105.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu recited the two important verses, He felt great pleasure; thus, as if He had five mouths, He began to praise His devotee.

devanagari: सार्वभौम - रामानन्दे परीक्षा करिते ।
श्री - रूपेर गुण दुँहारे लागिला कहिते ॥106॥
cc-antya-1.106.translation: Just to examine Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya and Rāmānanda Rāya, the Lord began to praise the transcendental qualities of Śrī Rūpa Gosvāmī before them.

devanagari: ‘ईश्वर - स्वभावा’ - भक्तेर ना लय अपराध ।
अल्प - सेवा बहुमाने आत्म - पर्यन्त प्रसाद ॥107॥
cc-antya-1.107.translation: Characteristically, the Supreme Personality of Godhead does not take seriously an offense committed by a pure devotee. The Lord accepts whatever small service a devotee renders as being such a great service that He is prepared to give even Himself, not to speak of other benedictions.

devanagari: भृत्यस्य पश्यति गुरूनपि नापराधान् सेवां मनागपि कृतां बहुधाभ्युपैति ।
आविष्करोति पिशुनेष्वपि नाभ्यसूयां शीलेन निर्मल - मतिः पुरुषोत्तमोऽयम् ॥108॥
cc-antya-1.108.translation: "The Supreme Personality of Godhead, who is known as Puruṣottama, the greatest of all persons, has a pure mind. He is so gentle that even if His servant is implicated in a great offense, He does not take it very seriously. Indeed, if His servant renders some small service, the Lord accepts it as being very great. Even if an envious person blasphemes the Lord, the Lord never manifests anger against him. Such are His great qualities."

lines: bhakta-saṅge prabhu āilā, dekhi' dui jana
devanagari: भक्त - सङ्गे प्रभु आइला, देखि’ दुइ जन ।
दण्डवत् हञा कैला चरण वन्दन ॥109॥
cc-antya-1.109.translation: When Haridāsa Ṭhākura and Rūpa Gosvāmī saw that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had come with His intimate devotees, they both immediately fell down like logs and offered prayers to their lotus feet.

lines: antya kono kono līlā kariyāchi varṇana
devanagari: आमि जरा - ग्रस्त, निकटे जानिया मरण ।
अन्त्य कोनो कोनो लीला करियाछि वर्णन ॥11॥
cc-antya-1.11.translation: I am now almost an invalid because of old age, and I know that at any moment I may die. Therefore I have already described some portions of the antya-līlā.

devanagari: भक्त - सङ्गे कैला प्रभु दुँहारे मिलन ।
पिण्डाते वसिला प्रभु लञा भक्त - गण ॥110॥
cc-antya-1.110.translation: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His personal devotees met Rūpa Gosvāmī and Haridāsa Ṭhākura. The Lord then sat down in an elevated place with His devotees.

lines: sabāra āgrahe nā uṭhilā piṅḍāra upare
devanagari: रूप हरिदास दुँहे वसिला पिण्डा - तले ।
सब्षार आाग्रहे ना उठिला पिण्डार उपरे ॥111॥
cc-antya-1.111.translation: Rūpa Gosvāmī and Haridāsa Ṭhākura sat at the foot of the elevated place where Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was sitting. Although everyone asked them to sit on the same level as the Lord and His associates, they did not do so.

lines: lajjāte nā paḍe rūpa mauna dharilā
devanagari: ‘पूर्व - श्लोक पड़, रूप,’ प्रभु आज्ञा कैला ।
लज्जाते ना पड़े रूप मौन धरिला ॥112॥
cc-antya-1.112.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu ordered Rūpa Gosvāmī to read the verse they had previously heard, Rūpa Gosvāmī, because of great shyness, did not read it but instead remained silent.

devanagari: स्वरूप - गोसाञि तबे सेइ श्लोक पड़िल ।
शुनि’ सबाकार चित्ते चमत्कार हैल ॥113॥
cc-antya-1.113.translation: Then Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī recited the verse, and when all the devotees heard it, their minds were struck with wonder.

lines: tathāhaṁ sā rādhā tad idam ubhayoḥ saṅgama-sukham
devanagari: प्रियः सोऽयं कृष्णः सह - चरि कुरु - क्षेत्र - मिलितस् तथाहं सा राधा तदिदमुभयोः सङ्गम - सुखम् ।
तथाप्यन्तः - खेलन्मधुर - मुरली - पञ्चम - जुषे मनो मे कालिन्दी - पुलिन - विपिनाय स्पृहयति ॥114॥
cc-antya-1.114.translation: "My dear friend, now I have met My very old and dear friend Kṛṣṇa on this field of Kurukṣetra. I am the same Rādhārāṇī, and now We are meeting together. It is very pleasant, but I would still like to go to the bank of the Yamunā beneath the trees of the forest there. I wish to hear the vibration of His sweet flute playing the fifth note within that forest of Vṛndāvana."

devanagari: राय, भट्टाचार्य बले , - “तोमार प्रसाद विने ।
तोमार हृदय ए इ जानिल केमने ॥115॥
cc-antya-1.115.translation: After hearing this verse, both Rāmānanda Rāya and Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya said to Caitanya Mahāprabhu, "Without Your special mercy, how could this Rūpa Gosvāmī have understood Your mind?"

lines: ye saba siddhānte brahmā nāhi pāya anta
devanagari: आमाते सञ्चा रि’ पूर्वे कहिला सिद्धान्त ।
ये सब्ष सिद्धान्ते ब्रह्मा नाहि पाय अन्त ॥116॥
cc-antya-1.116.translation: Śrīla Rāmānanda Rāya admitted that previously Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had empowered his heart so that he could express elevated and conclusive statements to which even Lord Brahmā has no access.

devanagari: ताते जानि - पूर्वे तोमार पाञाछे प्रसाद ।
ताहा विना नहे तोमार हृदयानुवाद ॥117॥
cc-antya-1.117.translation: "Had you not previously bestowed Your mercy on him," they said, "it would not have been possible for him to express Your internal feelings."

lines: ye śloka śunile lokera yāya duḥkha-śoka
devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - “कह रूप, नाटकेर श्लोक ।
ये श्लोक शुनिले लोकेर याय दु:ख - शोक” ॥118॥
cc-antya-1.118.translation: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "My dear Rūpa, please recite that verse from your drama which, upon being heard, makes all people's unhappiness and lamentation go away."

lines: bāra bāra prabhu yadi tāre ājñā dila
devanagari: बार बार प्रभु यदि तारे आज्ञा दिल ।
तबे सेइ श्लोक रूप - गोसाञि कहिल ॥119॥
cc-antya-1.119.translation: When the Lord persisted in asking this again and again, Rūpa Gosvāmī recited that verse [as follows].

lines: yei nāhi likhi, tāhā likhiye vistāre
devanagari: पूर्व - लिखित ग्रन्थ - सूत्र - अनुसारे ।
येइ नाहि लिखि, ताहा लिखिये विस्तारे ॥12॥
cc-antya-1.12.translation: In accordance with the codes previously written, I shall describe in detail whatever I have not mentioned.

lines: no jāne janitā kiyadbhir amṛtaiḥ kṛṣṇeti varṇa-dvayī
devanagari: तुण्डे ताण्डविनी रतिं वितनुते तुण्डावली - लब्धये कर्ण - क्रोड़ - कडुम्बिनी घटयते कर्णार्बुदेभ्यः स्पृहाम् ।
चेतः - प्राङ्गण - सङ्गिनी विजयते सर्वेन्द्रियाणां कृतिं नो जाने जनिता कियद्भिरमृतैः कृष्णेति वर्ण - द्वयी ॥120॥
cc-antya-1.120.translation: "I do not know how much nectar the two syllables 'Kṛṣ-ṇa' have produced. When the holy name of Kṛṣṇa is chanted, it appears to dance within the mouth. We then desire many, many mouths. When that name enters the holes of the ears, we desire many millions of ears. And when the holy name dances in the courtyard of the heart, it conquers the activities of the mind, and therefore all the senses become inert."

devanagari: यत भक्त - वृन्द आर रामानन्द राय ।
श्लोक शुनि’ सबार हइल आनन्द - विस्मय ॥121॥
cc-antya-1.121.translation: When all the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, especially Śrī Rāmānanda Rāya, heard this verse, they were all filled with transcendental bliss and were struck with wonder.

lines: emana mādhurya keha nāhi varṇe āra'
devanagari: सबे बले , - ‘नाम - महिमा शुनियाछि अपार ।
एमन माधुर्य केह नाहि वर्ण आर’ ॥122॥
cc-antya-1.122.translation: Everyone admitted that although they had heard many statements glorifying the holy name of the Lord, they had never heard such sweet descriptions as those of Rūpa Gosvāmī.

lines: rāya kahe,—"kon grantha kara hena jāni?
devanagari: राय कहे , - “कोन् ग्रन्थ कर हेन जानि ? ।
याहार भितरे ए इ सिद्धान्तेर खनि ?” ॥123॥
cc-antya-1.123.translation: Rāmānanda Rāya inquired, "What kind of drama are you writing? We can understand that it is a mine of conclusive statements."

devanagari: स्वरूप कहे , - “कृष्ण - लीलार नाटक करिते ।
व्रज - लीला - पुर - लीला एकत्र वर्णिते” ॥124॥
cc-antya-1.124.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara replied for Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī: "He wanted to compose a drama about the pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa. He planned to describe in one book both the pastimes of Vṛndāvana and those of Dvārakā and Mathurā.

devanagari: आरम्भियाछिला, एबे प्रभु - आज्ञा पाञा ।
दुड़ नाटक करितेछे विभाग करिया ॥125॥
cc-antya-1.125.translation: "He began it in that way, but now, following the order of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, he has divided it in two and is writing two plays, one concerning the pastimes of Mathurā and Dvārakā and the other concerning the pastimes of Vṛndāvana.

devanagari: विदग्ध - माधव आर ललित - माधव ।
दुइ नाटके प्रेम - रस अदभुत सब ॥126॥
cc-antya-1.126.translation: "The two plays are called Vidagdha-mādhava and Lalita-mādhava. Both of them wonderfully describe ecstatic emotional love of God."

devanagari: राय कहे , - “नान्दी - श्लोक पड़ देखि, शुनि?” ।
श्री - रूप श्लोक पड़े प्रभु - आज्ञा मा नि’ ॥127॥
cc-antya-1.127.translation: Rāmānanda Rāya said, "Please recite the introductory verse of Vidagdhamādhava so that I can hear and examine it." Thus Śrī Rūpa Gosvāmī, being ordered by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, recited the verse (1.1).

devanagari: सुधानां चान्द्रीणामपि मधुरिमोन्माद - दमनी दधाना राधादि - प्रणय - घन - सारैः सुरभिताम् ।
समन्तात्सन्तापोद्गम - विषम - संसार - सरणी - प्रणीतां ते तृष्णां हरतु हरि - लीला - शिखरिणी ॥128॥
cc-antya-1.128.translation: "May the pastimes of Śrī Kṛṣṇa reduce the miseries existing in the material world and nullify all unwanted desires. The pastimes of the Supreme Personality of Godhead are like śikhariṇī, a blend of yogurt and sugar candy. They overpower the pride of even the nectar produced on the moon, for they distribute the sweet fragrance of the concentrated loving affairs of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī and the gopīs."

lines: prabhura saṅkoce rūpa nā kare paṭhana
devanagari: राय कहे, - ‘कह इष्ट - देवेर वर्णन’ ।
प्रभुर सङ्कोचे रूप ना करे पठन ॥129॥
cc-antya-1.129.translation: Rāmānanda Rāya said, "Now please recite the description of the glories of your worshipable Deity." Rūpa Gosvāmī, however, hesitated due to embarrassment because Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was present.

devanagari: वृन्दावन हैते प्रभु नीलाचले आइला ।
स्वरूप - गोसाञि गौडे वार्ता पाठाइला ॥13॥
cc-antya-1.13.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to Jagannātha Purī from Vṛndāvana, Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosāñi immediately sent news of the Lord's arrival to the devotees in Bengal.

devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - “कह, केने कर सङ्कोचे - लाजे? ।
ग्रन्थेर फल शुनाइबा वैष्णव - समाजे ?” ॥130॥
cc-antya-1.130.translation: The Lord, however, encouraged Rūpa Gosvāmī, saying, "Why are you embarrassed? You should recite it so the devotees can hear the good fruit of your writing."

lines: śuni' prabhu kahe,—'ei ati stuti haila'
devanagari: तबे रूप - गोसाञि यदि श्लोक पड़िल ।
शुनि’ प्रभु कहे, - ‘एइ अति स्तुति हैल’ ॥131॥
cc-antya-1.131.translation: When Rūpa Gosvāmī thus recited his verse, Caitanya Mahāprabhu disapproved of it because it described His personal glories. He expressed the opinion that it was an exaggerated explanation.

devanagari: अनर्पित - चरीं चिरात्करुणयावतीर्ण: कलौ समर्पयि तुमुन्नतोज्ज्वल - रसां स्व - भक्ति - श्रियम् ।
हरिः पुरट - सुन्दर - द्युति - कदम्ब - सन्दीपितः सदा हृदय - कन्दरे स्फुरतु वः शची - नन्दनः ॥132॥
cc-antya-1.132.translation: "May the Supreme Lord, who is known as the son of Śrīmatī Śacīdevī, be transcendentally situated in the innermost core of your heart. Resplendent with the radiance of molten gold, He has descended in the Age of Kali by His causeless mercy to bestow what no incarnation has ever offered before: the most elevated mellow of devotional service, the mellow of conjugal love."

devanagari: सब भक्त - गण कहे श्लोक शुनिया ।
कृतार्थं करिला सबाय श्लोक शुनाञा ॥133॥
cc-antya-1.133.translation: All the devotees present so greatly appreciated this verse that they expressed their gratitude to Śrī Rūpa Gosvāmī for his transcendental recitation.

devanagari: राय कहे , - “कोन्आमुखे पात्र - सन्निधान ?” ।
रूप कहे , - “काल - साम्ये ‘प्रवर्तक’ नाम” ॥134॥
cc-antya-1.134.translation: Rāmānanda Rāya inquired, "How have you introduced the assembly of the players?" Rūpa Gosvāmī replied, "The players assemble at a suitable time under the heading of pravartaka.

devanagari: आक्षिप्तः काल - साम्येन
प्रवेशः स्यात्प्रवर्तकः ॥135॥
cc-antya-1.135.translation: 'When the entrance of the actors is set in motion by the arrival of a suitable time, the entrance is called pravartaka.'

devanagari: सोऽयं वसन्त - समयः समियाय यस्मिन् पूर्ण तमीश्वरमुपोढ़ - नवानुरागम् ।
गूढ़ - ग्रहा रुचिरया सह राधया सौ रङ्गाय सङ्गमयिता निशि पौर्णमासी ॥136॥
cc-antya-1.136.translation: 'Springtime had arrived, and the full moon of that season inspired the Supreme Personality of Godhead, who is complete in everything, with new attraction to meet the beautiful Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī at night to increase the beauty of Their pastimes.' "

devanagari: राय कहे , - “प्ररोचनादि कह देखि, शुनि?” ।
रूप कहे , - “महाप्रभुर श्रवणेच्छा जानि” ॥137॥
cc-antya-1.137.translation: Rāmānanda Rāya said, "Please recite the prarocanā portion so that I may hear and examine it." Śrī Rūpa replied, "I think that the desire to hear of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is prarocanā.

lines: śīlaiḥ pallavitaḥ sa ballava-vadhū-bandho prabandho 'py asau
devanagari: भक्तानामुदगादनर्गल - धियां वर्गो निसर्गोज्ज्वलः शीलैः पल्लवितः स बल्ल व - वधू - बन्धोः प्रबन्धोऽप्यसौ ।
लेभे चत्वरतां च ताण्डव - विधेर्तृन्दाष्टवी - गर्भ - भूर् मन्ये मद्विध - पुण्य - मण्डल - परीपाकोऽयमुन्मीलति ॥138॥
cc-antya-1.138.translation: 'The devotees now present are constantly thinking of the Supreme Lord and are therefore highly advanced. This work named Vidagdha-mādhava depicts the characteristic pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa with decorations of poetic ornaments. And the inner grounds of the forest of Vṛndāvana provide a suitable platform for the dancing of Kṛṣṇa with the gopīs. Therefore I think that the pious activities of persons like us, who have tried to advance in devotional service, have now attained maturity.'

lines: vidhātrī siddhārthān hari-guṇa-mayī vaḥ kṛtir iyam
devanagari: अभिव्यक्ता मत्तः प्रकृति - लघु - रूपादपि बुधा विधात्री सिद्धार्थान्हरि - गुण - मयी वः कृतिरियम् ।
पुलिन्देनाप्यग्निः किमुस मधमुन्मथ्य जनित हिरण्य - श्रेणीनामपहरति नान्तः - कलुषताम् ॥139॥
cc-antya-1.139.translation: "O learned devotees, I am by nature ignorant and low, yet even though it is from me that Vidagdha-mādhava has come, it is filled with descriptions of the transcendental attributes of the Supreme Personality of Godhead. Therefore, will not such literature bring about the attainment of the highest goal of life? Although its wood may be ignited by a low-class man, fire can nevertheless purify gold. Although I am very low by nature, this book may help cleanse the dirt from within the hearts of the golden devotees.' "

devanagari: शुनि’ शची आनन्दित, सब भक्त - गण ।
सत्रे मि लि’ नीलाचले करिला गमन ॥14॥
cc-antya-1.14.translation: Upon hearing this news, mother Śacī and all the other devotees of Navadvīpa were very joyful, and they all departed together for Nīlācala [Jagannātha Purī].

devanagari: राय कहे , - “कह देखि प्रेमोत्पत्ति - कारण ? ।
पूर्व - राग, विकार, चेष्टा, काम - लिखन ?” ॥140॥
cc-antya-1.140.translation: Then Rāmānanda Rāya inquired from Rūpa Gosvāmī about the causes of the loving affairs between Kṛṣṇa and the gopīs, such as previous attachment, transformations of love, endeavors for love, and exchanges of letters disclosing the gopīs' awakening love for Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: क्रमे श्री - रूप - गोसाञि सकलि कहिल ।
शुनि’ प्रभुर भक्त - गणेर चमत्कार हैल ॥141॥
cc-antya-1.141.translation: Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī gradually informed Rāmānanda Rāya about everything he asked. Hearing his explanations, all the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu were struck with wonder.

lines: ekasya śrutam eva lumpati matiṁ kṛṣṇeti nāmākṣaraṁ
eṣa snigdha-ghana-dyutir manasi me lagnaḥ paṭe vīkṣaṇāt
kaṣṭaṁ dhik puruṣa-traye ratir abhūn manye mṛtiḥ śreyasī
devanagari: एकस्य श्रुतमेव लुम्पति मतिं कृष्णेति नामाक्षरं सान्द्रोन्माद - परम्परामुपनयत्यन्यस्य वंशी - कलः ।
एष स्निग्ध - घन - द्युतिर्मनसि मे लग्नः पटे वीक्षणात् कष्टं धिक्पुरुष - त्रये रतिरभून्मन्ये मृतिः श्रेयसी ॥142॥
cc-antya-1.142.translation: Experiencing previous attachment to Kṛṣṇa [pūrva-rāga], Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī thought: "Since I have heard the name of a person called Kṛṣṇa, I have practically lost My good sense. Then, there is another person who plays His flute in such a way that after I hear the vibration, intense madness arises in My heart. And again there is still another person to whom My mind becomes attached when I see His beautiful lightning effulgence in His picture. Therefore I think that I am greatly condemned, for I have become simultaneously attached to three persons. It would be better for Me to die because of this."

devanagari: इयं सखि सु - दु:साध्या राधा - हृदय - वेदना ।
कृता यत्र चिकित्सापि कुत्सायां पर्यवस्यति ॥143॥
cc-antya-1.143.translation: "My dear friend, these palpitations of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's heart are extremely difficult to cure. Even if one applied some medical treatment, it would only end in defamation."

devanagari: धरि - अ पड़िच्छन्द - गुणं सुन्दर मह मन्दिरे तुमं वससि ।
तह तह रुन्धसि बलि - अं जह जह च - इदा पला एम्हि ॥144॥
cc-antya-1.144.translation: "O dearly beautiful, the artistic loveliness of Your picture is now impressed within My mind. Since You are now living within My mind, wherever I wish to run because I am agitated by impressions of You, I find that You, O My friend, are blocking My way."

lines: agre vīkṣya śikhaṇḍa-khaṇḍam acirād utkampam ālambate
guñjānāṁ ca vilokanān muhur asau sāsraṁ parikrośati
bālāyāḥ kila citta-bhūmim aviśat ko 'yaṁ navīna-grahaḥ
devanagari: अग्रे वीक्ष्य शिखण्ड - खण्डमचिरादुत्कम्पमालम्बते गुञ्जानां च विलोकनान्मुहुरसौ सास्त्रं परिक्रोशति ।
नो जाने जनयन्नपूर्व - नटन - क्रीड़ा - चमत्कारितां बालायाः किल चित्त - भूमिमविशत्कोऽयं नवीन - ग्रहः ॥145॥
cc-antya-1.145.translation: "Upon seeing peacock feathers in front of Her, this girl suddenly begins trembling. When She sometimes sees a necklace of guñjā [small conchshells], She sheds tears and cries Loudly. I do not know what kind of new ecstatic influence has entered the heart of this poor girl. It has imbued Her with the dancing attitude of a player creating wonderful, unprecedented dances on a stage."

lines: akāruṇyaḥ kṛṣṇo yadi mayi tavāgaḥ katham idaṁ
mudhā mā rodīr me kuru param imām uttara-kṛtim
yathā vṛndāraṇye ciram avicalā tiṣṭhati tanuḥ
devanagari: अकारुण्यः कृष्णो यदि मयि तवागः कथमिदं मुधा मा रोदी र्मे कुरु परमिमामुत्तर - कृतिम् ।
तमालस्य स्कन्थे विनिहित - भुज - वल्लरिरियं यथा वृन्दारण्ये चिरमविचला तिष्ठति तनुः ॥146॥
cc-antya-1.146.translation: Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī said to Her constant companion Viśākhā: "My dear friend, if Kṛṣṇa is unkind to Me, there will be no need for you to cry, for it will not be due to any fault of yours. I shall then have to die, but afterwards please do one thing for Me: to observe My funeral ceremony, place My body with its arms embracing a tamāla tree like creepers so that I may remain forever in Vṛndāvana undisturbed. That is My last request."(Vidagdha-mādhava 2.47)

devanagari: राय कहे , - “कह देखि भावेर स्वभाव ?” ।
रूप कहे , - “ऐछे हय कृष्णा - विषयक ‘भाव” ॥147॥
cc-antya-1.147.translation: Rāmānanda Rāya inquired, "What are the characteristics of emotional love?" Rūpa Gosvāmī replied, "This is the nature of emotional love for Kṛṣṇa.

lines: jñāyante sphuṭam asya vakra-madhurās tenaiva vikrāntayaḥ
devanagari: पीड़ाभिर्नव - कालकूट - कटुता - गर्वस्य निर्वासनो निस्यन्देन मुर्दा सुधा - मधुरिमाहङ्कार - सङ्कोचनः ।
प्रेमा सुन्दरि नन्द - नन्दन - परो जागर्ति यस्यान्तरे ज्ञायन्ते स्फुटमस्य वक्र - मधुरास्तेनैव विक्रान्तयः ॥148॥
cc-antya-1.148.translation: 'My dear beautiful friend, if one develops love of Godhead, love of Kṛṣṇa, the son of Nanda Mahārāja, all the bitter and sweet influences of this love will manifest in one's heart. Such love of Godhead acts in two ways. The poisonous effects of love of Godhead defeat the severe and fresh poison of the serpent. Yet there is simultaneously transcendental bliss, which pours down and defeats the poisonous effects of a snake, as well as the happiness derived from pouring nectar on one's head. It is perceived as doubly effective, simultaneously poisonous and nectarean.' "

devanagari: राय कहे , - “कह सहज - प्रेमेर लक्षण” ।
रूप - गोसाञि कहे, - “साहजिक प्रेम - धर्म” ॥149॥
cc-antya-1.149.translation: Rāmānanda Rāya further inquired, "What are the natural characteristics of awakening love of Godhead?" Rūpa Gosvāmī replied, "These are the natural characteristics of love of God.

lines: ācārya śivānanda sane mililā sabe āsi'
devanagari: कुलीन - ग्रामी भक्त आर यत खण्ड - वासी ।
आचार्य शिवानन्द साने मिलिला सबे आ सि’ ॥15॥
cc-antya-1.15.translation: Thus all the devotees of Kulīna-grāma and Śrī Khaṇḍa, as well as Advaita Ācārya, came together to meet Śivānanda Sena.

lines: stotraṁ yatra taṭa-sthatāṁ prakaṭayac cittasya dhatte vyathāṁ
doṣeṇa kṣayitām guṇena gurutāṁ kenāpy anātanvatī
premṇaḥ svārasikasya kasyacid iyaṁ vikrīḍati prakriyā
devanagari: स्तोत्रं यत्र तटस्थतां प्रकटयच्चित्तस्य धत्ते व्यथां निन्दापि प्रमदं प्रयच्छति परीहास - श्रियं बिभ्रती ।
दोषेण क्षयितां गुणेन गुरुतां केनाप्यनातन्वती प्रेम्णः स्वारसिकस्य कस्यचिदियं विक्रीड़ति प्रक्रिया ॥150॥
cc-antya-1.150.translation: 'When one hears praise from his beloved, he outwardIy remains neutral but feels pain within his heart. When he hears his beloved making accusations about him, he takes them to be jokes and enjoys pleasure. When he finds faults in his beloved, they do not diminish his love, nor do the beloved's good qualities increase his spontaneous affection. Thus spontaneous love continues under all circumstances. That is how spontaneous love of Godhead acts within the heart.'

lines: svānte śānti-dhurāṁ vidhāya vidhure prāyaḥ parāñciṣyati
hā maugdhyāt phalinī manoratha-latā mṛdvī mayonmūlitā
devanagari: श्रुत्वा निष्ठुरतां ममेन्दु - वदना प्रेमाङ्कुरं भिन्दती स्वान्ते शान्ति - धुरां विधाय विधुरे प्रायः पराञ्चिष्यति ।
किं वा पामर - काम - कार्मुक - परित्रस्ता विमोक्ष्यत्यसून् हा मौग्ध्यात्फलिनी मनोरथ - लता मृद्वी मयोन्मूलिता ॥151॥
cc-antya-1.151.translation: 'Upon hearing of My cruelty, moon-faced Rādhārāṇī may establish some kind of tolerance in Her aggrieved heart. But then She might turn against Me. Or, indeed, being fearful of the lusty desires invoked by the bow of formidable Cupid, She might even give up Her life. Alas! I have foolishly uprooted the soft creeper of Her desire just when it was ready to bear fruit.'

lines: prāṇebhyo 'pi suhṛt-tamāḥ sakhi tathā yūyaṁ parikleśitāḥ
dharmaḥ so 'pi mahān mayā na gaṇitaḥ sādhvībhir adhyāsito
dhig dhairyaṁ tad-upekṣitāpi yad ahaṁ jīvāmi pāpīyasī
devanagari: यस्योत्सङ्ग - सुखाशया शिथिलता गुर्वी गुरुभ्यस्त्रपा प्राणेभ्योऽपि सुहृत्तमाः सखि तथा यूयं परिक्लेशिताः ।
धर्मः सोऽपि महान्मया न गणितः साध्वीभिरथ्यासितो धिग्धै र्यं तदुपेक्षितापि यदहं जीवामि पापीयसी ॥152॥
cc-antya-1.152.translation: 'Desiring the happiness of His association and embraces, My dear friend, I disregarded even My superiors and relaxed My shyness and gravity before them. Furthermore, although you are My best friend, more dear to Me than My own life, I have given you so much trouble. Indeed, I even put aside the vow of dedication to My husband, a vow kept by the most elevated women. Oh, alas! Although He is now neglecting Me, I am so sinful that I am still living. Therefore I must condemn My so-called patience.'

lines: abhadraṁ bhadraṁ vā kim api hi na jānīmahi manāk
vayaṁ netuṁ yuktāḥ katham aśaraṇāṁ kā api daśāṁ
kathaṁ vā nyāyyā te prathayitum udāsīna-padavī
devanagari: गृहान्तः खेलन्त्यो निज - सहज - बाल्यस्य बलनाद् अभद्र भद्र वा किमपि हि न जानीमहि मनाक् ।
वयं नेतुं युक्ताः कथमशरणां कामपि दशां कथं वा न्याय्या ते प्रथयितुमुदासीन - पदवी ॥153॥
cc-antya-1.153.translation: 'I was engaged in My own playful activities in My home, and because of My childish innocence I did not know right from wrong. Therefore, is it good for You to have forced us into being so much attracted to You and then to have neglected us? Now You are indifferent to us. Do You think that is right?'

lines: antaḥ-kleśa-kalaṅkitāḥ kila vayaṁ yāmo 'dya yāmyāṁ purīṁ
hā medhāvini rādhike tava kathaṁ premā garīyān abhūt
devanagari: अन्तः - क्लेश - कलङ्किताः किल वयं यामोऽद्य याम्यां पुरीं नायं वञ्चन - सञ्चय - प्रणयिनं हासं तथाप्युज्झति ।
अस्मिन्सम्पुटिते गभीर - कपटैराभीर - पल्ली - विटे हा मेधाविनि राधिके तव कथं प्रेमा गरीयानभूत् ॥154॥
cc-antya-1.154.translation: 'Our hearts are so polluted by miserable conditions that we are certainly going to Pluto's kingdom. Nevertheless, Kṛṣṇa does not give up His beautiful loving smiling, which is full of cheating tricks. O Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, You are very intelligent. How could You have developed such great loving affection for this deceitful debauchee from the neighborhood of the cowherds?'

lines: hitvā dūre pathi dhava-taror antikaṁ dharā-setor
vāg-vīcibhiḥ kim iva vimukhī-bhāvam asyās tanoṣi
devanagari: हित्वा दूरे पथि धव - तरोरन्तिकं धर्म - सेतोर् भङ्गोदग्रा गुरु - शिखरिणं रंहसा लङ्घयन्ती ।
लेभे कृष्णार्णव नव - रसा राधिका - वाहिनी त्वां वाग्वीचीभिः किमिव विमुखी - भावमस्यास्तनोषि ॥155॥
cc-antya-1.155.translation: 'O Lord Kṛṣṇa, You are just like an ocean. The river of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī has reached You from a long distance-leaving far behind the tree of Her husband, breaking through the bridge of social convention, and forcibly crossing the hills of elder relatives. Coming here because of fresh feelings of love for You, that river has now received Your shelter, but now You are trying to turn Her back by the waves of unfavorable words. How is it that You are spreading this attitude?' "

devanagari: राय कहे , - “वृन्दावन, मुरली - नि:स्वन ।
कृष्ण, राधिकार कैछे करियाछ वर्णन ?” ॥156॥
cc-antya-1.156.translation: Śrīla Rāmānanda Rāya further inquired: "How have you described Vṛndāvana, the vibration of the transcendental flute, and the relationship between Kṛṣṇa and Rādhikā?

lines: kaha, tomāra kavitva śuni' haya camatkāra"
devanagari: “कह, तोमार कवित्व शुनि’ हय चमत्कार” ।
क्रमे रूप - गोसाञि कहे करि’ नमस्कार ॥157॥
cc-antya-1.157.translation: "Please tell me all this, for your poetic ability is wonderful." After offering obeisances to Rāmānanda Rāya, Rūpa Gosvāmī gradually began answering his inquiries.

devanagari: सु - गन्धौ माकन्द - प्रकर - मकरन्दस्य मथुरे विनिस्यन्दे वन्दी - कृत - मधुप - वृन्दं मुहुरिदम् ।
कृतान्दोलं मन्दोन्नतिभिरनिलैश्चन्दन - गिरेर् ममानन्दं वृन्दा - विपिनमतुलं तुन्दिलयति ॥158॥
cc-antya-1.158.translation: 'The sweet, fragrant honey oozing from newly grown mango buds is again and again attracting groups of bumblebees, and this forest is trembling in the softly moving breezes from the Malaya Hills, which are full of sandalwood trees. Thus the forest of Vṛndāvana is increasing My transcendental pleasure.'

devanagari: वृन्दावनं दिव्य - लता - परीतं लताश्च पुष्प - स्फुरिताग्र - भाजः ।
पुष्पाणि च स्फीत - मधु - व्रतानि मधु - व्रताश्च श्रुति - हारि - गीताः ॥159॥
cc-antya-1.159.translation: 'My dear friend, see how this forest of Vṛndāvana is full of transcendental creepers and trees. The tops of the creepers are full of flowers, and intoxicated bumblebees are buzzing around them, humming songs that please the ear and surpass even the Vedic hymns.'

devanagari: शिवानन्द करे सबार घाटि समाधान ।
सबारे पालन करे, देय वासा - स्थान ॥16॥
cc-antya-1.16.translation: Śivānanda Sena arranged for the journey. He maintained everyone and provided residential quarters.

devanagari: क्वचिद्धङ्गी - गीतं क्वचिदनिल - भङ्गी - शिशिरता क्वचिद्वल्ली - लास्यं क्वचिदमल - मल्ली - परिमल: ।
क्वचि द्धारा - शाली करक - फल - पाली - रस - भरो हृषीकाणां वृन्दं प्रमदयति वृन्दावनमिदम् ॥160॥
cc-antya-1.160.translation: 'My dear friend, this forest of Vṛndāvana is giving great pleasure to our senses in various ways. Somewhere bumblebees are singing in groups, and in some places mild breezes are cooling the entire atmosphere. Somewhere the creepers and tree twigs are dancing, the mallikā flowers are expanding their fragrance, and an overabundance of juice is constantly flowing in showers from pomegranate fruits.'

devanagari: परामृष्टाङ्गुष्ठ - त्रयमसित - रत्नैरुभयतो वहन्ती स ङ्कीर्णो मणिभिररुणौस्तत्परिसरौ ।
तयोर्म ध्ये हीरोजवल - विमल - जाम्बूनद - मयी करे कल्याणीयं विहरति हरे: केलि - मुरली ॥161॥
cc-antya-1.161.translation: The flute of Kṛṣṇa's pastimes measures three fingers in length, and it is bedecked with indra-nīla gems. At the ends of the flute are aruṇa gems [rubies], glittering beautifully, and in between the flute is plated with gold, set ablaze by diamonds. This auspicious flute, pleasing to Kṛṣṇa, is glittering in His hand with transcendental brilliance.'

lines: kasmāt tvayā sakhi guror viṣamā gṛhītā
devanagari: सद्वंशतस्तव जनिः पुरुषोत्तमस्य पाणी स्थितिर्मुरलिके सरलासि जात्या ।
कस्मा त्त्वया सखि गुरोर्विषमा गृहीता गोपाङ्गना - गण - विमोहन - मन्त्र - दीक्षा ॥162॥
cc-antya-1.162.translation: My dear friend the flute, it appears that you have been born of a very good family, for your residence is in the hands of Śrī Kṛṣṇa. By birth you are simple and are not at all crooked. Why then have you taken initiation into this dangerous mantra that enchants the assembled gopīs?'

devanagari: सखि मुरलि विशाल - च्छिद्र - जालेन पूर्णा लघुरति - कठिना त्वं ग्रन्थिला नीरसासि ।
तदपि भजसि शश्वच्चुम्बनानन्द - सान्द्रं हरि - कर - परिरम्भं केन पुण्योदयेन ॥163॥
cc-antya-1.163.translation: My dear friend the flute, you are actually full of many holes or faults. You are light, hard, juiceless and full of knots. But what kind of pious activities have engaged you in the service of being kissed by the Lord and embraced by His hands?'

lines: rundhann ambu-bhṛtaś camatkṛti-paraṁ kurvan muhus tumburuṁ
devanagari: औत्सुक्यावलिभिर्बलिं।
चटुलयन्भोगीन्द्रमाघूर्णयन् भिन्दन्त्रण्ड - कटाह - भित्तिमभितो बभ्राम वंशी - ध्वनिः ॥164॥
cc-antya-1.164.translation: 'The transcendental vibration of Kṛṣṇa's flute blocked the movements of the rain clouds, struck the Gandharvas full of wonder, and agitated the meditation of great saintly persons like Sanaka and Sanandana. It created wonder in Lord Brahmā, wrought intense curiosity that agitated the mind of Bali Mahārāja, who was otherwise firmly fixed, made Mahārāja Ananta, the carrier of the planets, whirl around, and penetrated the strong coverings of the universe. Thus the sound of the flute in the hands of Kṛṣṇa created a wonderful situation.'

devanagari: अयं नयन - दण्डित - प्रवर - पुण्डरीक - प्रभः प्रभाति नव - जागुड़ - द्युति - विड़म्बि - पीताम्बरः ।
अरण्यज - परिष्क्रिया - दमित - दिव्य - वेशादरो हरिन्मणि - मनोहर - द्युतिभिरुज्ज्वलाङ्गो हरिः ॥165॥
cc-antya-1.165.translation: 'The beauty of Kṛṣṇa's eyes surpasses the beauty of white lotus flowers, His yellow garments surpass the brilliance of fresh decorations of kuṅkuma, His ornaments of selected forest flowers surpass the hankering for the best of garments, and His bodily beauty possesses mind-attracting splendor greater than the jewels known as marakata-maṇi [emeralds].'

devanagari: जङ्घाधस्तट - सङ्गि - दक्षिण - पदं किञ्चिद्विभुग्न - त्रिकं साचि - स्तम्भित - कन्धरं सखि तिरः - सञ्चारि - नेत्राञ्चलम् ।
वंशीं कुट्मलिते दधानमधरे लोलाङ्गुली - सङ्गतां रिङ्गद्भ्रू - भ्रमरं वराङ्गि परमानन्दं पुरः स्वी - कुरु ॥166॥
cc-antya-1.166.translation: 'O most beautiful friend, please accept the Supreme Personality of Godhead, who is standing before you full of transcendental bliss. The borders of His eyes roam from side to side, and His eyebrows move slowly like bumblebees on His lotuslike face. Standing with His right foot placed below the knee of His left leg, the middle of His body curved in three places, and His neck gracefully tilted to the side, He takes His flute to His pursed lips and moves His fingers upon it here and there.'

lines: yugapad ayam apūrvaḥ kaḥ puro viśva-karmā
devanagari: कुल - वर - तनु - धर्म - ग्राव - वृन्दानि भिन्दन् सु - मुखि निशित - दीर्घापाङ्ग - टङ्क - च्छटाभि: ।
युगपदयमपूर्वः कः पुरो विश्वकर्मा मरकत - मणिा - लक्षेगॉँष्ठ - कक्षां चिनोति ॥167॥
cc-antya-1.167.translation: 'O beautiful-faced one, who is this creative person standing before us? With the sharp chisels of His loving glances, He is splitting the hard stones of many women's devotion to their husbands. And with the luster of His body, surpassing the brilliance of countless emeralds, He is simultaneously constructing private meeting places for His pastimes.'

devanagari: महेन्द्र - मणि - मण्डली - मद - विड़म्बि - देह - द्युतिर् व्रजेन्द्र - कुल - चन्द्रमाः स्फुरति कोऽपि नव्यो युवा ।
सखि स्थिर - कुलाङ्गना - निकर - नीवि - बन्धार्गल च्छिदा - करण - कौतुकी जयति यस्य वंशी - ध्वनिः ॥168॥
cc-antya-1.168.translation: My dear friend, this newly youthful Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the moon in the family of Nanda Mahārāja, is so beautiful that He defies the beauty of clusters of valuable jewels. All glories to the vibration of His flute, for it is cunningly breaking the patience of chaste ladies by loosening their belts and tight dresses.'

lines: balād akṣṇor lakṣmīḥ kavalayati navyaṁ kuvalayaṁ
daśāṁ kaṣṭām aṣṭā-padam api nayaty āṅgika-rucir
vicitraṁ rādhāyāḥ kim api kila rūpaṁ vilasati
devanagari: बलादक्ष्णोर्ल क्ष्मीः कवलयति नव्यं कुवलयं मुखोल्लासः पुल्लिं कमल - वनमुल्लङ्घयति च ।
दशा कष्टा मष्टापदमपि नयत्याङ्गिक - रुचिर् विचित्रं राधायाः किमपि किल रूपं विलसति ॥169॥
cc-antya-1.169.translation: The beauty of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's eyes forcibly devours the beauty of newly grown blue lotus flowers, and the beauty of Her face surpasses that of an entire forest of fully blossomed lotuses. Her bodily luster seems to place even gold in a painful situation. Thus the wonderful, unprecedented beauty of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī is awakening in Vṛndāvana.'

lines: bhakṣya diyā lañā cale kariyā pālane
devanagari: एक कुक्कुर चले शिवानन्द - सने ।
भक्ष्य दिया लञा चले करिया पालने ॥17॥
cc-antya-1.17.translation: While going to Jagannātha Purī, Śivānanda Sena allowed a dog to go with him. He supplied it food to eat and maintained it.

devanagari: विधुरेति दिवा विरूपतां शत - पत्रं बत शर्वरी - मुखे ।
इति केन सदा श्रियोज्वलं तुलनामर्हति मत्प्रियाननम् ॥170॥
cc-antya-1.170.translation: Although the effulgence of the moon is brilliant initially at night, in the daytime it fades away. Similarly, although the lotus is beautiful during the daytime, at night it closes. But, O My friend, the face of My most dear Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī is always bright and beautiful, both day and night. Therefore, to what can Her face be compared?'

devanagari: प्रमद - रस - तरङ्ग - स्मेर - गण्ड - स्थलायाः स्मर - धनुरनुबन्धि - भ्रू - लता - लास्य - भाजः ।
मद - कल - चल - भूङ्गी - भ्रान्ति - भङ्गीं दधानो हृदयमिदमदाङ्क्षीत्पक्ष्मलाक्ष्याः कटाक्षः ॥171॥
cc-antya-1.171.translation: When Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī smiles, waves of joy overtake Her cheeks, and Her arched eyebrows dance like the bow of Cupid. Her glance is so enchanting that it is like a dancing bumblebee, moving unsteadily due to intoxication. That bee has bitten the whorl of My heart.' "

devanagari: राय कहे , - “तोमार कवित्व अमृतेर धार ।
द्वितीय नाटकेर कह नान्दी - व्यवहार” ॥172॥
cc-antya-1.172.translation: Having heard these verses recited by Rūpa Gosvāmī, Śrīla Rāmānanda Rāya said, "Your poetic expressions are like continuous showers of nectar. Kindly let me hear the introductory portion of the second drama."

devanagari: रूप कहे , - “काहाँ तुमि सूर्योपम भास ।
मुञि कोन् क्षुद्र, - येन खद्योत - प्रकाश” ॥173॥
cc-antya-1.173.translation: Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī said, "In your presence, which is just like brilliant sunshine, I am as insignificant as the light of a glowworm.

devanagari: “तोमार आगे धाष्ठर्य एडू मुख - व्यादा न” ।
एत ब लि’ नान्दी - श्लोक करिला व्याख्यान ॥174॥
cc-antya-1.174.translation: It is even impudent for me to open my mouth before you." Then, having said this, he recited the introductory verse of Lalita-mādhava.

devanagari: सुर - रिपु - सुदृशामुरोज - कोकान् मुख - कमलानि च खेदयन्नखण्ड: ।
चिरमखिल - सुहृच्चकोर - नन्दी दिशतु मुकुन्द - यशः - शशी मुदं वः ॥175॥
cc-antya-1.175.translation: The beautiful moonlike glories of Mukunda give distress to the lotuslike faces of the wives of the demons and to their raised breasts, which are like gleaming cakravāka birds. Those glories, however, are pleasing to all His devotees, who are like cakora birds. May those glories forever give pleasure to you all.' "

devanagari: “द्वितीय नान्दी कह देखि ?” - राय पुछिला ।
सङ्कोच पाञा रूप पड़िते लागिला ॥176॥
cc-antya-1.176.translation: When Śrīla Rāmānanda Rāya further inquired about the second introductory verse, Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī was somewhat hesitant, but nevertheless he began to read.

lines: nija-praṇayitāṁ sudhām udayam āpnuvan yaḥ kṣitau
devanagari: निज - प्रणयितां सुधामुदयमाप्नुवन् यः क्षितौ किरत्यलमुरी - कृत - द्विज - कुलाधिराज - स्थितिः ।
स लुञ्छित - तमस्ततिर्मम शची - सुताख्यः शशी वशी - कृत - जगन्मनाः किमपि शर्म विन्यस्यतु ॥177॥
cc-antya-1.177.translation: The moonlike Supreme Personality of Godhead, who is known as the son of mother Śacī, has now appeared on earth to spread devotional love of Himself. He is emperor of the brāhmaṇa community. He can drive away all the darkness of ignorance and control the mind of everyone in the world. May that rising moon bestow upon us all good fortune.' "

devanagari: शुनिया प्रभुर यदि अन्तरे उल्लास ।
बाहिरे कहेन किछु करि’ रोषाभास ॥178॥
cc-antya-1.178.translation: Although Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was inwardly greatly pleased when He heard this verse, externally He spoke as if angry.

devanagari: “काँहा तोमार कृष्ण - रस - काव्य - सुधा - सिन्धु ।
तार मध्ये मिथ्या केने स्तुति - क्षार - बिन्दु” ॥179॥
cc-antya-1.179.translation: Your exalted poetic descriptions of the mellows of Lord Kṛṣṇa's pastimes are like an ocean of nectar. But why have you put in a false prayer about Me? It is like a drop of detestful alkali."

lines: uḍiyā nāvika kukkura nā caḍāya naukāte
devanagari: एक - दिन एक - स्थाने नदी पार हैते ।
उड़िया नाविक कुक्कुर ना चड़ाय नौकाते ॥18॥
cc-antya-1.18.translation: One day, when they needed to cross a river, an Orissan boatman would not allow the dog to get in the boat.

lines: tāra madhye eka bindu diyāche karpūra"
devanagari: राय कहे , - “रूपेर काव्य अमृतेर पूर ।
तार मध्ये एक बिन्दु दियाछे कपूर” ॥180॥
cc-antya-1.180.translation: Śrīla Rāmānanda Rāya objected, "It is not alkali at all. It is a particle of camphor he has put into the nectar of his exalted poetic expression."

devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - “राय, तोमार इहाते उल्लास ।
शुनितेइ लञा, लोके करे उपहास” ॥181॥
cc-antya-1.181.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "My dear Rāmānanda Rāya, you are jubilant at hearing these poetic expressions, but I am ashamed to hear them, for people in general will joke about the subject of this verse."

devanagari: राय कहे , - “लोकेर सुख इहार श्रवणे ।
अभीष्ट - देवेर स्मृति मङ्गलाचरणे” ॥182॥
cc-antya-1.182.translation: Rāmānanda Rāya said, "Instead of joking, people in general will feel great pleasure in hearing such poetry, for the initial remembrance of the worshipable Deity invokes good fortune."

devanagari: राय कहे , - “कोन् अङ्गे पात्रेर प्रवेश ?” ।
तबे रूप - गोसा ञि कहे ताहार विशेष ॥183॥
cc-antya-1.183.translation: Rāmānanda Rāya inquired, "By which subdivision of style do the players enter?" Rūpa Gosvāmī then began to speak specifically about this subject.

devanagari: नटता किरात - राजं निहत्य रङ्ग - स्थले कला - निधिना ।
समये तेन विधेयं गुणवति तारा - कर - ग्रहणम् ॥184॥
cc-antya-1.184.translation: “ 'While dancing on the stage after having killed the ruler of uncivilized men [Kaṁsa], Lord Kṛṣṇa, master of all arts, will at the proper time accept the hand of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, who is qualified with all transcendental attributes.' (Lalita-mādhava 1.11)

devanagari: ‘उद्घात्यक’ नाम एइ ‘आमुख’ - ‘वीथी’ अङ्गः ।
तोमार आागे कहि - इहा धाष्टर्येर तरङ्ग ॥185॥
cc-antya-1.185.translation: "This introduction is technically called udghātyaka, and the whole scene is called vīthī. You are so expert in dramatic expression that each of my statements before you is like a wave from an ocean of impudence.

devanagari: पदानि त्वगतार्थानि तदर्थ - गतये नरा: ।
योजयन्ति पदैरन्यैः स उद्धात्यक उच्यते ॥186॥
cc-antya-1.186.translation: To explain an unclear word, men generally join it with other words. Such an attempt is called udghātyaka.' "

devanagari: राय कहे , - “कह आगे अङ्गेर विशेष” ।
श्री - रूप कहेन किछु सङ्क्षेप - उद्देश ॥187॥
cc-antya-1.187.translation: When Rāmānanda Rāya requested Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī to speak further about various portions of the play, Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī briefly quoted his Lalita-mādhava.

devanagari: व्रज - वाम - दृशां न पद्धति:
प्रकटा सर्व - दृशः श्रुतेरपि ॥188॥
cc-antya-1.188.translation: The dust from cows and calves on the road creates a kind of darkness indicating that Kṛṣṇa is returning home from the pasture. Also, the darkness of evening provokes the gopīs to meet Kṛṣṇa. Thus the pastimes of Kṛṣṇa and the gopīs are covered by a kind of transcendental darkness and are therefore impossible for ordinary scholars of the Vedas to see.'

devanagari: ह्रियमवगृह्य गृहेभ्यः कर्षति राधां वनाय या निपुणा ।
सा जयति निसृष्टार्था वर - वंशज - काकली दूती ॥189॥
cc-antya-1.189.translation: May the sweet sound of Lord Kṛṣṇa's flute, His authorized messenger, be glorified, for it expertly releases Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī from Her shyness and attracts Her from Her home to the forest.'

lines: daśa paṇa kaḍi diyā kukkure pāra kailā
devanagari: कुक्कुर रहिला , - शिवानन्द दु:खी हैला ।
दश पण कड़ि दिया कुक्कुरे पार कैला ॥19॥
cc-antya-1.19.translation: Śivānanda Sena, unhappy that the dog had to stay behind, paid the boatman ten paṇa of conchshells to take the dog across the river.

devanagari: सह - चरि निरा तङ्कः कोऽयं युवा मुदिर - द्युतिर् व्रज - भुवि कुतः प्राप्तो माद्यन्मतॆ - गज - विभ्रमः ।
अहह च टुलैरुत्सर्पद्रिईगञ्चल - तस्करैर् मम धृति - धनं चेतः - कोषाद्विलुण्ठयतीह यः ॥190॥
cc-antya-1.190.translation: My dear friend, who is this fearless young man? He is as bright as a lightning cloud, and He wanders in His pastimes like a maddened elephant. From where has He come to Vṛndāvana? Alas, by His restless movements and attractive glances He is plundering from the vault of My heart the treasure of My patience.'

devanagari: विहार - सुर - दीर्घिका मम मनः - करीन्द्रस्य या विलोचन - चकोरयोः शरदमन्द - चन्द्र - प्रभा ।
उरोऽम्बर - तटस्य चाभरण - चारु - तारावली मयोन्नत - मनोरथैरियमलम्भि सा राधिका ॥191॥
cc-antya-1.191.translation: Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī is the Ganges in which the elephant of My mind enjoys pastimes. She is the shining of the full autumn moon for the cakora birds of My eyes. She is the dazzling ornament, the bright and beautiful arrangement of stars, on the border of the sky of My chest. Now today I have gained Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī because of the highly elevated state of My mind.' "

lines: eta śuni' rāya kahe prabhura caraṇe
devanagari: एत शुनि’ राय कहे प्रभुर चरणे ।
रूपेर कवित्व प्रशंसि’ सहस्त्र - वदने ॥192॥
cc-antya-1.192.translation: After hearing this, Śrīla Rāmānanda Rāya submitted at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu the superexcellence of Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī's poetic expression and began to praise it as if he had thousands of mouths.

devanagari: “कवित्व ना हय एड़ अमृतेर धार ।
नाटक - लक्षणा सब सिद्धान्तेर सार” ॥193॥
cc-antya-1.193.translation: Śrīla Rāmānanda Rāya said, "This is not a poetic presentation; it is a continuous shower of nectar. Indeed, it is the essence of all ultimate realizations, appearing in the form of plays.

devanagari: प्रेम - परिपाटी एड़ अद्भुत वर्णन ।
शुनि’ चित्त - कर्णेर हय आनन्द - घूर्णन ॥194॥
cc-antya-1.194.translation: The wonderful descriptions of Rūpa Gosvāmī are superb arrangements to express loving affairs. Hearing them will plunge the heart and ears of everyone into a whirlpool of transcendental bliss.

devanagari: किं काव्येन कवेस्तस्य किं काण्डेन धनुष्मतः ।
परस्य हृदये लग्नं न घूर्णयति यच्छिरः ॥195॥
cc-antya-1.195.translation: What is the use of a bowman's arrow or a poet's poetry if they penetrate the heart but do not cause the head to spin?'

lines: tomāra śakti vinā jīvera nahe ei vāṇī
devanagari: “तोमार शक्ति विना जीवेर नहे एइ वाणी ।
तुमि शक्ति दिया कहाओ, - हेन अनुमानि” ॥196॥
cc-antya-1.196.translation: Without Your mercy such poetic expressions would be impossible for an ordinary living being to write. My guess is that You have given him the power."

lines: ihāra guṇe ihāte āmāra tuṣṭa haila mana
devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - “प्रयागे इहार हइल मिलन ।
इहार गुणे इहाते आमार तुष्ट हैल मन” ॥197॥
cc-antya-1.197.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "I met Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī at Prayāga. He attracted and satisfied Me because of his qualities."

lines: aiche kavitva vinu nahe rasera pracāra
devanagari: मधुर प्रसन्न इहार काव्य सालङ्कार ।
ऐछे कवित्व विनु नहे रसेर प्रचार ॥198॥
cc-antya-1.198.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu praised the metaphors and other literary ornaments of Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī's transcendental poetry. Without such poetic attributes, He said, there is no possibility of preaching transcendental mellows.

lines: sabe kṛpā kari' iṅhāre deha' ei vara
devanagari: सबे कृपा करि’ इँहारे देह’ एइ वर ।
व्रज - लीला - प्रेम - रस येन वर्णे निरन्तर ॥199॥
cc-antya-1.199.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu requested all His personal associates to bless Rūpa Gosvāmī so that he might continuously describe the pastimes of Vṛndāvana, which are full of emotional love of Godhead.

devanagari: दुर्गमे पथि मेऽन्धस्य स्खलत्पाद - गतेर्मुहुः ।
स्व - कृपा - यष्टि - दानेन सन्तः सन्त्ववलम्बनम् ॥2॥
cc-antya-1.2.translation: My path is very difficult. I am blind, and my feet are slipping again and again. Therefore, may the saints help me by granting me the stick of their mercy as my support.

devanagari: एक - दिन शिवानन्दे घाटियाले राखिला ।
कुक्कुरके भात दिते सेवक पासरिला ॥20॥
cc-antya-1.20.translation: One day while Śivānanda was detained by a tollman, his servant forgot to give the dog its cooked rice.

devanagari: इँहार ये ज्येष्ठ - भ्राता, नाम - ‘सनात न’ ।
पृथिवीते विज्ञ - वर नाहि ताँर सम ॥200॥
cc-antya-1.200.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī's elder brother, whose name is Sanātana Gosvāmī, is such a wise and learned scholar that no one is equal to him."

lines: tomāra yaiche viṣaya-tyāga, taiche tāṅra rīti
devanagari: तोमार यैछे विषय - त्याग, तैछे ताँर रीति ।
दैन्य - वैराग्य - पाण्डित्येर ताँहातेइ स्थिति ॥201॥
cc-antya-1.201.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu told Rāmānanda Rāya, "Sanātana Gosvāmī's renunciation of material connections is just like yours. Humility, renunciation and excellent learning exist in him simultaneously.

lines: ei dui bhāiye āmi pāṭhāiluṅ vṛndāvane
devanagari: एइ दुइ भाइये आमि पाठाइ लुँ वृन्दावने ।
शक्ति दिया भक्ति - शास्त्र करिते प्रवर्तने ॥202॥
cc-antya-1.202.translation: I empowered both of these brothers to go to Vṛndāvana to expand the literature of bhakti."

lines: rāya kahe,—"īśvara tumi ye cāha karite
devanagari: राय कहे , - “ईश्वर तुमि ये चाह करिते ।
काष्ठेर पुतली तुमि पार नाचाइते” ॥203॥
cc-antya-1.203.translation: Śrīla Rāmānanda Rāya replied to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, "My Lord, You are the Supreme Personality of Godhead. If You like, You can cause even a wooden doll to dance.

lines: mora mukhe ye saba rasa karilā pracāraṇe
sei rasa dekhi ei ihāra likhane
devanagari: मोर मुखे ये सब रस करिला प्रचारणे ।
सेइ रस देखि ए इ इहार लिखने ॥204॥
cc-antya-1.204.translation: "I see that the truths regarding transcendental mellow that You have expounded through my mouth are all explained in the writings of Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī.

lines: yāre karāo, sei karibe jagat tomāra vaśa
devanagari: भक्तेकृपा - हेतु प्रकाशिते चाह व्रज - रस ।
यारे कराओ, सेइ करिबे जगत् तोमार वश ॥205॥
cc-antya-1.205.translation: "Because of Your causeless mercy toward Your devotees, You want to describe the transcendental pastimes in Vṛndāvana. Anyone empowered to do this can bring the entire world under Your influence."

devanagari: तबे महाप्रभु कैला रूपे आलिङ्गन ।
ताँरे कराइला सबार चरण वन्दन ॥206॥
cc-antya-1.206.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then embraced Rūpa Gosvāmī and asked him to offer prayers at the lotus feet of all the devotees present.

lines: kṛpā kari' rūpe sabe kailā āliṅgana
devanagari: अद्वैत - नित्यानन्दादि सब भक्त - गण ।
कृपा करि’ रूपे सबे कैला आलिङ्गन ॥207॥
cc-antya-1.207.translation: Advaita Ācārya, Nityānanda Prabhu and all the other devotees showed their causeless mercy to Rūpa Gosvāmī by embracing him in return.

devanagari: प्रभु - कृपा रूपे, आर रूपेर सदगुण ।
देखि’ चमत्कार हैल सबाकार मन ॥208॥
cc-antya-1.208.translation: Seeing Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's special mercy toward Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī and seeing his personal qualities, all the devotees were struck with wonder.

lines: tabe mahāprabhu saba bhakta lañā gelā
devanagari: तबे महाप्रभु सब भक्त गेला ।
हरिदास - ष्ठाकुर रूपे आलिङ्गन कैला ॥209॥
cc-antya-1.209.translation: Then, when Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu left with all of His devotees, Haridāsa Ṭhākura also embraced Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī.

devanagari: रात्रे आ सि’ शिवानन्द भोजनेर काले ।
‘कुक्कुर पाञाछे भात?’ - सेवके पुछिले ॥21॥
cc-antya-1.21.translation: At night, when Śivānanda Sena returned and was taking his meal, he inquired from the servant whether the dog had gotten its meals.

lines: ye saba varṇilā, ihāra ke jāne mahimā?"
devanagari: हरिदास कहे , - “तोमार भाग्येर नाहि सीमा ।
ये सब्ष वर्णिाला, इहार के जाने महिमा ?” ॥210॥
cc-antya-1.210.translation: Haridāsa Ṭhākura told him: "There is no limit to your good fortune. No one can understand the glories of what you have described."

lines: yei mahāprabhu kahāna, sei kahi vāṇī
devanagari: श्री - रूप कहेन , - “आमि किछुइ ना जानि ।
येह महाप्रभु कहान, सेह कहि वाणी” ॥211॥
cc-antya-1.211.translation: Śrī Rūpa Gosvāmī said, "I do not know anything. The only transcendental words I can utter are those which Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu makes me speak.

devanagari: हृदि यस्य प्रेरणया प्रवर्त्तितोऽहं वराक - रूपोऽपि ।
तस्य हरेः पद - कमलं वन्दे चैतन्य - देवस्य ॥212॥
cc-antya-1.212.translation: 'Although I am the lowest of men and have no knowledge, the Lord has mercifully bestowed upon me the inspiration to write transcendental literature about devotional service. Therefore I offer my obeisances at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, who has given me the chance to write these books.' "

devanagari: एइ - मत दुइ - जन कृष्ण - कथा - रङ्गे ।
सुखे काल गोडाय रूप हरिदास - सद्धे ॥213॥
cc-antya-1.213.translation: In this way Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī passed his time in close association with Haridāsa Ṭhākura by discussing the pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa in great happiness.

lines: cāri māsa rahi' saba prabhura bhakta-gaṇa
gosāñi vidāya dilā, gauḍe karilā gamana
devanagari: चारि मास र हि’ सब प्रभुर भक्त - गण ।
गोसाञि विदाय दिला, गौडे करिला गमन ॥214॥
cc-antya-1.214.translation: All the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu thus spent four months with Him. Then the Lord bade them farewell, and they returned to Bengal.

devanagari: श्री - रूप प्रभु - पदे नीलाचले रहिला ।
दोल - यात्रा प्रभु - सद्धे आनन्दे देखिला ॥215॥
cc-antya-1.215.translation: Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī, however, stayed at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and when the Dola-yātrā festival took place, he saw it in great happiness with the Lord.

lines: dola anantare prabhu rūpe vidāya dilā
devanagari: दोल अनन्तरे प्रभु रूपे विदाय दिला ।
अनेक प्रसाद करि’ शक्ति सञ्चा रिला ॥216॥
cc-antya-1.216.translation: After the Dola-yātrā festival ended, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu bade farewell to Rūpa Gosvāmī also. The Lord empowered him and bestowed upon him all kinds of mercy.

devanagari: “वृन्दावने याह’ तुमि, रहिह वृन्दावने ।
एकबार इहाँ पाठाइह सनातने” ॥217॥
cc-antya-1.217.translation: "Now go to Vṛndāvana and stay there," the Lord said. "You may send here your elder brother, Sanātana.

devanagari: व्रजे याइ रस - शास्त्र करिह निरूपण ।
लुप्त - तीर्थ सब ताहाँ करिह प्रचारण ॥218॥
cc-antya-1.218.translation: "When you go to Vṛndāvana, stay there, preach transcendental literature and excavate the lost holy places.

devanagari: “कृष्ण - सेवा, रस - भक्ति करिह प्रचार ।
आमिह देखिते ताहाँ याइमु एकबार” ॥219॥
cc-antya-1.219.translation: "Establish the service of Lord Kṛṣṇa and preach the mellows of Lord Kṛṣṇa's devotional service. I shall also go to Vṛndāvana once more."

lines: kukkura nāhi pāya bhāta śuni' duḥkhī hailā
devanagari: कुक्कुर नाहि पाय भात शुनि’ दु:खी हैला ।
कुक्कुर चाहिते दश - मनुष्य पाठाइला ॥22॥
cc-antya-1.22.translation: When he learned that the dog had not been supplied food in his absence, he was very unhappy. He then immediately sent ten men to find the dog.

lines: eta bali' prabhu tāṅre kailā āliṅgana
rūpa gosāñi śire dhare prabhura caraṇa
devanagari: एत ब लि’ प्रभु ताँरे कैला आलिङ्गन ।
रूप गोसाञि शिरे धरे प्रभुर चरण ॥220॥
cc-antya-1.220.translation: Having thus spoken, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu embraced Rūpa Gosvāmī, who then placed the lotus feet of the Lord upon his head.

devanagari: प्रभुर भक्त - गण - पाशे विदाय लइला ।
पुनरपि गौड़ - पथे वृन्दावने आइला ॥221॥
cc-antya-1.221.translation: Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī took leave of all the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and returned to Vṛndāvana by the path to Bengal.

lines: ei ta' kahilāṅa punaḥ rūpera milana
devanagari: एइ त’ कहिला ङ पुनः रूपेर मिलन ।
इहा येइ शुने, पाय चैतन्य - चरण ॥222॥
cc-antya-1.222.translation: Thus I have described the second meeting of Rūpa Gosvāmī and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Anyone who hears of this incident will certainly attain the shelter of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: श्री - रूप - रघुनाथ - पदे यार आश ।
चैतन्य - चरितामृत कहे कृष्णदास ॥223॥
cc-antya-1.223.translation: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.

lines: cāhiyā nā pāila kukkura, loka saba āilā
devanagari: चाहिया ना पाइल कुक्कुर, लोक सब आइला ।
दुःखी हञा शिवानन्द उपवास कैला ॥23॥
cc-antya-1.23.translation: When the men returned without success, Śivānanda Sena became very unhappy and fasted for the night.

lines: prabhāte kukkura cāhi' kāṅhā nā pāila
devanagari: प्रभाते कुक्कुर चाहि’ काँहा ना पाइल ।
सकल वैष्णवेर मने चमत्कार हैल ॥24॥
cc-antya-1.24.translation: In the morning they looked for the dog, but it could not be found anywhere. All the Vaiṣṇavas were astonished.

devanagari: उत्कण्ठाय च लि’ सबे आइला नीलाचले ।
पूर्ववत् महाप्रभु मिलिला सकले ॥25॥
cc-antya-1.25.translation: Thus in great anxiety they all walked to Jagannātha Purī, where Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu met them as usual.

devanagari: सबा लञा कैला जगन्नाथ दरशन ।
सबा लञा महाप्रभु करेन भोजन ॥26॥
cc-antya-1.26.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went with them to see the Lord in the temple, and on that day He also took lunch in the company of all those devotees.

devanagari: पूर्ववत् सबारे प्रभु पाठाइला वासा - स्थाने ।
प्रभु - ठाञि प्रातः - काले आङ्ला आर दिने ॥27॥
cc-antya-1.27.translation: As previously, the Lord provided them all with residential quarters. And the next morning all the devotees came to see the Lord.

lines: āsiyā dekhila sabe sei ta kukkure
devanagari: आसिया देखिल सबे सेइ त कुक्कुरे ।
प्रभु - पाशे वसियाछे किछु अल्प - दूरे ॥28॥
cc-antya-1.28.translation: When all the devotees came to the place of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, they saw the same dog was sitting a little apart the Lord.

devanagari: प्रसाद नारिकेल - शस्य देन फेला ञा ।
‘राम’ ‘कृष्णा’ ‘हरि’ कह’ - बलेन हासिया ॥29॥
cc-antya-1.29.translation: Furthermore, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was throwing remnants of green coconut pulp to the dog. Smiling in His own way, He was saying to the dog, "Chant the holy names Rāma, Kṛṣṇa, and Hari."

devanagari: श्री - रूप, सनातन भट्ट - रघुनाथ ।
श्री - जीव, गोपाल - भट्ट, दास - रघुनाथ ॥3॥
cc-antya-1.3-4.translation: I pray to the lotus feet of the six Gosvāmīs-Śrī Rūpa, Sanātana, Bhaṭṭa Raghunātha, Śrī Jīva, Gopāla Bhaṭṭa and Dāsa Raghunātha-so that all impediments to my writing this literature will be annihilated and my real desire will be fulfilled.

lines: śasya khāya kukkura, 'kṛṣṇa' kahe bāra bāra
devanagari: शस्य खाय कुक्कुर, ‘कृष्ण’ कहे बार बार ।
देखिया लोकेर मने हैल चमत्कार ॥30॥
cc-antya-1.30.translation: Seeing the dog eating the green coconut pulp and chanting "Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa" again and again, all the devotees present were very much surprised.

devanagari: शिवानन्द कुक्कुर देखि’ दण्डवत्कैला ।
दैन्य करि’ निज अपराध क्षमाइला ॥31॥
cc-antya-1.31.translation: When he saw the dog sitting in that way and chanting the name of Kṛṣṇa, Śivānanda, because of his natural humility, immediately offered his obeisances to the dog just to counteract his offenses to it.

lines: āra dina keha tāra dekhā nā pāilā
devanagari: आर दिन केह तार देखा ना पाइला ।
सिद्ध - देह पाञा कुक्कुर वैकुण्ठेते गेला ॥32॥
cc-antya-1.32.translation: The next day, no one saw that dog, for it had obtained its spiritual body and departed for Vaikuṇṭha, the spiritual kingdom.

devanagari: ऐछे दिव्य - लीला करे शचीर नन्दन ।
कुक्कुरके कृष्ण कहाञा करिला मोचन ॥33॥
cc-antya-1.33.translation: Such are the transcendental pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the son of mother Śacī. He even delivered a dog simply by inducing it to chant the mahā-mantra, Hare Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: एथा प्रभु - आज्ञाय रूप आइला वृन्दावन ।
कृष्ण - लीला - नाटक करिते हैल मन ॥34॥
cc-antya-1.34.translation: Meanwhile, following the order of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī returned to Vṛndāvana. He desired to write dramas concerning the pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: वृन्दावने नाटकेर आरम्भ करिला ।
मङ्गलाचरण ‘नान्दी - श्लोक’ तथाइ लिखिला ॥35॥
cc-antya-1.35.translation: In Vṛndāvana, Rūpa Gosvāmī began to write a drama. In particular, he composed the introductory verses to invoke good fortune.

lines: pathe cali' āise nāṭakera ghaṭanā bhāvite
devanagari: पथे च लि’ आइसे नाटकेर घटना भाविते ।
कड़चा करिया किछु लागिला लिखिते ॥36॥
cc-antya-1.36.translation: On his way to Gauḍa-deśa, Rūpa Gosvāmī had been thinking of how to write the action of the drama. Thus he had made some notes and begun to write.

devanagari: एइ - मते दुइ भाइ गौड़ - देशे आइला ।
गौडे आ सि’ अनुपमेर गङ्गा - प्राप्ति हैला ॥37॥
cc-antya-1.37.translation: In this way the two brothers Rūpa and Anupama reached Bengal, but when they arrived there Anupama died.

devanagari: रूप - गोसाञि प्रभु - पाशे करिला गमन ।
प्रभुरे देखिते ताँर उत्कण्ठित मन ॥38॥
cc-antya-1.38.translation: Rūpa Gosvāmī then departed to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, for he was very eager to see Him.

lines: anupamera lāgi' tāṅra kichu vilamba ha-ila
devanagari: अनुपमेर लागि’ ताँर किछु विलम्ब हइल ।
भक्त - गण - पाश आङ्ला, लाग्ना पाइल ॥39॥
cc-antya-1.39.translation: There was some delay because of the death of Anupama, and therefore when Rūpa Gosvāmī went to Bengal to see the devotees there, he could not get in touch with them because they had already left.

lines: eka rātri sei grāme karilā viśrāma
devanagari: उड़िया - देशे ‘सत्यभामा - पुर’ - नामे ग्राम ।
एक रात्रि सेइ ग्रामे करिला विश्राम ॥40॥
cc-antya-1.40.translation: In the province of Orissa there is a place known as Satyabhāmā-pura. Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī rested for a night in that village on his way to Jagannātha Purī.

lines: sammukhe āsiyā ājñā dilā bahu kṛpā kari'
devanagari: रात्रे स्वप्ने देखे, - एक दिव्य - रूपा नारी ।
सम्मुखे आसिया आज्ञा दिला बहु कृपा करि’ ॥41॥
cc-antya-1.41.translation: While resting in Satyabhāmā-pura, he dreamed that a celestially beautiful woman had come before him and very mercifully gave him the following order.

devanagari: आमार नाटक पृथक् करह रचन।
आमार कृपाते नाटक हैबे विलक्षण” ॥42॥
cc-antya-1.42.translation: "Write a separate drama about me," she said. "By my mercy, it will be extraordinarily beautiful."

devanagari: स्वप्न देखि’ रूप - गोसाञि करिला विचार ।
सत्यभामार आज्ञा - पृथक् नाटक करिबार ॥43॥
cc-antya-1.43.translation: After having that dream, Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī considered, "It is the order of Satyabhāmā that I write a separate drama for her.

lines: dui bhāga kari' ebe karimu racanā
devanagari: ब्रज - पुर - लीला एकत्र करियाछि घटना ।
दुद्ध भाग करि’एबे करिमु रचना ॥44॥
cc-antya-1.44.translation: I have brought together in one work all the pastimes performed by Lord Kṛṣṇa in Vṛndāvana and in Dvārakā. Now I shall have to divide them into two dramas."

devanagari: भाविते भाविते शीघ्र आइला नीलाचले ।
आसि’ उत्तरिला हरिदास - वासा - स्थले ॥45॥
cc-antya-1.45.translation: Thus absorbed in thought, he quickly reached Jagannātha Purī. When he arrived, he approached the hut of Haridāsa Ṭhākura.

devanagari: हरिदास - ठाकुर ताँरे बहु - कृपा कैला ।
‘तुमि आसिबे, - मोरे प्रभु ये कहिला’ ॥46॥
cc-antya-1.46.translation: Out of affectionate love and mercy, Haridāsa Ṭhākura told Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī, "Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu has already informed me that you would come here."

devanagari: ‘उपल - भोग’ देखि’ हरिदासेरे देखिते ।
प्रतिदिन आइसेन, प्रभु आइला आचम्बिते ॥47॥
cc-antya-1.47.translation: After seeing the upala-bhoga ceremony at the Jagannātha temple, Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would regularly come to see Haridāsa every day. Thus He suddenly arrived there.

devanagari: ‘रूप दण्डव त् - करे’, - हरिदास कहिला ।
हरिदासे मि लि’ प्रभु रूपे आलिङ्गिला ॥48॥
cc-antya-1.48.translation: When the Lord arrived, Rūpa Gosvāmī immediately offered his obeisances. Haridāsa informed the Lord, "This is Rūpa Gosvāmī offering You obeisances" and the Lord embraced him.

devanagari: हरिदास - रूपे लञा प्रभुवसिला एक - स्थाने ।
कुशल - प्रश्न, इष्ट - गोष्ठी कैला कत - क्षणे ॥49॥
cc-antya-1.49.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then sat down with Haridāsa and Rūpa Gosvāmī. They inquired from one another about auspicious news, and then continued to talk together for some time.

devanagari: जयतां सुरतौ पङ्गोर्मम मन्द - मतेर्गती ।
मत्सर्वस्व - पदाम्भो जौ राधा - मदन - मोहनौ ॥5॥
cc-antya-1.5.translation: Glory to the all-merciful Rādhā and Madana-mohana! I am lame and ill-advised, yet They are my directors, and Their lotus feet are everything to me.

lines: rūpa kahe,—'ta-ra saṅge dekhā nā ha-ila
devanagari: सनातनेर वार्ता यबे गोसाञि पुछिल ।
रूप कहे , - ‘तार सङ्गे देखा ना हइल ॥50॥
cc-antya-1.50.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu inquired about Sanātana Gosvāmī, Rūpa Gosvāmī replied, "I did not meet him.

lines: ataeva āmāra dekhā nahila tāṅra sāthe
devanagari: आमि गङ्गा - पथे आ इलाङ तिंहो राज - पथे ।
अतएव आमार देखा नहिल ताँर साथे ॥51॥
cc-antya-1.51.translation: I came by the path on the bank of the Ganges, whereas Sanātana Gosvāmī came by the public road. Therefore we did not meet.

devanagari: प्रयागे शुनिलैं, - तेंही गेला वृन्दावने ।
अनुपमेर गङ्गा - प्राप्ति कैल निवेदने” ॥52॥
cc-antya-1.52.translation: "In Prayāga I heard that he had already gone to Vṛndāvana." Rūpa Gosvāmī next informed the Lord about the death of Anupama.

lines: rūpe tāhāṅ vāsā diyā gosāñi calilā
devanagari: रूपे ताहाँ वासा दिया गोसाञि चलिला ।
गोसा ञिर सङ्गी भक्त रूपेरे मिलिला ॥53॥
cc-antya-1.53.translation: After allotting residential quarters there to Rūpa Gosvāmī, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu left. Then all of the Lord's personal associates met Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī.

lines: āra dina mahāprabhu saba bhakta lañā
rūpe milāilā sabāya kṛpā ta' kariyā
devanagari: आर दिन महाप्रभु सब भक्त लञा ।
रूपे मिलाइला सबाय कृपा त’ करिया ॥54॥
cc-antya-1.54.translation: On the next day, Caitanya Mahāprabhu again met Rūpa Gosvāmī, and with great mercy the Lord introduced him to all the devotees.

lines: kṛpā kari' rūpe sabe kailā āliṅgana
devanagari: सबार चरण रूप करिला वन्दन ।
कृपा करि’ रूपे सबे कैला आलिङ्गनः ॥55॥
cc-antya-1.55.translation: Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī offered his respectful obeisances unto the lotus feet of them all, and all the devotees, by their mercy, embraced him.

devanagari: ‘अद्वैत नित्यानन्द, तोमरा दुइ - जने’ ।
प्रभु कहे - रूपे कृपा कर काय - मने ॥56॥
cc-antya-1.56.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu told Advaita Ācārya and Nityānanda Prabhu, "You should both show Your mercy wholeheartedly to Rūpa Gosvāmī.

lines: tomā-duṅhāra kṛpāte iṅhāra ha-u taiche śakti
devanagari: तोमा - दुँहार कृपाते इँहार हउ तैछे शक्ति ।
याते विवरिते पारेन कृष्ण - रस - भक्ति ॥57॥
cc-antya-1.57.translation: May Rūpa Gosvāmī, by Your mercy, become so powerful that he will be able to describe the transcendental mellows of devotional service."

devanagari: गौड़िया, उड़िया, यत प्रभुर भक्त - गण ।
सबार हइल रूप स्नेहेर भाजन ॥58॥
cc-antya-1.58.translation: Thus Rūpa Gosvāmī became the object of love and affection for all the devotees of the Lord, including those who came from Bengal and those who resided in Orissa.

lines: mandire ye prasāda pāna, dena dui jane
devanagari: प्रतिदिन आ सि’ रूपे करेन मिलने ।
मन्दिरे ये प्रसाद पान, देन दुइ जने ॥59॥
cc-antya-1.59.translation: Every day Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would go to see Rūpa Gosvāmī, and whatever prasāda He received from the temple He would deliver to Rūpa Gosvāmī and Haridāsa Ṭhākura.

devanagari: श्रीमद् - रत्नागार - सिंहासन - स्थौ ।
श्रीमद् - राधा - श्रील - गोविन्द - देवौ प्रेष्ठालीभिः सेव्यमानौ स्मरामि ॥6॥
cc-antya-1.6.translation: In a temple of jewels in Vṛndāvana, underneath a desire tree, Śrī Śrī Rādhā-Govinda, served by Their most confidential associates, sit upon an effulgent throne. I offer my humble obeisances unto Them.

devanagari: इष्ट - गोष्ठी दुँहा सने करि’ कत - क्षण ।
मध्याह्न करिते प्रभु करिला गमन ॥60॥
cc-antya-1.60.translation: He would talk for some time with them both and then leave to perform His noontime duties.

devanagari: एइ - मत प्रतिदिन प्रभुर व्यवहार ।
प्रभु - कृपा पाञा रूपेर आनन्द अपार ॥61॥
cc-antya-1.61.translation: In this way Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu's dealings with them continued every day. Thus receiving the transcendental favor of the Lord, Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī felt unlimited pleasure.

devanagari: भक्त - गणा लञा कैला गुण्डिचा मार्जन ।
आइटोटा आ सि’ कैला वन्य - भोजन ॥62॥
cc-antya-1.62.translation: After Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, taking all His devotees with Him, performed the Guṇḍicā-mārjana [washing and cleansing the temple Guṇḍicā], He went to the garden known as Āiṭoṭā and accepted prasāda at a picnic within the garden.

devanagari: प्रसाद खाय, ‘हरि’ बले सर्व - भक्त - जन ।
देखि’ हरिदास - रूपेर हरषित मन ॥63॥
cc-antya-1.63.translation: When Haridāsa Ṭhākura and Rūpa Gosvāmī saw that all the devotees were accepting prasāda and chanting the holy name of Hari, they both were greatly pleased.

devanagari: गोविन्द - द्वारा प्रभुर शेष - प्रसाद पाइला ।
प्रेमे मत दुइ - जन नाचिते लागिला ॥64॥
cc-antya-1.64.translation: When they received the remnants of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's prasāda through Govinda, they respected it, and then they both began to dance in ecstasy.

lines: āra dina prabhu rūpe miliyā vasilā
devanagari: आर दिन प्रभु रूपे मिलिया वसिला ।
सर्वज्ञ - शिरोमणि प्रभु कहिते लागिला ॥65॥
cc-antya-1.65.translation: On the next day, when Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to see Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī, the omniscient Lord spoke as follows.

lines: vraja chāḍi' kṛṣṇa kabhu nā yāna kāhāṅte
devanagari: ‘कृष्णेरे बाहिर नाहि करिह व्रज हैते ।
व्रज छा ड़ि’ कृष्ण कभुना यान काहाँते ॥66॥
cc-antya-1.66.translation: Do not try to take Kṛṣṇa out of Vṛndāvana, for He does not go anywhere else at any time.

devanagari: कृष्णोऽन्यो यदु - सम्भूतो यः पूर्णः सोऽस्त्यतः परः ।
वृन्दावनं परित्यज्य स क्वचित्रैव गच्छति ॥67॥
cc-antya-1.67.translation: “ 'The Kṛṣṇa known as Yadukumāra is Vāsudeva Kṛṣṇa. He is different from the Kṛṣṇa who is the son of Nanda Mahārāja. Yadukumāra Kṛṣṇa manifests His pastimes in the cities of Mathurā and Dvārakā, but Kṛṣṇa the son of Nanda Mahārāja never at any time leaves Vṛndāvana.' "

devanagari: एत क हि’ महाप्रभु मध्याहे चलिला ।
रूप - गोसाञि मने किछु विस्मय हइला ॥68॥
cc-antya-1.68.translation: After saying this, Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to perform His noontime duties, leaving Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī somewhat surprised.

lines: jānilu, pṛthak nāṭaka karite prabhu-ājñā haila
devanagari: “पृथक् नाटक करिते सत्यभामा आज्ञा दिल ।
जानिलु, पृथक् नाटक करिते प्रभु - आज्ञा हैल ॥69॥
cc-antya-1.69.translation: "Satyabhāmā ordered me to write two different dramas," Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī thought. "Now I understand that this order has been confirmed by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: श्रीमान् रास - रसारम्भी वंशीवट - तट - स्थितः ।
कर्षन् वेणु - स्वनैर्गोपीर्गोपी - नाथः श्रियेऽस्तु नः ॥7॥
cc-antya-1.7.translation: Śrī Śrīla Gopīnātha, who originated the transcendental mellow of the rāsa dance, stands on the shore at Vaṁśīvaṭa and attracts the attention of the cowherd damsels with the sound of His celebrated flute. May they all confer upon us their benediction.

lines: pūrve dui nāṭaka chila ekatra racanā
devanagari: पूर्वे दुइ नाटक छिल एकत्र रचना ।
दुहू - भाग करिएबे करिमु घटना ॥70॥
cc-antya-1.70.translation: Formerly I wrote the two dramas as one composition. Now I shall divide it and describe the incidents in two separate works.

devanagari: दुइ ‘नान्दी’ ‘प्रस्तावना’, दुइ ‘संघटना’ ।
पृथक्करिया लिखि करिया भावना ॥71॥
cc-antya-1.71.translation: I shall write two separate invocations of good fortune and two different introductions. Let me think deeply about the matter and then describe two different sets of incidents."

devanagari: रथ - यात्राय जगन्नाथ दर्शन करिला ।
रथ - अग्रे प्रभुर नृत्य - कीर्तन देखिला ॥72॥
cc-antya-1.72.translation: During the Ratha-yātrā ceremony Rūpa Gosvāmī saw Lord Jagannātha. He also saw Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu dancing and chanting in front of the ratha.

lines: sei ślokārtha lañā śloka karilā tathāi
devanagari: प्रभुर नृत्य - श्लोक शुनि’ श्री - रूप - गोसाञि ।
सेइ श्लोकार्थ लञा श्लोक करिला तथाइ ॥73॥
cc-antya-1.73.translation: When Rūpa Gosvāmī heard a verse uttered by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu during the ceremony, he immediately composed another verse dealing with the same subject.

lines: pūrve sei saba kathā kariyāchi varṇana
devanagari: पूर्वे सेइ सब कथा करियाछि वर्णन ।
तथापि कहिये किछु सङ्क्षेपे कथन ॥74॥
cc-antya-1.74.translation: I have already described all these incidents, but I still wish to add briefly something more.

lines: sāmānya eka śloka prabhu paḍena kīrtane
kene śloka paḍe—ihā keha nāhi jāne
devanagari: सामान्य एक श्लोक प्रभु पड़ेन कीर्तने ।
केने श्लोक पड़े - इहा केह नाहि जाने ॥75॥
cc-antya-1.75.translation: Generally Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu recited a verse while dancing and chanting before the ratha, but no one knew why He was reciting that particular verse.

lines: sabe ekā svarūpa gosāñi ślokera artha jāne
devanagari: सबे एका स्वरूप गोसाञि श्लोकेर अर्थ जाने ।
श्लोकानुरूप पद प्रभुके करान आस्वादने ॥76॥
cc-antya-1.76.translation: Only Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī knew the purpose for which the Lord recited that verse. According to the Lord's attitude, he used to quote other verses to enable the Lord to relish mellows.

lines: sei arthe śloka kailā prabhure ye bhāya
devanagari: रूप - गोसाञि प्रभुर जानिया अभिप्राय ।
सेइ अर्थे श्लोक कैला प्रभुरे ये भाय ॥77॥
cc-antya-1.77.translation: Rūpa Gosvāmī, however, could understand the intention of the Lord, and thus he composed another verse that appealed to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: yaḥ kaumāra-haraḥ sa eva hi varas tā eva caitra-kṣapās
devanagari: सा चैवास्मि तथापि तत्र सुरत - व्यापार - लीला - विधौ।
रेवा - रोधसि वेतसी - तरु - तले चेतः समुत्कण्ठते ॥78॥
cc-antya-1.78.translation: That very personality who stole my heart during my youth is now again my master. These are the same moonlit nights of the month of Caitra. The same fragrance of mālatī flowers is there, and the same sweet breezes are blowing from the kadamba forest. In our intimate relationship, I am also the same lover, yet still my mind is not happy here. I am eager to go back to that place on the bank of the Revā under the Vetasī tree. That is my desire."

lines: tathāhaṁ sā rādhā tad idam ubhayoḥ saṅgama-sukham
devanagari: प्रियः सोऽयं कृष्णः सह - चरि कुरु - क्षेत्र - मिलितस् तथाहं सा राधा तदिदमुभयोः सङ्गम - सुखम् ।
तथाप्य न्तः - खेलन्मधुर - मुरली - पञ्चम - जुषे मनो मे कालिन्दी - पुलिन - विपिनाय स्पृहयति ॥79॥
cc-antya-1.79.translation: My dear friend, now I have met My very old and dear friend Kṛṣṇa on this field of Kurukṣetra. I am the same Rādhārāṇī, and now We are meeting together. It is very pleasant, but I would still like to go to the bank of the Yamunā beneath the trees of the forest there. I wish to hear the vibration of His sweet flute playing the fifth note within that forest of Vṛndāvana."

devanagari: जय जय श्री - चैतन्य जय नित्यानन्द ।
जयाद्वैत - चन्द्र जय गौर - भक्त - वृन्द ॥8॥
cc-antya-1.8.translation: All glories to Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu! All glories to Lord Nityānanda! All glories to Advaita Ācārya! All glories to the devotees of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu!

devanagari: ताल - पत्रे श्लोक लिखि’ चालेते राखिला ।
समुद्र - स्नान करिबारे रूप - गोसाञि गेला ॥80॥
cc-antya-1.80.translation: After writing this verse on a palm leaf, Rūpa Gosvāmī put it somewhere in his thatched roof and went to bathe in the sea.

lines: cāle śloka dekhi prabhu lāgilā paḍite
devanagari: हेन - काले प्रभु आइला ताँहारे मिलिते ।
चाले श्लोक देखि प्रभु लागिला पड़िते ॥81॥
cc-antya-1.81.translation: At that time, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went there to meet him, and when He saw the leaf pushed into the roof and saw the verse, He began to read it.

lines: śloka paḍi' prabhu sukhe premāviṣṭa hailā
devanagari: श्लोक प ड़ि’ प्रभु सुखे प्रेमाविष्ट हैला ।
हेन - काले रूप - गोसाञि स्नान करि’ आह्वला ॥82॥
cc-antya-1.82.translation: After reading the verse, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was overwhelmed by ecstatic love. At that very time, Rūpa Gosvāmī returned, having finished bathing in the sea.

lines: prabhu tāṅre cāpaḍa māri' kahite lāgilā
devanagari: प्रभु देखि’ दण्डवत्प्राङ्गणे पड़िला ।
प्रभु ताँरे चापड़ मारि’ कहते लागिला ॥83॥
cc-antya-1.83.translation: Seeing the Lord, Śrī Rūpa Gosvāmī fell flat in the courtyard to offer obeisances. The Lord slapped him mildly in love and spoke as follows.

lines: eta kahi' rūpe kailā dṛḍha āliṅgane
devanagari: ‘गूढ़ मोर हृदय तुञि जानिला केमने ?’ ।
एत क हि’ रूपे कैला दृढ़ आलिङ्गने ॥84॥
cc-antya-1.84.translation: My heart is very confidential. How did you know My mind in this way?" After saying this, He firmly embraced Rūpa Gosvāmī.

lines: sei śloka lañā prabhu svarūpe dekhāilā
devanagari: सेइ श्लोक लञा प्रभु स्वरूपे देखाइला ।
स्वरूपेर परीक्षा ला गि’ ताँहारे पुछिला ॥85॥
cc-antya-1.85.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu took that verse and showed it to Svarūpa Dāmodara for him to examine. Then the Lord questioned him.

devanagari: ‘मोर अन्तर - वार्ता रूप जानिल केमने?’ ।
स्वरूप कहे - जानि, कृपा करियाछ आपने ॥86॥
cc-antya-1.86.translation: How could Rūpa Gosvāmī have understood My heart?" the Lord asked. Svarūpa Dāmodara replied, "I can understand that You have already bestowed Your causeless mercy upon him.

lines: anyathā e artha kāra nāhi haya jñāna
tumi pūrve kṛpā kailā, kari anumāna"
devanagari: अन्यथा ए अर्थ कार नाहि हय ज्ञान ।
तुमि पूर्वे कृपा कैला, करि अनुमान ॥87॥
cc-antya-1.87.translation: No one could otherwise understand this meaning. I can therefore guess that previously You bestowed upon him Your causeless mercy."

lines: yogya-pātra jāni iṅhāya mora kṛpā ta' ha-ila
devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - “इँहो आमाय प्रयागे मिलिल ।
योग्य - पात्र जानि इँहाय मोर कृपा त’ हइल” ॥88॥
cc-antya-1.88.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "Rūpa Gosvāmī met Me at Prayāga. Knowing him to be a suitable person, I naturally bestowed My mercy upon him.

lines: tabe śakti sañcāri' āmi kailuṅ upadeśa
devanagari: तबे शक्ति सञ्चा रि’ आमि कैलुँ उपदेश ।
तुमिह कहिओ इहाँय रसेर विशेष” ॥89॥
cc-antya-1.89.translation: I thereupon also bestowed upon him My transcendental potency. Now you also should give him instructions. In particular, instruct him in transcendental mellows."

devanagari: मध्य - लीला सड्गाक्षेपेते करिलें वर्णन ।
अन्त्य - लीला - वर्णन किछु शुन, भक्त - गण ॥9॥
cc-antya-1.9.translation: I have briefly described the pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu in the madhya-līlā. Now I shall attempt to describe something about His last pastimes, which are known as the antya-līlā.

devanagari: स्वरूप कहे - “याते एइ श्लोक देखिलुँ ।
तुमि करियाछ कृपा, तबँहि जानिलु” ॥90॥
cc-antya-1.90.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara said, "As soon as I saw the unique composition of this verse, I could immediately understand that You had bestowed upon him Your special mercy.

devanagari: फलेन फल - कारणमनुष्मीयते ॥91॥
cc-antya-1.91.translation: By seeing a result, one can understand the cause of that result.'

devanagari: स्वर्गापगा - हेम - मृणालिनीनां नाना - मृणालाग्र - भुजो भजामः ।
अन्नानुरूपां तनु - रूप - ऋद्धिं कार्यं निदानाद्धि गुणानधीते ॥92॥
cc-antya-1.92.translation: The River Ganges flowing from the heavenly planets is full of golden lotus flowers, and we, the residents of those planets, eat the stems of the flowers. Thus we are very beautiful, more so than the inhabitants of any other planet. This is due to the law of cause and effect, for if one eats food in the mode of goodness, the mode of goodness increases the beauty of his body.' "

devanagari: चातुर्मास्य रहि’ गौड़े वैष्णव चलिला ।
रूप - गोसाञि महाप्रभुर चरणे रहिला ॥93॥
cc-antya-1.93.translation: After the four months of Cāturmāsya [Śrāvaṇa, Bhādra, Āśvina and Kārttika], all the Vaiṣṇavas of Bengal returned to their homes, but Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī remained in Jagannātha Purī under the shelter of the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: एक - दिन रूप करेन नाटक लिखन ।
आचम्बिते महाप्रभुर हैल आगमन ॥94॥
cc-antya-1.94.translation: One day while Rūpa Gosvāmī was writing his book, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu suddenly appeared.

devanagari: सम्भ्रमे दुँहे उठि’ दण्डवत् हैला ।
दुँहे आलिङ्गिया प्रभु आसने वसिला ॥95॥
cc-antya-1.95.translation: As soon as Haridāsa Ṭhākura and Rūpa Gosvāmī saw the Lord coming, they both stood up and then fell down to offer Him their respectful obeisances. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu embraced them both and then sat down.

lines: akṣara dekhiyā prabhu mane sukhī hailā
devanagari: ‘क्या पुंथि लिख?’ बलि’ एक - पत्र निला ।
अक्षर देखिया प्रभु मने सुखी हैला ॥96॥
cc-antya-1.96.translation: The Lord inquired, "What kind of book are you writing?" He held up a palm leaf that was a page of the manuscript, and when He saw the fine handwriting, His mind was very pleased.

lines: prīta hañā karena prabhu akṣarera stuti
devanagari: श्री - रूपेर अक्षर - येन मुकुतार पाँति ।
प्रीत हञा करेन प्रभु अक्षरेर स्तुति ॥97॥
cc-antya-1.97.translation: Thus being pleased, the Lord praised the writing by saying, "The handwriting of Rūpa Gosvāmī is just like rows of pearls."

lines: sei patre prabhu eka śloka ye dekhilā
devanagari: सेइ पत्रे प्रभु एक श्लोक ये देखिला ।
पड़ितेइ श्लोक, प्रेमे आविष्ट हइला ॥98॥
cc-antya-1.98.translation: While reading the manuscript, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu saw a verse on that page, and as soon as He read it He was overwhelmed by ecstatic love.
