lines: no jāne janitā kiyadbhir amṛtaiḥ kṛṣṇeti varṇa-dvayī
devanagari: तुण्डे ताण्डविनी रतिं वितनुते तुण्डावली - लब्धये कर्ण - क्रोड़ - कडुम्बिनी घटयते कर्णार्बुदेभ्यः स्पृहाम् ।
चेतः - प्राङ्गण - सङ्गिनी विजयते सर्वेन्द्रिया णां नो जाने जनिता कियद्भिरमृतैः कृष्णेति वर्ण - द्वयी ॥99॥
cc-antya-1.99.translation: "I do not know how much nectar the two syllables 'Kṛṣ-ṇa' have produced. When the holy name of Kṛṣṇa is chanted, it appears to dance within the mouth. We then desire many, many mouths. When that name enters the holes of the ears, we desire many millions of ears. And when the holy name dances in the courtyard of the heart, it conquers the activities of the mind, and therefore all the senses become inert."

lines: vande 'haṁ śrī-guroḥ śrī-yuta-pada-kamalaṁ śrī-gurūn vaiṣṇavāṁś ca
devanagari: वन्देऽहं श्री - गुरोः श्री - युत - पद - कमलं श्री - गुरून्वैष्णवांश्च श्री - रूपं साग्रजातं सह - गण - रघुनाथान्वितं तं स - जीवम् ।
साद्वैतं सावधूतं परिजन - सहितं कृष्ण - चैतन्य - देवं श्री - राष्धा - कृष्णा - पादान्सह - गण - ललिता - श्री - विशाखान्वितांश्च ॥1॥
cc-antya-2.1.translation: I offer my respectful obeisances unto the lotus feet of my spiritual master and of all the other preceptors on the path of devotional service. I offer my respectful obeisances unto all the Vaiṣṇavas and unto the six Gosvāmīs, including Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī, Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī, Jīva Gosvāmī and their associates. I offer my respectful obeisances unto Śrī Advaita Ācārya Prabhu, Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and all His devotees, headed by Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura. I then offer my respectful obeisances unto the lotus feet of Lord Kṛṣṇa, Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī and all the gopīs, headed by Lalitā and Viśākhā.

devanagari: सप्त - द्वीपेर लोक आर नव - खण्ड - वासी ।
देव, गन्धर्व, किन्नर मनुष्य - वेशे आ सि’ ॥10॥
cc-antya-2.10.translation: People from all over the universe, including the seven islands, the nine khaṇḍas, the planets of the demigods, Gandharvaloka and Kinnaraloka, would go there in the forms of human beings.

devanagari: लज्जा - भय पाञा आचार्य मौन हइला ।
आर दिन गोपालेरे देशे पाठाइला ॥100॥
cc-antya-2.100.translation: Thus Bhagavān Ācārya, greatly ashamed and fearful, remained silent. The next day, he asked Gopāla Bhaṭṭācārya to return to his own district.

lines: ghare bhāta kari' kare vividha vyañjana
devanagari: एक - दिन आचार्य प्रभुरे कैला निमन्त्रण ।
घरे भात करि’ करे विविध व्यञ्ज न ॥101॥
cc-antya-2.101.translation: One day Bhagavān Ācārya invited Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to dine at his home. Thus he was preparing rice and various types of vegetables.

devanagari: “छोट - हरिदास” नाम प्रभुर कीर्तनीया ।
ताहारे कहेन आचार्य डाकि या आनिया ॥102॥
cc-antya-2.102.translation: A devotee named Choṭa Haridāsa used to sing for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Bhagavān Ācārya called him to his home and spoke as follows.

devanagari: “मोर नामे शिखि - माहितिर भगिनी - स्थाने गिया ।
शुक्ल - चाउल एक मान आनह मागिया” ॥103॥
cc-antya-2.103.translation: "Please go to the sister of Śikhi Māhiti. In my name, ask her for a māna of white rice and bring it here."

devanagari: माहितिर भगिनी सेइ, नाम - माधवी - देवी ।
वृद्धा तपस्विनी आर परमा वैष्णवी ॥104॥
cc-antya-2.104.translation: Śikhi Māhiti's sister was named Mādhavīdevī. She was an elderly lady who always performed austerities. She was very advanced in devotional service.

devanagari: प्रभु लेखा करे यारे - राधिकार ‘गण’ ।
जगतेर मध्ये ‘पात्र’ - साड़े तिन जन ॥105॥
cc-antya-2.105.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu accepted her as having formerly been an associate of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī. In the entire world, three and a half people were His intimate devotees.

devanagari: स्वरूप गोसा ञि, आर राय रामानन्द ।
शिखि - माहिति - तिन, ताँर भगिनी - अर्ध - जन ॥106॥
cc-antya-2.106.translation: The three were Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, Rāmānanda Rāya and Śikhi Māhiti, and the half a person was Śikhi Māhiti's sister.

lines: tāṅra ṭhāñi taṇḍula māgi' ānila haridāsa
devanagari: ताँर ठाञि तण्डुल मागि’ आनिल हरिदास ।
तण्डुल देखि’ आचार्येर अधिक उल्लास ॥107॥
cc-antya-2.107.translation: After begging the rice from her, Junior Haridāsa brought it to Bhagavān Ācārya, who was very pleased to see its quality.

lines: snehe rāndhila prabhura priya ye vyañjana
devanagari: स्नेहे रान्धिल प्रभुर प्रिय ये व्यञ्जन ।
देउल प्रसाद, आदा - चाकि, लेम्बु - सलवण ॥108॥
cc-antya-2.108.translation: In great affection, Bhagavān Ācārya cooked varieties of vegetables and other preparations dear to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. He also obtained remnants of food from Lord Jagannātha and digestive aids such as ground ginger and also lime with salt.

devanagari: मध्याह्ने आसिया प्रभु भोजने वसिला ।
शाल्यन्न देखि’ प्रभु आचाये पुछिला ॥109॥
cc-antya-2.109.translation: At noon, when Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu came to eat the offerings of Bhagavān Ācārya, He first appreciated the fine rice and therefore questioned him.

lines: kṛṣṇa bali' nāce saba premāviṣṭa hañā
devanagari: प्रभुरे देखिया याय ‘वैष्णव’ हञा ।
कृष्ण बलि’ नाचे सब प्रेमाविष्ट हञा ॥11॥
cc-antya-2.11.translation: Having seen the Lord, they all became Vaiṣṇavas. Thus they danced and chanted the Hare Kṛṣṇa mantra in ecstatic love of Godhead.

lines: uttama anna eta taṇḍula kāṅhāte pāilā?
devanagari: उत्तम अन्न एत तण्डुल काँहाते पाइला ? ।
आचार्य कहे , - माधवी - पाश मागिया आनिला ॥110॥
cc-antya-2.110.translation: "Where did you get such fine rice?" the Lord asked. Bhagavān Ācārya replied, "I got it by begging from Mādhavīdevī."

devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - ‘कोन् याइ’ मागिया आनिल ?’ ।
छोट - हरिदासेर नाम आचार्य कहिल ॥111॥
cc-antya-2.111.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu asked who had begged the rice and brought it back, Bhagavān Ācārya mentioned the name of Junior Haridāsa.

devanagari: अन्न प्रशंसिया प्रभु भोजन करिला ।
निज - गृहे आसि’ गोविन्देरे आज्ञा दिला ॥112॥
cc-antya-2.112.translation: Praising the quality of the rice, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu partook of the prasāda. Then, after returning to His residence, He gave the following order to Govinda, His personal assistant.

lines: choṭa haridāse ihāṅ āsite nā dibā'
devanagari: “आजि हैते ए इ मोर आज्ञा पालिबा ।
छोट हरिदासे इहाँ आसिते ना दिबा” ॥113॥
cc-antya-2.113.translation: " From this day forward, do not allow Choṭa Haridāsa to come here."

lines: dvāra mānā haila, haridāsa duḥkhī haila mane
ki lāgiyā dvāra-mānā keha nāhi jāne
devanagari: द्वार माना हैल, हरिदास दु:खी हैल मने ।
कि लागिया द्वार - माना केह नाहि जाने ॥114॥
cc-antya-2.114.translation: When Junior Haridāsa heard that he had been ordered not to approach Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, he was very unhappy. No one could understand why he had been ordered not to come.

devanagari: तिन - दिन हैल हरिदास करे उपवास ।
स्वरूपादि आसि, पुछिला महाप्रभुर पाश ॥115॥
cc-antya-2.115.translation: Haridāsa fasted continuously for three days. Then Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī and other confidential devotees approached Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to inquire from Him.

devanagari: “कोनपराध, प्रभु, कैल हरिदास ? ।
कि लागिया द्वार - माना, करे उपवास ?” ॥116॥
cc-antya-2.116.translation: "What great offense has Junior Haridāsa committed? Why has he been forbidden to come to Your door? He has now been fasting for three days."

lines: dekhite nā pāroṅ āmi tāhāra vadana
devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - वैरागी करे प्रकृति सम्भाषण ।
देखिते ना पारों आमि ताहार वदन ॥117॥
cc-antya-2.117.translation: The Lord replied, "I cannot tolerate seeing the face of a person who has accepted the renounced order of life but who still talks intimately with a woman.

devanagari: दुर्वार इन्द्रिय करे विषय - ग्रहण ।
दारवी प्रकृति हरे मुनेरपि मन ॥118॥
cc-antya-2.118.translation: "So strongly do the senses adhere to the objects of their enjoyment that indeed a wooden statue of a woman attracts the mind of even a great saintly person.

devanagari: मात्रा स्वस्त्रा दुहित्रा वा ना विविक्तासनो भवेत् ।
बलवानिन्द्रिय - ग्रामो विद्वांसमपि कर्षति ॥119॥
cc-antya-2.119.translation: “ 'One should not sit closely with one's mother, sister or daughter, for the senses are so strong that they may attract even a person advanced in knowledge.'

lines: ye keha āsite nāre aneka saṁsārī
devanagari: एइ - मत दर्शने त्रिजगत् निस्तारि ।
ये केह आसिते नारे अनेक संसारी ॥12॥
cc-antya-2.12.translation: Thus by direct meetings, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu delivered the three worlds. Some people, however, could not go and were entangled in material activities.

devanagari: क्षुद्र - जीव सब मकर् ट - वैराग्य करिया ।
इन्द्रिय चराञा बुले ‘प्रकृति’ सम्भाषिया ॥120॥
cc-antya-2.120.translation: "There are many persons with little in their possession who accept the renounced order of life like monkeys. They go here and there engaging in sense gratification and speaking intimately with women."

lines: gosāñira āveśa dekhi' sabe mauna hailā
devanagari: एत क हि’ महाप्रभु अभ्यन्तरे गेला ।
गोसा ञिर आवेश देखि’ सबे मौन हैला ॥121॥
cc-antya-2.121.translation: After saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu entered His room. Seeing Him in such an angry mood, all the devotees fell silent.

lines: āra dine sabe meli' prabhura caraṇe
devanagari: आर दिने सबे मे लि’ प्रभुर चरणे ।
हरिदास लागि, किछु कैला निवेदने ॥122॥
cc-antya-2.122.translation: The next day, all the devotees together approached the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to submit an appeal on behalf of Junior Haridāsa.

lines: ebe śikṣā ha-ila nā karibe aparādha"
devanagari: “अल्प अपराध, प्रभु करह प्रसाद ।
एबे शिक्षा हइल ना करिबे अपराध” ॥123॥
cc-antya-2.123.translation: "Haridāsa has committed a small offense," they said. "Therefore, O Lord, please be merciful to him. Now he has received a sufficient lesson. In the future he will not commit such a offense."

lines: prabhu kahe,—"mora vaśa nahe mora mana
devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - मोर वश नहे मोर मन ।
प्रकृति - सम्भाषी वैरागी ना करे दर्शन ॥124॥
cc-antya-2.124.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "My mind is not under My control. It does not like to see anyone in the renounced order who talks intimately with women.

lines: nija kārye yāha sabe, chāḍa vṛthā kathā
punaḥ yadi kaha āmā nā dekhibe hethā"
devanagari: निज कार्ये या ह सबे, छाड़ वृथा कथा ।
पुनः यदि कह आमा ना देखिबे हेथा” ॥125॥
cc-antya-2.125.translation: "You should all tend to your respective engagements. Give up this useless talk. If you speak this way again, I shall go away, and you will no longer see Me here."

lines: eta śuni' sabe nija-karṇe hasta diyā
nija nija kārye sabe gela ta' uṭhiyā
devanagari: एत शुनि’ सबे निज - कर्ण हस्त दिया ।
निज निज कार्ये सबे गेल त’ उठिया ॥126॥
cc-antya-2.126.translation: Hearing this, all the devotees covered their ears with their hands, got up and went about their respective duties.

lines: bujhana nā yāya ei mahāprabhura līlā
devanagari: महाप्रभु मध्याह्न करिते चलि, गेला ।
बुझन ना याय एइ महाप्रभुर लीला ॥127॥
cc-antya-2.127.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu also left that place to perform His noon duties. No one could understand His pastimes.

devanagari: आर दिन सबे परमानन्द - पुरी - स्थाने ।
‘प्रभुके प्रसन्न कर’ - कैला निवेदने ॥128॥
cc-antya-2.128.translation: The next day, all the devotees went to Śrī Paramānanda Purī and requested him to pacify the Lord.

devanagari: तबे पुरी - गोसा ञि एका प्रभु - स्थाने आइला ।
नमस्क रि’ प्रभु ताँरे सम्भ्रमे वसाइला ॥129॥
cc-antya-2.129.translation: Paramānanda Purī thereupon went alone to the residence of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. The Lord, after offering him obeisances, seated him by His side with great respect.

lines: tā-sabā tārite prabhu sei saba deśe
devanagari: ता - सबा तारिते प्रभु सेइ सब देशे ।
.योग्य - भक्त जीव - देहे करेन ‘आवेशे’ ॥13॥
cc-antya-2.13.translation: To deliver people in regions throughout the universe who could not meet Him, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu personally entered the bodies of pure devotees.

devanagari: पुछिला, - कि आज्ञा, केने हैल आगमन ? ।
‘हरिदासे प्रसाद ला गि’ कैला निवेदन ॥130॥
cc-antya-2.130.translation: The Lord inquired, "What is your order? For what purpose have you come here?" Paramānanda Purī then submitted his prayer that the Lord show favor to Junior Haridāsa.

lines: saba vaiṣṇava lañā tumi raha ei ṭhāñi
devanagari: शुनिया कहेन प्रभु, - “शुनह, गोसा ञि ।
सब वैष्णव ल ञा तुमि रह एइ ठाञि” ॥131॥
cc-antya-2.131.translation: Hearing this request, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "My dear lord, please hear me. It is better for you to stay here with all the Vaiṣṇavas.

lines: more ājñā haya, muñi yāṅa ālālanātha
devanagari: मोरे आज्ञा हय, मुञि याइ आलालनाथ ।
एकले रहिब ताहाँ, गोविन्द - मात्र साथ” ॥132॥
cc-antya-2.132.translation: "Please give Me permission to go to Ālālanātha. I shall remain there alone; only Govinda will go with Me."

lines: eta bali' prabhu yadi govinde bolāilā
devanagari: एत ब लि’ प्रभु यदि गोविन्दे बोलाइला ।
पुरीरे नमस्कार क रि’ उठिया चलिला ॥133॥
cc-antya-2.133.translation: After saying this, the Lord called for Govinda. Offering obeisances to Paramānanda Purī, He got up and began to leave.

devanagari: आस्ते - व्यस्ते पुरी - गोसाञि प्रभु आगे गेला ।
अनुनय करि’ प्रभुरे घरे वसाइला ॥134॥
cc-antya-2.134.translation: In great haste Paramānanda Purī Gosāñi went before Him and with great humility persuaded Him to sit down in His own room.

lines: kebā ki balite pāre tomāra upara?
devanagari: “तोमार ये इच्छा, कर, स्वतन्त्र ईश्वर ।
केबा कि बलिते पारे तोमार उपर ? ॥135॥
cc-antya-2.135.translation: Paramānanda Purī said, "My dear Lord Caitanya, You are the independent Personality of Godhead. You can do whatever You like. Who can say anything above You?

lines: āmi saba nā jāni gambhīra hṛdaya tomāra"
devanagari: लोक - हित ला गि’ तोमार सब व्यवहार ।
आमि सब ना जानि गम्भीर हृदय तोमार” ॥136॥
cc-antya-2.136.translation: "All Your activities are for the benefit of people in general. We cannot understand them, for Your intentions are deep and grave."

devanagari: एत ब लि’ पुरी - गोसा ञि गेला निज - स्थाने ।
हरिदास - स्थाने गेला सब भक्त - गणे ॥137॥
cc-antya-2.137.translation: After saying this, Paramānanda Purī Gosāñi left for his own home. Then all the devotees went to see Junior Haridāsa.

lines: sabe tomāra hita vāñchi, karaha viśvāsa
devanagari: स्वरूप - गोसा ञि कहे, - “शुन, हरिदास ।
सबे तोमार हित वाञ्छि, करह विश्वास” ॥138॥
cc-antya-2.138.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosāñi said, "Please hear us, Haridāsa, for we all wish you well. Please believe this.

lines: kabhu kṛpā karibena yāte dayālu antara
devanagari: प्रभु हठे पड़ियाछे स्वतन्त्र ईश्वर ।
कभु कृपा करिबेन याते दयालु अन्तर ॥139॥
cc-antya-2.139.translation: "At present Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is persisting in His mood of anger because He is the independent Supreme Personality of Godhead. At some time, however, He will surely be merciful, for at heart He is very kind.

devanagari: सेइ जीवे निज - भक्ति करेन प्रकाशे ।
ताहार दर्शने ‘वैष्णव’ हय सर्व - देशे ॥14॥
cc-antya-2.14.translation: Thus He empowered living beings [His pure devotees] by manifesting in them so much of His own devotion that people in all other countries became devotees by seeing them.

lines: tumi haṭha kaile tāṅra haṭha se bāḍibe
snāna bhojana kara, āpane krodha yābe"
devanagari: तुमि हठ कैले ताँ र हठ से बाड़िबे ।
स्नान भोजन कर, आपने क्रोध या बे” ॥140॥
cc-antya-2.140.translation: "The Lord is persisting, and if you also persist, His persistence will increase. It is better for you to bathe and take prasāda. In due course, His anger will automatically subside."

lines: eta bali tāre snāna bhojana karāñā
devanagari: एत बलि तारे स्नान भोजन करा ञा ।
आपन भवन आइ ला तारे आश्वासिया ॥141॥
cc-antya-2.141.translation: Having said this, Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī induced Haridāsa to bathe and take prasāda. After thus reassuring him, he returned home.

devanagari: प्रभु यदि यान जगन्नाथ - दरशने ।
दूरे रहि’ हरिदास करेन दर्शने ॥142॥
cc-antya-2.142.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to see Lord Jagannātha in the temple, Haridāsa would stay a long distance away and see Him.

lines: priya bhakte daṇḍa karena dharma bujhāite
devanagari: महाप्रभु - कृपा - सिन्धु, के पारे बुझिते? ।
प्रिय भक्ते दण्ड करेन धर्म बुझाइते ॥143॥
cc-antya-2.143.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is the ocean of mercy. Who can understand Him? When He chastises His dear devotees, He certainly does so to reestablish the principles of religion or duty.

devanagari: देखि’ त्रास उपजिल सब भक्त - गणे ।
स्वप्ने - ह छाड़िल सबे स्त्री - सम्भाषणे ॥144॥
cc-antya-2.144.translation: After all the devotees saw this example, a mentality of fear grew among them. Therefore they all stopped talking with women, even in dreams.

devanagari: एइ - मते हरिदासेर एक वत्सर गेल ।
तबु महाप्रभुर मने प्रसाद नहिल ॥145॥
cc-antya-2.145.translation: In this way a complete year passed for Junior Haridāsa, but still there was not a sign of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's mercy toward him.

lines: prayāgete gela kāreha kichu nā baliyā
devanagari: रात्रि अवशेषे प्रभुरे दण्डवत् हञा ।
प्रयागेते गेल कारेह किछु ना बलिया ॥146॥
cc-antya-2.146.translation: Thus at the end of one night, Junior Haridāsa, after offering Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu his respectful obeisances, departed for Prayāga without saying anything to anyone.

devanagari: प्रभु - पद - प्राप्ति ला गि’ सङ्कल्प करिल ।
त्रिवेणी प्रवेश करि’ प्राण छाड़िल ॥147॥
cc-antya-2.147.translation: Junior Haridāsa had conclusively decided to attain shelter at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Thus he entered deep into the water at Triveṇī, the confluence of the Ganges and Yamunā at Prayāga, and in this way gave up his life.

devanagari: सेइ - क्षणे दिव्य - देहे प्रभु - स्थाने आइला ।
प्रभु - कृपा पाञा अन्तर्धानेइ रहिला ॥148॥
cc-antya-2.148.translation: Immediately after committing suicide in this way, he went in his spiritual body to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and received the mercy of the Lord. However, he still remained invisible.

lines: rātrye prabhure śunāya gīta, anye nāhi jāne
devanagari: गन्धर्व - देहे गान करेन अन्तर्धाने ।
रात्र्ये प्रभुरे शुनाय गीत, अन्ये नाहि जाने ॥149॥
cc-antya-2.149.translation: In a spiritual body resembling that of a Gandharva, Junior Haridāsa, although invisible, would sing at night for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to hear. No one but the Lord, however, knew of this.

lines: gauḍe yaiche āveśa, kari dig daraśana
devanagari: एड़ - मत आवेशे तारिल त्रिभुवन ।
गौड़े यैछे आवेश, करि दिग्दरशन ॥15॥
cc-antya-2.15.translation: In this way Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu delivered the entire three worlds, not only by His personal presence but also by empowering others. I shall briefly describe how He empowered a living being in Bengal.

devanagari: एक - दिन महाप्रभु पुछिला भक्त - गणे ।
‘हरिदास काँहा ? तारे आनह एखाने’ ॥150॥
cc-antya-2.150.translation: One day Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu inquired from the devotees, "Where is Haridāsa? Now you may bring him here."

lines: rātre uṭhi kāṅhā gelā, keha nāhi jāne"
devanagari: सबे कहे , - “हरिदास वर्ष - पूर्ण दिने ।
रात्रे उठि काँहा गेला, केह नाहि जाने” ॥151॥
cc-antya-2.151.translation: The devotees all replied, "One night at the end of a full year, Junior Haridāsa got up and went away. No one knows where he has gone."

devanagari: शुनि’ महाप्रभु ईषत् हासिया रहिला ।
सब भक्त - गण मने विस्मय हइला ॥152॥
cc-antya-2.152.translation: While hearing the devotees lament, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was mildly smiling. Thus all the devotees were very astonished.

devanagari: एक - दिन जगदानन्द, स्वरूप, गोविन्द ।
काशीश्वर, शङ्कर, दामोदर, मुकुन्द ॥153॥
cc-antya-2.153-154.translation: One day Jagadānanda, Svarūpa, Govinda, Kāśīśvara, Śaṅkara, Dāmodara and Mukunda all went to bathe in the sea. They could hear Haridāsa singing from a distant place as if calling them in his original voice.

devanagari: मनुष्य ना देखे - मधुर गीत - मात्र शुने ।
गोविन्दादि सबे मे लि’ कैल अनुमाने ॥155॥
cc-antya-2.155.translation: No one could see him, but they could hear him singing in a sweet voice. Therefore all the devotees, headed by Govinda, made this guess.

devanagari: ‘विषादि खा ञा हरिदास आत्म - घात कैल ।
सेइ पापे जानि ‘ब्रह्म - राक्षस’ हैल ॥156॥
cc-antya-2.156.translation: "Haridāsa must have committed suicide by drinking poison, and because of this sinful act, he has now become a brāhmaṇa ghost.

lines: ākāra nā dekhi, mātra śuni tāra gāna'
devanagari: आकार ना देखि, मात्र शुनि तार गान’ ।
स्वरूप कहेन , - “एइ मिथ्या अनुमान ॥157॥
cc-antya-2.157.translation: "We cannot see his material form," they said, "but still we hear his sweet singing. Therefore he must have become a ghost." Svarūpa Dāmodara, however, protested, "This is a false guess.

devanagari: आजन्म कृष्ण - कीर्तन, प्रभुर सेवन ।
प्रभु - कृपा - पात्र, आर क्षेत्रेर मरण ॥158॥
cc-antya-2.158.translation: "Junior Haridāsa chanted the Hare Kṛṣṇa mantra throughout his entire life and served the Supreme Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Moreover, he is dear to the Lord and has died in a holy place.

lines: durgati nā haya tāra, sad-gati se haya
devanagari: दुर्गति ना हय तार, सद्गति से हय ।
प्रभु - भङ्गी एइ, पाछे जानिबा निश्चय ॥159॥
cc-antya-2.159.translation: "Haridāsa cannot have been degraded; he must have attained liberation. This is a pastime of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. You will all understand it later."

devanagari: आम्बुया - मुलुके हय नकुल - ब्रह्मचारी ।
परम - वैष्णव तेंहो बड़ अधिकारी ॥16॥
cc-antya-2.16.translation: In Āmbuyā-muluka there was a person named Nakula Brahmacārī, who was a perfectly pure devotee, greatly advanced in devotional service.

lines: prayāga ha-ite eka vaiṣṇava navadvīpa āila
devanagari: प्रयाग ह इते एक वैष्णव नवद्वीप आइल ।
हरिदासेर वार्ता तेंहो सबारे कहिल ॥160॥
cc-antya-2.160.translation: A devotee returned to Navadvīpa from Prayāga and told everyone the details of Junior Haridāsa's suicide.

devanagari: यैछे सङ्कल्प, यैछे त्रिवेणी प्रवेशि ल ।
शुनि’, श्रीवासादिर मने विस्मय ह - ल ॥161॥
cc-antya-2.161.translation: He explained how Junior Haridāsa had made his resolution and had thus entered the waters at the confluence of the Yamunā and Ganges. Hearing these details, Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura and the other devotees were very surprised.

devanagari: वर्षान्तरे शिवानन्द सब भक्त ल ञा ।
प्रभुरे मिलिला आासि’ आनन्दित हञा ॥162॥
cc-antya-2.162.translation: At the end of the year, Śivānanda Sena came to Jagannātha Purī as usual, accompanied by the other devotees, and thus in great happiness met Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: ‘हरिदास काँहा ?’ यदि श्रीवास पुछिला ।
“स्व - कर्म - फल - भुक्पुमान्” - प्रभु उत्तर दिला ॥163॥
cc-antya-2.163.translation: When Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura inquired from Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, "Where is Junior Haridāsa?" The Lord replied, "A person is sure to achieve the results of his fruitive activities."

devanagari: तबे श्रीवास तार वृतान्त कहिल ।
यैछे सङ्कल्प, यैछे त्रिवेणी प्रवेशिल ॥164॥
cc-antya-2.164.translation: Then Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura related the details of Haridāsa's decision and his entering the waters at the confluence of the Ganges and Yamunā.

lines: śuni' prabhu hāsi' kahe suprasanna citta
devanagari: शुनि’ प्रभु हासि’ कहे सुप्रसन्न चित्त ।
‘प्रकृति दर्शन कैले एइ प्रायश्चित्त’ ॥165॥
cc-antya-2.165.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu heard these details, He smiled in a pleased mood and said, "If with sensual intentions one looks at women, this is the only process of atonement."

devanagari: स्वरूपादि मि लि’ तबे विचार करिला ।
त्रिवेणी - प्रभावे हरिदास प्रभु - पद पाइला ॥166॥
cc-antya-2.166.translation: Then all the devotees, headed by Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, concluded that because Haridāsa had committed suicide at the confluence of the rivers Ganges and Yamunā, he must have ultimately attained shelter at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: एइ - मत लीला करे शचीर नन्दन ।
याहा शुनि’ भक्त - गणेर युड़ाय कर्ण - मन ॥167॥
cc-antya-2.167.translation: In this way, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the son of mother Śacī, performs His pastimes, which greatly satisfy the ears and minds of pure devotees who hear about them.

devanagari: आपन कारुण्य, लोके वैराग्य - शिक्षण ।
स्व - भक्तेर गाढ़ - अनुराग - प्रकटी - करण ॥168॥
cc-antya-2.168.translation: This incident manifests the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, His teaching that a sannyāsī should remain in the renounced order, and the deep attachment to Him felt by His faithful devotees.

lines: eka līlāya karena prabhu kārya pāṅca-sāta
devanagari: तीर्थेर महिमा, निज भक्ते आत्मसात् ।
एक लीलाय करेन प्रभु कार्य पाँच - सात ॥169॥
cc-antya-2.169.translation: It also demonstrates the glories of holy places and shows how the Lord accepts His faithful devotee. Thus the Lord fulfilled five or seven purposes by performing one pastime.

devanagari: गौड़ - देशेर लोक निस्तारिते मन हैल ।
नकुल - हृदये प्रभु ‘आवेश’ करिल ॥17॥
cc-antya-2.17.translation: Desiring to deliver all the people of Bengal, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu entered the heart of Nakula Brahmacārī.

devanagari: मधुर चैतन्य - लीला - समुद्र - गम्भीर।
लोके नाहि बुझे, बुझे येइ ‘भक्त’ ‘धीर’ ॥170॥
cc-antya-2.170.translation: The pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu are like nectar, and they are deep like the ocean. People in general cannot understand them, but a sober devotee can.

lines: tarka nā kariha, tarke habe viparīta
devanagari: विश्वास करिया शुन चैतन्य - चरित ।
तकर् ना करिह, तकर्ेहबे विपरीत ॥171॥
cc-antya-2.171.translation: Please hear the pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu with faith and confidence. Do not argue, for arguments will produce a contrary result.

devanagari: श्री - रूप - रघुनाथ - पदे यार आश ।
चैतन्य - चरितामृत कहे कृष्णदास ॥172॥
cc-antya-2.172.translation: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.

lines: hāse, kānde, nāce, gāya unmatta hañā
devanagari: ग्रह - ग्रस्त - प्राय नकुल प्रेमाविष्ट हञा ।
हासे, कान्दे, नाचे, गाय उन्मत्त ह ञा ॥18॥
cc-antya-2.18.translation: Nakula Brahmacārī became exactly like a man haunted by a ghost. Thus he sometimes laughed, sometimes cried, sometimes danced and sometimes chanted like a madman.

lines: aśru, kampa, stambha, sveda, sāttvika vikāra
devanagari: अश्रु, कम्प, स्तम्भ, स्वेद, सात्त्विक विकार ।
निरन्तर प्रेमे नृत्य, सघन हुङ्कार ॥19॥
cc-antya-2.19.translation: He continuously exhibited bodily transformations of transcendental love. Thus he cried, trembled, became stunned, perspired, danced in love of Godhead and made sounds like those of a cloud.

devanagari: जय जय श्री - चैतन्य जय नित्यानन्द ।
जयाद्वैत - चन्द्र जय गौर - भक्त - वृन्द ॥2॥
cc-antya-2.2.translation: All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu! All glories to Nityānanda Prabhu! All glories to Advaita Ācārya! And all glories to all the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu!

devanagari: तैछे गौर - कान्ति, तैछे सदा प्रेमावेश ।
ताहा देखिबारे आइसे सर्व गौड़ - देश ॥20॥
cc-antya-2.20.translation: His body shone with the same luster as that of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and he showed the same absorption in ecstatic love of Godhead. People came from all provinces of Bengal to see these symptoms.

devanagari: यारे देखे तारे कहे, - ‘कह कृष्ण - नाम’ ।
ताँहार दर्शने लोक हय प्रेमोद्दाम ॥21॥
cc-antya-2.21.translation: He advised whomever he met to chant the holy names Hare Kṛṣṇa. Thus upon seeing him, people were overwhelmed with love of Godhead.

devanagari: चैतन्येर आवेश हय नकुलेर देहे ।
शुनि’ शिवानन्द आइला करिया सन्देहे ॥22॥
cc-antya-2.22.translation: When Śivānanda Sena heard that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had entered the body of Nakula Brahmacārī, he went there with doubts in his mind.

lines: parīkṣā karite tāṅra yabe icchā haila
devanagari: परीक्षा करिते ताँर यबे इच्छा हैल ।
बाहिरे रहिया तबे विचार करिल ॥23॥
cc-antya-2.23.translation: Desiring to test the authenticity of Nakula Brahmacārī, he stayed outside, thinking as follows.

devanagari: ‘आपने बोलान मोरे, इहा यदि जानि ।
आमार इष्ट - मन्त्र जा नि’ कहेन आपनि ॥24॥
cc-antya-2.24-25.translation: "If Nakula Brahmacārī personally calls me and knows my worshipable mantra, then I shall understand that he is inspired by the presence of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu." Thinking in this way, he stayed some distance apart.

lines: lokera saṅghaṭṭe keha darśana nā pāya
devanagari: असङ्ख्य लोकेर घटा, - केह आइसे याय ।
लोकेर सहुद्धे केह दर्शन ना पाय ॥26॥
cc-antya-2.26.translation: There was a large crowd of people, some coming and some going. Indeed, some people in that great crowd could not even see Nakula Brahmacārī.

lines: jana dui cāri yāha, bolāha tāhāre'
devanagari: आवेशे ब्रह्मचारी कहे , - “शिवानन्द आछे दूरे ।
जन दुइ चारि याह, बोलाह ताहारे” ॥27॥
cc-antya-2.27.translation: In his inspired state, Nakula Brahmacārī said, "Śivānanda Sena is staying some distance away. Two or four of you go call him."

devanagari: चारि - दिके धाय लोके ‘शिवानन्द’ बलि ।
शिवानन्द कोन्, तोमाय बोलाय ब्रह्मचारी ॥28॥
cc-antya-2.28.translation: Thus people began running here and there, calling in all directions, "Śivānanda! Whoever is Śivānanda, please come. Nakula Brahmacārī is calling you."

lines: śuni, śivānanda sena tāṅhā śīghra āila
devanagari: शुनि’, शिवानन्द सेन ताँहा शीघ्र आइल ।
नमस्कार करि’ ताँर निकटे वसिल ॥29॥
cc-antya-2.29.translation: Hearing these calls, Śivānanda Sena quickly went there, offered obeisances to Nakula Brahmacārī, and sat down near him.

devanagari: सर्व - लोक उद्धारिते गौर - अवतार ।
निस्तारेर हेतु तार त्रिविध प्रकार ॥3॥
cc-antya-2.3.translation: In His incarnation as Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa descended to deliver all the living beings in the three worlds, from Brahmaloka down to Pātālaloka. He caused their deliverance in three ways.

devanagari: ब्रह्मचारी बले , - “तुमि करिला संशय ।
एक - मना हञा शुन ताहार निश्चय” ॥30॥
cc-antya-2.30.translation: Nakula Brahmacārī said, "I know that you are doubtful. Now please hear this evidence with great attention.

devanagari: ‘गौर - गोपाल मन्त्र’ तोमार चारि अक्षर ।
अविश्वास छाड़, येइ करियाछ अन्तर ॥31॥
cc-antya-2.31.translation: "You are chanting the Gaura-gopāla mantra composed of four syllables. Now please give up the doubts that have resided within you."

lines: aneka sammāna kari' bahu bhakti kaila
devanagari: तबे शिवानन्देर मने प्रतीति हइल ।
अनेक सम्मान करि’ बहु भक्ति कैल ॥32॥
cc-antya-2.32.translation: Śivānanda Sena thereupon developed full confidence in his mind that Nakula Brahmacārī was filled with the presence of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Śivānanda Sena then offered him respect and devotional service.

devanagari: एइ - मत महाप्रभुर अचिन्त्य प्रभाव ।
एबे शुन प्रभुर यैछे हय ‘आविर्भाव’ ॥33॥
cc-antya-2.33.translation: In this way, one should understand the inconceivable potencies of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Now please hear how His appearance [āvirbhāva] takes place.

devanagari: शचीर मन्दिरे, आर नित्यानन्द - नर्तने ।
श्रीवास - कीर्तने, आर राघव - भवने ॥34॥
cc-antya-2.34-35.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu always appeared in four places-in the household temple of mother Śacī, in the places where Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu danced, in the house of Śrīvāsa Paṇḍita during congregational chanting and in the house of Rāghava Paṇḍita. He appeared because of His attraction to the love of His devotees. That is His natural characteristic.

lines: bhojana karilā, tāhā śuna mana diyā
devanagari: नृसिंहानन्देर आगे आविभूत हञा ।
भोजन करिला, ताहा शुन मन दिया ॥36॥
cc-antya-2.36.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu appeared before Nṛsiṁhānanda Brahmacārī and ate his offerings. Please hear about this with attention.

devanagari: शिवानन्देर भागिना श्रीकान्त - सेन नाम ।
प्रभुर कृपाते तेंहो बड़ भाग्यवान् ॥37॥
cc-antya-2.37.translation: Śivānanda Sena had a nephew named Śrīkānta Sena, who by the grace of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was extremely fortunate.

devanagari: एक वत्सर तेंहो प्रथम एकेश्वर ।
प्रभु देखिबारे आइला उत्कण्ठा - अन्तर ॥38॥
cc-antya-2.38.translation: One year, Śrīkānta Sena came alone to Jagannātha Purī in great eagerness to see the Lord.

lines: mahāprabhu tāre dekhi' baḍa kṛpā kailā
devanagari: महाप्रभु तारे देखि’ बड़ कृपा कैला ।
मास - दुइ तेंहो प्रभुर निकटे रहिला ॥39॥
cc-antya-2.39.translation: Seeing Śrīkānta Sena, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu bestowed causeless mercy upon him. Śrīkānta Sena stayed near Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu for about two months at Jagannātha Purī.

devanagari: साक्षात्दर्शन, आर योग्य - भक्त - जीवे ।
‘आवेश’ करये काहाँ, काहाँ ‘आविर्भावे’ ॥4॥
cc-antya-2.4.translation: The Lord delivered the fallen souls in some places by meeting them directly, in other places by empowering a pure devotee, and in still other places by appearing before someone Himself.

lines: tabe prabhu tāṅre ājñā kailā gauḍe yāite
devanagari: तबे प्रभु ताँरे आज्ञा कैला गौड़े याइते ।
भक्त - गणे निषेधिह एथाके आसिते ॥40॥
cc-antya-2.40.translation: When he was about to return to Bengal, the Lord told him, "Forbid the devotees of Bengal to come to Jagannātha Purī this year.

devanagari: ए - वत्सर ताँहा आमि याइमु आपने ।
ताहाइ मिलिमु सब अद्वैतादि सने ॥41॥
cc-antya-2.41.translation: "This year I shall personally go to Bengal and meet all the devotees there, headed by Advaita Ācārya.

lines: ācambite avaśya āmi yāiba tāṅra pāśe
devanagari: शिवानन्दे कहिह, - आमि ए इ पौष - मासे ।
आचम्बिते अवश्य आमि याइब ताँ र पाशे ॥42॥
cc-antya-2.42.translation: "Please inform Śivānanda Sena that this December I shall certainly go to his home.

lines: jagadānanda haya tāhāṅ, teṅho bhikṣā dibe
sabāre kahiha,—e vatsara keha nā āsibe"
devanagari: जगदानन्द हय ताहाँ, तेंहो भिक्षा दिबे ।
सबारे कहिह, - ए वत्सर केह ना आसिबे ॥43॥
cc-antya-2.43.translation: "Jagadānanda is there, and he will give Me offerings of food. Inform them all that no one should come to Jagannātha Purī this year."

devanagari: श्रीकान्त आसिया गौड़े सन्देश कहिल ।
शुनि’ भक्त - गण - मने आनन्द हइल ॥44॥
cc-antya-2.44.translation: When Śrīkānta Sena returned to Bengal and delivered this message, the minds of all the devotees were very pleased.

devanagari: चलितेछिला आचार्य, रहिला स्थिर ह ञा ।
शिवानन्द, जगदानन्द रहे प्रत्याशा करिया ॥45॥
cc-antya-2.45.translation: Advaita Ācārya was just about to go to Jagannātha Purī with the other devotees, but upon hearing this message, He waited. Śivānanda Sena and Jagadānanda also stayed back, awaiting the arrival of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: पौष - मासे आइल दुँहे सामग्री करिया ।
सन्ध्या - पर्यन्त रहे अपेक्षा करिया ॥46॥
cc-antya-2.46.translation: When the month of Pauṣa arrived, both Jagadānanda and Śivānanda collected all kinds of paraphernalia for the Lord's reception. Every day, they would wait until evening for the Lord to come.

lines: ei-mata māsa gela, gosāñi nā āilā
devanagari: एइ - मत मास गेल, गोसाञि ना आइला ।
जगदानन्द, शिवानन्द दु:खित हइला ॥47॥
cc-antya-2.47.translation: As the month passed but Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu did not come, Jagadānanda and Śivānanda became most unhappy.

lines: duṅhe tāṅre mili' tabe sthāne vasāilā
devanagari: आचम्बिते नृसिंहानन्द ताहाडि आइला ।
दुँहे ताँरे मिलि’ तबे स्थाने वसाइला ॥48॥
cc-antya-2.48-49.translation: Suddenly Nṛsiṁhānanda arrived, and Jagadānanda and Śivānanda arranged for him to sit near them. Seeing them both so unhappy, Nṛsiṁhānanda inquired, "Why do I see that you are both despondent?"

devanagari: ‘साक्षात्दर्शने’ प्राय सब निस्तारिला ।
नकुल - ब्रह्मचारीर देहे ‘आविष्ट’ हइला ॥5॥
cc-antya-2.5-6.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu delivered almost all the fallen souls by directly meeting them. He delivered others by entering the body of Nakula Brahmacārī and by appearing before Nṛsiṁhānanda Brahmacārī. "I shall deliver the fallen souls." This statement characterizes the Supreme Personality of Godhead.

lines: 'āsiba ājñā dilā prabhu kene nā āilā?'
devanagari: तबे शिवानन्द ताँरे सकल कहिला ।
‘आासिब आज्ञा दिला प्रभु केने ना आइला ?’ ॥50॥
cc-antya-2.50.translation: Then Śivānanda Sena told him, "Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu promised that He would come. Why, then, has He not arrived?"

lines: āmi ta' āniba tāṅre tṛtīya divase'
devanagari: शुनि’ ब्रह्मचारी कहे , - “करह सन्तोषे ।
आमि त’ आनिब ताँ रे तृतीय दिवसे” ॥51॥
cc-antya-2.51.translation: Hearing this, Nṛsiṁhānanda Brahmacārī replied, "Please be satisfied. I assure you that I shall bring Him here three days from now."

lines: ānibe prabhure ebe niścaya kailā mane
devanagari: ताँहार प्रभाव - प्रेम जाने दुइ - जने ।
आनिबे प्रभुरे एबे निश्चय कैला मने ॥52॥
cc-antya-2.52.translation: Śivānanda and Jagadānanda knew of Nṛsiṁhānanda Brahmacārī's influence and love of Godhead. Therefore they now felt assured that he would certainly bring Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: “प्रद्युम्न ब्रह्मचारी” - ताँर निज - नाम ।
“नृसिंहानन्द” नाम ताँर कैला गौर - धाम ॥53॥
cc-antya-2.53.translation: His real name was Pradyumna Brahmacārī. The name Nṛsiṁhānanda had been given to him by Lord Gaurasundara Himself.

lines: dui dina dhyāna kari' śivānandere kahila
devanagari: दुइ दिन ध्यान करि’ शिवानन्देरे कहिल ।
“पाणिहाटि ग्रामे आमि प्रभुरे आनिल ॥54॥
cc-antya-2.54.translation: After meditating for two days, Nṛsiṁhānanda Brahmacārī told Śivānanda Sena, "I have already brought Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to the village known as Pāṇihāṭi.

lines: kāli madhyāhne teṅho āsibena tomāra ghare
pāka-sāmagrī ānaha, āmi bhikṣā dimu tāṅre
devanagari: कालि मध्याह्ने तेंहो आसिबेन तोमार घरे ।
पाक - सामग्री आनह, आमि भिक्षा दिमु ताँरे ॥55॥
cc-antya-2.55.translation: "Tomorrow at noon He will come to your home. Therefore please bring all kinds of cooking ingredients. I shall personally cook and offer Him food.

lines: tabe tāṅre ethā āmi āniba satvara
niścaya kahilāṅa, kichu sandeha nā kara
devanagari: तबे ताँरे एथा आमि आनिब सत्वर।
निश्चय कहिलाड, किछु सन्देह ना कर ॥56॥
cc-antya-2.56.translation: "In this way I shall bring Him here very soon. Be assured that I am telling you the truth. Do not be doubtful.

lines: ye cāhiye, tāhā kara hañā tat-para
ati tvarāya kariba pāka, śuna ataḥpara
devanagari: ये चाहिये, ताहा कर ह ञा तत्पर ।
अति त्वराय करिब पाक, शुन अतःपर ॥57॥
cc-antya-2.57.translation: "Bring all the ingredients very soon, for I want to begin cooking immediately. Please do what I say."

lines: ye māgila, śivānanda āni' dilā tāi
devanagari: पाक - सामग्री आनह, आमि याहा चाइ” ।
ये मागिल, शिवानन्द आनि” दिला ता ई ॥58॥
cc-antya-2.58.translation: Nṛsiṁhānanda Brahmacārī said to Śivānanda, "Please bring whatever cooking ingredients I want." Thus Śivānanda Sena immediately brought whatever he asked for.

lines: nānā vyañjana, piṭhā, kṣīra nānā upahāra
devanagari: प्रातः - काल हैते पाक करिला अपार ।
नाना व्यञ्जन, पिष्ठा, क्षीर नाना उपहार ॥59॥
cc-antya-2.59.translation: Beginning early in the morning, Nṛsiṁhānanda Brahmacārī cooked many varieties of food, including vegetables, cakes, sweet rice and other preparations.

lines: caitanya prabhura lāgi' āra bhoga kaila
devanagari: जगन्नाथेर भिन्न भोग पृथक्बाड़िल ।
चैतन्य प्रभुर लागि’ आर भोग कैल ॥60॥
cc-antya-2.60.translation: After he finished cooking, he brought separate dishes for Jagannātha and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: इष्ट - देव नृसिंह लागि’ पृथक्बाड़िल ।
तिन - जने समर्पिया बाहिरे ध्यान कैल ॥61॥
cc-antya-2.61.translation: He also separately offered dishes to Nṛsiṁhadeva, his worshipable Deity. Thus he divided all the food into three offerings. Then, outside the temple, he began to meditate upon the Lord.

lines: tina bhoga khāilā, kichu avaśiṣṭa nāi
devanagari: देखे, शीघ्र आ सि’ वसिला चैतन्य - गोसा ञि ।
तिन भोग खाइला, किछु अवशिष्ट नाइ ॥62॥
cc-antya-2.62.translation: In his meditation he saw Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu quickly come, sit down and eat all three offerings, leaving behind no remnants.

devanagari: आनन्दे विह्वल प्रद्युम्न, पड़े अश्रु - धार।
“हाहा किबा कर” बलि’करये फुत्कार ॥63॥
cc-antya-2.63.translation: Pradyumna Brahmacārī was overwhelmed by transcendental ecstasy upon seeing Caitanya Mahāprabhu eating everything. Thus tears flowed from his eyes. Nevertheless, he expressed dismay, saying, "Alas, alas! My dear Lord, what are You doing? You are eating everyone's food!

devanagari: “जगन्नाथे - तोमाय ऐक्य, खाओ ताँर भोग ।
नृसिंहेर भोग केने कर उपयोग? ॥64॥
cc-antya-2.64.translation: "My dear Lord, You are one with Jagannātha; therefore I have no objection to Your eating His offering. But why are You touching the offering to Lord Nṛsiṁhadeva?

lines: ṭhākura upavāsī rahe, jiye kaiche dāsa?'
devanagari: नृसिंहेर हैल जानि आजि उपवास ।
ठाकुर उपवासी रहे, जिये कैछे दास ?” ॥65॥
cc-antya-2.65.translation: "I think that Nṛsiṁhadeva could not eat anything today, and therefore he is fasting. If the master fasts, how can the servant live?"

lines: bhojana dekhi' yadyapi tāṅra hṛdaye ullāsa
nṛsiṁha lakṣya kari' bāhye kichu kare duḥkhābhāsa
devanagari: भोजन देखि’ यद्यपि ताँ र हृदये उल्लास ।
नृसिंह लक्ष्य करि’ बाहो किछु करे दु:खाभास ॥66॥
cc-antya-2.66.translation: Although Nṛsiṁha Brahmacārī felt jubilation within his heart to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu eating everything, for the sake of Lord Nṛsiṁhadeva he externally expressed disappointment.

devanagari: स्वयं भगवान् कृष्ण - चैतन्य - गोसाञि ।
जगन्नाथ - नृसिंह - सह किछु भेद नाइ ॥67॥
cc-antya-2.67.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is the Supreme Personality of Godhead Himself. Therefore there is no difference between Him, Lord Jagannātha and Lord Nṛsiṁhadeva.

lines: ihā jānibāre pradyumnera gūḍha haita mana
devanagari: इहा जानिबारे प्रद्युम्नेर गूढ़ हैत मन ।
ताहा देखाइला प्रभु करिया भोजन ॥68॥
cc-antya-2.68.translation: Pradyumna Brahmacārī was deeply eager to understand this fact. Therefore Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu revealed it to him by a practical demonstration.

devanagari: भोजन करिया प्रभु गेला पाणिहाटि ।
सन्तोष पाडूला देखि’ व्यञ्जन - परिपाटी ॥69॥
cc-antya-2.69.translation: After eating all the offerings, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu started for Pāṇihāṭi. There, He was greatly satisfied to see the different varieties of vegetables prepared in the house of Rāghava.

lines: eka-bāra ye dekhilā, se kṛtārtha ha-ilā
devanagari: साक्षात्दर्शने सब जगत् तारिला ।
एक - बार ये देखिला, से कृतार्थ हइला ॥7॥
cc-antya-2.7.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was personally present, anyone in the world who met Him even once was fully satisfied and became spiritually advanced.

devanagari: शिवानन्द कहे , - ”केने करह फुत्कार?” ।
तेंह कहे , - ”देख तोमार प्रभुर व्यवहार ॥70॥
cc-antya-2.70.translation: Śivānanda said to Nṛsiṁhānanda, "Why are you expressing dismay?" Nṛsiṁhānanda replied, "Just see the behavior of your Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: tina janāra bhoga teṅho ekelā khāilā
devanagari: तिन जनार भोग तेंहो एकेला खाइला ।
जगन्नाथ - नृसिंह उपवासी हइला” ॥71॥
cc-antya-2.71.translation: "He alone has eaten the offerings for all three Deities. Because of this, both Jagannātha and Nṛsiṁhadeva remain fasting."

lines: kibā premāveśe kahe, kibā satya haya
devanagari: शुनि शिवानन्देर चित्ते हइल संशय।
किबा प्रेमावेशे कहे, किबा सत्य ह य ॥72॥
cc-antya-2.72.translation: When Śivānanda Sena heard this statement, he was unsure whether Nṛsiṁhānanda Brahmacārī was speaking that way because of ecstatic love or because it was actually a fact.

lines: sāmagrī āna nṛsiṁha lāgi punaḥ pāka kari'
devanagari: तबे शिवानन्दे किछु कहे ब्रह्मचारी ।
“सामग्री आान नृसिंह लागि पुनः पाक करि’ ॥73॥
cc-antya-2.73.translation: When Śivānanda Sena was thus perplexed, Nṛsiṁhānanda Brahmacārī said to him, "Bring more food. Let me cook again for Lord Nṛsiṁhadeva."

devanagari: तबे शिवानन्द भोग - सामग्री आनिला ।
पाक करि’नृसिंहेर भोग लागाइला ॥74॥
cc-antya-2.74.translation: Then Śivānanda Sena again brought the ingredients with which to cook, and Pradyumna Brahmacārī again cooked and offered the food to Nṛsiṁhadeva.

devanagari: वर्षान्तरे शिवानन्द लञा भक्त - गण ।
नीलाचले देखे याञा प्रभुर चरण ॥75॥
cc-antya-2.75.translation: The next year, Śivānanda went to Jagannātha Purī with all the other devotees to see the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: एक - दिन सभाते प्रभु बात चालाइला ।
नृसिंहानन्देर गुणा कहिते लागिला ॥76॥
cc-antya-2.76.translation: One day, in the presence of all the devotees, the Lord raised these topics concerning Nṛsiṁhānanda Brahmacārī and praised his transcendental qualities.

devanagari: “गत - वर्ष पौषे मोरे कराइल भोजन ।
कभु नाहि खाइ ऐछे मिष्टान्न - व्यञ्ज न” ॥77॥
cc-antya-2.77.translation: The Lord said, "Last year in the month of Pauṣa, when Nṛsiṁhānanda gave me varieties of sweetmeats and vegetables to eat, they were so good that I had never before eaten such preparations."

devanagari: शुनि’ भक्त - गण मने आश्चर्य मानिल ।
शिवानन्देर मने तबे प्रत्यय जन्मिल ॥78॥
cc-antya-2.78.translation: Hearing this, all the devotees were struck with wonder, and Śivānanda became confident that the incident was true.

devanagari: एइ - मत शची - गृहे सतत भोजन ।
श्रीवासेर गृहे करेन कीर्तन - दर्शन ॥79॥
cc-antya-2.79.translation: In this way Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu used to eat at the temple of Śacīmātā every day and also visit the house of Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura when kīrtana was performed.

devanagari: गौड़ - देशेर भक्त - गण प्रत्यब्द आसिया ।
पुनः गौड़ - देशे याय प्रभुरे मिलिया ॥8॥
cc-antya-2.8.translation: Every year, devotees from Bengal would go to Jagannātha Purī to meet Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and after the meeting they would return to Bengal.

lines: nityānandera nṛtya dekhena āsi' bāre bāre
devanagari: नित्यानन्देर नृत्य देखेन आसि’ बारे बारे ।
“निरन्तर आविर्भाव” राघवेर घरे ॥80॥
cc-antya-2.80.translation: Similarly, He was always present when Nityānanda Prabhu danced, and He regularly appeared at the house of Rāghava.

devanagari: प्रेम - वश गौर - प्रभु, याहाँ प्रेमोत्तम ।
प्रेम - वश हञा ताहा देन दरशन ॥81॥
cc-antya-2.81.translation: Lord Gaurasundara is greatly influenced by the love of His devotees. Therefore wherever there is pure devotion to the Lord, the Lord Himself, subdued by such love, appears, and His devotees see Him.

lines: yāṅra preme vaśa prabhu āise bāre bāre
devanagari: शिवानन्देर प्रेम - सीमा के कहिते पारे ? ।
याँर प्रेमे वश प्रभु आइसे बारे बारे ॥82॥
cc-antya-2.82.translation: Influenced by the loving affairs of Śivānanda Sena, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu came again and again. Therefore who can estimate the limits of his love?

devanagari: एइ त’ कहिलु गौरेर “आविर्भाव” ।
इहा ये इ शुने, जाने चैतन्य - प्रभाव ॥83॥
cc-antya-2.83.translation: Thus I have described the appearance of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Anyone who hears about these incidents can understand the transcendental opulence of the Lord.

devanagari: पुरुषोत्तमे प्रभु - पाशे भगवानाचार्य ।
परम वैष्णव तेंहो सुपण्डित आर्य ॥84॥
cc-antya-2.84.translation: At Jagannātha Purī, in the association of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, lived Bhagavān Ācārya, who was certainly a gentleman, a learned scholar and a great devotee.

devanagari: सख्य - भावाक्रान्त - चित्त, गोप - अवतार ।
स्वरूप - गोसाञि - सह सख्य - व्यवहार ॥85॥
cc-antya-2.85.translation: He was fully absorbed in thoughts of fraternal relationships with God. He was an incarnation of a cowherd boy, and thus his dealings with Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī were very friendly.

lines: madhye madhye prabhura teṅho karena nimantraṇa
devanagari: एकान्त - भावे आश्रियाछेन चैतन्य - चरण ।
मध्ये मध्ये प्रभुर तेंही करेन निमन्त्रण ॥86॥
cc-antya-2.86.translation: He sought the shelter of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu with full surrender. Sometimes he would invite the Lord to dine at his home.

lines: ghare bhāta kari' karena vividha vyañjana
devanagari: घरे भात करि’ करेन विविध व्यञ्जन ।
एकले गोसाञि लञा करान भोजन ॥87॥
cc-antya-2.87.translation: Bhagavān Ācārya prepared varieties of rice and vegetables at home and brought the Lord there alone to eat.

devanagari: ताँर पिता ‘विषयी’ बड़ शतानन्द - खाँन ।
‘विषय - विमुख’ आचार्य - ‘वैराग्य - प्रधान’ ॥88॥
cc-antya-2.88.translation: Bhagavān Ācārya's father, whose name was Śatānanda Khān, was an expert statesman, whereas Bhagavān Ācārya was not at all interested in the management of the state. Indeed, he was almost in the renounced order of life.

lines: kāśīte vedānta paḍi' gelā tāṅra ṭhāñi
devanagari: ‘गोपाल - भट्टाचार्य’ नाम ताँर छोट - भाइ ।
काशीते वेदान्त प ड़ि’ गेला ताँर ठाञि ॥89॥
cc-antya-2.89.translation: Bhagavān Ācārya's brother, whose name was Gopāla Bhaṭṭācārya, had studied Vedānta philosophy at Benares and had then returned to Bhagavān Ācārya's home.

devanagari: आर नाना - देशेर लोक आ सि’ जगन्नाथ ।
चैतन्य - चरण देखि’ हइल कृतार्थ ॥9॥
cc-antya-2.9.translation: Similarly, people who went to Jagannātha Purī from various provinces of India were fully satisfied after seeing the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: antaryāmī prabhu citte sukha nā pāilā
devanagari: आचार्य ताहारे प्रभु - पदे मिलाइला ।
अन्तर्यामी प्रभु चित्ते सुख ना पाइला ॥90॥
cc-antya-2.90.translation: Bhagavān Ācārya took his brother to meet Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, but the Lord, knowing that Gopāla Bhaṭṭācārya was a Māyāvādī philosopher, could not get much happiness from meeting him.

lines: kṛṣṇa-bhakti vinā prabhura nā haya ullāsa
devanagari: आचार्य - सम्बन्धे बाहो करे प्री त्याभास ।
कृष्ण - भक्ति विना प्रभुर ना हय उल्लास ॥91॥
cc-antya-2.91.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu derives no happiness from meeting one who is not a pure devotee of Kṛṣṇa. Thus because Gopāla Bhaṭṭācārya was a Māyāvādī scholar, the Lord felt no jubilation in meeting him. Nevertheless, because Gopāla Bhaṭṭācārya was related to Bhagavān Ācārya, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu feigned pleasure in seeing him.

lines: svarūpa gosāñire ācārya kahe āra dine
devanagari: स्वरूप गोसाञि रे आचार्य कहे आर दिने ।
“वेदान्त पड़िया गोपाल आइसाछे एखाने” ॥92॥
cc-antya-2.92.translation: Bhagavān Ācārya said to Svarūpa Dāmodara, "Gopāla, my younger brother, has returned to my home, having concluded his study of Vedānta philosophy."

lines: sabe meli' āisa, śuni 'bhāṣya' ihāra sthāne'
devanagari: “सबे मे लि’ आइस, शुनि ‘भाष्य’ इहार स्थाने” ।
प्रेम - क्रोध करि’ स्वरूप बलय वचने ॥93॥
cc-antya-2.93.translation: Bhagavān Ācārya requested Svarūpa Dāmodara to hear from Gopāla the commentary upon Vedānta. Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, however, somewhat angry because of love, spoke as follows.

devanagari: “बुद्धि भ्रष्ट हैल तोमार गोपालेर सङ्गे ।
मायावाद शुनिबारे उपजिल रङ्गे” ॥94॥
cc-antya-2.94.translation: "You have lost your intelligence in the association of Gopāla, and therefore you are eager to hear the Māyāvāda philosophy.

devanagari: वैष्णव ह ञा येबा शारीरक - भाष्य शुने ।
सेव्य - सेवक - भाव छा ड़ि’ आपनारे ‘ईश्वर’ माने ॥95॥
cc-antya-2.95.translation: "When a Vaiṣṇava listens to the Śārīraka-bhāṣya, the Māyāvāda commentary upon Vedānta-sūtra, he gives up the Kṛṣṇa conscious attitude that the Lord is the master and the living entity is His servant. Instead, he considers himself the Supreme Lord.

devanagari: महा - भागवत ये इ, कृष्ण प्राण - धन या र।
मायावाद - श्रवणे चित्त अवश्य फिरे ताँ र” ॥96॥
cc-antya-2.96.translation: "The Māyāvāda philosophy presents such a jugglery of words that even a highly elevated devotee who has accepted Kṛṣṇa as his life and soul changes his decision when he reads the Māyāvāda commentary on Vedānta-sūtra."

lines: āmā sabāra mana bhāṣya nāre phirāite'
devanagari: आचार्य कहे , - “आमा सबार कृष्ण - निष्ठ - चित्ते ।
आमा सबार मन भाष्य नारे फिराइते” ॥97॥
cc-antya-2.97.translation: In spite of Svarūpa Dāmodara's protest, Bhagavān Ācārya continued, "We are all fixed at the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa with our hearts and souls. Therefore the Śārīraka-bhāṣya cannot change our minds."

devanagari: स्वरूप कहे, “तथापि मायावाद - श्रवणे ।
“चित्, ब्रह्म, माया, मिथ्या” - एडू - मात्र शुने ॥98॥
cc-antya-2.98.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara replied, "Nevertheless, when we hear the Māyāvāda philosophy, we hear that Brahman is knowledge and that the universe of māyā is false, but we gain no spiritual understanding.

lines: yāhāra śravaṇe bhaktera phāṭe mana prāṇa"
devanagari: जीवाज्ञा न - कल्पित ईश्वरे, सकल - इ अज्ञान ।
याहार श्रवणे भक्तेर फाटे मन प्राण” ॥99॥
cc-antya-2.99.translation: "The Māyāvādī philosopher tries to establish that the living entity is only imaginary and that the Supreme Personality of Godhead is under the influence of māyā. Hearing this kind of commentary breaks the heart and life of a devotee."

lines: vande 'haṁ śrī-guroḥ śrī-yuta-pada-kamalaṁ śrī-gurūn vaiṣṇavāṁś ca
devanagari: वन्देऽहं श्री - गुरोः श्री - युत - पद - कमलं श्री - गुरून्वैष्णवांश्च श्री - रूपं साग्रजातं सह - गण - रघुनाथान्वितं तं स - जीवम् ।
साद्वैतं सावधूतं परिजन - सहितं कृष्ण - चैतन्य - देवं श्री - राष्धा - कृष्ण - पादान्सह - गण - ललिता - श्री - विशाखान्वितांश्च ॥1॥
cc-antya-3.1.translation: I offer my respectful obeisances unto the lotus feet of my spiritual master and of all the other preceptors on the path of devotional service, unto all the Vaiṣṇavas and unto the six Gosvāmīs, including Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī, Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī, Jīva Gosvāmī and their associates. I offer my respectful obeisances unto Śrī Advaita Ācārya Prabhu, Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, as well as all His devotees, headed by Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura. I then offer my respectful obeisances unto the lotus feet of Lord Kṛṣṇa and Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī and all the gopīs, headed by Lalitā and Viśākhā.

lines: kata-kṣaṇe se bālaka uṭhi' yabe gelā
sahite nā pāre, dāmodara kahite lāgilā
devanagari: कत - क्षणे से बालक उठि’ यबे गेला ।
सहिते ना पारे, दामोदर कहिते लागिला ॥10॥
cc-antya-3.10.translation: After some time, when the boy stood up and left, the intolerant Dāmodara Paṇḍita began to speak.

devanagari: निर्जन - वने कुटिर करि’ तुलसी सेवन ।
रात्रि - दिने तिन लक्ष नाम - सङ्कीर्तन ॥100॥
cc-antya-3.100.translation: Haridāsa Ṭhākura constructed a cottage in a solitary forest. There he planted a tulasī plant, and in front of the tulasī he would chant the holy name of the Lord 300,000 times daily. He chanted throughout the entire day and night.

devanagari: ब्राह्मणेर घरे करे भिक्षा निर्वाहण ।
प्रभावे सकल लोक करये पूजन ॥101॥
cc-antya-3.101.translation: For his bodily maintenance he would go to a brāhmaṇa's house and beg some food. He was spiritually so influential that all the neighboring people worshiped him.

devanagari: सेइ देशाध्यक्ष नाम - रामचन्द्र खाँन ।
वैष्णव - विद्वेषी सेइ पाषण्ड - प्रधान ॥102॥
cc-antya-3.102.translation: A landholder named Rāmacandra Khān was the zamindar of that district. He was envious of Vaiṣṇavas and was therefore a great atheist.

lines: haridāse loke pūje, sahite nā pāre
tāṅra apamāna karite nānā upāya kare
devanagari: हरिदासे लोके पूजे, सहिते ना पारे ।
ताँर अपमान करिते नाना उपाय करे ॥103॥
cc-antya-3.103.translation: Unable to tolerate that such respect was being offered to Haridāsa Ṭhākura, Rāmacandra Khān planned in various ways to dishonor him.

devanagari: कोन - प्रकारे हरिदासेर छिद्र नाहि पाय ।
वेश्या - गणे आ नि’ करे छिद्रेर उपाय ॥104॥
cc-antya-3.104.translation: By no means could he find any fault in the character of Haridāsa Ṭhākura. Therefore he called for local prostitutes and began a plan to discredit His Holiness.

devanagari: वेश्या - गणे कहे ,_“एइ वैरागी हरिदास ।
तुमि - सब कर इहार वैराग्य - धर्म नाश” ॥105॥
cc-antya-3.105.translation: Rāmacandra Khān said to the prostitutes, "There is a mendicant named Haridāsa Ṭhākura. All of you devise a way to deviate him from his vows of austerity."

devanagari: वेश्या - गण - मध्ये एक सुन्दरी युवती ।
से कहे , - “तिन - दिने हरिब ताँर मति” ॥106॥
cc-antya-3.106.translation: Among the prostitutes, one attractive young girl was selected. "I shall attract the mind of Haridāsa Ṭhākura," she promised, "within three days."

lines: khāṅna kahe,—"mora pāika yāuka tomāra sane
tomāra sahita ekatra tāre dhari' yena āne"
devanagari: खाँन कहे, - “मोर पाइक याउक तोमार सने ।
तोमार सहित एकत्र तारे ध रि’ येन आने” ॥107॥
cc-antya-3.107.translation: Rāmacandra Khān said to the prostitute, "My constable will go with you so that as soon as he sees you with Haridāsa Ṭhākura, immediately he will arrest him and bring both of you to me."

devanagari: वेश्या कहे, - “मोर सङ्ग हउक एक - बार ।
द्वितीय - बारे धरिते पाइक लइमु तोमार” ॥108॥
cc-antya-3.108.translation: The prostitute replied, "First let me have union with him once; then the second time I shall take your constable with me to arrest him."

devanagari: रात्रि - काले सेइ वेश्या सुवेश धरिया ।
हरिदासेर वासाय गेल उल्लसित हञा ॥109॥
cc-antya-3.109.translation: At night the prostitute, after dressing herself most attractively, went to the cottage of Haridāsa Ṭhākura with great jubilation.

devanagari: अन्योपदेशे पण्डित - कहे गोसाञिर ठाञि ।
cc-antya-3.11.translation: Dāmodara Paṇḍita impudently said to the Lord, "Everyone says that You are a great teacher because of Your instructions to others, but now we shall find out what kind of teacher You are.

devanagari: तुलसी नमस्करि’ हरिदासेर द्वारे याञा ।
गोसा ञिरे नमस्क रि’ रहिला दाण्डा ञा ॥110॥
cc-antya-3.110.translation: After offering obeisances to the tulasī plant, she went to the door of Haridāsa Ṭhākura, offered him obeisances and stood there.

devanagari: अङ्ग उघाड़िया देखाइ वसिला दुयारे ।
कहिते लागिला किछु सुमधुर स्वरे ॥111॥
cc-antya-3.111.translation: Exposing part of her body to his view, she sat down on the threshold of the door and spoke to him in very sweet words.

lines: tomā dekhi' kon nārī dharite pāre mana?
devanagari: “ठाकुर, तुमि - परम - सुन्दर, प्रथम यौवन ।
तोमा देखि’ कोन् नारी धरिते पारे मन ? ॥112॥
cc-antya-3.112.translation: "My dear Ṭhākura, O great preacher, great devotee, you are so beautifully built, and your youth is just beginning. Who is the woman who could control her mind after seeing you?

lines: tomāra saṅgama lāgi' lubdha mora mana
tomā nā pāile prāṇa nā yāya dhāraṇa"
devanagari: तोमार सङ्गम लागि’ लुब्ध मोर मन ।
तोमा ना पाइले प्राण ना याय धारण” ॥113॥
cc-antya-3.113.translation: "I am eager to be united with you. My mind is greedy for this. If I don't obtain you, I shall not be able to keep my body and soul together."

devanagari: हरिदास कहे , - “तोमा करिमु अङ्गीकार ।
सङ्ख्या - नाम - समाप्ति यावत् ना हय आमार ॥114॥
cc-antya-3.114-115.translation: Haridāsa Ṭhākura replied, "I shall accept you without fail, but you will have to wait until I have finished chanting my regular rounds on my beads. Until that time, please sit and listen to the chanting of the holy name. As soon as I am finished, I shall fulfill your desire."

lines: eta śuni' sei veśyā vasiyā rahilā
devanagari: एत शुनि’ सेइ वेश्या वसिया रहिला ।
कीर्तन करे हरिदास प्रातः काल हैला ॥116॥
cc-antya-3.116.translation: Hearing this, the prostitute remained sitting there while Haridāsa Ṭhākura chanted on his beads until the light of morning appeared.

devanagari: प्रातःकाल देखि’ वेश्या उठिया चलिला ।
सब समाचार याइ खाँनेरे कहिला ॥117॥
cc-antya-3.117.translation: When she saw that it was morning, the prostitute stood up and left. Coming before Rāmacandra Khān, she informed him of all the news.

lines: kāli avaśya tāhāra saṅge ha-ibe saṅgame'
devanagari: ‘आजि आमा अङ्गीकार करियाछे वचने ।
कालि अवश्य ताहार सङ्गे हइबे सङ्गमे’ ॥118॥
cc-antya-3.118.translation: "Today Haridāsa Ṭhākura has promised to enjoy with me. Tomorrow certainly I shall have union with him."

lines: āra dina rātri haile veśyā āila
devanagari: आर दिन रात्रि हैले वेश्या आइल ।
हरिदास तारे बहु आश्वास करिल ॥119॥
cc-antya-3.119.translation: The next night, when the prostitute came again, Haridāsa Ṭhākura gave her many assurances.

lines: ebe gosāñira guṇa-yaśa saba loke gāibe
devanagari: एबे गोसा ञिर गुण - यश सब लोके गाइबे ।
तबे गोसाञिर प्रतिष्ठा पुरुषोत्तमे हइबे ॥12॥
cc-antya-3.12.translation: "You are known as Gosāñi [teacher or ācārya], but now talk about Your attributes and reputation will spread throughout the city of Puruṣottama. How Your position will be impaired!"

lines: 'kāli duḥkha pāilā, aparādha nā la-ibā mora
devanagari: ‘कालि दुःख पाइला, अपराध ना लइबा मोर ।
अवश्य करिमु आमि तोमाय अङ्गीकार ॥120॥
cc-antya-3.120.translation: "Last night you were disappointed. Please excuse my offense. I shall certainly accept you.

lines: nāma pūrṇa haile, pūrṇa habe tomāra mana'
devanagari: तावत् इहाँ वसि’ शुन नाम - सङ्कीर्तन ।
नाम पूर्ण हैले, पूर्ण हबे तोमार मन’ ॥121॥
cc-antya-3.121.translation: "Please sit down and hear the chanting of the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra until my regular chanting is finished. Then your desire will surely be fulfilled."

devanagari: तुलसीरे ताङ्के वेश्या नमस्कार करि’ ।
द्वारे व सि’ नाम शुने बले ‘हरि’ ‘हरि’ ॥122॥
cc-antya-3.122.translation: After offering her obeisances to the tulasī plant and Haridāsa Ṭhākura, she sat down at the door. Hearing Haridāsa Ṭhākura chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa mantra, she also chanted, "O my Lord Hari, O my Lord Hari."

lines: tāra rīti dekhi' haridāsa kahena tāhāre
devanagari: रात्रि - शेष हैल, वेश्या उसिमिसि करे ।
तार रीति देखि’ हरिदास कहेन ताहारे ॥123॥
cc-antya-3.123.translation: When the night came to an end, the prostitute was restless. Seeing this, Haridāsa Ṭhākura spoke to her as follows.

lines: ei dīkṣā kariyāchi, haila āsi' śeṣe
devanagari: कोटि - नाम - ग्रहण - यज्ञ करि एक - मासे ।
एइ दीक्षा करियाछि, हैल आ सि’ शेषे ॥124॥
cc-antya-3.124.translation: "I have vowed to chant ten million names in a month. I have taken this vow, but now it is nearing its end.

lines: samasta rātri niluṅ nāma samāpta nā haila
devanagari: आजि समाप्त हइबे , - हेन ज्ञान छिल ।
समस्त रात्रि निलुँ नाम समाप्त ना हैल ॥125॥
cc-antya-3.125.translation: "I thought that today I would be able to finish my performance of yajña, my chanting of the Hare Kṛṣṇa mantra. I tried my best to chant the holy name all night, but I still did not finish.

lines: kāli samāpta habe, tabe habe vrata-bhaṅga
devanagari: “कालि समाप्त हबे, तबे हबे व्रत - भङ्ग ।
स्वच्छन्दे तोमार सङ्गे हइबेक सङ्ग” ॥126॥
cc-antya-3.126.translation: "Tomorrow I will surely finish, and my vow will be fulfilled. Then it will be possible for me to enjoy with you in full freedom."

lines: āra dina sandhyā ha-ite ṭhākura-ṭhāñi āila
devanagari: वेश्या गिया समाचार खाँनेरे कहिल ।
आर दिन सन्ध्या हइते ठाकुर - ठाञि आइल ॥127॥
cc-antya-3.127.translation: The prostitute returned to Rāmacandra Khān and informed him of what had happened. The next day she came earlier, at the beginning of the evening, and stayed with Haridāsa Ṭhākura.

devanagari: तुलसीके, ठाकुरके नमस्कार करि’ ।
द्वारे व सि’ नाम शुने, बले ‘हरि’ ‘हरि’ ॥128॥
cc-antya-3.128.translation: After offering obeisances to the tulasī plant and Haridāsa Ṭhākura, she sat down on the threshold of the room. Thus she began to hear Haridāsa Ṭhākura's chanting, and she also personally chanted "Hari, Hari," the holy name of the Lord.

devanagari: ‘नाम पूर्ण हबे आजि’, - बले हरिदास ।
‘तबे पूर्ण करिमु आजि तोमार अभिलाष’ ॥129॥
cc-antya-3.129.translation: "Today it will be possible for me to finish my chanting," Haridāsa Ṭhākura informed her. "Then I shall satisfy all your desires."

devanagari: शुनि’ प्रभु कहे, - ‘क्या कह, दामोदर ?’ ।
दामोदर कहे , - तुमि स्वतन्त्र ‘ईश्वर’ ॥13॥
cc-antya-3.13.translation: Although Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu knew that Dāmodara Paṇḍita was a pure and simple devotee, upon hearing this impudent talk the Lord said, "My dear Dāmodara, what nonsense are you speaking?" Dāmodara Paṇḍita replied, "You are the independent Personality of Godhead, beyond all criticism.

lines: ṭhākurera sane veśyāra mana phiri' gela
devanagari: कीर्तन करिते ऐछे रात्रि - शेष हैल ।
ठाकुरेर सने वेश्यार मन फिरि’ गेल ॥130॥
cc-antya-3.130.translation: The night ended while Haridāsa Ṭhākura was chanting, but by his association the mind of the prostitute had changed.

devanagari: दण्डवत् हञा पड़े ठाकुर - चरणे ।
रामचन्द्र - खाँनेर कथा कैल निवेदने ॥131॥
cc-antya-3.131.translation: The prostitute, now purified, fell at the lotus feet of Haridāsa Ṭhākura and confessed that Rāmacandra Khān had appointed her to pollute him.

devanagari: “वेश्या ह ञा मुञि पाप करियाछों अपार ।
कृपा करि’ कर मो - अधमे निस्तार” ॥132॥
cc-antya-3.132.translation: "Because I have taken the profession of a prostitute," she said, "I have performed unlimited sinful acts. My lord, be merciful to me. Deliver my fallen soul."

lines: ṭhākura kahe,—khāṅnera kathā saba āmi jāni
ajña mūrkha sei, tāre duḥkha nāhi māni
devanagari: ठाकुर कहे, - खाँनेर कथा सब आमि जानि ।
अज्ञ मूर्ख सेइ, तारे दुःख नाहि मानि ॥133॥
cc-antya-3.133.translation: Haridāsa Ṭhākura replied, "I know everything about the conspiracy of Rāmacandra Khān. He is nothing but an ignorant fool. Therefore his activities do not make me feel unhappy.

lines: tina dina rahilāṅa tomā nistāra lāgiyā
devanagari: सेइ - दिन याइताम ए - स्थान छाड़िया ।
तिन दिन रहिलाङ तोमा निस्तार लागिया ॥134॥
cc-antya-3.134.translation: "On the very day Rāmacandra Khān was planning his intrigue against me, I would have left this place immediately, but because you came to me I stayed here for three days to deliver you."

lines: ki mora kartavya, yāte yāya bhava-kleśa"
devanagari: वेश्या कहे, - “कृपा करि’ करह उपदेश ।
कि मोर कर्तव्य, याते याय भव - क्लेश” ॥135॥
cc-antya-3.135.translation: The prostitute said, "Kindly act as my spiritual master. Instruct me in my duty by which to get relief from material existence."

lines: ṭhākura kahe,—"gharera dravya brāhmaṇe kara dāna
ei ghare āsi' tumi karaha viśrāma
devanagari: ठाकुर कहे, - “घरेर द्रव्य ब्राह्मणे कर दान ।
एइ घरे आ सि’ तुमि करह विश्राम ॥136॥
cc-antya-3.136.translation: Haridāsa Ṭhākura replied, "Immediately go home and distribute to the brāhmaṇas whatever property you have. Then come back to this room and stay here forever in Kṛṣṇa consciousness.

lines: nirantara nāma lao, kara tulasī sevana
devanagari: निरन्तर नाम लओ, कर तुलसी सेवन ।
अचिरात् पाबे तबे कृष्णेर चरण ॥137॥
cc-antya-3.137.translation: "Chant the Hare Kṛṣṇa mantra continuously and render service to the tulasī plant by watering her and offering prayers to her. In this way you will very soon get the opportunity to be sheltered at the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa."

devanagari: एत बलि’ तारे ‘नाम’ उपदेश करि’ ।
उठिया चलिला ठाकुर बलि’ ‘हरि’ ‘हरि’ ॥138॥
cc-antya-3.138.translation: After thus instructing the prostitute about the process of chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa mantra, Haridāsa Ṭhākura stood up and left, continuously chanting "Hari, Hari."

lines: tabe sei veśyā gurura ājñā la-ila
devanagari: तबे सेइ वेश्या गुरुर आज्ञा लइल ।
गृह - वित्त येबा छिल, ब्राह्मणेरे दिल ॥139॥
cc-antya-3.139.translation: Thereafter, the prostitute distributed to the brāhmaṇas whatever household possessions she had, following the order of her spiritual master.

lines: svacchande ācāra kara, ke pāre balite?
devanagari: स्वच्छन्दे आचार कर, के पारे बलिते ? ।
मुखर जगतेर मुख पार आच्छादिते? ॥14॥
cc-antya-3.14.translation: "My dear Lord, You can act as You please. No one can say anything to restrict You. Nevertheless, the entire world is impudent. People can say anything. How can You stop them?

lines: māthā muḍi' eka-vastre rahila sei ghare
devanagari: माथा मुड़ि’ एक - वस्त्रे रहिल सेइ घरे ।
रात्रि - दिने तिन - लक्ष नाम ग्रहण करे ॥140॥
cc-antya-3.140.translation: The prostitute shaved her head clean in accordance with Vaiṣṇava principles and stayed in that room wearing only one cloth. Following in the footsteps of her spiritual master, she began chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra 300,000 times a day. She chanted throughout the entire day and night.

devanagari: तुलसी सेवन करे, चर्वण, उपवास ।
इन्द्रिय - दमन हैल, प्रेमेर प्रकाश ॥141॥
cc-antya-3.141.translation: She worshiped the tulasī plant, following in the footsteps of her spiritual master. Instead of eating regularly, she chewed whatever food she received as alms, and if nothing was supplied she would fast. Thus by eating frugally and fasting she conquered her senses, and as soon as her senses were controlled, symptoms of love of Godhead appeared in her person.

lines: baḍa baḍa vaiṣṇava tāṅra darśanete yānti
devanagari: प्रसिद्धा वैष्णवी हैल परम - महान्ती ।
बड़ बड़ वैष्णव ताँर दर्शनेते यान्ति ॥142॥
cc-antya-3.142.translation: Thus the prostitute became a celebrated devotee. She became very advanced in spiritual life, and many stalwart Vaiṣṇavas would come to see her.

devanagari: वेश्यार चरित्र देखि’ लोके चमत्कार ।
हरिदासेर महिमा कहे क रि’ नमस्कार ॥143॥
cc-antya-3.143.translation: Seeing the sublime character of the prostitute, everyone was astonished. Everyone glorified the influence of Haridāsa Ṭhākura and offered him obeisances.

lines: sei bīja vṛkṣa hañā āgete phalila
devanagari: रामचन्द्र खाँन अपराध - बीज कैल ।
सेइ बी ज वृक्ष हञा आगेते फलिल ॥144॥
cc-antya-3.144.translation: By inducing a prostitute to disturb Haridāsa Ṭhākura, Rāmacandra Khān caused a seed of offense at his lotus feet to germinate. This seed later became a tree, and when it fructified, Rāmacandra Khān ate its fruits.

devanagari: महदपराधेर फल अद्भुत कथन ।
प्रस्ताव पाञा कहि, शुन, भक्त - गण ॥145॥
cc-antya-3.145.translation: This offense at the lotus feet of an exalted devotee has resulted in a wonderful narration. Taking advantage of the opportunity afforded by these incidents, I shall explain what happened. O devotees, please listen.

devanagari: सहजेइ अवैष्णव रामचन्द्र - खाँन ।
हरिदासेर अपराधे हैल असुर - समान ॥146॥
cc-antya-3.146.translation: Rāmacandra Khān was naturally a nondevotee. Now, having offended the lotus feet of Haridāsa Ṭhākura, he became just like a demoniac atheist.

devanagari: वैष्णव - धर्म निन्दा करे, वैष्णव - अपमान ।
बहु - दिनेर अपराधे पाइल परिणाम ॥147॥
cc-antya-3.147.translation: Because of blaspheming the cult of Vaiṣṇavism and insulting the devotees for a long time, he now received the results of his offensive activities.

devanagari: नित्या नन्द - गोसा ञि गौड़े यबे आइला ।
प्रेम प्रचारिते तबे भ्रमिते लागिला ॥148॥
cc-antya-3.148.translation: When Lord Nityānanda returned to Bengal to preach the cult of bhakti, love of Godhead, He began touring all over the country.

devanagari: प्रेम - प्रचारण आर पाषण्ड - दलन ।
दुइ - कार्ये अवधूत करेन भ्रमण ॥149॥
cc-antya-3.149.translation: For two purposes-to spread the cult of bhakti and to defeat and subdue the atheists-Lord Nityānanda, the most dedicated devotee of the Lord, moved throughout the country.

lines: paṇḍita hañā mane kene vicāra nā kara?
rāṇḍī brāhmaṇīra bālake prīti kene kara?
devanagari: पण्डित ह ञा मने केने विचार ना कर ?।
राण्डी ब्राह्मणीर बालके प्रीति केने कर ? ॥15॥
cc-antya-3.15.translation: "Dear Lord, You are a learned teacher. Why then don't You consider that this boy is the son of a widowed brāhmaṇī? Why are You so affectionate to him?

devanagari: सर्वज्ञ नित्यानन्द आइला तार घरे ।
आसिया वसिला दुर्गा - मण्डप - उपरे ॥150॥
cc-antya-3.150.translation: Lord Nityānanda, who is omniscient because He is the Supreme Personality of Godhead, came to the house of Rāmacandra Khān and sat down on the altar of the Durgā-maṇḍapa.

devanagari: अनेक लोक - जन सङ्गे अङ्गन भरिल ।
भितर हैते रामचन्द्र सेवक पाठाइल ॥151॥
cc-antya-3.151.translation: When the Durgā-maṇḍapa and courtyard were filled with crowds of men, Rāmacandra Khān, who was inside the house, sent his servant to Lord Nityānanda.

devanagari: सेवक बले - “गोसाञि, मोरे पाठाइल खाँन ।
गृहस्थेर घरे तोमाय दिब वासा - स्थान” ॥152॥
cc-antya-3.152.translation: The servant informed Lord Nityānanda, "My dear sir, Rāmacandra Khān has sent me to accommodate You in some common man's house.

devanagari: गोयालार गोशाला हय अत्यन्त विस्तार ।
इहाँ सङ्कीर्ण - स्थल, तोमार मनुष्य अपार” ॥153॥
cc-antya-3.153.translation: "You might go to the house of a milkman, for the cow shed is spacious, whereas the space here in the Durgā-maṇḍapa is insufficient because You have many followers with You."

lines: aṭṭa aṭṭa hāsi' gosāñi kahite lāgilā
devanagari: भितरे आछिला, शुनि’ क्रोधे बाहिरिला ।
अट्ट अट्ट हा सि’ गोसा ञि कहिते लागिला ॥154॥
cc-antya-3.154.translation: When Nityānanda Prabhu heard this order from the servant of Rāmacandra Khān, He became very angry and came out. Laughing very loudly, He spoke as follows.

lines: mleccha go-vadha kare, tāra yogya haya"
devanagari: “सत्य कहे , - एइ घर मोर योग्य नय ।
म्लेच्छ गो - वध करे, तार योग्य हय” ॥155॥
cc-antya-3.155.translation: "Rāmacandra Khān has spoken rightly. This place is unfit for Me. It is fit for cow-killing meateaters."

lines: eta bali' krodhe gosāñi uṭhiyā calilā
tāre daṇḍa dite se grāme nā rahilā
devanagari: एत ब लि’ क्रोधे गोसा ञि उठिया चलिला ।
तारे दण्ड दिते से ग्रामे ना रहिला ॥156॥
cc-antya-3.156.translation: Having said this, Lord Nityānanda stood up and left in an angry mood. To chastise Rāmacandra Khān, He did not even stay in that village.

lines: ihāṅ rāmacandra khāna sevake ājñā dila
gosāñi yāhāṅ vasilā, tāra māṭī khodāila
devanagari: इहाँ रामचन्द्र खान सेवके आज्ञा दिल ।
गोसा ञि याहाँ वसिला, तार माटी खोदाइल ॥157॥
cc-antya-3.157.translation: Rāmacandra Khān ordered the servant to dig up the dirt in the place where Nityānanda Prabhu had sat.

lines: tabu rāmacandrera mana nā haila parasanna
devanagari: गोमय - जले लेपिला सब मन्दिर - प्राङ्गण ।
तबु रामचन्द्रेर मन ना हैल परसन्न ॥158॥
cc-antya-3.158.translation: To purify the Durgā-maṇḍapa temple and the courtyard, Rāmacandra Khān sprinkled and smeared it with water mixed with cow dung, but still his mind was unsatisfied.

lines: dasyu-vṛtti kare rāmacandra rājāre nā deya kara
kruddha hañā mleccha ujira āila tāra ghara
devanagari: दस्यु - वृत्ति करे रामचन्द्र राजारे ना देय कर ।
क्रुद्ध हञा म्लेच्छ उजिर आइल तार घर ॥159॥
cc-antya-3.159.translation: Rāmacandra Khān's business was questionable, for he tried to avoid paying income tax to the government. Therefore the government's minister of finance was angry and came to his residence.

devanagari: यद्यपि ब्राह्मणी सेइ तपस्विनी सती ।
तथापि ताहार दोष - सुन्दरी युवती ॥16॥
cc-antya-3.16.translation: "Although the boy's mother is completely austere and chaste, she has one natural fault-she is a very beautiful young girl.

lines: avadhya vadha kari' māṁsa se-ghare rāndhāila
devanagari: आसि’ सेइ दुर्गा - मण्डपे वासा कैल ।
अवध्य वध क रि’ मांस से - घरे रान्धाइल ॥160॥
cc-antya-3.160.translation: The Mohammedan minister made his residence in the Durgā-maṇḍapa of Rāmacandra Khān. He killed a cow and cooked the meat at that very place.

devanagari: स्त्री - पुत्र - सहित रा मचन्द्रेरे बान्धिया ।
तार घर - ग्राम लुटे तिन - दिन रहिया ॥161॥
cc-antya-3.161.translation: He arrested Rāmacandra Khān, along with his wife and sons, and then he continuously plundered the house and village for three days.

lines: sei ghare tina dina kare amedhya randhana
āra dina sabā lañā karilā gamana
devanagari: सेइ घरे तिन दिन करे अमेध्य रन्धन ।
आर दिन सबा लञा करिला गमन ॥162॥
cc-antya-3.162.translation: In that very room he cooked the flesh of a cow for three consecutive days. Then the next day he left, accompanied by his followers.

devanagari: जाति - धन - जन खानेर सकल लइल ।
बहु - दिन पर्यन्त ग्राम उजाड़ रहिल ॥163॥
cc-antya-3.163.translation: The Mohammedan minister took away Rāmacandra Khān's position, wealth and followers. For many days the village remained deserted.

lines: eka janāra doṣe saba deśa ujāḍaya
devanagari: महान्तेर अपमान ये देश - ग्रामे हय ।
एक जनार दोषे सब देश उजाड़य ॥164॥
cc-antya-3.164.translation: Wherever an advanced devotee is insulted, for one man's fault the entire town or place is afflicted.

devanagari: हरिदास - ठाकुर चलि’ आइला चान्दपुरे ।
आसिया रहिला बलराम - आचार्येर घरे ॥165॥
cc-antya-3.165.translation: Haridāsa Ṭhākura walked until he came to the village known as Cāndapura. There he stayed at the house of Balarāma Ācārya.

devanagari: हिरण्य, गोवर्धन - दुइ मुलुकेर मजुमदार ।
तार पुरोहित - ‘बलरा म’ नाम ताँर ॥166॥
cc-antya-3.166.translation: Hiraṇya and Govardhana were the two governmental treasurers in that division of the country. Their priest was named Balarāma Ācārya.

lines: yatna kari' ṭhākurere rākhilā sei grāme
devanagari: हरिदासेर कृपा - पात्र, ताते भक्ति - माने ।
यत्न करि’ ठाकुरेरे राखिला सेइ ग्रामे ॥167॥
cc-antya-3.167.translation: Balarāma Ācārya, being favored by Haridāsa Ṭhākura, was very attached to him. Therefore he kept Haridāsa Ṭhākura in the village with great care and attention.

devanagari: निर्जन पर्ण - शाला य करेन कीर्तन ।
बलराम - आचार्य - गृहे भिक्षा - निर्वाहण ॥168॥
cc-antya-3.168.translation: In the village, Haridāsa Ṭhākura was given a solitary thatched cottage, where he performed the chanting of the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra He accepted prasāda at the house of Balarāma Ācārya.

devanagari: रघुनाथ - दास बालक करेन अध्ययन ।
हरिदास - ठाकुरेरे याइ’ करेन दर्शन ॥169॥
cc-antya-3.169.translation: Raghunātha dāsa, who was the son of Hiraṇya Majumadāra and was later to become Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī, was at that time a boy engaged in study. He came to see Haridāsa Ṭhākura daily.

devanagari: तुमि - ह - परम युवा, परम सुन्दर ।
लोकेर काणाकाणि - बाते देह अवसर” ॥17॥
cc-antya-3.17.translation: "And You, my dear Lord, are a handsome, attractive young man. Therefore certainly people will whisper about You. Why should You give them such a opportunity?"

devanagari: हरिदास कृपा करे ताँहार उपरे ।
सेइ कृपा ‘कारण’ हैल चैतन्य पाइबारे ॥170॥
cc-antya-3.170.translation: Naturally Haridāsa Ṭhākura was merciful toward him, and because of the merciful benediction of this Vaiṣṇava, he later attained the shelter of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's lotus feet.

lines: tāhāṅ yaiche haila haridāsera mahimā kathana
devanagari: ताहाँ यैछे हैल हरिदासेर महिमा कथन ।
व्याख्यान, अद्भुत कथा शुन, भक्त - गण ॥171॥
cc-antya-3.171.translation: At the residence of Hiraṇya and Govardhana, discourses took place by which Haridāsa Ṭhākura was glorified. O devotees, please listen to that wonderful story.

devanagari: एक - दिन बलराम मि नति करिया ।
मजुमदारेर सभाय आइला ठाकुरे लाञा ॥172॥
cc-antya-3.172.translation: One day Balarāma Ācārya requested Haridāsa Ṭhākura with great humility to come to the assembly of the Majumadāras, Hiraṇya and Govardhana. Thus Balarāma Ācārya went there with Haridāsa Ṭhākura.

lines: ṭhākura dekhi' dui bhāi kailā abhyutthāna
pāya paḍi' āsana dilā kariyā sammāna
devanagari: ठाकुर देखि’ दुइ भाइ कैला अभ्युत्थान ।
पाय पड़ि’ आसन दिला करिया सम्मा न ॥173॥
cc-antya-3.173.translation: Seeing Haridāsa Ṭhākura, the two brothers immediately stood up and fell at his lotus feet. Then with great respect they offered him a place to sit.

devanagari: अनेक पण्डित सभाय, ब्राह्मण, सज्जन ।
दुइ भाइ महा - पण्डित - हिरण्य, गोवर्धन ॥174॥
cc-antya-3.174.translation: In that assembly were many learned scholars, brāhmaṇas and respectable gentlemen. The two brothers Hiraṇya and Govardhana were also greatly learned.

lines: śuniyā ta' dui bhāi pāilā baḍa sukhe
devanagari: हरिदासेर गुण सबे कहे पञ्च - मुखे ।
शुनिया त’ दुइ भाइ पाइला बड़ सुखे ॥175॥
cc-antya-3.175.translation: Everyone there began to speak of Haridāsa Ṭhākura's great qualities as if they had five mouths. Hearing this, both brothers were extremely happy.

devanagari: तिन - लक्ष नाम ठाकुर करेन कीर्तन ।
नामेर महिमा उठाइल पण्डित - गण ॥176॥
cc-antya-3.176.translation: It was mentioned in the assembly that Haridāsa Ṭhākura chanted the holy names of Kṛṣṇa 300,000 times a day. Thus all the learned scholars began to discuss the glories of the holy name.

lines: keha bale,—'nāma haite jīvera mokṣa haya'
devanagari: केह बले , - ‘नाम हैते हय पाप - क्षय’ ।
केह बले, - ‘नाम हैते जीवेर मोक्ष हय’ ॥177॥
cc-antya-3.177.translation: Some of them said, "By chanting the holy name of the Lord, one is freed from the reactions of all sinful life." Others said, "Simply by chanting the holy name of the Lord, a living being is liberated from material bondage."

lines: haridāsa kahena,—"nāmera ei dui phala naya
devanagari: हरिदास कहेन, - “नामेर एइ दुइ फल नय ।
नामेर फले कृष्ण - पदे प्रेम उपजय ॥178॥
cc-antya-3.178.translation: Haridāsa Ṭhākura protested, "These two benedictions are not the true result of chanting the holy name. By actually chanting the holy name without offenses, one awakens his ecstatic love for the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: एवं - व्रतः स्व - प्रिय - नाम - कीर्त्या जातानुरागो द्रुत - चित्त उच्चैः ।
हसत्यथो रोदिति रौति गायत्य् उन्माद - वन्नृत्यति लोक - बाह्यः ॥179॥
cc-antya-3.179.translation: "When a person is actually advanced and takes pleasure in chanting the holy name of the Lord, who is very dear to him, he is agitated and loudly chants the holy name. He also laughs, cries, becomes agitated and chants just like a madman, not caring for outsiders.'

devanagari: एत बलि’ दामोदर मौन हइला ।
अन्तरे सन्तोष प्रभु हासि’ विचारिला ॥18॥
cc-antya-3.18.translation: Having said this, Dāmodara Paṇḍita became silent. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu smiled, pleased within Himself, and considered the impudence of Dāmodara Paṇḍita.

devanagari: आनुषङ्गिक फल नामेर - ‘मुक्ति’, ‘पाप - नाश’ ।
ताहार दृष्टान्त यैछे सूर्येर प्रकाश ॥180॥
cc-antya-3.180.translation: "Liberation and extinction of the reactions of sinful life are two concomitant by-products of chanting the holy name of the Lord. An example is found in the gleams of morning sunlight.

devanagari: अंहः संहरदखिलं सकृद् उदयादेव सकल - लोकस्य ।
तरणिरिव तिमिर - जलधिं जयति जगन्मङ्गलं हरेर्नाम ॥181॥
