cc-antya-3.181.translation: "As the rising sun immediately dissipates all the world's darkness, which is deep like an ocean, so the holy name of the Lord, if chanted once without offenses, can dissipate all the reactions of a living being's sinful life. All glories to that holy name of the Lord, which is auspicious for the entire world.' "

lines: ei ślokera artha kara paṇḍitera gaṇa"
devanagari: एइ श्लोकेर अर्थ कर पण्डितेर गण” ।
सबे कहे , - ‘तुमि कह अर्थ - विवरण’ ॥182॥
cc-antya-3.182.translation: After reciting this verse, Haridāsa Ṭhākura said, "O learned scholars, please explain the meaning of this verse." But the audience requested Haridāsa Ṭhākura, "It is better for you to explain the meaning of this important verse."

lines: udaya nā haite ārambhe tamera haya kṣaya
devanagari: हरिदास कहेन , - “यैछे सूर उदय ।
उदय ना हैते आरम्भे तमेर हय क्षय” ॥183॥
cc-antya-3.183.translation: Haridāsa Ṭhākura said, "As the sun begins to rise, even before visible it dissipates the darkness of night.

devanagari: चौर - प्रेत - राक्षसादिर भय हय नाश ।
उदय हैले धर्म - कर्म - आदि परकाश ॥184॥
cc-antya-3.184.translation: "With the first glimpse of sunlight, fear of thieves, ghosts and demons immediately disappears, and when the sun is actually visible, everything is manifest, and everyone begins performing his religious activities and regulative duties.

devanagari: ऐछे नामोदयारम्भे पाप - आदिर क्षय ।
उदय कैले कृष्ण - पदे हय प्रेमोदय ॥185॥
cc-antya-3.185.translation: "Similarly, the first hint that offenseless chanting of the Lord's holy name has awakened dissipates the reactions of sinful life immediately. And when one chants the holy name offenselessly, one awakens to service in ecstatic love at the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: ‘मुक्ति’ तुच्छ - फल हय नामाभास हैते ॥186॥
cc-antya-3.186.translation: "Liberation is the insignificant result derived from a glimpse of awakening of offenseless chanting of the holy name.

devanagari: म्रियमाणो हरेर्नाम गृणन्पुत्रोपचारितम् ।
अजामिलोऽप्यगाद्धाम किमुत श्रद्धया गृणन् ॥187॥
cc-antya-3.187.translation: "While dying, Ajāmila chanted the holy name of the Lord, intending to call his son Nārāyaṇa. Nevertheless, he attained the spiritual world. What then to speak of those who chant the holy name with faith and reverence?'

lines: ye mukti bhakta nā laya, se kṛṣṇa cāhe dite"
devanagari: “ये मुक्ति भक्त ना लय, से कृष्ण चाहे दिते” ॥188॥
cc-antya-3.188.translation: "Liberation, which is unacceptable for a pure devotee, is always offered by Kṛṣṇa without difficulty.

devanagari: सालोक्य - सार्ष्टि - सारूप्य - सामीप्यैकत्वमप्युत ।
दीयमानं न गृह्णन्ति विना मत्सेवनं जनाः ॥189॥
cc-antya-3.189.translation: "My devotees do not accept sālokya, sārṣṭi, sārūpya, sāmīpya, or oneness with Me-even if I offer these liberations-in preference to serving Me.' "

devanagari: “इहारे कहिये शुद्ध - प्रेमेर तरङ्ग ।
दामोदर - सम मोर नाहि “अन्तरङ्ग” ॥19॥
cc-antya-3.19.translation: "This impudence is also a sign of pure love for Me. I have no other intimate friend like Dāmodara Paṇḍita."

devanagari: ‘गोपाल चक्रवर्ती’ नाम एक - जन ।
मजुमदारेर घरे सेइ आरिन्दा प्रधान ॥190॥
cc-antya-3.190.translation: At the house of Hiraṇya and Govardhana Majumadāra, a person named Gopāla Cakravartī was officially the chief tax collector.

lines: bāra-lakṣa mudrā sei pātsāra ṭhāñi bhare
devanagari: गौड़े र हि’ पात्साहा - आगे आरिन्दा - गिरि करे ।
बार - लक्ष मुद्रा सेइ पात्सार ठाञि भरे ॥191॥
cc-antya-3.191.translation: This Gopāla Cakravartī lived in Bengal. His duty as chief tax collector was to collect 1,200,000 coins to deposit in the treasury of the emperor.

devanagari: परम - सुन्दर, पण्डित, नूतन - यौवन ।
नामाभासे ‘मुक्ति’ ‘शुनि’ ना हइल सहन ॥192॥
cc-antya-3.192.translation: He had handsome bodily features, and he was learned and youthful, but he could not tolerate the statement that simply by glimpsing the awakening of the Lord's holy name one can attain liberation.

lines: kruddha hañā bale sei saroṣa vacana
devanagari: क्रुद्ध हञा बले सेइ सरोष वचन ।
“भावुकेर सिद्धान्त शुन, पण्डितेर गण ॥193॥
cc-antya-3.193.translation: This young man, Gopāla Cakravartī, became very angry upon hearing the statements of Haridāsa Ṭhākura. He immediately criticized him. "O assembly of learned scholars," he said, "just hear the conclusion of the emotional devotee.

devanagari: कोटि - जन्मे ब्रह्म - ज्ञाने येइ ‘मुक्ति’ नय ।
एइ कहे , - नामाभासे सेइ ‘मुक्ति’ हय” ॥194॥
cc-antya-3.194.translation: "After many millions upon millions of births, when one is complete in absolute knowledge, one still may not attain liberation, yet this man says that one may attain it simply by the awakening of a glimpse of the holy name."

devanagari: हरिदास कहेन, - केने करह संशय? ।
शास्त्रे कहे , - नामाभास - मात्रे ‘मुक्ति’ हय ॥195॥
cc-antya-3.195.translation: Haridāsa Ṭhākura said, "Why are you doubtful? The revealed scriptures say that one can attain liberation simply by a glimpse of offenseless chanting of the holy name.

devanagari: भक्ति - सुख - आगे ‘मुक्ति’ अति - तुच्छ हय ।
अतएव भक्त - गण ‘मुक्ति’ नाहि लय ॥196॥
cc-antya-3.196.translation: "For a devotee who enjoys the transcendental bliss of devotional service, liberation is most insignificant. Therefore pure devotees never desire to achieve liberation.

devanagari: त्वत्साक्षात्करणाह्लाद - विशुद्धाब्धि - स्थितस्य मे ।
सुखानि गोष्पदायन्ते ब्राह्माण्यपि जगद्गुरो ॥197॥
cc-antya-3.197.translation: "My dear Lord, O master of the universe, since I have directly seen You, my transcendental bliss has taken the shape of a great ocean. Being situated in that ocean, I now realize all other so-called happiness, including even brahmānanda, to be like the water contained in the hoofprint of a calf.' "

lines: tabe tomāra nāka kāṭi' karaha niścaya"
devanagari: विप्र कहे, - “नामाभासे यदि ‘मुक्ति’ नय ।
तबे तोमार नाक काटि’ करह निश्चय ॥198॥
cc-antya-3.198.translation: Gopāla Cakravartī said, "if one is not liberated by nāmābhāsa, then you may be certain that I shall cut off your nose."

devanagari: हरिदास कहेन, - “यदि नामाभासे ‘मुक्ति’ नये ।
तबे आमार नाक काटिमु, - एइ सुनिश्चय” ॥199॥
cc-antya-3.199.translation: Then Haridāsa Ṭhākura accepted the challenge offered by Gopāla Cakravartī. "If by nāmābhāsa liberation is not available," he said, "certainly I shall cut off my nose."

devanagari: जय जय गौरचन्द्र जय नि त्यानन्द ।
जयाद्वैत - चन्द्र जय गौर - भक्त - वृन्द ॥2॥
cc-antya-3.2.translation: All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu! All glories to Nityānanda Prabhu! All glories to Advaita Ācārya! And all glories to all the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu!

devanagari: एतेक विचा रि’ प्रभु मध्याह्ने चलिला ।
आर दिने दामोदरे निभृते बोलाइला ॥20॥
cc-antya-3.20.translation: Thinking in this way, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to perform His noon duties. The next day, He called Dāmodara Paṇḍita to a solitary place.

devanagari: शुनि’ सभासद् उठे करि’ हाहाकार ।
मजुमदार सेइ विप्रे करिल धिक्कार ॥200॥
cc-antya-3.200.translation: All the members of the assembly who had heard the challenge were greatly agitated, and they got up, making a tumultuous sound. Hiraṇya and Govardhana Majumadāra both immediately chastised the brāhmaṇa tax collector.

devanagari: बलाइ - पुरोहित तारे करिला भर्त्सन ।
“घट - पटिया मूर्ख तुञि भक्ति काँहा जान?” ॥201॥
cc-antya-3.201.translation: The priest named Balarāma Ācārya chastised Gopāla Cakravartī. "You are a foolish logician," he said, "What do you know about the devotional service of the Lord?

lines: sarva-nāśa habe tora, nā habe kalyāṇa"
devanagari: हरिदास - ठाकुरे तुञि कैलि अपमान! ।
सर्व - नाश हबे तोर, ना हबे कल्याण ॥202॥
cc-antya-3.202.translation: "You have insulted Haridāsa Ṭhākura. Thus there will be a dangerous position for you. You should not expect anything auspicious."

devanagari: शुनि’ हरिदास तबे उठिया चलिला ।
मजुमदार सेइ विप्रे त्याग करिला ॥203॥
cc-antya-3.203.translation: Then Haridāsa Ṭhākura got up to leave, and the Majumadāras, the masters of Gopāla Cakravartī, immediately dismissed Gopāla Cakravartī from their service.

devanagari: सभा - सहिते हरिदासेर पड़िला चरणे ।
हरिदास हा सि’ कहे मधुर - वचने ॥204॥
cc-antya-3.204.translation: With all the members of the assembly, the two Majumadāras fell at the lotus feet of Haridāsa Ṭhākura. Haridāsa Ṭhākura was smiling, however, and he spoke in a sweet voice.

lines: tāra doṣa nāhi, tāra tarka-niṣṭha mana
devanagari: तोमा - सबार दोष नाहि, एइ अज्ञ ब्राह्मण ।
तार दोष नाहि, तार तकर् - निष्ठ मन ॥205॥
cc-antya-3.205.translation: "None of you are at fault," he said. "Indeed, even this ignorant so-called brāhmaṇa is not at fault, for he is accustomed to dry speculation and logic.

lines: kothā haite jānibe se ei saba tattva?
devanagari: तकर्ेर गोचर नहे नामेर महत्त्व ।
कोथा हैते जानिबे से एड सब तत्त्व ? ॥206॥
cc-antya-3.206.translation: "One cannot understand the glories of the holy name simply by logic and argument. Therefore this man cannot possibly understand the glories of the holy name.

lines: yāha ghara, kṛṣṇa karuna kuśala sabāra
āmāra sambandhe duḥkha nā ha-uka kāhāra"
devanagari: याह घर, कृष्ण करुन कुशल सबार ।
आमार सम्बन्धे दुःख ना हउक काहार” ॥207॥
cc-antya-3.207.translation: "All of you may now go to your homes. May Lord Kṛṣṇa bestow his blessings upon you all. Do not be sorry because of my being insulted."

lines: tabe se hiraṇya-dāsa nija ghare āila
devanagari: तबे से हिरण्य - दास निज घरे आइल ।
सेइ ब्राह्मणे निज द्वार - माना कैल ॥208॥
cc-antya-3.208.translation: Then Hiraṇya dāsa Majumadāra returned to his home and ordered that Gopāla Cakravartī not be admitted therein.

lines: tina dina bhitare sei viprera 'kuṣṭha' haila
ati ucca nāsā tāra galiyā paḍila
devanagari: तिन दिन भितरे सेइ विप्रेर ‘कुष्ठ’ हैल ।
अति उच्च नासा तार गलिया पड़िल ॥209॥
cc-antya-3.209.translation: Within three days that brāhmaṇa was attacked by leprosy, and as a result his highly raised nose melted away and fell off.

lines: mātāra samīpe tumi raha tāṅhā yāñā
devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - “दामोदर, चलह नदीया ।
मातार समीपे तुमि रह ताँहा याञा ॥21॥
cc-antya-3.21.translation: The Lord said, "My dear friend Dāmodara, you had better go to Nadia and stay with My mother.

lines: koṅkaḍa ha-ila saba, kuṣṭhe gela gali'
devanagari: चम्पक - कलि - सम हस्त - पदाङ्गुलि ।
कोङ्कड़ हइल सब, कुष्ठे गेल गलि’ ॥210॥
cc-antya-3.210.translation: The brāhmaṇa's toes and fingers were beautiful like golden-colored campaka buds, but because of leprosy they all withered and gradually melted away.

devanagari: देखिया सकल लोक हैल चमत्कार ।
हरिदासे प्रशंसि’ ताँरे करे नमस्कार ॥211॥
cc-antya-3.211.translation: Seeing the condition of Gopāla Cakravartī, everyone was astonished. Everyone praised the influence of Haridāsa Ṭhākura and offered him obeisances.

lines: yadyapi haridāsa viprera doṣa nā la-ilā
devanagari: यद्यपि हरिदास विप्रेर दोष ना लइला ।
तथापि ईश्वर तारे फल भुञ्जाइला ॥212॥
cc-antya-3.212.translation: Although Haridāsa Ṭhākura, as a Vaiṣṇava, did not take seriously the brāhmaṇa's offense, the Supreme Personality of Godhead could not tolerate it, and thus he made the brāhmaṇa suffer the consequences.

devanagari: भक्त - स्वभाव , - अज्ञ - दोष क्षमा करे ।
कृष्ण - स्वभाव , - भक्त - निन्दा सहिते ना पारे ॥213॥
cc-antya-3.213.translation: A characteristic of a pure devotee is that he excuses any offense by an ignorant rascal. The characteristic of Kṛṣṇa, however, is that He cannot tolerate blasphemy of His devotees.

lines: viprera kuṣṭha śuni' haridāsa mane duḥkhī hailā
devanagari: विप्रेर कुष्ठ शुनि’ हरिदास मने दुःखी हैला ।
बलाइ - पुरोहिते कहि’ शान्तिपुर आइला ॥214॥
cc-antya-3.214.translation: Haridāsa Ṭhākura was unhappy when he heard that the brāhmaṇa Gopāla Cakravartī had been attacked by leprosy. Thus after informing Balarāma Ācārya, the priest of Hiraṇya Majumadāra, he went to Śāntipura, the home of Advaita Ācārya.

devanagari: आचा र्ये मिलिया कैला दण्डवत्प्रणाम ।
अद्वैत आलिङ्गन करि’ करिला सम्मान ॥215॥
cc-antya-3.215.translation: Upon meeting Advaita Ācārya, Haridāsa Ṭhākura offered Him respect and obeisances. Advaita Ācārya embraced him and showed respect to him in return.

lines: gaṅgā-tīre goṅphā kari' nirjane tāṅre dilā
devanagari: गङ्गा - तीरे गोंफा क रि’ निर्जने ताँरे दिला ।
भागवत - गीतार भक्ति - अर्थ शुनाइला ॥216॥
cc-antya-3.216.translation: On the bank of the Ganges, in a solitary place, Advaita Ācārya made a cavelike home for Haridāsa Ṭhākura and spoke to him about the real meaning of Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam and Bhagavad-gītā in terms of devotional service.

devanagari: आचा र्येर घरे नित्य भिक्षा - निर्वाहण ।
दुइ जना मिलि’ कृष्ण - कथा - आस्वादन ॥217॥
cc-antya-3.217.translation: Haridāsa Ṭhākura accepted food daily at the house of Advaita Ācārya. Meeting together, the two of them would taste the nectar of discourses on the subject matter of Kṛṣṇa.

lines: more pratyaha anna deha' kon prayojane?
devanagari: हरिदास कहे, - “गोसा ञि, करि निवेदने ।
मोरे प्रत्यह अन्न देह’ को प्रयोजने ?” ॥218॥
cc-antya-3.218.translation: Haridāsa Ṭhākura said, "My dear Advaita Ācārya, let me submit something before Your Honor. Every day You give me alms of food to eat. What is the necessity of this?

lines: nīce ādara kara, nā vāsaha bhaya lāja!!
devanagari: महा - महा - विप्र एथा कुलीन - समाज ।
नीचे आदर कर, ना वासह भय लाज!! ॥219॥
cc-antya-3.219.translation: "Sir, You are living within a society of great, great brāhmaṇas and aristocrats, but without fear or shame You adore a lower-class man like me.

lines: tomā vinā tāṅhāra rakṣaka nāhi dekhi āna
devanagari: तोमा विना ताँहार रक्षक नाहि देखि आन ।
आमाके - ह याते तुमि कैला सावधान ॥22॥
cc-antya-3.22.translation: "I see no one but you to protect her, for you are so careful that you can caution even Me.

lines: alaukika ācāra tomāra kahite pāi bhaya
sei kṛpā karibā,—yāte mora rakṣā haya"
devanagari: अलौकिक आचार तोमार कहिते पाइ भय ।
सेइ कृपा करिबा, - य़ाते मोर रक्षा हय ॥220॥
cc-antya-3.220.translation: "My dear sir, Your behavior is uncommon. Indeed, sometimes I am afraid to speak to You. But please favor me by protecting me from the behavior of society."

devanagari: आचार्य कहेन , - “तुमि ना करिह भय ।
सेइ आचरिब, येइ शास्त्र - मत हय” ॥221॥
cc-antya-3.221.translation: Advaita Ācārya replied, "My dear Haridāsa, do not be afraid. I shall behave strictly according to the principles of the revealed scriptures.

devanagari: “तुमि खाइले हय कोटि - ब्राह्मण - भोजन” ।
एत बलि, श्राद्ध - पात्र कराइला भोजन ॥222॥
cc-antya-3.222.translation: "Feeding you is equal to feeding ten million brāhmaṇas," Advaita Ācārya said. "Therefore, accept this śrāddha-pātra." Thus Advaita Ācārya made him eat.

devanagari: जगत् निस्तार लागि’ करेन चिन्तन ।
अवैष्णव - जगत् केमने हइबे मोचन? ॥223॥
cc-antya-3.223.translation: Advaita Ācārya was always absorbed in thoughts of how to deliver the fallen souls of the entire world. "The entire world is full of nondevotees," He thought. "How will they be delivered?"

devanagari: कृष्णे अवतारिते अद्वैत प्रतिज्ञा करिला ।
जल - तुलसी दिया पूजा करिते लागिला ॥224॥
cc-antya-3.224.translation: Determined to deliver all the fallen souls, Advaita Ācārya decided to cause Kṛṣṇa to descend. With this vow, he began to offer Ganges water and tulasī leaves to worship the Lord.

devanagari: हरिदास करे गोंफाय नाम - सङ्कीर्तन ।
कृष्ण अवतीर्ण हइबेन, - एइ ताँर मन ॥225॥
cc-antya-3.225.translation: Similarly, Haridāsa Ṭhākura chanted in his cave on the bank of the Ganges with the intention to cause Kṛṣṇa's descent.

devanagari: दुइ - जनेर भक्त्ये चैतन्य कैला अवतार ।
नाम - प्रेम प्रचा रि’ कैला जगत् उद्धार ॥226॥
cc-antya-3.226.translation: Because of the devotional service of these two persons, Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu descended as an incarnation. Thus He preached the holy name of the Lord and ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa to deliver the entire world.

devanagari: आर अलौकिक एक चरित्र ताँहार ।
याहार श्रवणे लोके हय चमत्कार ॥227॥
cc-antya-3.227.translation: There is another incident concerning Haridāsa Ṭhākura's uncommon behavior. One will be astonished to hear about it.

lines: tarka nā kariha, tarkāgocara tāṅra rīti
devanagari: तकर् ना करिह, तर्कागोचर ताँर रीति ।
विश्वास करिया शुन करिया प्रतीति ॥228॥
cc-antya-3.228.translation: Hear about such incidents without putting forth dry arguments, for these incidents are beyond our material reasoning. One must believe in them with faith.

devanagari: एक - दिन हरिदास गोंफाते वसिया ।
नाम - सङ्कीर्तन करेन उच्च करिया ॥229॥
cc-antya-3.229.translation: One day Haridāsa Ṭhākura was sitting in his cave, reciting very loudly the holy name of the Lord.

devanagari: तोमा सम ‘निरपेक्ष’ नाहि मोर गणे ।
‘निरपेक्ष’ नहिले ‘धर्म’ ना याय रक्षणे ॥23॥
cc-antya-3.23.translation: "You are the most neutral among My associates. This is very good, for without being neutral one cannot protect religious principles.

devanagari: ज्योत्स्नावती रात्रि, दश दिक्सुनिर्मल ।
गङ्गार लहरी ज्योत्स्नाय करे झल - मल ॥230॥
cc-antya-3.230.translation: The night was full of moonlight, which made the waves of the Ganges look dazzling. All directions were clear and bright.

lines: goṅphāra śobhā dekhi' lokera juḍāya antara
devanagari: द्वारे तुलसी लेपा - पिण्डिर उपर ।
गोंफार शोभा देखि’ लोकेर जुड़ाय अन्तर ॥231॥
cc-antya-3.231.translation: Thus everyone who saw the beauty of the cave, with the tulasī plant on a clean altar, was astonished and satisfied at heart.

devanagari: हेन - काले एक नारी अङ्गने आइल ।
ताँर अङ्ग - कान्त्ये स्थान पीत - वर्ण हइल ॥232॥
cc-antya-3.232.translation: At that time, in that beautiful scene, a woman appeared in the courtyard. The beauty of her body was so bright that it tinged the entire place with a hue of yellow.

devanagari: ताँर अङ्ग - गन्धे दश दिक् आमोदित ।
भूषण - ध्वनिते कर्ण हय चमकित ॥233॥
cc-antya-3.233.translation: The scent of her body perfumed all directions, and the tinkling of her ornaments startled the ear.

devanagari: आसिया तुलसीरे सेइ कैला नमस्कार ।
तुलसी परिक्रमा करि’ गेला गोंफा - द्वार ॥234॥
cc-antya-3.234.translation: After coming there, the woman offered obeisances to the tulasī plant, and after circumambulating the tulasī plant she came to the door of the cave where Haridāsa Ṭhākura was sitting.

lines: dvāre vasi' kahe kichu madhura vacana
devanagari: योड़ - हाते हरिदासेर वन्दिला चरण ।
द्वारे व सि’ कहे किछु मधुर वचन ॥235॥
cc-antya-3.235.translation: With folded hands she offered obeisances at the lotus feet of Haridāsa Ṭhākura. Sitting at the door, she then spoke in a very sweet voice.

lines: tava saṅga lāgi' mora ethāke prayāṇa
devanagari: जगतेर बन्धु तुमि रूप - गुणवान् ।
तव सङ्ग लागि’ मोर एथाके प्रयाण ॥236॥
cc-antya-3.236.translation: "My dear friend," she said, "you are the friend of the entire world. You are so beautiful and qualified. I have come here only for union with you.

devanagari: “मोरे अङ्गीकार कर हाञा सदय ।
दीने दया करे , - एइ साधु - स्वभाव हय” ॥237॥
cc-antya-3.237.translation: "My dear sir, kindly accept me and be merciful toward me, for it is a characteristic of all saintly persons to be kind toward the poor and fallen."

devanagari: एत ब लि’ नाना - भाव करये प्रकाश ।
याहार दर्शने मुनिर हय धैर्य - नाश ॥238॥
cc-antya-3.238.translation: After saying this, she began to manifest various postures, which even the greatest philosopher would lose his patience upon seeing.

devanagari: निर्विकार हरिदास गम्भीर - आशय ।
बलिते लागिला तारे ह ञा सदय ॥239॥
cc-antya-3.239.translation: Haridāsa Ṭhākura was immovable, for he was deeply determined. He began to speak to her, being very merciful toward her.

lines: āmā haite ye nā haya, se tomā haite haya
āmāre karilā daṇḍa, āna kebā haya
devanagari: आमा हैते ये ना हय, से तोमा हैते हय ।
आमारे करिला दण्ड, आन केबा हय ॥24॥
cc-antya-3.24.translation: "You can do whatever I cannot. Indeed, you can chastise even Me, not to speak of others.

devanagari: सङ्ख्या - नाम - सङ्कीर्तन - एइ ‘महा - यज्ञ’ मन्ये ।
ताहाते दीक्षित आमि हइ प्रति - दिने ॥240॥
cc-antya-3.240.translation: "I have been initiated into a vow to perform a great sacrifice by chanting the holy name a certain number of times every day.

lines: yāvat kīrtana samāpta nahe, nā kari anya kāma
kīrtana samāpta haile, haya dīkṣāra viśrāma
devanagari: यावत्कीर्तन समाप्त नहे, ना करि अन्य काम ।
कीर्तन समाप्त हैले, हय दीक्षार विश्राम ॥241॥
cc-antya-3.241.translation: "As long as the vow to chant is unfulfilled, I do not desire anything else. When I finish my chanting, then I have an opportunity to do anything.

lines: nāma samāpta haile karimu tava prīti-ācaraṇa
devanagari: द्वारे व सि’ शुन तुमि नाम - सङ्कीर्तन ।
नाम समाप्त हैले करिमु तव प्रीति - आचरण ॥242॥
cc-antya-3.242.translation: "Sit down at the door and hear the chanting of the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra. As soon as the chanting is finished, I shall satisfy you as you desire."

devanagari: एत ब लि’ करेन तेंहो नाम - सङ्कीर्तन ।
सेइ नारी व सि’ करे श्री - नाम - श्रवण ॥243॥
cc-antya-3.243.translation: After saying this, Haridāsa Ṭhākura continued to chant the holy name of the Lord. Thus the woman sitting before him began to hear the chanting of the holy name.

devanagari: कीर्तन करिते आ सि’ प्रातः काल हैल ।
प्रातः काल देखि’ नारी उठिया चलिल ॥244॥
cc-antya-3.244.translation: In this way, as he chanted and chanted, the morning approached, and when the woman saw that it was morning, she got up and left.

lines: nānā bhāva dekhāya, yāte brahmāra hare mana
devanagari: एइ - मत तिन - दिन करे आगमन ।
नाना भाव देखाय, याते ब्रह्मार हरे म न ॥245॥
cc-antya-3.245.translation: For three days she approached Haridāsa Ṭhākura in this way, exhibiting various feminine postures that would bewilder the mind of even Lord Brahmā.

devanagari: कृष्णे नामाविष्ट - मना सदा हरिदास ।
अरण्ये रोदित हैल स्त्री - भाव - प्रकाश ॥246॥
cc-antya-3.246.translation: Haridāsa Ṭhākura was always absorbed in thoughts of Kṛṣṇa and the holy name of Kṛṣṇa. Therefore the feminine poses the woman exhibited were just like crying in the forest.

devanagari: तृतीय दिवसेर रात्रि - शेष यबे हैल ।
ठाकुरेर स्थाने नारी कहिते लागिल ॥247॥
cc-antya-3.247.translation: At the end of the night of the third day, the woman spoke to Haridāsa Ṭhākura as follows.

devanagari: “तिन दिन वञ्चिला आमा क रि’ आश्वासन ।
रात्रि - दिने नहे तोमार नाम - समाप न” ॥248॥
cc-antya-3.248.translation: "My dear sir, for three days you have cheated me by giving me false assurances, for I see that throughout the entire day and night your chanting of the holy name is never finished."

devanagari: हरिदास ठाकुर कहेन, - “आमि कि करिमु? ।
नियम करियाछि, ताहा केमने छाड़िमु?” ॥249॥
cc-antya-3.249.translation: Haridāsa Ṭhākura said, "My dear friend, what can I do? I have made a vow. How, then, can I give it up?"

lines: mātāra gṛhe raha yāi mātāra caraṇe
devanagari: मातार गृहे रह याइ मातार चरणे ।
तोमार आगे नहिबे कारो स्वच्छन्दाचरणे ॥25॥
cc-antya-3.25.translation: "It is best for you to go to the shelter of My mother's lotus feet, for no one will be able to behave independently in front of you.

lines: tabe nārī kahe tāṅre kari' namaskāra
devanagari: तबे नारी कहे ताँरे करि’ नमस्कार ।
‘आमि - माया’ करिते आइलाङ परीक्षा तोमार ॥250॥
cc-antya-3.250.translation: After offering obeisances to Haridāsa Ṭhākura, the woman said: "I am the illusory energy of the Supreme Personality of Godhead. I came here to test you.

devanagari: ब्रह्मादि जीव, आमि सबारे मोहिलुँ ।
एकेला तोमारे आमि मोहिते नारि लुँ ॥251॥
cc-antya-3.251.translation: "I have previously captivated the mind of even Brahmā, not to speak of others. Your mind alone have I failed to attract.

devanagari: महा - भागवत तुमि, - तोमार दर्शने ।
तोमार कृष्ण - नाम - कीर्तन - श्रवणे ॥252॥
cc-antya-3.252-253.translation: "My dear sir, you are the foremost devotee. Simply seeing you and hearing you chant the holy name of Kṛṣṇa has purified my consciousness. Now I want to chant the holy name of the Lord. Please be kind to me by instructing me about the ecstasy of chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra.

lines: saba jīva preme bhāse, pṛthivī haila dhanyā
devanagari: चैतन्यावतारे वहे प्रेमामृत - वन्या ।
सब जीव प्रेमे भासे, पृथिवी हैल धन्या ॥254॥
cc-antya-3.254.translation: "There is now a flood of the eternal nectar of love of Godhead due to the incarnation of Lord Caitanya, All living entities are floating in that flood. The entire world is now thankful to the Lord.

lines: e-vanyāya ye nā bhāse, sei jīva chāra
devanagari: ए - वन्याय ये ना भासे, सेइ जीव छार ।
कोटि - कल्पे कभु तार नाहिक निस्तार ॥255॥
cc-antya-3.255.translation: "Anyone who does not float in this inundation is most condemned. Such a person cannot be delivered for millions of kalpas.

lines: tomāra saṅge lobha haila kṛṣṇa-nāma laite
devanagari: पूर्वे आमि राम - नाम पाञाछि ‘शिव’ हैते ।
तोमार सङ्गे लोभ हैल कृष्ण - नाम लैते ॥256॥
cc-antya-3.256.translation: "Formerly I received the holy name of Lord Rāma from Lord Śiva, but now, due to your association, I am greatly eager to chant the holy name of Lord Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: मुक्ति - हेतुक तारक हय ‘राम - नाम’ ।
‘कृष्ण - नाम’ पारक ह ञा करे प्रेम - दान ॥257॥
cc-antya-3.257.translation: "The holy name of Lord Rāma certainly gives liberation, but the holy name of Kṛṣṇa transports one to the other side of the ocean of nescience and at last gives one ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa.

lines: kṛṣṇa-nāma deha' tumi more kara dhanyā
devanagari: कृष्ण - नाम देह’ तुमि मोरे कर धन्या ।
आमारे भासाय यैछे एइ प्रेम - वन्या ॥258॥
cc-antya-3.258.translation: "Please give me the holy name of Kṛṣṇa and thus make me fortunate, so that I also may float in the flood of love of Godhead inaugurated by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu."

devanagari: एत ब लि’ वन्दिला हरिदासेर चरण ।
हरिदास कहे , - “कर कृष्ण - सङ्कीर्तन” ॥259॥
cc-antya-3.259.translation: After speaking in this way, Māyā worshiped the lotus feet of Haridāsa Ṭhākura, who initiated her by saying, "Just perform chanting of the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra."

lines: madhye madhye āsibā kabhu āmāra daraśane
śīghra kari' punaḥ tāhāṅ karaha gamane
devanagari: मध्ये मध्ये आसिबा कभु आमार दरशने ।
शीघ्र क रि’ पुनः ताहाँ करह गमने ॥26॥
cc-antya-3.26.translation: "At intervals you may come see Me here and then soon again go there.

lines: upadeśa pāñā māyā calilā hañā prīta
e-saba kathāte kāro nā janme pratīta
devanagari: उपदेश पाञा माया चलि ला हञा प्रीत ।
ए - सब कथाते कारो ना जन्मे प्रतीत ॥260॥
cc-antya-3.260.translation: After thus being instructed by Haridāsa Ṭhākura, Māyā left with great pleasure. Unfortunately, some people have no faith in these narrations.

devanagari: प्रतीत करिते कहि कारण इहार ।
याहार श्रवणे हय विश्वास सबार ॥261॥
cc-antya-3.261.translation: Therefore I shall explain the reasons why people should have faith. Everyone who hears this will be faithful.

devanagari: चैतन्यावतारे कृष्ण - प्रेमे लुब्ध हञा ।
ब्रह्म - शिव - सनकादि पृथिवीते जन्मिया ॥262॥
cc-antya-3.262.translation: During the incarnation of Lord Caitanya to inaugurate the Kṛṣṇa consciousness movement, even such personalities as Lord Brahmā, Lord Śiva and the four Kumāras took birth upon this earth, being allured by ecstatic love of Lord Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: कृष्ण - नाम लञा नाचे, प्रेम - वन्याय भासे ।
नारद - प्रह्लादादि आसे मनुष्य - प्रकाशे ॥263॥
cc-antya-3.263.translation: All of them, including the great sage Nārada and devotees like Prahlāda, came here as if human beings, chanting the holy names of Lord Kṛṣṇa together and dancing and floating in the inundation of love of Godhead.

devanagari: लक्ष्मी - आदि क रि’ कृष्ण - प्रेमे लुब्ध हञा ।
नाम - प्रेम आस्वादिला मनुष्ये जन्मिया ॥264॥
cc-antya-3.264.translation: The goddess of fortune and others, allured by love of Kṛṣṇa, also came down in the form of human beings and tasted the holy name of the Lord in love.

devanagari: अन्येर का कथा, आपने व्रजेन्द्र - नन्दन ।
अवत रि’ करेन प्रेम - रस आस्वादन ॥265॥
cc-antya-3.265.translation: What to speak of others, even Kṛṣṇa, the son of Nanda Mahārāja, personally descends to taste the nectar of love of Godhead in the form of the chanting of Hare Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: माया - दासी ‘प्रेम’ मागे, - इथे कि विस्मय ? ।
‘साधु - कृपा’ - ‘नाम’ विना ‘प्रेम’ ना जन्मय ॥266॥
cc-antya-3.266.translation: What is the wonder if the maidservant of Kṛṣṇa, His external energy, begs for love of Godhead? Without the mercy of a devotee and without the chanting of the holy name of the Lord, love of Godhead cannot be possible.

devanagari: चैतन्य - गोसाञिर लीलार एइ त’ स्वभाव ।
त्रिभुवन नाचे, गाय, पाञा प्रेम - भाव ॥267॥
cc-antya-3.267.translation: In the activities of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the three worlds dance and chant, having come in touch with love of Godhead. This is the characteristic of His pastimes.

devanagari: कृष्ण - आदि, आर यत स्थावर - जङ्गमे ।
कृष्ण - प्रेमे मत्त करे कृष्ण - सङ्कीर्तने ॥268॥
cc-antya-3.268.translation: The holy name of Kṛṣṇa is so attractive that anyone who chants it-including all living entities, moving and nonmoving, and even Lord Kṛṣṇa Himself-becomes imbued with love of Kṛṣṇa. This is the effect of chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra.

devanagari: स्वरूप - गोसा ञि कड़चाय ये - लीला लिखिल ।
रघुनाथ - दास - मुखे ये सब शुनिल ॥269॥
cc-antya-3.269.translation: I have heard from the mouth of Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī all that Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī recorded in his notes about the pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: mora sukha-kathā kahi' sukha diha' tāṅre
devanagari: मातारे कहिह मोर कोटी नमस्कारे ।
मोर सुख - कथा क हि’ सुख दिह’ ताँरे ॥27॥
cc-antya-3.27.translation: "Offer My mother millions of My obeisances. Please speak to her about My happiness here and thus give her happiness.

lines: sei saba līlā kahi saṅkṣepa kariyā
devanagari: सेइ सब लीला कहि सङ्क्षेप करिया ।
चैतन्य - कृपाते लिखि क्षुद्र - जीव ह ञा ॥270॥
cc-antya-3.270.translation: I have briefly described those pastimes. Whatever I have written is by the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, since I am an insignificant living being.

devanagari: हरिदास ठाकुरेर कहिलुँ महिमार कण ।
याहार श्रवणे भक्तेर जुड़ाय श्रवण ॥271॥
cc-antya-3.271.translation: I have described but a fragment of the glories of Haridāsa Ṭhākura, Hearing this satisfies the aural reception of every devotee.

devanagari: श्री - रूप - रघुनाथ - पदे यार आश ।
चैतन्य - चरितामृत कहे कृष्णदास ॥272॥
cc-antya-3.272.translation: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.

lines: ei lāgi' prabhu more pāṭhāilā ihāṅte'
devanagari: ‘निरन्तर निज - कथा तोमारे शुनाइते।
एइ लागि’ प्रभु मोरे पाठाइला इहाँते’ ॥28॥
cc-antya-3.28.translation: "Tell her that I sent you to inform her of My personal activities so that she may share in My happiness.

lines: eta kahi' mātāra mane santoṣa janmāiha
devanagari: एत क हि’ मातार मने सन्तोष जन्माइह।
आर गुह्य - कथा ताँरे स्मरण कराइह ॥29॥
cc-antya-3.29.translation: "Speaking in this way, satisfy the mind of mother Śacī. Also, remind her of one most confidential incident with this message from Me.

devanagari: पुरुषोत्तमे एक उड़िया - ब्राह्मण - कुमार ।
पितृ - शून्य, महा - सुन्दर, मृदु - व्यवहार ॥3॥
cc-antya-3.3.translation: In Jagannātha Purī there was a young boy who had been born of an Orissan brāhmaṇa but had later lost his father. The boy's features were very beautiful, and his behavior was extremely gentle.

devanagari: ‘बारे बारे आ सि’ आमि तोमार भवने ।
मिष्टान्न व्यञ्जन सब करिये भोजने ॥30॥
cc-antya-3.30.translation: "I come to your home again and again to eat all the sweetmeats and vegetables you offer.

lines: bhojana kariye āmi, tumi tāhā jāna
bāhya virahe tāhā svapna kari māna
devanagari: भोजन करिये आमि, तुमि ताहा जान ।
बाह्य विरहे ताहा स्वप्न करि मान ॥31॥
cc-antya-3.31.translation: “ 'You know that I come and eat the offerings, but because of external separation, you consider this a dream.

lines: nānā vyañjana, kṣīra, piṭhā, pāyasa rāndhilā
devanagari: एइ माघ - सङ्क्रान्त्ये तुमि रन्धन करिला ।
नाना व्यञ्जन, क्षीर, पिठा, पायस रान्धिला ॥32॥
cc-antya-3.32.translation: "During the last Māgha-saṅkrānti festival, you cooked varieties of vegetables, condensed milk, cakes and sweet rice for Me.

lines: kṛṣṇe bhoga lāgāñā yabe kailā dhyāna
āmāra sphūrti haila, aśru bharila nayana
devanagari: कृष्णे भोग लागाञा यबे कैला ध्यान ।
आमार स्फूर्ति हैल, अश्रु भरिल नयन ॥33॥
cc-antya-3.33.translation: "You offered the food to Lord Kṛṣṇa, and while you were in meditation I suddenly appeared, and your eyes filled with tears.

devanagari: आस्ते - व्यस्ते आमि गिया सकलि खाइल ।
आमि खाइ, - देखि’ तोमार सुख उपजिल ॥34॥
cc-antya-3.34.translation: "I went there in great haste and ate everything. When you saw Me eating, you felt great happiness.

lines: kṣaṇeke aśru muchiyā śūnya dekhi' pāta
devanagari: क्षणेके अश्रु मुछिया शून्य देखि’ पात ।
स्वपन देखि लुँ, ‘येन निमाञि खाइल भा त’ ॥35॥
cc-antya-3.35.translation: "In a moment, after you had wiped your eyes, you saw that the plate you had offered Me was empty. Then you thought, "I dreamt as if Nimāi were eating everything."

devanagari: बाह्य - विरह - दशाय पुनः भ्रान्ति हैल ।
‘भोग ना लागाइ लुँ, - एइ ज्ञान हैल ॥36॥
cc-antya-3.36.translation: "In the condition of external separation, you were again under illusion, thinking that you had not offered the food to Lord Viṣṇu.

lines: pāka-pātre dekhilā saba anna āche bhari'
devanagari: पाक - पात्रे देखिला सब अन्न आछे भरि’ ।
पुनः भोग लागाइला स्थान - संस्कार करि’ ॥37॥
cc-antya-3.37.translation: "Then you went to see the cooking pots and found that every pot was filled with food. Therefore you again offered the food, after cleansing the place for the offering.

devanagari: एइ - मत बार बार करिये भोजन ।
तोमार शुद्ध - प्रेमे मोरे करे आकर्षण ॥38॥
cc-antya-3.38.translation: "Thus I again and again eat everything you offer Me, for I am attracted by your pure love.

lines: nikaṭe lañā yāo āmā tomāra prema-bale'
devanagari: तोमार आज्ञाते आमि आछि नीलाचले ।
निकटे ल ञा याओ आमा तोमार प्रेम - बले’ ॥39॥
cc-antya-3.39.translation: "Only by your order am I living in Nīlācala [Jagannātha Purī]. Nevertheless, you still pull Me near you because of your great love for Me.' "

devanagari: प्रभु - स्थाने नित्य आइसे, करे नमस्कार ।
प्रभु - सने बात् कहे प्रभु - ‘प्राण’ तार ॥4॥
cc-antya-3.4-5.translation: The boy came daily to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and offered Him respectful obeisances. He was free to talk with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu because the Lord was his life and soul, but the boy's intimacy with the Lord and the Lord's mercy toward him were intolerable to Dāmodara Paṇḍita.

lines: mora nāma lañā tāṅra vandiha caraṇa"
devanagari: एइ - मत बार बार कराइह स्मरण ।
मोर नाम ल ञा ताँर वन्दिह चरण” ॥40॥
cc-antya-3.40.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu told Dāmodara Paṇḍita, "Remind mother Śacī in this way again and again and worship her lotus feet in My name."

lines: mātāke vaiṣṇave dite pṛthak pṛthak dila
devanagari: एत क हि’ जगन्नाथेर प्रसाद आनाइल ।
माताके वैष्णवे दिते पृथक् पृथक् दिल ॥41॥
cc-antya-3.41.translation: After saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu ordered that varieties of prasāda offered to Lord Jagannātha be brought. The Lord then gave him the prasāda, separately packed, to offer to various Vaiṣṇavas and His mother.

devanagari: तबे दामोदर च लि’ नदीया आइला ।
मातारे मिलिया ताँर चरणे रहिला ॥42॥
cc-antya-3.42.translation: In this way Dāmodara Paṇḍita went to Nadia [Navadvīpa]. After meeting mother Śacī, he stayed under the care of her lotus feet.

lines: prabhura yaiche ājñā, paṇḍita tāhā ācarilā
devanagari: आचा र्यादि वैष्णवेरे महा - प्रसाद दिला ।
प्रभुर यैछे आज्ञा, पण्डित ताहा आचरिला ॥43॥
cc-antya-3.43.translation: He delivered all the prasāda to such great Vaiṣṇavas as Advaita Ācārya. Thus he stayed there and behaved according to the order of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: dāmodara āge svātantrya nā haya kāhāra
tāra bhaye sabe kare saṅkoca vyavahāra
devanagari: दामोदर आगे स्वातन्त्र्य ना हय काहार ।
तार भये सबे करे सङ्कोच व्यवहार ॥44॥
cc-antya-3.44.translation: Everyone knew that Dāmodara Paṇḍita was strict in practical dealings. Therefore everyone was afraid of him and dared not do anything independent.

devanagari: प्रभु - गणे याँर देखे अल्प - मर्यादा - लङ्घन ।
वाक्य - दण्ड क रि’ करे मर्यादा स्थापन ॥45॥
cc-antya-3.45.translation: Dāmodara Paṇḍita would verbally chastise every devotee of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu whom he found deviating even slightly from proper behavior. Thus he established the standard etiquette.

devanagari: एइ - त कहिल दामोद रेर वाक्य - दण्ड ।
याहार श्रवणे भागे ‘अज्ञान पाषण्ड’ ॥46॥
cc-antya-3.46.translation: In this way I have described Dāmodara Paṇḍita's verbal chastisements. As one hears about this, atheistic principles and ignorance depart.

lines: ki lāgi' ki kare, keha nā pāre bujhite
devanagari: चैतन्येर लीला - गम्भीर, कोटि - समुद्र हैते ।
कि ला गि’ कि करे, केह ना पारे बुझिते ॥47॥
cc-antya-3.47.translation: The pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu are deeper than millions of seas and oceans. Therefore no one can understand what He does nor why He does it.

lines: ataeva gūḍha artha kichui nā jāni
devanagari: अतएव गूढ़ अर्थ किछुइ ना जानि ।
बाह्य अर्थ करिबारे करि टानाटानि ॥48॥
cc-antya-3.48.translation: I do not know the deep meaning of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's activities. As far as possible I shall try to explain them externally.

lines: tāṅhā lañā goṣṭhī kari' tāṅhāre puchilā
devanagari: एक - दिन प्रभु हरिदासेरे मिलिला ।
ताँहा ल ञा गोष्ठी क रि’ ताँहारे पुछिला ॥49॥
cc-antya-3.49.translation: One day Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu met Haridāsa Ṭhākura as usual, and in the course of discussion He inquired as follows.

devanagari: “हरिदास, कलि - काले यवन अपार ।
गो - ब्राह्मणे हिंसा करे महा दुराचार ॥50॥
cc-antya-3.50.translation: "My dear Ṭhākura Haridāsa, in this age of Kali most people are bereft of Vedic culture, and therefore they are called yavanas. They are concerned only with killing cows and brahminical culture. In this way they all engage in sinful acts.

lines: tāhāra hetu nā dekhiye,—e duḥkha apāra"
devanagari: इहा - सबार को न् मते हइबे निस्तार ? ।
ताहार हेतु ना देखिये, - ए दु:ख अपार” ॥51॥
cc-antya-3.51.translation: "How will these yavanas be delivered? To My great unhappiness, I do not see any way."

lines: yavanera saṁsāra dekhi' duḥkha nā bhāviha
devanagari: हरिदास कहे , - ”प्रभु, चिन्ता ना करिह ।
यवनेर संसार देखि’ दु:ख ना भाविह ॥52॥
cc-antya-3.52.translation: Haridāsa Ṭhākura replied, "My dear Lord, do not be in anxiety. Do not be unhappy to see the condition of the yavanas in material existence.

lines: 'hā rāma, hā rāma' bali' kahe nāmābhāse
devanagari: यवन - सकलेर ‘मुक्ति’ हबे अनायासे ।
‘हा राम, हा राम’ बलि’ कहे नामाभासे ॥53॥
cc-antya-3.53.translation: "Because the yavanas are accustomed to saying, 'hā rāma, hā rāma' [O Lord Rāmacandra], they will very easily be delivered by this nāmābhāsa.

lines: mahā-preme bhakta kahe,—'hā rāma, hā rāma'
yavanera bhāgya dekha, laya sei nāma
devanagari: महा - प्रेमे भक्त कहे , - ‘हा राम, हा राम’ ।
यवनेर भाग्य देख, लय सेइ नाम ॥54॥
cc-antya-3.54.translation: "A devotee in advanced ecstatic love exclaims, 'O my Lord Rāmacandra! O my Lord Rāmacandra!' But the yavanas also chant, 'hā rāma, hā rāma!' Just see their good fortune!"

lines: yadyapi anya saṅkete anya haya nāmābhāsa
tathāpi nāmera teja nā haya vināśa
devanagari: यद्यपि अन्य सङ्केते अन्य हय नामाभास ।
तथापि नामेर तेज ना हय विनाश ॥55॥
cc-antya-3.55.translation: Nāmācārya Haridāsa Ṭhākura, the authority on the chanting of the holy name, said, "The chanting of the Lord's holy name to indicate something other than the Lord is an instance of nāmābhāsa. Even when the holy name is chanted in this way, its transcendental power is not destroyed.

devanagari: दंष्ट्रि - दंष्ट्राहतो म्लेच्छो हा रामेति पुनः पुनः ।
उक्त्वापि मुक्तिमाप्नोति किं पुनः श्रद्धया गृणन् ॥56॥
cc-antya-3.56.translation: "Even a mleccha who is being killed by the tusk of a boar and who cries in distress again and again, "hā rāma, hā rāma" attains liberation. What then to speak of those who chant the holy name with veneration and faith?"

devanagari: अजामिल पुत्रे बोलाय बलि ‘नारायण’ ।
विष्णु - दूत आसि’ छाड़ाय ताहार बन्धन ॥57॥
cc-antya-3.57.translation: "Ajāmila was a great sinner during his life, but at the time of death he accidentally called for his youngest son, whose name was Nārāyaṇa, and the attendants of Lord Viṣṇu came to relieve him from the bonds of Yamarāja, the superintendent of death.

devanagari: ‘राम’ दुइ अक्षर इहा नहे व्यवहित ।
प्रेम - वाची ‘हा’ - शब्द ताहाते भूषित ॥58॥
cc-antya-3.58.translation: "The word 'rāma' consists of the two syllables, 'rā' and 'ma.' These are unseparated and are decorated with the loving word 'hā,' meaning 'O.'

devanagari: नामेर अक्षर - सबेर एइ त’ स्वभाव ।
व्यवहित हैले ना छाड़े आपन - प्रभाव ॥59॥
cc-antya-3.59.translation: "The letters of the holy name have so much spiritual potency that they act even when uttered improperly.

lines: prabhure nā dekhile sei rahite nā pāre
devanagari: बार बार निषेध करे ब्राह्मण - कुमारे ।
प्रभुरे ना देखिले सेइ रहिते ना पारे ॥6॥
cc-antya-3.6.translation: Dāmodara Paṇḍita again and again forbade the son of the brāhmaṇa to visit the Lord, but the boy could not bear staying home and not seeing Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: nāmaikaṁ yasya vāci smaraṇa-patha-gataṁ śrotra-mūlaṁ gataṁ vā
śuddhaṁ vāśuddha-varṇaṁ vyavahita-rahitaṁ tārayaty eva satyam
nikṣiptaṁ syān na phala-janakaṁ śīghram evātra vipra
devanagari: नामैकं यस्य वाचि स्मरण - पथ - गतं श्रोत्र - मूलं गतं वा शुद्धं वाशुद्ध - वर्णं व्यवहित - रहितं तारयत्येव सत्यम् ।
तच्चेद्देह - द्रविण - जनता - लोभ - पाषण्ड - मध्ये निक्षिप्तं स्यान्न फल - जनकं शीघ्रमेवात्र विप्र ॥60॥
cc-antya-3.60.translation: "If a devotee once utters the holy name of the Lord, or if it penetrates his mind or enters his ear, which is the channel of aural reception, that holy name will certainly deliver him from material bondage, whether vibrated properly or improperly, with correct or incorrect grammar, and properly joined or vibrated in separate parts. O brāhmaṇa, the potency of the holy name is therefore certainly great. However, if one uses the vibration of the holy name for the benefit of the material body, for material wealth and followers, or under the influence of greed or atheism-in other words, if one utters the name with offenses-such chanting will not produce the desired result very soon. Therefore one should diligently avoid offenses in chanting the holy name of the Lord.' "

devanagari: नामाभास हैते हय सर्व - पाप - क्षय ॥61॥
cc-antya-3.61.translation: Nāmācārya Haridāsa Ṭhākura continued, "If one offenselessly utters the holy name even imperfectly, one can be freed from all the results of sinful life.

lines: taṁ nirvyājaṁ bhaja guṇa-nidhe pāvanaṁ pāvanānāṁ
devanagari: तं निर्व्याजं भज गुण - निधे पावनं पावनानां श्रद्धा - रज्यन्मतिरतितरामुत्तमः - श्लोक - मौलिम् ।
प्रोद्यन्नन्तःकरण - कुहरे हन्त यन्नाम - भानोर् आभासोऽपि क्षपयति महा - पातक - ध्वान्त - राशिम् ॥62॥
cc-antya-3.62.translation: "O reservoir of all good qualities, just worship Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the purifier of all purifiers, the most exalted of the personalities worshiped by choice poetry. Worship Him with a faithful, unflinching mind, without duplicity and in a highly elevated manner. Thus worship the Lord, whose name is like the sun, for just as a slight appearance of the sun dissipates the darkness of night, so a slight appearance of the holy name of Kṛṣṇa can drive away all the darkness of ignorance that arises in the heart due to greatly sinful activities performed in previous lives."

devanagari: नामाभास हैते हय संसारेर क्षय ॥63॥
cc-antya-3.63.translation: "Even a faint light from the holy name of the Lord can eradicate all the reactions of sinful life."

devanagari: म्रियमाणो हरेर्नाम गृणन्पुत्रोपचारितम् ।
अजामिलोऽप्यगाद्धाम किमुत श्रद्धया गृणन् ॥64॥
cc-antya-3.64.translation: "While dying, Ajāmila chanted the holy name of the Lord, intending to call his son Nārāyaṇa. Nevertheless, he attained the spiritual world. What then to speak of those who chant the holy name with faith and reverence?'

devanagari: नामाभासे ‘मुक्ति’ हय सर्व - शास्त्रे देखि ।
श्री - भागवते ताते अजामिल - साक्षी” ॥65॥
cc-antya-3.65.translation: "Because of even the faintest rays of the effulgence of the Lord's holy name, one can attain liberation. We can see this in all the revealed scriptures. The evidence appears in the story of Ajāmila in Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam."

devanagari: शुनिया प्रभुर सुख बाड़ये अन्तरे ।
पुनरपि भङ्गी करि’ पुछये ताँहारे ॥66॥
cc-antya-3.66.translation: As Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu heard this from Haridāsa Ṭhākura, the happiness within His heart increased, but as a matter of course, He still inquired further.

devanagari: “पृथिवीते बहु - जीव - स्थावर - जङ्गम ।
इहा - सबार कि प्रकारे हइबे मोचन ?” ॥67॥
cc-antya-3.67.translation: "On this earth there are many living entities," the Lord said, "some moving and some not moving. What will happen to the trees, plants, insects and other living entities? How will they be delivered from material bondage?"

devanagari: हरिदास कहे , - “प्रभु, से कृपा तोमार।
स्थावर - जङ्गम आगे करियाछ निस्तार ॥68॥
cc-antya-3.68.translation: Haridāsa Ṭhākura replied, "My dear Lord, the deliverance of all moving and nonmoving living entities takes place only by Your mercy. You have already granted this mercy and delivered them.

lines: tumi ye kariyācha ei ucca saṅkīrtana
devanagari: तुमि ये करियाछ एइ उच्च सङ्कीर्तन ।
स्थावर - जङ्गमेर सेइ हयत’ श्रवण ॥69॥
cc-antya-3.69.translation: "You have loudly chanted the Hare Kṛṣṇa mantra, and everyone, moving or not moving, has benefited by hearing it.

lines: nitya āise, prabhu tāre kare mahā-prīta
devanagari: नित्य आइसे, प्रभु तारे करे महा - प्रीत ।
याँहा प्रीति ताँहा आइसे , - बालकेर रीत ॥7॥
cc-antya-3.7.translation: The boy came every day to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who treated him with great affection. It is the nature of any boy to go see a man who loves him.

lines: sthāvare se śabda lāge, pratidhvani haya
devanagari: शुनिया जङ्गमेर हय संसार - क्षय ।
स्थावरे से शब्द लागे, प्रतिध्वनि हय ॥70॥
cc-antya-3.70.translation: "My Lord, the moving entities who have heard Your loud saṅkīrtana have already been delivered from bondage to the material world, and after the nonmoving living entities like trees hear it, there is an echo.

devanagari: ‘प्रतिध्व नि’ नहे, सेइ करये ‘कीर्तन’ ।
तोमार कृपार एइ अकथ्य कथन ॥71॥
cc-antya-3.71.translation: "Actually, however, it is not an echo; it is the kīrtana of the nonmoving living entities. All this, although inconceivable, is possible by Your mercy.

devanagari: सकल जगते हय उच्च सङ्कीर्तन ।
शुनिया प्रेमावेशे नाचे स्थावर - जङ्गम ॥72॥
cc-antya-3.72.translation: "When loud chanting of the Hare Kṛṣṇa mantra is performed all over the world by those who follow in Your footsteps, all living entities, moving and nonmoving, dance in ecstatic devotional love.

devanagari: यैछे कैला झारिखण्डे वृन्दावन याइते ।
बलभद्र - भट्टाचार्य कहियाछेन आमाते ॥73॥
cc-antya-3.73.translation: "My dear Lord, all the incidents that took place while You were going to Vṛndāvana through the forest known as Jhārikhaṇḍa have been related to me by Your servant Balabhadra Bhaṭṭācārya.

devanagari: वासुदेव जीव लागि’ कैल निवेदन ।
तबे अङ्गीकार कैला जीवेर मोचन ॥74॥
cc-antya-3.74.translation: "When Your devotee Vāsudeva Datta submitted his plea at Your lotus feet for the deliverance of all living entities, You accepted that request.

devanagari: जगत् निस्तारिते एइ तोमार अवतार ।
भक्त - भाव आगे ताते कैला अङ्गीकार ॥75॥
cc-antya-3.75.translation: "My dear Lord, You have accepted the form of a devotee just to deliver all the fallen souls of this world.

devanagari: उच्च सङ्कीर्तन ताते करिला प्रचार ।
स्थिर - चर जीवेर सब खण्डाइला संसार” ॥76॥
cc-antya-3.76.translation: "You have preached the loud chanting of the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra and in this way freed all moving and nonmoving living entities from material bondage."

lines: prabhu kahe,—"saba jīva mukti yabe pābe
ei ta' brahmāṇḍa tabe jīva-śūnya habe!"
devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - “सब जीव मुक्ति यबे पाबे ।
एइ त’ ब्रह्माण्ड तबे जीव - शून्य हवे!” ॥77॥
cc-antya-3.77.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "If all living entities were liberated, the entire universe would be devoid of living beings."

devanagari: हरिदास बले, तोमार यावत्म र्त्ये स्थिति ।
तावत् स्थावर - जङ्गम, सर्व जीव - जाति ॥78॥
cc-antya-3.78-79.translation: Haridāsa said, "My Lord, as long as You are situated within the material world, You will send to the spiritual sky all the developed moving and nonmoving living entities in different species. Then again You will awaken the living entities who are not yet developed and engage them in activities.

lines: tāhā dekhi' dāmodara duḥkha pāya mane
balite nā pāre, bālaka niṣedha nā māne
devanagari: ताहा देखि’ दामोदर दु:ख पाय मने ।
बलिते ना पारे, बालक निषेध ना माने ॥8॥
cc-antya-3.8.translation: This was intolerable for Dāmodara Paṇḍita. He became greatly unhappy, but there was nothing he could say, for the boy would ignore his restrictions.

devanagari: सेइ जीव हबे इहाँ स्थावर - जङ्गम ।
ताहाते भरिबे ब्रह्माण्ड येन पूर्व - सम ॥80॥
cc-antya-3.80.translation: "In this way all moving and nonmoving living entities will come into existence, and the entire universe will be filled as it was previously.

lines: pūrve yena raghunātha saba āyodhyā lañā
devanagari: पूर्वे येन रघुनाथ सब अयोध्या लाञा ।
वैकुण्ठके गेला, अन्य - जीवे अयोध्या भरा ञा ॥81॥
cc-antya-3.81.translation: "Previously, when Lord Rāmacandra left this world, He took with Him all the living entities of Āyodhyā. Then He filled Āyodhyā again with other living entities.

lines: keha nā bujhite pāre tomāra gūḍha nāṭa
devanagari: अवत रि’ तुमि ऐछे पातियाछ हाट ।
केह ना बुझिते पारे तोमार गूढ़ नाट ॥82॥
cc-antya-3.82.translation: "My dear Lord, You have set a plan in motion by descending on the material world, but no one can understand how You are acting.

lines: pūrve yena vraje kṛṣṇa kari' avatāra
devanagari: पूर्वे येन व्रजे कृष्ण करि’ अवतार ।
सकल ब्रह्माण्ड - जीवेर खण्डाइला संसार ॥83॥
cc-antya-3.83.translation: "Formerly, when Lord Kṛṣṇa descended in Vṛndāvana, He freed all living entities in the universe from material existence in the same way.

devanagari: न चैवं विस्मयः कार्यों भवता भगवत्यजे ।
योगेश्वरेश्वरे कृष्णे यत एतद्विमुच्यते ॥84॥
cc-antya-3.84.translation: "Kṛṣṇa, the unborn Supreme Personality of Godhead, master of all of the masters of mystic power, delivers all living entities, moving and nonmoving. Nothing is astonishing in the activities of the Lord.'

lines: "ayaṁ hi bhagavān dṛṣṭaḥ kīrtitaḥ saṁsmṛtaś ca
phalaṁ prayacchati, kim uta samyag bhaktimatām" iti
devanagari: “अयं हि भगवान्दृष्टः कीर्तितः संस्मृतश्च
द्वेषानुबन्धेनाप्यखिल - सुरासुरादि - दुर्लभं
फलं प्रयच्छति, किमुत सम्यग्भक्तिमताम्” इति ॥85॥
cc-antya-3.85.translation: "Although the Supreme Personality of Godhead may be seen, glorified or remembered with an attitude of envy, He nevertheless awards the most confidential liberation, which is rarely achieved by the demigods and demons. What, then, can be said of those who are already fully engaged in devotional service to the Lord?'

devanagari: तैछे तुमि नवद्वीपे क रि’ अवतार ।
सकल - ब्रह्माण्ड - जीवेर करिला निस्तार ॥86॥
cc-antya-3.86.translation: "By descending as an incarnation at Navadvīpa, You, just like Kṛṣṇa, have already delivered all the living entities of the universe.

lines: se jānuka, mora punaḥ ei ta' niścaya
devanagari: ये कहे , - ‘चैतन्य - महिमा मोर गोचर हय’ ।
से जानुक, मोर पुनः एइ त’ निश्चय ॥87॥
cc-antya-3.87.translation: "One may say that he understands the glories of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. He may know whatever he may know, but as far as I am concerned, this is my conclusion.

lines: mora mano-gocara nahe tāra eka bindu"
devanagari: तोमार ये लीला महा - अमृतेर सिन्धु ।
मोर मनो - गोचर नहे तार एक बि न्दु ॥88॥
cc-antya-3.88.translation: "My dear Lord, Your pastimes are just like an ocean of nectar. It is not possible for me to conceive how great that ocean is or even to understand a drop of it."

lines: eta śuni' prabhura mane camatkāra haila
devanagari: एत शुनि’ प्रभुर मने चमत्कार हैल ।
‘मोर गूढ़ - लीला हरिदास केमने जानिल ?’ ॥89॥
cc-antya-3.89.translation: Hearing all this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was astonished. "These are actually My confidential pastimes," He thought. "How could Haridāsa have understood them?"

lines: āra dina sei bālaka prabhu-sthāne āilā
gosāñi tāre prīti kari' vārtā puchilā
devanagari: आर दिन सेइ बालक प्रभु - स्थाने आइला ।
गोसाञि तारे प्रीति क रि’ वार्ता पुछिला ॥9॥
cc-antya-3.9.translation: One day when the boy came to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the Lord very affectionately inquired from him about all kinds of news.

devanagari: मनेर सन्तोषे ताँरे कैला आलिङ्गन ।
बाह्ये प्रकाशिते ए - सब करिला वर्जन ॥90॥
cc-antya-3.90.translation: Greatly satisfied by the statements of Haridāsa Ṭhākura, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu embraced him. Outwardly, however, He avoided further discussions of these matters.

lines: bhakta-ṭhāñi lukāite nāre, haya ta' vidite
devanagari: ईश्वर - स्वभाव, ऐश्वर्य चाहे आच्छादिते ।
भक्त - ठाञि लुकाइते नारे, हय त’ विदिते ॥91॥
cc-antya-3.91.translation: This is a characteristic of the Supreme Personality of Godhead. Although He wants to cover His opulence, He cannot do so before His devotees. This is well-known everywhere.

devanagari: उल्लङ्गित - त्रिविध - सीम - समातिशायि - सम्भावनं तव परिव्रढ़िम - स्वभावम् ।
माया - बलेन भवतापि निगुह्यमानं पश्यन्ति केचिदनिशं त्वदनन्य - भावाः ॥92॥
cc-antya-3.92.translation: "O my Lord, everything within material nature is limited by time, space and thought. Your characteristics, however, being unequaled and unsurpassed, are always transcendental to such limitations. You sometimes cover such characteristics by Your own energy, but nevertheless Your unalloyed devotees are always able to see You under all circumstances."

devanagari: तबे महाप्रभु निज - भक्त - पाशे याञा ।
हरिदासेर गुण कहे शत - मुख हञा ॥93॥
cc-antya-3.93.translation: Then Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to His personal devotees and began speaking about Haridāsa Ṭhākura's transcendental qualities as if He had hundreds of mouths.

lines: bhaktera guṇa kahite prabhura bāḍaye ullāsa
devanagari: भक्तेर गुण कहिते प्रभुर बाड़ये उल्लास ।
भक्त - गण - श्रेष्ठ ताते श्री - हरिदास ॥94॥
cc-antya-3.94.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu derives great pleasure from glorifying His devotees, and among the devotees, Haridāsa Ṭhākura is the foremost.

lines: keha kona aṁśe varṇe, nāhi pāya pāra
devanagari: हरिदासेर गुण - गण - असङ्ख्य, अपार ।
केह कोन अंशे वर्णे, नाहि पाय पार ॥95॥
cc-antya-3.95.translation: The transcendental qualities of Haridāsa Ṭhākura are innumerable and unfathomable. One may describe a portion of them, but to count them all is impossible.

devanagari: चैतन्य - मङ्गले श्री - वृन्दावन - दास ।
हरिदासेर गुण किछु करियाछेन प्रकाश ॥96॥
cc-antya-3.96.translation: In Caitanya-maṅgala, Śrīla Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura has described the attributes of Haridāsa Ṭhākura to some extent.

lines: saba kahā nā yāya haridāsera caritra
keha kichu kahe karite āpanā pavitra
devanagari: सब कहा ना याय हरिदासेर चरित्र ।
केह किछु कहे करिते आपना पवित्र ॥97॥
cc-antya-3.97.translation: No one can describe all the qualities of Haridāsa Ṭhākura. One may say something about them just to purify himself.

devanagari: वृन्दावन - दास याहा ना कैल वर्णन ।
हरिदासेर गुण किछु शुन, भक्त - गण ॥98॥
cc-antya-3.98.translation: O devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, please hear something about the qualities of Haridāsa Ṭhākura that Śrīla Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura has not described in detail.

devanagari: हरिदास यबे निज - गृह त्याग कैला ।
बेनापोलेर वन - मध्ये कत - दिन रहिला ॥99॥
cc-antya-3.99.translation: After leaving his home, Haridāsa Ṭhākura stayed for some time in the forest of Benāpola.

devanagari: वृन्दावनात्पुनः प्राप्तं श्री - गौरः श्री - सनातनम् ।
देह - पातादवन्स्नेहाशुद्धं चक्रे परीक्षया ॥1॥
cc-antya-4.1.translation: When Sanātana Gosvāmī returned from Vṛndāvana, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu affectionately saved him from his determination to commit suicide. Then, after testing him, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu purified his body.

lines: tāte yadi ei deha bhāla-sthāne diye
devanagari: ताते यदि एइ देह भाल - स्थाने दिये ।
दुःख - शान्ति हय आर सद्गति पाइये ॥10॥
cc-antya-4.10.translation: "Therefore if I sacrifice this body in a good place, my unhappiness will be mitigated, and I shall attain an exalted destination.

lines: sei nija-kārya prabhu karena tomāra dvāre
devanagari: अवतार - कार्य प्रभुर - नाम - प्रचारे ।
सेइ निज - कार्य प्र भु करेन तोमार द्वारे ॥100॥
cc-antya-4.100.translation: "The mission of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, for which He has descended as an incarnation, is to spread the importance of chanting the holy name of the Lord. Now instead of personally doing so, He is spreading it through you.

lines: sabāra āge kara nāmera mahimā kathana
devanagari: प्रत्यह कर तिन - लक्ष नाम - सङ्कीर्तन ।
सबार आगे कर नामेर महिमा कथन ॥101॥
cc-antya-4.101.translation: "My dear sir, you are chanting the holy name 300,000 times daily and informing everyone of the importance of such chanting.

lines: āpane ācare keha, nā kare pracāra
pracāra karena keha, nā karena ācāra
devanagari: आपने आचरे केह, ना क रे प्रचार ।
प्रचार करेन केह, ना करेन आचार ॥102॥
cc-antya-4.102.translation: "Some behave very well but do not preach the cult of Kṛṣṇa consciousness, whereas others preach but do not behave properly.

devanagari: ‘आचार’, ‘प्रचार’, - नामेर करह ‘दुइ’ कार्य ।
तुमि - सर्व - गुरु, तुमि जगतेर आर्य ॥103॥
cc-antya-4.103.translation: "You simultaneously perform both duties in relation to the holy name by your personal behavior and by your preaching. Therefore you are the spiritual master of the entire world, for you are the most advanced devotee in the world."

devanagari: एइ - मत दुइ - जन नाना - कथा - रङ्गे ।
कृष्ण - कथा आस्वादय र हि’ एक - सङ्गे ॥104॥
cc-antya-4.104.translation: In this way the two of them passed their time discussing subjects concerning Kṛṣṇa. Thus they enjoyed life together.

devanagari: यात्रा - काले आइला सब गौड़ेर भक्त - गण ।
पूर्ववत् कैला सबे रथ - यात्रा दरशन ॥105॥
cc-antya-4.105.translation: During the time of Ratha-yātrā, all the devotees arrived from Bengal to visit the cart festival as they had done previously.

devanagari: रथ - अग्रे प्रभु तैछे करिला नर्तन ।
देखि चमत्कार हैल सनातनेर मन ॥106॥
cc-antya-4.106.translation: During the Ratha-yātrā festival, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu again danced before the cart of Jagannātha. When Sanātana Gosvāmī saw this, his mind was astonished.

lines: varṣāra cāri-māsa rahilā saba nija bhakta-gaṇe
devanagari: वर्षार चारि - मास रहिला सब निज भक्त - गणे ।
सबा - सङ्गे प्रभु मिलाइला सनातने ॥107॥
cc-antya-4.107.translation: The Lord's devotees from Bengal stayed at Jagannātha Purī during the four months of the rainy season, and Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu introduced Sanātana Gosvāmī to them all.

devanagari: अद्वैत, नित्यानन्द, श्रीवास, वक्रेश्वर ।
वासुदेव, मुरारि, राघव, दामोदर ॥108॥
cc-antya-4.108-110.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu introduced Sanātana Gosvāmī to these and other selected devotees: Advaita, Nityānanda, Śrīvāsa, Vakreśvara, Vāsudeva, Murāri, Rāghava, Dāmodara, Paramānanda Purī, Brahmānanda Bhāratī, Svarūpa Dāmodara, Gadādhara Paṇḍita, Sārvabhauma, Rāmānanda, Jagadānanda, Śaṅkara, Kāśīśvara and Govinda.

devanagari: जगन्नाथ रथ - यात्राय हइबेन बाहि र ।
ताँर रथ - चाकाय छाड़िमु एइ शरीर ॥11॥
cc-antya-4.11.translation: "During the Ratha-yātrā festival, when Lord Jagannātha comes out of the temple, I shall give up this body under the wheel of His cart.

devanagari: यथा - योग्य कराइल सबार चरण वन्दन ।
ताँरे कराइला सबार कृपार भाजन ॥111॥
cc-antya-4.111.translation: The Lord asked Sanātana Gosvāmī to offer obeisances to all the devotees in a way that befitted each one. Thus He introduced Sanātana Gosvāmī to them all, just to make him an object of their mercy.

devanagari: सद्गुणे, पाण्डित्ये, सबार प्रिय - सनातन ।
ग्रथा - योग्य कृपा - मैत्री - गौरव - भाजन ॥112॥
cc-antya-4.112.translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī was dear to everyone because of his exalted qualities in learning. Suitably, therefore, they bestowed upon him mercy, friendship and honor.

devanagari: सकल वैष्णव ग्नबे गौड़ - देशे गेला ।
सनातन महाप्रभुर चरणे रहिला ॥113॥
cc-antya-4.113.translation: When all the other devotees returned to Bengal after the Ratha-yātrā festival, Sanātana Gosvāmī stayed under the care of the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: दोल - यात्रा - आदि प्रभुर सङ्गेते देखिल ।
दिने - दिने प्रभु - सङ्गे आनन्द बाड़िल ॥114॥
cc-antya-4.114.translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī observed the Dola-yātrā ceremony with Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. In this way, his pleasure increased in the company of the Lord.

devanagari: पूर्वे वैशाख - मासे सनातन यबे आइला ।
ज्यैष्ठ - मासे प्रभु ताँरे परीक्षा करिला ॥115॥
cc-antya-4.115.translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī had come to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu at Jagannātha Purī during the month of April-May, and during the month of May-June Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu tested him.

devanagari: ज्यैष्ठ - मासे प्रभु ग्रमेश्वर - टोटा आइला ।
भक्त - अनुरोधे ताहाँ भिक्षा ये करिला ॥116॥
cc-antya-4.116.translation: In that month of May-June, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu came to the garden of Yameśvara [Lord Śiva] and accepted prasāda there at the request of the devotees.

devanagari: मध्या ह्न - भिक्षा - काले सनातने बोलाइल ।
प्रभु बोलाइला, ताँर आनन्द बाड़िल ॥117॥
cc-antya-4.117.translation: At noon, when it was time for lunch, the Lord called for Sanātana Gosvāmī, whose happiness increased because of the call.

devanagari: मध्याह्ने समुद्र - बालु हाछे अग्नि - सम ।
सेइ - पथे सनातन करिला गमन ॥118॥
cc-antya-4.118.translation: At noon the sand on the beach was as hot as fire, but Sanātana Gosvāmī came by that path.

lines: tapta-vālukāte pā poḍe, tāhā nāhi jāne
devanagari: ‘प्रभु बोलाञाछे’, - एइ आनन्दित मने ।
तप्त - बालुकाते पा पोड़े, ताहा नाहि जाने ॥119॥
cc-antya-4.119.translation: Overwhelmed by joy at being called by the Lord, Sanātana Gosvāmī did not feel that his feet were burning in the hot sand.

devanagari: महाप्रभुर आगे, आर देखि’ जगन्नाथ ।
रथे देह छाड़िमु, - एइ परम - पुरुषार्थ” ॥12॥
cc-antya-4.12.translation: "After seeing Lord Jagannātha, I shall give up my body under the wheel of the cart in the presence of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. This will be the highest benediction of my life."

lines: dui pāye phoskā haila, tabu gelā prabhu-sthāne
devanagari: दुइ पाये फोस्का हैल, तबु गेला प्रभु - स्थाने ।
भिक्षा क रि’ महाप्रभु करियाछेन विश्रामे ॥120॥
cc-antya-4.120.translation: Although the soles of both his feet were blistered because of the heat, he nevertheless went to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. There he found that the Lord, having taken His lunch, was resting.

devanagari: भिक्षा - अवशेष - पात्र गोविन्द तारे दिला ।
प्रसाद पाञा सनातन प्रभु - पाशे आइला ॥121॥
cc-antya-4.121.translation: Govinda gave Sanātana Gosvāmī the plate with the remnants of Lord Caitanya's food. After taking the prasāda, Sanātana Gosvāmī approached Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - “कोन्पथे आइला, सनातन ?” ।
तेंह कहे, - “समुद्र - पथे, करिलॅ आगम न” ॥122॥
cc-antya-4.122.translation: When the Lord inquired, "By which path have you come?" Sanātana Gosvāmī replied, "I have come on the path along the beach."

devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - “तप्त - बालुकाते केमने आइला?” ।
सिंह - द्वारेर पथ - शीतल, केने ना आइला ? ॥123॥
cc-antya-4.123.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "How did you come through the beach where the sand is so hot? Why didn't you come by the path in front of the Siṁha-dvāra gate? It is very cool.

lines: calite nā pāra, kemane karilā sahana?"
devanagari: “तप्त - बालुकाय तोमार पाय हैल व्रण ।
चलिते ना पार, केमने करिला सहन ?” ॥124॥
cc-antya-4.124.translation: "The hot sand must have blistered your soles. Now you cannot walk. How did you tolerate it?"

lines: pāye vraṇa hañāche tāhā nā jāniluṅ
devanagari: सनातन कहे, “दुख बहुत ना पाइलुँ ।
पाये व्रण हा ञाछे ताहा ना जानि लुँ” ॥125॥
cc-antya-4.125.translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī replied, "I did not feel much pain, nor did I know that there are blisters because of the heat.

devanagari: सिंह - द्वारे याइते मोर नाहि अधिकार ।
विशेषे - ठाकुरेर ताहाँ सेवकेर प्रचार ॥126॥
cc-antya-4.126.translation: "I have no right to pass by the Siṁha-dvāra, for the servants of Jagannātha are always coming and going there.

lines: tāra sparśa haile, sarva-nāśa habe mora"
devanagari: “सेवक गतागति करे, नाहि अवसर ।
तार स्पर्श हैले, सर्व - नाश हबे मोर” ॥127॥
cc-antya-4.127.translation: "The servants are always coming and going without interval. If I touch them, I shall be ruined."

lines: tuṣṭa hañā tāṅre kichu kahite lāgilā
devanagari: शुनि’ महाप्रभु मने सन्तोष पाइला ।
तुष्ट हुआ ताँरे किछु कहिते लागिला ॥128॥
cc-antya-4.128.translation: Having heard all these details, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, greatly pleased, spoke as follows.

devanagari: “यद्यपिओ तुमि हओ जगत्पावन ।
तोमा - स्पर्शे पवित्र हय देव - मुनि - गण ॥129॥
cc-antya-4.129-130.translation: "My dear Sanātana, although you are the deliverer of the entire universe and although even the demigods and great saints are purified by touching you, it is the characteristic of a devotee to observe and protect the Vaiṣṇava etiquette. Maintenance of the Vaiṣṇava etiquette is the ornament of a devotee.

lines: ei ta' niścaya kari' nīlācale āilā
devanagari: एइ त निश्चय क रि’ नीलाचले आइला ।
लोके पुछि’ हरिदास - स्थाने उत्तरिला ॥13॥
cc-antya-4.13.translation: Having made this resolution, Sanātana Gosvāmī went to Nīlācala, where he inquired directions from people and approached the residence of Haridāsa Ṭhākura.

devanagari: मर्यादा - लङ्घने लोक करे उपहास ।
इह - लोक, पर - लोक दुइ हय नाश ॥131॥
cc-antya-4.131.translation: "If one transgresses the laws of etiquette, people make fun of him, and thus he is vanquished in both this world and the next.

lines: maryādā rākhile, tuṣṭa kaile mora mana
tumi aiche nā karile kare kon jana?"
devanagari: “मर्यादा राखिले, तुष्ट कैले मोर मन ।
तुमि ऐछे ना करिले करे को जन?” ॥132॥
cc-antya-4.132.translation: "By observing the etiquette, you have satisfied My mind. Who else but you will show this example?"

lines: eta bali' prabhu tāṅre āliṅgana kaila
devanagari: एत ब लि’ प्रभु ताँरे आलिङ्गन कैल ।
ताँर कण्डु - रसा प्रभुर श्री - अङ्गे लागिल ॥133॥
cc-antya-4.133.translation: After saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu embraced Sanātana Gosvāmī, and the moisture oozing from the itching sores on Sanātana's body smeared the body of the Lord.

lines: bāra bāra niṣedhena, tabu kare āliṅgana
aṅge rasā lāge, duḥkha pāya sanātana
devanagari: बार बार निषेधेन, तबु करे आलिङ्गन ।
अङ्गे रसा लागे, दुःख पाय सनातन ॥134॥
cc-antya-4.134.translation: Although Sanātana Gosvāmī forbade Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to embrace him, the Lord did so. Thus His body was smeared with the moisture from Sanātana's body, and Sanātana became greatly distressed.

devanagari: एइ - मते सेवक - प्रभु दुँहे घर गेला ।
आर दिन जगदानन्द सनातनेरे मिलिला ॥135॥
cc-antya-4.135.translation: Thus both servant and master departed for their respective homes. The next day, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita went to meet Sanātana Gosvāmī.

devanagari: दुइ - जन व सि’ कृष्ण - कथा - गोष्ठी कैला।
पण्डितेरे सनातन दुःख निवेदिला ॥136॥
cc-antya-4.136.translation: When Jagadānanda Paṇḍita and Sanātana Gosvāmī sat together and began to discuss topics about Kṛṣṇa, Sanātana Gosvāmī submitted to Jagadānanda Paṇḍita the cause of his distress.

lines: yebā mane, tāhā prabhu nā dilā karite
devanagari: “इहाँ आइलाँ प्रभुरे देखि’ दुःख खण्डाइते ।
येबा मने, ताहा प्रभु ना दिला करिते” ॥137॥
cc-antya-4.137.translation: "I came here to diminish my unhappiness by seeing Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, but the Lord did not allow me to execute what was in my mind.

devanagari: निषेधिते प्रभु आलिङ्गन करेन मोरे ।
मोर कण्डु - रसा लागे प्रभुर शरीरे ॥138॥
cc-antya-4.138.translation: "Although I forbid Him to do so, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu nevertheless embraces me, and therefore His body becomes smeared with the discharges from my itching sores.

devanagari: अपराध हय मोर, नाहिक निस्तार ।
जगन्नाथेह ना देखिये , - ए दुःख अपार ॥139॥
cc-antya-4.139.translation: "In this way I am committing offenses at His lotus feet, for which I shall certainly not be delivered. At the same time, I cannot see Lord Jagannātha. This is my great unhappiness.

devanagari: हरिदासेर कैला तेंह चरण वन्दन ।
जानि’ हरिदास ताँरे कैला आलिङ्गन ॥14॥
cc-antya-4.14.translation: He offered his respects to the lotus feet of Haridāsa Ṭhākura, who knew him and thus embraced him.

lines: ki karile hita haya nāri nirdhārite"
devanagari: हित - निमित्त आइलाङ आमि, हैल विपरीते ।
कि करिले हित हय नारि निर्धारिते” ॥140॥
cc-antya-4.140.translation: "I came here for my benefit, but now I see that I am getting just the opposite. I do not know, nor can I ascertain, how there will be benefit for me."

devanagari: पण्डित कहे , - “तोमार वास - योग्य वृन्दावन” ।
रथ - यात्रा देखि ताहाँ करह गमन ॥141॥
cc-antya-4.141.translation: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita said, "The most suitable place for you to reside is Vṛndāvana. After seeing the Ratha-yātrā festival, you can return there.

lines: prabhura ājñā hañāche tomā' dui bhāye
devanagari: प्रभुर आज्ञा हाछे तोमा’ दुइ भाये ।
वृन्दावने वैस, ताहाँ सर्व - सुख पाइये ॥142॥
cc-antya-4.142.translation: "The Lord has already ordered both of you brothers to situate yourselves in Vṛndāvana. There you will achieve all happiness.

devanagari: ये - कार्ये आइला, प्रभुर देखिला चरण ।
रथे जगन्नाथ देखि’ करह गम न ॥143॥
cc-antya-4.143.translation: 'Your purpose in coming has been fulfilled, for you have seen the lotus feet of the Lord. Therefore, after seeing Lord Jagannātha on the Ratha-yātrā car, you can leave."

devanagari: सनातन कहे, - “भाल कैला उपदेश” ।
ताहाँ याब, सेइ मोर “प्रभु - दत्त देश” ॥144॥
cc-antya-4.144.translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī replied, "You have given me very good advice. I shall certainly go there, for that is the place the Lord has given me for my residence."

lines: eta bali' duṅhe nija-kārye uṭhi' gelā
devanagari: एत ब लि’ दुँहे निज - कार्ये उठि’ गेला ।
आर दिन महाप्रभु मिलिबारे आइला ॥145॥
cc-antya-4.145.translation: After talking in this way, Sanātana Gosvāmī and Jagadānanda Paṇḍita returned to their respective duties. The next day, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to see Haridāsa and Sanātana Gosvāmī.

devanagari: हरिदास कैला प्रभुर चरण वन्दन ।
हरिदासे कैला प्रभु प्रेम - आलिङ्गन ॥146॥
cc-antya-4.146.translation: Haridāsa Ṭhākura offered obeisances to the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and the Lord embraced him in ecstatic love.

lines: prabhu bolāya bāra bāra karite āliṅgana
devanagari: दूर हैते दण्ड - परणाम करे सनातन ।
प्रभु बोलाय बार बार करिते आलिङ्गन ॥147॥
cc-antya-4.147.translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī offered his obeisances and daṇḍavats from a distant place, but Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu called him again and again to embrace him.

devanagari: अपराध - भये तेंह मिलिते ना आइल ।
महाप्रभु मिलिबारे सेइ ठाञि गेल ॥148॥
cc-antya-4.148.translation: Out of fear of committing offenses, Sanātana Gosvāmī did not come forward to meet Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. The Lord, however, went forward to meet him.

devanagari: सनातन भा गि’ पाछे करेन गमन ।
बलात्कारे धरि, प्रभु कैला आलिङ्गन ॥149॥
cc-antya-4.149.translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī backed away, but Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu caught him by force and embraced him.

devanagari: महाप्रभु देखिते ताँर उत्कण्ठित मन ।
हरिदास कहे , - “प्रभु आसिबेन एखन” ॥15॥
cc-antya-4.15.translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī was very eager to see the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Therefore Haridāsa Ṭhākura said, "The Lord is coming here very soon."

lines: dui jana lañā prabhu vasilā piṇḍāte
devanagari: दुइ जन लञा प्रभु वसिला पिण्डाते ।
निर्विण्ण सनातन लागिला कहिते ॥150॥
cc-antya-4.150.translation: The Lord took them both with Him and sat down in a sacred place. Then Sanātana Gosvāmī, who was advanced in renunciation, began to speak.

lines: sevā-yogya nahi, aparādha karoṅ niti niti
devanagari: हित ला गि’ आइनु मुञि, हैल विपरीत ।
सेवा - योग्य नहि, अपराध करों निति निति ॥151॥
cc-antya-4.151.translation: "I came here for my benefit," he said, "but I see that I am getting just the opposite. I am unfit to render service. I simply commit offenses day after day.

lines: more tumi chuṅile mora aparādha haya
devanagari: सहजे नीच - जाति मुञि, दुष्ट, ‘पापाशय’ ।
मोरे तुमि छुडिले मोर अपराध हय ॥152॥
cc-antya-4.152.translation: "By nature I am lowborn. I am a contaminated reservoir of sinful activities. If You touch me, sir, that will be a great offense on my part.

lines: tomāra aṅge lāge, tabu sparśaha tumi bale
devanagari: ताहाते आमार अङ्गे कण्डु - रसा - रक्त चले ।
तोमार अङ्गे लागे, तबु स्पर्शह तुमि बले ॥153॥
cc-antya-4.153.translation: "Moreover, blood is running from infected itching sores on my body, smearing Your body with moisture, but still You touch me by force.

devanagari: बीभत्स स्पर्शिते ना कर घृणा - लेशे ।
एइ अपराधे मोर हबे सर्व - नाशे ॥154॥
cc-antya-4.154.translation: "My dear sir, You do not have even a pinch of aversion to touching my body, which is in a horrible condition. Because of this offense, everything auspicious will be vanquished for me.

lines: tāte ihāṅ rahile mora nā haya 'kalyāṇa'
devanagari: ताते इहाँ रहिले मोर ना हय ‘कल्याण’ ।
आज्ञा देह’ - रथ देखि’ याङ वृन्दावन ॥155॥
cc-antya-4.155.translation: "Therefore I see that I will get nothing auspicious by staying here. Kindly give me orders allowing me to return to Vṛndāvana after the Ratha-yātrā festival.

devanagari: “जगदानन्द - पण्डिते आमि युक्ति पुछिल ।
वृन्दावन याइते तेंह उपदेश दिल” ॥156॥
cc-antya-4.156.translation: "I have consulted Jagadānanda Paṇḍita for his opinion, and he has also advised me to return to Vṛndāvana."

devanagari: एत शुनि’ महाप्रभु सरोष - अन्तरे ।
जगदानन्दे क्रुद्ध हञा करे तिरस्कारे ॥157॥
cc-antya-4.157.translation: Hearing this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, in an angry mood, began to chastise Jagadānanda Paṇḍita.

devanagari: कालिकार बटुया जगा ऐछे गर्वी हैल ।
तोमा - सबारेह उपदेश करिते लागिल ॥158॥
cc-antya-4.158.translation: "Jagā [Jagadānanda Paṇḍita] is only a new boy, but he has become so proud that he thinks himself competent to advise a person like you.

devanagari: व्यवहारे - परमार्थे तुमि - तार गुरु - तुल्य ।
तोमारे उपदेशे, ना जाने आपन - मूल्य ॥159॥
cc-antya-4.159.translation: "In affairs of spiritual advancement and even in ordinary dealings, you are on the level of his spiritual master. Yet not knowing his own value, he dares to advise you.

devanagari: हेन - काले प्रभु ‘उपल - भोग’ देखिया ।
हरिदासे मिलिते आइला भक्त - गण लञा ॥16॥
cc-antya-4.16.translation: At that very moment, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, after visiting the temple of Jagannātha to see the offering of upala-bhoga [morning refreshments], came with His other devotees to see Haridāsa Ṭhākura.

devanagari: आमार उपदेष्टा तुमि - प्रामाणिक आर्य ।
तोमारेह उपदेशे - बालका करे ऐछे कार्य ॥160॥
cc-antya-4.160.translation: "My dear Sanātana, you are on the level of My adviser, for you are an authorized person. But Jagā wants to advise you. This is but the impudence of a naughty boy."

lines: śuni' sanātana pāye dhari' prabhure kahila
devanagari: शुनि’ सनातन पाये ध रि’ प्रभुरे कहिल ।
“जगदानन्देर सौभाग्य आजि से जानिल” ॥161॥
cc-antya-4.161.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was thus chastising Jagadānanda Paṇḍita, Sanātana Gosvāmī fell at the Lord's feet and said, "I can now understand the fortunate position of Jagadānanda.

devanagari: आपनार ‘असौभाग्य’ आजि हैल ज्ञान ।
जगते नाहि जगदानन्द - सम भाग्यवान् ॥162॥
cc-antya-4.162.translation: "I can also understand my misfortune. No one in this world is as fortunate as Jagadānanda.

devanagari: जगदानन्दे पियाओ आत्मीयता - सुधा - रस ।
मोरे पियाओ गौरव - स्तुति - निम्ब - निशिन्दा - रस ॥163॥
cc-antya-4.163.translation: "Sir, You are making Jagadānanda drink the nectar of affectionate relationships, whereas by offering me honorable prayers, You are making me drink the bitter juice of nimba and niśindā.

devanagari: आजिह नहिल मोरे आत्मीयता - ज्ञान! ।
मोर अभाग्य, तुमि स्वतन्त्र भगवान्! ॥164॥
cc-antya-4.164.translation: "It is my misfortune that You have not accepted me as one of Your intimate relations. But You are the completely independent Supreme Personality of Godhead."

lines: śuni' mahāprabhu kichu lajjita hailā mane
devanagari: शुनि’ महाप्रभु किछु लज्जित हैला मने ।
ताँरे सन्तोषिते किछु बलेन वचने ॥165॥
cc-antya-4.165.translation: Hearing this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was somewhat ashamed. Just to satisfy Sanātana Gosvāmī, He spoke the following words.

devanagari: जगदा नन्द प्रिय आमार नहे तोमा हैते ।
मर्यादा - लङ्गन आमि ना पारों सहिते ॥166॥
cc-antya-4.166.translation: "My dear Sanātana, please do not think that Jagadānanda is more dear to Me than you. However, I cannot tolerate transgressions of the standard etiquette.

devanagari: काहाँ तुमि - प्रामाणिक, शास्त्रे प्रवीण! ।
काहाँ जगा - कालिकार बटुया नवीन! ॥167॥
cc-antya-4.167.translation: "You are an experienced authority in the śāstras, whereas Jagā is just a young boy.

devanagari: आमाकेह बुझाइते तुमि धर शक्ति ।
कत ठाञि बुझाञाछ व्यवहार - भक्ति ॥168॥
cc-antya-4.168.translation: "You have the power to convince even Me. In many places you have already convinced Me about ordinary behavior and devotional service.

lines: tomāre upadeśa kare, nā yāya sahana
devanagari: तोमारे उपदेश करे, ना याय सहन ।
अतएव तारे आमि करिये भर्सन ॥169॥
cc-antya-4.169.translation: "Jagā's advising you is intolerable for Me. Therefore I am chastising him.

lines: prabhu dekhi' duṅhe paḍe daṇḍavat hañā
devanagari: प्रभु देखि’ दुँहे पड़े दण्डवत् हञा ।
प्रभु आलिङ्गिला हरिदासेरे उठाञा ॥17॥
cc-antya-4.17.translation: Seeing Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, they both immediately fell flat like rods to offer obeisances. The Lord then lifted Haridāsa and embraced him.

lines: tomāra guṇe stuti karāya yaiche tomāra guna
devanagari: बहिरङ्ग - ज्ञाने तोमारे ना करि स्तवन ।
तोमार गुणे स्तुति कराय यैछे तोमार गुण ॥170॥
cc-antya-4.170.translation: "I offer you praise not because I think of you as being outside an intimate relationship with Me but because you are actually so qualified that one is forced to praise your qualities.

devanagari: यद्यपि काहार ‘ममता’ बहु - जने हय ।
प्रीति - स्वभावे काहाते कोन भावोदय ॥171॥
cc-antya-4.171.translation: "Although one has affection for many persons, different types of ecstatic love awaken according to the nature of one's personal relationships.

devanagari: तोमार देह तुमि कर बीभत्स - ज्ञान ।
तोमार देह आमारे लागे अमृत - समान ॥172॥
cc-antya-4.172.translation: "You consider your body dangerous and awful, but I think that your body is like nectar.

devanagari: अप्राकृत - देह तोमार ‘प्राकृत’ कभु नय ।
तथापि तोमार ताते प्राकृत - बुद्धि हय ॥173॥
cc-antya-4.173.translation: "Actually your body is transcendental, never material. You are thinking of it, however, in terms of a material conception.

lines: 'prākṛta' haile ha tomāra vapu nāri upekṣite
devanagari: ‘प्राकृत’ हैले ह तोमार वपु नारि उपेक्षिते ।
भद्राभद्र - वस्तु - ज्ञान नाहिक ‘प्राकृते’ ॥174॥
cc-antya-4.174.translation: "Even if your body were material, I still could not neglect it, for the material body should be considered neither good nor bad.

devanagari: किं भद्रं किमभद्रं वा द्वैतस्यावस्तुनः कियत् ।
वाचोदितं तदनृतं मनसा ध्यातमेव च ॥175॥
cc-antya-4.175.translation: “ 'Anything not conceived in relationship to Kṛṣṇa should be understood to be illusion [māyā]. None of the illusions uttered by words or conceived in the mind are factual. Because illusion is not factual, there is no distinction between what we think is good and what we think is bad. When we speak of the Absolute Truth, such speculations do not apply.'

devanagari: ‘द्वैते’ भद्राभद्र - ज्ञान, सब - ‘मनोधर्म’ ।
‘एइ भाल, एइ मन्द’, - एइ सब ‘भ्रम’ ॥176॥
cc-antya-4.176.translation: "In the material world, conceptions of good and bad are all mental speculations. Therefore, saying, 'This is good, and this is bad,' is all a mistake.

devanagari: विद्या - विनय - सम्पन्ने ब्राह्मणे गवि हस्तिनि ।
शुनि चैव श्व - पाके च पण्डिताः सम - दर्शिनः ॥177॥
cc-antya-4.177.translation: “ 'The humble sage, by virtue of true knowledge, sees with equal vision a learned and gentle brāhmaṇa, a cow, an elephant, a dog and a dog-eater.'

devanagari: ज्ञान - विज्ञान - तृप्तात्मा कूट - स्थो विजितेन्द्रियः ।
युक्त इत्युच्यते योगी सम - लोष्ट्राश्म - काञ्चनः ॥178॥
cc-antya-4.178.translation: “ 'One who is fully satisfied in knowledge obtained and practically applied in life, who is always determined and fixed in his spiritual position, who completely controls his senses, and who sees pebbles, stone and gold on the same level, is understood to be a perfect yogī.'

devanagari: आमि त’ - सन्यासी, आमार ‘सम - दृष्टि’ धर्म ।
