चन्दन - पङ्केते आमार ज्ञान हय ‘सम’ ॥179॥
cc-antya-4.179.translation: "Since I am in the renounced order, My duty is to make no distinctions but instead be equipoised. My knowledge must be equally disposed toward sandalwood pulp and dirty mud.

devanagari: हरिदास कहे , - “सनातन करे नमस्कार” ।
सनातने देखि’ प्रभु हैला चमत्कार ॥18॥
cc-antya-4.18.translation: Haridāsa Ṭhākura said to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, "Here is Sanātana Gosvāmī offering his obeisances." Seeing Sanātana Gosvāmī, the Lord was greatly surprised.

lines: ei lāgi' tomā tyāga karite nā yuyāya
devanagari: एइ ला गि’ तोमा त्याग करिते ना झुयाय ।
घृणा - बुद्धि करि यदि, निज - धर्म याय’ ॥180॥
cc-antya-4.180.translation: "For this reason, I cannot reject you. If I hated you, I would deviate from My occupational duty."

devanagari: हरिदास कहे , - “प्रभु, ये कहिला तुमि ।
एइ ‘बाह्य प्रतारणा’ नाहि मानि आमि” ॥181॥
cc-antya-4.181.translation: Haridāsa said, "My dear Lord, what You have spoken deals with external formalities. I do not accept it.

devanagari: आमा - सब अधमे ये करियाछ अङ्गीकार ।
दीन - दयालु - गुण तोमार ताहाते प्रचार ॥182॥
cc-antya-4.182.translation: "My Lord, we are all fallen, but You have accepted us due to Your attribute of being merciful to the fallen. This is well known all over the world."

lines: tattvataḥ kahi tomā-viṣaye yaiche mora mana
devanagari: प्रभु हासि’ कहे, - “शुन, हरिदास, सनातन ।
तत्त्वतः कहि तोमा - विषये यैछे मोर मन” ॥183॥
cc-antya-4.183.translation: Lord Caitanya smiled and said, "Listen, Haridāsa and Sanātana. Now I am speaking the truth about how My mind is attached to you.

devanagari: तोमारे ‘लाल्य’, आपनाके ‘लालक’ अभिमान ।
लालकेर लाल्ये नहे दोष - परिज्ञान ॥184॥
cc-antya-4.184.translation: "My dear Haridāsa and Sanātana, I think of you as My little boys, to be maintained by Me. The maintainer never takes seriously any faults of the maintained.

devanagari: आपनारे हय मोर अमान्य - समान ।
तोमा - सबारे करों मुजि बालक - अभिमान ॥185॥
cc-antya-4.185.translation: "I always think of Myself as deserving no respect, but because of affection I always consider you to be like My little children.

lines: ghṛṇā nāhi janme, āra mahā-sukha pāya
devanagari: मातार यैछे बालकेर ‘अमेध्य’ लागे गाय ।
घृणा नाहि जन्मे, आर महा - सुख पाय ॥186॥
cc-antya-4.186.translation: "When a child passes stool and urine that touch the body of the mother, the mother never hates the child. On the contrary, she takes much pleasure in cleansing him.

lines: sanātanera klede āmāra ghṛṇā nā upajāya"
devanagari: ‘लाल्यामेध्य’ लालकेर चन्दन - सम भाय ।
सनातनेर क्लेदे आमार घृणा ना उपजाय ॥187॥
cc-antya-4.187.translation: "The stool and urine of the maintained child appear like sandalwood pulp to the mother. Similarly, when the foul moisture oozing from the itches of Sanātana touches My body, I have no hatred for him."

lines: tomāra gambhīra hṛdaya bujhana nā yāya
devanagari: हरिदास कहे , - “तुमि ईश्वर दया - मय ।
तोमार गम्भीर हृदय बुझन ना याय” ॥188॥
cc-antya-4.188.translation: Haridāsa Ṭhākura said, "My dear sir, You are the Supreme Personality of Godhead and are most merciful toward us. No one can understand what is within Your deeply affectionate heart.

devanagari: वासुदेव - गलत्कुष्ठी, ताते अङ्ग - कीड़ा - मय ।
तारे आलिङ्गन कैला हा सदय ॥189॥
cc-antya-4.189.translation: "You embraced the leper Vāsudeva, whose body was fully infected by worms. You are so kind that in spite of his condition You embraced him.

devanagari: सनातने आलिङ्गिते प्रभु आगु हैला ।
पाछे भागे सनातन कहिते लागिला ॥19॥
cc-antya-4.19.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu came forward to embrace him, Sanātana backed away and spoke as follows.

lines: bujhite nā pāri tomāra kṛpāra taraṅga"
devanagari: आलिङ्गिया कैला तार कन्दर्प - सम अङ्ग ।
बुझिते ना पारि तोमार कृपार तरङ्ग ॥190॥
cc-antya-4.190.translation: "By embracing him You made his body as beautiful as that of Cupid. We cannot understand the waves of Your mercy."

devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - वैष्णव - देह ‘प्राकृत’ कभु नये ।
‘अप्राकृत’ देह भक्तेर ‘चिदानन्द - मय’ ॥191॥
cc-antya-4.191.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "The body of a devotee is never material. It is considered to be transcendental, full of spiritual bliss.

devanagari: दीक्षा - काले भक्त करे आत्म - समर्पण ।
सेइ - काले कृष्ण तारे करे आत्म - सम ॥192॥
cc-antya-4.192.translation: "At the time of initiation, when a devotee fully surrenders unto the service of the Lord, Kṛṣṇa accepts him to be as good as Himself.

devanagari: सेइ देह करे तार चिदानन्द - मय ।
अप्राकृत - देहे ताँर चरण भजय ॥193॥
cc-antya-4.193.translation: "When the devotee's body is thus transformed into spiritual existence, the devotee, in that transcendental body, renders service to the lotus feet of the Lord.

devanagari: मर्यो यदा त्यक्त - समस्त - कर्मा निवेदितात्मा विचिकीर्षितो मे ।
तदामृतत्वं प्रतिपद्यमानो मयात्म - भूयाय च कल्पते वै ॥194॥
cc-antya-4.194.translation: “ 'The living entity who is subjected to birth and death, when he gives up all material activities dedicating his life to Me for executing My order, and thus acts according to My direction, at that time he reaches the platform of immortality, and becomes fit to enjoy the spiritual bliss of exchange of loving mellows with Me.'

devanagari: सनातनेर देहे कृष्ण कण्डु उपजाञा ।
आमा परीक्षिते इहाँ दिला पाठा ञा ॥195॥
cc-antya-4.195.translation: "Kṛṣṇa somehow or other manifested these itching sores on the body of Sanātana Gosvāmī and sent him here to test Me.

lines: ghṛṇā kari' āliṅgana nā karitāma yabe
devanagari: घृणा करि’ आलिङ्गन ना करिताम यबे ।
कृष्ण - ठाञि अपराध - दण्ड पाइताम तबे ॥196॥
cc-antya-4.196.translation: "If I had hated Sanātana Gosvāmī and had not embraced him, I would certainly have been chastised for offenses to Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: पारिषद - देह एइ, ना हय दुर्गन्ध ।
प्रथम दिवसे पाइ लुँ चतुःसम - गन्ध ॥197॥
cc-antya-4.197.translation: "Sanātana Gosvāmī is one of the associates of Kṛṣṇa. There could not be any bad odor from his body. On the first day I embraced him, I smelled the aroma of catuḥsama [a mixture of sandalwood pulp, camphor, aguru and musk]."

lines: tāṅra sparśe gandha haila candanera sama
devanagari: वस्तुतः प्रभु झबे कैला आलिङ्गन ।
ताँर स्पर्शे गन्ध हैल चन्दनेर सम ॥198॥
cc-antya-4.198.translation: In fact, however, when Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu embraced the body of Sanātana Gosvāmī, by the Lord's touch alone there was manifest a fragrance exactly like that of sandalwood pulp.

lines: tomāra āliṅgane āmi pāi baḍa sukha
devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - “सनातन, ना मानिह दुःख ।
तोमार आलिङ्गने आमि पाइ बड़ सुख” ॥199॥
cc-antya-4.199.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu continued, "My dear Sanātana, do not be aggrieved, for when I embrace you I actually get great pleasure.

devanagari: जय जय श्री - चैतन्य जय नित्यानन्द ।
जयाद्वैत - चन्द्र जय गौर - भक्त - वृन्द ॥2॥
cc-antya-4.2.translation: All glories to Lord Caitanya! All glories to Lord Nityānanda! All glories to Advaitacandra! And all glories to all the devotees of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu!

lines: "more nā chuṅiha, prabhu, paḍoṅ tomāra pāya
eke nīca-jāti adhama, āra kaṇḍu-rasā gāya
devanagari: “मोरे ना छुडिह, प्रभु, पड़ों तोमार पाय ।
एके नीच - जाति अधम, आर कण्डु - रसा गाय” ॥20॥
cc-antya-4.20.translation: "My Lord, please do not touch me. I fall at Your lotus feet. I am the lowest of men, having been born of a low caste. Besides that, I have infections on my body."

lines: vatsara rahi' tomāre āmi pāṭhāimu vṛndāvane
devanagari: ए - वत्सर तुमि इहाँ रह आमा - सने ।
वत्सर रहि तोमारे आमि पाठाइमु वृन्दावने ॥200॥
cc-antya-4.200.translation: "Stay with Me at Jagannātha Purī for one year, and after that I shall send you to Vṛndāvana."

lines: eta bali' punaḥ tāṅre kailā āliṅgana
kaṇḍu gela, aṅga haila suvarṇera sama
devanagari: एत ब लि’ पुनः ताँरे कैला आलिङ्गन ।
कण्डु गेल, अङ्ग हैल सुवर्णेर सम ॥201॥
cc-antya-4.201.translation: After saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu again embraced Sanātana Gosvāmī. Thus immediately Sanātana's itches disappeared, and his entire body resembled the color of gold.

devanagari: देखि’ हरिदास मने हैला चमत्कार ।
प्रभुरे कहेन, - “एइ भङ्गी ये तोमार” ॥202॥
cc-antya-4.202.translation: Seeing the change, Haridāsa Ṭhākura, greatly astonished, told the Lord, "This is Your pastime.

devanagari: सेइ झारिखण्डेर पानी तुमि खाओयाइला ।
सेइ पानी - लक्ष्ये इँहार कण्डु उपजाइला ॥203॥
cc-antya-4.203.translation: "My dear Lord, You made Sanātana Gosvāmī drink the water of Jhārikhaṇḍa, and You actually generated the consequent itching sores on his body.

lines: ei līlā-bhaṅgī tomāra keha nāhi jāne"
devanagari: कण्डु करि’ परीक्षा करिले सनातने ।
एइ लीला - भङ्गी तोमार केह नाहि जाने ॥204॥
cc-antya-4.204.translation: "After thus causing these itching sores, You examined Sanātana Gosvāmī. No one can understand Your transcendental pastimes."

lines: prabhura guṇa kahe duṅhe hañā prema-maya
devanagari: दुँहे आलिङ्गिया प्रभु गेला निजालय ।
प्रभुर गुण कहे दुँहे हा प्रेम - मय ॥205॥
cc-antya-4.205.translation: After embracing both Haridāsa Ṭhākura and Sanātana Gosvāmī, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to His residence. Then both Haridāsa Ṭhākura and Sanātana Gosvāmī, in great ecstatic love, began to describe the Lord's transcendental attributes.

devanagari: एइ - मत सनातन रहे प्रभु - स्थाने ।
कृष्ण - चैतन्य - गुण - कथा हरिदास - सने ॥206॥
cc-antya-4.206.translation: In this way Sanātana Gosvāmī stayed under the care of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and discussed the transcendental qualities of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu with Haridāsa Ṭhākura.

lines: dola-yātrā dekhi' prabhu tāṅre vidāya dilā
devanagari: दोल - यात्रा देखि प्रभु ताँरे विदाय दिला ।
वृन्दावने ये करिबेन, सब शिखाइला ॥207॥
cc-antya-4.207.translation: After they saw the Dola-yātrā festival, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu instructed Sanātana Gosvāmī fully about what to do in Vṛndāvana and bade him farewell.

devanagari: ये - काले विदाय हैला प्रभुर चरणे ।
दुइ - जनार विच्छेद - दशा ना याय वर्णने ॥208॥
cc-antya-4.208.translation: The scene of separation that took place when Sanātana Gosvāmī and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu took leave of one another is so piteous that it cannot be described herein.

devanagari: येइ वन - पथे प्रभु गेला वृन्दावन ।
सेइ - पथे याइते मन कैला सनातन ॥209॥
cc-antya-4.209.translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī decided to go to Vṛndāvana by the very forest path Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had traversed.

devanagari: बलात्कारे प्रभु ताँरे आलिङ्गन कैल ।
कण्डु - क्लेद महाप्रभुर श्री - अङ्गे लागिल ॥21॥
cc-antya-4.21.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, however, embraced Sanātana Gosvāmī by force. Thus the moisture oozing from the itching sores touched the transcendental body of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: ये - पथे, ये - ग्राम - नदी - शैल, याहाँ ग्रेइ लीला ।
बलभद्र - भट्ट - स्थाने सब लिखि’ निला ॥210॥
cc-antya-4.210.translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī noted from Balabhadra Bhaṭṭācārya all the villages, rivers and hills where Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had performed His pastimes.

devanagari: महाप्रभुर भक्त - गणे सबारे मिलिया ।
सेइ - पथे च लि’ याय से स्थान देखिया ॥211॥
cc-antya-4.211.translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī met all the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and then, traveling by that same path, visited the places through which Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had passed.

devanagari: ये - ये - लीला प्रभु पथे कैला ये - ये - स्थाने ।
ताहा देखि प्रेमावेश हय सनातने ॥212॥
cc-antya-4.212.translation: As soon as Sanātana Gosvāmī visited a place where Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had performed His pastimes on the way, he was immediately filled with ecstatic love.

devanagari: एइ - मते सनातन वृन्दावने आइला ।
पाछे आ सि’ रूप - गोसाञि ताँहारे मिलिला ॥213॥
cc-antya-4.213.translation: In this way Sanātana Gosvāmī reached Vṛndāvana. Later Rūpa Gosvāmī came and met him.

devanagari: एक - वत्सर रूप - गोसाञि र गौड़े विलम्ब हैल ।
कुटुम्बेर ‘स्थिति’ - अर्थ विभाग क रि’ दिले ॥214॥
cc-antya-4.214.translation: Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī was delayed in Bengal for a year because he was dividing his money among his relatives to situate them in their proper positions.

lines: gauḍe ye artha chila, tāhā ānāilā
devanagari: गौड़े ने अर्थ छिल, ताहा आनाइला ।
कुटुम्ब - ब्राह्मण - देवालये बाँटि’ दिला ॥215॥
cc-antya-4.215.translation: He collected whatever money he had accumulated in Bengal and divided it among his relatives, the brāhmaṇas and the temples.

devanagari: सब मनः - कथा गोसाञि करि’ निर्वाहण ।
निश्चिन्त हञा शीघ्र आइला वृन्दावन ॥216॥
cc-antya-4.216.translation: Thus after finishing all the tasks he had on his mind, he returned to Vṛndāvana fully satisfied.

lines: dui bhāi mili' vṛndāvane vāsa kailā
prabhura ye ājñā, duṅhe saba nirvāhilā
devanagari: दुइ भाइ मिलि’ वृन्दावने वास कैला ।
प्रभुर ये आज्ञा, दुँहे सब निर्वाहिला ॥217॥
cc-antya-4.217.translation: The brothers met at Vṛndāvana, where they stayed to execute the will of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: नाना - शास्त्र आनि’ लुप्त - तीर्थ उद्धारिला ।
वृन्दावने कृष्ण - सेवा प्रकाश करिला ॥218॥
cc-antya-4.218.translation: Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī and Sanātana Gosvāmī collected many revealed scriptures, and from the evidence in those scriptures they excavated all the lost sites of pilgrimage. Thus they established temples for the worship of Lord Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: सनातन ग्रन्थ कैला ‘भागवतामृते’ ।
भक्त - भक्ति - कृष्ण - तत्त्व जानि याहा हैते ॥219॥
cc-antya-4.219.translation: Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī compiled the Bhāgavatāmṛta. From this book one can understand who is a devotee, what is the process of devotional service, and who is Kṛṣṇa, the Absolute Truth.

devanagari: सब भक्त - गणे प्रभु मिलाइला सनातने ।
सनातन कैला सबार चरण वन्दने ॥22॥
cc-antya-4.22.translation: The Lord introduced all the devotees to Sanātana Gosvāmī, who offered his respectful obeisances unto the lotus feet of them all.

devanagari: सिद्धान्त - सार ग्रन्थ कैला ‘दशम - टिप्पनी’ ।
कृष्ण - लीला - रस - प्रेम याहा हैते जानि ॥220॥
cc-antya-4.220.translation: Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī wrote a commentary on the Tenth Canto known as Daśama-ṭippanī, from which we can understand the transcendental pastimes and ecstatic love of Lord Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: ‘हरि - भक्ति - विलास’ - ग्रन्थ कैला वैष्णव - आचार ।
वैष्णवेर कर्तव्य याहाँ पाइये पार ॥221॥
cc-antya-4.221.translation: He also compiled the Hari-bhakti-vilāsa, from which we can understand the standard behavior of a devotee and the full extent of a Vaiṣṇava's duty.

lines: āra yata grantha kailā, tāhā ke kare gaṇana
devanagari: आर यत ग्रन्थ कैला, ताहा के करे गणन ।
‘मदन - गोपाल - गोविन्देर सेवा’ - प्रकाशन ॥222॥
cc-antya-4.222.translation: Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī also compiled many other books. Who can enumerate them? The basic principle of all these books is to show us how to love Madana-mohana and Govindajī.

devanagari: रूप - गोसाञि कैला ‘रसामृत - सिन्धु’ सार ।
कृष्ण - भक्ति - रसेर याहाँ पाइये विस्तार ॥223॥
cc-antya-4.223.translation: Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī also wrote many books, the most famous of which is Bhakti-rasāmṛta-sindhu. From that book one can understand the essence of devotional service to Kṛṣṇa and the transcendental mellow one can derive from such service.

devanagari: ‘उज्ज्वल - नीलमणि’ - नाम ग्रन्थ कैल आर ।
राधा - कृष्ण - लीला - रस ताहाँ पाइये पार ॥224॥
cc-antya-4.224.translation: Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī also compiled the book named Ujjvala-nīlamaṇi, from which one can understand, to the fullest limits, the loving affairs of Śrī Śrī Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: ‘विदग्ध - माधव’, ‘ललित - माधव’, - नाटक - मुगल ।
कृष्ण - लीला - रस ताहाँ पाइये सकल ॥225॥
cc-antya-4.225.translation: Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī also compiled two important dramas named Vidagdha-mādhava and Lalita-mādhava, from which one can understand all the mellows derived from the pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa.

lines: sei saba granthe vrajera rasa vicārila
devanagari: ‘दान - केलि - कौमुदी’ आदि लक्ष - ग्रन्थ कैल ।
सेइ सब ग्रन्थे व्रजेर रस विचारिल ॥226॥
cc-antya-4.226.translation: Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī compiled 100,000 verses, beginning with the book Dāna-keli-kaumudī. In all these scriptures he elaborately explained the transcendental mellows of the activities of Vṛndāvana.

devanagari: ताँर लघु - भ्राता - श्री - वल्लभ - अनुपम ।
ताँर पुत्र महा - पण्डित - जीव - गोसाञि नाम ॥227॥
cc-antya-4.227.translation: The son of Śrī Vallabha, or Anupama, Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī's younger brother, was the great learned scholar named Śrīla Jīva Gosvāmī.

lines: sarva tyāji' teṅho pāche āilā vṛndāvana
devanagari: सर्व त्यजि’ तेंहो पाछे आइला वृन्दावन ।
तेंह भक्ति - शास्त्र बहु कैला प्रचारण ॥228॥
cc-antya-4.228.translation: After renouncing everything, Śrīla Jīva Gosvāmī went to Vṛndāvana. Later he also wrote many books on devotional service and expanded the work of preaching.

devanagari: ‘भागवत - सन्दर्भ’ - नाम कैल ग्र न्थ - सार ।
भागवत - सिद्धान्तेर ताहाँ पाइये पार ॥229॥
cc-antya-4.229.translation: In particular, Śrīla Jīva Gosvāmī compiled the book named Bhāgavata-sandarbha, or Ṣaṭ-sandarbha, which is the essence of all scriptures. From this book one can obtain a conclusive understanding of devotional service and the Supreme Personality of Godhead.

lines: prabhu lañā vasilā piṇḍāra upare bhakta-gaṇa
devanagari: प्रभु ला वसिला पिण्डार उपरे भक्त - गण ।
पिण्डार तले वसिला हरिदास सनातन ॥23॥
cc-antya-4.23.translation: The Lord and His devotees sat on a raised platform, and below that sat Haridāsa Ṭhākura and Sanātana Gosvāmī.

devanagari: ‘गोपाल - चम्पू’ नाम ग्रन्थ सार कैल ।
व्रज - प्रेम - लीला - रस - सार देखाइल ॥230॥
cc-antya-4.230.translation: He also compiled the book named Gopāla-campū, which is the essence of all Vedic literature. In this book he has exhibited the ecstatic loving transactions and pastimes of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa in Vṛndāvana.

devanagari: ‘षट्सन्दर्भ’ कृष्ण - प्रेम - तत्त्व प्रकाशिल ।
चारि - लक्ष ग्रन्थ तेंहो विस्तार करिल ॥231॥
cc-antya-4.231.translation: In the Ṣaṭ-sandarbha Śrīla Jīva Gosvāmī set forth the truths about the transcendental love of Kṛṣṇa. In this way he expanded 400,000 verses in all his books.

devanagari: जीव - गोसाञि गौड़ हैते मथुरा चलिला ।
नित्यानन्द - प्रभु - ठाञि आज्ञा मागिला ॥232॥
cc-antya-4.232.translation: When Jīva Gosvāmī wanted to go to Mathurā from Bengal, he requested permission from Śrīla Nityānanda Prabhu.

lines: prabhu prītye tāṅra māthe dharilā caraṇa
devanagari: प्रभु प्रीत्ये ताँर माथे धरिला चरण ।
रूप - सनातन - सम्बन्धे कैला आलिङ्गन ॥233॥
cc-antya-4.233.translation: Because of Jīva Gosvāmī's relationship with Rūpa Gosvāmī and Sanātana Gosvāmī, who were greatly favored by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Lord Nityānanda Prabhu placed His feet on the head of Śrīla Jīva Gosvāmī and embraced him.

devanagari: आज्ञा दिला , - “शीघ्र तुमि याह वृन्दावने ।
तोमार वंशे प्रभु दियाछेन सेइ - स्थाने” ॥234॥
cc-antya-4.234.translation: Lord Nityānanda Prabhu ordered, "Yes, go soon to Vṛndāvana. That place has been awarded to your family, to your father and uncles, by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and therefore you must go there immediately."

devanagari: ताँर आज्ञाय आइला, आज्ञा - फल पाइला ।
शास्त्र क रि’ कत - काल ‘भक्ति’ प्रचारिला ॥235॥
cc-antya-4.235.translation: By the order of Nityānanda Prabhu, he went and actually achieved the result of His order, for he compiled many books for a long time and preached the cult of bhakti from Vṛndāvana.

devanagari: एइ तिन - गुरु, आर रघुनाथ - दास ।
इँहा - सबार चरण वन्दों, याँर मुजि ‘दास’ ॥236॥
cc-antya-4.236.translation: These three-Rūpa Gosvāmī, Sanātana Gosvāmī and Jīva Gosvāmī-are my spiritual masters, and so also is Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī. I therefore offer prayers at their lotus feet, for I am their servant.

devanagari: एइ त कहि लुँ पुनः सनातन - सङ्गमे ।
प्रभुर आशय जानि याहार श्रवणे ॥237॥
cc-antya-4.237.translation: Thus I have described the Lord's meeting again with Sanātana Gosvāmī. By hearing this I can understand the Lord's desire.

devanagari: चैतन्य - चरित्र एइ - इक्षु - दण्ड - सम ।
चर्वण करिते हय रस - आस्वादन ॥238॥
cc-antya-4.238.translation: These characteristics of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu are like sugar cane that one can chew to relish transcendental juice.

devanagari: श्री - रूप - रघुनाथ - पदे यार आश ।
चैतन्य - चरितामृत कहे कृष्णदास ॥239॥
cc-antya-4.239.translation: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.

devanagari: कुशल - वार्ता महाप्रभु पुछेन सनातने ।
तेंह कहेन, - “परम मङ्गल देखिनु चरणे” ॥24॥
cc-antya-4.24.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu inquired from Sanātana about news of his well-being. Sanātana replied, "Everything is auspicious because I have seen Your lotus feet."

devanagari: मथुरार वैष्णव - सबेर कुशल पुछिला ।
सबार कुशल सनातन जानाइला ॥25॥
cc-antya-4.25.translation: When the Lord asked about all the Vaiṣṇavas at Mathurā, Sanātana Gosvāmī informed Him of their good health and fortune.

lines: ihāṅ haite gauḍe gelā, haila dina daśa
devanagari: प्रभु कहे, इहाँ रूप छिल दश - मास ।
इहाँ हैते गौड़े गेला, हैल दिन दश ॥26॥
cc-antya-4.26.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu informed Sanātana Gosvāmī, "Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī was here for ten months. He left for Bengal just ten days ago.

lines: bhāla chila, raghunāthe dṛḍha tāra bhakti"
devanagari: तोमार भाइ अनुपमेर हैल गङ्गा - प्राप्ति ।
भाल छिल, रघुनाथे दृढ़ तार भक्ति ॥27॥
cc-antya-4.27.translation: "Your brother Anupama is now dead. He was a very good devotee who had firm conviction in Raghunātha [Lord Rāmacandra]."

devanagari: सनातन कहे , - “नीच - वंशे मोर जन्म” ।
अधर्म अन्याय यत, - आमार कुल - धर्म ॥28॥
cc-antya-4.28.translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī said, "I was born in a low family, for my family commits all kinds of irreligious acts that violate the scriptural injunctions.

lines: hena vaṁśa ghṛṇā chāḍi' kailā aṅgīkāra
devanagari: हेन वंश घृणा छाड़ि’ कैला अङ्गीकार ।
तोमार कृपाय वंशे मङ्गल आमार ॥29॥
cc-antya-4.29.translation: "My Lord, without hatred for my family You have accepted me as Your servant. Only by Your mercy is there good fortune in my family.

lines: nīlācala haite rūpa gauḍe yabe gelā
devanagari: नीलाचल हैते रूप गौड़े यबे गेला ।
मथुरा हैते सनातन नीलाचल आइला ॥3॥
cc-antya-4.3.translation: When Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī returned from Jagannātha Purī to Bengal, Sanātana Gosvāmī went from Mathurā to Jagannātha Purī to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: सेइ अनुपम - भाइ शिशु - काल हैते ।
रघुनाथ - उपासना करे दृढ़ - चित्ते ॥30॥
cc-antya-4.30.translation: "From the very beginning of his childhood, my younger brother Anupama was a great devotee of Raghunātha [Lord Rāmacandra], and he worshiped Him with great determination.

devanagari: रात्रि - दिने रघुनाथेर ‘नाम’ आर ‘ध्यान’ ।
रामायण निरवधि शुने, करे गान ॥31॥
cc-antya-4.31.translation: "He always chanted the holy name of Raghunātha and meditated upon Him. He continuously heard about the activities of the Lord from the Rāmāyaṇa and chanted about them.

devanagari: आमि आर रूप - तार ज्येष्ठ - सहोदर ।
आमा - दहा - सङ्गे तेंह रहे निरन्तर ॥32॥
cc-antya-4.32.translation: "Rūpa and I are his elder brothers. He stayed with us continuously.

devanagari: आमा - सबा - सङ्गे कृष्ण - कथा, भागवत शुने ।
ताहार परीक्षा कैलुँ आमि - दुइ - जने ॥33॥
cc-antya-4.33.translation: "He heard Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam and talks about Lord Kṛṣṇa with us, and both of us examined him.

devanagari: शुनह वल्लभ, कृष्ण - परम - मधुर ।
सौन्दर्य, माधुर्य, प्रेम - विलास - प्रचुर ॥34॥
cc-antya-4.34.translation: “ 'Dear Vallabha,' we said, 'please hear from us. Lord Kṛṣṇa is supremely attractive. His beauty, sweetness and pastimes of love are without limit.

devanagari: “कृष्ण - भजन कर तुमि आमा - हार सङ्गे ।
तिन भाइ एकत्र रहिमु कृष्ण - कथा - रङ्गे” ॥35॥
cc-antya-4.35.translation: “ 'Engage yourself in devotional service to Kṛṣṇa with both of us. We three brothers shall stay together and enjoy discussing the pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa.'

lines: āmā-duṅhāra gaurave kichu phiri' gela mana
devanagari: एइ - मत बार - बार कहि दुइ - जन ।
आमा - दुँहार गौरवे किछु फिरि’ गेल मन ॥36॥
cc-antya-4.36.translation: "In this way we both spoke to him again and again, and because of this persuasion and his respect for us, his mind turned somewhat toward our instructions.

devanagari: तोमा - दुँहार आज्ञा आमि केमने लङ्घिमु ।
दीक्षा - मन्त्र देह’ कृष्ण - भजन करिमु ॥37॥
cc-antya-4.37.translation: "Vallabha replied, 'My dear brothers, how can I disobey your orders? Initiate me into the Kṛṣṇa mantra so that I may perform devotional service to Lord Kṛṣṇa.'

devanagari: एत क हि’ रात्रि - काले करेन चिन्तन ।
केमने छाड़िमु रघुनाथेर चरण ॥38॥
cc-antya-4.38.translation: "After saying this, at night he began to think, 'How shall I give up the lotus feet of Lord Raghunātha?'

lines: saba rātri krandana kari' kaila jāgaraṇa
devanagari: सब रात्रि क्रन्दन क रि’ कैल जागरण ।
प्रातः - काले आमा - दुँहाय कैल निवेदन ॥39॥
cc-antya-4.39.translation: "He stayed up all night and cried. In the morning, he came to us and submitted the following plea.

devanagari: झारिखण्ड - वनपथे आइला एकेला चलिया ।
कभु उपवास, कभु चर्वण करिया ॥4॥
cc-antya-4.4.translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī walked alone on the path through Jhārikhaṇḍa Forest in central India. Sometimes he fasted, and sometimes he would eat.

lines: kāḍite nā pāroṅ māthā, pāṅa baḍa vyathā
devanagari: रघुनाथेर पाद - पद्ये वेचियाछों माथा ।
काड़िते ना पारों माथा, पाङ बड़ व्यथा ॥40॥
cc-antya-4.40.translation: “ 'I have sold my head at the lotus feet of Lord Rāmacandra. I cannot take it away. That would be too painful for me.

lines: kṛpā kari' more ājñā deha' dui-jana
devanagari: कृपा करि’ मोरे आज्ञा देह’ दुइ - जन ।
जन्मे - जन्मे सेवों रघुनाथेर चरण ॥41॥
cc-antya-4.41.translation: “ 'Both of you please be merciful to me and order me in such a way so that life after life I may serve the lotus feet of Lord Raghunātha.

lines: chāḍibāra mana haile prāṇa phāṭi' yāya'
devanagari: रघुनाथेर पाद - पद्म छाड़ान ना याय ।
छाड़िबार मन हैले प्राण फाटि’ झाय’ ॥42॥
cc-antya-4.42.translation: “ 'It is impossible for me to give up the lotus feet of Lord Raghunātha. When I even think of giving them up, my heart breaks.'

devanagari: तबे आमि - हे तारे आलिङ्गन कैलुँ ।
साधु, दृढ़ - भक्ति तोमार - कहि’ प्रशंसिलुँ ॥43॥
cc-antya-4.43.translation: "Upon hearing this, both of us embraced him and encouraged him by saying, 'You are a great saintly devotee, for your determination in devotional service is fixed.' In this way we both praised him.

lines: ye vaṁśera upare tomāra haya kṛpā-leśa
sakala maṅgala tāhe khaṇḍe saba kleśa'
devanagari: ये वंशेर उपरे तोमार हय कृपा - लेश ।
सकल मङ्गल ताहे खण्डे सब क्लेश ॥44॥
cc-antya-4.44.translation: "My dear Lord, the family upon which You bestow even a little mercy is always fortunate, for such mercy makes all miseries disappear."

lines: pūrve āmi parīkṣiluṅ tāra ei rīta
devanagari: गोसाञि कहेन, - “एइ - मत मुरारि - गुप्त ।
पूर्वे आमि परीक्षिलुँ तार एइ रीत” ॥45॥
cc-antya-4.45.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "There was a similar incident concerning Murāri Gupta. Formerly I examined him, and his determination was similar.

lines: sei bhakta dhanya, ye nā chāḍe prabhura caraṇa
sei prabhu dhanya, ye nā chāḍe nija-jana
devanagari: सेइ भक्त धन्य, ग्रे ना छाड़े प्रभुर चरण ।
सेइ प्रभु धन्य, ये ना छाड़े निज - जन ॥46॥
cc-antya-4.46.translation: "Glorious is that devotee who does not give up the shelter of his Lord, and glorious is that Lord who does not abandon His servant.

lines: durdaive sevaka yadi yāya anya sthāne
sei ṭhākura dhanya tāre cule dhari' āne
devanagari: दुर्दैवे सेवक यदि याय अन्य स्थाने ।
सेइ ठाकुर धन्य तारे चुले धरि आने ॥47॥
cc-antya-4.47.translation: "If by chance a servant falls down and goes somewhere else, glorious is that master who captures him and brings him back by the hair.

lines: bhāla haila, tomāra ihāṅ haila āgamane
devanagari: भाल हैल, तोमार इहाँ हैल आगमने ।
एइ घरे रह इहाँ हरिदास - सने ॥48॥
cc-antya-4.48.translation: "It is very good that you have arrived here. Now stay in this room with Haridāsa Ṭhākura.

devanagari: “कृष्ण - भक्ति - रसे दुँहे परम प्रधान ।
कृष्ण - रस आस्वादन कर, लह कृष्ण - नाम” ॥49॥
cc-antya-4.49.translation: "Both of you are expert in understanding the mellows of Lord Kṛṣṇa's devotional service. Therefore you should both continue relishing the taste for such activities and chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra."

lines: gātre kaṇḍu haila, rasā paḍe khājuyāite
devanagari: झारिखण्डेर जलेर दोषे, उपवास हैते ।
गात्रे कण्डु हैल, रसा पड़े खाजुयाइते ॥5॥
cc-antya-4.5.translation: Because of bad water in Jhārikhaṇḍa and because of fasting, Sanātana Gosvāmī contracted a disease that made his body itch. Thus he was afflicted with itching sores from which fluid oozed.

devanagari: एत ब लि’ महाप्रभु उठिया चलिला ।
गोविन्द - द्वाराय दुँहे प्रसाद पाठाइला ॥50॥
cc-antya-4.50.translation: Having said this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu got up and left, and through Govinda He sent prasāda for them to eat.

devanagari: एइ - मत सनातन रहे प्रभु - स्थाने ।
जगन्नाथेर चक्र देखि’ करेन प्रणामे ॥51॥
cc-antya-4.51.translation: In this way, Sanātana Gosvāmī stayed under the care of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. He would see the wheel on the pinnacle of the Jagannātha temple and offer respectful obeisances.

devanagari: प्रभु आसि’ प्रति - दिन मिलेन दुइ - जने ।
इष्ट - गोष्ठी, कृष्ण - कथा कहे कत - क्षणे ॥52॥
cc-antya-4.52.translation: Every day Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would go there to meet these two stalwart devotees and discuss topics of Kṛṣṇa with them for some time.

lines: tāhā āni' nitya avaśya dena doṅhākāre
devanagari: दिव्य प्रसाद पाय नित्य जगन्नाथ - मन्दिरे ।
ताहा आनि’ नित्य अवश्य देन दोंहाकारे ॥53॥
cc-antya-4.53.translation: The offerings of prasāda in the temple of Lord Jagannātha were of the highest quality. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would bring this prasāda and deliver it to both devotees.

devanagari: एक - दिन आ सि’ प्रभु दुँहारे मिलिला ।
सनातने आचम्बिते कहिते लागिला ॥54॥
cc-antya-4.54.translation: One day when the Lord came to meet them, He suddenly began speaking to Sanātana Gosvāmī.

devanagari: सनातन, देह - त्यागे कृष्ण यदि पाइये ।
कोटि - देह क्षणेके तबे छाड़िते पारिये ॥55॥
cc-antya-4.55.translation: "My dear Sanātana," He said, "if I could attain Kṛṣṇa by committing suicide, I would certainly give up millions of bodies without a moment's hesitation.

lines: deha-tyāge kṛṣṇa nā paī, pāiye bhajane
devanagari: देह - त्यागे कृष्ण ना पाई, पाइये भजने ।
कृष्ण - प्राप्त्येर उपाय कोन नाहि ‘भक्ति’ विने ॥56॥
cc-antya-4.56.translation: "You should know that one cannot attain Kṛṣṇa simply by giving up the body. Kṛṣṇa is attainable by devotional service. There is no other means to attain Him.

devanagari: देह - त्यागादि व्रत, सब - तमो - धर्म ।
तमो - रजो - धर्मे कृष्णेर ना पाइये मर्म ॥57॥
cc-antya-4.57.translation: "Acts such as suicide are influenced by the mode of ignorance, and in ignorance and passion one cannot understand who Kṛṣṇa is.

lines: prema vinā kṛṣṇa-prāpti anya haite naya
devanagari: ‘भक्ति’ विना कृष्णे कभु नहे ‘प्रेमोदय’ ।
प्रेम विना कृष्ण - प्राप्ति अन्य हैते नय ॥58॥
cc-antya-4.58.translation: "Unless one discharges devotional service, one cannot awaken one's dormant love for Kṛṣṇa, and there is no means to attain Him other than awakening that dormant love.

devanagari: न साधयति मां योगो न साङ्ख्यं धर्म उद्धव ।
न स्वाध्यायस्तपस्त्यागो यथा भक्तिर्ममोर्जिता ॥59॥
cc-antya-4.59.translation: [The Supreme Personality of Godhead, Kṛṣṇa, said:] " 'My dear Uddhava, neither through aṣṭāṅga-yoga [the mystic yoga system to control the senses], nor through impersonal monism or an analytical study of the Absolute Truth, nor through study of the Vedas, nor through austerities, charity or acceptance of sannyāsa can one satisfy Me as much as by developing unalloyed devotional service unto Me.'

devanagari: निर्वेद हइल पथे, करेन विचार ।
‘नीच - जाति, देह मोर - अत्यन्त असार ॥6॥
cc-antya-4.6.translation: In disappointment, Sanātana Gosvāmī considered, "I am of a low caste, and my body is useless for devotional service.

lines: sādhaka nā pāya tāte kṛṣṇera caraṇa
devanagari: देह - त्यागादि तमो - धर्म - पातक - कारण ।
साधक ना पाय ताते कृष्णेर चरण ॥60॥
cc-antya-4.60.translation: "Measures like suicide are causes for sin. A devotee never achieves shelter at Kṛṣṇa's lotus feet by such actions.

lines: premī bhakta viyoge cāhe deha chāḍite
preme kṛṣṇa mile, seha nā pāre marite
devanagari: प्रेमी भक्त वियोगे चाहे देह छाड़िते ।
प्रेमे कृष्ण मिले, सेह ना पारे मरिते ॥61॥
cc-antya-4.61.translation: "Because of feelings of separation from Kṛṣṇa, an exalted devotee sometimes wants to give up his life. By such ecstatic love, however, one attains the audience of Kṛṣṇa, and at that time he cannot give up his body.

devanagari: गाढ़ानुरागेर वियोग ना याय सहन ।
ताते अनुरागी वाञ्छे आपन मरण ॥62॥
cc-antya-4.62.translation: "One who is deeply in love with Kṛṣṇa cannot tolerate separation from the Lord. Therefore such a devotee always desires his own death.

devanagari: यस्याङ्घि - पङ्कज - रजः - स्नपनं महान्तो वाञ्छन्त्युमा - पतिरिवात्म - तमोऽपहत्यै ।
यहम्बुजाक्ष न लभेय भवत्प्रसादं जह्यामसुन्व्रत - कृशाञ्छत - जन्मभिः स्यात् ॥63॥
cc-antya-4.63.translation: “ 'O lotus-eyed one, great personalities like Lord Śiva desire to bathe in the dust of Your lotus feet to drive away ignorance. If I do not get the mercy of Your Lordship, I shall observe vows to reduce the duration of my life, and thus I shall give up bodies for hundreds of births if it is possible to get Your mercy in that way.'

lines: dhyānena yāma padayoḥ padavīṁ sakhe te
devanagari: सिञ्चाङ्ग नस्त्वदधरामृत - पूरकेण हासावलोक - कल - गीत - ज - हृच्छयाग्निम् ।
नो चेद्वयं विरह - जाग्न्युपयुक्त - देहा ध्यानेन याम पदयोः पदवीं सखे ते ॥64॥
cc-antya-4.64.translation: “ 'O dear Kṛṣṇa, by Your smiling glances and melodious talk, You have awakened a fire of lusty desire in our hearts. Now You should extinguish that fire with a stream of nectar from Your lips by kissing us. Kindly do this. Otherwise, dear friend, the fire within our hearts will burn our bodies to ashes because of separation from You. Thus by meditation we shall claim shelter at Your lotus feet.' "

devanagari: कुबुद्धि छाड़िया कर श्रवण - कीर्तन ।
अचिरात् पाबे तबे कृष्णेर चरण ॥65॥
cc-antya-4.65.translation: Caitanya Mahāprabhu told Sanātana Gosvāmī, "Give up all your nonsensical desires, for they are unfavorable for getting shelter at the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa. Engage yourself in chanting and hearing. Then you will soon achieve the shelter of Kṛṣṇa without a doubt.

devanagari: नीच - जाति नका - भजने अयोग्य ।
सत्कुल - विप्र नहे भजनेर योग्य ॥66॥
cc-antya-4.66.translation: "A person born in a low family is not unfit for discharging devotional service to Lord Kṛṣṇa, nor is one fit for devotional service simply because he is born in an aristocratic family of brāhmaṇas.

lines: yei bhaje sei baḍa, abhakta—hīna, chāra
devanagari: येइ भजे सेइ बड़, अभक्त - हीन, छार ।
कृष्ण - भजने नाहि जाति - कुलादि - विचार ॥67॥
cc-antya-4.67.translation: "Anyone who takes to devotional service is exalted, whereas a nondevotee is always condemned and abominable. Therefore in the discharge of devotional service to the Lord, there is no consideration of the status of one's family.

devanagari: दीनेरे अधिक दया करे भगवान् ।
कुलीन, पण्डित, धनीर बड़ अभिमान ॥68॥
cc-antya-4.68.translation: "The Supreme Personality of Godhead, Kṛṣṇa, is always favorable to the humble and meek, but aristocrats, learned scholars and the wealthy are always proud of their positions.

lines: prāṇaṁ punāti sa kulaṁ na tu bhūrimānaḥ
devanagari: विप्राद् द्वि - षड् - गुण - युतादरविन्द - नाभ - पादारविन्द - विमुखात् श्रुपचं वरिष्ठम् ।
मन्ये तदर्पत - मनो - वचनेहितार्थ - प्राणं पुनाति स कुलं न तु भूरि - मानः ॥69॥
cc-antya-4.69.translation: “ 'One may be born in a brāhmaṇa family and have all twelve brahminical qualities, but if in spite of being thus qualified he is not devoted to the lotus feet of Lord Kṛṣṇa, who has a navel shaped like a lotus, he is not as good as a caṇḍāla who has dedicated his mind, words, activities, wealth and life to the service of the Lord. Simply to take birth in a brāhmaṇa family or to have brahminical qualities is not sufficient. One must be a pure devotee of the Lord. Thus if a śvapaca, or caṇḍāla, is a devotee, he delivers not only himself but his entire family as well, whereas a brāhmaṇa who is not a devotee but simply has brahminical qualifications cannot even purify himself, what to speak of his family.'

lines: jagannāthe gele tāṅra darśana nā pāimu
devanagari: जगन्नाथे गेले ताँर दर्शन ना पाइमु ।
प्रभुर दर्शन सदा करिते नारिमु ॥7॥
cc-antya-4.7.translation: "When I go to Jagannātha Purī, I shall not be able to see Lord Jagannātha, nor shall I always be able to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: भजनेर मध्ये श्रेष्ठ नव - विधा भक्ति ।
“कृष्ण - प्रेम”, ‘कृष्ण’ दिते धरे महा - शक्ति ॥70॥
cc-antya-4.70.translation: "Among the ways of executing devotional service, the nine prescribed methods are the best, for these processes have great potency to deliver Kṛṣṇa and ecstatic love for Him.

devanagari: तार मध्ये सर्वश्रेष्ठ नाम - सङ्कीर्तन ।
निरपराधे नाम लैले पाय प्रेम - धन ॥71॥
cc-antya-4.71.translation: "Of the nine processes of devotional service, the most important is to always chant the holy name of the Lord. If one does so, avoiding the ten kinds of offenses, one very easily obtains the most valuable love of Godhead."

devanagari: एत शुनि’ सनातनेर हैल चमत्कार ।
प्रभुरे ना भाय मोर मरण - विचार ॥72॥
cc-antya-4.72.translation: After hearing this, Sanātana Gosvāmī was exceedingly astonished. He could understand, "My decision to commit suicide has not been greatly appreciated by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu."

devanagari: सर्वज्ञ महाप्रभु निषेधिला मोरे ।
प्रभुर चरण धरि’ कहेन ताँहारे ॥73॥
cc-antya-4.73.translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī concluded, "Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who knows everything-past, present and future-has forbidden me to commit suicide." He then fell down, touching the lotus feet of the Lord, and spoke to Him as follows.

devanagari: सर्वज्ञ, कृपालु तुमि ईश्वर स्वतन्त्र ।
यैछे नाचाओ, तैछे नाचि , - येन काष्ठ - ग्रन्त्र ॥74॥
cc-antya-4.74.translation: "My Lord, You are the omniscient, merciful, independent Supreme Lord. Exactly like an instrument of wood, I dance as You make me do so.

lines: more jiyāile tomāra kibā habe lābha?"
devanagari: “नीच, अधम, पामर मुनि पामर - स्वभाव ।
मोरे जियाइले तोमार किबा हबे लाभ ?” ॥75॥
cc-antya-4.75.translation: "I am lowborn. Indeed, I am the lowest. I am condemned, for I have all the characteristics of a sinful man. If You keep me alive, what will be the profit?"

devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - “तोमार देह मोर निज - धन ।
तुमि मोरे करियाछ आत्म - समर्पण” ॥76॥
cc-antya-4.76.translation: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "Your body is My property. You have already surrendered unto Me. Therefore you no longer have any claim to your body.

lines: parera dravya tumi kene cāha vināśite?
dharmādharma vicāra kibā nā pāra karite?
devanagari: परेर द्रव्य तुमि केने चाह विनाशिते? ।
धर्माधर्म विचार किबा ना पार करिते ? ॥77॥
cc-antya-4.77.translation: "Why should you want to destroy another's property? Can't you consider what is right and wrong?

lines: e śarīre sādhimu āmi bahu prayojana
devanagari: “तोमार शरीर - मोर प्रधान साध न” ।
ए शरीरे साधिमु आमि बहु प्रयोजन ॥78॥
cc-antya-4.78.translation: "Your body is My principal instrument for executing many necessary functions. By your body I shall carry out many tasks.

devanagari: भक्त - भक्ति - कृष्णप्रेम - तत्त्वेर निधार ।
वैष्णवेर कृत्य, आर वैष्णव - आचार ॥79॥
cc-antya-4.79.translation: "You shall have to ascertain the basic principles of a devotee, devotional service, love of Godhead, Vaiṣṇava duties, and Vaiṣṇava characteristics.

devanagari: मन्दिर - निकटे शुनि ताँर वासा - स्थिति ।
मन्दिर - निकटे याइते मोर नाहि शक्ति ॥8॥
cc-antya-4.8.translation: "I have heard that the residential quarters of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu are near the temple of Jagannātha. But I shall not have the power to go near the temple.

devanagari: कृष्ण - भक्ति, कृष्णप्रेम - सेवा - प्रवर्तन ।
लुप्त - तीर्थ - उद्धार, आर वैराग्य - शिक्षण ॥80॥
cc-antya-4.80.translation: "You will also have to explain Kṛṣṇa's devotional service, establish centers for cultivation of love of Kṛṣṇa, excavate lost places of pilgrimage and teach people how to adopt the renounced order.

lines: tāhāṅ eta dharma cāhi karite pracāraṇa
devanagari: निज - प्रिय - स्थान मोर - मथुरा - वृन्दावन ।
ताहाँ एत धर्म चाहि करिते प्रचारण ॥81॥
cc-antya-4.81.translation: "Mathurā-Vṛndāvana is My own very dear abode. I want to do many things there to preach Kṛṣṇa consciousness.

devanagari: मातार आज्ञाय आमि व सि नीलाचले ।
ताहाँ ‘धर्म’ शिखाइते नाहि निज - बले ॥82॥
cc-antya-4.82.translation: "By the order of My mother I am sitting here in Jagannātha Purī; therefore, I cannot go to Mathurā-Vṛndāvana to teach people how to live there according to religious principles.

lines: eta saba karma āmi ye-dehe karimu
tāhā chāḍite cāha tumi, kemane sahimu?"
devanagari: एत सब कर्म आमि ये - देहे करिमु ।
ताहा छाड़िते चाह तुमि, केमने सहिमु? ॥83॥
cc-antya-4.83.translation: "I have to do all this work through your body, but you want to give it up. How can I tolerate this?"

lines: tomāra gambhīra hṛdaya ke bujhite pāre?
devanagari: तबे सनातन कहे , - “तोमाके नमस्कारे ।
तोमार गम्भीर हृदय के बुझिते पारे?” ॥84॥
cc-antya-4.84.translation: At that time Sanātana Gosvāmī said to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, "I offer my respectful obeisances unto You. No one can understand the deep ideas You plan within Your heart.

lines: āpane nā jāne, putalī kibā nāce gāya!
devanagari: काष्ठेर पुतली येन कुहके नाचाय ।
आपने ना जाने, पुतली किबा नाचे गाय! ॥85॥
cc-antya-4.85.translation: "A wooden doll chants and dances according to the direction of a magician but does not know how he is dancing and singing.

lines: yāre yaiche nācāo, se taiche kare nartane
kaiche nāce, kebā nācāya, seha nāhi jāne"
devanagari: यारे यैछे नाचाओ, से तैछे करे नर्तने ।
कैछे नाचे, केबा नाचाय, सेह नाहि जाने” ॥86॥
cc-antya-4.86.translation: "My dear Lord, as You cause one to dance, he dances accordingly, but how he dances and who is causing him to dance he does not know."

lines: parera dravya iṅho cāhena karite vināśa
devanagari: हरिदासे कहे प्रभु, - “शुन, हरिदास ।
परेर द्रव्य इँहो चाहेन करिते विनाश” ॥87॥
cc-antya-4.87.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then said to Haridāsa Ṭhākura, "My dear Haridāsa, please hear Me. This gentleman wants to destroy another's property.

lines: parera sthāpya dravya keha nā khāya, vilāya
devanagari: “परेर स्थाप्य द्रव्य केह ना खाय, विलाय ।
निषेधिह इँहारे , - येन ना करे अन्याय” ॥88॥
cc-antya-4.88.translation: "One who is entrusted with another's property does not distribute it or use it for his own purposes. Therefore, tell him not to do such an unlawful thing."

lines: tomāra gambhīra hṛdaya bujhite nā pāri
devanagari: हरिदास कहे , - “मिथ्या अभिमान करि ।
तोमार गम्भीर हृदय बुझिते ना पारि” ॥89॥
cc-antya-4.89.translation: Haridāsa Ṭhākura replied, "We are falsely proud of our capabilities. Actually we cannot understand Your deep intentions.

lines: tāṅra sparśa haile mora habe aparādhe
devanagari: जगन्नाथेर सेवक फेरे कार्य - अनुरोधे ।
ताँर स्पर्श हैले मोर हबे अपराधे ॥9॥
cc-antya-4.9.translation: "The servants of Lord Jagannātha generally move about tending to their duties, but if they touch me I shall be an offender.

lines: kon kon kārya tumi kara kon dvāre
tumi nā jānāile keha jānite nā pāre
devanagari: कोन् को कार्य तुमि कर कोन् द्वारे ।
तुमि ना जानाइले केह जानते ना पारे ॥90॥
cc-antya-4.90.translation: "Unless You inform us, we cannot understand what Your purpose is nor what You want to do through whom.

lines: eta saubhāgya ihāṅ nā haya kāhāra"
devanagari: “एतादृश तुमि इँहारे करियाछ अङ्गीकार ।
एत सौभाग्य इहाँ ना हय काहार” ॥91॥
cc-antya-4.91.translation: "My dear sir, since You, a great personality, have accepted Sanātana Gosvāmī, he is greatly fortunate; no one can be as fortunate as he."

devanagari: तबे महाप्रभु करि’ हुँहारे आलिङ्गन ।
‘मध्याह्न’ करिते उठि’ करिला गमन ॥92॥
cc-antya-4.92.translation: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu embraced both Haridāsa Ṭhākura and Sanātana Gosvāmī and then got up and left to perform His noon duties.

devanagari: सनातने कहे हरिदास क रि’ आलिङ्गन ।
“तोमार भाग्येर सीमा ना याय कथन” ॥93॥
cc-antya-4.93.translation: "My dear Sanātana," Haridāsa Ṭhākura said, embracing him, "no one can find the limits of your good fortune.

devanagari: तोमार देह कहेन प्रभु मोर निज - धन ।
तोमा - सम भाग्यवान् नाहि कोन जन ॥94॥
cc-antya-4.94.translation: "Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu has accepted your body as His own property. Therefore no one can equal you in good fortune.

lines: nija-dehe ye kārya nā pārena karite
se kārya karāibe tomā, seha mathurāte
devanagari: निज - देहे ये कार्य ना पारेन करिते ।
से कार्य कराइबे तोमा, सेह मथुराते ॥95॥
cc-antya-4.95.translation: "What Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu cannot do with His personal body He wants to do through you, and He wants to do it in Mathurā.

lines: ye karāite cāhe īśvara, sei siddha haya
devanagari: ये कराइते चाहे ईश्वर, सेइ सिद्ध हय ।
तोमार सौभाग्य एइ कहिलुँ निश्चय ॥96॥
cc-antya-4.96.translation: "Whatever the Supreme Personality of Godhead wants us to do will successfully be accomplished. This is your great fortune. That is my mature opinion.

devanagari: भक्ति - सिद्धान्त, शास्त्र - आचार - निर्णय ।
तोमा - द्वारे कराइबेन, बुझिलुँ आशय ॥97॥
cc-antya-4.97.translation: "I can understand from the words of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu that He wants you to write books about the conclusive decision of devotional service and about the regulative principles ascertained from the revealed scriptures.

lines: āmāra ei deha prabhura kārye nā lāgila
bhārata-bhūmite janmi' ei deha vyartha haila
devanagari: आमार एइ देह प्रभुर कार्ये ना लागिल ।
भारत - भूमिते जन्मि’ एइ देह व्यर्थ हैल ॥98॥
cc-antya-4.98.translation: "My body could not be used in the service of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Therefore although it took birth in the land of India, this body has been useless."

devanagari: सनातन कहे , - “तोमा - सम केबा आछे आन ।
महाप्रभुर गणे तुमि - महा - भाग्यवान्!” ॥99॥
cc-antya-4.99.translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī replied, "O Haridāsa Ṭhākura, who is equal to you? You are one of the associates of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Therefore you are the most fortunate.

devanagari: वैगुण्य - कीट - कलितः पैशुन्य - व्रण - पीड़ितः ।
दैन्यार्णवे निमग्नोऽहं चैतन्य - वैद्यमाश्रये ॥1॥
cc-antya-5.1.translation: I am infected by germs of material activity and suffering from boils due to envy. Therefore, falling in an ocean of humility, I take shelter of the great physician Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: धर्मः स्वनुष्ठितः पुंसां विष्वक्सेन - कथासु यः ।
नोत्पादयेद् यदि रतिं श्रम एव हि केवलम् ॥10॥
cc-antya-5.10.translation: "A person who properly performs his regulative duties according to varṇa and āśrama but does not develop his dormant attachment for Kṛṣṇa or awaken his taste to hear and chant about Kṛṣṇa is certainly laboring fruitlessly.' "

lines: ādau tumi śuna, yadi tomāra mana māne
devanagari: आदौ तुमि शुन, यदि तोमार मन माने ।
पाछे महाप्रभुरे तबे कराइमु श्रवणे ॥100॥
cc-antya-5.100.translation: "First you hear it, and if it is acceptable to your mind, I shall request Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to hear it."

lines: ye-se śāstra śunite icchā upaje tomāra
devanagari: स्वरूप कहे , - “तुमि ‘गोप’ परम - उदार ।
ये - से शास्त्र शुनिते इच्छा उपजे तोमार” ॥101॥
cc-antya-5.101.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī replied, "Dear Bhagavān Ācārya, you are a very liberal cowherd boy. Sometimes the desire awakens within you to hear any kind of poetry.

devanagari: ‘यद्वा - तद्वा’ कविर वाक्ये हय ‘रसाभास’ ।
सिद्धान्त - विरुद्ध शुनिते ना हय उल्लास ॥102॥
cc-antya-5.102.translation: "In the writings of so-called poets there is generally a possibility of overlapping transcendental mellows. When the mellows thus go against the conclusive understanding, no one likes to hear such poetry.

devanagari: ‘रस’, ‘रसाभास’ यार नाहिक विचार ।
भक्ति - सिद्धान्त - सिन्धु नाहि पाय पार ॥103॥
cc-antya-5.103.translation: "A so-called poet who has no knowledge of transcendental mellows and the overlapping of transcendental mellows cannot cross the ocean of the conclusions of devotional service.

devanagari: ‘व्याकरण’ नाहि जाने, ना जाने ‘अलङ्कार’ ।
‘नाटकालङ्कार’ - ज्ञान नाहिक याहार ॥104॥
cc-antya-5.104-105.translation: "A poet who does not know the grammatical regulative principles, who is unfamiliar with metaphorical ornaments, especially those employed in drama, and who does not know how to present the pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa is condemned. Moreover, the pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu are especially difficult to understand.

devanagari: कृष्ण - लीला, गौर - लीला से करे वर्णन ।
गौर - पाद - पद्म याँर हय प्राण - धन ॥106॥
cc-antya-5.106.translation: "One who has accepted the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu as his life and soul can describe the pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa or the pastimes of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: ग्राम्य - कविर कवित्व शुनिते हय ‘दुःख’ ।
विदग्ध - आत्मीय - वाक्य शुनिते हय ‘सुख’ ॥107॥
cc-antya-5.107.translation: "Hearing the poetry of a person who has no transcendental knowledge and who writes about the relationships between man and woman simply causes unhappiness, whereas hearing the words of a devotee fully absorbed in ecstatic love causes great happiness.

lines: rūpa yaiche dui nāṭaka kariyāche ārambhe
devanagari: रूप यैछे दुइ नाटक करियाछे आरम्भे ।
शुनिते आनन्द बाड़े यार मुख - बन्धे ॥108॥
cc-antya-5.108.translation: "The standard for writing dramas has been set by Rūpa Gosvāmī. If a devotee hears the introductory portions of his two dramas, they enhance his transcendental pleasure."

devanagari: भगवानाचार्य कहे , - “शुन एक - बार ।
तुमि शुनिले भाल - मन्द जानिबे विचार” ॥109॥
cc-antya-5.109.translation: Despite the explanation of Svarūpa Dāmodara, Bhagavān Ācārya requested, "Please hear the drama once. If you hear it, you can consider whether it is good or bad."

devanagari: तबे प्रद्युम्न - मिश्र गेला रामानन्देर स्थाने ।
रायेर सेवक ताँरे वसाइल आसने ॥11॥
cc-antya-5.11.translation: Pradyumna Miśra, being thus advised by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, went to the home of Rāmānanda Rāya. There the servant of Rāmānanda Rāya gave him a proper place to sit down.

lines: dui tina dina ācārya āgraha karila
tāṅra āgrahe svarūpera śunite icchā ha-ila
devanagari: दुइ तिन दिन आचार्य आग्रह करिल ।
ताँर आग्रहे स्वरूपेर शुनिते इच्छा हइल ॥110॥
cc-antya-5.110.translation: For two or three days Bhagavān Ācārya continually asked Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī to hear the poetry. Because of his repeated requests, Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī wanted to hear the poetry written by the brāhmaṇa from Bengal.

lines: sabā lañā svarūpa gosāñi śunite vasilā
devanagari: सबा लञा स्वरूप गोसाञि शुनिते वसिला ।
तबे सेइ कवि नान्दी - श्लोक पड़िला ॥111॥
cc-antya-5.111.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī sat down with other devotees to hear the poetry, and then the poet began to read the introductory verse.

devanagari: विकच - कमल - नेत्रे श्री - जगन्नाथ - संज्ञे कनक - रुचिरिहात्मन्यात्मतां यः प्रपन्नः ।
प्रकृति - जड़मशेषं चेतयन्नाविरासीत् स दिशतु तव भव्यं कृष्ण - चैतन्य - देवः ॥112॥
cc-antya-5.112.translation: "The Supreme Personality of Godhead has assumed a golden complexion and has become the soul of the body named Lord Jagannātha, whose blooming lotus eyes are widely expanded. Thus He has appeared in Jagannātha Purī and brought dull matter to life. May that Lord, Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanyadeva, bestow upon you all good fortune."

devanagari: श्लोक शुनि’ सर्व - लोक ताहारे बाखाने ।
स्वरूप कहे , - “एइ श्लोक करह व्याख्याने” ॥113॥
cc-antya-5.113.translation: When everyone present heard the verse, they all commended the poet, but Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī requested him, "Kindly explain this verse."

devanagari: कवि कहे , - जगन्नाथ - सुन्दर - शरीर ।
चैतन्य - गोसाञि - शरीरी महा - धीर ॥114॥
cc-antya-5.114.translation: The poet said, "Lord Jagannātha is a most beautiful body, and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who is exceptionally grave, is the owner of that body.

devanagari: सहजे ज ड़ - जगतेर चेतन कराइते ।
नीलाचले महाप्रभु हैला आविर्भूते ॥115॥
cc-antya-5.115.translation: "Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu has appeared here in Nīlācala [Jagannātha Purī] to spiritualize the entire dull material world."

lines: duḥkha pāñā svarūpa kahe sakrodha vacana
devanagari: शुनिया सबार हैल आनन्दित - मन ।
दुःख पाञा स्वरूप कहे सक्रोध वचन ॥116॥
cc-antya-5.116.translation: Hearing this, everyone present was greatly happy. But Svarūpa Dāmodara, who alone was very unhappy, began to speak in great anger.

lines: dui ta' īśvare tora nāhika viśvāsa
devanagari: आरे मूर्ख, आपनार कैलि सर्व - नाश! ।
दुइ त’ ईश्वरे तोर नाहिक विश्वास ॥117॥
cc-antya-5.117.translation: "You are a fool," he said. "You have brought ill fortune upon yourself, for you have no knowledge of the existence of the two Lords, Jagannāthadeva and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, nor have you faith in Them.

devanagari: पूर्णानन्द - चित्स्वरूप जगन्नाथ - राय ।
ताँरे कैलि जड़ - नश्वर - प्राकृत - काय!! ॥118॥
cc-antya-5.118.translation: "Lord Jagannātha is completely spiritual and full of transcendental bliss, but you have compared Him to a dull, destructible body composed of the inert, external energy of the Lord.

devanagari: पूर्ण - घडू - ऐश्वर्य चैतन्य - स्वयं भगवान् ।
ताँरे कैलि क्षुद्र जीव स्फुलिङ्ग समान!! ॥119॥
cc-antya-5.119.translation: "You have calculated Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who is the Supreme Personality of Godhead, full in six opulences, to be on the level of an ordinary living being. Instead of knowing Him as the supreme fire, you have accepted Him as a spark."

lines: darśana nā pāñā miśra sevake puchila
devanagari: दर्शन ना पाञा मिश्र सेवके पुछिल ।
रायेर वृत्तान्त सेवक कहिते लागिल ॥12॥
cc-antya-5.12.translation: Unable to see Rāmānanda Rāya immediately, Pradyumna Miśra inquired from the servant, who then gave a description of Śrī Rāmānanda Rāya.

devanagari: दुइ - ठाञि अपराधे पाइबि दुर्गति! ।
अतत्त्व - ज्ञ ‘तत्त्व’ वर्णे, तार एइ रीति! ॥120॥
cc-antya-5.120.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara continued, "Because you have committed an offense to Lord Jagannātha and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, you will attain a hellish destination. You do not know how to describe the Absolute Truth, but nevertheless you have tried to do so. Therefore you must be condemned.

devanagari: आर एक करियाछ परम ‘प्रमाद’! ।
देह - देहि - भेद ईश्वरे कैले ‘अपराध’! ॥121॥
cc-antya-5.121.translation: "You are in complete illusion, for you have distinguished between the body and soul of His Lordship [Lord Jagannātha or Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu]. That is a great offense.

devanagari: ईश्वरेर नाहि कभु देह - देहि - भेद ।
स्वरूप, देह, - चिदानन्द, नाहिक विभेद ॥122॥
cc-antya-5.122.translation: "At no time is there a distinction between the body and soul of the Supreme Personality of Godhead. His personal identity and His body are made of blissful spiritual energy. There is no distinction between them.

devanagari: “देह - देहि - विभागोऽयं
नेश्वरे विद्यते क्वचित्” ॥123॥
cc-antya-5.123.translation: "There is no distinction between the body and soul of the Supreme Personality of Godhead at any time.'

lines: nātaḥ paraṁ parama yad bhavataḥ svarūpam
devanagari: नातः परं परम यद्भवतः स्वरूपम् आनन्द - मात्रमविकल्पमविद्ध - वर्चः ।
पश्यामि विश्व - सृजमेकमविश्वमात्मन् भूतेन्द्रियात्मक - मदस्त उपाश्रितोऽस्मि ॥124॥
cc-antya-5.124-125.translation: "O my Lord, I do not see a form superior to Your present form of eternal bliss and knowledge. In Your impersonal Brahman effulgence in the spiritual sky, there is no occasional change and no deterioration of internal potency. I surrender unto You because, whereas I am proud of my material body and senses, Your Lordship is the cause of the cosmic manifestation. Yet You are untouched by matter. \\ “ 'This present form, or any transcendental form expanded by the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Śrī Kṛṣṇa, is equally auspicious for all the universes. Since You have manifested this eternal personal form upon whom Your devotees meditate, I therefore offer my respectful obeisances unto You. Those who are destined to be dispatched to the path of hell neglect Your personal form because of speculating on material topics.'

devanagari: काहाँ ‘पूर्णानन्दैश्वर्य’ कृष्ण ‘मायेश्वर’! ।
cc-antya-5.126.translation: "Whereas Kṛṣṇa, the Absolute Truth, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, is full of transcendental bliss, possesses all six spiritual opulences in full, and is the master of the material energy, the small conditioned soul, who is always unhappy, is the servant of the material energy.

devanagari: ह्लादिन्या सम्विदाश्लिष्टः सच्चिदानन्द - ईश्वरः ।
स्वाविद्या संवृतो जीवः सड्क्लेश - निकराकरः ॥127॥
cc-antya-5.127.translation: "The Supreme Personality of Godhead, the Supreme Controller, is always full of transcendental bliss and is accompanied by the potencies known as hlādinī and samvit. The conditioned soul, however, is always covered by ignorance and embarassed by the threefold miseries of life. Thus he is a treasure house of all kinds of tribulations."

devanagari: शुनि’ सभा - सदेर चित्ते हैल चमत्कार ।
“सत्य कहे गोसाञि, दुँहार करियाछे तिरस्कार” ॥128॥
cc-antya-5.128.translation: Hearing this explanation, all the members of the assembly were struck with wonder. "Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī has spoken the real truth," they admitted. "The brāhmaṇa from Bengal has committed an offense by wrongly describing Lord Jagannātha and Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu."

lines: śuniyā kavira haila lajjā, bhaya, vismaya
haṁsa-madhye baka yaiche kichu nāhi kaya
devanagari: शुनिया कविर हैल लज्जा, भय, विस्मय ।
हंस - मध्ये बक यैछे किछु नाहि कय ॥129॥
cc-antya-5.129.translation: When the Bengali poet heard this chastisement from Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, he was ashamed, fearful and astonished. Indeed, being like a duck in a society of white swans, he could not say anything.

devanagari: दुइ देव - कन्या हय परम - सुन्दरी ।
नृत्य - गीते सुनिपुणा, वयसे किशोरी ॥13॥
cc-antya-5.13.translation: "There are two dancing girls who are extremely beautiful. They are very youthful, and they are expert in dancing and singing.

devanagari: तार दुःख देखि, स्वरूप सदय - हृदय ।
उपदेश कैला तारे यैछे ‘हित’ हय ॥130॥
cc-antya-5.130.translation: Seeing the poet's unhappiness, Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, who was naturally very kindhearted, advised him so that he could derive some benefit.

devanagari: याह, भागवत पड़ वैष्णवेर स्थाने ।
एकान्त आश्रय कर चैतन्य - चरणे ॥131॥
cc-antya-5.131.translation: "If you want to understand Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam," he said, "you must approach a self-realized Vaiṣṇava and hear from him. You can do this when you have completely taken shelter of the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu."

devanagari: चैतन्येर भक्त - गणेर नित्य कर ‘सङ्ग’ ।
तबेत जानिबा सिद्धान्त - समुद्र - तरङ्ग ॥132॥
cc-antya-5.132.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara continued, "Associate regularly with the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, for then only will you understand the waves of the ocean of devotional service.

devanagari: तबेत पाण्डित्य तोमार हइबे सफल ।
कृष्णेर स्वरूप - लीला वर्णिबा निर्मल ॥133॥
cc-antya-5.133.translation: "Only if you follow the principles of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His devotees will your learning be successful. Then you will be able to write about the transcendental pastimes of Kṛṣṇa without material contamination.

devanagari: एइ श्लोक करियाछ पाञा सन्तोष ।
तोमार हृदयेर अर्थे दुँहाय लागे ‘दोष’ ॥134॥
cc-antya-5.134.translation: "You have composed this introductory verse to your great satisfaction, but the meaning you have expressed is contaminated by offenses to both Lord Jagannātha and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: tumi yaiche-taiche kaha, nā jāniyā rīti
devanagari: तुमि यैछे - तैछे कह, ना जानिया रीति ।
सरस्वती सेइ - शब्दे करियाछे स्तुति ॥135॥
cc-antya-5.135.translation: "You have written something irregular, not knowing the regulative principles, but the goddess of learning, Sarasvatī, has used your words to offer her prayers to the Supreme Lord.

lines: yaiche indra, daityādi kare kṛṣṇera bhartsana
devanagari: यैछे इन्द्र, दैत्यादि करे कृष्णेर भर्सन ।
सेइ - शब्दे सरस्वती करेन स्तवन ॥136॥
cc-antya-5.136.translation: "Sometimes demons, and even Lord Indra, the King of heaven, chastised Kṛṣṇa, but mother Sarasvatī, taking advantage of their words, offered prayers to the Lord.

devanagari: वाचालं बालिशं स्तब्धं अज्ञं पण्डित - मानिनम् ।
कृष्णं मर्त्यमुपाश्रित्य गोपा में चक्रुरप्रियम् ॥137॥
cc-antya-5.137.translation: "[Lord Indra said:] 'This Kṛṣṇa, who is an ordinary human being, is talkative, childish, impudent and ignorant, although He thinks Himself very learned. The cowherd men in Vṛndāvana have offended me by accepting Him. This has not been greatly appreciated by me.'

devanagari: ऐश्वर्य - मदे मत्त इन्द्र , - येन मातोयाल ।
बुद्धि - नाश हैल, केवल नाहिक साम्भाल ॥138॥
cc-antya-5.138.translation: "Indra, the King of heaven, being too proud of his heavenly opulences, became like a madman. Thus bereft of his intelligence, he could not restrain himself from speaking nonsensically about Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: इन्द्र बले , - “मुञि कृष्णेर करियाछि निन्दन” ।
तार - इ मुखे सरस्वती करेन स्तवन ॥139॥
cc-antya-5.139.translation: "Thus Indra thought, 'I have properly chastised Kṛṣṇa and defamed Him.' But Sarasvatī, the goddess of learning, took this opportunity to offer prayers to Kṛṣṇa.

lines: sei duṅhe lañā rāya nibhṛta udyāne
devanagari: सेइ दुँहे लञा राय निभृत उद्याने ।
निज - नाटक - गीतेर शिखाय नर्तने ॥14॥
cc-antya-5.14.translation: "Śrīla Rāmānanda Rāya has taken these two girls to a solitary place in his garden, where he is teaching and directing them to dance according to the songs he has composed for his drama.

devanagari: ‘वाचाल’ कहिये ‘वेद - प्रवर्तक’ धन्य ।
‘बालिश’ - तथापि ‘शिशु - प्राय’ गर्व - शून्य ॥140॥
cc-antya-5.140.translation: "The word 'vācāla' is used to refer to a person who can speak according to Vedic authority, and the word 'bāliśa' means 'innocent.' Kṛṣṇa spoke the Vedic knowledge, yet He always presents Himself as a prideless, innocent boy.

devanagari: वन्द्याभावे ‘अनम्र’ - ‘स्तब्ध’ - शब्दे कय ।
याहा हैते अन्य ‘विज्ञ’ नाहि - से ‘अज्ञ’ हय ॥141॥
cc-antya-5.141.translation: "When there is no one else to receive obeisances, one may be called 'anamra,' or one who offers obeisances to no one. This is the meaning of the word 'stabdha.' And because no one is found to be more learned than Kṛṣṇa, He may be called 'ajña,' indicating that nothing is unknown to Him.

devanagari: पण्डितेर मान्य - पात्र - हय ‘पण्डित - मानी’ ।
तथापि भक्त - वात्सल्ये ‘मनुष्य’ अभिमानी ॥142॥
cc-antya-5.142.translation: "The word 'paṇḍita-mānī' can be used to indicate that Kṛṣṇa is honored even by learned scholars. Nevertheless, because of affection for His devotees, Kṛṣṇa appears like an ordinary human being and may therefore be called 'martya.'

devanagari: जरासन्ध कहे , - “कृष्ण - पुरुष - अधम” ।
तोर सङ्गे ना युझिमु, “याहि बन्धु - हन्” ॥143॥
cc-antya-5.143.translation: "The demon Jarāsandha chastised Kṛṣṇa, saying, 'You are the lowest of human beings. I shall not fight with You, for You killed Your own relatives.'

devanagari: याहा हैते अन्य पुरुष - सकल - ‘अधम’ ।
सेइ हय ‘पुरुषाधम’ - सरस्वतीर मन ॥144॥
cc-antya-5.144.translation: "Mother Sarasvatī takes 'puruṣādhama' to mean 'puruṣottama,' He to whom all men are subordinate.

devanagari: ‘बान्धे सबारे’ - ताते अविद्या ‘बन्धु’ हय ।
‘अविद्या - नाशक’ - ‘बन्धु - हन्’ - शब्दे कय ॥145॥
cc-antya-5.145.translation: "Nescience, or māyā, may be called 'bandhu' because she entangles everyone in the material world. Therefore by using the word 'bandhu-han,' mother Sarasvatī says that Lord Kṛṣṇa is the vanquisher of māyā.

devanagari: एइ - मत शिशुपाल करिल निन्दन ।
सेइ - वाक्ये सरस्वती करेन स्तवन ॥146॥
cc-antya-5.146.translation: "Śiśupāla also blasphemed Kṛṣṇa in this way, but the goddess of learning, Sarasvatī, offered her prayers to Kṛṣṇa even by his words.

lines: taiche ei śloke tomāra arthe 'nindā' āise
devanagari: तैछे एइ श्लोके तोमार अर्थे ‘निन्दा’ आइसे ।
सरस्वतीर अर्थ शुन, याते ‘स्तुति’ भासे ॥147॥
cc-antya-5.147.translation: "In that way, although your verse is blasphemous according to your meaning, mother Sarasvatī has taken advantage of it to offer prayers to the Lord.

devanagari: जगन्नाथ हन कृष्णेर ‘आत्म - स्वरूप’ ।
किन्तु इहाँ दारु - ब्रह्म - स्थावर - स्वरूप ॥148॥
cc-antya-5.148.translation: "There is no difference between Lord Jagannātha and Kṛṣṇa, but here Lord Jagannātha is fixed as the Absolute Person appearing in wood. Therefore He does not move.

devanagari: ताहा - सह आत्मता एक - रूप ह ञा ।
कृष्ण एक - तत्त्व - रूप - दुई रूप हञा ॥149॥
cc-antya-5.149.translation: "Thus Lord Jagannātha and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, although appearing as two, are one because They are both Kṛṣṇa, who is one alone.

lines: tumi ihāṅ vasi' raha, kṣaṇeke āsibena
tabe yei ājñā deha, sei karibena"
devanagari: तुमि इहाँ वसि’ रह, क्षणेके आसिबेन ।
तबे येइ आज्ञा देह, सेइ करिबे न ॥15॥
cc-antya-5.15.translation: "Please sit here and wait for a few moments. As soon as he comes, he will execute whatever order you give him."

lines: tāhāra milana kari' ekatā yaiche prāpti
devanagari: संसार - तारण - हेतु येइ इच्छा - शक्ति ।
ताहार मिलन क रि’ एकता यैछे प्राप्ति ॥150॥
cc-antya-5.150.translation: "The supreme desire to deliver the entire world meets in both of Them, and for that reason also They are one and the same.

devanagari: सकल संसारी लोकेर करिते उद्धार ।
गौर - जङ्गम - रूपे कैला अवतार ॥151॥
cc-antya-5.151.translation: "To deliver all the materially contaminated people of the world, that same Kṛṣṇa has descended, moving as Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: जगन्नाथेर दर्शने खण्डाय संसार ।
सब - देशेर सब - लोक नारे आसिबार ॥152॥
cc-antya-5.152.translation: "By visiting Lord Jagannātha one is freed from material existence, but not all men of all countries can come or be admitted here in Jagannātha Purī.

devanagari: श्री - कृष्ण - चैतन्य - प्रभु देशे देशे याञा ।
सब - लोके निस्तारिला जङ्गम - ब्रह्म ह ञा ॥153॥
cc-antya-5.153.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, however, moves from one country to another, personally or by His representative. Thus He, as the moving Brahman, delivers all the people of the world.

lines: eho bhāgya tomāra aiche karile varṇana
devanagari: सरस्वतीर अर्थ एइ कहि लुँ विवरण ।
एहो भाग्य तोमार ऐछे करिले वर्णन ॥154॥
cc-antya-5.154.translation: "Thus I have explained the meaning intended by mother Sarasvatī, the goddess of learning. It is your great fortune that you have described Lord Jagannātha and Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu in that way.

lines: kṛṣṇe gāli dite kare nāma uccāraṇa
devanagari: “कृष्णे गालि दिते करे नाम उच्चारण ।
सेइ नाम हय तार ‘मुक्तिर’ कारण” ॥155॥
cc-antya-5.155.translation: "Sometimes it so happens that one who wants to chastise Kṛṣṇa utters the holy name, and thus the holy name becomes the cause of his liberation."

lines: tabe sei kavi sabāra caraṇe paḍiyā
sabāra śaraṇa laila dante tṛṇa lañā
devanagari: तबे सेइ कवि सबार चरणे पड़िया ।
सबार शरण लैल दन्ते तृण लञा ॥156॥
cc-antya-5.156.translation: Upon hearing this proper explanation by Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, the Bengali poet fell down at the feet of all the devotees and took shelter of them with a straw in his mouth.

lines: tabe saba bhakta tāre aṅgīkāra kailā
devanagari: तबे सब भक्त तारे अङ्गीकार कैला ।
तार गुण कहि’ महाप्रभुरे मिलाइला ॥157॥
cc-antya-5.157.translation: Thereupon all the devotees accepted his association. Explaining his humble behavior, they introduced him to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: sei kavi sarva tyaji' rahilā nīlācale
devanagari: सेइ कवि सर्व त्यजि’ रहिला नीलाचले ।
गौर - भक्त - गणेर कृपा के कहिते पारे? ॥158॥
cc-antya-5.158.translation: By the mercy of the devotees of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, that poet from Bengal gave up all other activities and stayed with them at Jagannātha Purī. Who can explain the mercy of the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu?

devanagari: एइ त’ कहिलुँ प्रद्युम्न - मिश्र - विवरण ।
प्रभुर आज्ञाय कैल कृष्ण - कथार श्रवण ॥159॥
cc-antya-5.159.translation: I have thus described the narration concerning Pradyumna Miśra and how, following the order of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, he listened to discourses about Kṛṣṇa spoken by Rāmānanda Rāya.

devanagari: तबे प्रद्युम्न - मिश्र ताहाँ रहिल वसिया ।
रामानन्द निभृते सेइ दुइ - जन ल ञा ॥16॥
cc-antya-5.16.translation: While Pradyumna Miśra remained seated there, Rāmānanda Rāya took the two girls to a solitary place.

lines: āpane śrī-mukhe prabhu varṇe yāṅra sīmā
devanagari: तार मध्ये कहि लुँ रामानन्देर महिमा ।
आपने श्री - मुखे प्रभु वर्णे याँर सीमा ॥160॥
cc-antya-5.160.translation: Within the narration I have explained the glorious characteristics of Śrī Rāmānanda Rāya, through whom Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu personally described the limits of ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa.

lines: ajña hañā śraddhāya pāila prabhura caraṇa
devanagari: प्रस्तावे कहि लुँ कविर नाटक - विवरण ।
अज्ञ ह ञा श्रद्धाय पाइल प्रभुर चरण ॥161॥
cc-antya-5.161.translation: In the course of the narration, I have also told about the drama by the poet from Bengal. Although he was ignorant, because of his faith and humility he nevertheless obtained the shelter of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: श्री - कृष्ण - चैतन्य - लीला - अमृतेर सार ।
एक - लीला - प्रवाहे वहे शत - शत धार ॥162॥
cc-antya-5.162.translation: The pastimes of Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya Mahāprabhu are the essence of nectar. From the stream of one of His pastimes flow hundreds and thousands of branches.

lines: śraddhā kari' ei līlā yei paḍe, śune
devanagari: श्रद्धा क रि’ एइ लीला येइ पड़े, शुने ।
गौर - लीला, भक्ति - भक्त - रस - तत्त्व जाने ॥163॥
cc-antya-5.163.translation: Anyone who reads and hears these pastimes with faith and love can understand the truth about devotional service, devotees and the transcendental mellows of the pastimes of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: श्री - रूप - रघुनाथ - पदे यार आश ।
चैतन्य - चरितामृत कहे कृष्णदास ॥164॥
cc-antya-5.164.translation: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.

devanagari: स्व - हस्ते करेन तार अभ्यङ्ग - मर्दन ।
स्व - हस्ते कराने स्नान, गात्र सम्मार्जन ॥17॥
cc-antya-5.17.translation: With his own hand, Śrī Rāmānanda Rāya massaged their bodies with oil and bathed them with water. Indeed, Rāmānanda Rāya cleansed their entire bodies with his own hand.

devanagari: स्व - हस्ते परान वस्त्र, सर्वाङ्ग मण्डन ।
तबु निर्विकार राय - रामानन्देर मन ॥18॥
cc-antya-5.18.translation: Although he dressed the two young girls and decorated their bodies with his own hand, he remained unchanged. Such is the mind of Śrīla Rāmānanda Rāya.

devanagari: काष्ठ - पाषाण - स्पर्शे हय यैछे भाव ।
तरुणी - स्पर्शे रामानन्देर तैछे ‘स्वभाव’ ॥19॥
cc-antya-5.19.translation: While touching the young girls, he was like a person touching wood or stone, for his body and mind were unaffected.

devanagari: जय जय शची - सुत श्री - कृष्ण - चैतन्य ।
जय जय कृपा - मय नित्यानन्द धन्य ॥2॥
cc-antya-5.2.translation: All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the son of mother Śacī! All glories to Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu! Indeed, He is the most glorious and merciful.

devanagari: सेव्य - बुद्धि आरोपिया करेन सेवन ।
स्वाभाविक दासी - भाव करेन आरोपण ॥20॥
cc-antya-5.20.translation: Śrīla Rāmānanda Rāya used to act in that way because he thought of himself in his original position as a maidservant of the gopīs. Thus although externally he appeared to be a man, internally, in his original spiritual position, he considered himself a maidservant and considered the two girls gopīs.

devanagari: महाप्रभुर भक्त - गणेर दुर्गम महिमा ।
ताहे रामानन्देर भाव - भक्ति - प्रेम - सीमा ॥21॥
cc-antya-5.21.translation: The greatness of the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is exceedingly difficult to understand. Śrī Rāmānanda Rāya is unique among them all, for he showed how one can extend his ecstatic love to the extreme limit.

devanagari: तबे सेइ दुइ - जने नृत्य शिखाइला ।
गीतेर गूढ़ अर्थ अभिनय कराइला ॥22॥
cc-antya-5.22.translation: Rāmānanda Rāya directed the two girls how to dance and express the deep meaning of his songs through dramatic performances.

devanagari: सञ्चारी, सात्त्वि क, स्थायि - भावेर लक्षण ।
मुखे नेत्रे अभिनय करे प्रकटन ॥23॥
cc-antya-5.23.translation: He taught them how to express the symptoms of continuous, natural and transitional ecstasies with the movements of their faces, their eyes and the other parts of their bodies.

devanagari: भाव - प्रकटन - लास्य राय ये शिखाय ।
जगन्नाथेर आगे दुँहे प्रकट देखाय ॥24॥
cc-antya-5.24.translation: Through the feminine poses and dances they were taught by Rāmānanda Rāya, the two girls precisely exhibited all these expressions of ecstasy before Lord Jagannātha.

devanagari: तबे सेइ दुइ - जने प्रसाद खाओयाइला ।
निभृते दुँहारे निज - घरे पाठाइला ॥25॥
cc-antya-5.25.translation: Then Rāmānanda Rāya fed the two girls sumptuous prasāda and sent them to their homes unexposed.

lines: kon jāne kṣudra jīva kāṅhā tāṅra mana?
devanagari: प्रति - दिन राय ऐछे कराय साधन ।
को जाने क्षुद्र जीव काँहा ताँर मन? ॥26॥
cc-antya-5.26.translation: Every day he trained the two deva-dāsīs how to dance. Who among the small living entities, their minds always absorbed in material sense gratification, could understand the mentality of Śrī Rāmānanda Rāya?

devanagari: मिश्रेर आगमन राये सेवक कहिला ।
शीघ्र रामानन्द तबे सभाते आइला ॥27॥
cc-antya-5.27.translation: When the servant informed Rāmānanda Rāya of Pradyumna Miśra's arrival, Rāmānanda Rāya immediately went to the assembly room.

devanagari: मिश्रेरे नमस्कार करे सम्मान करिया ।
निवेदन करे किछु विनीत हञा ॥28॥
cc-antya-5.28.translation: He offered his obeisances to Pradyumna Miśra with all respect and then, with great humility, spoke as follows.

devanagari: बहु - क्षण आइला, मोरे केह ना कहिल ।
तोमार चरणे मोर अपराध हइल ॥29॥
cc-antya-5.29.translation: "Sir, you came here long ago, but no one informed me. Therefore I have certainly become an offender at your lotus feet.

devanagari: जयाद्वैत कृपा - सिन्धु जय भक्त - गण ।
जय स्वरूप, गदाधर, रूप, सनातन ॥3॥
cc-antya-5.3.translation: I offer my respectful obeisances unto Advaita Prabhu, the ocean of mercy, and to all the devotees, such as Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, Gadādhara Paṇḍita, Śrī Rūpa Gosvāmī and Śrī Sanātana Gosvāmī.

lines: tomāra āgamane mora pavitra haila ghara
ājñā kara, kyā karoṅ tomāra kiṅkara"
devanagari: तोमार आगमने मोर पवित्र हैल घर ।
आज्ञा कर, क्या करें तोमार किङ्कर ॥30॥
cc-antya-5.30.translation: "My entire home has been purified by your arrival. Kindly order me. What can I do for you? I am your servant."

devanagari: मिश्र कहे , - “तोमा देखिते हैल आगमने ।
आपना पवित्र कैलुँ तोमार दरशने” ॥31॥
cc-antya-5.31.translation: Pradyumna Miśra replied, "I came simply to see you. Now I have purified myself by seeing Your Honor."

lines: atikāla dekhi' miśra kichu nā kahila
devanagari: अतिकाल देखि मिश्र किछु ना कहिल ।
विदाय हइया मिश्र निज - घर गेल ॥32॥
cc-antya-5.32.translation: Because Pradyumna Miśra saw that it was late, he did not say anything else to Rāmānanda Rāya. Instead, he took leave of him and returned to his own home.

devanagari: आर दिन मिश्र आइल प्रभु - विद्यमाने ।
प्रभु कहे, - ‘कृष्ण - कथा शुनिला राय - स्थाने’? ॥33॥
cc-antya-5.33.translation: The next day, when Pradyumna Miśra arrived in the presence of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the Lord inquired, "Have you heard talks about Kṛṣṇa from Śrī Rāmānanda Rāya?"

devanagari: तबे मिश्र रामानन्देर वृत्तान्त कहिला ।
शुनि’ महाप्रभु तबे कहिते लागिला ॥34॥
cc-antya-5.34.translation: Pradyumna Miśra thereupon described the activities of Śrī Rāmānanda Rāya. After hearing about these activities, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu began to speak.

lines: "āmi ta' sannyāsī, āpanāre virakta kari' māni
darśana rahu dūre, 'prakṛtira' nāma yadi śuni
devanagari: आमि त’ सन्यासी, आपनारे विरक्त क रि’ मानि ।
दर्शन रहु दूरे, ‘प्रकृतिर’ नाम यदि शुनि ॥35॥
cc-antya-5.35-36.translation: "I am a sannyāsī," He said, "and I certainly consider Myself renounced. But not to speak of seeing a woman, if I even hear the name of a woman, I feel changes in My mind and body. Therefore who could remain unmoved by the sight of a woman? It is very difficult.

devanagari: रामानन्द रायेर कथा शुन, सर्व - जन ।
कहिबार कथा नहे, याहा आश्चर्य - कथन ॥37॥
cc-antya-5.37.translation: "Everyone please hear these topics about Rāmānanda Rāya, although they are so wonderful and uncommon that they should not be spoken.

devanagari: एके देव - दासी, आर सुन्दरी तरुणी ।
तार सब अङ्ग - सेवा करेन आपनि ॥38॥
cc-antya-5.38.translation: "The two professional dancing girls are beautiful and youthful, yet Śrī Rāmānanda Rāya personally massages oil upon their bodies.

devanagari: स्नानादि कराय, पराय वास - विभूषण ।
गुह्य अङ्गेर हय ताहा दर्शन - स्पर्शन ॥39॥
cc-antya-5.39.translation: "He personally bathes and dresses them and decorates them with ornaments. In this way, he naturally sees and touches the private parts of their bodies.

devanagari: एक - दिन प्रद्युम्न - मिश्र प्रभुर चरणे ।
दण्डवत् करि’ किछु करे निवेदने ॥4॥
cc-antya-5.4.translation: One day Pradyumna Miśra came to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, offering his respects and inquiring from Him with great submission.

devanagari: तबु निर्विकार राय - रामानन्देर मन ।
नाना - भावोद्गार तारे कराय शिक्षण ॥40॥
cc-antya-5.40.translation: "Nevertheless, the mind of Śrī Rāmānanda Rāya never changes, although he teaches the girls how to physically express all the transformations of ecstasy.

devanagari: निर्विकार देह - मन - काष्ठ - पाषाण - सम! ।
आश्चर्य , - तरुणी - स्पर्शे निर्विकार मन ॥41॥
cc-antya-5.41.translation: "His mind is as steady as wood or stone. Indeed, it is wonderful that even when he touches such young girls, his mind never changes.

devanagari: एक रामानन्देर हय एइ अधिकार ।
ताते जानि अप्राकृत - देह ताँहार ॥42॥
cc-antya-5.42.translation: "The authority for such acts is the prerogative of Rāmānanda Rāya alone, for I can understand that his body is not material but has been completely transformed into a spiritual entity.

lines: tāṅhāra manera bhāva teṅha jāne mātra
tāhā jānibāre āra dvitīya nāhi pātra
devanagari: ताँहार मनेर भाव तेंह जाने मात्र ।
ताहा जानिबारे आर द्वितीय नाहि पात्र ॥43॥
cc-antya-5.43.translation: "He alone, and no one else, can understand the position of his mind.

devanagari: किन्तु शास्त्र - दृष्ट्ये एक करि अनुमान ।
श्री - भागवत - शास्त्र - ताहाते प्रमाण ॥44॥
cc-antya-5.44.translation: "But I can make a guess in terms of directions from the śāstra. Śrīmad Bhāgavatam, the Vedic scripture, gives the direct evidence in this matter.

lines: yei jana kahe, śune kariyā viśvāsa
devanagari: व्रज - वधू - सङ्गे कृष्णेर रासादि - विलास ।
येइ जन कहे, शुने करिया विश्वास ॥45॥
cc-antya-5.45-46.translation: "When one hears or describes with great faith the pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa, such as His rāsa dance with the gopīs, the disease of lusty desires in his heart and the agitation caused by the three modes of material nature are immediately nullified, and he becomes sober and silent.

devanagari: उज्ज्वल मधुर प्रेम - भक्ति सेइ पाय ।
आनन्दे कृष्ण - माधुर्ये विहरे सदाय ॥47॥
cc-antya-5.47.translation: "Tasting the transcendental, effulgent, sweetly ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa, such a person can enjoy life twenty-four hours a day in the transcendental bliss of the sweetness of Kṛṣṇa's pastimes.

devanagari: विक्रीड़ितं व्रज - वधूभिरिदं च विष्णोः श्रद्धान्वितोऽनुशृणुयादथ वर्णयेद् यः ।
भक्तिं परां भगवति प्रतिलभ्य कामं हृद् - रोगमाश्वपहिनोत्यचिरेण धीरः ॥48॥
cc-antya-5.48.translation: "A transcendentally sober person who, with faith and love continuously hears from a realized soul about the activities of Lord Kṛṣṇa in His rāsa dance with the gopīs, or one who describes such activities, can attain full transcendental devotional service at the lotus feet of the Supreme Personality of Godhead. Thus lusty material desires, which are the heart disease of all materialistic persons, are for him quickly and completely vanquished.'

lines: ye śune, ye paḍe, tāṅra phala etādṛśī
devanagari: ये शुने, ये पड़े, ताँर फल एतादृशी ।
सेइ भावाविष्ट सेइ सेवे अहर्निशि ॥49॥
cc-antya-5.49-50.translation: "If a transcendentally situated person, following in the footsteps of Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī, hears and speaks about the rāsa-līlā dance of Kṛṣṇa and is always absorbed in thoughts of Kṛṣṇa while serving the Lord day and night within his mind, what shall I say about the result? It is so spiritually exalted that it cannot be expressed in words. Such a person is an eternally liberated associate of the Lord, and his body is completely spiritualized.
