Although he is visible to material eyes, he is spiritually situated, and all his activities are spiritual. By the will of Kṛṣṇa, such a devotee is understood to possess a spiritual body.

lines: kona bhāgye pāñāchoṅ tomāra durlabha caraṇa
devanagari: शुन, प्रभु, मुजि दीन गृहस्थ अधम! ।
कोन भाग्ये पा ञाछों तोमार दुर्लभ चरण ॥5॥
cc-antya-5.5.translation: "My Lord," he said, "kindly hear me. I am a cripple-minded householder, the most fallen of men, but somehow, by my good fortune, I have received the shelter of Your lotus feet, which are rarely to be seen.

devanagari: रागानुग - मार्गे जानि रायेर भजन ।
सिद्ध - देह - तुल्य, ताते ‘प्राकृत’ नहे मन ॥51॥
cc-antya-5.51.translation: "Śrīla Rāmānanda Rāya is situated on the path of spontaneous love of Godhead. Therefore he is in his spiritual body, and his mind is not materially affected.

lines: śunite icchā haya yadi, punaḥ yāha tathā
devanagari: आमिह रायेर स्थाने शुनि कृष्ण - कथा ।
शुनिते इच्छा हय यदि, पुनः याह तथा ॥52॥
cc-antya-5.52.translation: "I also hear topics about Kṛṣṇa from Rāmānanda Rāya. If you want to hear such topics, go to him again.

devanagari: मोर नाम लइह , - “तेंहो पाठाइला मोरे ।
तोमार स्थाने कृष्ण - कथा शुनिबार तरे” ॥53॥
cc-antya-5.53.translation: "You can take My name before him, saying, 'He has sent me to hear about Lord Kṛṣṇa from you.'

lines: śīghra yāha, yāvat teṅho āchena sabhāte"
devanagari: शीघ्र याह, यावत्तेहो आछेन सभाते ।
एत शुनि’ प्रद्युम्न - मिश्र चलिला तुरिते ॥54॥
cc-antya-5.54.translation: "Go hastily while he is in the assembly room." Hearing this, Pradyumna Miśra immediately departed.

devanagari: राय - पाश गेल, राय प्रणति करिल ।
“आज्ञा कर, ये ला गि’ आगमन हैल” ॥55॥
cc-antya-5.55.translation: Pradyumna Miśra went to Rāmānanda Rāya, who offered him respectful obeisances and said, "Please order me. For what purpose have you come?"

devanagari: मिश्र कहे , - “महाप्रभु पाठाइला मोरे ।
तोमार स्थाने कृष्ण - कथा शुनिबार तरे” ॥56॥
cc-antya-5.56.translation: Pradyumna Miśra answered, "Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu has sent me to hear topics about Lord Kṛṣṇa from you."

devanagari: शुनि’ रामानन्द राय हैला प्रेमावेशे ।
कहिते लागिला किछु मनेर हरिषे ॥57॥
cc-antya-5.57.translation: Hearing this, Rāmānanda Rāya became absorbed in ecstatic love and began to speak with great transcendental pleasure.

lines: ihā va-i mahā-bhāgya āmi pāba kothā?"
devanagari: “प्रभुर आज्ञाय कृष्ण - कथा शुनिते आइला एथा ।
इहा वइ महा - भाग्य आमि पाब कोथा ?” ॥58॥
cc-antya-5.58.translation: "Following the instruction of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, you have come to hear about Kṛṣṇa. This is my great fortune. How else would I get such an opportunity?"

lines: eta kahi tāre lañā nibhṛte vasilā
devanagari: एत कहि तारे लञा निभृते वसिला ।
‘कि कथा शुनिते चाह?’ मिश्रेरे पुछिला ॥59॥
cc-antya-5.59.translation: Saying this, Śrī Rāmānanda Rāya took Pradyumna Miśra to a secluded place and inquired from him, "What kind of kṛṣṇa-kathā do you want to hear from me?"

devanagari: कृष्ण - कथा शुनिबारे मोर इच्छा हय ।
कृष्ण - कथा कह मोरे ह ञा सदय ॥6॥
cc-antya-5.6.translation: "I wish to hear topics concerning Lord Kṛṣṇa constantly. Be merciful unto me and kindly tell me something about Kṛṣṇa."

lines: sei kathā krame tumi kahibā āmāre
devanagari: तेंहो कहे, - “ये कहिला विद्यानगरे ।
सेइ कथा क्रमे तुमि कहिबा आमारे” ॥60॥
cc-antya-5.60.translation: Pradyumna Miśra replied, "Kindly tell me about the same topics you spoke about at Vidyānagara.

lines: āmi ta' bhikṣuka vipra, tumi—mora poṣṭā
devanagari: आनेर कि कथा, तुमि - प्रभुर उपदेष्टा! ।
आमि त’ भिक्षुक विप्र, तुमि - मोर पोष्टा ॥61॥
cc-antya-5.61.translation: "You are an instructor even for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, not to speak of others. I am but a beggar brāhmaṇa, and you are my maintainer.

lines: bhāla, manda—kichu āmi puchite nā jāni
devanagari: भाल, मन्द - “किछु आमि पुछिते ना जानि ।
‘दीन’ देखि’ कृपा करि’ कहिबा आपनि” ॥62॥
cc-antya-5.62.translation: "I do not know how to inquire, for I do not know what is good and what is bad. Seeing me to be poor in knowledge, kindly speak whatever is good for me by your own good will."

devanagari: तबे रामानन्द क्रमे कहिते लागिला ।
कृष्ण - कथा - रसामृत - सिन्धु उथलिला ॥63॥
cc-antya-5.63.translation: Thereupon Rāmānanda Rāya gradually began speaking on topics of Kṛṣṇa. Thus the ocean of the transcendental mellow of those topics became agitated.

lines: āpane praśna kari' pāche karena siddhānta
devanagari: आपने प्र श्न करि’ पाछे करेन सिद्धान्त ।
तृतीय प्रहर हैल, नहे कथा - अन्त ॥64॥
cc-antya-5.64.translation: He began personally posing questions and then answering them with conclusive statements. When afternoon came, the topics still did not end.

lines: vaktā śrotā kahe śune duṅhe premāveśe
devanagari: वक्ता श्रोता कहे शुने दुँहे प्रेमावेशे ।
आत्म - स्मृति नाहि, काहाँ जानिब दिन - शेषे ॥65॥
cc-antya-5.65.translation: The speaker and listener spoke and heard in ecstatic love. Thus they forgot their bodily consciousness. How, then, could they perceive the end of the day?

devanagari: सेवक कहिल , - ‘दिन हैल अवसा न’ ।
तबे राय कृष्ण - कथार करिला विश्राम ॥66॥
cc-antya-5.66.translation: The servant informed them, "The day has already ended." Then Rāmānanda Rāya ended his discourses about Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: बहु - सम्मान क रि’ मिश्रे विदाय दिला ।
‘कृतार्थ हइलाङ’ बलि’ मिश्र नाचिते लागिला ॥67॥
cc-antya-5.67.translation: Rāmānanda Rāya paid great respect to Pradyumna Miśra and bade him farewell. Pradyumna Miśra said, "I have become very satisfied." He then began to dance.

lines: ghare giyā miśra kaila snāna, bhojana
devanagari: घरे गिया मिश्र कैल स्नान, भोजन ।
सन्ध्या - काले देखिते आइल प्रभुर चरण ॥68॥
cc-antya-5.68.translation: After returning home, Pradyumna Miśra bathed and ate his meal. In the evening he came to see the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: प्रभुर चरण वन्दे उल्लसित - मने ।
प्रभु कहे, - ‘कृष्ण - कथा हइल श्रवणे’? ॥69॥
cc-antya-5.69.translation: In great happiness he worshiped the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. The Lord inquired, "Have you heard topics about Kṛṣṇa?"

lines: sabe rāmānanda jāne, tāṅra mukhe śuni
devanagari: प्रभु कहेन, - “कृष्ण - कथा आमि नाहि जानि ।
सबे रामानन्द जाने, ताँर मुखे शुनि” ॥7॥
cc-antya-5.7.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "I do not know about topics concerning Lord Kṛṣṇa. I think that only Rāmānanda Rāya knows, for I hear these topics from him.

devanagari: मिश्र कहे , - “प्रभु, मोरे कृतार्थ करिला ।
कृष्ण - कथामृतार्णवे मोरे डुबाइला” ॥70॥
cc-antya-5.70.translation: Pradyumna Miśra said, "My dear Lord, You have made me extremely obliged to You because You have drowned me in a nectarean ocean of talks about Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: रामानन्द राय - कथा कहिले ना हय ।
‘मनुष्य’ नहे राय, कृष्ण - भक्ति - रस - मय ॥71॥
cc-antya-5.71.translation: "I cannot properly describe the discourses of Rāmānanda Rāya, for he is not an ordinary human being. He is fully absorbed in the devotional service of the Lord.

lines: āra eka kathā rāya kahilā āmāre
devanagari: आर एक कथा राय कहिला आमारे ।
‘कृष्ण - कथा - वक्ता क रि’ ना जानिह मोरे ॥72॥
cc-antya-5.72.translation: "There is one other thing Rāmānanda Rāya said to me. 'Do not consider me the speaker in these talks about Kṛṣṇa.

lines: mora mukhe kathā kahena āpane gauracandra
devanagari: मोर मुखे कथा कहेन आपने गौरचन्द्र ।
यैछे कहाय, तैछे कहि , - येन वीणा - यन्त्र ॥73॥
cc-antya-5.73.translation: "Whatever I speak is personally spoken by Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Like a stringed instrument, I vibrate whatever He causes me to speak.

lines: mora mukhe kahāya kathā, kare paracāra
devanagari: मोर मुखे कहाय कथा, करे परचार ।
पृथिवीते के जानिबे ए - लीला ताँहार ? ॥74॥
cc-antya-5.74.translation: "In this way the Lord speaks through my mouth to preach the cult of Kṛṣṇa consciousness. Within the world, who will understand this pastime of the Lord?'

lines: brahmādi-devera e saba nā haya gocara
devanagari: ये - सब शुनिलँ, कृष्ण - रसेर सागर ।
ब्रह्मादि - देवेर ए सब ना हय गोचर ॥75॥
cc-antya-5.75.translation: "What I have heard from Rāmānanda Rāya is like a nectarean ocean of discourses about Kṛṣṇa. Even the demigods, beginning with Lord Brahmā, cannot understand all these topics.

lines: janme janme tomāra pāya vikāilāṅa āmi
devanagari: हेन ‘रस’ पान मोरे कराइला तुमि ।
जन्मे जन्मे तोमार पाय विकाइलाङ आमि ॥76॥
cc-antya-5.76.translation: "My dear Lord, You have made me drink this transcendental nectar of kṛṣṇa-kathā. Therefore I am sold to Your lotus feet, life after life."

devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - “रामानन्द विनयेर खनि” ।
आपनार कथा पर - मुण्डे देन आनि’ ॥77॥
cc-antya-5.77.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "Rāmānanda Rāya is a source of all humility. Therefore he has attributed his own words to another's intelligence.

devanagari: महानुभवेर एइ सहज ‘स्वभाव’ हय ।
आपनार गुण नाहि आपने कहय ॥78॥
cc-antya-5.78.translation: "This is a natural characteristic of those advanced in devotional service. They do not personally speak of their own good qualities."

devanagari: रामानन्द - रायेर एइ कहिलु गुण - लेश ।
प्रद्युम्न मिश्रेरे यैछे कैला उपदेश ॥79॥
cc-antya-5.79.translation: I have described but a fraction of the transcendental attributes of Rāmānanda Rāya, as revealed when he instructed Pradyumna Miśra.

lines: bhāgye tomāra kṛṣṇa-kathā śunite haya mana
devanagari: भाग्ये तोमार कृष्ण - कथा शुनिते हय मन ।
रामानन्द - पाश याइ’ करह श्रवण ॥8॥
cc-antya-5.8.translation: "It is your good fortune that you are inclined to hear topics regarding Kṛṣṇa. The best course for you would be to go to Rāmānanda Rāya and hear these topics from him.

devanagari: ‘गृहस्थ’ हञा नहे राय ष ड् - वर्गेर वशे ।
‘विषयी’ हञा सन्न्यासीरे उपदेशे ॥80॥
cc-antya-5.80.translation: Although Rāmānanda Rāya was a householder, he was not under the control of the six kinds of bodily change. Although apparently a pounds-and-shillings man, he advised even persons in the renounced order.

devanagari: एइ - सब गुण ताँर प्रकाश करिते ।
मिश्रेरे पाठाइला ताहाँ श्रवण करिते ॥81॥
cc-antya-5.81.translation: To demonstrate the transcendental attributes of Rāmānanda Rāya, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sent Pradyumna Miśra to hear discourses about Kṛṣṇa from him.

devanagari: भक्त - गुण प्रकाशिते प्रभु भाल जाने ।
नाना - भङ्गीते गुण प्रकाशि” निज - लाभ माने ॥82॥
cc-antya-5.82.translation: The Supreme Personality of Godhead, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, knows very well how to demonstrate the qualities of His devotees. Therefore, acting like an artistic painter, He does so in various ways and considers this His personal profit.

devanagari: आर एक ‘स्वभाव’ गौरेर शुन, भक्त - गण ।
ऐश्वर्य - स्वभाव गूढ़ करे प्रकटन ॥83॥
cc-antya-5.83.translation: There is yet another characteristic of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. O devotees, listen carefully to how He manifests His opulence and characteristics, although they are exceptionally deep.

devanagari: सन्यासी पण्डित - गणेर करिते गर्व नाश ।
नीच - शूद्र - द्वारा करेन धर्मेर प्रकाश ॥84॥
cc-antya-5.84.translation: To vanquish the false pride of so-called renunciants and learned scholars, He spreads real religious principles, even through a śūdra, or lowborn fourth-class man.

devanagari: ‘भक्ति’, ‘प्रेम’, ‘तत्त्व’ कहे राये क रि’ ‘वक्ता’ ।
आपनि प्रद्युम्न - मिश्र - सह हय ‘श्रोता’ ॥85॥
cc-antya-5.85.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu preached about devotional service, ecstatic love and the Absolute Truth by making Rāmānanda Rāya, a gṛhastha born in a low family, the speaker. Then Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu Himself, the exalted brāhmaṇa-sannyāsī, and Pradyumna Miśra, the purified brāhmaṇa, both became the hearers of Rāmānanda Rāya.

devanagari: हरिदा स - द्वारा नाम - माहात्म्य - प्रकाश ।
सनातन - द्वारा भक्ति - सिद्धान्त - विलास ॥86॥
cc-antya-5.86.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu exhibited the glories of the holy name of the Lord through Haridāsa Ṭhākura, who was born in a Mohammedan family. Similarly, He exhibited the essence of devotional service through Sanātana Gosvāmī, who had almost been converted into a Mohammedan.

lines: ke bujhite pāre gambhīra caitanyera khelā?
devanagari: श्री - रूप - द्वारा व्रजेर प्रेम - रस - लीला ।
के बुझिते पारे गम्भीर चैतन्येर खेला? ॥87॥
cc-antya-5.87.translation: The Lord also fully exhibited the ecstatic love and transcendental pastimes of Vṛndāvana through Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī. Considering all this, who can understand the deep plans of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu?

lines: trijagat bhāsāite pāre yāra eka bindu
devanagari: श्री - चैतन्य - लीला एइ - अमृतेर सिन्धु ।
त्रिजगत् भासाइते पारे यार एक बिन्दु ॥88॥
cc-antya-5.88.translation: The activities of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu are just like an ocean of nectar. Even a drop of this ocean can inundate all the three worlds.

devanagari: चैतन्य - चरितामृत नित्य कर पान ।
याहा हैते ‘प्रेमानन्द’, ‘भक्ति - तत्त्व - ज्ञान’ ॥89॥
cc-antya-5.89.translation: O devotees, relish daily the nectar of Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta and the pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, for by doing so one can merge in the transcendental bliss and full knowledge of devotional service.

devanagari: कृष्ण - कथाय रुचि तोमार - बड़ भाग्यवान् ।
यार कृष्ण - कथाय रुचि, सेइ भाग्यवान् ॥9॥
cc-antya-5.9.translation: "I see that you have acquired a taste for hearing talks regarding Kṛṣṇa. Therefore you are extremely fortunate. Not only you but anyone who has awakened such a taste is considered most fortunate.

devanagari: एइ - मत महाप्रभु भक्त - गण लञा ।
नीलाचले विहरये भक्ति प्रचारिया ॥90॥
cc-antya-5.90.translation: Thus Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, accompanied by His associates, His pure devotees, enjoyed transcendental bliss in Jagannātha Purī [Nīlācala] preaching the bhakti cult in many ways.

lines: nāṭaka kari' lañā āila prabhuke śunāite
devanagari: बङ्ग - देशी एक विप्र प्रभुर चरिते ।
नाटक क रि’ लञा आइल प्रभुके शुनाइते ॥91॥
cc-antya-5.91.translation: A brāhmaṇa from Bengal wrote a drama about the characteristics of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and came with his manuscript to induce the Lord to hear it.

lines: tāṅre mili' tāṅra ghare karila ālaya
devanagari: भगवानाचार्य - सने तार परिचय ।
ताँरे मिलि ताँर घरे करिल आलय ॥92॥
cc-antya-5.92.translation: The brāhmaṇa was acquainted with Bhagavān Ācārya, one of the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Therefore after meeting him at Jagannātha Purī, the brāhmaṇa made his residence at Bhagavān Ācārya' s home.

lines: tāṅra saṅge aneka vaiṣṇava nāṭaka śunila
devanagari: प्रथमे नाटक तेंहो ताँरे शुनाइल ।
ताँर सङ्गे अनेक वैष्णव नाटक शुनिल ॥93॥
cc-antya-5.93.translation: First the brāhmaṇa induced Bhagavān Ācārya to hear the drama, and then many other devotees joined Bhagavān Ācārya in listening to it.

devanagari: सबेइ प्रशंसे नाटक “परम उत्तम” ।
महाप्रभुरे शुनाइते सबार हैल मन ॥94॥
cc-antya-5.94.translation: All the Vaiṣṇavas praised the drama, saying, "Very good, very good." They also desired for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to hear the drama.

lines: gīta, śloka, grantha, kavitva—yei kari' āne
devanagari: गीत, श्लोक, ग्रन्थ, कवित्व - येइ करि’ आने ।
प्रथमे शुनाय सेइ स्वरूपेर स्थाने ॥95॥
cc-antya-5.95.translation: Customarily, anyone who composed a song, verse, literary composition or poem about Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu first had to bring it to Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī to be heard.

lines: svarūpa-ṭhāñi uttare yadi, lañā, tāṅra mana
devanagari: स्वरूप - ठाञि उत्तरे यदि, लञा, ताँर मन ।
तबे महाप्रभु - ठाञि कराय श्रवण ॥96॥
cc-antya-5.96.translation: If passed by Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, it could be presented for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to hear.

lines: sahite nā pāre prabhu, mane haya krodha
devanagari: ‘रसाभास’ हय यदि ‘सिद्धान्त - विरोध’ ।
सहिते ना पारे प्रभु, मने हय क्रोध ॥97॥
cc-antya-5.97.translation: If there were a hint that transcendental mellows overlapped in a manner contrary to the principles of the bhakti cult, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would not tolerate it and would become very angry.

lines: ataeva prabhu kichu āge nāhi śune
devanagari: अतएव प्रभु किछु आगे नाहि शुने ।
एइ मर्यादा प्रभु करियाछे नियमे ॥98॥
cc-antya-5.98.translation: Therefore Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would not hear anything before Svarūpa Dāmodara heard it first. The Lord made this etiquette a regulative principle.

lines: eka vipra prabhura nāṭaka kariyāche uttama
devanagari: स्वरूपेर ठाञि आचार्य कैला निवेदन ।
एक विप्र प्रभुर नाटक करियाछे उत्तम ॥99॥
cc-antya-5.99.translation: Bhagavān Ācārya submitted to Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, "A good brāhmaṇa has prepared a drama about Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu that appears exceptionally well composed.

devanagari: कृपा - गुणैर्यः कुगृहान्ध - कूपाद् उद्धृत्य भङ्ग्या रघुनाथ - दासम् ।
न्यस्य स्वरूपे विदधेऽन्तरङ्गं श्री - कृष्ण - चैतन्यममुं प्रपद्ये ॥1॥
cc-antya-6.1.translation: With the ropes of His causeless mercy, Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya Mahāprabhu employed a trick to deliver Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī from the blind well of contemptible family life. He made Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī one of His personal associates, placing him under the charge of Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī. I offer my obeisances unto Him.

devanagari: पूर्वे यैछे राधार ललिता सहाय - प्रधान ।
तैछे स्वरूप - गोसाञि राखे महाप्रभुर प्राण ॥10॥
cc-antya-6.10.translation: Previously, when Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī felt the pangs of separation from Kṛṣṇa, Her constant companion Lalitā kept Her alive by helping Her in many ways. Similarly, when Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu felt Rādhārāṇī's emotions, Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī helped Him maintain His life.

devanagari: एइ त कहि लुँ नित्यानन्देर विहार ।
‘चिड़ा - दधि - महोत्सव’ - नामे ख्याति यार ॥100॥
cc-antya-6.100.translation: Thus I have described the pastimes of Lord Nityānanda Prabhu in relation to the celebrated festival of chipped rice and yogurt.

lines: prabhu viśrāma kailā, yadi dina-śeṣa haila
devanagari: प्रभु विश्राम कैला, यदि दिन - शेष हैल ।
राघव - मन्दिरे तबे कीर्तन आरम्भिल ॥101॥
cc-antya-6.101.translation: Nityānanda Prabhu rested for the day, and when the day ended He went to the temple of Rāghava Paṇḍita and began congregational chanting of the holy name of the Lord.

lines: śeṣe nṛtya kare preme jagat bhāsāya
devanagari: भक्त सब नाचा नित्यानन्द - राय ।
शेषे नृत्य करे प्रेमे जगत् भासाय ॥102॥
cc-antya-6.102.translation: Lord Nityānanda Prabhu first influenced all the devotees to dance, and finally He Himself began dancing, thus inundating the entire world in ecstatic love.

lines: sabe nityānanda dekhe, nā dekhe anya-jana
devanagari: महाप्रभु ताँर नृत्य करेन दरशन ।
सबे नित्यानन्द देखे, ना देखे अन्य - जन ॥103॥
cc-antya-6.103.translation: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was observing the dancing of Lord Nityānanda Prabhu. Nityānanda Prabhu could see this, but the others could not.

devanagari: नित्यानन्देर नृत्य, - येन ताँहार नर्तने।
उपमा दिबार नाहि ए - तिन भुवने ॥104॥
cc-antya-6.104.translation: The dancing of Lord Nityānanda Prabhu, like the dancing of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, cannot be compared to anything within these three worlds.

devanagari: नृत्येर माधुरी केबा वर्णिबारे पारे ।
महाप्रभु आइसे येइ नृत्य देखिबारे ॥105॥
cc-antya-6.105.translation: No one can properly describe the sweetness of Lord Nityānanda's dancing. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu personally comes to see it.

lines: nṛtya kari' prabhu yabe viśrāma karilā
devanagari: नृत्य करि’ प्रभु यबे विश्राम करिला ।
भोजनेर ला गि’ पण्डित निवेदन कैला ॥106॥
cc-antya-6.106.translation: After the dancing and after Lord Nityānanda had rested, Rāghava Paṇḍita submitted his request that the Lord take supper.

devanagari: भोजने वसिला प्रभु निज - गण ल ञा ।
महाप्रभुर आसन डाहिने पातिया ॥107॥
cc-antya-6.107.translation: Lord Nityānanda Prabhu sat down for supper with His personal associates and made a sitting place on His right side for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: महाप्रभु आसि’ सेइ आसने वसिल ।
देखि’ राघवेर मने आनन्द बाड़िल ॥108॥
cc-antya-6.108.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu came there and sat down at His place. Seeing this, Rāghava Paṇḍita felt increasing happiness. Rāghava Paṇḍita felt increasing happiness.

devanagari: दुइ - भाइ - आगे प्रसाद आनिया धरिला ।
सकल वैष्णवे पिछे परिवेशन कैला ॥109॥
cc-antya-6.109.translation: Rāghava Paṇḍita brought the prasāda before the two brothers and thereafter distributed prasāda to all the other Vaiṣṇavas.

lines: ei dui janāra saubhāgya kahana nā yāya
devanagari: एइ दुइ जनार सौभाग्य कहन ना याय ।
प्रभुर ‘अन्तरङ्ग’ बलि’ याँरे लोके गाय ॥11॥
cc-antya-6.11.translation: To describe the fortunate position of Rāmānanda Rāya and Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī is extremely difficult. They were renowned as intimately confidential friends of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: नाना - प्रकार पिठा, पायस, दिव्य शाल्यन्न ।
अमृत निन्दये ऐछे विविध व्यञ्जन ॥110॥
cc-antya-6.110.translation: There were varieties of cakes, sweet rice and fine cooked rice that surpassed the taste of nectar. There were also varieties of vegetables.

lines: mahāprabhu yāhā khāite āise bāra bāra
devanagari: राघव - ठाकुरेर प्रसाद अमृतेर सार ।
महाप्रभु याहा खाइते आइसे बार बार ॥111॥
cc-antya-6.111.translation: The food prepared and offered to the Deity by Rāghava Paṇḍita was like the essence of nectar. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu came there again and again to eat such prasāda.

lines: pāka kari' rāghava yabe bhoga lāgāya
devanagari: पाक क रि’ राघव यबे भोग लागाय ।
महाप्रभुर लागि’ भोग पृथक्वाड़य ॥112॥
cc-antya-6.112.translation: When Rāghava Paṇḍita offered the food to the Deity after cooking, he would make a separate offering for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: madhye madhye prabhu tāṅre dena daraśana
devanagari: प्रति - दिन महाप्रभु करेन भोजन ।
मध्ये मध्ये प्रभु ताँरे देन दरशन ॥113॥
cc-antya-6.113.translation: Every day, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would eat at the house of Rāghava Paṇḍita. Sometimes He would give Rāghava Paṇḍita the opportunity to see Him.

lines: yatna kari' khāoyāya, nā rahe avaśeṣe
devanagari: दुइ भाइरे राघव आनि’ परिवेशे ।
यत्न करि’ खाओयाय, ना रहे अवशेषे ॥114॥
cc-antya-6.114.translation: Rāghava Paṇḍita would bring and distribute prasāda to the two brothers, feeding Them with great attention. They ate everything, and therefore there were no remnants left.

lines: kata upahāra āne, hena nāhi jāni
devanagari: कत उपहार आने, हेन नाहि जानि ।
राघवेर घरे रान्धे राधा - ठाकुराणी ॥115॥
cc-antya-6.115.translation: He brought so many presentations that no one could know them perfectly. Indeed, it was a fact that the supreme mother, Rādhārāṇī, personally cooked in the house of Rāghava Paṇḍita.

lines: amṛta ha-ite pāka tāṅra adhika madhura
devanagari: दुर्वासार ठाञि तेंहो पा ञाछेन वर ।
अमृत हइते पाक ताँर अधिक मधुर ॥116॥
cc-antya-6.116.translation: Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī received from Durvāsā Muni the benediction that whatever She cooked would be sweeter than nectar. That is the special feature of Her cooking.

lines: dui bhāi tāhā khāñā santoṣa apāra
devanagari: सुगन्धि सुन्दर प्रसाद - माधुर सार ।
दुइ भाइ ताहा खाञा सन्तोष अपार ॥117॥
cc-antya-6.117.translation: Aromatic and pleasing to see, the food was the essence of all sweetness. Thus the two brothers, Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu and Lord Nityānanda Prabhu, ate it with great satisfaction.

devanagari: भोजने वसिते रघुनाथे कहे सर्व - जन ।
पण्डित कहे , - ‘इँह पाछे करिबे भोज न’ ॥118॥
cc-antya-6.118.translation: All the devotees present requested Raghunātha dāsa to sit down and take prasāda, but Rāghava Paṇḍita told them, "He will take prasāda later."

devanagari: भक्त - गण आकण्ठ भरिया करिल भोजन ।
‘हरि’ ध्वनि क रि’ उठि’ कैला आचमन ॥119॥
cc-antya-6.119.translation: All the devotees took prasāda, filling themselves to the brim. Thereafter, chanting the holy name of Hari, they stood up and washed their hands and mouths.

devanagari: एइ - मत विहरे गौर लञा भक्त - गण ।
रघुनाथ - मिलन एबे शुन, भक्त - गण ॥12॥
cc-antya-6.12.translation: The Lord thus enjoyed His life with His devotees. O devotees of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, now hear how Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī met the Lord.

lines: bhojana kari' dui bhāi kailā ācamana
devanagari: भोजन क रि’ दुइ भाइ कैला आचमन ।
राघव आनि’ पराइला माल्य - चन्दन ॥120॥
cc-antya-6.120.translation: After eating, the two brothers washed Their hands and mouths. Then Rāghava Paṇḍita brought flower garlands and sandalwood pulp and decorated Them.

devanagari: बिड़ा खाओयाइला, कैला चरण वन्दन ।
भक्त - गणे दिला बिड़ा, माल्य - चन्दन ॥121॥
cc-antya-6.121.translation: Rāghava Paṇḍita offered Them betel nuts and worshiped Their lotus feet. He also distributed betel nuts, flower garlands and sandalwood pulp to the devotees.

lines: dui bhāiera avaśiṣṭa pātra dilā tāṅre
devanagari: राघवेर कृपा रघुनाथेर उपरे ।
दुइ भाइएर अवशिष्ट पात्र दिला ताँरे ॥122॥
cc-antya-6.122.translation: Rāghava Paṇḍita, being very merciful toward Raghunātha dāsa, offered him the dishes with the remnants of food left by the two brothers.

lines: tāṅra śeṣa pāile, tomāra khaṇḍila bandhana"
devanagari: कहिला , - “चैतन्य गोसाञि करियाछेन भोजन ।
ताँर शेष पाइले, तोमार खण्डिल बन्ध न” ॥123॥
cc-antya-6.123.translation: He said, "Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu has eaten this food. If you take His remnants, you will be released from the bondage of your family."

lines: kabhu gupta, kabhu vyakta, svatantra bhagavān
devanagari: भक्त - चित्ते भक्त - गृहे सदा अवस्थान ।
कभु गुप्त, कभु व्यक्त, स्वतन्त्र भगवान् ॥124॥
cc-antya-6.124.translation: The Supreme Personality of Godhead always resides either in the heart or in the home of a devotee. This fact is sometimes hidden and sometimes manifest, for the Supreme Personality of Godhead is fully independent.

lines: ihāte saṁśaya yāra, sei yāya nāśa
devanagari: सर्वत्र व्यापक प्रभुर सदा सर्वत्र वास ।
इहाते संशय यार, सेइ याय नाश ॥125॥
cc-antya-6.125.translation: The Supreme Personality of Godhead is all-pervasive, and therefore He resides everywhere. Anyone who doubts this will be annihilated.

devanagari: प्राते नित्यानन्द प्रभु गङ्गा - स्नान करिया ।
सेइ वृक्ष - मूले वसिला निज - गण लञा ॥126॥
cc-antya-6.126.translation: In the morning, after taking His bath in the Ganges, Nityānanda Prabhu sat down with His associates beneath the same tree under which He had previously sat.

devanagari: रघुनाथ आसि’ कैला चरण वन्दन ।
राघव - पण्डित - द्वारा कैला निवेदन ॥127॥
cc-antya-6.127.translation: Raghunātha dāsa went there and worshiped Lord Nityānanda's lotus feet. Through Rāghava Paṇḍita, he submitted his desire.

devanagari: “अधम, पामर मुइ हीन जीवाधम! ।
मोर इच्छा हय - पाङ चैतन्य - चरण” ॥128॥
cc-antya-6.128.translation: "I am the lowest of men, the most sinful, fallen and condemned. Nevertheless, I desire to attain the shelter of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: vāmana hañā yena cānda dharibāre cāya
aneka yatna kainu, tāte kabhu siddha naya
devanagari: वामन ह ञा येन चान्द धरिबारे चाय ।
अनेक यत्न कैनु, ताते कभु सिद्ध नय ॥129॥
cc-antya-6.129.translation: "Like a dwarf who wants to catch the moon, I have tried my best many times, but I have never been successful.

devanagari: पूर्वे शान्तिपुरे रघुनाथ प्रबे आइला ।
महाप्रभु कृपा करि’ ताँरे शिखाइला ॥13॥
cc-antya-6.13.translation: When Raghunātha dāsa, during his family life, went to meet Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu at Śāntipura, the Lord gave him worthy instructions by His causeless mercy.

devanagari: यत - बार पलाइ आमि गृहादि छाड़िया ।
पिता, माता - दुइ मोरे राखये बान्धिया ॥130॥
cc-antya-6.130.translation: "Every time I tried to go away and give up my home relationships, my father and mother unfortunately kept me bound.

lines: tomāra kṛpā vinā keha 'caitanya' nā pāya
tumi kṛpā kaile tāṅre adhameha pāya
devanagari: तोमार कृपा विना केह ‘चैतन्य’ ना पाय ।
तुमि कृपा कैले ताँरे अधमेह पाय ॥131॥
cc-antya-6.131.translation: "No one can attain the shelter of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu without Your mercy, but if You are merciful, even the lowest of men can attain shelter at His lotus feet.

lines: ayogya mui nivedana karite kari bhaya
devanagari: अयोग्य मुइ निवेदन करिते करि भय ।
मोरे ‘चैतन्य’ देह’ गोसाञि हञा सदय ॥132॥
cc-antya-6.132.translation: "Although I am unfit and greatly afraid to submit this plea, I nevertheless request You, sir, to be especially merciful toward me by granting me shelter at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: mora māthe pada dhari' karaha prasāda
devanagari: “मोर माथे पद ध रि’ करह प्रसाद ।
निर्विघ्ने चैतन्य पाङ - कर आशीर्वाद” ॥133॥
cc-antya-6.133.translation: "Placing Your feet on my head, give me the benediction that I may achieve the shelter of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu without difficulty. I pray for this benediction."

lines: śuni' hāsi' kahe prabhu saba bhakta-gaṇe
devanagari: शुनि’ हासि’ कहे प्रभु सब भक्त - गणे ।
“इहार विषय - सुख - इन्द्र - सुख - समे” ॥134॥
cc-antya-6.134.translation: After hearing this appeal by Raghunātha dāsa, Lord Nityānanda Prabhu smiled and told all the devotees, "Raghunātha dāsa's standard of material happiness is equal to that of Indra, the King of heaven.

devanagari: चैतन्य - कृपाते सेह नाहि भाय मने ।
सबे आशीर्वाद कर - पाउक चैतन्य - चरणे ॥135॥
cc-antya-6.135.translation: "Because of the mercy bestowed upon him by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Raghunātha dāsa, although situated in such material happiness, does not like it at all. Therefore let every one of you be merciful toward him and give him the benediction that he may very soon attain shelter at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: “कृष्ण - पाद - पद्म - गन्ध येइ जन पाय ।
ब्रह्मलोक - आदि - सुख ताँरे नाहि भाय” ॥136॥
cc-antya-6.136.translation: "One who experiences the fragrance of the lotus feet of Lord Kṛṣṇa does not even value the standard of happiness available in Brahmaloka, the topmost planet. And what to speak of heavenly happiness?

devanagari: यो दुस्त्यजान्दार - सुतान्सुहृद्राज्यं हृदि - स्पृशः ।
जहौ युवैव मल - वदुत्तम - श्लोक - लालसः ॥137॥
cc-antya-6.137.translation: "Lord Kṛṣṇa, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, is offered sublime, poetic prayers by those trying to attain His favor. Thus He is known as Uttamaśloka. Being very eager to gain the association of Lord Kṛṣṇa, King Bharata, although in the prime of youth, gave up his very attractive wife, affectionate children, most beloved friends and opulent kingdom, exactly as one gives up stool after excreting it.' "

lines: tāṅra māthe pada dhari' kahite lāgilā
devanagari: तबे रघुनाथे प्रभु निकटे बोलाइला ।
ताँर माथे पद धरि कहिते लागिला ॥138॥
cc-antya-6.138.translation: Then Lord Nityānanda Prabhu called Raghunātha dāsa near Him, placed His lotus feet upon Raghunātha dāsa's head and began to speak.

lines: tomāya kṛpā kari' gaura kailā āgamana
devanagari: “तुमि ग्रे कराइला एइ पुलिन - भोजन ।
तोमाय कृपा करि’ गौर कैला आगमन” ॥139॥
cc-antya-6.139.translation: "My dear Raghunātha dāsa," He said, "since you arranged the feast on the bank of the Ganges, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu came here just to show you His mercy.

devanagari: प्रभुर शिक्षाते तेंहो निज - घरे याय ।
मकर् ट - वैराग्य छा ड़ि’ हैला ‘विषयि - प्राय’ ॥14॥
cc-antya-6.14.translation: Instead of becoming a so-called renunciate, Raghunātha dāsa, following the instructions of the Lord, returned home and played exactly like a pounds-and-shillings man.

lines: nṛtya dekhi' rātrye kailā prasāda bhakṣaṇa
devanagari: कृपा करि’ कैला चिड़ा - दुग्ध भोजन ।
नृत्य देखि’ रात्र्ये कैला प्रसाद भक्षण ॥140॥
cc-antya-6.140.translation: "By His causeless mercy He ate the chipped rice and milk. Then, after seeing the dancing of the devotees at night, He took His supper.

devanagari: तोमा उद्धारिते गौर आइला आपने ।
छुटिल तोमार यत विघ्नादि - बन्धने ॥141॥
cc-antya-6.141.translation: "Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Gaurahari, came here personally to deliver you. Now rest assured that all the impediments meant for your bondage are gone.

devanagari: स्वरूपेर स्थाने तोमा करिबे समर्पणे ।
‘अन्तरङ्ग’ भृत्य बलि’ राखिबे चरणे ॥142॥
cc-antya-6.142.translation: "Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu will accept you and place you under the charge of His secretary, Svarūpa Dāmodara. You will thus become one of the most confidential internal servants and will attain the shelter of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: “निश्चिन्त ह ञा याह आपन - भवन ।
अचिरे निर्विघ्ने पाबे चैतन्य - चरण” ॥143॥
cc-antya-6.143.translation: "Being assured of all this, return to your own home. Very soon, without impediments, you will attain the shelter of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu."

devanagari: सब भक्त - द्वारे ताँरे आशीर्वाद कराइला ।
ताँ - सबार चरण रघुनाथ वन्दिला ॥144॥
cc-antya-6.144.translation: Lord Nityānanda had Raghunātha dāsa blessed by all the devotees, and Raghunātha dāsa offered his respects to their lotus feet.

devanagari: प्रभु - आज्ञा लञा वैष्णवेर आज्ञा लइला ।
राघव - सहिते निभृते युक्ति करिला ॥145॥
cc-antya-6.145.translation: After taking leave of Lord Nityānanda Prabhu and then all the other Vaiṣṇavas, Srī Raghunātha dāsa consulted secretly with Rāghava Paṇḍita.

lines: yukti kari' śata mudrā, soṇā tolā-sāte
devanagari: युक्ति करि’ शत मुद्रा, सोणा तोला - साते ।
निभृते दिला प्रभुर भाण्डारीर हाते ॥146॥
cc-antya-6.146.translation: After consulting with Rāghava Paṇḍita, he secretly delivered one hundred gold coins and about seven tolās of gold to the hand of Nityānanda Prabhu's treasurer.

devanagari: ताँरे निषेधिला , - “प्रभुरे एबे ना कहिबा ।
निज - घरे याबेन यबे तबे निवेदिबा” ॥147॥
cc-antya-6.147.translation: Raghunātha dāsa admonished the treasurer, "Do not speak about this to Lord Nityānanda Prabhu now, but when He returns home, kindly inform Him about this presentation."

lines: tabe rāghava-paṇḍita tāṅre ghare lañā gelā
devanagari: तबे राघव - पण्डित ताँरे घरे ल ञा गेला ।
ठाकुर दर्शन कराञा माला - चन्दन दिला ॥148॥
cc-antya-6.148.translation: Thereupon, Rāghava Paṇḍita took Raghunātha dāsa to his home. After inducing him to see the Deity, he gave Raghunātha dāsa a garland and sandalwood pulp.

devanagari: अनेक ‘प्रसाद’ दिला पथे खाइबारे ।
तबे पुनः रघुनाथ कहे पण्डितेरे ॥149॥
cc-antya-6.149.translation: He gave Raghunātha dāsa a large quantity of prasāda to eat on his way home. Then Raghunātha dāsa again spoke to Rāghava Paṇḍita.

devanagari: भितरे वैराग्य, बाहिरे करे सर्व - कर्म ।
देखिया त’ माता - पितार आनन्दित मन ॥15॥
cc-antya-6.15.translation: Raghunātha dāsa was inwardly completely renounced, even in family life, but he did not express his renunciation externally. Instead, he acted just like an ordinary businessman. Seeing this, his father and mother were satisfied.

lines: "prabhura saṅge yata mahānta, bhṛtya āśrita jana
devanagari: “प्रभुर सङ्गे यत महान्त, भृत्य, आश्रित जन ।
पूजिते चाहिये आमि सबार चरण” ॥150॥
cc-antya-6.150.translation: "I want to give money," he said, "just to worship the lotus feet of all the great devotees, servants and subservants of Lord Nityānanda Prabhu.

lines: biśa, pañca-daśa, bāra, daśa, pañca haya
mudrā deha' vicāri' yāra yata yogya haya
devanagari: बिश, पञ्च - दश, बार, दश, पञ्च हय ।
मुद्रा देह’ विचा रि’ यार यत योग्य हय ॥151॥
cc-antya-6.151.translation: "As you think fit, give twenty, fifteen, twelve, ten or five coins to each of them."

lines: yāṅra nāme yata rāghava ciṭhi lekhāilā
devanagari: सब लेखा करिया राघव - पाश दिला ।
याँर नामे यत राघव चिठि लेखाइला ॥152॥
cc-antya-6.152.translation: Raghunātha dāsa drew up an account of the amount to be given and submitted it to Rāghava Paṇḍita, who then made up a list showing how much money was to be paid to each and every devotee.

devanagari: एक - शत मुद्रा आर सोणा तोला - द्वय ।
पण्डितेर आगे दिल करिया विनय ॥153॥
cc-antya-6.153.translation: With great humility, Raghunātha dāsa placed one hundred gold coins and about two tolās of gold before Rāghava Paṇḍita for all the other devotees.

devanagari: ताँर पद - धूलि लञा स्वगृहे आइला ।
नित्यानन्द - कृपा पाञा कृतार्थ मानिला ॥154॥
cc-antya-6.154.translation: After taking dust from the feet of Rāghava Paṇḍita, Raghunātha dāsa returned to his home, feeling greatly obligated to Lord Nityānanda Prabhu because of having received His merciful benediction.

lines: sei haite abhyantare nā karena gamana
devanagari: सेइ हैते अभ्यन्तरे ना करेन गमन ।
बाहिरे दुर्गा - मण्डपे याञा करेन शयन ॥155॥
cc-antya-6.155.translation: From that day on, he did not go into the interior section of the house. Instead, he would sleep on the Durgā-maṇḍapa [the place where mother Durgā was worshiped].

devanagari: ताँहा जा गि’ रहे सब रक्षक - गण ।
पलाइते करेन नाना उपाय चिन्तन ॥156॥
cc-antya-6.156.translation: There, however, the watchmen alertly kept guard. Raghunātha dāsa was thinking of various means by which to escape their vigilance.

devanagari: हेन - काले गौड़ - देशेर सब भक्त - गण ।
प्रभुरे देखिते नीलाचले करिला गमन ॥157॥
cc-antya-6.157.translation: At that time, all the devotees of Bengal were going to Jagannātha Purī to see Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: tāṅ-sabāra saṅge raghunātha yāite nā pāre
prasiddha prakaṭa saṅga, tabahiṅ dharā paḍe
devanagari: ताँ - सबार सङ्गे रघुनाथ याइते ना पारे ।
प्रसिद्ध प्रकट सङ्ग, तबहिं धरा पड़े ॥158॥
cc-antya-6.158.translation: Raghunātha dāsa could not accompany them, for they were so famous that he would immediately have been caught.

devanagari: एइ - मत चिन्तिते दैवे एक - दिने ।
बाहिरे देवी - मण्डपे करियाछेन शयने ॥159॥
cc-antya-6.159-160.translation: Thus Raghunātha dāsa thought deeply about how to escape, and one night while he was sleeping on the Durgā-maṇḍapa, the priest Yadunandana Ācārya entered the house when only four daṇḍas remained until the end of the night.

devanagari: ‘मथुरा हैते प्रभु आइला’, - वार्ता यबे पाइला ।
प्रभु - पाश चलिबारे उद्योग करिला ॥16॥
cc-antya-6.16.translation: When he received a message that Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had returned from Mathurā City, Raghunātha dāsa endeavored to go to the lotus feet of the Lord.

devanagari: वासुदेव - दत्तेर तेंह हय ‘अनुगृहीत’ ।
रघुनाथेर ‘गुरु’ तेंहो हय ‘पुरोहित’ ॥161॥
cc-antya-6.161.translation: Yadunandana Ācārya was the priest and spiritual master of Raghunātha dāsa. Although born in a brāhmaṇa family, he had accepted the mercy of Vāsudeva Datta.

devanagari: अद्वैत - आचा र्येर तेंह ‘शिष्य अन्तरङ्ग’ ।
आचार्य - आज्ञाते माने - चैतन्य ‘प्राण - धन’ ॥162॥
cc-antya-6.162.translation: Yadunandana Ācārya had been officially initiated by Advaita Ācārya. Thus he considered Lord Caitanya his life and soul.

devanagari: अङ्गने आसिया तेंहो यबे दाण्डाइला ।
रघुनाथ आसि’ तबे दण्डवत् कैला ॥163॥
cc-antya-6.163.translation: When Yadunandana Ācārya entered the house of Raghunātha dāsa and stood in the courtyard, Raghunātha dāsa went there and fell down to offer his obeisances.

lines: tāṅra eka śiṣya tāṅra ṭhākurera sevā kare
devanagari: ताँर एक शिष्य ताँर ठाकुरेर सेवा करे ।
सेवा छाड़ियाछे, तारे साधिबार तरे ॥164॥
cc-antya-6.164.translation: One of Yadunandana Ācārya's disciples had been worshiping the Deity but had left that service. Yadunandana Ācārya wanted Raghunātha dāsa to induce the disciple to take up that service again.

lines: sevā yena kare, āra nāhika brāhmaṇa"
devanagari: रघुनाथे कहे, - “तारे करह साधन ।
सेवा येन करे, आर नाहिक ब्राह्मण” ॥165॥
cc-antya-6.165.translation: Yadunandana Ācārya requested Raghunātha dāsa, "Please induce the brāhmaṇa to resume the service, for there is no other brāhmaṇa to do it."

devanagari: एत क हि’ रघुनाथे लञा चलिला ।
रक्षक सब शेष - रात्रे निद्राय पड़िला ॥166॥
cc-antya-6.166.translation: After saying this, Yadunandana Ācārya took Raghunātha dāsa with him and went out. By that time all the watchmen were deeply asleep because it was the end of the night.

lines: kahite śunite duṅhe cale sei pathe
devanagari: आचा र्येर घर इहार पूर्व - दिशाते ।
कहिते शुनिते दुँहे चले सेइ पथे ॥167॥
cc-antya-6.167.translation: East of the house of Raghunātha dāsa was the house of Yadunandana Ācārya. Yadunandana Ācārya and Raghunātha dāsa talked together as they went toward that house.

lines: "āmi sei vipre sādhi' pāṭhāimu tomā sthāne
devanagari: अर्ध - पथे रघुनाथ कहे गुरुर चरणे ।
‘आमि सेइ विप्रे साधि’ पाठाइमु तोमा स्थाने ॥168॥
cc-antya-6.168.translation: Halfway along the path, Raghunātha dāsa submitted at the lotus feet of his spiritual master, "I shall go to the home of that brāhmaṇa, induce him to return, and send him to your home.

lines: tumi sukhe ghare yāha—more ājñā haya"
ei chale ājñā māgi' karilā niścaya
devanagari: तुमि सुखे घरे याह - मोरे आज्ञा हय ।
एइ छले आज्ञा मा गि’ करिला निश्चय ॥169॥
cc-antya-6.169.translation: "You may go home without anxiety. Following your order, I shall persuade the brāhmaṇa." On this plea, after asking permission, he decided to go away.

devanagari: हेन - काले मुलुकेर एक म्लेच्छ अधिकारी ।
सप्तग्राम - मुलुकेर से हय ‘चौधुरी’ ॥17॥
cc-antya-6.17.translation: At that time there was a Mohammedan official collecting the taxes of Saptagrāma.

devanagari: “सेवक रक्षक आर केह नाहि सङ्गे ।
पलाइते आमार भाल एइत प्रसङ्गे” ॥170॥
cc-antya-6.170.translation: Raghunātha dāsa thought, "This is the greatest opportunity to go away because this time there are no servants or watchmen with me."

devanagari: एत चिन्ति’ पूर्व - मुखे करिला गमन ।
उलटिया चाहे पाछे , - नाहि कोन जन ॥171॥
cc-antya-6.171.translation: Thinking in this way, he quickly proceeded toward the east. Sometimes he turned around and looked back, but no one was following him.

devanagari: श्री - चैतन्य - नित्यानन्द - चरण चिन्तिया ।
पथ छाड़ि’ उपपथे यायेन धा ञा ॥172॥
cc-antya-6.172.translation: Thinking of the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and Lord Nityānanda Prabhu, he left the general path and proceeded with great haste on the one not generally used.

lines: grāme-grāmera patha chāḍi' yāya vane vane
devanagari: ग्रामे - ग्रामेर पथ छाड़ि’ याय वने वने ।
काय - मनो - वाक्ये चिन्ते चैतन्य - चरणे ॥173॥
cc-antya-6.173.translation: Giving up the general path from village to village, he passed through the jungles, thinking with heart and soul about the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: पञ्च - दश - क्रोश - पथ च लि’ गेला एक - दिने ।
सन्ध्या - काले रहि ला एक गोपेर बाथाने ॥174॥
cc-antya-6.174.translation: He walked about thirty miles in one day, and in the evening he took rest in the cowshed of a milkman.

lines: upavāsī dekhi' gopa dugdha āni' dilā
sei dugdha pāna kari' paḍiyā rahilā
devanagari: उपवासी देखि’ गोप दुग्ध आनि’ दिला ।
सेइ दुग्ध पान करि’ पड़िया रहिला ॥175॥
cc-antya-6.175.translation: When the milkman saw that Raghunātha dāsa was fasting, he gave him some milk. Raghunātha dāsa drank the milk and lay down to rest there for the night.

lines: ethā tāṅra sevaka rakṣaka tāṅre nā dekhiyā
devanagari: एथा ताँर सेवक रक्षक ताँरे ना देखियो ।
ताँर गुरु - पाशे वार्ता पुछिलेन गिया ॥176॥
cc-antya-6.176.translation: At the house of Raghunātha dāsa, the servant and watchman, not seeing him there, immediately went to inquire about him from his spiritual master, Yadunandana Ācārya.

devanagari: तेंह कहे, ‘आज्ञा मा गि’ गेला निज - घर’ ।
‘पलाइल रघुनाथ’ - उठिल कोलाहल ॥177॥
cc-antya-6.177.translation: Yadunandana Ācārya said, "He has already asked my permission and returned home." Thus there arose a tumultuous sound, as everyone cried, "Now Raghunātha has gone away!"

devanagari: ताँर पिता कहे , - “गौड़ेर सब भक्त - गण ।
प्रभु - स्थाने नीलाचले करिला गमन” ॥178॥
cc-antya-6.178.translation: Raghunātha dāsa's father said, "Now all the devotees from Bengal have gone to Jagannātha Purī to see Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: daśa jana yāha, tāre ānaha dhariyā"
devanagari: सेइ - सङ्गे रघुनाथ गेल पलाञा ।
दश जन याह, तारे आनह धरिया” ॥179॥
cc-antya-6.179.translation: "Raghunātha dāsa has fled with them. Ten men should immediately go catch him and bring him back."

lines: tāra adhikāra gela, mare se dekhiyā
devanagari: हिरण्य - दास मुलुक निलमक्ररि करिया ।
तार अधिकार गेल, मरे से देखिया ॥18॥
cc-antya-6.18.translation: When Hiraṇya dāsa, Raghunātha dāsa's uncle, made an agreement with the government to collect taxes, the Mohammedan caudhurī, or tax collector, having lost his position, became extremely envious of him.

devanagari: शिवानन्दे पत्री दिल विनय करिया ।
‘आमार पुत्रेरे तुमि दिबा बाहुड़िया’ ॥180॥
cc-antya-6.180.translation: Raghunātha dāsa's father wrote a letter to Śivānanda Sena, asking him with great humility, "Please return my son."

lines: jhāṅkarā paryanta gela sei daśa jane
devanagari: झाङ्करा पर्यन्त गेल सेइ दश जने ।
झाङ्कराते पाइल गिया वैष्णवेर गणे ॥181॥
cc-antya-6.181.translation: In Jhāṅkarā, the ten men caught up with the group of Vaiṣṇavas going to Nīlācala.

devanagari: पत्री दिया शिवानन्दे वार्ता पुछिल ।
शिवानन्द कहे , - ‘तेंह एथा ना आइल’ ॥182॥
cc-antya-6.182.translation: After delivering the letter, the men inquired from Śivānanda Sena about Raghunātha dāsa, but Śivānanda Sena replied, "He did not come here."

lines: bāhuḍiyā sei daśa jana āila ghara
devanagari: बाहुड़िया सेइ दश जन आइल घर ।
ताँर माता - पिता हइल चिन्तित अन्तर ॥183॥
cc-antya-6.183.translation: The ten men returned home, and Raghunātha dāsa's father and mother were filled with anxiety.

devanagari: एथा रघुनाथ - दास प्रभाते उठिया ।
पूर्व - मुख छाड़ि’ चले दक्षिण - मुख हञा ॥184॥
cc-antya-6.184.translation: Raghunātha dāsa, who had been resting at the milkman's house, got up early in the morning. Instead of going to the east, he turned his face south and proceeded.

devanagari: छत्रभोग पार ह ञा छाड़िया सराण ।
कुग्राम दिया दिया करिल प्रयाण ॥185॥
cc-antya-6.185.translation: He crossed Chatrabhoga, but instead of going on the general path, he proceeded on the path that went from village to village.

lines: bhakṣaṇa apekṣā nāhi, samasta divasa gamana
devanagari: भक्षण अपेक्षा नाहि, समस्त दिवस गमन ।
क्षुधा नाहि बाधे, चैतन्य - चरण - प्राप्त्ये मन ॥186॥
cc-antya-6.186.translation: Not caring about eating, he traveled all day. Hunger was not an impediment, for his mind was concentrated upon obtaining shelter at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: kabhu carvaṇa, kabhu randhana, kabhu dugdha-pāna
yabe yei mile, tāhe rākhe nija prāṇa
devanagari: कभु चर्वण, कभु रन्धन, कभु दुग्ध - पान ।
यबे येइ मिले, ताहे राखे निज प्राण ॥187॥
cc-antya-6.187.translation: Sometimes he chewed fried grains, sometimes he cooked, and sometimes he drank milk. In this way he kept his life and soul together with whatever was available wherever he went.

devanagari: बार दिने च लि’ गेला श्री - पुरुषोत्तम ।
पथे तिन - दिन मात्र करिला भोजन ॥188॥
cc-antya-6.188.translation: He reached Jagannātha Purī in twelve days but could only eat for three days on the way.

devanagari: स्वरूपादि - सह गोसाञि आछेन वसिया ।
हेन - काले रघुनाथ मिलिल आसिया ॥189॥
cc-antya-6.189.translation: When Raghunātha dāsa met Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the Lord was sitting with His companions, headed by Svarūpa Dāmodara.

lines: bāra lakṣa deya rājāya, sādhe biśa lakṣa
se 'turuk' kichu nā pāñā haila pratipakṣa
devanagari: बार लक्ष देय राजाय, साधे बिश लक्ष ।
से ‘तुरुक्’ किछु ना पाञा हैल प्रतिपक्ष ॥19॥
cc-antya-6.19.translation: Hiraṇya dāsa was collecting 2,000,000 coins and therefore should have delivered 1,500,000 to the government. Instead, he was giving only 1,200,000, thus making an extra profit of 300,000 coins. Seeing this, the Mohammedan caudhurī, who was a Turk, became his rival.

devanagari: अङ्गनेते दूरे रहि’ करेन प्रणिपात ।
मुकुन्द - दत्त कहे , - ‘एइ आइल रघुनाथ’ ॥190॥
cc-antya-6.190.translation: Staying at a distant place in the courtyard, he fell down to offer obeisances. Then Mukunda Datta said, "Here is Raghunātha."

lines: uṭhi' prabhu kṛpāya tāṅre kailā āliṅgana
devanagari: प्रभु कहेन, - ‘आइस’, तेंहो धरिला चरण ।
उठि’ प्रभु कृपाय ताँरे कैला आलिङ्गन ॥191॥
cc-antya-6.191.translation: As soon as Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu heard these words, He immediately welcomed Raghunātha dāsa. "Come here," He said. Raghunātha dāsa then clasped the lotus feet of the Lord, but the Lord stood up and embraced him out of His causeless mercy.

devanagari: स्वरूपादि सब भक्तेर चरण वन्दिला ।
प्रभु - कृपा देखि’ सबै आलिङ्गन कैला ॥192॥
cc-antya-6.192.translation: Raghunātha dāsa offered prayers at the lotus feet of all the devotees, headed by Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī. Seeing the special mercy Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had bestowed upon Raghunātha dāsa, they embraced him also.

devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - “कृष्ण - कृपा बलिष्ठ सबा हैते ।
तोमारे काड़िल विषय - विष्ठा - गर्त हैते” ॥193॥
cc-antya-6.193.translation: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "The mercy of Lord Kṛṣṇa is stronger than anything else. Therefore the Lord has delivered you from the ditch of materialistic life, which is like a hole into which people pass stool."

lines: tava kṛpā kāḍila āmā,—ei āmi māni'
devanagari: रघुनाथ मने कहे, - कृष्ण नाहि जानि ।
तव कृपा काड़िल आमा, - एइ आमि मा नि’ ॥194॥
cc-antya-6.194.translation: Raghunātha dāsa answered within his mind, "I do not know who Kṛṣṇa is. I simply know that Your mercy, O my Lord, has saved me from my family life."

devanagari: प्रभु कहेन, - “तोमार पिता - ज्येठा दुइ जने ।
चक्रवर्ती - सम्बन्धे हा म ‘आजा’ करि’ माने” ॥195॥
cc-antya-6.195.translation: The Lord continued, "Your father and his elder brother are both related as brothers to My grandfather, Nīlāmbara Cakravartī. Therefore I consider them My grandfathers.

devanagari: चक्रवर्तीर दुहे हय भ्रातृ - रूप दास ।
अतएव तारे आमि करि परिहास ॥196॥
cc-antya-6.196.translation: "Since your father and his elder brother are younger brothers of Nīlāmbara Cakravartī, I may joke about them in this way.

devanagari: तोमार बाप - ज्येठा - विषय - विष्ठा - गर्तेर कीड़ा ।
सुख करि’ माने विषय - विषेर महा - पीड़ा ॥197॥
cc-antya-6.197.translation: "My dear Raghunātha dāsa, your father and his elder brother are just like worms in stool in the ditch of material enjoyment, for the great disease of the poison of material enjoyment is what they consider happiness.

devanagari: यद्यपि ब्रह्मण्य करे ब्राह्मणेर सहाय ।
‘शुद्ध - वैष्णव’ नहे, हये वैष्णवेर प्राय’ ॥198॥
cc-antya-6.198.translation: "Although your father and uncle are charitable to brāhmaṇas and greatly help them, they are nevertheless not pure Vaisnavas. However, they are almost like Vaiṣṇavas.

lines: sei karma karāya, yāte haya bhava-bandha
devanagari: तथापि विषयेर स्वभाव करे महा - अन्ध ।
सेइ कर्म कराय, याते हय भव - बन्ध ॥199॥
cc-antya-6.199.translation: "Those who are attached to materialistic life and are blind to spiritual life must act in such a way that they are bound to repeated birth and death by the actions and reactions of their activities.

devanagari: जय जय श्री - चैतन्य जय नित्यानन्द ।
जयाद्वैत - चन्द्र जय गौर - भक्त - वृन्द ॥2॥
cc-antya-6.2.translation: All glory to Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu! All glory to Lord Nityānanda! All glory to Śrī Advaita Ācārya! And all glory to all the devotees of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu!

devanagari: राज - घरे कैफियत् दिया उजीरे आनिल ।
हिरण्य - दास पलाइल, रघुनाथेरे बान्धिल ॥20॥
cc-antya-6.20.translation: After sending a confidential account to the government treasury, the caudhurī brought the minister in charge. The caudhurī came, wanting to arrest Hiraṇya dāsa, but Hiraṇya dāsa had left home. Therefore the caudhurī arrested Raghunātha dāsa.

devanagari: “हेन ‘विषय’ हैते कृष्ण उद्धारिला तोमा’ ।
या कहन ना याय कृष्ण - कृपार महिमा” ॥200॥
cc-antya-6.200.translation: "By His own free will, Lord Kṛṣṇa has delivered you from such a condemned materialistic life. Therefore the glories of Lord Kṛṣṇa's causeless mercy cannot be expressed."

devanagari: रघुनाथेर क्षीणता - मालिन्य देखियो ।
स्वरूपेरे कहेन प्रभु कृपाई - चित्त ह ञा ॥201॥
cc-antya-6.201.translation: Seeing Raghunātha dāsa skinny and dirty because of having traveled for twelve days and fasted, Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, His heart melting due to causeless mercy, spoke to Svarūpa Dāmodara.

devanagari: एइ रघुनाथे आमि सँपिनु तोमारे ।
पुत्र - भृत्य - रूपे तुमि कर अङ्गीकारे ॥202॥
cc-antya-6.202.translation: "My dear Svarūpa," He said, "I entrust this Raghunātha dāsa to you. Please accept him as your son or servant.

devanagari: तिन ‘रघुनाथ’ - नाम हय आमार गणे ।
‘स्वरूपेर रघु’ - आजि हैते इहार नामे ॥203॥
cc-antya-6.203.translation: "There are now three Raghunāthas among My associates. From this day forward, this Raghunātha should be known as the Raghu of Svarūpa Dāmodara."

devanagari: एत क हि’ रघुनाथेर हस्त धरिला ।
स्वरूपेर हस्ते ताँरे समर्पण कैला ॥204॥
cc-antya-6.204.translation: Saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu grasped the hand of Raghunātha dāsa and entrusted him to the hands of Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī.

devanagari: स्वरूप कहे , - ‘महाप्रभुर ने आज्ञा हैल’ ।
एत क हि’ रघुनाथे पुनः आलिङ्गिल ॥205॥
cc-antya-6.205.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī accepted Raghunātha dāsa, saying, "Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, whatever You order is accepted." He then embraced Raghunātha dāsa again.

devanagari: चैतन्येर भक्त - वात्स ल्य कहिते ना पारि ।
गोविन्देरे कहे रघुनाथे दया करि’ ॥206॥
cc-antya-6.206.translation: I cannot properly express the affection of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu for His devotees. Being merciful toward Raghunātha dāsa, the Lord spoke as follows to Govinda.

devanagari: “पथे इँह करियाछे बहुत लङ्घन ।
कत - दिन कर इहार भाल सन्तर्पण” ॥207॥
cc-antya-6.207.translation: "On the way, Raghunātha dāsa has fasted and undergone hardships for many days. Therefore, take good care of him for some days so that he may eat to his satisfaction."

devanagari: रघुनाथे कहे - “याञा, कर सिन्धु - स्नान ।
जगन्नाथ देखि’ आसि’ करह भोजन” ॥208॥
cc-antya-6.208.translation: Then Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu told Raghunātha dāsa, "Go bathe in the sea. Then see Lord Jagannātha in the temple and return here to take your meal."

lines: eta bali' prabhu madhyāhna karite uṭhilā
devanagari: एत ब लि’ प्रभु मध्याह्न करिते उठिला ।
रघुनाथ - दास सब भक्तेरे मिलिला ॥209॥
cc-antya-6.209.translation: After saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu got up and went to perform His midday duties, and Raghunātha met all the devotees present.

devanagari: प्रति - दिन रघुनाथे करये भर्त्सना ।
‘बाप - ज्येठारे आ न’, नहे पाइबा यातना ॥21॥
cc-antya-6.21.translation: Every day, the Mohammedan would chastise Raghunātha dāsa and tell him, "Bring your father and his elder brother. Otherwise you will be punished."

devanagari: रघुनाथे प्रभुर कृपा देखि, भक्त - गण ।
विस्मित ह ञा करे ताँर भाग्य - प्रशंसन ॥210॥
cc-antya-6.210.translation: Having seen the causeless mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu upon Raghunātha dāsa, all the devotees, struck with wonder, praised his good fortune.

devanagari: रघुनाथ समुद्रे याञा स्नान करिला ।
जगन्नाथ देखि’ पुनः गोविन्द - पाश आइला ॥211॥
cc-antya-6.211.translation: Raghunātha dāsa took his bath in the sea and saw Lord Jagannātha. Then he returned to Govinda, the personal servant of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: prabhura avaśiṣṭa pātra govinda tāṅre dilā
devanagari: प्रभुर अवशिष्ट पात्र गोविन्द ताँरे दिला ।
आनन्दित ह ञा रघुनाथ प्रसाद पाइला ॥212॥
cc-antya-6.212.translation: Govinda offered him a plate with the remnants of food left by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and Raghunātha dāsa accepted the prasāda with great happiness.

lines: govinda prasāda tāṅre dila pañca dine
devanagari: एइ - मत रहे तेंह स्वरूप - चरणे ।
गोविन्द प्रसाद ताँरे दिल पञ्च दिने ॥213॥
cc-antya-6.213.translation: Raghunātha dāsa stayed under the care of Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, and Govinda supplied him remnants of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's food for five days.

devanagari: आर दिन हैते ‘पुष्प - अञ्ज लि’ देखियो ।
सिंह - द्वारे खाड़ा रहे भिक्षार लागिया ॥214॥
cc-antya-6.214.translation: Beginning from the sixth day, Raghunātha dāsa would stand at the gate known as Siṁha-dvāra to beg alms after the puṣpa-añjali ceremony, in which flowers were offered to the Lord.

lines: sevā sāri' rātrye kare gṛhete gamana
devanagari: जगन्नाथेर सेवक यत - ‘विषयीर गण’ ।
सेवा सा रि’ रात्र्ये करे गृहेते गमन ॥215॥
cc-antya-6.215.translation: After finishing their prescribed duties, the many servants of Lord Jagannātha, who are known as viṣayīs, return home at night.

lines: pasārira ṭhāñi anna dena kṛpā ta' kariyā
devanagari: सिंह - द्वारे अन्नार्थी वैष्णवे देखियो ।
पसारिर ठाञि अन्न देन कृपा त’ करिया ॥216॥
cc-antya-6.216.translation: If they see a Vaiṣṇava standing at the Siṁha-dvāra begging alms, out of mercy they arrange with the shopkeepers to give him something to eat.

devanagari: एइ - मत सर्व - काल आछे व्यवहार ।
निष्किञ्चन भक्त खाड़ा हय सिंह - द्वार ॥217॥
cc-antya-6.217.translation: Thus it is a custom for all time that a devotee who has no other means of support stands at the Siṁha-dvāra gate to receive alms from the servants.

devanagari: सर्व - दिन करेन वैष्णव नाम - सङ्कीर्तन ।
स्वच्छ न्दे करेन जगन्नाथ दरशन ॥218॥
cc-antya-6.218.translation: A completely dependent Vaiṣṇava thus chants the holy name of the Lord all day and sees Lord Jagannātha with full freedom.

lines: keha chatre māgi' khāya, yebā kichu pāya
keha rātre bhikṣā lāgi' siṁha-dvāre raya
devanagari: केह छत्रे मा गि’ खाय, येबा किछु पाय ।
केह रात्रे भिक्षा ला गि’ सिंह - द्वारे रय ॥219॥
cc-antya-6.219.translation: It is a custom for some Vaiṣṇavas to beg from the charity booths and eat whatever they obtain, whereas others stand at night at the Siṁha-dvāra gate, begging alms from the servants.

lines: mana phiri' yāya, tabe nā pāre mārite
devanagari: मारिते आनये यदि देखे रघुनाथे ।
मन फि रि’ याय, तबे ना पारे मारिते ॥22॥
cc-antya-6.22.translation: The caudhurī wanted to beat him, but as soon as he saw Raghunātha's face, his mind changed, and he could not beat him.

devanagari: महाप्रभुर भक्त - गणेर वैराग्य प्रधान ।
याहा देखि’ प्रीत हन गौर - भगवान् ॥220॥
cc-antya-6.220.translation: Renunciation is the basic principle sustaining the lives of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's devotees. Seeing this renunciation, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, is extremely satisfied.

lines: rātrye siṁha-dvāre khāḍā hañā māgi' khāya"
devanagari: प्रभुरे गोविन्द कहे, - “रघुनाथ ‘प्रसाद’ ना लय ।
रात्र्ये सिंह - द्वारे खाड़ा ह ञा मागि’ खाय” ॥221॥
cc-antya-6.221.translation: Govinda said to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, "Raghunātha dāsa no longer takes prasāda here. Now he stands at the Siṁha-dvāra, where he begs some alms to eat."

lines: śuni' tuṣṭa hañā prabhu kahite lāgila
devanagari: शुनि’ तुष्ट हञा प्रभु कहिते लागिल ।
भाल कैल, वैरागीर धर्म आचरिल ॥222॥
cc-antya-6.222.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu heard this, He was greatly satisfied. "Raghunātha dāsa has done well," He said. "He has acted suitably for a person in the renounced order.

devanagari: वैरागी करिबे सदा नाम - सङ्कीर्तन ।
मागिया खात्रा करे जीवन रक्षण ॥223॥
cc-antya-6.223.translation: "A person in the renounced order should always chant the holy name of the Lord. He should beg some alms to eat, and he should sustain his life in this way.

devanagari: वैरागी ह ञा येबा करे परापेक्षा ।
कार्य - सिद्धि नहे, कृष्ण करेन उपेक्षा ॥224॥
cc-antya-6.224.translation: "A vairāgī [a person in the renounced order] should not depend on others. 'If he does so, he will be unsuccessful, and he will be neglected by Kṛṣṇa.

lines: paramārtha yāya, āra haya rasera vaśa
devanagari: वैरागी ह ञा करे जिह्वार लालस ।
परमार्थ याय, आर हय रसेर वश ॥225॥
cc-antya-6.225.translation: "If a renunciant is eager for his tongue to taste different foods, his spiritual life will be lost, and he will be subservient to the tastes of his tongue.

devanagari: वैरागीर कृत्य - सदा नाम - सङ्कीर्तन ।
शाक - पत्र - फल - मूले उदर - भरण ॥226॥
cc-antya-6.226.translation: "The duty of a person in the renounced order is to chant the Hare Kṛṣṇa mantra always. He should satisfy his belly with whatever vegetables, leaves, fruits and roots are available.

devanagari: “जिह्वार लालसे येइ इति - उति धाय ।
शिश्नोदर - परायण कृष्ण नाहि पाय” ॥227॥
cc-antya-6.227.translation: "One who is subservient to the tongue and who thus goes here and there, devoted to the genitals and the belly, cannot attain Kṛṣṇa."

devanagari: आर दिन रघुनाथ स्वरूप - चरणे ।
आपनार कृत्य लागि’ कैला निवेदने ॥228॥
cc-antya-6.228.translation: The next day, Raghunātha dāsa inquired at the lotus feet of Svarūpa Dāmodara about his duty.

lines: "ki lāgi' chāḍāilā ghara, nā jāni uddeśa
ki mora kartavya, prabhu kara upadeśa"
devanagari: “कि ला गि’ छाड़ाइला घर, ना जानि उद्देश ।
कि मोर कर्तव्य, प्रभु कर उपदेश” ॥229॥
cc-antya-6.229.translation: "I do not know why I have given up household life," he said. "What is my duty? Kindly give me instructions."

lines: mukhe tarje garje, mārite sabhaya antara
devanagari: विशेषे कायस्थ - बुद्ध्ये अन्तरे करे डर ।
मुखे तर्जे गर्जे, मारिते सभय अन्तर ॥23॥
cc-antya-6.23.translation: Indeed, the caudhurī was afraid of Raghunātha dāsa because Raghunātha dāsa belong to the kāyastha community. Although the caudhurī would chastise him with oral vibrations, he was afraid to beat him.

lines: prabhura āge kathā-mātra nā kahe raghunātha
devanagari: प्रभुर आगे कथा - मात्र ना कहे रघुनाथ ।
स्वरूप - गोविन्द - द्वारा कहाय निज - बात् ॥230॥
cc-antya-6.230.translation: Raghunātha dāsa never even spoke a word before the Lord. Instead, he informed the Lord of his desires through Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī and Govinda.

lines: prabhura āge svarūpa nivedilā āra dine
devanagari: प्रभुर आगे स्वरूप निवेदिला आर दिने ।
रघुनाथ निवेदय प्रभुर चरणे ॥231॥
cc-antya-6.231.translation: The next day, Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī submitted to Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, "Raghunātha dāsa has this to say at Your lotus feet.

lines: "ki mora kartavya, muñi nā jāni uddeśa
devanagari: “कि मोर कर्तव्य, मुञि ना जानि उद्देश ।
आपनि श्री - मुखे मोरे कर उपदेश” ॥232॥
cc-antya-6.232.translation: "I do not know my duty or the goal of my life. Therefore, please personally give me instructions from Your transcendental mouth.' "

devanagari: हासि’ महाप्रभु रघुनाथेरे कहिल ।
तोमार उपदेष्टा क रि’ स्वरूपेरे दिल ॥233॥
cc-antya-6.233.translation: Smiling, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu told Raghunātha dāsa, "I have already appointed Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī as your instructor.

lines: āmi tata nāhi jāni, iṅho yata jāne
devanagari: ‘साध्य’ - ‘साधन’ - तत्त्व शिख इँहार स्थाने ।
आमि तत नाहि जानि, इँहो यत जाने ॥234॥
cc-antya-6.234.translation: "You may learn from him what your duty is and how to discharge it. I do not know as much as he.

lines: tathāpi āmāra ājñā ya śraddhā yadi haya
āmāra ei vākye tabe kariha niścaya
devanagari: तथापि आमार आज्ञा य श्रद्धा यदि हय ।
आमार एइ वाक्ये तबे करिह निश्चय ॥235॥
cc-antya-6.235.translation: "Nevertheless, if you want to take instructions from Me with faith and love, you may ascertain your duties from the following words.

lines: grāmya-kathā nā śunibe, grāmya-vārtā nā kahibe
bhāla nā khāibe āra bhāla nā paribe
devanagari: ग्राम्य - कथा ना शुनिबे, ग्राम्य - वार्ता ना कहिबे ।
भाल ना खाइबे आर भाल ना परिबे ॥236॥
cc-antya-6.236.translation: "Do not talk like people in general or hear what they say. You should not eat very palatable food, nor should you dress very nicely.

lines: amānī mānada hañā kṛṣṇa-nāma sadā la'be
devanagari: अमानी मानद ह ञा कृष्ण - नाम सदा ल’बे ।
व्रजे राधा - कृष्ण - सेवा मानसे करिबे ॥237॥
cc-antya-6.237.translation: "Do not expect honor, but offer all respect to others. Always chant the holy name of Lord Kṛṣṇa, and within your mind render service to Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa in Vṛndāvana.

lines: ei ta' saṅkṣepe āmi kailuṅ upadeśa
devanagari: एइ त’ सङ्क्षेपे आमि कैलुँ उपदेश ।
स्वरूपेर ठाञि इहार पाइबे विशेष ॥238॥
cc-antya-6.238.translation: "I have briefly given you My instructions. Now you will get all details about them from Svarūpa Dāmodara.

devanagari: तृणादपि सु - नीचेन तरोरिव सहिष्णुना ।
अमानिना मान - देन कीर्तनीयः सदा हरिः ॥239॥
cc-antya-6.239.translation: "One who thinks himself lower than grass, who is more tolerant than a tree, and who does not expect personal honor but is always prepared to give respect to others, can very easily always chant the holy name of the Lord."

devanagari: तबे रघुनाथ किछु चिन्तिला उपाय ।
विनति करिया कहे सेइ म्लेच्छ - पाय ॥24॥
cc-antya-6.24.translation: While this was going on, Raghunātha dāsa thought of a tricky method of escape. Thus he humbly submitted this plea at the feet of the Mohammedan caudhurī.

devanagari: एत शुनि’ रघुनाथ वन्दिला चरण ।
महाप्रभु कैला ताँरे कृपा - आलिङ्गन ॥240॥
cc-antya-6.240.translation: Having heard this, Raghunātha dāsa offered prayers at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and the Lord, with great mercy, embraced him.

devanagari: पुनः समर्पिला ताँरे स्वरूपेर स्थाने ।
‘अन्तरङ्ग - सेवा’ करे स्वरूपेर सने ॥241॥
cc-antya-6.241.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu again entrusted him to Svarūpa Dāmodara. Thus Raghunātha dāsa rendered very confidential service with Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī.

devanagari: हेन - काले आइला सब गौड़ेर भक्त - गण ।
पूर्ववत् प्रभु सबाय करिला मिलन ॥242॥
cc-antya-6.242.translation: At this time, all the devotees from Bengal arrived, and, as previously, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu met them with great feeling.

devanagari: सबा ल ञा कैला प्रभु गुण्डिचा - मार्जन ।
सबा लञा कैला प्रभु वन्य - भोजन ॥243॥
cc-antya-6.243.translation: As He had previously done, He cleansed the Guṇḍicā temple and held a picnic feast in the garden with the devotees.

devanagari: रथ - यात्राय सबा लञा करिला नर्तन ।
देखि’ रघुनाथेर चमत्कार हैल मन ॥244॥
cc-antya-6.244.translation: The Lord again danced with the devotees during the Ratha-yātrā festival. Seeing this, Raghunātha dāsa was struck with wonder.

devanagari: रघुनाथ - दास यबे सबारे मिलिला ।
अद्वैत - आचार्य ताँरे बहु कृपा कैला ॥245॥
cc-antya-6.245.translation: When Raghunātha dāsa met all the devotees, Advaita Ācārya showed him great mercy.

lines: tomā laite tomāra pitā pāṭhāila daśa jana
devanagari: शिवानन्द - सेन ताँरे कहेन विवरण ।
तोमा लैते तोमार पिता पाठाइल दश जन ॥246॥
cc-antya-6.246.translation: He also met Śivānanda Sena, who informed him, "Your father sent ten men to take you away.

lines: jhāṅkarā ha-ite tomā nā pāñā gela ghare
devanagari: तोमारे पाठाइते पत्री पाठाइल मोरे ।
झाङ्करा हइते तोमा ना पा ञा गेल घरे ॥247॥
cc-antya-6.247.translation: "He wrote me a letter asking me to send you back, but when those ten men received no information about you, they returned home from Jhāṅkarā."

lines: cāri māsa rahi' bhakta-gaṇa gauḍe gelā
devanagari: चारि मास रहि’ भक्त - गण गौड़े गेला ।
शुनि’ रघुनाथेर पिता मनुष्य पाठाइला ॥248॥
cc-antya-6.248.translation: When all the devotees from Bengal returned home after staying at Jagannātha Purī for four months, Raghunātha dāsa's father heard about their arrival and therefore sent a man to Śivānanda Sena.

devanagari: से मनुष्य शिवानन्द - सेनेरे पुछिल ।
महाप्रभुर स्थाने एक ‘वैरागी’ देखिल ॥249॥
cc-antya-6.249.translation: That man inquired from Śivānanda Sena, "Did you see anyone in the renounced order at the residence of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu?

lines: "āmāra pitā, jyeṭhā haya tomāra dui bhāi
devanagari: आमार पिता, ज्येठा हय तोमार दुइ भाइ ।
भाइ - भाइये तोमरा कलह कर सर्वदाइ ॥25॥
cc-antya-6.25.translation: "My dear sir, my father and his elder brother are both your brothers. All brothers always fight about something.

devanagari: गोवर्धनेर पुत्र तेंहो, नाम - ‘रघुनाथ’ ।
नीलाचले परिचय आछे तोमार साथ ? ॥250॥
cc-antya-6.250.translation: "That person is Raghunātha dāsa, the son of Govardhana Majumadāra. Did you meet him in Nīlācala?"

lines: parama vikhyāta teṅho, kebā nāhi jāne
devanagari: शिवानन्द कहे , - “तेंहो हय प्रभुर स्थाने ।
परम विख्यात तेंहो, केबा नाहि जाने” ॥251॥
cc-antya-6.251.translation: Śivānanda Sena replied, "Yes, sir. Raghunātha dāsa is with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and is a very famous man. Who does not know him?

devanagari: स्वरूपेर स्थाने तारे करियाछेन समर्पण ।
प्रभुर भक्त - गणेर तेंहो हय प्राण - सम ॥252॥
cc-antya-6.252.translation: "Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu has placed him under the charge of Svarūpa Dāmodara. Raghunātha dāsa has become just like the life of all the Lord's devotees.

devanagari: रात्रि - दिन करे तेंहो नाम - सङ्कीर्तन ।
क्षण - मात्र नाहि छाड़े प्रभुर चरण ॥253॥
cc-antya-6.253.translation: "He chants the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra all day and night. He never gives up the shelter of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, not even for a moment.

lines: yaiche taiche āhāra kari' rākhaye parāṇa
devanagari: परम वैराग्य तार, नाहि भक्ष्य - परिधान ।
यैछे तैछे आहार क रि’ राखये पराण ॥254॥
cc-antya-6.254.translation: "He is in the supreme order of renounced life. Indeed, he does not care about eating or dressing. Somehow or other he eats and maintains his life.

devanagari: दश - दण्ड रात्रि गेले ‘पुष्पाञ्जलि’ देखिया ।
सिंह - द्वारे खाड़ा हय आहार लागिया ॥255॥
cc-antya-6.255.translation: "After ten daṇḍas [four hours] of the night have passed and Raghunātha dāsa has seen the performance of puṣpāñjali, he stands at the Siṁha-dvāra gate to beg some alms to eat.

lines: keha yadi deya, tabe karaye bhakṣaṇa
devanagari: “केह यदि देय, तबे करये भक्षण ।
कभु उपवास, कभु करये चर्वण” ॥256॥
cc-antya-6.256.translation: "He eats if someone gives him something to eat. Sometimes he fasts, and sometimes he chews fried grains."

devanagari: एत शुनि’ सेइ मनुष्य गोवर्धन - स्थाने ।
कहिल गिया सब रघुनाथ - विवरणे ॥257॥
cc-antya-6.257.translation: After hearing this, the messenger returned to Govardhana Majumadāra and informed him all about Raghunātha dāsa.

lines: śuni' tāṅra mātā pitā duḥkhita ha-ila
devanagari: शुनि’ ताँर माता पिता दुःखित हइल ।
पुत्र - ठाञि द्रव्य - मनुष्य पाठाइते मन कैल ॥258॥
cc-antya-6.258.translation: Hearing the description of Raghunātha dāsa's behavior in the renounced order, his father and mother were very unhappy. Therefore they decided to send him some men with goods for his comfort.

lines: cāri-śata mudrā, dui bhṛtya, eka brāhmaṇa
devanagari: चारि - शत मुद्रा, दुइ भृत्य, एक ब्राह्मण ।
शिवानन्देर ठाञि पाठाइल तत - क्षण ॥259॥
cc-antya-6.259.translation: Raghunātha dāsa's father immediately sent four hundred coins, two servants and one brāhmaṇa to Śivānanda Sena.

lines: kabhu kalaha, kabhu prīti—ihāra niścaya nāi
kāli punaḥ tina bhāi ha-ibā eka-ṭhāñi
devanagari: कभु कलह, कभु प्रीति - इहार निश्चय नाई।
कालि पुनः तिन भाइ हइबा एक - ठाञि ॥26॥
cc-antya-6.26.translation: "Sometimes brothers fight among themselves, and sometimes they have very friendly dealings. There is no certainty when such changes will take place. Thus I am sure that although today you are fighting, tomorrow you three brothers will be sitting together in peace.

lines: āmi yāi yabe, āmāra saṅge yāibā
devanagari: शिवानन्द कहे , - “तुमि सब याइते नारिबा ।
आमि याइ यबे, आमार सङ्गे याइबा” ॥260॥
cc-antya-6.260.translation: Śivānanda Sena informed them, "You cannot go to Jagannātha Purī directly. When I go there, you may accompany me.

lines: ebe ghara yāha, yabe āmi saba calimu
tabe tomā sabākāre saṅge lañā yāmu
devanagari: एबे घर याह, यबे आमि सब चलिमु ।
तबे तोमा सबाकारे सङ्गे लञा यामु ॥261॥
cc-antya-6.261.translation: "Now go home. When all of us go, I shall take all of you with me."

devanagari: एइ त’ प्रस्तावे श्री - कवि - कर्णपूर ।
रघुनाथ - महिमा ग्रन्थे लिखिला प्रचुर ॥262॥
cc-antya-6.262.translation: Describing this incident, the great poet Śrī Kavi-karṇapūra has written extensively about the glorious activities of Raghunātha dāsa in his book.

lines: tac-chiṣyo raghunātha ity adhiguṇaḥ prāṇādhiko mādṛśām
vairāgyaika-nidhir na kasya vidito nīlācale tiṣṭhatām
devanagari: आचार्यो यदुनन्दनः सु - मधुरः श्री - वासुदेव - प्रियस् तच्छिष्यो रघुनाथ इत्यधिगुणः प्राणाधिको मादृशाम् ।
श्री - चैतन्य - कृपातिरेक - सतत - स्निग्धः स्वरूपानुगो वैराग्यैक - निधिर्न कस्य विदितो नीलाचले तिष्ठताम् ॥263॥
cc-antya-6.263.translation: "Raghunātha dāsa is a disciple of Yadunandana Ācārya, who is very gentle and is extremely dear to Vāsudeva Datta, a resident of Kāñcanapallī. Because of Raghunātha dāsa's transcendental qualities, he is always more dear than life for all of us devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Since he has been favored by the abundant mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, he is always pleasing. Vividly providing a superior example for the renounced order, this very dear follower of Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī is the ocean of renunciation. Who among the residents of Nīlācala [Jagannātha Purī] does not know him very well?

devanagari: यः सर्व - लोकैक - मनोऽभिरुच्या सौभाग्य - भूः काचिदकृष्ट - पच्या ।
यत्रायमारोपण - तुल्य - कालं तत्प्रेम - शाखी फलवानतुल्यः ॥264॥
cc-antya-6.264.translation: "Because he is very pleasing to all the devotees, Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī easily became like the fertile earth of good fortune in which it was suitable for the seed of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu to be sown. At the same time that the seed was sown, it grew into a matchless tree of the love of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and produced fruit."

devanagari: शिवानन्द यैछे सेइ मनुष्ये कहिला ।
कर्णपूर सेइ - रूपे श्लोक वर्णिला ॥265॥
cc-antya-6.265.translation: In these verses, the great poet Kavi-karṇapūra gives the same information that Śivānanda Sena conveyed to the messenger from Raghunātha dāsa's father.

lines: raghunāthera sevaka, vipra tāṅra saṅge cale
devanagari: वर्षान्तरे शिवानन्द चले नीलाचले ।
रघुनाथेर सेवक, विप्र ताँर सङ्गे चले ॥266॥
cc-antya-6.266.translation: The next year, when Śivānanda Sena was going to Jagannātha Purī as usual, the servants and the brāhmaṇa, who was a cook, went with him.

lines: sei vipra bhṛtya, cāri-śata mudrā lañā
devanagari: सेइ विप्र भृत्य, चारि - शत मुद्रा लञा ।
नीलाचले रघुनाथे मिलिला आसिया ॥267॥
cc-antya-6.267.translation: The servants and brāhmaṇa brought four hundred coins to Jagannātha Purī, and there they met Raghunātha dāsa.

devanagari: रघुनाथ - दास अङ्गीकार ना करिल ।
द्रव्य लञा दुइ - जन ताहाङि रहिल ॥268॥
cc-antya-6.268.translation: Raghunātha dāsa did not accept the money and men sent by his father. Therefore a servant and the brāhmaṇa stayed there with the money.

devanagari: तबे रघुनाथ करि’ अनेक यतन ।
मासे दुइ - दिन कैला प्रभुर निमन्त्रण ॥269॥
cc-antya-6.269.translation: At that time, Raghunātha dāsa invited Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to his house with great attention for two days every month.

lines: āmi yaiche pitāra, taiche tomāra bālaka
āmi tomāra pālya, tumi āmāra pālaka
devanagari: आमि यैछे पितार, तैछे तोमार बालक ।
आमि तोमार पाल्य, तुमि आमार पालक ॥27॥
cc-antya-6.27.translation: "Just as I am my father's son, so I am also yours. I am your dependent, and you are my maintainer.

devanagari: दुइ निमन्त्रणे लागे कौड़ि अष्ट - पण ।
ब्राह्मण - भृत्य - ठाञि करेन एतेक ग्रहण ॥270॥
cc-antya-6.270.translation: The cost for these two occasions was 640 kauḍis. Therefore he would take that much from the servant and the brāhmaṇa.

devanagari: एइ - मत निमन्त्रण वर्ष दुइ कैला ।
पाछे रघुनाथ निमन्त्रण छाड़ि’ दिला ॥271॥
cc-antya-6.271.translation: Raghunātha dāsa continued to invite Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu in this way for two years, but at the end of the second year he stopped.

lines: māsa-dui yabe raghunātha nā kare nimantraṇa
devanagari: मास - दुइ यबे रघुनाथ ना करे निमन्त्रण ।
स्वरूपे पुछिला तबे शचीर नन्दन ॥272॥
cc-antya-6.272.translation: When Raghunātha dāsa neglected to invite Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu for two consecutive months, the Lord, the son of Śacī, questioned Svarūpa Dāmodara.

devanagari: ‘रघु केने आमाय निमन्त्रण छाड़ि’ दिल?’ ।
स्वरूप कहे , - “मने किछु विचार करिल” ॥273॥
cc-antya-6.273.translation: The Lord asked, "Why has Raghunātha dāsa stopped inviting Me?" Svarūpa Dāmodara replied, "He must have reconsidered something in his mind.

lines: prasanna nā haya ihāya jāni prabhura mana
devanagari: विषयीर द्रव्य लञा करि निमन्त्रण ।
प्रसन्न ना हय इहाय जानि प्रभुर मन ॥274॥
cc-antya-6.274.translation: “ 'I invite Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu by accepting goods from materialistic people. I know that the Lord's mind is not satisfied by this.

lines: mora citta dravya la-ite nā haya nirmala
devanagari: मोर चित्त द्रव्य लइते ना हय निर्मल ।
एइ निमन्त्रणे देखि , - ‘प्रतिष्ठा’ - मात्र फल ॥275॥
cc-antya-6.275.translation: “ 'My consciousness is impure because I accept all these goods from people who are interested only in pounds, shillings and pence. Therefore by this kind of invitation I only get some material reputation.

lines: nā mānile duḥkhī ha-ibeka mūrkha jana
devanagari: उपरोधे प्रभु मोर मानेन निमन्त्रण ।
ना मानिले दुःखी हइबेक मूर्ख जन ॥276॥
cc-antya-6.276.translation: “ 'At my request Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu accepts the invitations because He knows that a foolish person like me would be unhappy if He did not accept them.'

devanagari: एत विचारिया निमन्त्रण छाड़ि’ दिल ।
शुनि’ महाप्रभु हासि’ बलिते लागिल ॥277॥
cc-antya-6.277.translation: "Considering all these points," Svarūpa Dāmodara concluded, "he has stopped inviting You." Hearing this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu smiled and spoke as follows.

lines: malina mana haile nahe kṛṣṇera smaraṇa
devanagari: “विषयीर अन्न खाइले मलिन हय मन ।
मलिन मन हैले नहे कृष्णेर स्मरण” ॥278॥
cc-antya-6.278.translation: "When one eats food offered by a materialistic man, one's mind becomes contaminated, and when the mind is contaminated, one is unable to think of Kṛṣṇa properly.

devanagari: विषयीर अन्न ह य ‘राजस’ निमन्त्रण ।
दाता, भोक्ता - दुँहार मलिन हय मन ॥279॥
cc-antya-6.279.translation: "When one accepts an invitation from a person contaminated by the material mode of passion, the person who offers the food and the person who accepts it are both mentally contaminated.

lines: pālaka hañā pālyere tāḍite nā yuyāya
devanagari: “पालक ह ञा पाल्येरे ताड़िते ना युयाय ।
तुमि सर्व - शास्त्र जान ‘जिन्दा - पीर’ - प्राय” ॥28॥
cc-antya-6.28.translation: "For a maintainer to punish the person he maintains is not good. You are expert in all the scriptures. Indeed, you are like a living saint."

lines: iṅhāra saṅkoce āmi eta dina nila
devanagari: “इँहार सङ्कोचे आमि एत दिन निल ।
भाल हैल - जानिया आपनि छाड़ि दिल” ॥280॥
cc-antya-6.280.translation: "Because of Raghunātha dāsa's eagerness, I accepted his invitation for many days. It is very good that Raghunātha dāsa, knowing this, has now automatically given up this practice."

lines: chatre yāi' māgiyā khāite ārambha karilā
devanagari: कत दि ने रघुनाथ सिंह - द्वार छाड़िला ।
छत्रे याइ’ मागिया खाइते आरम्भ करिला ॥281॥
cc-antya-6.281.translation: After some days, Raghunātha dāsa gave up standing near the Siṁha-dvāra gate and instead began eating by begging alms from a booth for free distribution of food.

lines: 'raghu bhikṣā lāgi' ṭhāḍa kene nahe siṁha-dvāre'?
devanagari: गोविन्द - पाश शुनि’ प्रभु पुछेन स्वरूपेरे ।
‘रघु भिक्षा लागि’ ठाड़ केने नहे सिंह - द्वारे’? ॥282॥
cc-antya-6.282.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu heard this news from Govinda, He inquired from Svarūpa Dāmodara, "Why does Raghunātha dāsa no longer stand at the Siṁha-dvāra gate to beg alms?"

devanagari: स्वरूप कहे , - “सिंह - द्वारे दुःख अनुभविया ।
छत्रे मा गि’ खाय मध्याह्न - काले गिया” ॥283॥
cc-antya-6.283.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara replied, "Raghunātha dāsa felt unhappy standing at the Siṁha-dvāra. Therefore he is now going at midday to beg alms from the charity booth."

devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - “भाल कैल, छाड़िल सिंह - द्वार” ।
सिंह - द्वारे भिक्षा - वृत्ति - वेश्यार आचार ॥284॥
cc-antya-6.284.translation: Hearing this news, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "He has done very well by no longer standing at the Siṁha-dvāra gate. Such begging of alms resembles the behavior of a prostitute.

lines: kim artham ayam āgacchati, ayaṁ dāsyati, anena dattam ayam aparaḥ. samety ayaṁ dāsyati, anenāpi na dattam anyaḥ sameṣyati, sa dāsyati ity ādi.
devanagari: तथा हि - किमर्थमयमागच्छति, अयं दास्यति, अनेन दत्तमयमपरः ।
समेत्ययं दास्यति, अनेनापि न दत्तमन्यः समेष्यति, स दास्यति इत्यादि ॥285॥
cc-antya-6.285.translation: "Here is a person coming near. He will give me something. This person gave me something last night. Now another person is coming near. He may give me something. The person who just passed did not give me anything, but another person will come, and he will give me something.' Thus a person in the renounced order gives up his neutrality and depends on the charity of this person or that. Thinking in this way, he adopts the occupation of a prostitute.

devanagari: “छत्रे याइ यथा - लाभ उदर - भरण ।
अन्य कथा नाहि, सुखे कृष्ण - सङ्कीर्तन” ॥286॥
cc-antya-6.286.translation: "If one goes to the booth where free food is distributed and fills his belly with whatever he obtains, there is no chance of further unwanted talk, and one can very peacefully chant the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra."

lines: eta bali' tāṅre punaḥ prasāda karilā
devanagari: एत ब लि’ ताँरे पुनः प्रसाद करिला ।
cc-antya-6.287.translation: After saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu again bestowed His mercy upon Raghunātha dāsa by giving him a piece of stone from Govardhana Hill and a garland of small conchshells.

devanagari: शङ्करानन्द - सरस्वती वृन्दावन हैते आइला ।
तेंह सेइ शिला - गुञ्जा - माला लञा गेला ॥288॥
cc-antya-6.288.translation: Previously, when Śaṅkarānanda Sarasvatī had returned from Vṛndāvana, he had brought the piece of stone from Govardhana Hill and also the garland of conchshells.

lines: dui vastu mahāprabhura āge āni' dilā
devanagari: पार्श्वे गाँथा गुञ्जा - माला, गोवर्धन - शिला ।
दुइ वस्तु महाप्रभुर आगे आनि’ दिला ॥289॥
cc-antya-6.289.translation: He presented Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu these two items—the garland of conchshells and the stone from Govardhana Hill.
