lines: eta śuni' sei mlecchera mana ārdra haila
dāḍi vāhi' aśru paḍe, kāṅdite lāgila
devanagari: एत शुनि’ सेइ म्लेच्छेर मन आर्द्र हैन ।
दाड़ि वा हि’ अश्रु पड़े, काँदिते लागिल ॥29॥
cc-antya-6.29.translation: Hearing Raghunātha dāsa's appealing voice, the Mohammedan's heart softened. He began to cry, and tears glided down his beard.

lines: dui apūrva-vastu pāñā prabhu tuṣṭa hailā
devanagari: दुइ अपूर्व - वस्तु पाञा प्रभु तुष्ट हैला ।
स्मरणेर काले गले परे गुञ्जा - माला ॥290॥
cc-antya-6.290.translation: Upon receiving these two uncommon items, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was extremely happy. While chanting, He would put the garland around His neck.

lines: kabhu nāsāya ghrāṇa laya, kabhu śire kare
devanagari: गोवर्धन - शिला प्रभु हृदये - नेत्रे धरे ।
कभु नासाय घ्राण लय, कभु शिरे करे ॥291॥
cc-antya-6.291.translation: The Lord would put the stone to His heart or sometimes to His eyes. Sometimes He would smell it with His nose and sometimes place it on His head.

devanagari: नेत्र - जले सेइ शिला भिजे निरन्तर ।
शिलारे कहेन प्रभु - ‘कृष्ण - कलेवर’ ॥292॥
cc-antya-6.292.translation: The stone from Govardhana was always moist with tears from His eyes. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would say, "This stone is directly the body of Lord Kṛṣṇa."

devanagari: एइ - मत तिन - वत्सर शिला - माला धरिला ।
तुष्ट हञा शिला - माला रघुनाथे दिला ॥293॥
cc-antya-6.293.translation: For three years He kept the stone and garland. Then, greatly satisfied by the behavior of Raghunātha dāsa, the Lord delivered both of them to him.

lines: iṅhāra sevā kara tumi kariyā āgraha
devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - “एइ शिला कृष्णेर विग्रह ।
इँहार सेवा कर तुमि करिया आग्रह” ॥294॥
cc-antya-6.294.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu instructed Raghunātha dāsa, "This stone is the transcendental form of Lord Kṛṣṇa. Worship the stone with great eagerness."

lines: ei śilāre kara tumi sāttvika pūjana
devanagari: एइ शिलार कर तुमि सात्त्विक पूजन ।
अचिरात् पाबे तुमि कृष्ण - प्रेम - धन ॥295॥
cc-antya-6.295.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu continued, "Worship this stone in the mode of goodness like a perfect brāhmaṇa, for by such worship you will surely attain ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa without delay.

devanagari: एक कुँजा जल आर तुलसी - मञ्जरी ।
सात्त्विक - सेवा एई शुद्ध - भावे करि ॥296॥
cc-antya-6.296.translation: "For such worship, one needs a jug of water and a few flowers from a tulasī tree. This is worship in complete goodness when performed in complete purity.

devanagari: दुइ - दिके दुइ - पत्र मध्ये कोमल मञ्जरी ।
एइ - मत अष्ट - मञ्जरी दिबे श्रद्धा क रि’ ॥297॥
cc-antya-6.297.translation: "With faith and love, you should offer eight soft tulasī flowers, each with two tulasī leaves, one on each side of each flower."

lines: śrī-haste śilā diyā ei ājñā dilā
devanagari: श्री - हस्ते शिला दिया एइ आज्ञा दिला ।
आनन्दे रघुनाथ सेवा करिते लागिला ॥298॥
cc-antya-6.298.translation: After thus advising him how to worship, Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu personally offered Raghunātha dāsa the govardhana-śilā with His transcendental hand. As advised by the Lord, Raghunātha dāsa worshiped the śilā in great transcendental jubilation.

devanagari: एक - वितस्ति दुइ - वस्त्र, पिंड़ा एक - खानि ।
स्वरूप दिलेन कुँजा आनिबारे पानि ॥299॥
cc-antya-6.299.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara gave Raghunātha dāsa two cloths, each about six inches long, a wooden platform and a jug in which to keep water.

devanagari: एइ - मत गौरचन्द्र भक्त - गण - सङ्गे ।
नीलाचले नाना लीला करे नाना - रङ्गे ॥3॥
cc-antya-6.3.translation: Thus Lord Gauracandra performed various pastimes with His associates at Jagannātha Purī in varieties of transcendental pleasure.

lines: āji chāḍāimu tomā' kari' eka sūtra"
devanagari: म्लेच्छ बले, - “आजि हैते तुमि - मोर ‘पुत्र’ ।
आजि छाड़ाइमु तोमा’ करि’ एक सूत्र” ॥30॥
cc-antya-6.30.translation: The Mohammedan caudhurī told Raghunātha dāsa, "You are my son from this day on. Today, by some means, I shall have you released."

devanagari: एइ - मत रघुनाथ करेन पूजन ।
पूजा - काले देखे शिलाय ‘व्रजेन्द्र - नन्दन’ ॥300॥
cc-antya-6.300.translation: Thus Raghunātha dāsa began worshiping the stone from Govardhana, and as he worshiped he saw the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Kṛṣṇa, the son of Nanda Mahārāja, directly in the stone.

lines: ei cinti' raghunātha preme bhāsi' gelā
devanagari: ‘प्रभुर स्वहस्त - दत्त गोवर्धन - शिला’ ।
एइ चिन्ति’ रघुनाथ प्रेमे भासि’ गेला ॥301॥
cc-antya-6.301.translation: Thinking of how he had received the govardhana-śilā directly from the hands of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Raghunātha dāsa was always overflooded with ecstatic love.

devanagari: जल - तुलसीर सेवाय ताँर यत सुखोदय ।
षोड़शोपचार - पूजाय तत सुख नय ॥302॥
cc-antya-6.302.translation: The amount of transcendental bliss that Raghunātha dāsa enjoyed simply by offering water and tulasī is impossible to achieve even if one worships the Deity with sixteen kinds of paraphernalia.

devanagari: एइ - मत कत दिन करेन पूजन ।
तबे स्वरूप - गोसाञि ताँरे कहिला वचन ॥303॥
cc-antya-6.303.translation: After Raghunātha dāsa had thus worshiped the govardhana-śilā for some time, Svarūpa Dāmodara one day spoke to him as follows.

lines: śraddhā kari' dile, sei amṛtera sama
devanagari: “अष्ट - कौड़िर खाजा - सन्देश कर समर्पण ।
श्रद्धा क रि’ दिले, सेइ अमृतेर सम” ॥304॥
cc-antya-6.304.translation: "Offer the Govardhana stone eight kauḍis worth of the first-class sweetmeats known as khājā and sandeśa. If you offer them with faith and love, they will be just like nectar."

devanagari: तबे अष्ट - कौड़िर खाजा करे समर्पण ।
स्वरूप - आज्ञाय गोविन्द ताहा करे समाधान ॥305॥
cc-antya-6.305.translation: Raghunātha dāsa then began offering the costly sweetmeats known as khājā, which Govinda, following the order of Svarūpa Dāmodara, would supply.

devanagari: रघुनाथ सेइ शिला - माला यबे पाइला ।
गोसाञि र अभिप्राय एइ भावना करिला ॥306॥
cc-antya-6.306.translation: When Raghunātha dāsa received from Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu the stone and the garland of conchshells, he could understand the Lord's intention. Thus he thought as follows.

devanagari: शिला दिया गोसाञि समर्पिला ‘गोवर्धने’ ।
गुञ्जा - माला दिया दिला ‘राधिका - चरणे’ ॥307॥
cc-antya-6.307.translation: "By offering me the govardhana-śilā, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu has offered me a place near Govardhana Hill, and by offering me the garland of conch shells, He has offered me shelter at the lotus feet of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī."

devanagari: आनन्दे रघुनाथेर बाह्य विस्मरण ।
काय - मने सेविलेन गौराङ्ग - चरण ॥308॥
cc-antya-6.308.translation: Raghunātha dāsa's transcendental bliss was boundless. Forgetting everything external, he served the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu with his body and mind.

lines: ananta guṇa raghunāthera ke karibe lekhā?
devanagari: अनन्त गुण रघुनाथेर के करिबे लेखा? ।
रघुनाथेर नियम, - येन पाषाणेर रेखा ॥309॥
cc-antya-6.309.translation: Who could list the unlimited transcendental attributes of Raghunātha dāsa? His strict regulative principles were exactly like lines on a stone.

devanagari: उजिरे कहिया रघुनाथे छोड़ाइल ।
प्रीति क रि’ रघुनाथे कहिते लागिल ॥31॥
cc-antya-6.31.translation: After informing the minister, the caudhurī released Raghunātha dāsa and then began to speak to him with great affection.

lines: āhāra-nidrā cāri daṇḍa seha nahe kona dine
devanagari: साढ़े सात प्रहर याय कीर्तन - स्मरणे ।
आहार - निद्रा चारि दण्ड सेह नहे कोन दिने ॥310॥
cc-antya-6.310.translation: Raghunātha dāsa spent more than twenty-two hours out of every twenty-four chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra and remembering the lotus feet of the Lord. He ate and slept for less than an hour and a half, and on some days that also was impossible.

lines: ājanma nā dila jihvāya rasera sparśana
devanagari: वैराग्येर कथा ताँर अद्भुत - कथन ।
आजन्म ना दिल जिह्वाय रसेर स्पर्शन ॥311॥
cc-antya-6.311.translation: Topics concerning his renunciation are wonderful. Throughout his life he never allowed his tongue sense gratification.

lines: chiṇḍā kāni kāṅthā vinā nā pare vasana
devanagari: छिण्डा कानि काँथा विना ना परे वसन ।
सावधाने प्रभुर कैला आज्ञार पालन ॥312॥
cc-antya-6.312.translation: He never touched anything to wear except a small torn cloth and a patchwork wrapper. Thus he very rigidly executed the order of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: प्राण - रक्षा ला गि’ येबा करेन भक्षण ।
ताहा खा ञा आपनाके कहे निर्वेद - वचन ॥313॥
cc-antya-6.313.translation: Whatever he ate was only to keep his body and soul together, and when he ate he would reproach himself thus.

devanagari: आत्मानं चेद्विजानीयात्परं ज्ञान - धुताशयः ।
किमिच्छन्कस्य वा हेतोर्देहं पुष्णाति लम्पटः ॥314॥
cc-antya-6.314.translation: "If one's heart has been cleansed by perfect knowledge and one has understood Kṛṣṇa, the Supreme Brahman, he then gains everything. Why should such a person act like a debauchee by trying very carefully to maintain his material body?"

lines: dui-tina dina haile bhāta saḍi' yāya
devanagari: प्रसादान्न पसारिर यत ना विकाय ।
दुइ - तिन दिन हैले भात सड़ि’ याय ॥315॥
cc-antya-6.315.translation: Lord Jagannātha's prasāda is sold by shopkeepers, and that which is not sold decomposes after two or three days.

devanagari: सिंह - द्वारे गाभी - आगे सेइ भात डारे ।
सड़ा - गन्धे तैलङ्गी - गाइ खाइते ना पारे ॥316॥
cc-antya-6.316.translation: All the decomposed food is thrown before the cows from Tailaṅga at the Siṁha-dvāra gate. Because of its rotten odor, even the cows cannot eat it.

lines: sei bhāta raghunātha rātre ghare āni'
bhāta pākhāliyā phele ghare diyā bahu pāni
devanagari: सेइ भात रघुनाथ रात्रे घरे आनि’ ।
भात पाखालिया फेले घरे दिया बहु पानि ॥317॥
cc-antya-6.317.translation: At night Raghunātha dāsa would collect that decomposed rice, bring it home and wash it with ample water.

lines: bhitarera dṛḍha yei māji bhāta pāya
lavaṇa diyā raghunātha sei anna khāya
devanagari: भितरेर दृढ़ येइ माजि भात पाय ।
लवण दिया रघुनाथ सेइ अन्न खाय ॥318॥
cc-antya-6.318.translation: Then he ate the hard inner portion of the rice with salt.

devanagari: एक - दिन स्वरूप ताहा करिते देखिला ।
हासिया ताहार किछु मागिया खाइला ॥319॥
cc-antya-6.319.translation: One day Svarūpa Dāmodara saw the activities of Raghunātha dāsa. Thus he smiled and asked for a small portion of that food and ate it.

devanagari: तोमार ज्ये ठा निर्बुद्धि अष्ट - लक्ष खाय ।
आमि - भागी, आमारे किछु दिबारे युयाय ॥32॥
cc-antya-6.32.translation: "The elder brother of your father is less intelligent," he said. "He enjoys of it to me.

devanagari: स्वरूप कहे , - “ऐछे अमृत खाओ निति - निति ।
आमा - सबाय नाहि देह’, - कि तोमार प्रकृति?” ॥320॥
cc-antya-6.320.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara said, "You eat such nectar every day, but you never offer it to us. Where is your character?"

lines: govindera mukhe prabhu se vārtā śunilā
āra dina āsi' prabhu kahite lāgilā
devanagari: गोविन्देर मुखे प्रभु से वार्ता शुनिला ।
आर दिन आ सि’ प्रभु कहिते लागिला ॥321॥
cc-antya-6.321.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu heard news of this from the mouth of Govinda, He went there the next day and spoke as follows.

lines: kāṅhā vastu khāo sabe, more nā deha' kene?'
eta bali' eka grāsa karilā bhakṣaṇe
devanagari: ‘काँहा वस्तु खाओ सबे, मोरे ना देह’ केने?’।
एत ब लि’ एक ग्रास करिला भक्षणे ॥322॥
cc-antya-6.322.translation: "What nice things are you eating? Why don't you give anything to Me?" Saying this, He forcibly took a morsel and began to eat.

lines: āra grāsa laite svarūpa hātete dharilā
'tava yogya nahe' bali' bale kāḍi' nilā
devanagari: आर ग्रास लैते स्वरूप हातेते धरिला ।
‘तव योग्य नहे’ बलि’ बले काड़ि’ निला ॥323॥
cc-antya-6.323.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was taking another morsel of food, Svarūpa Dāmodara caught Him by the hand and said, "It is not fit for You." Thus he forcibly took the food away.

lines: aiche svāda āra kona prasāde nā pāi"
devanagari: प्रभु बले, - “निति - निति नाना प्रसाद खाइ ।
ऐछे स्वाद आर कोन प्रसादे ना पाइ” ॥324॥
cc-antya-6.324.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "Of course, every day I eat varieties of prasāda, but I have never tasted such nice prasāda as that which Raghunātha is eating."

devanagari: एइ - मत महाप्रभु नाना लीला करे।
रघुनाथेर वैराग्य देखि सन्तोष अन्तरे ॥325॥
cc-antya-6.325.translation: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu performed many pastimes at Jagannātha Purī. Seeing the severe penances performed by Raghunātha dāsa in the renounced order, the Lord was greatly satisfied.

devanagari: आपन - उद्धार एइ रघुनाथ - दास ।
‘गौराङ्ग - स्तव - कल्प - वृक्षे’ करियाछेन प्रकाश ॥326॥
cc-antya-6.326.translation: In his own poem known as the Gaurāṅga-stava-kalpavṛkṣa, Raghunātha dāsa has described his personal deliverance.

lines: svarūpe yaḥ svīye kujanam api māṁ nyasya muditaḥ
dadau me gaurāṅgo hṛdaya udayan māṁ madayati
devanagari: महा - सम्पद्दावादपि पतितमुद्धृत्य कृपया स्वरूपे यः स्वी ये कुजनमपि मां न्यस्य मुदितः ।
उरो - गुञ्जा - हारं प्रियमपि च गोवर्धन - शिलां ददौ मे गौराङ्गो हृदय उदयन्मां मदयति ॥327॥
cc-antya-6.327.translation: "Although I am a fallen soul, the lowest of men, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu delivered me from the blazing forest fire of great material opulence by His mercy. He handed me over in great pleasure to Svarūpa Dāmodara, His personal associate. The Lord also gave me the garland of small conchshells that He wore on His chest and a stone from Govardhana Hill, although they were very dear to Him. That same Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu awakens within my heart and makes me mad after Him."

devanagari: एइ त कहि लुँ रघुनाथेर मिलन ।
इहा येइ शुने पाय चैतन्य - चरण ॥328॥
cc-antya-6.328.translation: Thus I have described the meeting of Raghunātha dāsa with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Anyone who hears about this incident attains the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: श्री - रूप - रघुनाथ - पदे यार आश ।
चैतन्य - चरितामृत कहे कृष्णदास ॥329॥
cc-antya-6.329.translation: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.

lines: yāha tumi, tomāra jyeṭhāre milāha āmāre
ye-mate bhāla haya karuna, bhāra diluṅ tāṅre
devanagari: याह तुमि, तोमार ज्येठारे मिलाह आमारे ।
ये - मते भाल हय करुन, भार दि लुँ ताँरे ॥33॥
cc-antya-6.33.translation: "Now you go arrange a meeting between me and your uncle. Let him do whatever he thinks best. I shall completely depend on his decision."

devanagari: रघुनाथ आसि’ तबे ज्येठारे मिलाइल ।
म्लेच्छ - सहित वश कैल - सब शान्त हैल ॥34॥
cc-antya-6.34.translation: Raghunātha dāsa arranged a meeting between his uncle and the caudhurī. He settled the matter, and everything was peaceful.

devanagari: एइ - मत रघुनाथेर वत्सरेक गेल ।
द्वितीय वत्सरे पलाइते मन कैल ॥35॥
cc-antya-6.35.translation: In this way Raghunātha dāsa passed one year exactly like a first-class business manager, but the next year he again decided to leave home.

lines: dūra haite pitā tāṅre ānila dhariyā
devanagari: रात्रे उठि’ एकेला चलिला पला ञा ।
दूर हैते पिता ताँरे आनिल धरिया ॥36॥
cc-antya-6.36.translation: He got up alone one night and left, but his father caught him in a distant place and brought him back.

lines: ei-mate bāre bāre palāya, dhari' āne
tabe tāṅra mātā kahe tāṅra pitā sane
devanagari: एइ - मते बारे बारे पलाय, धरि’ आने ।
तबे ताँर माता कहे ताँर पिता सने ॥37॥
cc-antya-6.37.translation: This became almost a daily affair. Raghunātha would run away from home, and his father would again bring him back. Then Raghunātha dāsa's mother began speaking to his father.

lines: tāṅra pitā kahe tāre nirviṇṇa hañā
devanagari: “पुत्र ‘बातुल’ हइल, इहाय राखह बान्धिया” ।
ताँर पिता कहे तारे निर्विण्ण हञा ॥38॥
cc-antya-6.38.translation: "Our son has become mad," she said. "Just keep him by binding him with ropes." His father, being very unhappy, replied to her as follows.

lines: e saba bāndhite nārileka yāṅra mana
devanagari: “इन्द्र - सम ऐश्वर्य, स्त्री अप्सरा - सम ।
ए सब बान्धिते नारिलेक याँर मन” ॥39॥
cc-antya-6.39.translation: "Raghunātha dāsa, our son, has opulences like Indra, the heavenly King, and his wife is as beautiful as an angel. Yet all this could not tie down his mind.

devanagari: यद्यपि अन्तरे कृष्ण - वियोग बाधये ।
बाहिरे ना प्रकाशय भक्त - दुःख - भये ॥4॥
cc-antya-6.4.translation: Although Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu felt pangs of separation from Kṛṣṇa, He did not manifest His feelings externally, for He feared the unhappiness of His devotees.

devanagari: दड़िर बन्धने ताँरे राखिबा के - मते? ।
जन्म - दाता पिता नारे ‘प्रारब्ध’ खण्डाइते ॥40॥
cc-antya-6.40.translation: "How then could we keep this boy home by binding him with ropes? It is not possible even for one's father to nullify the reactions of one's past activities.

devanagari: “चैतन्य - चन्द्रेर कृपा हाछे इँहारे ।
चैतन्य - चन्द्रेर ‘बातुल’ के राखिते पारे ?” ॥41॥
cc-antya-6.41.translation: "Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu has fully bestowed His mercy on him. Who can keep home such a madman of Caitanyacandra?"

devanagari: तबे रघुनाथ किछु विचारिला मने ।
नित्यानन्द - गोसाञि र पाश चलिला आर दिने ॥42॥
cc-antya-6.42.translation: Then Raghunātha dāsa considered something in his mind, and the next day he went to Nityānanda Gosāñi.

devanagari: पानिहाटि - ग्रामे पाइला प्रभुर दरशन ।
कीर्तनीया सेवक सङ्गे आर बहु - जन ॥43॥
cc-antya-6.43.translation: In the village of Pānihāṭi, Raghunātha dāsa obtained an interview with Nityānanda Prabhu, who was accompanied by many kīrtana performers, servants and others.

devanagari: गङ्गा - तीरे वृक्ष - मूले पिण्डार उपरे ।
वसियाछेन - येन कोटी सूर्योदय करे ॥44॥
cc-antya-6.44.translation: Sitting on a rock under a tree on the bank of the Ganges, Lord Nityānanda seemed as effulgent as hundreds and thousands of rising suns.

devanagari: तले उपरे बहु - भक्त हाछे वेष्टित ।
देखि’ प्रभुर प्रभाव रघुनाथ - विस्मित ॥45॥
cc-antya-6.45.translation: Many devotees sat on the ground surrounding Him. Seeing the influence of Nityānanda Prabhu, Raghunātha dāsa was astonished.

devanagari: दण्डवत् हञा सेइ पड़िला कत - दूरे ।
सेवक कहे , - ‘रघुनाथ दण्डवत् करे’ ॥46॥
cc-antya-6.46.translation: Raghunātha dāsa offered his obeisances by falling prostrate at a distant place, and the servant of Nityānanda Prabhu pointed out, "There is Raghunātha dāsa, offering You obeisances."

lines: āya, āya, āji tora karimu daṇḍana"
devanagari: शुनि’ प्रभु कहे, - “चोरा दिलि दरशन ।
आय, आय, आजि तोर करिमु दण्डन” ॥47॥
cc-antya-6.47.translation: Hearing this, Lord Nityānanda Prabhu said, "You are a thief. Now you have come to see Me. Come here, come here. Today I shall punish you!"

lines: prabhu bolāya, teṅho nikaṭe nā kare gamana
ākarṣiyā tāṅra māthe prabhu dharilā caraṇa
devanagari: प्रभु बोलाय, तेंहो निकटे ना करे गमन ।
आकर्षिया ताँर माथे प्रभु धरिला चरण ॥48॥
cc-antya-6.48.translation: The Lord called him, but Raghunātha dāsa did not go near the Lord. Then the Lord forcibly caught him and placed His lotus feet upon Raghunātha dāsa's head.

devanagari: कौतुकी नित्यानन्द सहजे दयामय ।
रघुनाथे कहे किछु हञा सदय ॥49॥
cc-antya-6.49.translation: Lord Nityānanda was by nature very merciful and funny. Being merciful, He spoke to Raghunātha dāsa as follows.

lines: tabe ye vaikalya prabhura varṇana nā yāya
devanagari: उत्कट विरह - दुःख यबे बाहिराय ।
तबे ने वैकल्य प्रभुर वर्णन ना याय ॥5॥
cc-antya-6.5.translation: The transformations undergone by the Lord when He manifested severe unhappiness due to separation from Kṛṣṇa cannot be described.

lines: "nikaṭe nā āisa, corā, bhāga' dūre dūre
devanagari: “निकटे ना आइस, चोरा, भाग’ दूरे दूरे ।
आजि लाग्पाञाछि, दण्डिमु तोमारे” ॥50॥
cc-antya-6.50.translation: "You are just like a thief, for instead of coming near, you stay away at a distant place. Now that I have captured you, I shall punish you.

lines: dadhi, ciḍā bhakṣaṇa karāha mora gaṇe"
devanagari: “दधि, चिड़ा भक्षण कराह मोर गणे” ।
शुनि’ आनन्दित हैल रघुनाथ मने ॥51॥
cc-antya-6.51.translation: "Make a festival and feed all My associates yogurt and chipped rice." Hearing this, Raghunātha dāsa was greatly pleased.

lines: bhakṣya-dravya loka saba grāma haite āne
devanagari: सेइ - क्षणे निज - लोक पाठाइला ग्रामे ।
भक्ष्य - द्रव्य लोक सब ग्राम हैते आने ॥52॥
cc-antya-6.52.translation: Raghunātha dāsa immediately sent his own men to the village to purchase all kinds of eatables and bring them back.

lines: ciḍā, dadhi, dugdha, sandeśa, āra cini, kalā
devanagari: चिड़ा, दधि, दुग्ध, सन्देश, आर चिनि, कला ।
सब द्रव्य आना ञा चौदिके धरिला ॥53॥
cc-antya-6.53.translation: Raghunātha dāsa brought chipped rice, yogurt, milk, sweetmeats, sugar, bananas and other eatables and placed them all around.

devanagari: ‘महोत्सव’ - नाम शुनि’ ब्राह्मण - सज्जन ।
आसिते लागिल लोक असङ्ख्य - गणन ॥54॥
cc-antya-6.54.translation: As soon as they heard that a festival was going to be held, all kinds of brāhmaṇas and other gentlemen began to arrive. Thus there were innumerable people.

devanagari: आर ग्रामान्तर हैते सामग्री आनिल ।
शत दुइ - चारि होल्ना ताँहा आनाइल ॥55॥
cc-antya-6.55.translation: Seeing the crowd increasing, Raghunātha dāsa arranged to get more eatables from other villages. He also brought two to four hundred large, round earthen pots.

lines: baḍa baḍa mṛt-kuṇḍikā ānāila pāṅca sāte
eka vipra prabhu lāgi' ciḍā bhijāya tāte
devanagari: बड़ बड़ मृत्कुण्डिका आनाइल पाँच साते ।
एक विप्र प्रभु लागि’ चिड़ा भिजाय ताते ॥56॥
cc-antya-6.56.translation: He also obtained five or seven especially large earthen pots, and in these pots a brāhmaṇa began soaking chipped rice for the satisfaction of Lord Nityānanda.

lines: ardheka chānila dadhi, cini, kalā diyā
devanagari: एक - ठाञि तप्त - दुग्धे चिड़ा भिजाञा ।
अर्धेक छानिल दधि, चिनि, कला दिया ॥57॥
cc-antya-6.57.translation: In one place, chipped rice was soaked in hot milk in each of the large pots. Then half the rice was mixed with yogurt, sugar and bananas.

lines: cāṅpā-kalā, cini, ghṛta, karpūra tāte dila
devanagari: आर अर्धेक घनावृत - दुग्धेते छानिल ।
चाँपा - कला, चिनि, घृत, कर्पूर ताते दिल ॥58॥
cc-antya-6.58.translation: The other half was mixed with condensed milk and a special type of banana known as cāṅpā-kalā. Then sugar, clarified butter and camphor were added.

lines: dhuti pari' prabhu yadi piṇḍāte vasilā
devanagari: धुति परि’ प्रभु यदि पिण्डाते वसिला ।
सात - कुण्डी विप्र ताँर आगेते धरिला ॥59॥
cc-antya-6.59.translation: After Nityānanda Prabhu had changed His cloth for a new one and sat on a raised platform, the brāhmaṇa brought before Him the seven huge pots.

devanagari: रामानन्देर कृष्ण - कथा, स्वरूपेर गान ।
विरह - वेदनाय प्रभुर राखये पराण ॥6॥
cc-antya-6.6.translation: When the Lord acutely felt pangs of separation from Kṛṣṇa, only Śrī Rāma-nanda Rāya's talk about Kṛṣṇa and the sweet songs of Svarūpa Dāmodara kept Him alive.

devanagari: चबुतरा - उपरे व्रत प्रभुर निज - गणे ।
बड़ बड़ लोक वसिला मण्डली - रचने ॥60॥
cc-antya-6.60.translation: On that platform, all the most important associates of Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu, as well as other important men, sat down in a circle around the Lord.

devanagari: रामदास, सुन्दरानन्द, दास - गदाधर ।
मुरारि, कमलाकर, सदाशिव, पुरन्दर ॥61॥
cc-antya-6.61.translation: Among them were Rāmadāsa, Sundarānanda, Gadādhara dāsa, Murāri, Kamalākara, Sadāśiva and Purandara.

devanagari: धनञ्जय, जगदीश, परमेश्वर - दास ।
महेश, गौरीदास, होड़ - कृष्णदास ॥62॥
cc-antya-6.62.translation: Dhanañjaya, Jagadīśa, Parameśvara dāsa, Maheśa, Gaurīdāsa and Hoḍa Kṛṣṇadāsa were also there.

lines: upare vasilā saba, ke kare gaṇana?
devanagari: उद्धारण दत्त आदि यत निज - गण ।
उपरे वसिला सब, के करे गणन ? ॥63॥
cc-antya-6.63.translation: Similarly, Uddhāraṇa Datta Ṭhākura and many other personal associates of the Lord sat on the raised platform with Nityānanda Prabhu. No one could count them all.

lines: śuni' paṇḍita bhaṭṭācārya yata vipra āilā
mānya kari' prabhu sabāre upare vasāilā
devanagari: शुनि’ पण्डित भट्टाचार्य यत विप्र आइला ।
मान्य करि’ प्रभु सबारे उपरे वसाइला ॥64॥
cc-antya-6.64.translation: Hearing about the festival, all kinds of learned scholars, brāhmaṇas and priests went there. Lord Nityānanda Prabhu honored them and made them sit on the raised platform with Him.

lines: dui dui mṛt-kuṇḍikā sabāra āge dila
devanagari: दुइ दुइ मृत्कुण्डिका सबार आगे दिल ।
एके दुग्ध - चिड़ा, आरे दधि - चिड़ा कैल ॥65॥
cc-antya-6.65.translation: Everyone was offered two earthen pots. In one was put chipped rice with condensed milk and in the other chipped rice with yogurt.

lines: maṇḍalī-bandhe vasilā, tāra nā haya gaṇane
devanagari: आर यत लोक सब चौतरा - तलाने ।
मण्डली - बन्धे वसिला, तार ना हय गणने ॥66॥
cc-antya-6.66.translation: All the other people sat in groups around the platform. No one could count how many people there were.

lines: ekeka janāre dui dui holnā dila
devanagari: एकेक जनारे दुइ दुइ होल्ना दिल ।
दधि - चिड़ा दुग्ध - चिड़ा, दुइते भिजाइल ॥67॥
cc-antya-6.67.translation: Each and every one of them was supplied two earthen pots-one of chipped rice soaked in yogurt and the other of chipped rice soaked in condensed milk.

lines: kona kona vipra upare sthāna nā pāñā
dui holnāya ciḍā bhijāya gaṅgā-tīre giyā
devanagari: कोन कोन विप्र उपरे स्थान ना पाञा ।
दुइ होल्नाय चिड़ा भिजाय गङ्गा - तीरे गिया ॥68॥
cc-antya-6.68.translation: Some of the brāhmaṇas, not having gotten a place on the platform, went to the bank of the Ganges with their two earthen pots and soaked their chipped rice there.

lines: tīre sthāna nā pāñā āra kata jana
devanagari: तीरे स्थान ना पाञा आर कत जन ।
जले नामि’ दधि - चिड़ा करये भक्षण ॥69॥
cc-antya-6.69.translation: Others, who could not get a place even on the bank of the Ganges, got down into the water and began eating their two kinds of chipped rice.

lines: dine prabhu nānā-saṅge haya anya mana
devanagari: दिने प्रभु नाना - सङ्गे हय अन्य मन ।
रात्रि - काले बाड़े प्रभुर विरह - वेदन ॥7॥
cc-antya-6.7.translation: Because the Lord associated with various devotees during the day, His mind was somewhat diverted, but at night the pangs of separation from Kṛṣṇa increased very rapidly.

lines: keha upare, keha tale, keha gaṅgā-tīre
devanagari: केह उपरे, केह तले, केह गङ्गा - तीरे ।
बिश - जन तिन - ठाञि परिवेशन करे ॥70॥
cc-antya-6.70.translation: Thus some sat on the platform, some at the base of the platform, and some on the bank of the Ganges, and they were all supplied two pots each by the twenty men who distributed the food.

devanagari: हेन - काले आइला तथा राघव पण्डित ।
हासिते लागिला देखि’ हञा विस्मित ॥71॥
cc-antya-6.71.translation: At that time, Rāghava Paṇḍita arrived there. Seeing the situation, he began to laugh in great surprise.

lines: prabhure āge diyā bhakta-gaṇe bāṅṭi dila
devanagari: नि - सक्ड़ि नाना - मत प्रसाद आनिल ।
प्रभुरे आगे दिया भक्त - गणे बाँटि दिल ॥72॥
cc-antya-6.72.translation: He brought many other kinds of food cooked in ghee and offered to the Lord. This prasāda he first placed before Lord Nityānanda and then distributed among the devotees.

lines: tumi ihāṅ utsava kara, ghare prasāda rahila"
devanagari: प्रभुरे कहे, - “तोमा ला गि’ भोग लागाइल ।
तुमि इहाँ उत्सव कर, घरे प्रसाद रहिल” ॥73॥
cc-antya-6.73.translation: Rāghava Paṇḍita said to Lord Nityānanda, "For You, sir, I have already offered food to the Deity, but You are engaged in a festival here, and so the food is lying there untouched."

lines: rātrye tomāra ghare prasāda karimu bhakṣaṇa
devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - “ए - द्रव्य दिने करिये भोजन ।
रात्र्ये तोमार घरे प्रसाद करिमु भक्षण” ॥74॥
cc-antya-6.74.translation: Lord Nityānanda replied, "Let Me eat all this food here during the day, and I shall eat at your home at night.

devanagari: “गोप - जाति आमि बहु गोप - गण सङ्गे ।
आमि सुख पाइ एइ पुलिन - भोजन - रङ्गे” ॥75॥
cc-antya-6.75.translation: "I belong to a community of cowherd boys, and therefore I generally have many cowherd associates with Me. I am happy when we eat together in a picnic like this by the sandy bank of the river."

devanagari: राघवे वसा ञा दुइ कुण्डी देओयाइला ।
राघव द्विविध चिड़ा ताते भिजाइला ॥76॥
cc-antya-6.76.translation: Lord Nityānanda made Rāghava Paṇḍita sit down and had two pots delivered to him also. There were two kinds of chipped rice soaked in them.

devanagari: सकल - लोकेर चिड़ा पूर्ण यबे हइल ।
ध्याने तबे प्रभु महाप्रभुरे आनिल ॥77॥
cc-antya-6.77.translation: When chipped rice had been served to everyone, Lord Nityānanda Prabhu, in meditation, brought Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: tāṅre lañā sabāra ciḍā dekhite lāgilā
devanagari: महाप्रभु आइला देखि निताई उठिला ।
ताँरे लञा सबार चिड़ा देखिते लागिला ॥78॥
cc-antya-6.78.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu arrived, Lord Nityānanda Prabhu stood up. They then saw how the others were enjoying the chipped rice with yogurt and condensed milk.

lines: sakala kuṇḍīra, holnāra ciḍāra eka eka grāsa
devanagari: सकल कुण्डीर, होल्नार चिड़ार एक एक ग्रास ।
महाप्रभुर मुखे देन करि’ परिहास ॥79॥
cc-antya-6.79.translation: From each and every pot, Lord Nityānanda Prabhu took one morsel of chipped rice and pushed it into the mouth of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu as a joke.

lines: tāṅra sukha-hetu saṅge rahe dui janā
devanagari: ताँर सुख - हेतु सङ्गे रहे दुइ जना ।
कृष्ण - रस - श्लोक - गीते करेन सान्त्वना ॥8॥
cc-antya-6.8.translation: Two people—Rāmānanda Rāya and Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī—stayed with the Lord to pacify Him by reciting various verses about Kṛṣṇa's pastimes and by singing appropriate songs for His satisfaction.

lines: hāsi' mahāprabhu āra eka grāsa lañā
tāṅra mukhe diyā khāoyāya hāsiyā hāsiyā
devanagari: हासि’ महाप्रभु आर एक ग्रास लञा ।
ताँर मुखे दिया खाओयाय हासिया हासिया ॥80॥
cc-antya-6.80.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, also smiling, took a morsel of food, pushed it into the mouth of Nityānanda and laughed as He made Lord Nityānanda eat it.

devanagari: एइ - मत निताई बुले सकल मण्डले ।
दाण्डा ञा रङ्ग देखे वैष्णव सकले ॥81॥
cc-antya-6.81.translation: In this way Lord Nityānanda was walking through all the groups of eaters, and all the Vaiṣṇavas standing there were seeing the fun.

lines: ki kariyā beḍāya,—ihā keha nāhi jāne
mahāprabhura darśana pā ya kona bhāgyavāne
devanagari: कि करिया बेड़ाय , - इहा केह नाहि जा ने ।
महाप्रभुर दर्शन पाय कोन भाग्यवाने ॥82॥
cc-antya-6.82.translation: No one could understand what Nityānanda Prabhu was doing as He walked about. Some, however, who were very fortunate, could see that Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was also present.

lines: cāri kuṇḍī āroyā ciḍā rākhilā ḍāhine
devanagari: तबे हासि नित्यानन्द वसिला आसने ।
चारि कुण्डी आरोया चिड़ा राखिला डाहिने ॥83॥
cc-antya-6.83.translation: Then Nityānanda Prabhu smiled and sat down. On His right side He kept four pots of chipped rice that had not been made from boiled paddy.

lines: dui bhāi tabe ciḍā khāite lāgilā
devanagari: आसन दिया महाप्रभुरे ताहाँ वसाइला ।
दुइ भाइ तबे चिड़ा खाइते लागिला ॥84॥
cc-antya-6.84.translation: Lord Nityānanda offered Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu a place and had Him sit down. Then together the two brothers began eating chipped rice.

devanagari: देखि’ नित्यानन्द - प्रभु आनन्दित हैला ।
कत कत भावावेश प्रकाश करिला ॥85॥
cc-antya-6.85.translation: Seeing Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu eating with Him, Lord Nityānanda Prabhu became very happy and exhibited varieties of ecstatic love.

devanagari: आज्ञा दिला , - “हरि ब लि’ करह भोज न”।
‘हरि’ ‘हरि’ - ध्वनि उठि’ भरिल भुवन ॥86॥
cc-antya-6.86.translation: Lord Nityānanda Prabhu ordered, "All of you eat, chanting the holy name of Hari." Immediately the holy names "Hari, Hari" resounded, filling the entire universe.

devanagari: ‘हरि’ ‘हरि’ बलि’ वैष्णव करये भोजन ।
पुलिन - भोजन सबार हइल स्मरण ॥87॥
cc-antya-6.87.translation: When all the Vaiṣṇavas were chanting the holy names"Hari, Hari" and eating, they remembered how Kṛṣṇa and Balarāma ate with Their companions the cowherd boys on the bank of the Yamunā.

devanagari: नित्यानन्द महाप्रभु कृपालु, उदार ।
रघुनाथेर भाग्ये एत कैला अङ्गीकार ॥88॥
cc-antya-6.88.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and Lord Nityānanda Prabhu are extremely merciful and liberal. It was Raghunātha dāsa's good fortune that They accepted all these dealings.

devanagari: नित्यानन्द - प्रभाव - कृपा जानिबे को जन? ।
महाप्रभु आनि’ कराय पुलिन - भोजन ॥89॥
cc-antya-6.89.translation: Who can understand the influence and mercy of Lord Nityānanda Prabhu? He is so powerful that He induced Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to come eat chipped rice on the bank of the Ganges.

devanagari: सुबल यैछे पूर्वे कृष्ण - सुखेर सहाय ।
गौर - सुख - दान - हेतु तैछे राम - राय ॥9॥
cc-antya-6.9.translation: Previously, when Lord Kṛṣṇa was personally present, Subala, one of His cowherd boy friends, gave Him happiness when He felt separation from Rādhārāṇī. Similarly, Rāmānanda Rāya helped give happiness to Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: श्री - रामदासादि गोप प्रेमाविष्ट हैला ।
गङ्गा - तीरे ‘यमुना - पुलिन’ ज्ञान कैला ॥90॥
cc-antya-6.90.translation: All the confidential devotees who were cowherd boys, headed by Śrī Rāmadāsa, were absorbed in ecstatic love. They thought the bank of the Ganges to be the bank of the Yamunā.

lines: ciḍā, dadhi, sandeśa, kalā ānila vecite
devanagari: महोत्सव शुनि’ पसारि नाना - ग्राम हैते ।
चिड़ा, दधि, सन्देश, कला आनिल वेचिते ॥91॥
cc-antya-6.91.translation: When the shopkeepers of many other villages heard about the festival, they arrived there to sell chipped rice, yogurt, sweetmeats and bananas.

lines: yata dravya lañā āise, saba mūlya kari' laya
tāra dravya mūlya diyā tāhāre khāoyāya
devanagari: यत द्रव्य लञा आइसे, सब मूल्य करि’ लय ।
तार द्रव्य मूल्य दिया ताहारे खाओयाय ॥92॥
cc-antya-6.92.translation: As they came, bringing all kinds of food, Raghunātha dāsa purchased it all. He gave them the price for their goods and later fed them the very same food.

lines: kautuka dekhite āila yata yata jana
sei ciḍā, dadhi, kalā karila bhakṣaṇa
devanagari: कौतुक देखिते आइल यत यत जन ।
सेइ चिड़ा, दधि, कला करिल भक्षण ॥93॥
cc-antya-6.93.translation: Anyone who came to see how these funny things were going on was also fed chipped rice, yogurt and bananas.

devanagari: भोजन क रि’ नित्यानन्द आचमन कैला ।
चारि कुण्डीर अवशेष रघुनाथे दिला ॥94॥
cc-antya-6.94.translation: After Lord Nityānanda Prabhu finished eating, He washed His hands and mouth and gave Raghunātha dāsa the food remaining in the four pots.

lines: grāse-grāse kari' vipra saba bhakte dila
devanagari: आर तिन कुण्डिकाय अवशेष छिल ।
ग्रासे - ग्रासे क रि’ विप्र सब भक्ते दिल ॥95॥
cc-antya-6.95.translation: There was food remaining in the three other big pots of Lord Nityānanda, and a brāhmaṇa distributed it to all the devotees, giving a morsel to each.

devanagari: पुष्य - माला विप्न आनि’ प्रभु - गले दिल ।
चन्दन आनिया प्रभुर सर्वाङ्गे लेपिल ॥96॥
cc-antya-6.96.translation: Then a brāhmaṇa brought a flower garland, placed the garland on Nityānanda Prabhu's neck and smeared sandalwood pulp all over His body.

devanagari: सेवक ताम्बूल लञा करे समर्पण ।
हासिया हासिया प्रभु करये चर्वण ॥97॥
cc-antya-6.97.translation: When a servant brought betel nuts and offered them to Lord Nityānanda, the Lord smiled and chewed them.

lines: śrī-haste prabhu tāhā sabākāre bāṅṭi' dila
devanagari: माला - चन्दन - ताम्बूल शेष ये आछिल ।
श्री - हस्ते प्रभु ताहा सबाकारे बाँटि’ दिल ॥98॥
cc-antya-6.98.translation: With His own hands Lord Nityānanda Prabhu distributed to all the devotees whatever flower garlands, sandalwood pulp and betel nuts remained.

devanagari: आनन्दित रघुनाथ प्रभुर ‘शेष’ पाञा ।
आपनार गण - सह खाइला बाँटिया ॥99॥
cc-antya-6.99.translation: After receiving the remnants of food left by Lord Nityānanda Prabhu, Raghunātha dāsa, who was greatly happy, ate some and distributed the rest among his own associates.

devanagari: चैतन्य - चरणाम्भोज - मकरन्द - लिहो भजे ।
येषां प्रसाद - मात्रेण पामरोऽप्यमरो भवेत् ॥1॥
cc-antya-7.1.translation: Let me offer my respectful obeisances unto the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Simply by the causeless mercy of the devotees engaged in licking honey from His lotus feet, even a fallen soul becomes eternally liberated.

devanagari: येषां संस्मरणात्पुंसां सद्यः शुध्यन्ति वै गृहाः ।
किं पुनर्दर्शन - स्पर्श - पाद - शौचासनादिभिः ॥10॥
cc-antya-7.10.translation: "One can immediately purify his entire house simply by remembering exalted personalities, to say nothing of directly seeing them, touching their lotus feet, washing their feet or offering them places to sit.'

devanagari: प्रत्यह वल्लभ - भट्ट आइसे प्रभु - स्थाने ।
‘उद्ग्राहादि’ प्राय करे आचार्यादि - सने ॥100॥
cc-antya-7.100.translation: Every day, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa would come to the place of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to engage in unnecessary arguments with Advaita Ācārya and other great personalities, such as Svarūpa Dāmodara.

devanagari: येइ किछु करे भट्ट ‘सिद्धान्त’ स्थापन ।
शुनितेइ आचार्य ताहा करेन खण्डन ॥101॥
cc-antya-7.101.translation: Whatever conclusions Vallabha Bhaṭṭa eagerly presented were refuted by personalities like Advaita Ācārya.

devanagari: आचार्यादि - आगे भट्ट यबे यबे याय ।
राजहंस - मध्ये येन रहे बक - प्राय ॥102॥
cc-antya-7.102.translation: Whenever Vallabha Bhaṭṭa entered the society of devotees, headed by Advaita Ācārya, he was like a duck in a society of white swans.

devanagari: एक - दिन भट्ट पुछिल आचार्येरे ।
“जीव - ‘प्रकृति’ ‘पति’ करि’ मानये कृष्णेरे” ॥103॥
cc-antya-7.103.translation: One day Vallabha Bhaṭṭa said to Advaita Ācārya, "Every living entity is female [prakṛti] and considers Kṛṣṇa her husband [pati].

lines: pati-vratā hañā patira nāma nāhi laya
devanagari: “पति - व्रता ह ञा पतिर नाम नाहि लय ।
तोमरा कृष्णा - नाम लह, - कोन् धर्म हय?” ॥104॥
cc-antya-7.104.translation: "It is the duty of a chaste wife, devoted to her husband, not to utter her husband's name, but all of you chant the name of Kṛṣṇa. How can this be called a religious principle?"

lines: iṅhāre puchaha, iṅha karibena ihāra samādhāna
devanagari: आचा र्य कहे, - “आगे तोमार ‘धर्म’ मूर्तिमान् ।
इँहारे पुछह, इँह करिबेन इहार समाधान” ॥105॥
cc-antya-7.105.translation: Advaita Ācārya responded, "In front of you is Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the personification of religious principles. You should ask Him, for He will give you the proper answer."

lines: śuni' prabhu kahena,—"tumi nā jāna dharma-marma
devanagari: शुनि’ प्रभु कहेन, - “तुमि ना जान धर्म - मर्म” ।
स्वामि - आज्ञा पाले , - एइ पति - व्रता - धर्म ॥106॥
cc-antya-7.106.translation: Hearing this, Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "My dear Vallabha Bhaṭṭa, you do not know religious principles. Actually, the first duty of a chaste woman is to carry out the order of her husband.

lines: patira ājñā pati-vratā nā pāre laṅghite
devanagari: पतिर आज्ञा , - निरन्तर ताँर नाम लइते ।
पतिर आज्ञा पति - व्रता ना पारे लङ्घिते ॥107॥
cc-antya-7.107.translation: "The order of Kṛṣṇa is to chant His name incessantly. Therefore one who is chaste and adherent to the husband Kṛṣṇa must chant the Lord's name, for she cannot deny the husband's order.

devanagari: “अतएव नाम लय, नामेर ‘फल’ पाय ।
नामेर फले कृष्ण - पदे ‘प्रेम’ उपजाय” ॥108॥
cc-antya-7.108.translation: "Following this religious principle, a pure devotee of Lord Kṛṣṇa always chants the holy name. As a result of this, he gets the fruit of ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa."

lines: ghare yāi' mane duḥkhe karena cintana
devanagari: शुनिया वल्लभ - भट्ट हैल निर्वचन ।
घरे याइ’ मने दुःखे करेन चिन्तन ॥109॥
cc-antya-7.109.translation: Hearing this, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa was speechless. He returned home greatly unhappy and began to consider thus.

devanagari: कलि - कालेर धर्म - कृष्ण - नाम - सङ्कीर्तन ।
कृष्ण - शक्ति विना नहे तार प्रवर्तन ॥11॥
cc-antya-7.11.translation: "The fundamental religious system in the age of Kali is the chanting of the holy name of Kṛṣṇa. Unless empowered by Kṛṣṇa, one cannot propagate the saṅkīrtana movement.

lines: eka-dina upare yadi haya mora vāt
devanagari: नित्य आमार एइ सभाय हय कक्षा - पात ।
एक - दिन उपरे यदि हय मोर बात् ॥110॥
cc-antya-7.110-111.translation: "Every day I am defeated in this assembly. If by chance I am one day victorious, that will be a great source of happiness for me, and all my shame will go away. But what means shall I adopt to establish my statements?"

lines: āra dina āsi' vasilā prabhure namaskari'
sabhāte kahena kichu mane garva kari'
devanagari: आर दिन आ सि’ वसिला प्रभुरे नमस्करि’ ।
सभाते कहेन किछु मने गर्व करि’ ॥112॥
cc-antya-7.112.translation: The next day when he came to the assembly of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, he sat down after offering obeisances to the Lord and said something with great pride.

devanagari: भागवते स्वा मीर व्याख्यान कैराछि खण्डन ।
लइते ना पारि ताँर व्याख्यान - वचन ॥113॥
cc-antya-7.113.translation: "In my commentary on Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam," he said, "I have refuted the explanations of Śrīdhara Svāmī. I cannot accept his explanations.

lines: sei vyākhyā karena yāhāṅ yei paḍe āni'
devanagari: “सेइ व्याख्या करेन याहाँ येइ पड़े आनि ।
एक - वाक्यता नाहि, ताते ‘स्वामी’ नाहि मानि” ॥114॥
cc-antya-7.114.translation: "Whatever Śrīdhara Svāmī reads he explains according to the circumstances. Therefore he is inconsistent in his explanations and cannot be accepted as an authority."

lines: prabhu hāsi' kahe,—"svāmī nā māne yei jana
devanagari: प्रभु हासि’ कहे, - “स्वामी ना माने येइ जन ।
वेश्यार भितरे तारे करिये गण न” ॥115॥
cc-antya-7.115.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu smilingly replied, "One who does not accept the svāmī [husband] as an authority I consider a prostitute."

devanagari: एत क हि’ महाप्रभु मौन धरिला ।
शुनिया सबार मने सन्तोष हइला ॥116॥
cc-antya-7.116.translation: After saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was very grave. All the devotees present derived great satisfaction from hearing this statement.

devanagari: जगतेर हित ला गि’ गौर - अवतार ।
अन्तरेर अभिमान जानेन ताहार ॥117॥
cc-antya-7.117.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu descended as an incarnation for the benefit of the entire world. Thus He knew the mind of Vallabha Bhaṭṭa very well.

devanagari: नाना अवज्ञाने भट्टे शोधेन भगवान् ।
कृष्ण यैछे खण्डिलेन इन्द्रेर अभिमान ॥118॥
cc-antya-7.118.translation: By various hints and refutations, Lord Caitanya, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, corrected Vallabha Bhaṭṭa exactly as Kṛṣṇa had cut down the false pride of Indra.

lines: garva cūrṇa haile, pāche ughāḍe nayane
devanagari: अज्ञ जीव निज - ‘हिते’ ‘अहित क रि’ माने ।
गर्व चूर्ण हैले, पाछे उघाड़े नयने ॥119॥
cc-antya-7.119.translation: An ignorant living being does not recognize his actual profit. Because of ignorance and material pride, he sometimes considers profit a loss, but when his pride is cut down he can actually see his true benefit.

devanagari: ताहा प्रवर्ताइला तुमि, - एइ त ‘प्रमाण’ ।
कृष्ण - शक्ति धर तुमि, - इथे नाहि आन ॥12॥
cc-antya-7.12.translation: "You have spread the saṅkīrtana movement of Kṛṣṇa consciousness. Therefore it is evident that You have been empowered by Lord Kṛṣṇa. There is no question about it.

lines: ghare āsi' rātrye bhaṭṭa cintite lāgila
devanagari: घरे आ सि’ रात्र्ये भट्ट चिन्तिते लागिल ।
“पूर्वे प्रयागे मोरे महा - कृपा कैल” ॥120॥
cc-antya-7.120.translation: Returning home that night, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa thought, "Previously, at Prayāga, Lord Caitanya was very kind to me.

lines: ebe kene prabhura mote phiri' gela mana?
devanagari: स्वगण - सहिते मोर मानिला निमन्त्रण ।
एबे केने प्रभुर मोते फिरि’ गेल मन ? ॥121॥
cc-antya-7.121.translation: "He accepted my invitation with His other devotees, and He was kind to me. Why has He now changed so much here at Jagannātha Purī?

devanagari: ‘आमि जिति’, - एइ गर्व - शून्य हउक इँहार चित ।
ईश्वर - स्वभाव , - करेन सबाकार हित ॥122॥
cc-antya-7.122.translation: "Being very proud of my learning, I am thinking, 'Let me become victorious.' Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, however, is trying to purify me by nullifying this false pride, for a characteristic of the Supreme Personality of Godhead is that He acts for everyone's welfare.

lines: se garva khaṇḍāite mora karena apamāna
devanagari: आपना जानाइते आमि करि अभिमान ।
से गर्व खण्डाइते मोर करेन अपमान ॥123॥
cc-antya-7.123.translation: "I am falsely proud, advertising myself as a learned scholar. Therefore Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu insults me just to favor me by cutting down this false pride.

lines: kṛṣṇera upare kaila yena indra mahā-mūrkha"
devanagari: आमार ‘हित’ करेन, - इहो आमि मानि ‘दुःख’ ।
कृष्णेर उपरे कैल येन इन्द्र महा - मूर्ख ॥124॥
cc-antya-7.124.translation: "He is actually acting for my benefit, although I interpret His actions as insults. This is exactly like the incident in which Lord Kṛṣṇa cut down Indra, the great, puffed-up fool, to correct him."

lines: eta cinti' prāte āsi' prabhura caraṇe
dainya kari' stuti kari' la-ila śaraṇe
devanagari: एत चिन्ति’ प्राते आ सि’ प्रभुर चरणे ।
दैन्य क रि’ स्तुति करि’ लइल शरणे ॥125॥
cc-antya-7.125.translation: Thinking in this way, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa approached Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu the next morning, and in great humility, offering many prayers, he sought shelter and surrendered at the lotus feet of the Lord.

lines: tomāra āge mūrkha āmi pāṇḍitya prakāśiluṅ
devanagari: “आमि अज्ञ जीव , - अज्ञोचित कर्म कैलुँ ।
तोमार आगे मूर्ख आमि पाण्डित्य प्रकाशिलुँ” ॥126॥
cc-antya-7.126.translation: Vallabha Bhaṭṭa admitted, "I am a great fool, and indeed I have acted like a fool by trying to demonstrate to You my learning.

devanagari: तुमि - ईश्वर, निजोचित कृपा ये करिला ।
अपमान क रि’ सर्व गर्व खण्डाइला ॥127॥
cc-antya-7.127.translation: "My dear Lord, You are the Supreme Personality of Godhead. You have showed mercy to me in a way just befitting Your position by insulting me to cut down all my false pride.

lines: indra yena kṛṣṇera nindā karila ajñāne
devanagari: आमि - अज्ञ, ‘हित’ - स्थाने मानि ‘अपमाने’ ।
इन्द्र येन कृष्णेर निन्दा करिल अज्ञाने ॥128॥
cc-antya-7.128.translation: "I am an ignorant fool, for I interpret as an insult what is meant for my benefit, just like King Indra, who out of ignorance tried to surpass Kṛṣṇa, the Supreme Lord.

devanagari: तोमार कृपा - अञ्जने एबे गर्व - आन्ध्य गेल ।
तुमि एत कृपा कैला, - एबे ‘ज्ञान’ हैल ॥129॥
cc-antya-7.129.translation: "My dear Lord, You have cured the blindness of my false pride by smearing my eyes with the ointment of Your mercy. You have bestowed so much mercy upon me that my ignorance is now gone.

lines: yei tomā dekhe, sei kṛṣṇa-preme bhāse
devanagari: जगते करिला तुमि कृष्ण - नाम प्रकाशे ।
येइ तोमा देखे, सेइ कृष्ण - प्रेमे भासे ॥13॥
cc-antya-7.13.translation: "You have manifested the holy name of Kṛṣṇa throughout the entire world. Anyone who sees You is immediately absorbed in ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa.

lines: kṛpā kari' mora māthe dharaha caraṇa"
devanagari: “अपराध कैनु, क्षम, लइनु शरण ।
कृपा करि’ मोर माथे धरह चरण” ॥130॥
cc-antya-7.130.translation: "My dear Lord, I have committed offenses. Please excuse me. I seek shelter of You. Please be merciful unto me by placing Your lotus feet on my head."

devanagari: प्रभु कहे “तुमि ‘पण्डि त’ ‘महा - भागव त’ ।
दुइ - गुण याहाँ, ताहाँ नाहि गर्व - पर्वत ॥131॥
cc-antya-7.131.translation: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "You are both a greatly learned scholar and a great devotee. Wherever there are two such attributes, there cannot be a mountain of false pride.

devanagari: श्रीधर - स्वामी निन्दि’ निज - टीका कर! ।
श्रीधर - स्वामी नाहि मान’, - एत ‘गर्व’ धर! ॥132॥
cc-antya-7.132.translation: "You have dared criticize Śrīdhara Svāmī, and you have begun your own commentary on Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, not accepting his authority. That is your false pride.

devanagari: श्रीधर - स्वामि - प्रसादे ‘भागव त’ जानि ।
जगद्गुरु श्रीधर - स्वामी ‘गुरु’ करि’ मानि ॥133॥
cc-antya-7.133.translation: "Śrīdhara Svāmī is the spiritual master of the entire world because by his mercy we can understand Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam. I therefore accept him as a spiritual master.

devanagari: श्रीधर - उपरे गर्वे ये किछु लिखिबे ।
‘अर्थ - व्यस्त’ लिखन सेइ, लोके ना मानिबे ॥134॥
cc-antya-7.134.translation: "Whatever you might write due to false pride, trying to surpass Śrīdhara Svāmī, would carry a contrary purport. Therefore no one would pay attention to it.

lines: saba loka mānya kari' karibe grahaṇa
devanagari: श्रीधरेर अनुगत ये करे लिखन ।
सब लोक मान्य क रि’ करिबे ग्रहण ॥135॥
cc-antya-7.135.translation: "One who comments on Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam following in the footsteps of Śrīdhara Svāmī will be honored and accepted by everyone.

devanagari: श्रीधरानुगत कर भागवत - व्याख्यान ।
अभिमान छाड़ि’ भज कृष्ण भगवान् ॥136॥
cc-antya-7.136.translation: "Put forth your explanation of Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam following in the footsteps of Śrīdhara Svāmī. Giving up your false pride, worship the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: “अपराध छाड़ि’ कर कृष्ण - सङ्कीर्तन ।
अचिरात् पाबे तबे कृष्णेर चरण” ॥137॥
cc-antya-7.137.translation: "Abandoning your offenses, chant the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra, the holy names of the Lord. Then very soon you will achieve shelter at the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa."

devanagari: भट्ट कहे , - “यदि मोरे हइला प्रसन्न ।
एक - दिन पुनः मोर मान’ निमन्त्रण” ॥138॥
cc-antya-7.138.translation: Vallabha Bhaṭṭa Ācārya requested Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, "If You are actually pleased with me, please accept my invitation once again."

devanagari: प्रभु अवतीर्ण हैला जगत्तारिते ।
मानिलेन निमन्त्रण, तारे सुख दिते ॥139॥
cc-antya-7.139.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who had descended to deliver the entire universe, accepted the invitation of Vallabha Bhaṭṭa just to give him happiness.

devanagari: प्रेम - परकाश नहे कृष्ण - शक्ति विने ।
‘कृष्ण’ - एक प्रेम - दाता, शास्त्र - प्रमाणे ॥14॥
cc-antya-7.14.translation: "Without being especially empowered by Kṛṣṇa, one cannot manifest ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa, for Kṛṣṇa is the only one who gives ecstatic love. That is the verdict of all revealed scriptures.

lines: daṇḍa kari' kare tāra hṛdaya śodhana
devanagari: जगतेर ‘हित’ हउक - एइ प्रभुर मन ।
दण्ड क रि’ करे तार हृदय शोधन ॥140॥
cc-antya-7.140.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is always eager to see everyone in the material world happy. Therefore sometimes He chastises someone just to purify his heart.

devanagari: स्वगण - सहित प्रभुर निमन्त्रण कैला ।
महाप्रभु तारे तबे प्रसन्न हुइला ॥141॥
cc-antya-7.141.translation: When Vallabha Bhaṭṭa invited Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His associates, the Lord was very pleased with him.

devanagari: जगदानन्द - पण्डितेर शुद्ध गाढ़ भाव ।
सत्यभामा - प्राय प्रेम ‘वाम्य - स्वभाव’ ॥142॥
cc-antya-7.142.translation: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita's pure ecstatic love for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was very deep. It can be compared to the love of Satyabhāmā, who always quarreled with Lord Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: बार - बार प्रणय कलह करे प्रभु - सने ।
अन्योऽन्ये खट्मटि चले दुइ - जने ॥143॥
cc-antya-7.143.translation: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita was accustomed to provoking loving quarrels with the Lord. There was always some disagreement between them.

devanagari: गदाधर - पण्डितेर शुद्ध गाढ़ भाव ।
रुक्मिणी - देवीर यैछे दक्षिण - स्वभाव ॥144॥
cc-antya-7.144.translation: Gadādhara Paṇḍita's pure ecstatic love for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was also very deep. It was like that of Rukmiṇīdevī, who was always especially submissive to Kṛṣṇa.

lines: tāṅra praṇaya-roṣa dekhite prabhura icchā haya
devanagari: ताँर प्र णय - रोष देखते प्रभुर इच्छा हय ।
ऐश्वर्य - ज्ञाने ताँर रोष नाहि उपजय ॥145॥
cc-antya-7.145.translation: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sometimes desired to see Gadādhara Paṇḍita's affectionate anger, but because of knowledge of the Lord's opulences, his anger was never invoked.

lines: ei lakṣya pāñā prabhu kailā roṣābhāsa
devanagari: एइ लक्ष्य पाञा प्रभु कैला रोषाभास ।
शुनि’ पण्डितेर चित्ते उपजिल त्रास ॥146॥
cc-antya-7.146.translation: For this purpose Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sometimes showed His apparent anger. Hearing of this anger inspired great fear in the heart of Gadādhara Paṇḍita.

lines: pūrve yena kṛṣṇa yadi parihāsa kaila
devanagari: पूर्वे येन कृष्ण यदि परिहास कैल ।
शुनि’ रुक्मिणीर मने त्रास उपजिल ॥147॥
cc-antya-7.147.translation: Previously, in kṛṣṇa-līlā, when Lord Kṛṣṇa wanted to joke with Rukmiṇīdevī, she took His words seriously, and fear awoke within her mind.

devanagari: वल्लभ - भट्टेर हय वात्सल्य - उपासन ।
बाल - गोपाल - मन्त्रे तेंहो करेन सेवन ॥148॥
cc-antya-7.148.translation: Vallabha Bhaṭṭa was accustomed to worshiping the Lord as child Kṛṣṇa. Therefore he had been initiated into the Bāla-gopāla mantra and was thus worshiping the Lord.

lines: paṇḍitera sane tāra mana phiri' gela
devanagari: पण्डितेर सने तार मन फि रि’ गेल ।
किशोर - गोपाल - उपासनाय मन दिल ॥149॥
cc-antya-7.149.translation: In the association of Gadādhara Paṇḍita, his mind was converted, and he dedicated his mind to worshiping Kiśora-gopāla, Kṛṣṇa as a young boy.

devanagari: सन्त्ववतारा बहवः पुष्कर - नाभस्य सर्वतो - भद्राः ।
कृष्णादन्यः को वा लतास्वपि प्रेम - दो भवति ॥15॥
cc-antya-7.15.translation: "There may be many all-auspicious incarnations of the Personality of Godhead, but who other than Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa can bestow love of God upon the surrendered souls?' "

lines: paṇḍita kahe,—"ei karma nahe āmā haite
devanagari: पण्डितेर ठाञि चाहे मन्त्रादि शिखिते ।
पण्डित कहे , - “एइ कर्म नहे आमा हैते” ॥150॥
cc-antya-7.150.translation: Vallabha Bhaṭṭa wanted to be initiated by Gadādhara Paṇḍita, but Gadādhara Paṇḍita refused, saying, "The work of acting as a spiritual master is not possible for me.

lines: tāṅra ājñā vinā āmi nā ha-i 'svatantra'
devanagari: आमि - परतन्त्र, आमार प्रभु - गौरचन्द्र ।
ताँर आज्ञा विना आमि ना हइ ‘स्वतन्त्र’ ॥151॥
cc-antya-7.151.translation: "I am completely dependent. My Lord is Gauracandra, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. I cannot do anything independently, without His order.

lines: tumi ye āmāra ṭhāñi kara āgamana
devanagari: “तुमि ने आमार ठाञि कर आगमन ।
ताहातेइ प्रभु मोरे देन ओलाहन” ॥152॥
cc-antya-7.152.translation: "My dear Vallabha Bhaṭṭa, your coming to me is not appreciated by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Therefore He sometimes speaks to chastise me."

lines: śeṣe yadi prabhu tāre suprasanna haila
devanagari: एइ - मत भट्टेर कथेक दिन गेल ।
शेषे यदि प्रभु तारे सुप्रसन्न हैल ॥153॥
cc-antya-7.153-154.translation: Some days passed, and when Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, finally pleased with Vallabha Bhaṭṭa, accepted his invitation, the Lord sent Svarūpa Dāmodara, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita and Govinda to call for Gadādhara Paṇḍita.

devanagari: पथे पण्डितेरे स्वरूप कहेन वचन ।
“परीक्षिते प्रभु तोमारे कैला उपेक्षण” ॥155॥
cc-antya-7.155.translation: On the way, Svarūpa Dāmodara said to Gadādhara Paṇḍita, "Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu wanted to test you. Therefore He neglected you.

lines: tumi kene āsi' tāṅre nā dilā olāhana?
devanagari: “तुमि केने आसि’ ताँरे ना दिला ओलाहन ? ।
भीत - प्राय ह ञा काँहे करिला सहन ?” ॥156॥
cc-antya-7.156.translation: "Why did you not retaliate by reproaching Him? Why did you fearfully tolerate His criticism?"

devanagari: पण्डित कहेन , - प्रभु स्वतन्त्र सर्वज्ञ - शिरोमणि ।
ताँर सने ‘हठ’ करि, - भाल नाहि मानि ॥157॥
cc-antya-7.157.translation: Gadādhara Paṇḍita said, "Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is completely independent. He is the topmost omniscient personality. It would not look well for me to talk to Him as if His equal.

lines: yei kahe, sei sahi nija-śire dhari'
devanagari: “येइ कहे, सेइ सहि निज - शिरे धरि’ ।
आपने करिबेन कृपा गुण - दोष विचा रि” ॥158॥
cc-antya-7.158.translation: "I can tolerate whatever He says, bearing it upon my head. He will automatically be merciful to me after considering my faults and attributes."

lines: eta bali' paṇḍita prabhura sthāne āilā
devanagari: एत ब लि’ पण्डित प्रभुर स्थाने आइला ।
रोदन करिया प्रभुर चरणे पड़िला ॥159॥
cc-antya-7.159.translation: After saying this, Gadādhara Paṇḍita went to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and fell down crying at the lotus feet of the Lord.

lines: māyāvādī sannyāsī āmi, nā jāni kṛṣṇa-bhakti
devanagari: महाप्रभु कहे - “शुन, भट्ट महा - मति ।
मायावादी सन्यासी आमि, ना जानि कृष्ण - भक्ति” ॥16॥
cc-antya-7.16.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "My dear Vallabha Bhaṭṭa, you are a learned scholar. Kindly listen to Me. I am a sannyāsī of the Māyāvāda school. Therefore I have no chance of knowing what kṛṣṇa-bhakti is.

devanagari: ईषत् हासिया प्रभु कैला आलिङ्गन ।
सबारे शुनाञा कहेन मधुर वचन ॥160॥
cc-antya-7.160.translation: Smiling slightly, the Lord embraced him and spoke sweet words so that others would also hear.

lines: krodhe kichu nā kahilā, sakala sahilā
devanagari: “आमि चालाइ लुँ तोमा, तुमि ना चलिला ।
क्रोधे किछु ना कहिला, सकल सहिला” ॥161॥
cc-antya-7.161.translation: "I wanted to agitate you," the Lord said, "but you did not become agitated. Indeed, you could not say anything angry. Instead, you tolerated everything.

lines: āmāra bhaṅgīte tomāra mana nā calilā
devanagari: “आमार भङ्गीते तोमार मन ना चलिला ।
सुदृढ़ सरल - भावे आमारे किनिला” ॥162॥
cc-antya-7.162.translation: "Your mind was not disturbed by My tricks. Rather, you stayed fixed in your simplicity. In this way you have purchased Me."

devanagari: पण्डितेर भाव - मुद्रा कहन ना याय ।
‘गदाधर - प्राण - नाथ’ नाम हैल याय ॥163॥
cc-antya-7.163.translation: No one can describe the characteristics and ecstatic love of Gadādhara Paṇḍita. Therefore another name for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is Gadādhara-prāṇanātha, "the life and soul of Gadādhara Paṇḍita."

lines: paṇḍite prabhura prasāda kahana nā yāya
devanagari: पण्डिते प्रभुर प्रसाद कहन ना याय ।
‘गदाइर गौराङ्ग’ बलि’ याँरै लोके गाय ॥164॥
cc-antya-7.164.translation: No one can say how merciful the Lord is to Gadādhara Paṇḍita, but people know the Lord as Gadāira Gaura, "the Lord Gaurāṅga of Gadādhara Paṇḍita."

lines: eka-līlāya vahe gaṅgāra śata śata dhāre
devanagari: चैतन्य - प्रभुर लीला के बुझिते पारे? ।
एक - लीलाय वहे गङ्गार शत शत धारे ॥165॥
cc-antya-7.165.translation: No one can understand the pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. They are like the Ganges, for hundreds and thousands of branches flow from even one of His activities.

devanagari: पण्डि तेर सौजन्य, ब्रह्मण्यता - गुण ।
दृढ़ प्रेम - मुद्रा लोके करिला ख्यापन ॥166॥
cc-antya-7.166.translation: Gadādhara Paṇḍita is celebrated all over the world for his gentle behavior, his brahminical attributes and his steady love for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: अभिमान - पङ्क धुञा भट्टरे शोधिला ।
सेइ - द्वारा आर सब लोके शिखाइला ॥167॥
cc-antya-7.167.translation: The Lord purified Vallabha Bhaṭṭa by cleansing him of the mud of false pride. By such activities the Lord also instructed others.

lines: bāhyārtha yei laya, sei nāśa yāya
devanagari: अन्तरे अनुग्रह, बाह्ये ‘उपेक्षार प्राय’ ।
बाह्यार्थ येइ लय, सेइ नाश याय ॥168॥
cc-antya-7.168.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was actually always merciful within His heart, but He was sometimes externally negligent of His devotees. We should not be preoccupied with His external feature, however, for if we do so we shall be vanquished.

lines: sei bujhe, gauracandre yāṅra dṛḍha bhakti
devanagari: निगूढ़ चैतन्य - लीला बुझिते कार शक्ति? ।
सेइ बुझे, गौरचन्द्रे याँर दृढ़ भक्ति ॥169॥
cc-antya-7.169.translation: The pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu are very deep. Who can understand them? Only one who has firm, deep devotion to His lotus feet.

lines: tāṅra saṅge āmāra mana ha-ila nirmala
devanagari: अद्वैताचार्य - गोसाञि - ‘साक्षातीश्वर’ ।
ताँर सङ्गे आमार मन हइल निर्मल ॥17॥
cc-antya-7.17.translation: "Nevertheless, My mind has become purified because I have associated with Advaita Ācārya, who is directly the Supreme Personality of Godhead.

lines: prabhu tāhāṅ bhikṣā kaila lañā nija-gaṇa
devanagari: दिनान्तरे पण्डित कैल प्रभुर निमन्त्रण ।
प्रभु ताहाँ भिक्षा कैल लञा निज - गण ॥170॥
cc-antya-7.170.translation: Another day, Gadādhara Paṇḍita invited Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to dinner. The Lord took prasāda at his home with His personal associates.

devanagari: ताहाङि वल्लभ - भट्ट प्रभुर आज्ञा लैल ।
पण्डित - ठाञि पूर्व - प्रार्थित सब सिद्धि हैल ॥171॥
cc-antya-7.171.translation: There Vallabha Bhaṭṭa took permission from Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and his desire to be initiated by Gadādhara Paṇḍita was thus fulfilled.

devanagari: एइ त’ कहिलुँ वल्लभ - भट्टेर मिलन ।
याहार श्रवणे पाय गौर - प्रेम - धन ॥172॥
cc-antya-7.172.translation: I have thus explained the Lord's meeting with Vallabha Bhaṭṭa. By hearing of this incident, one can achieve the treasure of love for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: श्री - रूप - रघुनाथ - पदे यार आश ।
चैतन्य - चरितामृत कहे कृष्णदास ॥173॥
cc-antya-7.173.translation: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.

devanagari: सर्व - शास्त्रे कृष्ण - भक्त्ये नाहि याँर सम ।
अतएव ‘अद्वैत - आचार्य’ ताँर नाम ॥18॥
cc-antya-7.18.translation: "He is unparalleled in His understanding of all the revealed scriptures and the devotional service of Lord Kṛṣṇa. Therefore He is called Advaita Ācārya.

devanagari: याँहार कृपाते म्लेच्छेर हय कृष्ण - भक्ति ।
के कहिते पारे ताँर वैष्णवता - शक्ति? ॥19॥
cc-antya-7.19.translation: "He is such a great personality that by His mercy He can convert even the meateaters [mlecchas] to the devotional service of Kṛṣṇa. Who, therefore, can estimate the power of His Vaiṣṇavism?

devanagari: जय जय श्री - चैतन्य जय नित्यानन्द ।
जयाद्वैत - चन्द्र जय गौर - भक्त - वृन्द ॥2॥
cc-antya-7.2.translation: All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu! All glories to Nityānanda Prabhu! All glories to Advaitacandra! And all glories to the devotees of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu!

devanagari: नित्यानन्द - अवधूत - ‘साक्षातीश्वर’ ।
भावोन्मादे मत्त कृष्ण - प्रेमेर सागर ॥20॥
cc-antya-7.20.translation: "Lord Nityānanda Prabhu, the avadhūta, is also directly the Supreme Personality of Godhead. He is always intoxicated with the madness of ecstatic love. Indeed, He is an ocean of love of Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: षड् - दर्शन - वेत्ता भट्टाचार्य - सार्वभौम ।
षड् - दर्शने जगद्गुरु भागवतोत्तम ॥21॥
cc-antya-7.21.translation: "Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya perfectly knows the six philosophical theses. He is therefore the spiritual master of the entire world in the six paths of philosophy. He is the best of devotees.

devanagari: तेंह देखाइला मोरे भक्ति - योग - पार ।
ताँर प्रसादे जानि लुँ ‘कृष्ण - भक्ति - योग’ सार ॥22॥
cc-antya-7.22.translation: "Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya has shown Me the limit of devotional service. Only by his mercy have I understood that devotional service to Kṛṣṇa is the essence of all mystic yoga.

devanagari: रामानन्द - राय कृष्ण - रसेर निधान ।
तेंह जानाइला - कृष्ण - स्वयं भगवान् ॥23॥
cc-antya-7.23.translation: "Śrīla Rāmānanda Rāya is the ultimate knower of the transcendental mellows of Lord Kṛṣṇa's devotional service. He has instructed Me that Lord Kṛṣṇa is the Supreme Personality of Godhead.

devanagari: ताते प्रेम - भक्ति - ‘पुरुषार्थ - शिरोमणि’ ।
राग - मार्गे प्रेम - भक्ति सर्वाधिक जानि ॥24॥
cc-antya-7.24.translation: "Through the mercy of Rāmānanda Rāya, I have understood that ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa is the highest goal of life and that spontaneous love of Kṛṣṇa is the highest perfection.

lines: dāsya, sakhya, vātsalya, āra ye śṛṅgāra
devanagari: दास्य, सख्य, वात्सल्य, आर ये शृङ्गार ।
दास, सखा, गुरु, कान्ता , - ‘आश्रय’ याहार ॥25॥
cc-antya-7.25.translation: "The servant, friend, superior and conjugal lover are the shelters of the transcendental mellows called dāsya, sakhya, vātsalya and śṛṅgāra.

devanagari: ‘ऐश्वर्य - ज्ञान - युक्त’, ‘केवल’ - भाव आर ।
ऐश्वर्य - ज्ञाने ना पाइ व्रजेन्द्र - कुमार ॥26॥
cc-antya-7.26.translation: "There are two kinds of emotion [bhāva]. Emotion with an understanding of the Lord's full opulences is called aiśvarya-jñāna-yukta, and pure, uncontaminated emotion is called kevala. One cannot achieve shelter at the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa, the son of Mahārāja Nanda, simply by knowing His opulences.

devanagari: नायं सुखापो भगवान्देहिनां गोपिका - सुतः ।
ज्ञानिनां चात्म - भूतानां यथा भक्ति - मतामिह ॥27॥
cc-antya-7.27.translation: "The Supreme Personality of Godhead, Kṛṣṇa, the son of mother Yaśodā, is accessible to those devotees engaged in spontaneous loving service, but He is not as easily accessible to mental speculators, to those striving for self-realization by severe austerities and penances, or to those who consider the body the same as the self.'

devanagari: ‘आत्म - भूत’ - शब्दे कहे ‘पारिषद - गण’ ।
ऐश्वर्य - ज्ञाने लक्ष्मी ना पाइला व्रजेन्द्र - नन्दन ॥28॥
cc-antya-7.28.translation: "The word 'ātma-bhūta' means 'personal associates.' Through the understanding of opulence, the goddess of fortune could not receive the shelter of Kṛṣṇa; the son of Nanda Mahārāja.

devanagari: नायं श्रियोऽङ्ग उ नितान्त - रतेः प्रसादः स्वर्योषि तां नलिन - गन्ध - रुचां कुतोऽन्याः ।
रासोत्सवेऽस्य भुज - दण्ड - गृहीत - कण्ठ - लब्धाशिषां य उदगाद्व्रज - सुन्दरीणाम् ॥29॥
cc-antya-7.29.translation: "When Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa was dancing with the gopīs in the rāsa-līlā, the gopīs were embraced by the arms of the Lord. This transcendental favor was never bestowed upon the goddess of fortune or the other consorts in the spiritual world. Indeed, never was such a favor even imagined by the most beautiful girls in the heavenly planets, whose bodily luster and aroma resemble those of lotus flowers. And what to speak of worldly women who are very beautiful according to the material estimation?'

devanagari: वर्षान्तरे यत गौड़ेर भक्त - गण आइला ।
पूर्ववत् महाप्रभु सबारे मिलिला ॥3॥
cc-antya-7.3.translation: The next year, all the devotees of Bengal went to visit Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and as previously, the Lord met each and every one of them.

devanagari: शुद्ध - भावे सखा करे स्कन्धे आरोहण ।
शुद्ध - भावे व्रजेश्वरी करेन बन्धन ॥30॥
cc-antya-7.30.translation: "In pure Kṛṣṇa consciousness, a friend mounts the shoulder of Kṛṣṇa, and mother Yaśodā binds the Lord.

devanagari: ‘मोर सखा’, ‘मोर पुत्र’, - एइ ‘शुद्ध’ मन ।
अतएव शुक - व्यास करे प्रशंसन ॥31॥
cc-antya-7.31.translation: "In pure Kṛṣṇa consciousness, without knowledge of the Lord's opulences, a devotee considers Kṛṣṇa his friend or son. Therefore this devotional attitude is praised even by Śukadeva Gosvāmī and Vyāsadeva, the supreme authority.

devanagari: इत्थं सतां ब्रह्म - सुखानुभूत्या दास्यं गतानां पर - दैवतेन ।
मायाश्रितानां नर - दारकेण साकं विजः कृत - पुण्य - पुञ्जाः ॥32॥
cc-antya-7.32.translation: "Those who are engaged in self-realization, appreciating the Brahman effulgence of the Lord, and those engaged in devotional service, accepting the Supreme Personality of Godhead as master, as well as those who are under the clutches of māyā, thinking the Lord an ordinary person, cannot understand that certain exalted personalities-after accumulating volumes of pious activities-are now playing with the Lord in friendship as cowherd boys.'

devanagari: त्रय्या चोपनिषद्भिश्च साङ्ख्य - योगैश्च सात्वतैः ।
उपगीयमान - माहात्म्यं हरिं सामन्यतात्मजम् ॥33॥
cc-antya-7.33.translation: "When mother Yaśodā saw all the universes within the mouth of Kṛṣṇa, she was certainly astonished for the time being. Nevertheless, she still considered the Lord her own son, although He is worshiped by great personalities who offer him sacrifices, great saints who understand the greatness of the Lord by studying the Upaniṣads, great philosophers who analytically study the universe, great yogīs who know him as the all-pervading Supersoul, and even devotees who accept the Lord as the Supreme Personality of Godhead.'

devanagari: नन्दः किमकरोद्बह्मन्श्रेय एवं महोदयम् ।
यशोदा वा महा - भागा पपौ यस्याः स्तनं हरिः ॥34॥
cc-antya-7.34.translation: "O brāhmaṇa, what pious activities did Nanda Mahārāja perform to receive the Supreme Personality of Godhead Kṛṣṇa as his son? And what pious activities did mother Yaśodā perform that made the Absolute Supreme Personality of Godhead Kṛṣṇa call her "mother" and suck her breasts?'

devanagari: ऐश्वर्य देखिलेह ‘शुद्धेर’ नहे ऐश्वर्य ज्ञान ।
अतएव ऐश्वर्य हइते ‘केवल’ - भाव प्रधान ॥35॥
cc-antya-7.35.translation: "Even if a pure devotee sees the opulence of Kṛṣṇa, he does not accept it. Therefore pure consciousness is more exalted than consciousness of the Lord's opulence.

devanagari: ए सब शिखाइला मोरे राय - रामानन्द ।
अनर्गल रस - वेत्ता प्रेम - सुखानन्द ॥36॥
cc-antya-7.36.translation: "Rāmānanda Rāya is extremely aware of transcendental mellows. He is incessantly absorbed in the happiness of ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa. It is he who has instructed Me all this.

devanagari: कहन ना याय रामानन्देर प्रभाव ।
राय - प्रसादे जानि लुँ व्रजेर ‘शुद्ध’ भाव ॥37॥
cc-antya-7.37.translation: "It is impossible to describe the influence and knowledge of Rāmānanda Rāya, for only by his mercy have I understood the unalloyed love of the residents of Vṛndāvana.

devanagari: दामोदर - स्वरूप - ‘प्रेम - रस’ मूर्तिमान् ।
याँर सङ्गे हैल व्रज - मधुर - रस - ज्ञान ॥38॥
cc-antya-7.38.translation: "The transcendental mellow of ecstatic love is personified by Svarūpa Dāmodara. By his association I have understood Vṛndāvana's transcendental mellow of conjugal love.

devanagari: ‘शुद्ध - प्रेम’ व्रज - देवीर - काम - गन्ध - हीन।
‘कृष्ण - सुख - तात्पर्य’, - एइ तार चिह्न ॥39॥
cc-antya-7.39.translation: "The unalloyed love of the gopīs and Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī is without any trace of material lust. The criterion of such transcendental love is that its only purpose is to satisfy Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: एइ - मत विलास प्रभुर भक्त - गण लञा ।
हेन - काले वल्लभ - भट्ट मिलिल आसिया ॥4॥
cc-antya-7.4.translation: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu performed His pastimes with His devotees. Then a learned scholar named Vallabha Bhaṭṭa went to Jagannātha Purī to meet the Lord.

lines: tenāṭavīm aṭasi tad vyathate na kiṁ svit
devanagari: यत्ते सुजात - चरणाम्बुरुहं स्तनेषु भीताः शनैः प्रिय दधीमहि कर्कशेषु ।
तेनाटवीमटसि तद्व्यथते न किं स्वित् कूर्पादिभिर्भमति धीर्भवदायुषां नः ॥40॥
cc-antya-7.40.translation: "O dearly beloved! Your lotus feet are so soft that we place them gently on our breasts, fearing that Your feet will be hurt. Our lives rest only in You. Our minds, therefore, are filled with anxiety that Your tender feet might be wounded by pebbles as You roam about on the forest path.'

lines: premete bhartsanā kare ei tāra cihna
devanagari: गोपी - गणेर शुद्ध - प्रेम ऐश्वर्य - ज्ञान - हीन ।
प्रेमेते भर्त्सना करे एइ तार चिह्न ॥41॥
cc-antya-7.41.translation: "Obsessed with pure love, without knowledge of opulences, the gopīs sometimes chastised Kṛṣṇa. That is a symptom of pure ecstatic love.

devanagari: पति - सुतान्वय - भ्रातृ - बान्धवान् अतिविलय तेऽन्त्यच्युतागताः ।
गति - विदस्तवोद्गीत - मोहिताः कितव योषितः कस्त्यजेन्निशि ॥42॥
cc-antya-7.42.translation: "O dear Kṛṣṇa, we gopīs have neglected the order of our husbands, sons, family, brothers and friends and have left their company to come to You. You know everything about our desires. We have come only because we are attracted by the supreme music of Your flute. But You are a great cheater, for who else would give up the company of young girls like us in the dead of night?'

devanagari: सर्वोत्तम भजन एइ सर्व - भक्ति जि नि’ ।
अतएव कृष्ण कहे, - ‘आमि तोमार ऋणी’ ॥43॥
cc-antya-7.43.translation: "The conjugal love of the gopīs is the most exalted devotional service, surpassing all other methods of bhakti. Therefore Lord Kṛṣṇa is obliged to say, 'My dear gopīs, I cannot repay you. Indeed, I am always indebted to you.'

devanagari: न पारयेऽहं निरवद्य - संयुजां स्व - साधु - कृत्यं विबुधायुषापि वः ।
या माभजन्दुर्जय - गेह - शृङ्खलाः संवृश्च्य तद्वः प्रतियातु साधुना ॥44॥
cc-antya-7.44.translation: "O gopīs, I am not able to repay My debt for your spotless service, even within a lifetime of Brahmā. Your connection with Me is beyond reproach. You have worshiped Me, cutting off all domestic ties, which are difficult to break. Therefore please let your own glorious deeds be your compensation.'

devanagari: ऐश्वर्य - ज्ञान हैते केवला - भाव - प्रधान ।
पृथिवीते भक्त नाहि उद्धव - समान ॥45॥
cc-antya-7.45.translation: "Completely distinct from love of Kṛṣṇa in opulence, pure love of Kṛṣṇa is on the highest level. On the surface of the world there is no devotee greater than Uddhava.

lines: svarūpera saṅge pāiluṅ e saba śikṣaṇa
devanagari: तेंह याँर पद - धूलि करेन प्रार्थन ।
स्वरूपेर सङ्गे पाइलुँ ए सब शिक्षण ॥46॥
cc-antya-7.46.translation: "Uddhava desires to take on his head the dust of the gopīs' lotus feet. I have learned about all these transcendental loving affairs of Lord Kṛṣṇa from Svarūpa Dāmodara.

lines: yā dustyajaṁ svajanam ārya-pathaṁ ca hitvā
devanagari: आसामहो चरण - रेणु - जुषामहं स्यां वृन्दावने किमपि गुल्म - लतौषधीनाम् ।
या दुस्त्यजं स्व - जनमार्य - पथं च हित्वा भेजुर्मुकुन्द - पदवीं श्रुतिभिर्विमृग्याम् ॥47॥
cc-antya-7.47.translation: "The gopīs of Vṛndāvana have given up the association of their husbands, sons and other family members, who are very difficult to give up, and they have forsaken the path of chastity to take shelter of the lotus feet of Mukunda, Kṛṣṇa, which one should search for by Vedic knowledge. Oh, let me be fortunate enough to be one of the bushes, creepers or herbs in Vṛndāvana because the gopīs trample them and bless them with the dust of their lotus feet.'

lines: prati dina laya teṅha tina-lakṣa nāma
devanagari: हरिदास - ठाकुर - महा - भागवत - प्रधान ।
प्रति दिन लय तेंह तिन - लक्ष नाम ॥48॥
cc-antya-7.48.translation: "Haridāsa Ṭhākura, the teacher of the holy name, is among the most exalted of all devotees. Every day he chants 300,000 holy names of the Lord.

lines: nāmera mahimā āmi tāṅra ṭhāñi śikhiluṅ
devanagari: नामेर महिमा आमि ताँर ठाञि शिखि लुँ ।
ताँर प्रसादे नामेर महिमा जानि लुँ ॥49॥
cc-antya-7.49.translation: "I have learned about the glories of the Lord's holy name from Haridāsa Ṭhākura, and by his mercy I have understood these glories.

devanagari: आसिया वन्दिल भट्ट प्रभुर चरणे ।
प्रभु ‘भागवत - बुद्धये’ कैला आलिङ्गने ॥5॥
cc-antya-7.5.translation: When Vallabha Bhaṭṭa arrived, he offered his obeisances at the lotus feet of the Lord. Accepting him as a great devotee, the Lord embraced him.

devanagari: आचार्यरत्न आ चार्यनिधि पण्डित - गदाधर ।
जगदानन्द, दामोदर, शङ्कर, वक्रेश्वर ॥50॥
cc-antya-7.50-52.translation: "Ācāryaratna, Ācāryanidhi, Gadādhara Paṇḍita, Jagadānanda, Dāmodara, Śaṅkara, Vakreśvara, Kāśīśvara, Mukunda, Vāsudeva, Murāri and many other devotees have descended in Bengal to preach to everyone the glories of the holy name of Kṛṣṇa and the value of love for Him. I have learned from them the meaning of devotional service to Kṛṣṇa."

lines: bhaṅgī kari' mahāprabhu kahe eta vāṇī
devanagari: भट्टेर हृदये दृढ़ अभिमान जा नि’ ।
भङ्गी करि’ महाप्रभु कहे एत वाणी ॥53॥
cc-antya-7.53.translation: Knowing that Vallabha Bhaṭṭa's heart was full of pride, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu spoke these words, hinting at how one can learn about devotional service.

devanagari: “आमि से ‘वैष्णव’, - भक्ति - सिद्धान्त सब जानि ।
आमि से भागवत - अर्थ उत्तम वाखानि” ॥54॥
cc-antya-7.54.translation: "I am a great Vaiṣṇava. Having learned all the conclusions of Vaiṣṇava philosophy, I can understand the meaning of Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam and explain it very well."

lines: bhaṭṭera manete ei chila dīrgha garva
prabhura vacana śuni' se ha-ila kharva
devanagari: भट्टेर मनेते एइ छिल दीर्घ गर्व ।
प्रभुर वचन शुनि’ से हइल खर्व ॥55॥
cc-antya-7.55.translation: Such pride had existed for a long time within Vallabha Bhaṭṭa's mind, but as he heard the preaching of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, his pride was cut down.

devanagari: प्रभुर मुखे वैष्णवता शुनिया सबार ।
भट्टेर इच्छा हैल ताँ - सबारे देखिबार ॥56॥
cc-antya-7.56.translation: When Vallabha Bhaṭṭa heard from the mouth of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu about the pure Vaiṣṇavism of all these devotees, he immediately desired to see them.

lines: bhaṭṭa kahe,—"e saba vaiṣṇava rahe kon sthāne?
devanagari: भट्ट कहे , - “ए सब वैष्णव रहे कोन् स्थाने? ।
कोन् प्रकारे पाइमु इहाँ - सबार दर्शने ?” ॥57॥
cc-antya-7.57.translation: Vallabha Bhaṭṭa said, "Where do all these Vaiṣṇavas live, and how can I see them?"

devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - “केह गौड़े, केह देशान्तरे ।
सब आसियाछे रथ - यात्रा देखिबारे” ॥58॥
cc-antya-7.58.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "Although some of them live in Bengal and some in other states, they have all come here to see the Ratha-yātrā festival.

devanagari: इहाङि रहेन सबे, वासा - नाना - स्थाने ।
इहाङिपाइबा तुमि सबार दर्शने ॥59॥
cc-antya-7.59.translation: "At present they are all living here. Their residences are in various quarters. Here you will get the audience of them all."

lines: mānya kari' prabhu tāre nikaṭe vasāilā
devanagari: मान्य क रि’ प्रभु तारे निकटे वसाइला ।
विनय करिया भट्ट कहिते लागिला ॥6॥
cc-antya-7.6.translation: With great respect, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu seated Vallabha Bhaṭṭa near Him. Then Vallabha Bhaṭṭa very humbly began to speak.

lines: tabe bhaṭṭa kahe bahu vinaya vacana
bahu dainya kari' prabhure kaila nimantraṇa
devanagari: तबे भट्ट कहे बहु विनय वचन ।
बहु दैन्य करि’ प्रभुरे कैल निमन्त्रण ॥60॥
cc-antya-7.60.translation: Thereafter, with great submission and humility, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa invited Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to dine at his home.

lines: āra dina saba vaiṣṇava prabhu-sthāne āilā
devanagari: आर दि न सब वैष्णव प्रभु - स्थाने आइला ।
सबा - सने महाप्रभु भट्टे मिलाइला ॥61॥
cc-antya-7.61.translation: The next day, when all the Vaiṣṇavas came to the abode of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the Lord introduced Vallabha Bhaṭṭa to them all.

devanagari: ‘वैष्णवे’र तेज देखि’ भट्टेर चमत्कार ।
ताँ - सबार आगे भट्ट - खद्योत - आकार ॥62॥
cc-antya-7.62.translation: He was surprised to see the brilliance of their faces. Indeed, among them Vallabha Bhaṭṭa seemed just like a glowworm.

devanagari: तबे भट्ट बहु महा - प्रसाद आनाइल ।
गण - सह महाप्रभुरे भोजन कराइल ॥63॥
cc-antya-7.63.translation: Then Vallabha Bhaṭṭa brought in a great quantity of Lord Jagannātha's mahā-prasāda and sumptuously fed Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His associates.

devanagari: परमानन्द पुरी - सङ्गे सन्न्यासीर गण ।
एक - दिके वैसे सब करिते भोजन ॥64॥
cc-antya-7.64.translation: All the sannyāsī associates of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu headed by Paramānanda Purī, sat on one side and thus partook of the prasāda.

devanagari: अद्वैत, नित्यानन्द - राय - पार्श्वे दुइ - जन ।
मध्ये महाप्रभु वसिला, आगे - पाछे भक्त - गण ॥65॥
cc-antya-7.65.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sat in the midst of the devotees. Advaita Ācārya and Lord Nityānanda each sat on one side of the Lord. The other devotees sat in front of the Lord and behind Him.

lines: gauḍera bhakta yata kahite nā pāri
aṅgane vasilā saba hañā sāri sāri
devanagari: गौड़ेर भक्त यत कहिते ना पारि ।
अङ्गने वसिला सब हञा सारि सारि ॥66॥
cc-antya-7.66.translation: The devotees from Bengal, whom I am unable to count, all sat down in lines in the courtyard.

devanagari: प्रभुर भक्त - गण देखि’ भट्टेर चमत्कार ।
प्रत्येके सबार पदे कैल नमस्कार ॥67॥
cc-antya-7.67.translation: When Vallabha Bhaṭṭa saw all the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, he was greatly surprised, but in devotion he offered his obeisances at the lotus feet of each and every one of them.

devanagari: स्वरूप, जगदानन्द, काशीश्वर, शङ्कर ।
परिवेशन करे, आर राघव, दामोदर ॥68॥
cc-antya-7.68.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara, Jagadānanda, Kāśīśvara and Śaṅkara, along with Rāghava and Dāmodara Paṇḍita, took charge of distributing the prasāda.

devanagari: महा - प्रसाद वल्लभ - भट्ट बहु आनाइल ।
प्रभु - सह सन्यासि - गण भोजने वसिल ॥69॥
cc-antya-7.69.translation: Vallabha Bhaṭṭa had brought a large quantity of mahā-prasāda offered to Lord Jagannātha. Thus all the sannyāsīs sat down to eat with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: बहु - दिन मनोरथ तोमा’ देखिबारे ।
जगन्नाथ पूर्ण कैला, देखिलुँ तोमारे ॥7॥
cc-antya-7.7.translation: "For a long time," he said, "I have desired to see You, my Lord. Now Lord Jagannātha has fulfilled this desire; therefore I am seeing You.

lines: hari hari dhvani uṭhe saba brahmāṇḍa bhari'
devanagari: प्रसाद पाय वैष्णव - गण बले, ‘हरि’ ‘हरि’ ।
हरि हरि ध्वनि उठे सब ब्रह्माण्ड भ रि’ ॥70॥
cc-antya-7.70.translation: Accepting the prasāda, all the Vaiṣṇavas chanted the holy names Hari, Hari. The rising vibration of the holy name of Hari filled the entire universe.

lines: mālā, candana, guvāka, pāna aneka ānila
sabā' pūjā kari' bhaṭṭa ānandita haila
devanagari: माला, चन्दन, गुवाके, पान अनेक आनिल ।
सबा’ पूजा करि’ भट्ट आनन्दित हैल ॥71॥
cc-antya-7.71.translation: When all the Vaiṣṇavas had finished eating, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa brought a large quantity of garlands, sandalwood pulp, spices and betel. He worshiped them very respectfully and became extremely happy.

devanagari: रथ - यात्रा - दिने प्रभु कीर्तन आरम्भिला ।
पूर्ववत् सात सम्प्रदाय पृथक् करिला ॥72॥
cc-antya-7.72.translation: On the day of the car festival, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu began the congregational chanting. As He had done previously, He divided all the devotees into seven groups.

devanagari: अद्वैत, नित्यानन्द, हरिदास, वक्रेश्वर ।
श्रीवास, राघव, पण्डित - गदाधर ॥73॥
