cc-antya-7.73-74.translation: Seven devotees-Advaita, Nityānanda, Haridāsa Ṭhākura, Vakreśvara, Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura, Rāghava Paṇḍita and Gadādhara Paṇḍita-formed seven groups and began dancing. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, chanting "Hari bol," wandered from one group to another.

lines: eka eka nartakera preme bhāsila bhuvana
devanagari: चौद्द मादल बाजे उच्च सङ्कीर्तन ।
एक एक नर्तकेर प्रेमे भासिल भुवन ॥75॥
cc-antya-7.75.translation: Fourteen mṛdaṅgas resounded with the loud congregational chanting, and in each group was a dancer whose dance of ecstatic love inundated the entire world.

devanagari: देखि’ वल्लभ - भट्टेर हैल चमत्कार ।
आनन्दे विह्वल नाहि आपन - साम्भाल ॥76॥
cc-antya-7.76.translation: Seeing all this, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa was completely astonished. He was overwhelmed by transcendental bliss and lost himself.

devanagari: तबे महाप्रभु सबार नृत्य राखिला ।
पूर्ववत् आपने नृत्य करते लागिला ॥77॥
cc-antya-7.77.translation: Then Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stopped the dancing of the others, and as He had done previously, He personally began to dance.

lines: 'ei ta' sākṣāt kṛṣṇa' bhaṭṭera ha-ila niścaya
devanagari: प्रभुर सौन्दर्य देखि आर प्रेमोदय ।
‘एई त’ साक्षात्कृष्ण’ भट्टेर हइल निश्चये ॥78॥
cc-antya-7.78.translation: Seeing the beauty of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and the awakening of His ecstatic love, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa concluded, "Here is Lord Kṛṣṇa, without a doubt."

devanagari: एत मत रथ - यात्रा सकले देखिल ।
प्रभुर चरित्रे भट्टेर चमत्कार हैल ॥79॥
cc-antya-7.79.translation: Thus Vallabha Bhaṭṭa witnessed the car festival. He was simply astonished by the characteristics of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: tomāra darśana ye pāya sei bhāgyavān
devanagari: तोमार दर्शन ये पाय सेइ भाग्यवान् ।
तोमाके देखिये , - येन साक्षात्भगवान् ॥8॥
cc-antya-7.8.translation: "One who receives Your audience is fortunate indeed, for You are the Supreme Personality of Godhead Himself.

devanagari: यात्रानन्तरे भट्ट झाइ महाप्रभु - स्थाने ।
प्रभु - चरणे किछु कैल निवेदने ॥80॥
cc-antya-7.80.translation: One day, after the festival was over, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa went to the abode of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and submitted a request at the lotus feet of the Lord.

devanagari: “भागवतेर टीका किछु करियाछि लिखन ।
आपने महाप्रभु यदि करेन श्रवण” ॥81॥
cc-antya-7.81.translation: "I have written some commentary on Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam," he said. "Would Your Lordship kindly hear it?"

devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - “भागवतार्थ बुझिते ना पारि ।
भागवतार्थ शुनिते आमि नहि अधिकारी” ॥82॥
cc-antya-7.82.translation: The Lord replied, "I do not understand the meaning of Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam. Indeed, I am not a suitable person to hear its meaning.

devanagari: वसि’ कृष्ण - नाम मात्र करिये ग्रहणे ।
सङ्ख्या - नाम पूर्ण मोर नहे रात्रि - दिने ॥83॥
cc-antya-7.83.translation: "I simply sit and try to chant the holy name of Kṛṣṇa, and although I chant all day and night, I nevertheless cannot complete the chanting of my prescribed number of rounds."

devanagari: भट्ट कहे, “कृष्ण - नामेर अर्थ - व्याख्याने ।
विस्तार कैराछि, ताहा करह श्रवणे” ॥84॥
cc-antya-7.84.translation: Vallabha Bhaṭṭa said, "I have tried to describe elaborately the meaning of Kṛṣṇa's holy name. Kindly hear the explanation."

lines: prabhu kahe,—"kṛṣṇa-nāmera bahu artha nā māni
devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - “कृष्ण - नामेर बहु अर्थ ना मानि ।
‘श्याम - सुन्दर’ ‘यशोदा - नन्दन ,’ - एइ - मात्र जानि ॥85॥
cc-antya-7.85.translation: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "I do not accept many different meanings for the holy name of Kṛṣṇa. I know only that Lord Kṛṣṇa is Śyāmasundara and Yaśodānandana. That's all I know.

devanagari: तमाल - श्यामल - त्विषि श्री - यशोदा - स्तनन्धये ।
कृष्ण - नाम्नो रूढ़िरिति सर्व - शास्त्र - विनिर्णयः ॥86॥
cc-antya-7.86.translation: "The only purport of the holy name of Kṛṣṇa is that He is dark blue like a tamāla tree and is the son of mother Yaśodā. This is the conclusion of all the revealed scriptures.'

lines: ei artha āmi mātra jāniye nirdhāra
devanagari: “एइ अर्थ आमि मात्र जानिये निर्धार ।
आर सर्व - अर्थे मोर नाहि अधिकार” ॥87॥
cc-antya-7.87.translation: "I conclusively know these two names, Śyāmasundara and Yaśodānandana. I do not understand any other meanings, nor have I the capacity to understand them."

lines: sarvajña prabhu jāni' tāre karena upekṣā
devanagari: फल्गु - प्राय भट्टेर नामादि सब - व्याख्या ।
सर्वज्ञ प्रभु जानि’ तारे क रेन उपेक्षा ॥88॥
cc-antya-7.88.translation: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is omniscient. Therefore He could understand that Vallabha Bhaṭṭa's explanations of Kṛṣṇa's name and Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam were useless. Therefore He did not care about them.

devanagari: विमना ह ञा भट्ट गेला निज - घर ।
प्रभु - विषये भक्ति किछु हइल अन्तर ॥89॥
cc-antya-7.89.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu rigidly declined to hear his explanations, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa went home feeling morose. His faith and devotion to the Lord changed.

lines: tomāre ye smaraṇa kare, se haya pavitra
devanagari: तोमारे ये स्मरण करे, से हय पवित्र ।
दर्शने पवित्र हबे , - इथे कि विचित्र ? ॥9॥
cc-antya-7.9.translation: "Since one who remembers You is purified, why should it be astonishing that one becomes purified by seeing You?

lines: nānā mate prīti kari' kare āsā-yāi
devanagari: तबे भट्ट गेला पण्डित - गोसाञि र ठाञि ।
नाना मते प्रीति क रि’ करे आसा - याइ ॥90॥
cc-antya-7.90.translation: Thereafter, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa went to the home of Gadādhara Paṇḍita. He kept coming and going, showing affection in various ways, and thus maintained a relationship with him.

lines: bhaṭṭera vyākhyāna kichu nā kare śravaṇa
devanagari: प्रभुर उपेक्षाय सब नीलाचलेर जन ।
भट्टेर व्याख्यान किछु ना करे श्रवण ॥91॥
cc-antya-7.91.translation: Because Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu did not take Vallabha Bhaṭṭa very seriously, none of the people in Jagannātha Purī would hear any of his explanations.

devanagari: लज्जित हैल भट्ट, हैल अपमाने ।
दुःखित हञा गेल पण्डितेर स्थाने ॥92॥
cc-antya-7.92.translation: Ashamed, insulted and unhappy, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa went to Gadādhara Paṇḍita.

lines: tumi kṛpā kari' rākha āmāra jīvana
devanagari: दैन्य क रि’ कहे, - “निलुँ तोमार शरण ।
तुमि कृपा करि’ राख आमार जीवन” ॥93॥
cc-antya-7.93.translation: Approaching him with great humility, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa said, "I have taken shelter of you, my dear sir. Kindly be merciful to me and save my life.

devanagari: “कृष्ण - नाम - व्याख्या यदि करह श्रवण ।
तबे मोर लज्जा - पङ्क हय प्रक्षालन” ॥94॥
cc-antya-7.94.translation: "Please hear my explanation of the meaning of Lord Kṛṣṇa's name. In that way the mud of the shame that has come upon me will be washed off."

lines: ki karibena,—eko, karite nā pāre niścaya
devanagari: सङ्कटे पड़िल पण्डित, करये संशय ।
कि करिबेन , - एको, करिते ना पारे निश्चय ॥95॥
cc-antya-7.95.translation: Thus Paṇḍita Gosāñi fell into a dilemma. He was in such doubt that he could not decide alone what to do.

lines: yadyapi paṇḍita āra nā kailā aṅgīkāra
bhaṭṭa yāi' tabu paḍe kari' balātkāra
devanagari: यद्यपि पण्डित आर ना कैला अङ्गीकार ।
भट्ट याइ’ तबु पड़े करि’ बलात्कार ॥96॥
cc-antya-7.96.translation: Although Gadādhara Paṇḍita Gosāñi did not want to hear it, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa began to read his explanation with great force.

devanagari: आभिजा त्ये पण्डित करिते नारे निषेधन ।
ए सङ्कटे राख, कृष्ण लइलाङ शरण ॥97॥
cc-antya-7.97.translation: Because Vallabha Bhaṭṭa was a learned brāhmaṇa, Gadādhara Paṇḍita could not forbid him. Thus he began to think of Lord Kṛṣṇa. "My dear Lord Kṛṣṇa," he requested, "please protect me in this danger. I have taken shelter of You.

lines: tāṅre bhaya nāhi kichu, 'viṣama' tāṅra gaṇa"
devanagari: “अन्तर्यामी प्रभु जानिबेन मोर मन ।
ताँरे भय नाहि किछु, ‘विषम’ ताँर गण” ॥98॥
cc-antya-7.98.translation: "Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is present in everyone's heart, and He will certainly know my mind. Therefore I do not fear Him. His associates, however, are extremely critical."

lines: yadyapi vicāre paṇḍitera nāhi kichu doṣa
tathāpi prabhura gaṇa tāṅre kare praṇaya-roṣa
devanagari: यद्यपि विचारे पण्डितेर नाहि किछु दोष ।
तथापि प्रभुर गण ताँरे करे प्रणय - रोष ॥99॥
cc-antya-7.99.translation: Although Gadādhara Paṇḍita Gosāñi was not in the least at fault, some of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's devotees showed affectionate anger toward him.

devanagari: तं वन्दे कृष्ण - चैतन्यं रामचन्द्र - पुरी - भयात् ।
लौकिका हारतः स्वं यो भिक्षान्नं समकोचयत् ॥1॥
cc-antya-8.1.translation: Let me offer my respectful obeisances to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who reduced His eating due to fear of the criticism of Rāmacandra Purī.

devanagari: तिन - जने इष्ठ - गोष्ठी कैला कत - क्षण ।
जगदानन्द - पण्डित ताँरे कैला निम न्त्रण ॥10॥
cc-antya-8.10.translation: The three of them talked about Kṛṣṇa for some time, and then Jagadānanda came and extended an invitation to Rāmacandra Purī.

lines: yadyapi guru-buddhye prabhu tāra doṣa nā la-ila
devanagari: यद्यपि गुरु - बुद्ध्ये प्रभु तार दोष ना लइल ।
तार फल - द्वारा लोके शिक्षा कराइल ॥100॥
cc-antya-8.100.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu did not consider the offenses of Rāmacandra Purī, for the Lord considered him His spiritual master. However, his character instructed everyone about the result of offending the spiritual master.

devanagari: चैतन्य - चरित्र - येन अमृतेर पूर ।
शुनिते श्रवणे मने लागये मधुर ॥101॥
cc-antya-8.101.translation: The character of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is full of nectar. Hearing about it is pleasing to the ear and mind.

devanagari: चैतन्य - चरित्र लिखि, शुन एक - मने ।
अनायासे पाबे प्रेम श्री - कृष्ण - चरणे ॥102॥
cc-antya-8.102.translation: I write about the character of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. O readers, please hear with attention, for thus you will easily receive ecstatic love for the lotus feet of Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: श्री - रूप - रघुनाथ - पदे यार आश ।
चैतन्य - चरितामृत कहे कृष्णदास ॥103॥
cc-antya-8.103.translation: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.

lines: yatheṣṭa bhikṣā karilā teṅho nindāra lāgiyā
devanagari: जगन्नाथेर प्रसाद आनिला भिक्षार लागिया ।
यथेष्ट भिक्षा करिला तेंहो निन्दार लागिया ॥11॥
cc-antya-8.11.translation: A large quantity of the remnants of food from Lord Jagannātha was brought in for distribution. Rāmacandra Purī ate sumptuously, and then he wanted to find faults in Jagadānanda Paṇḍita.

devanagari: भिक्षा क रि’ कहे पुरी, - “शुन, जगदानन्द ।
अवशेष प्रसाद तुमि करह भक्षण” ॥12॥
cc-antya-8.12.translation: After finishing the meal, Rāmacandra Purī requested, "My dear Jagadānanda, please listen. You eat the food that is left."

devanagari: आग्रह करिया ताँरे वसि’ खाओयाइल ।
आपने आग्रह क रि’ परिवेशन कैल ॥13॥
cc-antya-8.13.translation: With great eagerness Rāmacandra Purī seated Jagadānanda Paṇḍita and personally served him prasāda.

devanagari: आग्रह करिया पुनः पुनः खाओयाइल ।
आचमन कैले निन्दा करिते लागिल ॥14॥
cc-antya-8.14.translation: Encouraging him again and again, Rāmacandra Purī fed him sumptuously, but when Jagadānanda had washed his hands and mouth, Rāmacandra Purī began criticizing him.

devanagari: “शुनि, चैतन्य - गण करे बहुत भक्षण ।
‘सत्य’ सेइ वाक्य , - साक्षात् देखिलुँ एखन” ॥15॥
cc-antya-8.15.translation: "I have heard," he said, "that the followers of Caitanya Mahāprabhu eat more than necessary. Now I have directly seen that this is true.

lines: sannyāsīre eta khāoyāñā kare dharma nāśa
vairāgī hañā eta khāya, vairāgyera nāhi 'bhāsa' "
devanagari: सन्न्यासीरे एत खाओया ञा करे धर्म नाश ।
वैरागी ह ञा एत खाय, वैराग्येर नाहि ‘भास’ ॥16॥
cc-antya-8.16.translation: "Feeding a sannyāsī too much breaks his regulative principles, for when a sannyāsī eats too much, his renunciation is destroyed."

lines: ei ta' svabhāva tāṅra āgraha kariyā
piche nindā kare, āge bahuta khāoyāñā
devanagari: एइ त’ स्वभाव ताँ र आग्रह करिया ।
पिछे निन्दा करे, आगे बहुत खाओयाञा ॥17॥
cc-antya-8.17.translation: The characteristic of Rāmacandra Purī was that first he would induce someone to eat more than necessary and then he would criticize him.

devanagari: पूर्वे यबे माधवेन्द्र करेन अन्तर्धान ।
रामचन्द्र - पुरी तबे आइला ताँर स्थान ॥18॥
cc-antya-8.18.translation: Formerly, when Mādhavendra Purī was at the last stage of his life, Rāmacandra Purī came to where he was staying.

devanagari: पुरी - गोसाञि करे कृष्ण - नाम - सङ्कीर्तन ।
‘मथुरा ना पाइनु’ बलि’ करेन क्रन्दन ॥19॥
cc-antya-8.19.translation: Mādhavendra Purī was chanting the holy name of Kṛṣṇa, and sometimes he would cry, "O my Lord, I did not get shelter at Mathurā."

devanagari: जय जय श्री - चैतन्य करुणा - सिन्धु - अवतार ।
ब्रह्मा - शिवादिक भजे चरण याँहार ॥2॥
cc-antya-8.2.translation: All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the incarnation of the ocean of mercy. His lotus feet are worshiped by demigods like Lord Brahmā and Lord Śiva.

lines: śiṣya hañā guruke kahe, bhaya nāhi kare
devanagari: रामचन्द्र - पुरी तबे उपदेशे ताँरे ।
शिष्य ह ञा गुरुके कहे, भय नाहि करे ॥20॥
cc-antya-8.20.translation: Then Rāmacandra Purī was so foolish that he fearlessly dared to instruct his spiritual master.

devanagari: “तुमि - पूर्ण - ब्रह्मानन्द, करह स्मरण ।
ब्रह्मवित् हञा केने करह रोदन ?” ॥21॥
cc-antya-8.21.translation: "If you are in full transcendental bliss," he said, "you should now remember only Brahman. Why are you crying?"

devanagari: शुनि’ माधवेन्द्र - मने क्रोध उपजिल ।
‘दूर, दूर, पापिष्ठ’ बलि’ भर्त्सना करिल ॥22॥
cc-antya-8.22.translation: Hearing this instruction, Mādhavendra Purī, greatly angry, rebuked him by saying, "Get out, you sinful rascal!

devanagari: ‘कृष्ण ना पाइनु, ना पाइनु ‘मथुरा’ ।
आपन - दुःखे मरों - एइ दिते आइल ज्वाला ॥23॥
cc-antya-8.23.translation: "O my Lord Kṛṣṇa, I could not reach You, nor could I reach Your abode, Mathurā. I am dying in my unhappiness, and now this rascal has come to give me more pain.

lines: more mukha nā dekhābi tui, yāo yathi-tathi
tore dekhi' maile mora habe asad-gati
devanagari: मोरे मुख ना देखाबि तुइ, याओ यथि - तथि।
तोरे देखि’ मैले मोर ह बे असद्गति ॥24॥
cc-antya-8.24.translation: "Don't show your face to me! Go anywhere else you like. If I die seeing your face, I shall not achieve the destination of my life.

lines: kṛṣṇa nā pāinu muñi maroṅ āpanāra duḥkhe
devanagari: कृष्ण ना पाइनु मुजि मरों आपनार दुःखे ।
मोरे ‘ब्रह्म’ उपदेशे एइ छार मूर्ख ॥25॥
cc-antya-8.25.translation: "I am dying without achieving the shelter of Kṛṣṇa, and therefore I am greatly unhappy. Now this condemned foolish rascal has come to instruct me about Brahman."

lines: ei ye śrī-mādhavendra śrī-pāda upekṣā karila
devanagari: एइ ये श्री - माधवेन्द्र श्रीपाद उपेक्षा करिल ।
सेइ अपराधे इँहार ‘वासना’ जन्मिल ॥26॥
cc-antya-8.26.translation: Rāmacandra Purī was thus denounced by Mādhavendra Purī. Due to his offense, gradually material desire appeared within him.

lines: sarva loka nindā kare, nindāte nirbandha
devanagari: शुष्क - ब्रह्म - ज्ञानी, नाहि कृष्णेर ‘सम्बन्ध’ ।
सर्व लोक निन्दा करे, निन्दाते निर्बन्ध ॥27॥
cc-antya-8.27.translation: One who is attached to dry speculative knowledge has no relationship with Kṛṣṇa. His occupation is criticizing Vaiṣṇavas. Thus he is situated in criticism.

devanagari: ईश्वर - पुरी गोसाञि करे श्रीपाद - सेवन ।
स्वहस्ते करेन मल - मूत्रादि मार्जन ॥28॥
cc-antya-8.28.translation: Īśvara Purī, the spiritual master of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, performed service to Mādhavendra Purī, cleaning up his stool and urine with his own hand.

devanagari: निरन्तर कृष्ण - नाम कराय स्मरण ।
कृष्ण - नाम, कृष्ण - लीला शुनाय अनुक्षण ॥29॥
cc-antya-8.29.translation: Īśvara Purī was always chanting the holy name and pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa for Mādhavendra Purī to hear. In this way he helped Mādhavendra Purī remember the holy name and pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa at the time of death.

devanagari: जय जय अवधूत - चन्द्र नित्यानन्द ।
जगत् बाँधिल येंह दिया प्रेम - फाँद ॥3॥
cc-antya-8.3.translation: All glories to Nityānanda Prabhu, the greatest of mendicants, who bound the entire world with a knot of ecstatic love for God.

lines: tuṣṭa hañā purī tāṅre kailā āliṅgana
devanagari: तुष्ट हञा पुरी ताँरे कैला आलिङ्गन ।
वर दिला - ‘कृष्णे तोमार हउक प्रेम - धन’ ॥30॥
cc-antya-8.30.translation: Pleased with Īśvara Purī, Mādhavendra Purī embraced him and gave him the benediction that he would be a great devotee and lover of Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: सेइ हैते ईश्वर - पुरी - ‘प्रेमेर सागर’ ।
रामचन्द्र - पुरी हैल सर्व - निन्दाकर ॥31॥
cc-antya-8.31.translation: Thus Īśvara Purī became like an ocean of ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa, whereas Rāmacandra Purī became a dry speculator and a critic of everyone else.

devanagari: महदनुग्रह - निग्रहेर ‘साक्षी’ दुइ - जने ।
एइ दुइ - द्वारे शिखाइला जग - जने ॥32॥
cc-antya-8.32.translation: Īśvara Purī received the blessing of Mādhavendra Purī, whereas Rāmacandra Purī received a rebuke from him. Therefore these two persons, Īśvara Purī and Rāmacandra Purī, are examples of the objects of a great personality's benediction and punishment. Mādhavendra Purī instructed the entire world by presenting these two examples.

lines: ei śloka paḍi' teṅho kaila antardhāna
devanagari: जगद्गुरु माधवेन्द्र करि’ प्रेम दान ।
एइ श्लोक पड़ि’ तेंहो कैल अन्तर्धान ॥33॥
cc-antya-8.33.translation: His Divine Grace Mādhavendra Purī, the spiritual master of the entire world, thus distributed ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa. While passing away from the material world, he chanted the following verse.

devanagari: अयि दीन - दयार्द्र नाथ हे मथुरा - नाथ कदावलोक्यसे ।
हृदयं त्वदलोक - कातरं दयित भ्राम्यति किं करोम्यहम् ॥34॥
cc-antya-8.34.translation: "O my Lord! O most merciful master! O master of Mathurā! When shall I see You again? Because of my not seeing You, my agitated heart has become unsteady. O most beloved one, what shall I do now?"

devanagari: एइ श्लोके कृष्ण - प्रेम करे उपदेश ।
कृष्णेर विरहे भक्तेर भाव - विशेष ॥35॥
cc-antya-8.35.translation: In this verse Mādhavendra Purī instructs how to achieve ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa. By feeling separation from Kṛṣṇa, one becomes spiritually situated.

devanagari: पृथिवीते रोपण करि’ गेला प्रेमाङ्कुर ।
सेइ प्रेमाङ्कुरेर वृक्ष - चैतन्य - ठाकुर ॥36॥
cc-antya-8.36.translation: Mādhavendra Purī sowed the seed of ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa within this material world and then departed. That seed later became a great tree in the form of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: yei ihā śune, sei baḍa bhāgyavān
devanagari: प्रस्तावे कहि लुँ पुरी - गोसाञि र निर्माण ।
येइ इहा शुने, सेइ बड़ भाग्यवान् ॥37॥
cc-antya-8.37.translation: I have incidentally described the passing away of Mādhavendra Purī. Anyone who hears this must be considered very fortunate.

lines: virakta svabhāva, kabhu rahe kona sthale
devanagari: रामचन्द्र - पुरी ऐछे रहिला नीलाचले ।
विरक्त स्वभाव, कभु रहे कोन स्थले ॥38॥
cc-antya-8.38.translation: Thus Rāmacandra Purī stayed at Jagannātha Purī. As customary for those in the renounced order, he would sometimes stay someplace and then go away.

devanagari: अनिमन्त्रण भिक्षा करे, नाहिक निर्णय ।
अन्येर भिक्षार स्थितिर लयेन निश्चय ॥39॥
cc-antya-8.39.translation: There was no certainty of where Rāmacandra Purī would take his meal, for he would do so even uninvited. Nevertheless, he was very particular to keep account of how others were taking their meals.

devanagari: जय जय अद्वैत ईश्वर अवतार ।
कृष्ण अवतारि’ कैल जगत् निस्तार ॥4॥
cc-antya-8.4.translation: All glories to Advaita Prabhu, the incarnation of the Supreme Personality of Godhead. He induced Kṛṣṇa to descend and thus delivered the entire world.

lines: prabhura nimantraṇe lāge kauḍi cāri paṇa
kabhu kāśīśvara, govinda khāna tina jana
devanagari: प्रभुर निमन्त्रणे लागे कौड़ि चारि पण ।
कभु काशीश्वर, गोविन्द खान तिन जन ॥40॥
cc-antya-8.40.translation: To invite Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would cost 320 kauḍis [small conchshells]. This would provide lunch for three people, including Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and sometimes Kāśīśvara and Govinda.

devanagari: प्रत्यह प्रभुर भिक्षा इति - उति हय ।
केह यदि मूल्य आने, चारि - पण - निर्णय ॥41॥
cc-antya-8.41.translation: Every day the Lord would take His meal at a different place, and if someone was prepared to pay for a meal, the price was fixed at only four paṇas.

lines: prabhura sthiti, rīti, bhikṣā, śayana, prayāṇa
devanagari: प्रभुर स्थिति, रीति, भिक्षा, शयन, प्रयाण ।
रामचन्द्र - पुरी करे सर्वानुसन्धान ॥42॥
cc-antya-8.42.translation: Rāmacandra Purī concerned himself with gathering all sorts of information about how Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was situated, including His regulative principles, His lunch, His sleep and His movements.

lines: chidra cāhi' bule, kāṅhā chidra nā pāila
devanagari: प्रभुर यतेक गुण स्पर्शिते नारिल ।
छिद्र चा हि’ बुले, काँहा छिद्र ना पाइल ॥43॥
cc-antya-8.43.translation: Because Rāmacandra Purī was interested only in finding faults, he could not understand the transcendental qualities of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. His only concern was finding faults, but still he could not find any.

devanagari: ‘सन्यासी ह ञा करे मिष्टान्न भक्षण ।
एइ भोगे हय कैछे इन्द्रिय - वारण’? ॥44॥
cc-antya-8.44.translation: At last he found a fault. "How can a person in the renounced order eat so many sweetmeats?" he said. "If one eats sweets, controlling the senses is very difficult."

devanagari: एइ निन्दा क रि’ कहे सर्व - लोक - स्थाने ।
प्रभुरे देखितेह अवश्य आइसे प्रति - दिने ॥45॥
cc-antya-8.45.translation: In this way Rāmacandra Purī blasphemed Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu before everyone, but nevertheless he would regularly come to see the Lord every day.

lines: teṅho chidra cāhi' bule,—ei tāra kāma
devanagari: प्रभु गुरु - बुद्ध्ये करेन सम्भ्रम, सम्मान ।
तेंहो छिद्र चा हि’ बुले, - एइ तार काम ॥46॥
cc-antya-8.46.translation: When they met, the Lord would offer him respectful obeisances, considering him a Godbrother of His spiritual master. Rāmacandra Purī's business, however, was to search for faults in the Lord.

lines: yata nindā kare tāhā prabhu saba jāne
devanagari: यत निन्दा करे ताहा प्रभु सब जाने ।
तथापि आदर करे बड़इ सम्भ्रमे ॥47॥
cc-antya-8.47.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu knew that Rāmacandra Purī was criticizing Him before everyone, but whenever Rāmacandra Purī came to see Him, the Lord offered him respects with great attention.

devanagari: एक - दिन प्रातः - काले आइला प्रभुर घर।
पिपीलिका देखि’ किछु कहेन उत्तर ॥48॥
cc-antya-8.48.translation: One day Rāmacandra Purī came in the morning to the abode of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Seeing many ants, he said something to criticize the Lord.

devanagari: “रात्रावत्र ऐक्षवमासीत्, तेन पिपीलिकाः सञ्चरन्ति ।
अहो! विरक्ता नां सन्यासिनामियमिन्द्रिय - लालसेति ब्रुवन्नुत्थाय गतः” ॥49॥
cc-antya-8.49.translation: "Last night there was sugar candy here," he said. "Therefore ants are wandering about. Alas, this renounced sannyāsī is attached to such sense gratification!" After speaking in this way, he got up and left.

devanagari: जय जय श्रीवासादि यत भक्त - गण ।
श्री - कृष्ण - चैतन्य प्रभु - याँर प्राण - धन ॥5॥
cc-antya-8.5.translation: All glories to all the devotees, headed by Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura. Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya Mahāprabhu is their life and soul.

devanagari: प्रभु परम्पराय निन्दा कैराछेन श्रवण ।
एबे साक्षात् शुनिलेन ‘कल्पि त’ निन्दन ॥50॥
cc-antya-8.50.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had heard rumors about Rāmacandra Purī's blasphemy. Now He directly heard his fanciful accusations.

devanagari: सहजेइ पिपीलिका सर्वत्र बेड़ाय ।
ताहाते तकर् उठाजा दोष लागाय ॥51॥
cc-antya-8.51.translation: Ants generally crawl about here, there and everywhere, but Rāmacandra Purī, looking for imaginary faults, criticized Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu by alleging that there had been sweetmeats in His room.

devanagari: शुनि’ ताहा प्रभुर सङ्कोच - भय मने ।
गोविन्दे बोला ञा किछु कहेन वचने ॥52॥
cc-antya-8.52.translation: After hearing this criticism, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was doubtful and apprehensive. Therefore He called Govinda and instructed him as follows.

lines: "āji haite bhikṣā āmāra ei ta' niyama
devanagari: आजि हैते भिक्षा आमार एइ त नियम ।
पिण्डा - भोगेर एक चौठि, पाँच - गण्डार व्यञ्जन ॥53॥
cc-antya-8.53.translation: "From today on it will be a rule that I shall accept only one-fourth of a pot of Lord Jagannātha's prasāda and five gaṇḍās worth of vegetables.

lines: ihā ba-i adhika āra kichu nā ānibā
adhika ānile āmā ethā nā dekhibā"
devanagari: “इहा बइ अधिक आर किछु ना आनिबा ।
अधिक आनिले आमा एथा ना देखिबा” ॥54॥
cc-antya-8.54.translation: "If you bring any more than this, you will not see Me here anymore."

lines: sakala vaiṣṇave govinda kahe ei vāt
śuni' sabāra māthe yaiche haila vajrāghāta
devanagari: सकल वैष्णवे गोविन्द कहे एइ बात् ।
शुनि’ सबार माथे यैछे हैल वज्राघात ॥55॥
cc-antya-8.55.translation: Govinda relayed this message to all the devotees. When they heard it, they felt as if their heads had been struck by thunderbolts.

devanagari: रामचन्द्र - पुरीके सबाय देय तिरस्कार ।
‘एइ पापिष्ठ आ सि’ प्राण लइल सबार’ ॥56॥
cc-antya-8.56.translation: All the devotees condemned Rāmacandra Purī, saying, "This sinful man has come here and taken our lives."

devanagari: सेइ - दिन एक - विप्र कैल निमन्त्रण ।
एक - चौठि भात, पाँच - गण्डार व्यञ्जन ॥57॥
cc-antya-8.57-58.translation: That day, a brāhmaṇa extended an invitation to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. When Govinda accepted only five gaṇḍās worth of vegetables and a fourth of a pot of rice, the brāhmaṇa, in great despair, struck his head with his hand and cried, "Alas! Alas!"

lines: ye kichu rahila, tāhā govinda pāila
devanagari: सेइ भात - व्यञ्जन प्रभु अर्धेक खाइल ।
ये किछु रहिल, ताहा गोविन्द पाइल ॥59॥
cc-antya-8.59.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu ate only half of the rice and vegetables, and whatever remained was taken by Govinda.

devanagari: एइ - मत गौरचन्द्र निज - भक्त - सङ्गे ।
नीलाचले क्रीड़ा करे कृष्ण - प्रेम - तरङ्गे ॥6॥
cc-antya-8.6.translation: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, at Jagannātha Purī, performed His various pastimes with His own devotees in the waves of love for Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: अर्धाशन करेन प्रभु, गोविन्द अर्धाशन ।
सब भक्त - गण तबे छाड़िल भोजन ॥60॥
cc-antya-8.60.translation: Thus both Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and Govinda ate only half the food they needed. Because of this, all the other devotees gave up eating.

devanagari: गोविन्द - काशीश्वरे प्रभु कैला आज्ञापन ।
‘दुँहे अन्यत्र मा गि’ कर उदर भरण’ ॥61॥
cc-antya-8.61.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu ordered Govinda and Kāśīśvara, "You may both take alms elsewhere to fill your bellies."

devanagari: एइ - रूप महा - दुःखे दिन कत गेल ।
शुनि’ रामचन्द्र - पुरी प्रभु - पाश आइल ॥62॥
cc-antya-8.62.translation: In this way, some days passed in great unhappiness. Hearing of all this, Rāmacandra Purī went to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: praṇāma kari' prabhu kailā caraṇa vandana
devanagari: प्रणाम क रि’ प्रभु कैला चरण वन्दन ।
प्रभुरे कहये किछु हासिया वचन ॥63॥
cc-antya-8.63.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu offered His obeisances to Rāmacandra Purī, worshiping his feet. Then Rāmacandra Purī smiled and spoke to the Lord.

lines: yaiche taiche kare mātra udara bharaṇa
devanagari: “सन्न्यासीर धर्म नहे इन्द्रिय - तर्पण’ ।
यैछे तैछे करे मात्र उदर भरण ॥64॥
cc-antya-8.64.translation: Rāmacandra Purī advised, "It is not the business of a sannyāsī to gratify his senses. He should fill his belly some way or other.

devanagari: तोमारे क्षीण देखि, शुनि, - कर अर्धाशन ।
एइ ‘शुष्क - वैराग्य’ नहे सन्न्यासीर ‘धर्म’ ॥65॥
cc-antya-8.65.translation: "I have heard that You have cut Your eating in half. Indeed, I see that You are skinny. Such dry renunciation is also not the religion of a sannyāsī.

lines: yathā-yogya udara bhare, nā kare 'viṣaya' bhoga
devanagari: यथा - योग्य उदर भरे, ना करे ‘विषय’ भोग ।
सन्न्यासीर तबे सिद्ध हय ज्ञान - योग ॥66॥
cc-antya-8.66.translation: "A sannyāsī eats as much as necessary to maintain his body, but he does not enjoy satisfying his senses materially. Thus a sannyāsī becomes perfect in his spiritual advancement in knowledge.

devanagari: नात्यश्नतोऽपि योगोऽस्ति न चैकान्तमनश्नतः ।
न चाति - स्वप्न - शीलस्य जाग्रतो नैव चार्जुन ॥67॥
cc-antya-8.67-68.translation: "My dear Arjuna, one cannot perform mystic yoga if he eats more than necessary or needlessly fasts, sleeps and dreams too much or does not sleep enough. One should eat and enjoy his senses as much as necessary, one should properly endeavor to execute his duties, and one should regulate his sleep and wakefulness. Thus one can become freed from material pains by executing mystic yoga.' "

devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - “अज्ञ बालक मुइ शिष्य’ तोमार।
मोरे शिक्षा देह’, - एइ भाग्य आमार” ॥69॥
cc-antya-8.69.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then humbly submitted, "I am just like an ignorant boy and am like your disciple. It is My great fortune that you are instructing Me."

devanagari: हेन - काले रामचन्द्र - पुरी - गोसाञि आइला ।
परमानन्द - पुरीरे आर प्रभुरे मिलिला ॥7॥
cc-antya-8.7.translation: Then a sannyāsī named Rāmacandra Purī Gosāñi came to see Paramānanda Purī and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: एत शुनि’ रामचन्द्र - पुरी उठि’ गेला ।
भक्त - गण अर्धाशन करे , - पुरी गोसाञि शुनिला ॥70॥
cc-antya-8.70.translation: Hearing this, Rāmacandra Purī got up and left. He also heard from various sources that all the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu were eating half as much as usual.

devanagari: आर दिन भक्त - गण - सह परमानन्द - पुरी ।
प्रभु - पाशे निवेदिला दैन्य - विनय क रि’ ॥71॥
cc-antya-8.71.translation: The next day, Paramānanda Purī and other devotees approached Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu with great humility and submission.

lines: tāra bole anna chāḍi' kibā habe lābha?
devanagari: “रामचन्द्र - पुरी हय निन्दुक - स्वभाव ।
तार बोले अन्न छाड़ि’ किबा हबे लाभ ?” ॥72॥
cc-antya-8.72.translation: Paramānanda Purī said, "My Godbrother Rāmacandra Purī is by nature a bad critic. If You give up eating because of his words, what will be the profit?

lines: ye nā khāya, tāre khāoyāya yatana kariyā
devanagari: पुरीर स्वभाव, - यथेष्ट आहार कराञा ।
ये ना खाय, तारे खाओयाय यतन करिया ॥73॥
cc-antya-8.73.translation: "It is the nature of Rāmacandra Purī that first he lets one eat as much as desired, and if one does not eat more than necessary, with great attention he makes him eat more.

devanagari: खाओयाञा पुनः तारे करये निन्दन ।
एत अन्न खाओ , - तोमार कत आछे धन ? ॥74॥
cc-antya-8.74.translation: "In this way he induces one to eat more than necessary, and then he directly criticizes him, saying,'You eat so much. How much money do you have in your treasury?

lines: sannyāsīke eta khāoyāñā kara dharma nāśa!
devanagari: सन्न्यासीके एत खाओयात्रा कर धर्म नाश! ।
अतएव जानिनु, - तोमार किछु नाहि भास’ ॥75॥
cc-antya-8.75.translation: "Also, by inducing sannyāsīs to eat so much, you spoil their religious principles. Therefore I can understand that you have no advancement.'

lines: ke kaiche vyavahāre, kebā kaiche khāya
devanagari: के कैछे व्यवहारे, केबा कैछे खाय ।
एई अनुसन्धान तेंहो करय सदाय ॥76॥
cc-antya-8.76.translation: "It is Rāmacandra Purī's business to inquire always about how others are eating and conducting their daily affairs.

lines: śāstre yei dui dharma kairāche varjana
devanagari: शास्त्रे येइ दुइ धर्म कैराछे वर्जन ।
सेइ कर्म निरन्तर इँहार करण ॥77॥
cc-antya-8.77.translation: "The two kinds of activity rejected in the revealed scriptures constitute his daily affairs.

devanagari: पर - स्वभाव - कर्माणि न प्रशंसेन्न गर्हयेत् ।
विश्वमे कात्मकं पश्यन्प्रकृत्या पुरुषेण च ॥78॥
cc-antya-8.78.translation: "One should see that because of the meeting of material nature and the living entity, the universe is acting uniformly. Thus one should neither praise nor criticize the characteristics or activities of others.'

devanagari: तार म ध्ये पूर्व - विधि ‘प्रशंसा’ छाड़िया ।
पर - विधि ‘निन्दा’ करे ‘बलिष्ठ’ जानिया ॥79॥
cc-antya-8.79.translation: "Of the two rules, Rāmacandra Purī obeys the first by abandoning praise, but although he knows that the second is more prominent, he neglects it by criticizing others.

devanagari: परमानन्द - पुरी कैल चरण वन्दन ।
पुरी - गोसाञि कैल ताँरे दृढ़ आलिङ्गन ॥8॥
cc-antya-8.8.translation: Paramānanda Purī offered respects at the feet of Rāmacandra Purī, and Rāmacandra Purī strongly embraced him.

devanagari: पूर्व - परयोर्मध्ये पर - विधिर्बलवान् ॥80॥
cc-antya-8.80.translation: "Between the former rule and the latter rule, the latter is more important.'

lines: yāhāṅ guṇa śata āche, tāhā nā kare grahaṇa
devanagari: याहाँ गुण शत आछे, ताहा ना करे ग्रहण ।
गुण - मध्ये छले करे दोष - आरोपण ॥81॥
cc-antya-8.81.translation: "Even where there are hundreds of good qualities, a critic does not consider them. Rather, he attempts by some trick to point out a fault in those attributes.

lines: iṅhāra svabhāva ihāṅ karite nā yuyāya
devanagari: इँहार स्वभाव इहाँ करिते ना युयाय ।
तथापि कहिये किछु मर्म - दुःख पाय ॥82॥
cc-antya-8.82.translation: "One should not, therefore, follow the principles of Rāmacandra Purī. Nevertheless, I have to say something against him because he is making our hearts unhappy.

lines: iṅhāra vacane kene anna tyāga kara?
devanagari: “इँहार वचने केने अन्न त्याग कर ? ।
पूर्ववत् निमन्त्रण मान’, - सबार बोल धर” ॥83॥
cc-antya-8.83.translation: "Why have you given up proper eating due to the criticism of Rāmacandra Purī? Please accept invitations as before. This is the request of us all."

lines: prabhu kahe,—"sabe kene purīre kara roṣa?
'sahaja' dharma kahe teṅho, tāṅra kibā doṣa?
devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - “सबे केने पुरीरे कर रोष? ।
‘सहज’ धर्म कहे तेंहो, ताँर किबा दोष ?” ॥84॥
cc-antya-8.84.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "Why are all of you angry at Rāmacandra Purī? He is expounding the natural principles of sannyāsa life. Why are you accusing him?

devanagari: “यति हञा जिह्वा - लाम्पट्य - अत्यन्त अन्याय ।
यतिर धर्म , - प्राण राखिते आहार - मात्र खाय” ॥85॥
cc-antya-8.85.translation: "For a sannyāsī to indulge in satisfying the tongue is a great offense. The duty of a sannyāsī is to eat only as much as needed to keep body and soul together."

lines: tabe sabe meli' prabhure bahu yatna kailā
devanagari: तबे सबे मे लि’ प्रभुरे बहु यत्न कैला ।
सबार आग्रहे प्रभु अर्धेक राखिला ॥86॥
cc-antya-8.86.translation: When they all requested very fervently that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu take a full meal, He still would not do so. Instead, He responded to their request by accepting half as much as usual.

devanagari: दुइ - पण कौड़ि लागे प्रभुर निमन्त्रणे ।
कभु दुइ - जन भोक्ता, कभु तिन - जने ॥87॥
cc-antya-8.87.translation: The cost for the food needed to invite Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was fixed at two paṇas of kauḍis [160 conchshells], and that food would be taken by two men and sometimes three.

devanagari: अभोज्यान्न विप्र यदि करेन निमन्त्रण ।
प्रसाद - मूल्य लइते लागे कौड़ि दुइ - पण ॥88॥
cc-antya-8.88.translation: When a brāhmaṇa at whose home an invitation could not be accepted invited the Lord, he would pay two paṇas of conchshells to purchase the prasāda.

lines: kichu 'prasāda' āne, kichu pāka kare ghare
devanagari: भोज्यान्न विप्र यदि निमन्त्रण करे ।
किछु ‘प्रसाद’ आने, किछु पाक करे घरे ॥89॥
cc-antya-8.89.translation: When a brāhmaṇa at whose home an invitation could be accepted invited Him, the brāhmaṇa would purchase part of the prasāda and cook the rest at home.

devanagari: महाप्रभु कैला ताँरे दण्डवत् नति ।
आलिङ्गन करि’ तेंहो कैल कृष्ण - स्मृति ॥9॥
cc-antya-8.9.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu also offered obeisances unto Rāmacandra Purī, who then embraced Him and thus remembered Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: पण्डित - गोसाञि, भगवानाचार्य, सार्वभौम ।
निमन्त्रणेर दिने यदि करे नि मन्त्रण ॥90॥
cc-antya-8.90-91.translation: Even on a day when Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was invited to dine by others, if Gadādhara Paṇḍita, Bhagavān Ācārya or Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya invited Him, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had no independence. He would accept their invitations as they desired.

lines: yāhāṅ yaiche yogya, tāhāṅ karena vyavahāra
devanagari: भक्त - गणे सुख दिते प्रभुर ‘अवतार’ ।
याहाँ यैछे योग्य, ताहाँ करेन व्यवहार ॥92॥
cc-antya-8.92.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu actually descended to give happiness to the devotees. Thus He behaved in whatever way fit the time and circumstances.

devanagari: कभु लौकिक रीति, - येन ‘इतर’ जन ।
कभु स्वतन्त्र, करेन ‘ऐश्वर्य’ प्रकटन ॥93॥
cc-antya-8.93.translation: Because of His full independence, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sometimes behaved like a common man and sometimes manifested His godly opulence.

lines: kabhu tāre nāhi māne, dekhe tṛṇa-prāya
devanagari: कभु रामचन्द्र - पुरीर हय भृत्य - प्राय ।
कभु तारे नाहि माने, देखे तृण - प्राय ॥94॥
cc-antya-8.94.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sometimes accepted Rāmacandra Purī as His master and considered Himself a servant, and sometimes the Lord, not caring for him, would see him as being just like a straw.

devanagari: ईश्वर - चरित्र प्रभुर - बुद्धिर अगोचर ।
यबे येइ करेन, सेइ सब - मनोहर ॥95॥
cc-antya-8.95.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu behaved exactly like the Supreme Personality of Godhead, beyond the restriction of anyone's intelligence. Whatever He liked He did, but all His activities were very beautiful.

devanagari: एइ - मत रामचन्द्र - पुरी नीलाचले ।
दिन कत रहि गेला तीर्थ’ करिबारे ॥96॥
cc-antya-8.96.translation: Thus Rāmacandra Purī stayed for some days at Nīlācala [Jagannātha Purī]. Then he left to visit various holy places of pilgrimage.

lines: teṅho gele prabhura gaṇa haila haraṣita
devanagari: तेंहो गेले प्रभुर गण हैल हरषित ।
शिरेर पाथर येन पड़िल आचम्बित ॥97॥
cc-antya-8.97.translation: The devotees considered Rāmacandra Purī to be like a great burden on their heads. When he left Jagannātha Purī, everyone felt extremely happy, as if a great stone burden had suddenly fallen from their heads to the ground.

devanagari: स्वच्छन्दे निमन्त्रण, प्रभुर कीर्तन - नर्तन ।
स्वच्छन्दे करेन सबे प्रसाद भोजन ॥98॥
cc-antya-8.98.translation: After his departure, everything was happy once again. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu accepted invitations as usual and led congregational chanting and dancing. Everyone else also accepted prasāda without hindrances.

lines: guru upekṣā kaile, aiche phala haya
devanagari: गुरु उपेक्षा कैले, ऐछे फल हय ।
क्रमे ईश्वर - पर्यन्त अपराधे ठेकय ॥99॥
cc-antya-8.99.translation: If one's spiritual master rejects him, one becomes so fallen that he, like Rāmacandra Purī, commits offenses even to the Supreme Personality of Godhead.

devanagari: अगण्य - धन्य - चैतन्य - गणानां प्रेम - वन्यया ।
निन्येऽधन्य - जन - स्वान्त - मरुः शश्वदनूपताम् ॥1॥
cc-antya-9.1.translation: The innumerable, glorious followers of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu brought a constant flood to the desertlike hearts of the unfortunate with an inundation of ecstatic love.

lines: prahlāda, bali, vyāsa, śuka ādi muni-gaṇa
āsi' prabhu dekhi' preme haya acetana
devanagari: प्रह्लाद, बलि, व्यास, शुक आदि मुनि - गण ।
आसि’ प्रभु देखि प्रेमे हय अचेतन ॥10॥
cc-antya-9.10.translation: Prahlāda Mahārāja, Bali Mahārāja, Vyāsadeva, Śukadeva Gosvāmī and other great sages came to visit Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Upon seeing Him, they became unconscious in ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa.

lines: tumi yāha, prabhure rākhaha yatna kari'
ei mui tāhāre chāḍinu saba kauḍi"
devanagari: तुमि याह, प्रभुरे राखह यत्न करि’ ।
एइ मुइ ताहारे छाडिनु सब कौड़ि” ॥100॥
cc-antya-9.100.translation: "Go personally to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and keep Him at Jagannātha Purī with great attention. I shall excuse Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka from all his debts."

lines: kauḍi chāḍile prabhu kadācit duḥkha māne"
devanagari: मिश्र कहे, “कौड़ि छाड़िबा , - नहे प्रभुर मने ।
कौड़ि छाड़िले प्रभु कदाचित् दुःख माने” ॥101॥
cc-antya-9.101.translation: Kāśī Miśra said, "Excusing Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka of all his debts will not make the Lord happy, for that is not His intention."

devanagari: राजा कहे, “कौड़ि छाड़िमु, - इहा ना कहिबा ।
सहजे मोर प्रिय ता ‘रा, - इहा जानाइबा ॥102॥
cc-antya-9.102.translation: The King said, "I shall absolve Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka of all his debts, but don't speak of this to the Lord. Simply let Him know that all the family members of Bhavānanda Rāya and Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka are naturally my dear friends.

devanagari: भवानन्द - राय - आमार पूज्य - गर्वित ।
ताँर पुत्र - गणे आमार सहजेइ प्रीत” ॥103॥
cc-antya-9.103.translation: "Bhavānanda Rāya is worthy of my worship and respect. Therefore I am always naturally affectionate to his sons."

lines: eta bali' miśre namaskari' rājā ghare gelā
devanagari: एत बलि’ मिश्रे नमस्क रि’ राजा घरे गेला ।
गोपीनाथे ‘बड़ जाना य’ डाकिया आनिला ॥104॥
cc-antya-9.104.translation: After offering obeisances to Kāśī Miśra, the King returned to his palace and called for both Gopīnātha and the eldest prince.

lines: sei mālajāṭhyā daṇḍa pāṭa tomāre ta' diluṅ
devanagari: राजा कहे, - “सब कौड़ि तोमारे छाड़ि लुँ ।
सेइ मा लञाठ्या दण्ड पाट तोमारे त’ दिलुँ ॥105॥
cc-antya-9.105.translation: The King told Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka, "You are excused for all the money you owe the treasury, and the place known as Mālajāṭhyā Daṇḍapāṭa is again given to you for collections.

lines: āra bāra aiche nā khāiha rāja-dhana
āji haite diluṅ tomāya dviguṇa vartana"
devanagari: आर बार ऐछे ना खाइह राज - धन ।
आजि हैते दि लुँ तोमाय द्विगुण वर्तन” ॥106॥
cc-antya-9.106.translation: "Do not again misappropriate the revenue of the government. In case you think your salary insufficient, henceforward it will be doubled."

devanagari: एत बलि’ ‘नेत - धटी’ तारे पराइल ।
प्रभु - आज्ञा लञा याह, विदाय तोमा दिल” ॥107॥
cc-antya-9.107.translation: After saying this, the King appointed him by offering him a silken wrapper for his body. "Go to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu," he said. "After taking permission from Him, go to your home. I bid you farewell. Now you may go."

lines: paramārthe prabhura kṛpā, seha rahu dūre
ananta tāhāra phala, ke balite pāre?
devanagari: परमार्थे प्रभुर कृपा, सेह रहु दूरे ।
अनन्त ताहार फल, के बलिते पारे ? ॥108॥
cc-antya-9.108.translation: By the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, one can certainly become spiritually advanced. Indeed, no one can estimate the results of His mercy.

lines: tāhāra gaṇanā kāro mane nāhi āise!
devanagari: ‘राज्य - विषय - फल एइ - कृपार ‘आभा से’! ।
ताहार गणना कारो मने नाहि आइसे! ॥109॥
cc-antya-9.109.translation: Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka achieved the result of kingly opulence due to but a glimpse of the Lord's mercy. Therefore no one can calculate the full value of His mercy.

lines: bāhire phukāre loka, darśana nā pāñā
devanagari: बाहिरे फुकारे लोक, दर्शन ना पा ञा ।
‘कृष्ण कह’ बलेन प्रभु बाहिरे आसिया ॥11॥
cc-antya-9.11.translation: Being unable to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the populace outside His room would make a tumultuous sound. Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would go outside and tell them, "Chant Hare Kṛṣṇa."

devanagari: काहाँ चाङ्गे चड़ाञा लय धन - प्राण! ।
काहाँ सब छा ड़ि’ सेइ राज्यादि - प्रदान! ॥110॥
cc-antya-9.110.translation: Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka was lifted onto the cāṅga to be killed, and all his money was taken away, but instead his debts were excused, and he was appointed collector in the same place.

lines: kāhāṅ sarvasva veci' laya, deyā nā yāya kauḍi!
devanagari: काहाँ सर्वस्व वेचि’ लय, देया ना याय कौड़ि!।
काहाँ द्विगुण वर्तन, पराय नेत - धड़ि! ॥111॥
cc-antya-9.111.translation: On one hand Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka was unable to clear his debt even by selling all his possessions, but on the other his salary was doubled, and he was honored with the silken wrapper.

lines: prabhura icchā nāhi, tāre kauḍi chāḍāibe
devanagari: प्रभुर इच्छा नाहि, तारे कौड़ि छाड़ाइबे ।
द्विगुण वर्तन करि’ पुनः ‘विषय’ दिबे ॥112॥
cc-antya-9.112.translation: It was not the desire of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu that Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka be excused of his debt to the government, nor was it His desire that his salary be doubled or that he be reappointed collector at the same place.

lines: tathāpi tāra sevaka āsi' kaila nivedana
tāte kṣubdha haila yabe mahāprabhura mana
devanagari: तथापि तार सेवक आ सि’ कैल निवेदन ।
ताते क्षुब्ध हैल यबे महाप्रभुर मन ॥113॥
cc-antya-9.113.translation: When Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka's servant went to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and informed the Lord of his plight, the Lord was somewhat agitated and dissatisfied.

devanagari: विषय - सुख दिते प्रभुर नाहि मनोबल ।
निवेदन - प्रभावेह तबु फले एत फल ॥114॥
cc-antya-9.114.translation: The Lord had no intention to award His devotee the happiness of material opulence, yet simply because of His being informed, such a great result was obtained.

lines: ke kahite pāre gaurera āścarya svabhāva?
brahmā-śiva ādi yāṅra nā pāya antarbhāva
devanagari: के कहिते पारे गौरेर आश्चर्य स्वभाव ? ।
ब्रह्मा - शिव आदि याँर ना पाय अन्तर्भाव ॥115॥
cc-antya-9.115.translation: No one can estimate the wonderful characteristics of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Even Lord Brahmā and Lord Śiva cannot understand the intentions of the Lord.

devanagari: एथा काशी - मिश्र आ सि’ प्रभुर चरणे ।
राजार चरित्र सब कैला निवेदने ॥116॥
cc-antya-9.116.translation: Kāśī Miśra went to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and informed Him in detail of all the King's intentions.

devanagari: प्रभु कहे,_“काशी - मिश्र, कि तुमि करिला? ।
राज - प्रतिग्रह तुमि आमा’ कराइला ?” ॥117॥
cc-antya-9.117.translation: Upon hearing about Kāśī Miśra's tactics with the King, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "Kāśī Miśra, what have you done? You have made Me indirectly take help from the King."

devanagari: मिश्र कहे , - “शुन, प्रभु, राजार वचने ।
अकपटे राजा एइ कैला निवेदने ॥118॥
cc-antya-9.118.translation: Kāśī Miśra said, "My dear Lord, the King has done this without reservations. Kindly hear his statement.

devanagari: ‘प्रभु येन नाहि जानेन, - राजा आमार लागिया ।
दुइ - लक्ष काहन कौड़ि दिलेक छाड़िया ॥119॥
cc-antya-9.119.translation: "The King said,'Speak to the Lord in such a way that He will not think, "For My sake the King has forfeited 200,000 kāhanas of kauḍis."

lines: prabhura darśane saba loka preme bhāse
devanagari: प्रभुर दर्शने सब लोक प्रेमे भासे ।
एइ - मत याय प्रभुर रात्रि - दिवसे ॥12॥
cc-antya-9.12.translation: All kinds of people would come to see the Lord, and upon seeing Him they would be overwhelmed with ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa. In this way Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu passed His days and nights.

devanagari: भवानन्देर पुत्र सब - मोर प्रियतम ।
इँहा - सबकारे आमि देखि आत्म - सम ॥120॥
cc-antya-9.120.translation: "Inform Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu that all the sons of Bhavānanda Rāya are especially dear to me. I consider them like members of my family.

lines: khāya, piye, luṭe, vilāya, nā karoṅ vicāra
devanagari: अतएव याहाँ याहाँ देइ अधिकार ।
खाय, पिये, लुटे, विलाय, ना करों विचार ॥121॥
cc-antya-9.121.translation: "Therefore I have appointed them collectors in various places, and although they spend the government's money, eat, drink, plunder and distribute it as they like, I do not take them very seriously.

lines: ye khāila, yebā dila, nāhi lekhā-dāya
devanagari: राजमहिन्दार ‘राजा’ कैनु राम - राय ।
ये खाइल, येबा दिल, नाहि लेखा - दाय ॥122॥
cc-antya-9.122.translation: "I made Rāmānanda Rāya the governor of Rājamahendrī. There is practically no account of whatever money he took and distributed in that position.

devanagari: गोपीनाथ एइ - मत ‘विषय’ करिया ।
दुइ - चारि - लक्ष काहन रहे त’ खाञा ॥123॥
cc-antya-9.123.translation: "Having been appointed collector, Gopīnātha, in the same way, also generally spends two to four hundred thousand kāhanas as he likes.

lines: kichu deya, kichu nā deya, nā kari vicāra
devanagari: किछु देय, किछु ना देय, ना करि विचार ।
‘जाना’ - सहित अप्रीत्ये दुःख पाइल एइ - बार ॥124॥
cc-antya-9.124.translation: "Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka would collect some and pay some, spending it at will, but I would not consider this very seriously. This time, however, he was put in trouble because of a misunderstanding with the prince.

devanagari: ‘जाना’ एत कैला , - - इहा मुइ नाहि जानों ।
भवानन्देर पुत्र - सबे आत्म - सम मानों ॥125॥
cc-antya-9.125.translation: "The prince created this situation without my knowledge, but actually I consider all the sons of Bhavānanda Rāya to be like my relatives.

lines: tāṅhā lāgi' dravya chāḍi'—ihā māt jāne
devanagari: ताँहा ला गि’ द्रव्य छा ड़ि’ - इहा मात् जाने ।
‘सहजेइ मोर प्रीति हय ताहा - सने’” ॥126॥
cc-antya-9.126.translation: "Because of my intimate relationship with them, I have absolved Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka of all his debts. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu does not know this fact. Whatever I have done is because of my intimate relationship with the family of Bhavānanda Rāya.' "

devanagari: शुनिया राजार विनय प्रभुर आनन्द ।
हेन - काले आइला तथा राय भवानन्द ॥127॥
cc-antya-9.127.translation: Having heard from Kāśī Miśra all these statements concerning the King's mentality, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was very happy. At that time, Bhavānanda Rāya also arrived there.

devanagari: पञ्च - पुत्र - सहिते आ सि’ पड़िला चरणे ।
उठाञा प्रभु ताँरे कैला आलिङ्गने ॥128॥
cc-antya-9.128.translation: Bhavānanda Rāya, along with his five sons, fell at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who lifted him up and embraced him.

devanagari: रामानन्द - राय आदि सबाइ मिलिला ।
भवानन्द - राय तबे बलिते लागिला ॥129॥
cc-antya-9.129.translation: Thus Rāmānanda Rāya, all his brothers, and their father met Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Then Bhavānanda Rāya began speaking.

devanagari: एक - दिन लोक आ सि’ प्रभुरे निवेदिल ।
गोपीनाथेरे ‘बड़ जाना’ चाङ्गे चड़ाइल ॥13॥
cc-antya-9.13.translation: One day people suddenly came to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and informed Him, "Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka, the son of Bhavānanda Rāya, has been condemned to death by the baḍa-jānā, the eldest son of the King, and has been raised on the cāṅga.

lines: e vipade rākhi' prabhu, punaḥ nilā mūla
devanagari: “तोमार किङ्कर एइ सब मोर कुल ।
ए विपदे रा खि’ प्रभु, पुनः निला मूल ॥130॥
cc-antya-9.130.translation: "All these members of my family," he said, "are Your eternal servants. You have saved us from this great danger. Therefore You have purchased us for a proper price.

devanagari: भक्त - वात्सल्य एबे प्रकट करिला ।
पूर्वे येन पञ्च - पाण्डवे विपदे तारिला” ॥131॥
cc-antya-9.131.translation: "You have now demonstrated Your love for Your devotees, just as when You previously saved the five Pāṇḍavas from great danger."

devanagari: ‘नेतधटी’ - माथे गोपीनाथ चरणे पड़िला ।
राजार कृपा - वृत्तान्त सकल कहिला ॥132॥
cc-antya-9.132.translation: Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka, his head covered with the silken wrapper, fell at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and described in detail the King's mercy toward him.

devanagari: बाकी - कौड़ि बाद, आर द्विगुण वर्तन कैला ।
पुनः ‘विषय’ दिया नेत - धटी’ पराइला ॥133॥
cc-antya-9.133.translation: "The King has excused me for the balance due," he said. "He has reappointed me to my post by honoring me with this silken cloth and has doubled my salary.

devanagari: काहाँ चाङ्गेर उपर सेइ मरण - प्रमाद!।
काहाँ ‘नेत - धटी’ पुनः, - ए - सब प्रसाद! ॥134॥
cc-antya-9.134.translation: "I was lifted upon the cāṅga to be killed, but on the contrary I was honored with this silken cloth. This is all Your mercy.

lines: cāṅgera upare tomāra caraṇa dhyāna kailuṅ
devanagari: चाङ्गेर उपरे तोमार चरण ध्यान कैलुँ।
चरण - स्मरण - प्रभावे एइ फल पाइ लुँ ॥135॥
cc-antya-9.135.translation: "On the cāṅga I began meditating upon Your lotus feet, and the power of that remembrance has yielded all these results.

lines: loke camatkāra mora e saba dekhiyā
devanagari: लोके चमत्कार मोर ए सब देखियो ।
प्रशंसे तोमार कृपा - महिमा गा ञा ॥136॥
cc-antya-9.136.translation: "Struck with wonder by my affairs, the populace is glorifying the greatness of Your mercy.

devanagari: किन्तु तोमार स्मरणेर नहे एइ ‘मुख्य - फल’ ।
‘फलाभा स’ एइ, - याते विष य’ चञ्चल ॥137॥
cc-antya-9.137.translation: "However, my Lord, these are not the principal results of meditating upon Your lotus feet. Material opulence is very flickering. Therefore it is simply a glimpse of the result of Your mercy.

lines: sei kṛpā mote nāhi, yāte aiche haya!
devanagari: राम - राये, वाणीनाथे कैला निर्विष य’ ।
सेइ कृपा मोते नाहि, याते ऐछे हय! ॥138॥
cc-antya-9.138.translation: "Your real mercy has been granted to Rāmānanda Rāya and Vāṇīnātha Rāya, for You have detached them from all material opulence. I think that I have not been favored by such mercy.

devanagari: “शुद्ध कृपा कर, गोसा ञि, घुचाह ‘विषय’ ।
निर्विण्ण ह - इनु, मोते ‘विषय’ ना हय” ॥139॥
cc-antya-9.139.translation: "Kindly bestow upon me Your pure mercy so that I may also become renounced. I am no longer interested in material enjoyment."

lines: tale khaḍga pāti' tāre upare ḍāribe
prabhu rakṣā karena yabe, tabe nistāribe
devanagari: तले खड्ग पाति’ तारे उपरे डारिबे ।
प्रभु रक्षा करेन यबे, तबे निस्तारिबे ॥14॥
cc-antya-9.14.translation: "He has placed swords beneath the platform," they said, "and will throw Gopīnātha upon them. O Lord, only if You protect him will he be saved.

devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - सन्यासी यबे ह - इबा पञ्च - जन ।
कुटुम्ब - बाहुल्य तोमार के करे भरण? ॥140॥
cc-antya-9.140.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "If you all adopt the renounced order and lose interest in dealing with pounds, shillings and pence, who will take charge of maintaining your large family?

devanagari: महा - विषय कर, किबा विरक्त उदास ।
जन्मे - जन्मे तुमि पञ्च - मोर ‘निज - दास’ ॥141॥
cc-antya-9.141.translation: "Whether you are involved in material activities or become completely renounced, you five brothers are all My eternal servants, birth after birth.

devanagari: किन्तु मोर करिह एक ‘आज्ञा’ पालन ।
‘व्यय ना करिह किछु राजार मूल - धन’ ॥142॥
cc-antya-9.142.translation: "However, just obey one order from Me. Do not spend any of the King's revenue.

lines: rājāra mūla-dhana diyā ye kichu labhya haya
sei dhana kariha nānā dharme-karme vyaya
devanagari: राजार मूल - धन दिया ये किछु लभ्य हय ।
सेइ धन करिह नाना धर्मे - कर्मे व्यय ॥143॥
cc-antya-9.143.translation: "First you should pay the revenue due the King, and then you may spend the balance for religious and fruitive activities.

devanagari: असद्व्यय ना करिह , - य़ाते दुइ - लोक या य” ।
एत बलि’ सबकारे दिलेन विदाय ॥144॥
cc-antya-9.144.translation: "Don't spend a farthing for sinful activities for which you will be the loser both in this life and the next." After saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu bade them farewell.

devanagari: रायेर घरे प्रभुर ‘कृपा - विवर्त’ कहिल ।
भक्त - वात्सल्य - गुण याते व्यक्त हैल ॥145॥
cc-antya-9.145.translation: Thus the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was spoken of in the family of Bhavānanda Rāya. That mercy was clearly demonstrated, although it appeared to be something different.

lines: sabāya āliṅgiyā prabhu vidāya yabe dilā
hari-dhvani kari' saba bhakta uṭhi' gelā
devanagari: सबाय आलिङ्गिया प्रभु विदाय यबे दिला ।
हरि - ध्वनि क रि’ सब भक्त उ ठि’ गेला ॥146॥
cc-antya-9.146.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu embraced them all and bade them farewell. Then all the devotees got up and left, loudly chanting the holy name of Hari.

lines: prabhura kṛpā dekhi' sabāra haila camatkāra
devanagari: प्रभुर कृपा देखि’ सबार हैल चमत्कार ।
ताहारा बुझिते नारे प्रभुर व्यवहार ॥147॥
cc-antya-9.147.translation: Seeing the extraordinary mercy the Lord granted to the family of Bhavānanda Rāya, everyone was struck with wonder. They could not understand the behavior of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: tārā sabe yadi kṛpā karite sādhila
devanagari: तारा सबे यदि कृपा करिते साधिल ।
‘आमा’ हैते किछु नहे - प्रभु तबे कहिल ॥148॥
cc-antya-9.148.translation: Indeed, when all the devotees had requested the Lord to bestow His mercy upon Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka, the Lord had replied that He could do nothing.

devanagari: गोपीनाथेर निन्दा, आर आपन - निर्वेद ।
एइ मात्र कहिल - इहार ना बुझिबे भेद ॥149॥
cc-antya-9.149.translation: I have simply described the chastisement of Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's indifference. But the deep meaning of this behavior is very difficult to understand.

devanagari: सवंशे तोमार सेवक - भवानन्द - राय ।
ताँर पुत्र - तोमार सेवके राखिते युयाय ॥15॥
cc-antya-9.15.translation: "Bhavānanda Rāya and his entire family are your servants. Therefore it is quite fitting for You to save the son of Bhavānanda Rāya."

lines: kāśī-miśre nā sādhila, rājāre nā sādhila
udyoga vinā mahāprabhu eta phala dila
devanagari: काशी - मिश्रे ना साधिल, राजारे ना साधिल ।
उद्योग विना महाप्रभु एत फल दिल ॥150॥
cc-antya-9.150.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu gave so much to Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka without directly making requests of either Kāśī Miśra or the King.

lines: sei bujhe' tāṅra pade yāṅra mana 'dhīra'
devanagari: चैतन्य - चरित्र एइ परम गम्भीर ।
सेइ बुझे, ताँर पदे याँर मन ‘धीर’ ॥151॥
cc-antya-9.151.translation: The intentions of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu are so deep that one can understand them only if he has complete faith in service to the lotus feet of the Lord.

lines: prema-bhakti pāya, tāṅra vipada yāya nāśa
devanagari: येइ इहाँ शुने प्रभुर वात्सल्य - प्रकाश ।
प्रेम - भक्ति पाय, ताँर विपद याय नाश ॥152॥
cc-antya-9.152.translation: Whether or not one understands it, if one hears of this incident concerning Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka's activities and Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's causeless mercy upon him, certainly he will be promoted to the platform of ecstatic love for the Lord, and for him all dangers will be nullified.

devanagari: श्री - रूप - रघुनाथ - पदे यार आश ।
चैतन्य - चरितामृत कहे कृष्णदास ॥153॥
cc-antya-9.153.translation: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.

lines: tabe sei loka kahe saba vivaraṇa
devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - ‘राजा केने करये ताड़न ?’।
तबे सेइ लोक कहे सब विवरण ॥16॥
cc-antya-9.16.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu inquired, "Why is the King chastising him?" Thereupon the people described the entire incident.

devanagari: “गोपीनाथ - पट्टनायक - रामानन्द - भाई ।
सर्व - काल हय तेंह राज - विषयी ॥17॥
cc-antya-9.17.translation: They said, "Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka, the brother of Rāmānanda Rāya, has always been a treasurer for the government.

lines: sādhi' pāḍi' āni' dravya dila rāja-dvāra
devanagari: ‘मालञाठ्या - दण्डपाटे’ तार अधिकार ।
साधि’ पाड़ि’ आनि’ द्रव्य दिल राज - द्वार ॥18॥
cc-antya-9.18.translation: "He served in the place known as Mālajāṭhyā Daṇḍapāta, soliciting and collecting money there and depositing it in the government treasury.

lines: dui-lakṣa kāhana tāra ṭhāñi bākī ha-ila
dui-lakṣa kāhana kauḍi rājā ta' māgila
devanagari: दुइ - लक्ष काहन तार ठाञि बाकी ह - इल ।
दुइ - लक्ष काहन कौड़ि राजा त’ मागिल ॥19॥
cc-antya-9.19.translation: "Once when he deposited the collection, however, a balance of 200,000 kāhanas of conchshells was due from him. Therefore the King demanded this sum.

devanagari: जय जय श्री कृष्ण - चैतन्य दयामय ।
जय जय नित्यानन्द करुण - हृदय ॥2॥
cc-antya-9.2.translation: All glories to Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the most merciful incarnation! All glories to Lord Nityānanda, whose heart is always compassionate!

lines: teṅha kahe,—"sthūla-dravya nāhi ye gaṇi' diba
devanagari: तेंह कहे , - “स्थूल - द्रव्य नाहि ये गणि’ दिब ।
क्रमे - क्रमे वेचि’ किनि’ द्रव्य भरिब ॥20॥
cc-antya-9.20.translation: "Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka replied,'There is no money I can immediately give you in cash. Please give me time. Gradually I shall purchase and sell my gross goods and in this way fill your treasury.

lines: ghoḍā daśa-bāra haya, laha' mūlya kari' "
eta bali' ghoḍā āne rāja-dvāre dhari'
devanagari: घोड़ा दश - बार हय, लह” मूल्य करि’” ।
एत बलि’ घोड़ा आने राज - द्वारे ध रि’ ॥21॥
cc-antya-9.21.translation: "There are ten to twelve good horses. Take them immediately for a proper price.' After saying this, he brought all the horses to the door of the King.

lines: eka rāja-putra ghoḍāra mūlya bhāla jāne
devanagari: एक राज - पुत्र घोड़ार मूल्य भाल जाने ।
तारे पाठाइल राजा पात्र - मित्र सने ॥22॥
cc-antya-9.22.translation: "One of the princes knew how to estimate the price of horses very well. Thus the King sent for him to come with his ministers and friends.

devanagari: सेइ राज - पुत्र मूल्य करे घाटाञा ।
गोपीनाथेर क्रोध हैल मूल्य शुनिया ॥23॥
cc-antya-9.23.translation: "The prince, however, purposely gave a reduced estimate for the value of the horses. When Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka heard the price quoted, he was very angry.

devanagari: सेइ राज - पुत्रेर स्वभाव, - ग्रीवा फिराय ।
ऊर्ध्व - मुखे बार - बार इति - उति चाय ॥24॥
cc-antya-9.24.translation: "That prince had a personal idiosyncrasy of turning his neck and facing the sky, looking here and there again and again.

lines: tāre nindā kari' kahe sagarva vacane
rājā kṛpā kare tāte bhaya nāhi māne
devanagari: तारे निन्दा क रि’ कहे सगर्व वचने ।
राजा कृपा करे ताते भय नाहि माने ॥25॥
cc-antya-9.25.translation: "Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka criticized the prince. He was unafraid of the prince because the King was very kind toward him.

lines: 'āmāra ghoḍā grīvā nā phirāya ūrdhve nāhi cāya
tāte ghoḍāra mūlya ghāṭi karite nā yuyāya'
devanagari: ‘आमार घोड़ा ग्रीवा ना फिराय ऊर्ध्वे नाहि चाय ।
ताते घोड़ार मूल्य घाटि करिते ना युयाय’ ॥26॥
cc-antya-9.26.translation: "Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka said, 'My horses never turn their necks or look upward. Therefore the price for them should not be reduced.'

lines: rājāra ṭhāñi yāi' bahu lāgāni karila
devanagari: शुनि’ राजपुत्र - मने क्रोध उपजिल ।
राजार ठाञि याइ’ बहु लागानि करिल ॥27॥
cc-antya-9.27.translation: "Hearing this criticism, the prince became very angry. Going before the King, he made some false allegations against Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka.

lines: "kauḍi nāhi dibe ei, beḍāya chadma kari'
ājñā deha yadi,—'cāṅge caḍāñā la-i kauḍi'
devanagari: “कौड़ि नाहि दिबे एइ, बेड़ाय छद्म क रि’ ।
आज्ञा देह यदि , - ‘चाङ्गे चड़ाञा ल - इ कौड़ि’ ॥28॥
cc-antya-9.28.translation: "This Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka,' he said,'is unwilling to pay the money due. Instead, he is squandering it under some pretext. If you issue an order, I can put him on the cāṅga and thus realize the money.'

lines: rājā bale,—"yei bhāla, sei kara yāya
ye upāye kauḍi pāi, kara se upāya"
devanagari: राजा बले , - “येइ भाल, सेइ कर याय ।
ये उपाये कौड़ि पाइ, कर से उपा य” ॥29॥
cc-antya-9.29.translation: "The King replied, 'You can adopt whatever means you think best. Any device by which you can somehow or other realize the money is all right.'

devanagari: जयाद्वैताचार्य जय जय दयामय ।
जय गौर - भक्त - गण सब रसमय ॥3॥
cc-antya-9.3.translation: All glories to Advaita Ācārya, who is very merciful! All glories to the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who are always overwhelmed by transcendental bliss!

devanagari: राज - पुत्र आसि’ तारे चाङ्गे चड़ाइल ।
खड़ग - उपरे फेलाइते तले खड़ग पातिल” ॥30॥
cc-antya-9.30.translation: "Thus the prince went back, raised Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka onto the platform of the cāṅga and spread swords below upon which to throw him."

lines: śuni' prabhu kahe kichu kari' praṇaya-roṣa
devanagari: शुनि’ प्रभु कहे किछु करि’ प्रणय - रोष ।
“राज - कौड़ि दिते नारे, राजार किबा दोष ? ॥31॥
cc-antya-9.31.translation: After hearing this explanation, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied with affectionate anger. "Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka does not want to pay dues to the King," the Lord said. "How then is the King at fault in punishing him?

devanagari: राज - विलात्साधि’ खाय, नाहि राज - भय ।
दारी - नाटुयारे दिया करे नाना व्यय ॥32॥
cc-antya-9.32.translation: "Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka is in charge of collecting money on behalf of the government, but he misappropriates it. Not fearing the King, he squanders it to see dancing girls.

lines: rāja-dravya śodhi' pāya, tāra karuka vyaya"
devanagari: येइ चतुर, सेइ कुरुक राज - विषय ।
राज - द्रव्य शोधि’ पाय, तार करुक व्य य” ॥33॥
cc-antya-9.33.translation: "If one is intelligent, let him perform service to the government, and after paying the government, he can spend whatever money is left."

devanagari: हेन - काले आर लोक आइल धा ञा ।
‘वाणीनाथादि सवंशे लञा गेल बान्धिया’ ॥34॥
cc-antya-9.34.translation: At that time another person came there in great haste, bringing the news that Vāṇīnātha Rāya and his entire family had been arrested.

lines: prabhu kahe,—"rājā āpane lekhāra dravya la-iba
devanagari: प्रभु कहे,_“राजा आपने लेखार द्रव्य ल - इब ।
आमि - विरक्त सन्यासी, ताहे कि करिब ?” ॥35॥
cc-antya-9.35.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "The King must personally realize the dues. I am but a sannyāsī, a member of the renounced order. What can I do?"

devanagari: तबे स्वरूपादि यत प्रभुर भक्त - गण ।
प्रभुर चरणे सबे कैला निवेदन ॥36॥
cc-antya-9.36.translation: Then all the devotees, headed by Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, fell at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and submitted the following plea.

devanagari: “रामानन्द - रायेर गोष्ठी, सब - तोमार ‘दास’ ।
तोमार उचित नहे ऐछन उदास” ॥37॥
cc-antya-9.37.translation: "All the members of Rāmānanda Rāya's family are Your eternal servants. Now they are in danger. It is not befitting for You to be indifferent to them in this way."

devanagari: शुनि’ महाप्रभु कहे सक्रोध वचने ।
“मोरे आज्ञा देह’ सबे, याङराज - स्थाने! ॥38॥
cc-antya-9.38.translation: After hearing this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu spoke in an angry mood. "You want to order Me to go to the King," He said.

lines: kauḍi māgi' laṅ muñi āṅcala pātiyā
devanagari: तोमा - सबार एइ मत , - राज - ठाञि याञा ।
कौड़ि मा गि’ लङ्मुञि आँचल पातिया ॥39॥
cc-antya-9.39.translation: "Your opinion is that I should go to the King's palace and spread My cloth to beg money from him.

devanagari: एइ - मत महाप्रभु भक्त - गण - सङ्गे ।
नीलाचले वास करेन कृष्ण - प्रेम - रङ्गे ॥4॥
cc-antya-9.4.translation: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu lived at Nīlācala [Jagannātha Purī] with His personal devotees, always merged in ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa.

lines: māgile vā kene dibe dui-lakṣa kāhana?"
devanagari: पाँच - गण्डार पात्र हय सन्यासी ब्राह्मण ।
मागिले वा केने दिबे दुइ - लक्ष काहन ?” ॥40॥
cc-antya-9.40.translation: "Of course, a sannyāsī or brāhmaṇa may beg for up to five gaṇḍās, but why should he be granted the inappropriate sum of 200,000 kāhanas of conchshells?"

devanagari: हेन - काले आर लोक आइल धा ञा ।
खड़ेगर उपरे गोपीनाथे दितेछे डारिया ॥41॥
cc-antya-9.41.translation: Then another person came with the news that Gopīnātha had already been set up to be thrown upon the points of the swords.

lines: śuni' prabhura gaṇa prabhure kare anunaya
prabhu kahe,—"āmi bhikṣuka, āmā haite kichu naya
devanagari: शुनि’ प्रभुर गण प्रभुरे करे अनुनय ।
प्रभु कहे, - ”आमि भिक्षुक, आमा हैते किछु नय ॥42॥
cc-antya-9.42.translation: Hearing this news, all the devotees again appealed to the Lord, but the Lord replied, "I am a beggar. It is impossible for Me to do anything about this.

lines: tāte rakṣā karite yadi haya sabāra mane
devanagari: ताते रक्षा करिते यदि हय सबार मने ।
सबे मेलि’ जानाह जगन्नाथेर चरणे ॥43॥
cc-antya-9.43.translation: "Therefore if you want to save him, you should all pray together at the lotus feet of Jagannātha.

devanagari: ईश्वर जगन्नाथ , - याँर हाते सर्व ‘अर्थ’ ।
कर्तुमकर्तुमन्यथा करिते समर्थ” ॥44॥
cc-antya-9.44.translation: "Lord Jagannātha is the Supreme Personality of Godhead. He possesses all potencies. Therefore He is able to act freely and can do and undo whatever He likes."

devanagari: इहाँ यदि महाप्रभु एतेक कहिला ।
हरिचन्दन - पात्र याइ’ राजारे क हिला ॥45॥
cc-antya-9.45.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied in this way, an officer named Haricandana Pātra went to the King and spoke with him.

devanagari: “गोपीनाथ - पट्टनायक - सेवक तोमार।
सेवकेर प्राण - दण्ड नहे व्यवहार” ॥46॥
cc-antya-9.46.translation: "After all," he said, "Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka is your faithful servant. To condemn a servant to death is not good behavior.

lines: viśeṣa tāhāra ṭhāñi kauḍi bākī haya
prāṇa nile kibā lābha? nija dhana-kṣaya
devanagari: विशेष ताहार ठाञि कौड़ि बाकी हय ।
प्राण निले किबा लाभ ? निज धन - क्षय ॥47॥
cc-antya-9.47.translation: "His only fault is that he owes some money to the government. If he is killed, however, what profit will there be? The government will be the loser, for it will not get the money.

lines: yathārtha mūlye ghoḍā laha, yebā bākī haya
krame krame dibe, vyartha prāṇa kene laya"
devanagari: यथार्थ मूल्ये घोड़ा लह, येबा बाकी हय ।
क्रमे क्रमे दिबे, व्यर्थ प्राण केने ल य” ॥48॥
cc-antya-9.48.translation: "It would be better to take the horses for a proper price and let him gradually repay the balance. Why are you killing him unnecessarily?"

lines: rājā kahe,—"ei vāt āmi nāhi jāni
prāṇa kene la-iba, tāra dravya cāhi āmi
devanagari: राजा कहे , - “एइ बात् आमि नाहि जानि ।
प्राण केने ल - इब, तार द्रव्य चाहि आमि ॥49॥
cc-antya-9.49.translation: The King answered in surprise, "I did not know about all this. Why should his life be taken? I only want the money from him.

lines: nānā-bhāve vyākula prabhura mana āra aṅga
devanagari: अन्तरे - बाहिरे कृष्ण - विरह - तरङ्ग ।
नाना - भावे व्याकुल प्रभुर मन आर अङ्ग ॥5॥
cc-antya-9.5.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu always felt waves of separation from Kṛṣṇa, externally and internally. His mind and body were agitated by various spiritual transformations.

lines: tumi yāi' kara tāhāṅ sarva samādhāna
dravya yaiche āise, āra rahe tāra prāṇa"
devanagari: तुमि याइ’ कर ताहाँ सर्व समाधान ।
द्रव्य यैछे आइसे, आर रहे तार प्राण” ॥50॥
cc-antya-9.50.translation: "Go there and adjust everything. I want only the payment, not his life."

devanagari: तबे हरिचन्दन आ सि’ जानारे कहिल ।
चाङ्गे हैते गोपीनाथे शीघ्र नामाइल ॥51॥
cc-antya-9.51.translation: Haricandana then returned and informed the prince of the King's desire, and immediately Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka was taken down from the cāṅga.

devanagari: ‘द्रव्य देह’ राजा मागे - उपाय पुछिल ।
‘यथार्थ - मूल्ये घोड़ा लह’, तेंह त’ कहिल ॥52॥
cc-antya-9.52.translation: Then he was told that the King demanded the money due him and asked what means he would adopt to pay it. "Kindly take my horses," he replied, "for a proper price.

lines: 'krame krame dimu, āra yata kichu pāri
devanagari: ‘क्रमे क्रमे दिमु, आर यत किछु पारि ।
अविचारे प्राण लह , - कि बलिते पारि ?’ ॥53॥
cc-antya-9.53.translation: "I shall gradually pay the balance as I can. Without consideration, however, you were going to take my life. What can I say?"

lines: yathārtha mūlya kari' tabe saba ghoḍā la-ila
āra dravyera muddatī kari' ghare pāṭhāila
devanagari: यथार्थ मूल्य करि’ तबे सब घोड़ा ल - इल ।
आर द्रव्येर मुद्दती करि’ घरे पाठाइल ॥54॥
cc-antya-9.54.translation: Then the government took all the horses for a proper price, a time was set for payment of the balance, and Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka was released.

lines: ethā prabhu sei manuṣyere praśna kaila
devanagari: एथा प्रभु सेइ मनुष्येरे प्रश्न कैल ।
“वाणीनाथ कि करे, यबे बान्धिया आनिल ?” ॥55॥
cc-antya-9.55.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu inquired from the messenger, "What was Vāṇīnātha doing when he was arrested and brought there?"

devanagari: से - कहे “वाणीनाथ निर्भये लय कृष्ण - नाम ।
‘हरे कृष्ण, हरे कृष्ण’ कहे अविश्राम” ॥56॥
cc-antya-9.56.translation: The messenger replied, "He was fearlessly, incessantly chanting the mahā-mantra-Hare Kṛṣṇa, Hare Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa Kṛṣṇa, Hare Hare Hare Rāma, Hare Rāma, Rāma Rāma, Hare Hare.

lines: sahasrādi pūrṇa haile, aṅge kāṭe rekhā"
devanagari: सङ्ख्या लागि’ दुइ - हाते अङ्गुलीते लेखा ।
सहस्रादि पूर्ण हैले, अङ्गे काटे रेखा” ॥57॥
cc-antya-9.57.translation: "He counted the chants on the fingers of both hands, and after he had finished chanting one thousand times, he would make a mark on his body."

devanagari: शुनि’ महाप्रभु ह - इला परम आनन्द ।
के बुझिते पारे गौरेर कृपा - छन्द - बन्ध? ॥58॥
cc-antya-9.58.translation: Hearing this news, the Lord was very pleased. Who can understand the mercy of the Lord upon His devotee?

devanagari: हेन - काले काशी - मिश्र आइला प्रभु - स्थाने ।
प्रभु ताँरे कहे किछु सोद्वेग - वचने ॥59॥
cc-antya-9.59.translation: At that time Kāśī Miśra came to the residence of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and the Lord talked with him with some agitation.

devanagari: दिने नृत्य - कीर्तन, जगन्नाथ - दरशन ।
रात्र्ये राय - स्वरूप - सने रस - आस्वादन ॥6॥
cc-antya-9.6.translation: During the day He chanted, danced and saw Lord Jagannātha in the temple. At night He tasted transcendental bliss in the company of Rāmānanda Rāya and Svarūpa Dāmodara.

lines: nānā upadrava ihāṅ, nā pāi soyātha"
devanagari: “इहाँ रहिते नारि, यामु आलालनाथ ।
नाना उपद्रव इहाँ, ना पाइ सोयाथ” ॥60॥
cc-antya-9.60.translation: "I cannot stay here any longer," the Lord said. "I shall go to Ālālanātha. There are too many disturbances here, and I cannot get any rest.

devanagari: भवानन्द - रायेर गोष्ठी करे राज - विषय ।
नाना - प्रकारे करे तारा राज - द्रव्य व्यय ॥61॥
cc-antya-9.61.translation: "All the family members of Bhavānanda Rāya are engaged in government service, but they spend the government's revenue in various ways.

lines: rājāra ki doṣa rājā nija-dravya cāya
dite nāre dravya, daṇḍa āmāre jānāya
devanagari: राजार कि दोष ? राजा निज - द्रव्य चाय ।
दिते नारे द्रव्य, दण्ड आमारे जानाय ॥62॥
cc-antya-9.62.translation: "What is the fault on the part of the King? He wants the government's money. However, when they are punished for failing to pay the government its due, they come to Me to release them.

devanagari: राजा गोपीनाथे यदि चाङ्गे चड़ाइल ।
चारि - बारे लोके आ सि’ मोरे जानाइल ॥63॥
cc-antya-9.63.translation: "When the King put Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka on the cāṅga, messengers came four times to inform Me about the incident.

lines: āmāya duḥkha deya, nija-duḥkha kahi' āsi'
devanagari: भिक्षुक सन्यासी आमि निर्जन - वासी ।
आमाय दुःख देय, निज - दुःख कहि’ आसि’ ॥64॥
cc-antya-9.64.translation: "As a beggar sannyāsī, a mendicant, I wish to live alone in a solitary place, but these people come to tell Me about their unhappiness and disturb Me.

lines: kāli ke rākhibe, yadi nā dibe rāja-dhana?
devanagari: आजि तारे जगन्नाथ करिला रक्षण ।
कालि के राखिबे, यदि ना दिबे राज - धन? ॥65॥
cc-antya-9.65.translation: "Jagannātha has saved him once from death today, but if tomorrow he again does not pay what he owes the treasury, who will give him protection?

lines: viṣayīra vārtā śuni' kṣubdha haya mana
tāte ihāṅ rahi' mora nāhi prayojana"
devanagari: विषयीर वार्ता शुनि’ क्षुब्ध हय मन ।
ताते इहाँ रहि’ मोर नाहि प्रयोजन” ॥66॥
cc-antya-9.66.translation: "If we hear about the activities of materialistic persons, our minds become agitated. There is no need for Me to stay here and be disturbed in that way."

lines: "tumi kene ei vāte kṣobha kara mane?
devanagari: काशी - मिश्र कहे प्रभुर धरिया चरणे ।
“तुमि केने एइ बाते क्षोभ कर मने? ॥67॥
cc-antya-9.67.translation: Kāśī Miśra caught hold of the Lord's lotus feet and said, "Why should You be agitated by these affairs?

lines: vyavahāra lāgi' tomā bhaje, sei jñāna-andha
devanagari: व्यवहार ला गि’ तोमा भजे, सेइ ज्ञान - अन्ध ॥68॥
cc-antya-9.68.translation: "You are a renounced sannyāsī. What connections do You have? One who worships You for some material purpose is blind to all knowledge."

lines: viṣaya lāgi' tomāya bhaje, sei mūrkha jana
devanagari: तोमार भजन - फले तोमाते ‘प्रेम - धन’ ।
विषय ला गि’ तोमाय भजे, सेइ मूर्ख जन ॥69॥
cc-antya-9.69.translation: Kāśī Miśra continued, "If one engages in devotional service for Your satisfaction, this will result in his increasingly awakening his dormant love for You. But if one engages in Your devotional service for material purposes, he should be considered a number-one fool.

devanagari: त्रिजगतेर लोक आ सि’ करेन दरशन ।
येइ देखे, सेइ पाय कृष्ण - प्रेम - धन ॥7॥
cc-antya-9.7.translation: People from the three worlds used to come visit Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Anyone who saw Him received the transcendental treasure of love for Kṛṣṇa.

lines: tomā lāgi' rāmānanda rājya tyāga kailā
devanagari: तोमा ला गि’ रामानन्द राज्य त्याग कैला ।
तोमा ला गि’ सनातन विष य’ छाड़िला ॥70॥
cc-antya-9.70.translation: "It is only for Your sake that Rāmānanda Rāya resigned from the governorship of South India and Sanātana Gosvāmī gave up his post as minister.

devanagari: तोमा ला गि’ रघुनाथ सकल छाड़िल ।
हेथाय ताहार पिता विषय पाठाइल ॥71॥
cc-antya-9.71.translation: "It is for Your sake that Raghunātha dāsa gave up all his family relationships. His father sent money and men here to serve him.

lines: chatre māgi' khāya, 'viṣaya' sparśa nāhi kare
devanagari: तोमार चरण - कृपा हञाछे ताहारे ।
छत्रे मा गि’ खाय, ‘विषय’ स्पर्श नाहि करे ॥72॥
cc-antya-9.72.translation: "However, because he has received the mercy of Your lotus feet, he does not even accept his father's money. Instead he eats by begging alms from centers for the distribution of food.

lines: tomā haite viṣaya-vāñchā, tāra icchā naya
devanagari: रामानन्देर भाइ गोपीनाथ - महाशय ।
तोमा हैते विषय - वाञ्छा, तार इच्छा नय ॥73॥
cc-antya-9.73.translation: "Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka is a good gentleman. He does not desire material benefits from You.

devanagari: तार दुःख देखि’ तार सेवकादि - गण ।
तोमारे जानाइल , - य़ाते ‘अनन्य - शरण’ ॥74॥
cc-antya-9.74.translation: "It is not Gopīnātha who sent all those men so that You would release him from his plight. Rather, his friends and servants, seeing his distressed condition, informed You because they all knew that Gopīnātha is a soul surrendered unto You.

lines: sei 'śuddha-bhakta', ye tomā bhaje tomā lāgi'
devanagari: सेइ ‘शुद्ध - भक्त’, ये तोमा भजे तोमा ला गि’ ।
आपनार सुख - दुःखे हय भोग - भोगी’ ॥75॥
cc-antya-9.75.translation: "Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka is a pure devotee who worships You only for Your satisfaction. He does not care about his personal happiness or distress, for that is the business of a materialist.

devanagari: तोमार अनुकम्पा चाहे, भजे अनुक्षण ।
अचिरात् मिले ताँरे तोमार चरण ॥76॥
cc-antya-9.76.translation: "One who engages in Your devotional service twenty-four hours a day, desiring only Your mercy, will very soon attain shelter at Your lotus feet.

devanagari: तत्तेऽनुकम्पां सु - समीक्षमाणो भुञ्जान एवात्म - कृतं विपाकम् ।
हृद्वाग्वपुभिर्विदधन्नमस्ते जीवेत यो मुक्ति - पदे स दाय - भाक् ॥77॥
cc-antya-9.77.translation: "One who seeks Your compassion and thus tolerates all kinds of adverse conditions due to the karma of his past deeds, who engages always in Your devotional service with his mind, words and body, and who always offers obeisances unto You is certainly a bona fide candidate for becoming Your unalloyed devotee.'

lines: ethā tumi vasi' raha, kene yābe ālālanātha?
keha tomā nā śunābe viṣayīra vāt
devanagari: एथा तुमि वसि’ रह, केने याबे आलालनाथ ? ।
केह तोमा ना शुनाबे विषयीर बात् ॥78॥
cc-antya-9.78.translation: "Kindly stay here at Jagannātha Purī. Why should You go to Ālālanātha? Henceforward, no one will approach You about material affairs."

lines: yadi vā tomāra tāre rākhite haya mana
āji ye rākhila, sei karibe rakṣaṇa"
devanagari: यदि वा तोमार तारे राखिते हय मन ।
आजि ये राखिल, सेइ करिबे रक्षण” ॥79॥
cc-antya-9.79.translation: Finally Kāśī Miśra told the Lord, "If You want to give protection to Gopīnātha, then Lord Jagannātha, who protected him today, will also protect him in the future."

devanagari: मनुष्येर वेशे देव - गन्धर्व - किन्न र ।
सप्त - पातालेर यत दैत्य विषधर ॥8॥
cc-antya-9.8.translation: The inhabitants of the seven higher planetary systems-including the demigods, the Gandharvas and the Kinnaras-and the inhabitants of the seven lower planetary systems [Pātālaloka], including the demons and serpentine living entities, all visited Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu in the dress of human beings.

devanagari: एत बलि’ काशी - मिश्र गेला स्व - मन्दिरे ।
मध्याह्ने प्रतापरुद्र आइला ताँर घरे ॥80॥
cc-antya-9.80.translation: After saying this, Kāśī Miśra left the abode of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and returned to his own temple. At noon King Pratāparudra came to Kāśī Miśra's home.

devanagari: प्रतापरुद्रेर एक आछये नियमे ।
यत दिन रहे तेंह श्री - पुरुषोत्तमे ॥81॥
cc-antya-9.81.translation: As long as King Pratāparudra stayed in his capital, Puruṣottama, he performed one regular duty.

lines: nitya āsi' kare miśrera pāda saṁvāhana
devanagari: नित्य आ सि’ करे मिश्रेर पाद संवाहन ।
जगन्नाथ - सेवार करे भियान श्रवण ॥82॥
cc-antya-9.82.translation: He would come daily to the house of Kāśī Miśra to massage his lotus feet. The King would also hear from him about how opulently Lord Jagannātha was served.

lines: rājā miśrera caraṇa yabe cāpite lāgilā
tabe miśra tāṅre kichu bhaṅgīte kahilā
devanagari: राजा मिश्रेर चरण यबे चापिते लागिला ।
तबे मिश्र ताँ रे किछु भङ्गीते कहिला ॥83॥
cc-antya-9.83.translation: When the King began pressing his lotus feet, Kāśī Miśra informed him about something through hints.

devanagari: “देव, शुन आर एक अपरूप बात्! ।
महाप्रभु क्षेत्र छाड़ि’ याबेन आलालनाथ !” ॥84॥
cc-antya-9.84.translation: "My dear King," he said, "please hear one uncommon item of news. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu wants to leave Jagannātha Purī and go to Ālālanātha."

lines: śuni rājā duḥkhī hailā, puchilena kāraṇa
tabe miśra kahe tāṅre saba vivaraṇa
devanagari: शुनि राजा दुःखी हैला, पुछिलेन कारण ।
तबे मिश्र कहे ताँ रे सब विवरण ॥85॥
