cc-antya-9.85.translation: When the King heard that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was going to Ālālanātha, he was very unhappy and inquired about the reason. Then Kāśī Miśra informed him of all the details.

lines: tāra sevaka saba āsi' prabhure kahilā
devanagari: “गोपीनाथ - पट्टनायके यबे चाङ्गे चड़ाइला ।
तार सेवक सब आ सि’ प्रभुरे कहिला ॥86॥
cc-antya-9.86.translation: "When Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka was lifted onto the cāṅga," he said, "all his servants went to inform Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: शुनिया क्षोभित हैल महाप्रभुर मन ।
क्रोधे गोपीनाथे कैला बहुत भर्त्सन ॥87॥
cc-antya-9.87.translation: "Hearing about this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was extremely sorry at heart, and in anger He chastised Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka.

devanagari: ‘अजितेन्द्रिय ह ञा करे राज़ - विषय ।
नाना असत् पथे करे राज - द्रव्य व्यय ॥88॥
cc-antya-9.88.translation: "Because he is mad after sense gratification,' the Lord said, 'he acts as a government servant but spends the government's revenue for various sinful activities.

lines: tāhā hari' bhoga kare mahā-pāpī jana
devanagari: ब्रह्मस्व - अधिक एइ हय राज - धन ।
ताहा ह रि’ भोग करे महा - पापी जन ॥89॥
cc-antya-9.89.translation: "The revenue of the government is more sacred than the property of a brāhmaṇa. One who misappropriates the government's money and uses it to enjoy sense gratification is most sinful.

devanagari: सप्त - द्वीपे नव - खण्डे वैसे यत जन ।
नाना - वेशे आ सि’ करे प्रभुर दरशन ॥9॥
cc-antya-9.9.translation: Dressed in different ways, people from the seven islands and nine khaṇḍas visited Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: rājāra vartana khāya, āra curi kare
devanagari: राजार वर्तन खाय, आर चुरि करे ।
राज - दण्ड्य हय सेइ शास्त्रेर विचारे ॥90॥
cc-antya-9.90.translation: "One who serves the government but misappropriates the government's revenue is liable to be punished by the king. That is the verdict of all revealed scriptures.

lines: nija-kauḍi māge, rājā nāhi kare daṇḍa
devanagari: निज - कौड़ि मागे, राजा नाहि करे दण्ड ।
राजा - महा - धार्मिक, एइ हय पापी भण्ड! ॥91॥
cc-antya-9.91.translation: "The King wanted his revenue paid and did not want to enforce punishment. Therefore the King is certainly very religious. But Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka is a great cheat.

lines: ei mahā-duḥkha ihāṅ ke sahite pāre?
devanagari: राजा - कड़ि ना देय, आमारे फुकारे ।
एइ महा - दुःख इहाँ के सहिते पारे? ॥92॥
cc-antya-9.92.translation: "He does not pay the revenue to the King, but he wants My help for release. This is a greatly sinful affair. I cannot tolerate it here.

lines: viṣayīra bhāla manda vārtā nā śunimu' "
devanagari: आलालनाथ याइ’ ताहाँ निश्चिन्ते रहिमु ।
विषयीर भाल मन्द वार्ता ना शुनिमु” ॥93॥
cc-antya-9.93.translation: "Therefore I shall leave Jagannātha Purī and go to Ālālanātha, where I shall live peacefully and not hear about all these affairs of materialistic people.' "

lines: eta śuni' kahe rājā pāñā mane vyathā
"saba dravya chāḍoṅ, yadi prabhu rahena ethā
devanagari: एत शुनि’ कहे राजा पा ञा मने व्यथा ।
सब द्रव्य छाड़ों, यदि प्रभु रहेन एथा ॥94॥
cc-antya-9.94.translation: When King Pratāparudra heard all these details, he felt great pain in his mind. "I shall give up all that is due from Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka," he said, "if Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stays here at Jagannātha Purī.

devanagari: एक - क्षण प्रभुर यदि पाइये दरशन ।
कोटि - चिन्तामणि - लाभ नहे तार सम ॥95॥
cc-antya-9.95.translation: "If even for a moment I could get an interview with Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, I would not care for the profit of millions of cintāmaṇi stones.

lines: kon chāra padārtha ei dui-lakṣa kāhana?
devanagari: कोन् छार पदार्थ एइ दुइ - लक्ष काहन ? ।
प्राण - राज्य करों प्रभु - पदे निर्मज्छन” ॥96॥
cc-antya-9.96.translation: "I do not care about this small sum of 200,000 kāhanas. Not to speak of this, I would indeed sacrifice everything at the lotus feet of the Lord, including my life and kingdom."

lines: tārā duḥkha pāya,—ei nā yāya sahana"
devanagari: मिश्र कहे, “कौड़ि छाड़िबा , - नहे प्रभुर मन ।
तारा दुःख पाय, - एइ ना याय सहन” ॥97॥
cc-antya-9.97.translation: Kāśī Miśra hinted to the King, "It is not the Lord's desire that you forfeit the payment. He is unhappy only because the whole family is troubled."

lines: rājā kahe,—"tāre āmi duḥkha nāhi diye
cāṅge caḍā, khaḍge ḍārā,—āmi nā jāniye
devanagari: राजा कहे , - “तारे आमि दुःख नाहि दिये ।
चाङ्गे चड़ा, खड्गे डारा, - आमि ना जानिये ॥98॥
cc-antya-9.98.translation: The King replied, "I have no desire to give pain to Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka and his family, nor did I know about his being lifted on the cāṅga to be thrown on the swords and killed.

devanagari: पुरुषोत्तम - जानारे तेंह कैल परिहास ।
सेइ ‘जाना’ तारे देखाइल मिथ्या त्रास ॥99॥
cc-antya-9.99.translation: "He sneered at Puruṣottama Jānā. Therefore the prince tried to scare him as a punishment.

devanagari: वन्दे श्री - कृष्ण - चैतन्यं भक्तानुग्रह - कातरम् ।
येन केनापि सन्तुष्टं भक्त - दत्तेन श्रद्धया ॥1॥
cc-antya-10.1.translation: Let me offer my respectful obeisances unto Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who is always pleased to accept anything given with faith and love by His devotees and is always ready to bestow mercy upon them.

lines: caitanyera kṛpāya jāne ei saba dharma
devanagari: एइ सब हय भक्ति - शास्त्र - सूक्ष्म मर्म ।
चैतन्येर कृपाय जाने एइ सब धर्म ॥100॥
cc-antya-10.100.translation: These are some of the finer points of etiquette in devotional service. Only one who has received the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu can understand these principles.

lines: ei saba prakāśite kailā eta bhaṅgī
devanagari: भक्त - गुण प्रकाशिते प्रभु बड़ रङ्गी ।
एइ सब प्रकाशिते कैला एत भङ्गी ॥101॥
cc-antya-10.101.translation: The Lord is very interested in manifesting the exalted qualities of His devotees, and that is why He engineered this incident.

devanagari: सङ्क्षेपे कहिलुँ एइ परि - मुण्डा - नृत्य ।
अद्यापिह गाय याहा चैतन्येर भृत्य ॥102॥
cc-antya-10.102.translation: Thus I have briefly described Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's dancing in the hall of the Jagannātha temple. The servants of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sing about this dancing even now.

devanagari: एइ - मत महाप्रभु लञा निज - गण ।
गुण्डिचा - गृहेर कैला क्षालन, मार्जन ॥103॥
cc-antya-10.103.translation: Accompanied by His personal associates, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu washed and swept the Guṇḍicā temple, cleansing it as usual.

devanagari: पूर्ववत् कैला प्रभु कीर्तन, नर्तन ।
पूर्ववत् टोटाय कैला वन्य - भोजन ॥104॥
cc-antya-10.104.translation: The Lord danced and chanted and then enjoyed a picnic in the garden as He had done before.

devanagari: पूर्ववत् रथ - आगे करिला नर्तन ।
हेरा - पञ्चमी - यात्रा कैला दरशन ॥105॥
cc-antya-10.105.translation: As previously, He danced in front of the Jagannātha cart and observed the festival of Herā-pañcamī.

devanagari: चारि - मास वर्षाय रहिला सब भक्त - गण ।
जन्माष्टमी आदि यात्रा कैला दरशन ॥106॥
cc-antya-10.106.translation: All the devotees from Bengal stayed in Jagannātha Purī for the four months of the rainy season and observed many other ceremonies, such as the anniversary of Lord Kṛṣṇa's birth.

lines: pūrve yadi gauḍa ha-ite bhakta-gaṇa āila
prabhure kichu khāoyāite sabāra icchā haila
devanagari: पूर्वे यदि गौड़ ह - इते भक्त - गण आइल ।
प्रभुरे किछु खाओयाइते सबार इच्छा हैल ॥107॥
cc-antya-10.107.translation: Formerly, when all the devotees had arrived from Bengal, they all desired to give Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu something to eat.

lines: keha kona prasāda āni' deya govinda-ṭhāñi
devanagari: केह कोन प्रसाद आ नि’ देय गोविन्द - ठाञि ।
‘इहा येन अवश्य भक्षण करेन गोसा ञि’ ॥108॥
cc-antya-10.108.translation: Each devotee would bring a certain type of prasāda. He would entrust it to Govinda and request him, "Please arrange that the Lord will surely eat this prasāda."

lines: keha paiḍa, keha nāḍu, keha piṭhā-pānā
devanagari: केह पैड़, केह नाडु, केह पिठा - पाना ।
बहु - मूल्य उत्तम - प्रसाद - प्रकार यार नाना ॥109॥
cc-antya-10.109.translation: Some brought paiḍa [a coconut preparation], some brought sweetballs, and some brought cakes and sweet rice. The prasāda was of different varieties, all very costly.

lines: 'dhari' rākha' bali' prabhu nā karena bhakṣaṇa
devanagari: ‘अमुकेइ दियाछे’ गोविन्द करे निवेदन ।
‘धरि’ राख’ बलि’ प्रभु ना करेन भक्षण ॥110॥
cc-antya-10.110.translation: Govinda would present the prasāda and say to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, "This has been given by such and such devotee." The Lord, however, would not actually eat it. He would simply say, "Keep it in storage."

lines: dharite dharite gharera bharila eka koṇa
devanagari: धरिते धरिते घरेर भरिल एक कोण ।
शत - जनेर भक्ष्य यत हैल सञ्चयन ॥111॥
cc-antya-10.111.translation: Govinda kept accumulating the food, and soon it filled a corner of the room. There was quite enough to feed at least a hundred people.

devanagari: गोविन्देरे सबे पुछे करिया यतन ।
‘आमा - दत्त प्रसाद प्रभुरे कि कराइला भक्षण? ॥112॥
cc-antya-10.112.translation: All the devotees asked Govinda with great eagerness, "Have you given Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu the prasāda brought by me?"

lines: kāhāṅ kichu kahi' govinda kare vañcana
devanagari: काहाँ किछु कहि’ गोविन्द करे वञ्चन ।
आर दिन प्रभुरे कहे निर्वेद - वचन ॥113॥
cc-antya-10.113.translation: When the devotees questioned Govinda, he had to tell them lies. Therefore one day he spoke to the Lord in disappointment.

lines: tomāre khāoyāite vastu dena mora sthāne
devanagari: “आचार्यादि महाशय करिया यतने ।
तोमारे खाओयाइते वस्तु देन मोर स्थाने ॥114॥
cc-antya-10.114.translation: "Many respectable devotees, headed by Advaita Ācārya, make a great endeavor to entrust me with varieties of food for You.

lines: tumi se nā khāo, tāṅrā puche bāra bāra
kata vañcanā karimu, kemane āmāra nistāra?"
devanagari: तुमि से ना खाओ, ताँरा पुछे बार बार ।
कत वञ्चना करिमु, केमने आमार निस्तार ?” ॥115॥
cc-antya-10.115.translation: "You do not eat it, but they ask me again and again. How long shall I go on cheating them? How shall I be freed from this responsibility?"

lines: kebā ki diyāche, tāhā ānaha ekhāne'
devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - ‘आदि - वस्या’ दुःख काँहे माने? ।
केबा कि दियाछे, ताहा आनह एखाने ॥116॥
cc-antya-10.116.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "Why are you so foolishly unhappy? Bring here to Me whatever they have given you."

lines: nāma dhari' dhari' govinda kare nivedane
devanagari: एत बलि’ महाप्रभु वसिला भोजने ।
नाम ध रि’ धरि’ गोविन्द करे निवेदने ॥117॥
cc-antya-10.117.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sat down to eat. Then Govinda offered Him the preparations one after another, and as he did so he spoke the name of the person who had given each one.

devanagari: “आचार्येर एइ पैड़, पाना - सर - पूपी ।
एइ अमृत - गुटिका, मण्डा, कर्पूर - कूपी ॥118॥
cc-antya-10.118.translation: "These preparations-paiḍa, sweet rice, cakes made with cream, and also amṛta-guṭikā, maṇḍā and a pot of camphor-have been given by Advaita Ācārya.

devanagari: श्रीवास - पण्डितेर एइ अनेक प्रकार ।
पिठा, पाना, अमृत - मण्डा पद्म - चिनि आर ॥119॥
cc-antya-10.119.translation: "Next there are varieties of food-cakes, cream, amṛta-maṇḍā and padmacini-given by Śrīvāsa Paṇḍita.

devanagari: कुलीन - ग्रामी, खण्ड - वासी मि लिला आसिया ।
शिवानन्द - सेन चलिला सबारे लञा ॥12॥
cc-antya-10.12.translation: The inhabitants of Kulīna-grāma and Khaṇḍa also came and joined. Śivānanda Sena took the leadership and thus started taking care of them all.

devanagari: आचार्यरत्नेर एइ सब उपहार ।
आचार्यनिधिर एइ, अनेक प्रकार ॥120॥
cc-antya-10.120.translation: "All these are gifts of Ācāryaratna, and these varieties of gifts are from Ācāryanidhi.

devanagari: वासुदेव - दत्तेर एइ मुरारि - गुप्तेर आर ।
बुद्धिमन्त - खाँनेर एइ विविध प्रकार ॥121॥
cc-antya-10.121.translation: "And all these varieties of food have been given by Vāsudeva Datta, Murāri Gupta and Buddhimanta Khān.

devanagari: श्रीमान् सेन, श्रीमान् पण्डित, आचार्य - नन्दन ।
ताँ - सबार दत्त एइ करह भोजन ॥122॥
cc-antya-10.122.translation: "These are gifts given by Śrīmān Sena, Śrīmān Paṇḍita and Ācārya Nandana. Please eat them all.

devanagari: कुलीन - ग्रामेर एइ आगे देख यत ।
खण्ड - वासी लोकेर एइ देख तत” ॥123॥
cc-antya-10.123.translation: "Here are the preparations made by the inhabitants of Kulīna-grāma, and these have been made by the inhabitants of Khaṇḍa."

lines: aiche sabāra nāma lañā prabhura āge dhare
santuṣṭa hañā prabhu saba bhojana kare
devanagari: ऐछे सबार नाम ल ञा प्रभुर आगे धरे ।
सन्तुष्ट हञा प्रभु सब भोजन करे ॥124॥
cc-antya-10.124.translation: In this way, Govinda gave everyone's name as he put the food before the Lord. Being very satisfied, the Lord began to eat it all.

devanagari: यद्यपि मासेकेर वासि मुकुता नारिकेल ।
अमृत - गुटिकादि, पानादि सकल ॥125॥
cc-antya-10.125-126.translation: The hard sweets made of coconut, mukuta nārikela, the sweetballs, the many kinds of sweet drinks and all the other preparations were at least a month old, but although they were old, they had not become tasteless or stale. Indeed, they had all stayed fresh. That is the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: शत - जनेर भक्ष्य प्रभु दण्डेके खाइला! ।
‘आर किछु आछे?’ बलि’ गोविन्दे पुछिला ॥127॥
cc-antya-10.127.translation: Within a very short time, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu ate enough for a hundred people. Then He asked Govinda, "Is there anything more left?"

lines: prabhu kahe,—'āji rahu, tāhā dekhimu pāche'
devanagari: गोविन्द बले , - ‘राघवेर झालि मात्र आछे’ ।
प्रभु कहे, - ‘आजि रहु, ताहा देखिमु पाछे’ ॥128॥
cc-antya-10.128.translation: Govinda replied, "Now there are only the bags of Rāghava." The Lord said, "Let them remain today. I shall see them later."

lines: āra dina prabhu yadi nibhṛte bhojana kailā
devanagari: आर दि न प्रभु यदि निभृते भोजन कैला ।
राघवेर झालि खुलि’ सकल देखिला ॥129॥
cc-antya-10.129.translation: The next day, while taking His lunch in a secluded place, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu opened the bags of Rāghava and inspected their contents one after another.

devanagari: राघव - पण्डित चले झालि साजाइया ।
दमयन्ती यत द्रव्य दियाछे करिया ॥13॥
cc-antya-10.13.translation: Rāghava Paṇḍita came with bags full of food prepared very nicely by his sister, Damayantī.

lines: saba dravyera kichu kichu upayoga kailā
devanagari: सब द्रव्येर किछु किछु उपयोग कैला ।
स्वादु, सुगन्धि देखि’ बहु प्रशंसिला ॥130॥
cc-antya-10.130.translation: He tasted a little of everything they contained and praised it all for its flavor and aroma.

devanagari: वत्सरेक तरे आर राखिला धरिया ।
भोजन - काले स्वरूप परिवेशे खसा ञा ॥131॥
cc-antya-10.131.translation: All the varieties of the remaining prasāda were kept to eat throughout the year. When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu ate His lunch, Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī would serve it little by little.

lines: bhaktera śraddhāra dravya avaśya karena upabhoga
devanagari: कभु रात्रि - काले किछु करेन उपयोग ।
भक्तेर श्रद्धार द्रव्य अवश्य करेन उपभोग ॥132॥
cc-antya-10.132.translation: Sometimes Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would take some of it at night. The Lord certainly enjoys preparations made with faith and love by His devotees.

devanagari: एइ - मत महाप्रभु भक्त - गण - सङ्गे ।
चातुर्मास्य गोङाइला कृष्ण - कथा - रङ्गे ॥133॥
cc-antya-10.133.translation: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu spent the entire period of Cāturmāsya [the four months of the rainy season] in the happiness of discussing topics of Kṛṣṇa with His devotees.

lines: ghare bhāta rāndhe āra vividha vyañjana
devanagari: मध्ये मध्ये आचा र्यादि करे निमन्त्रण ।
घरे भात रान्धे आर विविध व्यञ्जन ॥134॥
cc-antya-10.134.translation: From time to time, Advaita Ācārya and others would invite Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu for home-cooked rice and varieties of vegetables.

lines: ādā, lavaṇa, lembu, dugdha, dadhi, khaṇḍa-sāra
devanagari: मरिचेर झाल, आर मधुराम्ल आर ।
आदा, लवण, लेम्बु, दुग्ध, दधि, खण्ड - सार ॥135॥
cc-antya-10.135-136.translation: They offered pungent preparations made with black pepper, sweet-and-sour preparations, ginger, salty preparations, limes, milk, yogurt, cheese, two or four kinds of spinach, soup made with bitter melon, eggplant mixed with nimba flowers, and fried paṭola.

devanagari: भृष्ट फुल - बड़ी, आर मुद्ग - डालि - सूप ।
विविध व्यञ्जन रान्धे प्रभुर रुचि - अनुरूप ॥137॥
cc-antya-10.137.translation: They also offered phula-baḍī, liquid mung dahl and many vegetables, all cooked according to the Lord's taste.

lines: kāhāṅ ekā yāyena, kāhāṅ gaṇera sahita
devanagari: जगन्नाथेर प्रसाद आने करिते मिश्रित ।
काहाँ एका यायेन, काहाँ गणेर सहित ॥138॥
cc-antya-10.138.translation: They would mix these preparations with the remnants of food from Lord Jagannātha. When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu accepted the invitations, He went sometimes alone and sometimes with His associates.

devanagari: आचार्यरत्न, आचार्यनिधि, नन्दन, राघव ।
श्रीवास - आदि यत भक्त, विप्र सब ॥139॥
cc-antya-10.139.translation: Devotees like Ācāryaratna, Ācāryanidhi, Nandana Ācārya, Rāghava Paṇḍita and Śrīvāsa were all of the brāhmaṇa caste.

lines: nānā apūrva bhakṣya-dravya prabhura yogya bhoga
devanagari: नाना अपूर्व भक्ष्य - द्रव्य प्रभुर योग्य भोग ।
वत्सरेक प्रभु याहा करेन उपयोग ॥14॥
cc-antya-10.14.translation: Damayantī made varieties of unparalleled food just suitable for Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to eat. The Lord ate it continually for one year.

devanagari: एइ - मत निमन्त्रण करेन यत्न करि ।
वासुदेव, गदाधर - दास, गुप्त - मुरारि ॥140॥
cc-antya-10.140-141.translation: They would extend invitations to the Lord. Vāsudeva Datta, Gadādhara dāsa, Murāri Gupta, the inhabitants of Kulīna-grāma and Khaṇḍa and many other devotees who were not brāhmaṇas by caste would purchase food offered to Lord Jagannātha and then extend invitations to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: शिवानन्द - सेनेर शुन निमन्त्रणाख्यान ।
शिवानन्देर बड़ - पुत्रेर ‘चैतन्य - दास’ नाम ॥142॥
cc-antya-10.142.translation: Now hear about the invitation Śivānanda Sena extended to the Lord. His eldest son was named Caitanya dāsa.

lines: milāile, prabhu tāṅra nāma ta' puchilā
devanagari: प्रभुरे मिलाइते ताँ रे सङ्गेइ आनिला ।
मिलाइले, प्रभु ताँर नाम त’ पुछिला ॥143॥
cc-antya-10.143.translation: When Śivānanda brought his son, Caitanya dāsa, to be introduced to the Lord, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu inquired about his name.

devanagari: ‘चैतन्य - दास’ नाम शुनि’ कहे गौर - राय ।
‘किबा नाम धरा ञाछ, बुझन ना याय’ ॥144॥
cc-antya-10.144.translation: When the Lord heard that his name was Caitanya dāsa, He said, "What kind of name have you given him? It is very difficult to understand."

lines: sena kahe,—'ye jāniluṅ, sei nāma dharila'
devanagari: सेन कहे , - ‘ये जानि लुँ, सेइ नाम धरि ल’ ।
एत बलि’ महाप्रभुरे निमन्त्रण कैल ॥145॥
cc-antya-10.145.translation: Śivānanda Sena replied, "He has kept the name that appeared to me from within." Then he invited Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu for lunch.

devanagari: जगन्नाथेर बहु - मूल्य प्रसाद आनाइला ।
भक्त - गणे लञा प्रभु भोजने वसिला ॥146॥
cc-antya-10.146.translation: Śivānanda Sena had bought very costly remnants of Lord Jagannātha's food. He brought it in and offered it to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who sat down to accept the prasāda with His associates.

devanagari: शिवानन्देर गौरवे प्रभु करिला भोजन ।
अति - गुरु - भोजने प्रभुर प्रसन्न नहे मन ॥147॥
cc-antya-10.147.translation: Because of Śivānanda Sena's glories, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu ate all kinds of prasāda to honor his request. However, the Lord ate more than necessary, and therefore His mind was dissatisfied.

devanagari: आर दिन चैतन्य - दास कैला निमन्त्रण ।
प्रभुर ‘अभीष्ट’ बुझि’ आनिला व्यञ्जन ॥148॥
cc-antya-10.148.translation: The next day, Caitanya dāsa, the son of Śivānanda Sena, extended an invitation to the Lord. He could understand the Lord's mind, however, and therefore he arranged for a different kind of food.

lines: dadhi, lembu, ādā, āra phula-baḍā, lavaṇa
sāmagrī dekhiyā prabhura prasanna haila mana
devanagari: दधि, लेम्बु, आदा, आर फुल - बड़ा, लवण ।
सामग्री देखिया प्रभुर प्रसन्न हैल मन ॥149॥
cc-antya-10.149.translation: He offered yogurt, limes, ginger, soft baḍā and salt. Seeing all these arrangements, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was very pleased.

devanagari: आम्र - काशन्दि, आदा - काशन्दि झाल - काशन्दि नाम ।
नेम्बु - आदा आम्र - कोलि विविध विधान ॥15॥
cc-antya-10.15-16.translation: These are the names of some of the pickles and condiments in the bags of Rāghava Paṇḍita: āmra-kāśandi, ādā-kāśandi, jhāla-kāśandi, nembu-ādā, āmra-koli, āmsi, āma-khaṇḍa, tailāmra and āma-sattā. With great attention, Damayantī also made dried bitter vegetables into a powder.

lines: prabhu kahe,—"ei bālaka āmāra mata jāne
devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - “एइ बालक आमार मत जाने ।
सन्तुष्ट ह - इलाँ आमि इहार निमन्त्रणे” ॥150॥
cc-antya-10.150.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "This boy knows My mind. Therefore I am very satisfied to keep his invitation."

devanagari: एत बलि’ दधि - भात करिला भोजन ।
चैतन्य - दासेरे दिला उच्छिष्ट - भाजन ॥151॥
cc-antya-10.151.translation: After saying this, the Lord ate the rice mixed with yogurt and offered Caitanya dāsa the remnants of His food.

devanagari: चारि - मास एइ - मत निमन्त्रणे याय ।
कोन कोन वैष्णव ‘दिवस’ नाहि पाय ॥152॥
cc-antya-10.152.translation: The four months of Cāturmāsya passed in this manner, with the Lord accepting invitations from His devotees. Because of a heavy schedule of invitations, however, some of the Vaiṣṇavas could not get an open day on which to invite the Lord.

devanagari: गदाधर - पण्डित, भट्टाचार्य सार्वभौम ।
इँहा सबार आछे भिक्षार दिवस - नियम ॥153॥
cc-antya-10.153.translation: Gadādhara Paṇḍita and Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya had fixed dates on which Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would accept their invitations every month.

devanagari: गोपीनाथाचार्य, जगदानन्द, काशीश्वर ।
भगवान्, रामभद्राचार्य, शङ्कर, वक्रेश्वर ॥154॥
cc-antya-10.154-155.translation: Gopīnātha Ācārya, Jagadānanda, Kāśīśvara, Bhagavān, Rāmabhadrācārya, Śaṅkara and Vakreśvara, who were all brāhmaṇas, extended invitations to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and offered Him food cooked at home, whereas other devotees would pay two paṇas of small conchshells to purchase Jagannātha's prasāda and then invite the Lord.

devanagari: प्रथमे आछिल ‘निर्बन्ध’ कौड़ि चारि - पण ।
रामचन्द्र - पुरी - भये घाटाइला निमन्त्रण ॥156॥
cc-antya-10.156.translation: At first the cost of Jagannātha prasāda for an invitation was four paṇas of conchshells, but when Rāmacandra Purī was there, the price was cut in half.

lines: cāri-māsa rahi' gauḍera bhakte vidāya dilā
devanagari: चारि - मास रहि’ गौड़ेर भक्ते विदाय दिला ।
नीलाचलेर सङ्गी भक्त सङ्गेइ रहिला ॥157॥
cc-antya-10.157.translation: The devotees who came from Bengal stayed with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu for four consecutive months, and then the Lord bade them farewell. After the Bengali devotees departed, the devotees who were the Lord's constant companions at Jagannātha Purī stayed with the Lord.

devanagari: एइ त’ कहिलुँ प्रभुर भिक्षा - निमन्त्रण ।
भक्त - दत्त वस्तु यैछे कैला आस्वादन ॥158॥
cc-antya-10.158.translation: Thus I have described how Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu accepted invitations and how He accepted and tasted the prasāda offered by His devotees.

devanagari: तार मध्ये राघवेर झालि - विवरण ।
तार मध्ये परि - मुण्डा - नृत्य - कथन ॥159॥
cc-antya-10.159.translation: In the midst of that narration are descriptions of Rāghava Paṇḍita's bags of food and the dancing in the temple of Jagannātha.

lines: śraddhā kari' śune yei caitanyera kathā
devanagari: श्रद्धा क रि’ शुने येइ चैतन्येर कथा ।
चैतन्य - चरणे प्रेम पाइबे सर्वथा ॥160॥
cc-antya-10.160.translation: One who hears about the pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu with faith and love will certainly attain ecstatic love for the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu without fail.

devanagari: शुनिते अमृत - सम जुड़ाय कर्ण - मन ।
सेइ भाग्यवान्, येइ करे आस्वादन ॥161॥
cc-antya-10.161.translation: Narrations of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's activities are just like nectar to hear. Indeed, they satisfy both the ears and mind. One who tastes the nectar of these activities is certainly very fortunate.

devanagari: श्री - रूप - रघुनाथ - पदे यार आश ।
चैतन्य - चरितामृत कहे कृष्णदास ॥162॥
cc-antya-10.162.translation: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.

lines: sukutāya ye sukha prabhura, tāhā nahe pañcāmṛte
devanagari: ‘सुकुता’ बलि’ अवज्ञा ना करिह चित्ते ।
सुकुताय ये सुख प्रभुर, ताहा नहे पञ्चामृते ॥17॥
cc-antya-10.17.translation: Do not neglect sukutā because it is a bitter preparation. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu derived more happiness from eating this sukutā than from drinking pañcāmṛta [a preparation of milk, sugar, ghee, honey and curd].

devanagari: भाव - ग्राही महाप्रभु स्नेह - मात्र लय ।
सुकुता पाता काशन्दिते महा - सुख पाय ॥18॥
cc-antya-10.18.translation: Since Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is the Supreme Personality of Godhead, He extracts the purpose from everything. He accepted Damayantī's affection for Him, and therefore He derived great pleasure even from the dried bitter leaves of sukutā and from kāśandi [a sour condiment].

devanagari: ‘मनुष्य’ - बुद्धि दमयन्ती करे प्रभुर पाय ।
गुरु - भोजने उदरे कभु ‘आम’ हा याय ॥19॥
cc-antya-10.19.translation: Because of her natural love for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Damayantī considered the Lord an ordinary human being. Therefore she thought that He would become sick by overeating and there would be mucus within His abdomen.

devanagari: जय जय गौरचन्द्र जय नित्यानन्द ।
जयाद्वैत - चन्द्र जय गौर - भक्त - वृन्द ॥2॥
cc-antya-10.2.translation: All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu! All glories to Lord Nityānanda Prabhu! All glories to Advaitacandra! All glories to all the devotees of Lord Caitanya!

lines: sukutā khāile sei āma ha-ibeka nāśa
ei sneha mane bhāvi' prabhura ullāsa
devanagari: सुकुता खाइले सेइ आम ह - इबेक नाश ।
एइ स्नेह मने भावि’ प्रभुर उल्लास ॥20॥
cc-antya-10.20.translation: Because of sincere affection, she thought that eating this sukutā would cure the Lord's disease. Considering these affectionate thoughts of Damayantī, the Lord was very pleased.

lines: vasanti hi premṇi guṇā na vastuni
devanagari: प्रियेण सङ्ग्रथ्य विपक्ष - सन्निधा व् उपाहितां वक्षसि पीवर - स्तनी ।
स्त्रजं न काचिद्विजहौ जलाविलां वसन्ति हि प्रेम्णि गुणा न वस्तुनि ॥21॥
cc-antya-10.21.translation: "A dear lover strung a garland and placed it on the shoulder of his beloved in the presence of her co-wives. She had raised breasts and was very beautiful, yet although the garland was tainted with mud, she did not reject it, for its value lay not in material things but in love."

devanagari: धनिया - मौहरीर तण्डुल गुण्डा करिया ।
नाडु बान्धियाछे चिनि - पाक करिया ॥22॥
cc-antya-10.22.translation: Damayantī powdered coriander and anise seeds, cooked them with sugar and made them into small sweetmeats that were shaped like small balls.

lines: pṛthak pṛthak bāndhi' vastrera kuthalī bhitara
devanagari: शुण्ठि - खण्ड नाडु, आर आम - पित्त - हर ।
पृथक् पृथक् बान्धि‘वस्त्रेर कुथली भितर ॥23॥
cc-antya-10.23.translation: She made balls of sweetmeats with dried ginger to remove mucus caused by too much bile. She put all these preparations separately into small cloth bags.

devanagari: कोलि - शुण्ठि, कोलि - चूर्ण, कोलि - खण्ड आर ।
कत नाम ल - इब, शत - प्रकार ‘आचार’ ॥24॥
cc-antya-10.24.translation: She made a hundred varieties of condiments and pickles. She also made koli-śuṇṭhi, koli-cūrṇa, koli-khaṇḍa and many other preparations. How many should I name?

devanagari: नारिकेल - खण्ड नाडु, आर नाडु गङ्गा - जल ।
चिर - स्थायी खण्ड - विकार करिला सकल ॥25॥
cc-antya-10.25.translation: She made many sweetmeats shaped like balls. Some were made with powdered coconut, and others looked as white as the water of the Ganges. In this way she made many varieties of long-lasting sugar confections.

devanagari: चिर - स्थायी क्षीर - सार, मण्डादि - विकार ।
अमृत - कर्पूर आदि अनेक प्रकार ॥26॥
cc-antya-10.26.translation: She made long-lasting cheese, many varieties of sweetmeats with milk and cream, and many other varied preparations, such as amṛta-karpūra.

devanagari: शालिकाचुटि - धान्येर ‘आतप’ चिड़ा क रि’ ।
नूतन - वस्त्रेर बड़ कुथली सब भरि’ ॥27॥
cc-antya-10.27.translation: She made flat rice from fine, unboiled, śāli paddy and filled a large bag made of new cloth.

lines: kateka ciḍā huḍum kari' ghṛtete bhājiyā
devanagari: कतेक चिड़ा हुड़म्करि’ घृतेते भाजिया ।
चिनि - पाके नाडु कैला कर्पूरादि दिया ॥28॥
cc-antya-10.28.translation: She made some of the flat rice into puffed rice, fried it in ghee, cooked it in sugar juice, mixed in some camphor and rolled it into balls.

devanagari: शालि - धान्येर तण्डुल - भाजा चूर्ण करिया ।
घृत - सिक्त चूर्ण कैला चिनि - पाक दिया ॥29॥
cc-antya-10.29-30.translation: She powdered fried grains of fine rice, moistened the powder with ghee and cooked it in a solution of sugar. Then she added camphor, black pepper, cloves, cardamom and other spices and rolled it into balls that were very palatable and aromatic.

devanagari: वर्षान्तरे सब भक्त प्रभुरे देखिते ।
परम - आनन्दे सबे नीलाचल याइते ॥3॥
cc-antya-10.3.translation: The next year, all the devotees were very pleased to go to Jagannātha Purī [Nīlācala] to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: शालि - धान्येर ख - इ पुनः घृतेते भाजिया ।
चिनि - पाक उ ख्ड़ा कैला कर्पूरादि दिया ॥31॥
cc-antya-10.31.translation: She took parched rice from fine paddy, fried it in ghee, cooked it in a sugar solution, mixed in some camphor and thus made a preparation called ukhḍā or muḍki.

devanagari: फुट्कलाइ चूर्ण करि’ घृते भाजाइल ।
चिनि - पाके कर्पूरादि दिया नाडु कैल ॥32॥
cc-antya-10.32.translation: Another variety of sweet was made with fused peas that were powdered, fried in ghee and then cooked in sugar juice. Camphor was mixed in, and then the sweet was rolled into a ball.

lines: kahite nā jāni nāma e-janme yāhāra
devanagari: कहिते ना जानि नाम ए - जन्मे याहार ।
ऐछे नाना भक्ष्य - द्रव्य सहस्र - प्रकार ॥33॥
cc-antya-10.33.translation: I could not mention the names of all these wonderful eatables, even in a lifetime. Damayantī made hundreds and thousands of varieties.

devanagari: राघवेर आज्ञा, आर करेन दमयन्ती ।
दुँहार प्रभुते स्नेह परम - भकति ॥34॥
cc-antya-10.34.translation: Damayantī made all these preparations following the order of her brother, Rāghava Paṇḍita. Both of them had unlimited affection for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and were advanced in devotional service.

devanagari: गङ्गा - मृत्तिका आनि’ वस्त्रेते छानिया ।
पाँपड़ि करिया दिला गन्ध - द्रव्य दिया ॥35॥
cc-antya-10.35.translation: Damayantī took earth from the Ganges, dried it, powdered it, strained it through a fine cloth, mixed in aromatic ingredients and rolled it into small balls.

lines: āra saba vastu bhare vastrera kuthalī
devanagari: पातल मृत्पात्रे सन्धानादि भरि’ ।
आर सब वस्तु भरे वस्त्रेर कुथली ॥36॥
cc-antya-10.36.translation: The condiments and similar items were put into thin earthen pots, and everything else was put into small cloth bags.

lines: sāmānya jhāli haite dviguṇa jhāli kailā
devanagari: सामान्य झालि हैते द्विगुण झालि कैला ।
पारिपाटि क रि’ सब झालि भराइला ॥37॥
cc-antya-10.37.translation: From small bags Damayantī made bags that were twice as large. Then with great attention she filled all the large ones with the small ones.

lines: jhāli bāndhi' mohara dila āgraha kariyā
tina bojhāri jhāli vahe krama kariyā
devanagari: झालि बान्धि’ मोहर दिल आग्रह करिया ।
तिन बोझारि झालि वहे क्रम करिया ॥38॥
cc-antya-10.38.translation: She then wrapped and sealed each and every bag with great attention. The bags were carried by three bearers, one after another.

devanagari: सङ्क्षेपे कहिलुँ एइ झालिर विचार ।
‘राघवेर झालि’ बलि’ विख्याति याहार ॥39॥
cc-antya-10.39.translation: Thus I have briefly described the bags that have become famous as rāghavera jhāli.

devanagari: अद्वैताचार्य - गोसा ञि - सर्व - अग्र - गण्य ।
आचार्यरत्न, आचार्यनिधि, श्रीवास आदि धन्य ॥4॥
cc-antya-10.4.translation: Advaita Ācārya Gosāñi led the party from Bengal. He was followed by Ācāryaratna, Ācāryanidhi, Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura and other glorious devotees.

devanagari: झालिर उपर ‘मुन्सिब’ मकरध्वज - कर ।
प्राण - रूपे झालि राखे ह ञा तत्पर ॥40॥
cc-antya-10.40.translation: The superintendent for all those bags was Makaradhvaja Kara, who kept them with great attention like his very life.

devanagari: एइ - मते वैष्णव सब नीलाचले आइला ।
दैवे जगन्नाथेर से दिन जल - लीला ॥41॥
cc-antya-10.41.translation: Thus all the Vaiṣṇavas from Bengal went to Jagannātha Purī. By chance, they arrived on the day when Lord Jagannātha performs pastimes in the water.

devanagari: नरेन्द्रेर जले ‘गोविन्द’ नौकाते चड़िया ।
जल - क्रीड़ा करे सब भक्त - गण ल ञा ॥42॥
cc-antya-10.42.translation: Boarding a boat in the waters of Narendra-sarovara, Lord Govinda performed His water pastimes with all the devotees.

devanagari: सेइ - काले महाप्रभु भक्त - गण - सङ्गे ।
नरेन्द्रे आइला देखिते जल - केलि - रङ्गे ॥43॥
cc-antya-10.43.translation: Then Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu arrived with His personal associates to see the jubilant pastimes of Lord Jagannātha in the Narendra-sarovara.

devanagari: सेइ - काले आइला सब गौड़ेर भक्त - गण ।
नरेन्द्रेते प्रभु - सङ्गे ह - इल मिलन ॥44॥
cc-antya-10.44.translation: At the same time, all the devotees from Bengal arrived at the lake and had a great meeting with the Lord.

devanagari: भक्त - गण पड़े आ सि’ प्रभुर चरणे ।
उठाञा प्रभु सबारे कैला आलिङ्गने ॥45॥
cc-antya-10.45.translation: All the devotees immediately fell at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and the Lord lifted and embraced every one of them.

devanagari: गौड़ीया - सम्प्रदाय सब करेन कीर्तन ।
प्रभुर मिलने उठे प्रेमेर क्रन्दन ॥46॥
cc-antya-10.46.translation: The Gauḍīya-sampradāya, consisting of all the devotees from Bengal, began congregational chanting. When they met the Lord, they began to cry loudly in ecstatic love.

devanagari: जल - क्रीड़ा, वाद्य, गीत, नर्तन, कीर्तन ।
महा - कोलाहल तीरे, सलिले खेलन ॥47॥
cc-antya-10.47.translation: Because of the pastimes in the water, there was great jubilation on the shore, with music, singing, chanting, dancing and tumultuous crying.

devanagari: गौड़ीया - सङ्कीर्तने आर रोदन मिलिया ।
महा - कोलाहल हैल ब्रह्माण्ड भरिया ॥48॥
cc-antya-10.48.translation: The chanting and crying of the Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇavas mixed and created a tumultuous sound vibration that filled the entire universe.

lines: saba bhakta lañā prabhu nāmilena jale
devanagari: सब भक्त लञा प्रभु नामिलेन जले ।
सबा ला जल - क्रीड़ा करेन कुतूहले ॥49॥
cc-antya-10.49.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu entered the water with His devotees and began His pastimes with them in great jubilation.

devanagari: यद्यपि प्रभुर आज्ञा गौड़े रहिते ।
तथापि नित्यानन्द प्रेमे चलिला देखिते ॥5॥
cc-antya-10.5.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had ordered Lord Nityānanda to stay in Bengal, but nevertheless, because of ecstatic love, Lord Nityānanda also went to see Him.

devanagari: प्रभुर एइ जल - क्रीड़ा दास - वृन्दावन ।
‘चैतन्य - मङ्गले विस्तारि’ करियाछेन वर्णन ॥50॥
cc-antya-10.50.translation: In his Caitanya-maṅgala [now known as Caitanya-bhāgavata], Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura has given a detailed description of the activities the Lord performed in the water.

lines: vyartha likhana haya, āra grantha bāḍaya
devanagari: पुनः इहाँ वर्णिले पुनरुक्ति हय ।
व्यर्थ लिखन हय, आर ग्रन्थ बाड़य ॥51॥
cc-antya-10.51.translation: There is no use describing here the activities of the Lord again. It would simply be repetitious and would increase the size of this book.

devanagari: जल - लीला क रि’ गोविन्द चलिला आलय ।
निज - गण लञा प्रभु गेला देवालय ॥52॥
cc-antya-10.52.translation: After concluding His pastimes in the water, Lord Govinda returned to His residence. Then Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to the temple, taking all His devotees with Him.

devanagari: जगन्नाथ दे खि’ पुनः निज - घरे आइला ।
प्रसाद आना ञा भक्त - गणे खाओयाइला ॥53॥
cc-antya-10.53.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to His residence after visiting the temple of Jagannātha, He asked for a large quantity of Lord Jagannātha's prasāda, which He then distributed among His devotees so that they could eat sumptuously.

devanagari: इष्ट - गोष्ठी सबा लञा कत - क्षण कैला ।
निज निज पूर्व - वासाय सबाय पाठाइला ॥54॥
cc-antya-10.54.translation: After talking with all the devotees for some time, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu asked them to occupy the individual residences in which they had lived the previous year.

devanagari: गोविन्द - ठाञि राघव झालि समर्पिला ।
भोजन - गृहेर कोणे झालि गोविन्द राखिला ॥55॥
cc-antya-10.55.translation: Rāghava Paṇḍita delivered the bags of eatables to Govinda, who kept them in a corner of the dining room.

lines: dravya bharibāre rākhe anya gṛhe lañā
devanagari: पूर्व - वत्सरेर झालि आजाड़ करिया ।
द्रव्य भरिबारे राखे अन्य गृहे लञा ॥56॥
cc-antya-10.56.translation: Govinda thoroughly emptied the bags from the previous year and kept them in another room to fill them with other goods.

devanagari: आर दिन महाप्रभु निज - गण ल ञा ।
जगन्नाथ देखिलेन शय्योत्थाने याञा ॥57॥
cc-antya-10.57.translation: The next day, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went with His personal devotees to see Lord Jagannātha when Lord Jagannātha arose early in the morning.

devanagari: बेड़ा - सङ्कीर्तन तहाँ आरम्भ करिला ।
सात - सम्प्रदाय तबे गाइते लागिला ॥58॥
cc-antya-10.58.translation: After seeing Lord Jagannātha, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu began His all-encompassing saṅkīrtana. He formed seven groups, which then began to chant.

devanagari: सात - सम्प्रदाये नृत्य करे सात जन ।
अद्वैत आचार्य, आर प्रभु - नित्यानन्द ॥59॥
cc-antya-10.59.translation: In each of the seven groups was a principal dancer like Advaita Ācārya and Lord Nityānanda.

lines: tāṅra ājñā bhāṅge tāṅra saṅgera kāraṇe
devanagari: अनुरागेर लक्षण एइ, - ‘विधि’ नाहि माने ।
ताँर आज्ञा भा ङ्गे ताँर सङ्गेर कारणे ॥6॥
cc-antya-10.6.translation: Indeed, it is a symptom of real affection that one breaks the order of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, not caring for the regulative principles, to associate with Him.

devanagari: वक्रेश्वर, अच्युतानन्द, पण्डित - श्रीवास ।
सत्यराज - खाँन, आर नरहरि - दास ॥60॥
cc-antya-10.60.translation: The dancers in the other groups were Vakreśvara Paṇḍita, Acyutānanda, Paṇḍita Śrīvāsa, Satyarāja Khān and Narahari dāsa.

devanagari: सात - सम्प्रदाये प्रभु करेन भ्रमण ।
‘मोर सम्प्रदाये प्रभु’ - ऐछे सबार मन ॥61॥
cc-antya-10.61.translation: As Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu walked from one group to another inspecting them, the men in each group thought, "The Lord is within our group."

devanagari: सङ्कीर्तन - कोलाहले आकाश भेदिल ।
सब जगन्नाथ - वासी देखिते आइल ॥62॥
cc-antya-10.62.translation: The congregational chanting made a tumultuous roar that filled the sky. All the inhabitants of Jagannātha Purī came to see the kīrtana.

lines: rājā āsi' dūre dekhe nija-gaṇa lañā
devanagari: राजा आ सि’ दूरे देखे निज - गण ल ञा ।
राज - पत्नी सब देखे अट्टाली चड़िया ॥63॥
cc-antya-10.63.translation: Accompanied by his personal staff, the King also came there and watched from a distance, and all the queens watched from the elevated parts of the palace.

devanagari: कीर्तन - आटोपे पृथिवी करे टलमल ।
‘हरि - ध्वनि’ करे लो क, हैल कोलाहल ॥64॥
cc-antya-10.64.translation: Due to the forceful vibration of kīrtana, the entire world began trembling. When everyone chanted the holy name, they made a tumultuous sound.

lines: āpane nācite tabe prabhura haila mana
devanagari: एइ - मत कत - क्षण कराइला कीर्तन ।
आपने नाचिते तबे प्रभुर हैल मन ॥65॥
cc-antya-10.65.translation: In this way the Lord had congregational chanting performed for some time, and then He Himself desired to dance.

devanagari: सात - दिके सात - सम्प्रदाय गाय, बाजाय ।
मध्ये महा - प्रेमावेशे नाचे गौर - राय ॥66॥
cc-antya-10.66.translation: The seven groups began chanting and beating their drums in seven directions, and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu began dancing in the center in great ecstatic love.

lines: svarūpere sei pada gāite ājñā dila
devanagari: उड़िया - पद महाप्रभुर मने स्मृति हैल।
स्वरूपेरे सेइ पद गाइते आज्ञा दिल ॥67॥
cc-antya-10.67.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu remembered a line in the Orissan language and ordered Svarūpa Dāmodara to sing it.

devanagari: “जगमोहन - परि - मुण्डा याउ” ॥68॥
cc-antya-10.68.translation: "Let my head fall at the feet of Jagannātha in the kīrtana hall known as Jagamohana."

devanagari: एइ पदे नृत्य करेन परम - आवेशे ।
सब - लोक चौदिके प्रभुर प्रेम - जले भासे ॥69॥
cc-antya-10.69.translation: Simply because of this line, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was dancing in greatly ecstatic love. People all around Him floated in the water of His tears.

lines: rāse yaiche ghara yāite gopīre ājñā dilā
tāṅra ājñā bhāṅgi' tāṅra saṅge se rahilā
devanagari: रासे यैछे घर याइते गोपीरे आज्ञा दिला ।
ताँर आज्ञा भाङ्गि’ ताँर सङ्गे से रहिला ॥7॥
cc-antya-10.7.translation: During the rāsa dance, Kṛṣṇa asked all the gopīs to return home, but the gopīs neglected His order and stayed there for His association.

devanagari: ‘बोल्’ ‘बोल्’ बलेन प्रभु श्री - बाहु तुलिया ।
हरि - ध्वनि करे लोक आनन्दे भासिया ॥70॥
cc-antya-10.70.translation: Raising His two arms, the Lord said, "Chant! Chant!" Floating in transcendental bliss, the people responded by chanting the holy name of Hari.

lines: prabhu paḍi' mūrchā yāya, śvāsa nāhi āra
devanagari: प्रभु पड़ि’ मूर्छा याय, श्वास नाहि आर ।
आचम्बिते उठे प्रभु करिया हुङ्कार ॥71॥
cc-antya-10.71.translation: The Lord fell to the ground unconscious, not even breathing. Then suddenly He stood up, making a loud sound.

lines: kabhu praphullita aṅga, kabhu haya saru
devanagari: सघन पुलक, - येन शिमुलेर तरु ।
कभु प्रफुल्लित अङ्ग, कभु हय सरु ॥72॥
cc-antya-10.72.translation: The hairs on His body constantly stood up like the thorns on a śimula tree. Sometimes His body was swollen and sometimes lean and thin.

devanagari: प्रति रोम - कूपे हय प्रस्वेद, रक्तोद्गम ।
‘जज’ ‘गग’ ‘परि’ ‘मुमु’ - गद्गद वचन ॥73॥
cc-antya-10.73.translation: He bled and perspired from every pore of His body. His voice faltered. Unable to say the line properly, He uttered only, "jaja gaga pari mumu."

lines: eka eka danta yena pṛthak pṛthak naḍe
aiche naḍe danta,—yena bhūme khasi' paḍe
devanagari: एक ए क दन्त येन पृथक् पृथक् नड़े ।
ऐछे नड़े दन्त , - येन भूमे खसि’ पड़े ॥74॥
cc-antya-10.74.translation: All His teeth shook, as if each were separate from the others. Indeed, they seemed about to fall to the ground.

lines: tṛtīya prahara ha-ila, nṛtya nahe śeṣa
devanagari: क्षणे क्षणे बाड़े प्रभुर आनन्द - आवेश ।
तृतीय प्रहर ह - इल, नृत्य नहे शेष ॥75॥
cc-antya-10.75.translation: His transcendental bliss increased at every moment. Therefore even by midafternoon the dancing had not ended.

devanagari: सब लोकेर उथलिल आनन्द - सागर ।
सब लोक पासरिल देह - आत्म - घर ॥76॥
cc-antya-10.76.translation: The ocean of transcendental bliss overflowed, and everyone present forgot his body, mind and home.

devanagari: तबे नित्यानन्द प्रभु सृजिला उपाय ।
क्रमे - क्रमे कीर्तनीया राखिल सबाय ॥77॥
cc-antya-10.77.translation: Then Lord Nityānanda found a way to end the kīrtana. He gradually stopped all the chanters.

devanagari: स्वरूपेर सङ्गे मात्र एक सम्प्रदाय ।
स्वरूपेर सङ्गे सेह मन्द - स्वर गाय ॥78॥
cc-antya-10.78.translation: Thus only one group continued chanting with Svarūpa Dāmodara, and they chanted very softly.

lines: kolāhala nāhi, prabhura kichu bāhya haila
devanagari: कोलाहल नाहि, प्रभुर किछु बाह्य हैल ।
तबे नित्यानन्द सबार श्रम जानाइल ॥79॥
cc-antya-10.79.translation: When there was no longer a tumultuous sound, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to consciousness. Then Nityānanda Prabhu informed Him of the fatigue of the chanters and dancers.

devanagari: आज्ञा - पालने कृष्णेर यैछे परितोष ।
प्रेमे आज्ञा भाङ्गिले हय कोटि - सुख - पोष ॥8॥
cc-antya-10.8.translation: If one carries out Kṛṣṇa's order, Kṛṣṇa is certainly pleased, but if one sometimes breaks His order due to ecstatic love, that gives Him millions of times greater happiness.

lines: sabā lañā āsi' kailā samudre snapana
devanagari: भक्त - श्रम जा नि’ कैला कीर्तन समापन ।
सबा ल ञा आसि’ कैला समुद्रे स्नपन ॥80॥
cc-antya-10.80.translation: Understanding the fatigue of the devotees, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stopped the congregational chanting. Then He bathed in the sea, accompanied by them all.

lines: saba lañā prabhu kailā prasāda bhojana
devanagari: सब लञा प्रभु कैला प्रसाद भोजन ।
सबारे विदाय दिला करिते शयन ॥81॥
cc-antya-10.81.translation: Then Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu took prasāda with all of them and then asked them to return to their dwellings and take rest.

devanagari: गम्भीरार द्वारे करेन आपने शयन ।
गोविन्द आसिया करे पाद - सम्वाहन ॥82॥
cc-antya-10.82.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu lay down at the door of the Gambhīrā, and Govinda came there to massage His legs.

devanagari: सर्व - काल आछे एइ सुदृढ़ ‘नियम’ ।
‘प्रभु यदि प्रसाद पाञा करेन शयन ॥83॥
cc-antya-10.83-84.translation: It was a steady, long-standing rule that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would lie down to rest after lunch and Govinda would come to massage His legs. Then Govinda would honor the remnants of food left by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: saba dvāra yuḍi' prabhu kariyāchena śayana
bhitare yāite nāre, govinda kare nivedana
devanagari: सब द्वार युड़ि’ प्रभु करियाछेन शयन ।
भितरे याइते नारे, गोविन्द करे निवेदन ॥85॥
cc-antya-10.85.translation: This time when the Lord lay down, He occupied the entire doorway. Govinda could not enter the room, and therefore he made the following request.

devanagari: ‘एक - पाश हओ, मोरे देह’ भितर याइते’ ।
प्रभु कहे, - ‘शक्ति नाहि अङ्ग चालाइते’ ॥86॥
cc-antya-10.86.translation: "Kindly turn on one side. Let me pass to enter the room." However, the Lord replied, "I don't have the strength to move My body."

lines: bāra bāra govinda kahe eka-dik ha-ite
devanagari: बार बार गोविन्द कहे एक - दिक् ह - इते ।
प्रभु कहे, - ’अङ्ग आमि नारि चालाइते’ ॥87॥
cc-antya-10.87.translation: Govinda made his request again and again, but the Lord replied, "I cannot move My body."

lines: prabhu kahe,—'kara vā nā kara, yei laya tomāra mana'
devanagari: गोविन्द कहे , - ‘करिते चाहि पाद - सम्वाह न’ ।
प्रभु कहे, - ‘कर वा ना कर, येइ लय तोमार म न’ ॥88॥
cc-antya-10.88.translation: Govinda repeatedly requested, "I want to massage Your legs," but the Lord said, "Do it or don't do it. It depends upon your mind."

lines: tabe govinda bahirvāsa tāṅra upare diyā
devanagari: तबे गोविन्द बहिर्वास ताँर उपरे दिया ।
भितर - घरे गेला महाप्रभुरे लङ्गिया ॥89॥
cc-antya-10.89.translation: Then Govinda spread the Lord's wrapper over the Lord's body and in this way entered the room by crossing over Him.

devanagari: वासुदेव - दत्त, मुरारि - गुप्त, गङ्गादास ।
श्रीमान् सेन, श्रीमान् पण्डित, अकिञ्चन कृष्णदास ॥9॥
cc-antya-10.9-11.translation: Vāsudeva Datta, Murāri Gupta, Gaṅgādāsa, Śrīmān Sena, Śrīmān Paṇḍita, Akiñcana Kṛṣṇadāsa, Murāri Gupta, Garuḍa Paṇḍita, Buddhimanta Khān, Sañjaya Puruṣottama, Bhagavān Paṇḍita, Śuklāmbara Brahmacārī, Nṛsiṁhānanda Brahmacārī and many others joined together to go to Jagannātha Purī. It would be impossible to mention the names of them all.

devanagari: पाद - सम्वाहन कैल, कटि - पृष्ठ चापिल ।
मधूर - मर्दने प्रभुर परिश्रम गेल ॥90॥
cc-antya-10.90.translation: Govinda massaged the Lord's legs as usual. He pressed the Lord's waist and back very softly, and thus all the Lord's fatigue went away.

lines: sukhe nidrā haila prabhura, govinda cāpe aṅga
devanagari: सुखे निद्रा हैल प्रभुर, गोविन्द चापे अङ्ग ।
दण्ड - दुइ ब - इ प्रभुर हैला निद्रा - भङ्ग ॥91॥
cc-antya-10.91.translation: As Govinda stroked His body, the Lord slept very nicely for about forty-five minutes, and then His sleep broke.

lines: govinde dekhiyā prabhu bale kruddha hañā
devanagari: गोविन्दे देखिया प्रभु बले क्रुद्ध हञा ।
‘आजि केने एत - क्षण आछिस् वसिया? ॥92॥
cc-antya-10.92.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu saw Govinda sitting by His side, He was somewhat angry. "Why have you been sitting here for so long today?" the Lord asked.

lines: mora nidrā haile kene nā gelā prasāda khāite?'
govinda kahe—'dvāre śuilā, yāite nāhi pathe'
devanagari: मोर निद्रा हैले केने ना गेला प्रसाद खाइते ?’ ।
गोविन्द कहे - ‘द्वारे शुइला, याइते नाहि पथे’ ॥93॥
cc-antya-10.93.translation: "Why didn't you go to take your meal after I fell asleep?" the Lord asked. Govinda replied, "You were lying down, blocking the door, and there was no way to go."

lines: taiche kene prasāda laite nā kailā gamane?'
devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - ‘भितरे तबे आइला केमने ? ।
तैछे केने प्रसाद लैते ना कैला गमने ?’ ॥94॥
cc-antya-10.94.translation: The Lord asked, "How did you enter the room? Why didn't you go out to take your lunch in the same way?"

devanagari: गोविन्द कहे मने - ”आमार ‘सेवा’ से ‘नियम’ ।
अपराध ह - उक, किबा नरके गमन” ॥95॥
cc-antya-10.95.translation: Govinda mentally replied, "My duty is to serve, even if I have to commit offenses or go to hell.

devanagari: ‘सेवा’ लागि’ कोटि ‘अपराध’ नाहि गणि ।
स्व - निमित्त ‘अपराधाभा से’ भय मा नि’ ॥96॥
cc-antya-10.96.translation: "I would not mind committing hundreds and thousands of offenses for the service of the Lord, but I greatly fear committing even a glimpse of an offense for my own self."

lines: eta saba mane kari' govinda rahilā
prabhu ye puchilā, tāra uttara nā dilā
devanagari: एत सब मने क रि’ गोविन्द रहिला ।
प्रभु ये पुछिला, तार उत्तर ना दिला ॥97॥
cc-antya-10.97.translation: Thinking in this way, Govinda kept silent. He did not reply to the Lord's inquiry.

lines: pratyaha prabhura nidrāya yāna prasāda la-ite
se divasera śrama dekhi' lāgilā cāpite
devanagari: प्रत्यह प्रभुर निद्राय यान प्रसाद ल - इते ।
से दिवसेर श्रम दे खि’ लागिला चापिते ॥98॥
cc-antya-10.98.translation: It was Govinda's practice to go take lunch when the Lord was asleep. On that day, however, seeing the Lord's weariness, Govinda continued massaging His body.

devanagari: याइतेह पथ नाहि, याइबे केमने ? ।
महा - अपराध हय प्रभुर लङ्घने ॥99॥
cc-antya-10.99.translation: There was no way to go. How could he leave? When he thought of crossing over the Lord's body, he considered it a great offense.

devanagari: नमामि हरिदासं तं चैतन्यं तं च तत्प्रभुम् ।
संस्थितामपि यन्मूर्ति स्वाङ्के कृत्वा ननर्त यः ॥1॥
cc-antya-11.1.translation: Let me offer my respectful obeisances unto Haridāsa Ṭhākura and his master, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who danced with the body of Haridāsa Ṭhākura on His lap.

lines: yaiche taiche likhi, kari āpana pāvana
devanagari: ए - सब प्रसादे लिखि चैतन्य - लीला - गुण ।
यैछे तैछे लिखि, करि आपन पावन ॥10॥
cc-antya-11.10.translation: I am writing this narration of the pastimes and attributes of the Lord by the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His associates. I do not know how to write properly, but I am purifying myself by writing this description.

lines: tabe mahāprabhu saba bhakte vidāya dilā
devanagari: तबे महाप्रभु सब भक्ते विदाय दिला ।
हर्ष - विषादे प्रभु विश्राम करिला ॥100॥
cc-antya-11.100.translation: Thereafter, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu bid farewell to all the devotees, and He Himself, with mixed feelings of happiness and distress, took rest.

devanagari: एइ त कहिलुँ हरिदासेर विजय ।
याहार श्रवणे कृष्णे दृढ़ - भक्ति हय ॥101॥
cc-antya-11.101.translation: Thus I have spoken about the victorious passing away of Haridāsa Ṭhākura. Anyone who hears this narration will certainly fix his mind firmly in devotional service to Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: चैतन्ये र भक्त - वात्सल्य इहातेइ जानि ।
भक्त - वाञ्छा पूर्ण कैला न्यासि - शिरोमणि ॥102॥
cc-antya-11.102.translation: From the incident of Haridāsa Ṭhākura's passing away and the great care Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu took in commemorating it, one can understand just how affectionate He is toward His devotees. Although He is the topmost of all sannyāsīs, He fully satisfied the desire of Haridāsa Ṭhākura.

lines: tāṅre kole kari' kailā āpane nartana
devanagari: शेष - काले दिला ताँरे दर्शन - स्पर्शन ।
ताँरे कोले क रि’ कैला आपने नर्तन ॥103॥
cc-antya-11.103.translation: At the last stage of Haridāsa Ṭhākura's life, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu gave him His company and allowed him to touch Him. Thereafter, He took the body of Ṭhākura Haridāsa on His lap and personally danced with it.

lines: āpane śrī-haste kṛpāya tāṅre vālu dilā
devanagari: आपने श्री - हस्ते कृपाय ताँरे वालु दिला ।
आपने प्रसाद मा गि’ महोत्सव कैला ॥104॥
cc-antya-11.104.translation: Out of His causeless mercy He personally covered the body of Haridāsa Ṭhākura with sand and personally begged alms from the shopkeepers. Then He conducted a great festival to celebrate the passing away of Haridāsa Ṭhākura.

lines: e saubhāgya lāgi' āge karilā prayāṇa
devanagari: महा - भागवत हरिदास - परम - विद्वान् ।
ए सौभाग्य ला गि’ आगे करिला प्रयाण ॥105॥
cc-antya-11.105.translation: Haridāsa Ṭhākura was not only the topmost devotee of the Lord, but also a great and learned scholar. It was his great fortune that he passed away before Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: karṇa-mana tṛpta kare yāra eka bindu
devanagari: चैतन्य - चरित्र एइ अमृतेर सिन्धु ।
कर्ण - मन तृप्त करे यार एक बिन्दु ॥106॥
cc-antya-11.106.translation: The life and characteristics of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu are exactly like an ocean of nectar, one drop of which can please the mind and ear.

devanagari: भव - सिन्धु तरिबारे आछे यार चित्त ।
श्रद्धा क रि’ शुन सेइ चैतन्य - चरित्र ॥107॥
cc-antya-11.107.translation: Anyone who desires to cross over the ocean of nescience, please hear with great faith the life and characteristics of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: श्री - रूप - रघुनाथ - पदे यार आश ।
चैतन्य - चरितामृत कहे कृष्णदास ॥108॥
cc-antya-11.108.translation: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.

devanagari: एइ - मत महाप्रभुर नीलाचले वास ।
सड़े भक्त - गण लञा कीर्तन - विलास ॥11॥
cc-antya-11.11.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu thus resided at Jagannātha Purī with His personal devotees and enjoyed the congregational chanting of the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā mantra.

devanagari: दिने नृत्य - कीर्तन, ईश्वर - दरशन ।
रात्र्ये राय - स्वरूप - सने रस - आस्वादन ॥12॥
cc-antya-11.12.translation: In the daytime Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu engaged in dancing and chanting and in seeing the temple of Lord Jagannātha. At night, in the company of His most confidential devotees, such as Rāmānanda Rāya and Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, He tasted the nectar of the transcendental mellows of Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa's pastimes.

devanagari: एइ - मत महाप्रभुर सुखे काल याय ।
कृष्णेर विरह - विकार अङ्गे नाना हय ॥13॥
cc-antya-11.13.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu very happily passed His days in this way at Nīlācala, Jagannātha Purī. Feeling separation from Kṛṣṇa, He exhibited many transcendental symptoms all over His body.

lines: dine dine bāḍe vikāra, rātrye atiśaya
cintā, udvega, pralāpādi yata śāstre kaya
devanagari: दिने दिने बाड़े विकार, रात्र्ये अतिशय ।
चिन्ता, उद्वेग, प्रलापादि यत शास्त्रे कय ॥14॥
cc-antya-11.14.translation: Day after day the symptoms increased, and at night they increased even more. All these symptoms, such as transcendental anxiety, agitation, and talking like a madman, were present, just as they are described in the śāstras.

devanagari: स्वरूप गोसा ञि, आर रामानन्द - राय ।
रात्रि - दिने करे दोंहे प्रभुर सहाय ॥15॥
cc-antya-11.15.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī and Rāmānanda Rāya, the chief assistants in Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's pastimes, remained with Him both day and night.

devanagari: एक - दिन गोविन्द महा - प्रसाद ल ञा ।
हरिदासे दिते गेला आनन्दित हञा ॥16॥
cc-antya-11.16.translation: One day Govinda, the personal servant of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, went in great jubilation to deliver the remnants of Lord Jagannātha's food to Haridāsa Ṭhākura.

devanagari: देखे, - हरिदास ठा कुर करियाछे शयन ।
मन्द मन्द करितेछे सङ्ख्या - सङ्कीर्तन ॥17॥
cc-antya-11.17.translation: When Govinda came to Haridāsa, he saw that Haridāsa Ṭhākura was lying on his back and chanting his rounds very slowly.

devanagari: गोविन्द कहे , - ‘उठ आ सि’ करह भोज न’ ।
हरिदास कहे , - आजि करिमु लङ्घन ॥18॥
cc-antya-11.18.translation: "Please rise and take your mahā-prasāda," Govinda said. Haridāsa Ṭhākura replied, "Today I shall observe fasting.

devanagari: सङ्ख्या - कीर्तन पूरे नाहि, के - मते खाइब ? ।
महा - प्रसाद आनियाछ, के - मते उपेक्षिब ? ॥19॥
cc-antya-11.19.translation: "I have not finished chanting my regular number of rounds. How, then, can I eat? But you have brought mahā-prasāda, and how can I neglect it?"

devanagari: जय जय श्री - चैतन्य जय दयामय ।
जयाद्वैत - प्रिय नित्यानन्द - प्रिय जय ॥2॥
cc-antya-11.2.translation: All glories to Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who is very merciful and who is very dear to Advaita Ācārya and Lord Nityānanda.

lines: eka rañca lañā tāra karilā bhakṣaṇa
devanagari: एत बलि’ महा - प्रसाद करिला वन्दन ।
एक रञ्च लञा तार करिला भक्षण ॥20॥
cc-antya-11.20.translation: Saying this, he offered prayers to the mahā-prasāda, took a little portion, and ate it.

lines: āra dina mahāprabhu tāṅra ṭhāñi āilā
devanagari: आर दिन महाप्रभु ताँर ठाञि आइला ।
सुस्थ हओ, हरिदास - बलि’ ताँरे पुछिला ॥21॥
cc-antya-11.21.translation: The next day, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to Haridāsa's place and inquired from him, "Haridāsa, are you well?"

lines: śarīra sustha haya mora, asustha buddhi-mana
devanagari: नमस्कार क रि’ तेंहो कैला निवेदन ।
शरीर सुस्थ हय मोर, असुस्थ बुद्धि - मन ॥22॥
cc-antya-11.22.translation: Haridāsa offered his obeisances to the Lord and replied, "My body is all right, but my mind and intelligence are not well."

lines: prabhu kahe,—'kon vyādhi, kaha ta' nirṇaya?'
devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - ‘कोन् व्याधि, कह त’ निर्णय ?’ ।
तेंहो कहे , - ‘सङ्ख्या - कीर्तन ना पूरय’ ॥23॥
cc-antya-11.23.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu further inquired from Haridāsa, "Can you ascertain what your disease is?" Haridāsa Ṭhākura replied, "My disease is that I cannot complete my rounds."

lines: siddha-deha tumi, sādhane āgraha kene kara?
devanagari: प्रभु कहे,_“वृद्ध ह - इला ‘सङ्ख्या’ अल्प कर ।
सिद्ध - देह तुमि, साधने आग्रह केने क र? ॥24॥
cc-antya-11.24.translation: "Now that you have become old," the Lord said, "you may reduce the number of rounds you chant daily. You are already liberated, and therefore you need not follow the regulative principles very strictly.

devanagari: लोक निस्तारिते एइ तोमार ‘अवतार’ ।
नामेर महिमा लोके करिला प्रचार ॥25॥
cc-antya-11.25.translation: "Your role in this incarnation is to deliver the people in general. You have sufficiently preached the glories of the holy name in this world."

lines: ebe alpa saṅkhyā kari' kara saṅkīrtana"
devanagari: एबे अल्प सङ्ख्या करि’ कर सङ्कीर्तन” ।
हरिदास कहे , - “शुन मोर सत्य निवेदन ॥26॥
cc-antya-11.26.translation: The Lord concluded, "Now, therefore, please reduce the fixed number of times you chant the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra." Haridāsa Ṭhākura replied, "Kindly hear my real plea.

devanagari: हीन - जाति जन्म मोर निन्द्य - कलेवर ।
हीन - कर्मे रत मुञि अधम पामर ॥27॥
cc-antya-11.27.translation: "I was born in an inferior family, and my body is most abominable. I always engage in low work. Therefore, I am the lowest, most condemned of men.

lines: raurava ha-ite kāḍi' more vaikuṇṭhe caḍāilā
devanagari: अदृश्य, अस्पृश्य मोरे अङ्गीकार कैला ।
रौरव ह - इते का ड़ि’ मोरे वैकुण्ठे चड़ाइला ॥28॥
cc-antya-11.28.translation: "I am unseeable and untouchable, but You have accepted me as Your servant. This means that You have delivered me from a hellish condition and raised me to the Vaikuṇṭha platform.

lines: jagat nācāo, yāre yaiche icchā haya
devanagari: स्वतन्त्र ईश्वर तुमि हओ इच्छामय ।
जगत् नाचाओ, यारे यैछे इच्छा हय ॥29॥
cc-antya-11.29.translation: "My dear Lord, You are the fully independent Personality of Godhead. You act by Your own free will. You cause the whole world to dance and act as You like.

devanagari: जय श्रीनिवासेश्वर हरिदास - नाथ ।
जय गदाधर - प्रिय स्वरूप - प्राण - नाथ ॥3॥
cc-antya-11.3.translation: All glories to the master of Śrīnivāsa Ṭhākura! All glories to the master of Haridāsa Ṭhākura! All glories to the dear master of Gadādhara Paṇḍita! All glories to the master of the life of Svarūpa Dāmodara!

devanagari: अनेक नाचाइला मोरे प्रसाद करिया ।
विप्रेर श्राद्ध - पात्र खाइ नु ‘म्लेच्छ’ हञा ॥30॥
cc-antya-11.30.translation: "My dear Lord, by Your mercy You have made me dance in many ways. For example, I was offered the śrāddha-pātra that should have been offered to first-class brāhmaṇas. I ate from it even though I was born in a family of meateaters.

lines: eka vāñchā haya mora bahu dina haite
devanagari: एक वाञ्छा हय मोर बहु दिन हैते ।
लीला सम्वरिबे तुमि - लय मोर चित्ते ॥31॥
cc-antya-11.31.translation: "I have had one desire for a very long time. I think that quite soon, my Lord, You will bring to a close Your pastimes within this material world.

lines: sei līlā prabhu more kabhu nā dekhāibā
devanagari: सेइ लीला प्रभु मोरे कभु ना देखाइबा ।
आपनार आगे मोर शरीर पाड़िबा ॥32॥
cc-antya-11.32.translation: "I wish that You not show me this closing chapter of Your pastimes. Before that time comes, kindly let my body fall down in Your presence.

devanagari: हृदये धरिमु तोमार कमल चरण ।
नयने देखिमु तोमार चाँद वदन ॥33॥
cc-antya-11.33.translation: "I wish to catch Your lotuslike feet upon my heart and see Your moonlike face.

devanagari: जिह्वाय उच्चारिमु तोमार ‘कृष्ण - चैतन्य’ - नाम ।
एइ - मत मोर इच्छा , - छाड़िमु पराण ॥34॥
cc-antya-11.34.translation: "With my tongue I shall chant Your holy name, 'Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya!' That is my desire. Kindly let me give up my body in this way.

lines: mora ei icchā yadi tomāra prasāde haya
devanagari: मोर एइ इच्छा यदि तोमार प्रसादे हय ।
एइ निवेदन मोर कर, दयामय ॥35॥
cc-antya-11.35.translation: "O most merciful Lord, if by Your mercy it is possible, kindly grant my desire.

lines: ei nīca deha mora paḍuka tava āge
devanagari: एइ नीच देह मोर पड़क तवे आगे ।
एइ वाञ्छा - सिद्धि मोर तोमातेइ लागे” ॥36॥
cc-antya-11.36.translation: "Let this lowborn body fall down before You. You can make possible this perfection of all my desires."

devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - “हरिदास, ये तुमि मागिबे ।
कृष्ण कृपामय ताहा अवश्य करिबे ॥37॥
cc-antya-11.37.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "My dear Haridāsa, Kṛṣṇa is so merciful that He must execute whatever you want.

lines: kintu āmāra ye kichu sukha, saba tomā lañā
devanagari: किन्तु आमार ये किछु सुख, सब तोमा लञा ।
तोमार योग्य नहे , - याबे आमारे छाड़िया” ॥38॥
cc-antya-11.38.translation: "But whatever happiness is Mine is all due to your association. It is not fitting for you to go away and leave Me aside."

devanagari: चरणे धरि’ कहे हरिदास ,_“ना करिह ‘माया’ ।
अवश्य मो - अधमे, प्रभु, कर एइ ‘दया’ ॥39॥
cc-antya-11.39.translation: Catching the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Haridāsa Ṭhākura said, "My Lord, do not create an illusion! Although I am so fallen, You must certainly show me this mercy!

devanagari: जय काशी - प्रिय जगदानन्द - प्राणेश्वर ।
जय रूप - सनातन - रघुनाथेश्वर ॥4॥
cc-antya-11.4.translation: All glories to Lord Śrī Caitanya, who is very dear to Kāśī Miśra. He is the Lord of the life of Jagadānanda and the Lord of Rūpa Gosvāmī, Sanātana Gosvāmī and Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī.

devanagari: मोर शिरोमणि कत कत महाशय ।
तोमार लीलार सहाय कोटि - भक्त हय ॥40॥
cc-antya-11.40.translation: "My Lord, there are many respectable personalities, millions of devotees, who are fit to sit on my head. They are all helpful in Your pastimes.

lines: āmā-hena yadi eka kīṭa mari' gela
eka pipīlikā maile pṛthvīra kāhāṅ hāni haila?
devanagari: आमा - हेन यदि एक कीट म रि’ गेल ।
एक पिपीलिका मैले पृथ्वीर काहाँ हानि हैल? ॥41॥
cc-antya-11.41.translation: "My Lord, if an insignificant insect like me dies, what is the loss? If an ant dies, where is the loss to the material world?

lines: avaśya pūrābe, prabhu, mora ei āśa"
devanagari: ‘भकत - वत्सल’ प्रभु, तुमि, मुड़ ‘भक्ताभा स’ ।
अवश्य पूराबे, प्रभु, मोर एइ आश” ॥42॥
cc-antya-11.42.translation: "My Lord, You are always affectionate to Your devotees. I am just an imitation devotee, but nevertheless I wish that You fulfill my desire. That is my expectation."

devanagari: मध्याह्न करिते प्रभु चलिला आपने ।
ईश्वर देखिया कालि दिबेन दरशने ॥43॥
cc-antya-11.43.translation: Because He had to perform His noon duties, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu got up to leave, but it was settled that the following day, after He saw Lord Jagannātha, He would return to visit Haridāsa Ṭhākura.

devanagari: तबे महाप्रभु ताँरे करि’ आलिङ्गन ।
मध्याह्न करिते समुद्रे करिला गमन ॥44॥
cc-antya-11.44.translation: After embracing him, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu left to perform His noon duties and went to the sea to take His bath.

lines: prātaḥ-kāle īśvara dekhi' saba bhakta lañā
devanagari: प्रातः काले ईश्वर देखि सब भक्त ल ञा ।
हरिदासे देखिते आइला शीघ्र करिया ॥45॥
cc-antya-11.45.translation: The next morning, after visiting the Jagannātha temple, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, accompanied by all His other devotees, came hastily to see Haridāsa Ṭhākura.

devanagari: हरिदासेर आगे आ सि’ दिला दरशन ।
हरिदास वन्दिला प्रभुर आर वैष्णव - चरण ॥46॥
cc-antya-11.46.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and the other devotees came before Haridāsa Ṭhākura, who offered his respects to the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and all the Vaiṣṇavas.

devanagari: प्रभु कहे,‘हरिदास, कह समाचार’ ।
हरिदास कहे , - ‘प्रभु, ये कृपा तोमार’ ॥47॥
cc-antya-11.47.translation: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu inquired, "My dear Haridāsa, what is the news?" Haridāsa Ṭhākura replied, "My Lord, whatever mercy You can bestow upon me."

devanagari: अङ्गने आरम्भिला प्रभु महा - सङ्कीर्तन ।
वक्रेश्वर - पण्डित ताहाँ करेन नर्तन ॥48॥
cc-antya-11.48.translation: Upon hearing this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu immediately began great congregational chanting in the courtyard. Vakreśvara Paṇḍita was the chief dancer.

devanagari: स्वरूप - गोसा ञि आदि यत प्रभुर गण ।
हरिदासे बे ड़ि’ करे नाम - सङ्कीर्तन ॥49॥
cc-antya-11.49.translation: Headed by Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, all the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu surrounded Haridāsa Ṭhākura and began congregational chanting.

devanagari: जय गौर - देह कृष्ण स्वयं भगवान् ।
कृपा करि’ देह’ प्रभु, निज - पद - दान ॥5॥
cc-antya-11.5.translation: All glories to the transcendental form of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who is Kṛṣṇa Himself, the Supreme Personality of Godhead. My dear Lord, kindly give me shelter at Your lotus feet by Your causeless mercy.

devanagari: रामानन्द, सार्वभौम, सबार अग्रेते ।
हरिदासेर गुण प्रभु लागिला कहिते ॥50॥
cc-antya-11.50.translation: In front of all the great devotees like Rāmānanda Rāya and Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu began to describe the holy attributes of Haridāsa Ṭhākura.

lines: haridāsera guṇa kahite prabhu ha-ilā pañca-mukha
devanagari: हरिदासेर गुण कहिते प्रभु ह - इला पञ्च - मुख ।
कहिते कहिते प्रभुर बाड़े महा - सुख ॥51॥
cc-antya-11.51.translation: As He described the transcendental attributes of Haridāsa Ṭhākura, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu seemed to possess five mouths. The more He described, the more His great happiness increased.

lines: haridāsera guṇe sabāra vismita haya mana
devanagari: हरिदासेर गुणे सबार विस्मित हय मन ।
सर्व - भक्त वन्दे हरिदासेर चरण ॥52॥
cc-antya-11.52.translation: After hearing of the transcendental qualities of Haridāsa Ṭhākura, all the devotees present were struck with wonder. They all offered their respectful obeisances to the lotus feet of Haridāsa Ṭhākura.

devanagari: हरिदास निजागृते प्रभुरे वसाइला ।
निज - नेत्र - दुइ भृङ्ग - मुख - पद्म दिला ॥53॥
cc-antya-11.53.translation: Haridāsa Ṭhākura made Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sit down in front of him, and then he fixed his eyes, like two bumblebees, on the lotus face of the Lord.

devanagari: स्व - हृदये आ नि’ धरिल प्रभुर चरण ।
सर्व - भक्त - पद - रेणु मस्तक - भूषण ॥54॥
cc-antya-11.54.translation: He held the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu on his heart and then took the dust of the feet of all the devotees present and put it on his head.

devanagari: ‘श्री - कृष्ण - चैतन्य’ शब्द बलेन बार बार ।
प्रभु - मुख - माधुरी पिये, नेत्रे जल - धार ॥55॥
cc-antya-11.55.translation: He began to chant the holy name of Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya again and again. As he drank the sweetness of the face of the Lord, tears constantly glided down from his eyes.

devanagari: ‘श्री - कृष्ण - चैतन्य’ शब्द करिते उच्चारण ।
नामेर सहित प्राण कैल उत्क्रामण ॥56॥
cc-antya-11.56.translation: While chanting the holy name of Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya, he gave up his air of life and left his body.

devanagari: महा - योगेश्वर - प्राय दे खि’ स्वच्छन्दे मरण ।
‘भीष्मेर निर्माण’ सबार ह - इल स्मरण ॥57॥
cc-antya-11.57.translation: Seeing the wonderful death of Haridāsa Ṭhākura by his own will, which was just like a great mystic yogī's, everyone remembered the passing away of Bhīṣma.

devanagari: ‘हरि’ ‘कृष्ण’ - शब्दे सबे करे कोलाहल ।
प्रेमानन्दे महाप्रभु ह - इला विह्वल ॥58॥
cc-antya-11.58.translation: There was a tumultuous noise as they all chanted the holy names "Hari" and "Kṛṣṇa." Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu became overwhelmed with ecstatic love.

lines: haridāsera tanu prabhu kole laila uṭhāñā
devanagari: हरिदासेर तनु प्रभु कोले लैल उठाञा ।
अङ्गने नाचेन प्रभु प्रेमाविष्ट हञा ॥59॥
cc-antya-11.59.translation: The Lord raised the body of Haridāsa Ṭhākura and placed it on His lap. Then He began to dance in the courtyard in great ecstatic love.

devanagari: जय नित्यानन्द - चन्द्र जय चैतन्येर प्राण ।
तोमार चरणारविन्दे भक्ति देह’ दान ॥6॥
cc-antya-11.6.translation: All glories to Lord Nityānanda, who is the life and soul of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. My dear Lord, kindly give me engagement in devotional service at Your lotus feet.

devanagari: प्रभुर आवेशे अवश सर्व - भक्त - गण ।
प्रेमावेशे स बे नाचे, करेन कीर्तन ॥60॥
cc-antya-11.60.translation: Because of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's ecstatic love, all the devotees were helpless, and in ecstatic love they also began to dance and chant congregationally.

devanagari: एइ - मते नृत्य प्रभु कैला कत - क्षण ।
स्वरूप - गोसा ञि प्रभुरे कराइल सावधान ॥61॥
cc-antya-11.61.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu danced for some time, and then Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī informed Him of other rituals for the body of Ṭhākura Haridāsa.

lines: samudre lañā gelā tabe kīrtana kariyā
devanagari: हरिदास - ठाकुरे तबे विमाने चड़ाञा ।
समुद्रे लञा गेला तबे कीर्तन करिया ॥62॥
cc-antya-11.62.translation: The body of Haridāsa Ṭhākura was then raised onto a carrier that resembled an airship and taken to the sea, accompanied by congregational chanting.

lines: āge mahāprabhu calena nṛtya karite karite
devanagari: आगे महाप्रभु चलेन नृत्य करिते करिते ।
पाछे नृत्य करे वक्रेश्वर भक्त - गण - साथे ॥63॥
cc-antya-11.63.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu danced in front of the procession, and Vakreśvara Paṇḍita, along with the other devotees, chanted and danced behind Him.

devanagari: हरिदासे समुद्र - जले स्नान कराइला ।
प्रभु कहे, - “समुद्र एइ ‘महा - तीर्थ’ ह - इला” ॥64॥
cc-antya-11.64.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu bathed the body of Haridāsa Ṭhākura in the sea and then declared, "From this day on, this sea has become a great pilgrimage site."

devanagari: हरिदासेर पादोदक पिये भक्त - गण ।
हरिदासेर अड़े दिला प्रसाद - चन्दन ॥65॥
cc-antya-11.65.translation: Everyone drank the water that had touched the lotus feet of Haridāsa Ṭhākura, and then they smeared remnants of Lord Jagannātha's sandalwood pulp over Haridāsa Ṭhākura's body.

lines: ḍora, kaḍāra, prasāda, vastra aṅge dilā
devanagari: डोर, कड़ार, प्रसाद, वस्त्र अङ्गे दिला ।
वालुकार गर्न करि’ ताहे शोयाइला ॥66॥
cc-antya-11.66.translation: After a hole was dug in the sand, the body of Haridāsa Ṭhākura was placed in it. Remnants from Lord Jagannātha, such as His silken ropes, sandalwood pulp, food and cloth, were placed on the body.

devanagari: चारि - दिके भक्त - गण करेन कीर्तन ।
वक्रेश्वर - पण्डित करेन आनन्दे नर्तन ॥67॥
cc-antya-11.67.translation: All around the body, the devotees performed congregational chanting, and Vakreśvara Paṇḍita danced in jubilation.

lines: āpani sri-haste vālu dilā tāṅra gāya
devanagari: ‘हरि - बोल’ ‘हरि - बोल’ बले गौरराय ।
आपनि श्री - हस्ते वालु दिला ताँर गाय ॥68॥
cc-antya-11.68.translation: With His transcendental hands, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu personally covered the body of Haridāsa Ṭhākura with sand, chanting "Hari bol! Hari bol!"

lines: tāṅre vālu diyā upare piṇḍā bāṅdhāilā
devanagari: ताँरे वालु दिया उपरे पिण्डा बाँधाइला ।
चौदिके पिण्डेर महा आवरण कैला ॥69॥
cc-antya-11.69.translation: They covered the body of Haridāsa Ṭhākura with sand and then constructed a platform upon the site. The platform was protected all around by fencing.

devanagari: जय जयाद्वैत - चन्द्र चैतन्येर आर्य ।
स्व - चरणे भक्ति देह’ जयाद्वैताचार्य ॥7॥
cc-antya-11.7.translation: All glories to Advaita Ācārya, who is treated by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu as superior due to His age and respectability. Please give me engagement in devotional service at Your lotus feet.

lines: tāhā beḍi' prabhu kailā kīrtana, nartana
devanagari: ताहा बे ड़ि’ प्रभु कैला कीर्तन, नर्तन ।
हरि - ध्वनि - कोलाहले भरिल भुवन ॥70॥
cc-antya-11.70.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu danced and chanted all around the platform, and as the holy name of Hari roared tumultuously, the whole universe became filled with the vibration.

devanagari: तबे महाप्रभु सब भक्त - गण - सङ्गे।
समुद्रे करिला स्नान - जल - केलि रङ्गे ॥71॥
cc-antya-11.71.translation: After saṅkīrtana, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu bathed in the sea with His devotees, swimming and playing in the water in great jubilation.

devanagari: हरिदासे प्रदक्षिण क रि’ आइल सिंह - द्वारे ।
हरि - कीर्तन - कोलाहल सकल नगरे ॥72॥
cc-antya-11.72.translation: After circumambulating the tomb of Haridāsa Ṭhākura, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to the Siṁha-dvāra gate of the Jagannātha temple. The whole city chanted in congregation, and the tumultuous sound vibrated all over the city.

devanagari: सिंह - द्वारे आ सि’ प्रभु पसारिर ठाङि।
आँचल पातिया प्रसाद मागिला तथाई ॥73॥
cc-antya-11.73.translation: Approaching the Siṁha-dvāra gate, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu spread His cloth and began to beg prasāda from all the shopkeepers there.

lines: prasāda māgiye bhikṣā deha' ta' āmāre'
devanagari: ‘हरिदास - ठाकुरेर महोत्सवेर तरे ।
प्रसाद मागिये भिक्षा देह’ त’ आमारे’ ॥74॥
cc-antya-11.74.translation: "I am begging prasāda for a festival honoring the passing away of Haridāsa Ṭhākura," the Lord said. "Please give Me alms."

lines: prasāda dite āse tārā ānandita hañā
devanagari: शुनिया पसारि सब चाङ्गड़ा उठाञा ।
प्रसाद दिते आसे तारा आनन्दित ह ञा ॥75॥
cc-antya-11.75.translation: Hearing this, all the shopkeepers immediately came forward with big baskets of prasāda, which they jubilantly delivered to Lord Caitanya.

devanagari: स्वरूप - गोसा ञि पसारिके निषेधिल ।
चाङ्गड़ा लञा पसारि पसारे वसिल ॥76॥
cc-antya-11.76.translation: However, Svarūpa Dāmodara stopped them, and the shopkeepers returned to their shops and sat down with their baskets.

lines: cāri vaiṣṇava, cāri pichāḍā saṅge rākhilā
devanagari: स्वरूप - गोसा ञि प्रभुरे घर पाठाइला ।
चारि वैष्णव, चारि पिछाड़ा सङ्गे राखिला ॥77॥
cc-antya-11.77.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara sent Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu back to His residence, and kept with him four Vaiṣṇavas and four servant carriers.

lines: eka eka dravyera eka eka puñjā deha' more
devanagari: स्वरूप - गोसा ञि कहिलेन सब पसारिरे ।
एक एक द्रव्येर एक एक पुञ्जा देह’ मोरे ॥78॥
cc-antya-11.78.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara said to all the shopkeepers, "Deliver to me four palmfuls of prasāda from each and every item."

lines: lañā āilā cāri janera mastake caḍāñā
devanagari: एइ - मते नाना प्रसाद बोझा बान्धा ञा ।
लञा आइला चारि जनेर मस्तके चड़ा ञा ॥79॥
cc-antya-11.79.translation: In this way varieties of prasāda were collected, then packed up in different loads and carried on the heads of the four servants.

lines: saba bhakta mili' more bhakti deha' dāna
devanagari: जय गौर - भक्त - गण, गौर याँर प्राण ।
सब भक्त मिलि’ मोरे भक्ति देह’ दान ॥8॥
cc-antya-11.8.translation: All glories to all the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, for the Lord is their life and soul. All of you, kindly bestow devotional service upon me.

devanagari: वाणीनाथ पट्टनायक प्रसाद आनिला ।
काशी - मिश्र अनेक प्रसाद पाठाइला ॥80॥
cc-antya-11.80.translation: Not only did Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī bring prasāda, but Vāṇīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka, as well as Kāśī Miśra, sent large quantities.

lines: saba vaiṣṇave prabhu vasāilā sāri sāri
āpane pariveśe prabhu lañā janā cāri
devanagari: सब वै ष्णवे प्रभु वसाइला सारि सारि ।
आपने परिवेशे प्रभु लञा जना चारि ॥81॥
cc-antya-11.81.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu made all the devotees sit in rows and personally began to distribute the prasāda, assisted by four other men.

lines: eka eka pāte pañca-janāra bhakṣya pariveśe
devanagari: महाप्रभुर श्री - हस्ते अल्प ना आइसे ।
एक - एक पाते पञ्च - जनार भक्ष्य परिवेशे ॥82॥
cc-antya-11.82.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was not accustomed to taking prasāda in small quantities. He therefore put on each plate what at least five men could eat.

devanagari: स्वरूप कहे , - “प्रभु, वसि’ करह दर्शन ।
आमि इँहा - सबा लञा करि परिवेशन ॥83॥
cc-antya-11.83.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī requested Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, "Please sit down and watch. With these men to help me, I shall distribute the prasāda."

devanagari: स्वरूप, जगदानन्द, काशीश्वर, शङ्कर ।
चारि - जन परिवेशन करे निरन्तर ॥84॥
cc-antya-11.84.translation: The four men-Svarūpa, Jagadānanda, Kāśīśvara and Śaṅkara-distributed the prasāda continuously.

lines: prabhu nā khāile keha nā kare bhojana
devanagari: प्रभु ना खाइले केह ना करे भोजन ।
प्रभुरे से दिने काशी - मिश्रेर निमन्त्रण ॥85॥
cc-antya-11.85.translation: All the devotees who sat down would not accept the prasāda as long as the Lord had not eaten. On that day, however, Kāśī Miśra had extended an invitation to the Lord.

devanagari: आपने काशी - मिश्र आइला प्रसाद ला ञा ।
प्रभुरे भिक्षा कराइला आग्रह करिया ॥86॥
cc-antya-11.86.translation: Therefore Kāśī Miśra personally went there and delivered prasāda to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu with great attention and made Him eat.

devanagari: पुरी - भारतीर सङ्गे प्रभु भिक्षा कैला ।
सकल वैष्णव तबे भोजन करिला ॥87॥
cc-antya-11.87.translation: With Paramānanda Purī and Brahmānanda Bhāratī, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sat down and accepted the prasāda. When He began to eat, so did all the Vaiṣṇavas.

lines: deha' deha' bali' prabhu balena vacana
devanagari: आकण्ठ पूराञा सबाय कराइला भोजन ।
देह’ देह’ बलि’ प्रभु बलेन वचन ॥88॥
cc-antya-11.88.translation: Everyone was filled up to the neck because Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu kept telling the distributors, "Give them more! Give them more!"

devanagari: भोजन करिया सबे कैला आचमन ।
सबारे पराइला प्रभु माल्य - चन्दन ॥89॥
cc-antya-11.89.translation: After all the devotees finished accepting prasāda and had washed their hands and mouths, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu decorated each of them with a flower garland and sandalwood pulp.

devanagari: जय रूप, सनातन, जीव, रघुनाथ।
रघुनाथ, गोपाल , - छय मोर नाथ ॥9॥
cc-antya-11.9.translation: All glories to Rūpa Gosvāmī, Sanātana Gosvāmī, Jīva Gosvāmī, Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī, Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī, and Gopāla Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī, the six Gosvāmīs of Vṛndāvana. They are all my masters.

devanagari: प्रेमाविष्ट हञा प्रभु करेन वर - दान ।
शुनि’ भक्त - गणेर जुड़ाय मनस्काम ॥90॥
cc-antya-11.90.translation: Overwhelmed with ecstatic love, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu offered a benediction to all the devotees, which all the devotees heard with great satisfaction.

lines: ye ihāṅ nṛtya kaila, ye kaila kīrtana
devanagari: हरिदासेर विजयोत्सव ये कैल दर्शन ।
ये इहाँ नृत्य कैल, ये कैल कीर्तन ॥91॥
cc-antya-11.91-93.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu gave this benediction: "Anyone who has seen the festival of Śrī Haridāsa Ṭhākura's passing away, anyone who has chanted and danced here, anyone who has offered sand on the body of Haridāsa Ṭhākura and anyone who has joined this festival to partake of the prasāda will achieve the favor of Kṛṣṇa very soon. There is such wonderful power in seeing Haridāsa Ṭhākura.

lines: kṛpā kari' kṛṣṇa more diyāchilā saṅga
devanagari: कृपा करि’ कृष्ण मोरे दियाछिला सङ्ग ।
स्वतन्त्र कृष्णेर इच्छा, कैला सङ्ग - भङ्ग ॥94॥
cc-antya-11.94.translation: "Being merciful upon Me, Kṛṣṇa gave Me the association of Haridāsa Ṭhākura. Being independent in His desires, He has now broken that association.

devanagari: हरिदासेर इच्छा यबे ह - इल चलिते ।
आमार शकति ताँरे नारिल राखिते ॥95॥
cc-antya-11.95.translation: "When Haridāsa Ṭhākura wanted to leave this material world, it was not within My power to detain him.

devanagari: इच्छा - मात्रे कैला निज - प्राण निष्क्रामण ।
पूर्वे येन शुनियाछि भीष्मेर मरण ॥96॥
cc-antya-11.96.translation: "Simply by his will, Haridāsa Ṭhākura could give up his life and go away, exactly like Bhīṣma, who previously died simply by his own desire, as we have heard from śāstra.

devanagari: हरिदास आछिल पृथिवीर शिरोमणि’ ।
ताहा विना रन - शून्या ह - इल मेदिनी ॥97॥
