cc-antya-11.97.translation: "Haridāsa Ṭhākura was the crown jewel on the head of this world; without him, this world is now bereft of its valuable jewel."

devanagari: ‘जय जय हरिदा स’ बलि’ कर हरि - ध्वनि” ।
एत बलि’ महाप्रभु नाचेन आपनि ॥98॥
cc-antya-11.98.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then told everyone, "Say 'All glories to Haridāsa Ṭhākura!' and chant the holy name of Hari." Saying this, He personally began to dance.

devanagari: सबे गाय , - “जय जय जय हरिदास ।
नामेर महिमा येह करिला प्रकाश” ॥99॥
cc-antya-11.99.translation: Everyone began to chant, "All glories to Haridāsa Ṭhākura, who revealed the importance of chanting the holy name of the Lord!"

devanagari: श्रूयतां श्रूयतां नित्यं गीयतां गीयतां मुदा ।
चिन्त्यतां चिन्त्यतां भक्ताश्चैतन्य - चरितामृतम् ॥1॥
cc-antya-12.1.translation: O devotees, may the transcendental life and characteristics of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu be always heard, chanted and meditated upon with great happiness.

devanagari: नित्यानन्द - प्रभुरे प्रद्यपि आज्ञा नाइ ।
तथापि देखिते चलेन चैतन्य - गोसाञि ॥10॥
cc-antya-12.10.translation: Because Nityānanda Prabhu was preaching in Bengal, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had ordered Him not to come to Jagannātha Purī. That year, however, He went with the rest of the party to see the Lord.

lines: sei sei bhakta sukhe āpanā pāsare
devanagari: जगदानन्द मिलिते याय येइ भक्त - घरे ।
सेइ सेइ भक्त सुखे आपना पासरे ॥100॥
cc-antya-12.100.translation: Whenever Jagadānanda Paṇḍita went to visit a devotee's house, that devotee immediately forgot himself in great happiness.

devanagari: चैतन्येर प्रेम - पात्र जगदानन्द धन्य ।
यारे मिले सेइ माने , - ‘पाइलुँ चैतन्य’ ॥101॥
cc-antya-12.101.translation: All glories to Jagadānanda Paṇḍita! He is so favored by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu that anyone who meets him thinks, "Now I have gotten the association of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu directly."

devanagari: शिवानन्द - सेन - गृहे याजा रहिला ।
‘चन्दनादि तैल ताहाँ एक - मात्रा कैला ॥102॥
cc-antya-12.102.translation: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita stayed at Śivānanda Sena's house for some time, and they prepared about sixteen seers of scented sandalwood oil.

devanagari: सुगन्धि करिया तैल गागरी भरिया ।
नीलाचले ल ञा आइला यतन करिया ॥103॥
cc-antya-12.103.translation: They filled a large earthen pot with the aromatic oil, and with great care Jagadānanda Paṇḍita brought it to Nīlācala, Jagannātha Purī.

devanagari: गोविन्देर ठाञि तैल धरिया राखिला ।
प्रभु - अङ्गे दिह’ तैल” गोविन्दे कहिला ॥104॥
cc-antya-12.104.translation: This oil was placed in the care of Govinda, and Jagadānanda requested him, "Please rub this oil on the body of the Lord."

devanagari: तबे प्रभु - ठाञि गोविन्द कैल निवेदन ।
‘जगदानन्द चन्दनादि - तैल आनियाछेन ॥105॥
cc-antya-12.105.translation: Govinda therefore told Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, "Jagadānanda Paṇḍita has brought some scented sandalwood oil.

devanagari: ताँर इच्छा , - प्रभु अल्प मस्तके लागाय ।
पित्त - वायु - व्याधि - प्रकोप शान्त ह ञा याय ॥106॥
cc-antya-12.106.translation: "It is his desire that Your Lordship apply a little of this oil on Your head so that blood pressure due to bile and air will be considerably diminished.

devanagari: एक - कलस सुगन्धि तैल गौड़ेते करिया ।
इहाँ आनियाछे बहु यतन करिया” ॥107॥
cc-antya-12.107.translation: "He prepared a large jug of it in Bengal, and with great care he has brought it here."

devanagari: प्रभु कहे,_“सन्यासीर नाहि तैले अधिकार ।
ताहाते सुगन्धि तैल, - परम धिक्का र! ॥108॥
cc-antya-12.108.translation: The Lord replied, "A sannyāsī has no use for oil, especially perfumed oil such as this. Take it out immediately."

devanagari: जगन्नाथे देह’ तैल, - दीप येन ज्वले ।
तार परिश्रम हैब परम - सफले” ॥109॥
cc-antya-12.109.translation: "Deliver this oil to the temple of Jagannātha, where it may be burned in the lamps. In this way, Jagadānanda's labor to manufacture the oil will be perfectly successful."

devanagari: श्रीवासादि चारि भाइ, सङ्गेते मालिनी ।
आचार्यरत्नेर सङ्गे ताँहार गृहिणी ॥11॥
cc-antya-12.11.translation: Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura was also there with his three brothers and his wife, Mālinī. Ācāryaratna was similarly accompanied by his wife.

lines: mauna kari' rahila paṇḍita, kichu nā kahila
devanagari: एइ कथा गोविन्द जगदानन्देरे कहिल ।
मौन क रि’ रहिल पण्डित, किछु ना कहिल ॥110॥
cc-antya-12.110.translation: When Govinda informed Jagadānanda Paṇḍita of this message, Jagadānanda remained silent, not saying even a word.

lines: dina daśa gele govinda jānāila āra-bāra
devanagari: दिन दश गेले गोविन्द जानाइल आर - बार ।
पण्डितेर इच्छा , - ‘तैल प्रभु करे अङ्गीकार’ ॥111॥
cc-antya-12.111.translation: When ten days had passed, Govinda again told Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, "It is the desire of Jagadānanda Paṇḍita that Your Lordship accept the oil."

lines: śuni' prabhu kahe kichu sakrodha vacana
devanagari: शुनि’ प्रभु कहे किछु सक्रोध वचन ।
मर्दनिया एक राख करिते मर्दन! ॥112॥
cc-antya-12.112.translation: When the Lord heard this, He angrily said, "Why not keep a masseur to massage Me?

lines: ei sukha lāgi' āmi kariluṅ sannyāsa!
devanagari: एइ सुख लागि’ आमि करि लुँ सन्यास! ।
आमार ‘सर्व - नाश’ - तोमा - सबार ‘परिहा स’ ॥113॥
cc-antya-12.113.translation: "Have I taken sannyāsa for such happiness? Accepting this oil would bring My ruination, and all of you would laugh.

lines: pathe yāite taila-gandha mora yei pābe
devanagari: पथे याइते तैल - गन्ध मोर येइ पाबे ।
‘दारी सन्यासी’ करि’ आमारे कहिबे ॥114॥
cc-antya-12.114.translation: "If someone passing on the road smelled this oil on My head, he would think Me a dārī sannyāsī, a tantric sannyāsī who keeps women."

lines: śuni prabhura vākya govinda mauna karilā
devanagari: शुनि प्रभुर वाक्य गोविन्द मौन करिला ।
प्रातः - काले जगदानन्द प्रभु - स्थाने आइला ॥115॥
cc-antya-12.115.translation: Hearing these words of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Govinda remained silent. The next morning, Jagadānanda went to see the Lord.

lines: prabhu kahe,—"paṇḍita, taila ānilā gauḍa ha-ite
āmi ta' sannyāsī,—taila nā pāri la-ite
devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - “पण्डित, तैल आनिला गौड़ ह - इते ।
आमि त’ सन्यासी , - तैल ना पारि ल - इते ॥116॥
cc-antya-12.116.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said to Jagadānanda Paṇḍita, "My dear Paṇḍita, you have brought Me some oil from Bengal, but since I am in the renounced order, I cannot accept it.

lines: jagannāthe deha' lañā dīpa yena jvale
devanagari: जगन्नाथे देह’ ला दीप येन ज्वले ।
तोमार सकल श्रम ह - इबे सफले” ॥117॥
cc-antya-12.117.translation: "Deliver the oil to the temple of Jagannātha so that it may be burned in the lamps. Thus your labor in preparing the oil will be fruitful."

lines: paṇḍita kahe,—'ke tomāre kahe mithyā vāṇī
āmi gauḍa haite taila kabhu nāhi āni'
devanagari: पण्डित कहे , - ‘के तोमारे कहे मिथ्या वाणी ।
आमि गौड़ हैते तैल कभु नाहि आनि’ ॥118॥
cc-antya-12.118.translation: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita replied, "Who tells You all these false stories? I never brought any oil from Bengal."

lines: eta bali' ghara haite taila-kalasa lañā
devanagari: एत बलि’ घर हैते तैल - कलस लञा ।
प्रभुर आगे आङ्गिनाते फेलिला भाङ्गिया ॥119॥
cc-antya-12.119.translation: After saying this, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita took the jug of oil from the room and threw it down before Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu in the courtyard and broke it.

devanagari: शिवानन्द - पत्नी चले तिन - पुत्र लञा ।
राघव - पण्डित चले झालि साजा ञा ॥12॥
cc-antya-12.12.translation: The wife of Śivānanda Sena also came, along with their three sons. Rāghava Paṇḍita joined them, carrying his famous bags of food.

lines: taila bhāṅgi' sei pathe nija-ghara giyā
devanagari: तैल भाङ्गि’ सेइ पथे निज - घर गिया ।
शुइया रहिला घरे कपाट खिलिया ॥120॥
cc-antya-12.120.translation: After breaking the jug, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita returned to his residence, bolted the door and lay down.

lines: tṛtīya divase prabhu tāṅra dvāre yāñā
devanagari: तृतीय दिवसे प्रभु ताँर द्वारे याञा ।
‘उठह’ पण्डित ‘ - करि’ कहेन डाकिया ॥121॥
cc-antya-12.121.translation: Three days later, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to the door of his room and said, "My dear Jagadānanda Paṇḍita, please get up.

devanagari: ‘आजि भिक्षा दिबा आमाय करिया रन्धने ।
मध्याह्ने आसिब, एबे याइ दरशने’ ॥122॥
cc-antya-12.122.translation: "I want you personally to cook My lunch today. I am going now to see the Lord in the temple. I shall return at noon."

lines: eta bali' prabhu gelā, paṇḍita uṭhilā
snāna kari' nānā vyañjana randhana karilā
devanagari: एत बलि’ प्रभु गेला, पण्डित उठिला ।
स्नान क रि’ नाना व्यञ्जन रन्धन करिला ॥123॥
cc-antya-12.123.translation: After Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said this and left, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita got up from his bed, bathed, and began to cook varieties of vegetables.

devanagari: मध्याह्न करिया प्रभु आइला भोजने ।
पाद प्रक्षालन क रि’ दिलेन आसने ॥124॥
cc-antya-12.124.translation: After finishing His noontime ritualistic duties, the Lord arrived for lunch. Jagadānanda Paṇḍita washed the Lord's feet and gave the Lord a sitting place.

lines: kalāra ḍoṅgā bhari' vyañjana caudike dharilā
devanagari: सघृत शाल्यन्न कला - पाते स्तूप कैला ।
कलार डोङ्गा भरि’ व्यञ्जन चौदिके धरिला ॥125॥
cc-antya-12.125.translation: He had cooked fine rice, mixed it with ghee and piled it high on a banana leaf. There were also varieties of vegetables, placed all around in pots made of banana tree bark.

devanagari: अन्न - व्यञ्जनोपरि तुलसी - मञ्जरी ।
जगन्नाथेर पिठा - पाना आगे आने ध रि’ ॥126॥
cc-antya-12.126.translation: On the rice and vegetables were tulasī flowers, and in front of the Lord were cakes, sweet rice and other prasāda of Jagannātha.

lines: tomāya āmāya āji ekatra kariba bhojana
devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - “द्वितीय - पाते बा ड़’ अन्न - व्यञ्जन ।
तोमाय आमाय आजि एकत्र करिब भोजनः ॥127॥
cc-antya-12.127.translation: The Lord said, "Spread another leaf with a helping of rice and vegetables so that today you and I may take lunch together."

lines: hasta tuli' rahena prabhu, nā karena bhojana
tabe paṇḍita kahena kichu saprema vacana
devanagari: हस्त तुलि’ रहेन प्रभु, ना करेन भोजन ।
तबे पण्डित कहेन किछु सप्रेम वचन ॥128॥
cc-antya-12.128.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu kept His hands raised and would not accept the prasāda until Jagadānanda Paṇḍita, with great affection and love, spoke the following words.

devanagari: “आपने प्रसाद लह, पाछे मुञि ल - इमु ।
तोमार आग्रह आमि केमने खण्डिमु?” ॥129॥
cc-antya-12.129.translation: "Please first take prasāda Yourself, and I shall eat later. I shall not refuse Your request."

lines: datta, gupta, vidyānidhi, āra yata jana
devanagari: दत्त, गुप्त, विद्यानिधि, आर यत जन ।
दुइ - तिन शत भक्त करिला गमन ॥13॥
cc-antya-12.13.translation: Vāsudeva Datta, Murāri Gupta, Vidyānidhi and many other devotees went to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. All together, they numbered two or three hundred.

devanagari: तबे महाप्रभु सुखे भोजने वसिला ।
व्यञ्जनेर स्वाद पाञा कहिते लागिला ॥130॥
cc-antya-12.130.translation: In great happiness, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then accepted the lunch. When He had tasted the vegetables, He again began to speak.

devanagari: “क्रोधावेशेर पाकेर हय ऐ छे स्वाद! ।
एइ त’ जानिये तोमाय कृष्णेर ‘प्रसाद’ ॥131॥
cc-antya-12.131.translation: "Even when you cook in an angry mood," He said, "the food is very tasteful. This shows how pleased Kṛṣṇa is with you.

lines: tomāra haste pāka karāya uttama kariyā
devanagari: आपने खाइबे कृष्ण, ताहार लागिया ।
तोमार हस्ते पाक कराय उत्तम करिया ॥132॥
cc-antya-12.132.translation: "Because He will personally eat the food, Kṛṣṇa makes you cook so nicely.

lines: tomāra bhāgyera sīmā ke kare varṇana?"
devanagari: ऐछे अमृत - अन्न कृष्णे कर समर्पण ।
तोमार भाग्येर सीमा के करे वर्णन ?” ॥133॥
cc-antya-12.133.translation: "You offer such nectarean rice to Kṛṣṇa. Who can estimate the limit of your fortune?"

devanagari: पण्डित कहे , - “ये खाइबे, सेइ पाक - कर्ता ।
आमि - सब - केवल - मात्र सामग्री - आहर्ता” ॥134॥
cc-antya-12.134.translation: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita replied, "He who will eat has cooked this. As far as I am concerned, I simply collect the ingredients."

lines: punaḥ punaḥ paṇḍita nānā vyañjana pariveśe
bhaye kichu nā balena prabhu, khāyena hariṣe
devanagari: पुनः पुनः पण्डित नाना व्यञ्जन परिवेशे ।
भये किछु ना बलेन प्रभु, खायेन हरिषे ॥135॥
cc-antya-12.135.translation: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita continued to offer the Lord varieties of vegetables. Out of fear, the Lord said nothing, but continued eating happily.

lines: āra dina haite bhojana haila daśa-guṇa
devanagari: आग्रह करिया पण्डित कराइला भोजन ।
आर दिन हैते भोजन हैल दश - गुण ॥136॥
cc-antya-12.136.translation: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita eagerly forced the Lord to eat so much that He ate ten times more than on other days.

devanagari: बार - बार प्रभु उठिते करेन मन ।
सेइ - काले पण्डित परिवेशे व्यञ्जन ॥137॥
cc-antya-12.137.translation: Again and again when the Lord wished to get up, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita would feed Him more vegetables.

lines: kichu balite nārena prabhu, khāyena tarāse
devanagari: किछु बलिते नारेन प्रभु, खायेन तरासे ।
ना खाइले जगदानन्द करिबे उपवासे ॥138॥
cc-antya-12.138.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu dared not forbid him to feed Him more. He just continued eating, fearful that Jagadānanda would fast if He stopped.

devanagari: तबे प्रभु कहेन करि’ विनय - सम्मान ।
‘दश - गुण खाओयाइला एबे कर समाधान’ ॥139॥
cc-antya-12.139.translation: At last the Lord respectfully submitted, "My dear Jagadānanda, you have already made Me eat ten times more than I am used to. Now, please stop."

lines: śacīmātā dekhi' sabe tāṅra ājñā lañā
devanagari: शचीमाता देखि सबे ताँर आज्ञा लञा ।
आनन्दे चलिला कृष्ण - कीर्तन करिया ॥14॥
cc-antya-12.14.translation: The devotees first saw Śacīmātā and took her permission. Then, in great happiness, they started for Jagannātha Purī, congregationally chanting the holy name of the Lord.

devanagari: तबे महाप्रभु उठि’ कैला आचमन ।
पण्डित आनिल, मुखवास, माल्य, चन्दन ॥140॥
cc-antya-12.140.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stood up and washed His hands and mouth, while Jagadānanda Paṇḍita brought spices, a garland, and sandalwood pulp.

lines: candanādi lañā prabhu vasilā sei sthāne
devanagari: चन्दनादि ल ञा प्रभु वसिला सेइ स्थाने ।
‘आमार आगे आजि तुमि करह भोजने’ ॥141॥
cc-antya-12.141.translation: Accepting the sandalwood pulp and garland, the Lord sat down and said, "Now, in front of Me, you must eat."

lines: mui, ebe la-iba prasāda kari' samādhāna
devanagari: पण्डित कहे , - “प्रभु याइ’ करुन विश्राम ।
मुइ, एबे ल - इब प्रसाद क रि’ समाधान ॥142॥
cc-antya-12.142.translation: Jagadānanda replied, "My Lord, You go take rest. I shall take prasāda after I finish making some arrangements.

lines: iṅhā sabāya dite cāhi kichu vyañjana-bhāta"
devanagari: रसुइर कार्य कैराछे रामाइ, रघुनाथ ।
इँहा सबाय दिते चाहि किछु व्यञ्जन - भात” ॥143॥
cc-antya-12.143.translation: "Rāmāi Paṇḍita and Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa did the cooking, and I want to give them some rice and vegetables."

devanagari: प्रभु कहेन, - “गोविन्द, तुमि इहाङि रहिबा ।
पण्डित भोजन कैले, आमारे कहिबा” ॥144॥
cc-antya-12.144.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then told Govinda, "You remain here. When the Paṇḍita has taken his food, come inform Me.

devanagari: एत कहि’ महाप्रभु करिला गमन ।
गोविन्देरे पण्डित किछु कहेन वचन ॥145॥
cc-antya-12.145.translation: After Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had said this and left, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita spoke to Govinda.

devanagari: तुमि शीघ्र याह करिते पाद - सम्वाहने ।
कहिह , - ‘पण्डित एबे वसिल भोजने’ ॥146॥
cc-antya-12.146.translation: "Go quickly and massage the Lord's feet," he said. "You may tell Him, 'The Paṇḍita has just sat down to take his meal.'

lines: prabhu nidrā gele, tumi khāiha āsiyā"
devanagari: तोमारे प्रभुर ‘शेष’ राखिमु धरिया ।
प्रभु निद्रा गेले, तुमि खाइह आसिया” ॥147॥
cc-antya-12.147.translation: "I shall keep some remnants of the Lord's food for you. When He is asleep, come and take your portion."

devanagari: रामाइ, नन्दाइ आर गोविन्द, रघुनाथ ।
सबारे बाँटिया दिला प्रभुर व्यञ्जन - भात ॥148॥
cc-antya-12.148.translation: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita thus distributed remnants of the Lord's food to Rāmāi, Nandāi, Govinda and Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa.

devanagari: आपने प्रभुर ‘शेष’ करिला भोजन ।
तबे गोविन्देरे प्रभु पाठाइला पुनः ॥149॥
cc-antya-12.149.translation: He also personally ate the remnants of food left by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Then the Lord again sent Govinda.

lines: sabāre pālana kari' sukhe lañā yāna
devanagari: शिवानन्द - सेन करे घाटी - समाधान ।
सबारे पालन क रि’ सुखे लञा यान ॥15॥
cc-antya-12.15.translation: Śivānanda Sena managed the payment of tolls at different places. Maintaining everyone, he guided all the devotees in great happiness.

devanagari: देख, - जगदानन्द प्रसाद पाय कि ना पाय ।
शीघ्र आ सि’ समाचार कहिबे आमा य” ॥150॥
cc-antya-12.150.translation: The Lord told him, "Go see whether Jagadānanda Paṇḍita is eating. Then quickly return and let Me know."

lines: govinda āsi' dekhi' kahila paṇḍitera bhojana
devanagari: गोविन्द आ सि’ देखि’ कहिल पण्डितेर भोजन ।
तबे महाप्रभु स्वस्त्ये करिल शयन ॥151॥
cc-antya-12.151.translation: Seeing that Jagadānanda Paṇḍita was indeed eating, Govinda informed the Lord, who then became peaceful and went to sleep.

devanagari: जगदान न्दे - प्रभुते प्रेम चले एइ - मते ।
सत्यभामा - कृष्णे यैछे शुनि भागवते ॥152॥
cc-antya-12.152.translation: The affectionate loving exchanges between Jagadānanda Paṇḍita and Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu continued in this manner, exactly like the exchanges between Satyabhāmā and Lord Kṛṣṇa related in Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam.

devanagari: जगदानन्देर सौभाग्येर के कहिबे सीमा ? ।
जगदानन्देर सौभाग्येर तेंह से उपमा ॥153॥
cc-antya-12.153.translation: Who can estimate the limit of Jagadānanda Paṇḍita's fortune? He himself is the example of his own great fortune.

devanagari: जगदानन्देर ‘प्रेम - विवर्त’ शुने येइ जन ।
प्रेमेर ‘स्वरूप’ जाने, पाय प्रेम - धन ॥154॥
cc-antya-12.154.translation: Anyone who hears about the loving exchanges between Jagadānanda Paṇḍita and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, or who reads Jagadānanda's book Prema-vivarta, can understand what love is. Moreover, he achieves ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: श्री - रूप - रघुनाथ - पदे यार आश ।
चैतन्य - चरितामृत कहे कृष्णदास ॥155॥
cc-antya-12.155.translation: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.

lines: sabāra saba kārya karena, dena vāsa-sthāna
devanagari: सबार सब कार्य करेन, देन वास - स्थान ।
शिवानन्द जाने उड़िया - पथेर सन्धान ॥16॥
cc-antya-12.16.translation: Śivānanda Sena took care of everyone and gave each devotee places to stay. He knew all the paths leading to Orissa.

devanagari: एक - दिन सब लोक घाटियाले राखिला ।
सबा छाड़ाञा शिवानन्द एकला रहिला ॥17॥
cc-antya-12.17.translation: One day when the party was being checked by a toll collector, the devotees were allowed to pass, and Śivānanda Sena remained behind alone to pay the taxes.

devanagari: सबे गिया रहिला ग्राम - भितर वृक्ष - तले ।
शिवानन्द विना वास - स्थान नाहि मिले ॥18॥
cc-antya-12.18.translation: The party went into a village and waited beneath a tree because no one but Śivānanda Sena could arrange for their residential quarters.

lines: śivānanda gāli pāḍe vāsā nā pāñā
devanagari: नित्यानन्द - प्रभु भोखे व्याकुल हञा ।
शिवानन्दे गालि पाड़े वासा ना पाञा ॥19॥
cc-antya-12.19.translation: Nityānanda Prabhu meanwhile became very hungry and upset. Because He had not yet obtained a suitable residence, He began calling Śivānanda Sena ill names.

devanagari: जय जय श्री - चैतन्य जय दयामय ।
जय जय नित्यानन्द कृपा - सिन्धु जय ॥2॥
cc-antya-12.2.translation: All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who is all-merciful! All glories to Nityānanda Prabhu, who is an ocean of mercy!

lines: 'tina putra maruka śivāra, ekhana nā āila
bhokhe mari' genu, more vāsā nā deoyāila'
devanagari: ‘तिन पुत्र मरुक शिवार, एखन ना आइल ।
भोखे म रि’ गेनु, मोरे वासा ना देओयाइ ल’ ॥20॥
cc-antya-12.20.translation: "Śivānanda Sena has not arranged for My residence," He complained, "and I am so hungry I could die. Because he has not come, I curse his three sons to die."

devanagari: शुनि’ शिवानन्देर पत्नी कान्दिते लागिला ।
हेन - काले शिवानन्द घाटी हैते आइला ॥21॥
cc-antya-12.21.translation: Hearing this curse, Śivānanda Sena's wife began to cry. Just then, Śivānanda returned from the toll station.

lines: 'putre śāpa dichena gosāñi vāsā nā pāñā'
devanagari: शिवानन्देर पत्नी ताँरे कहेन कान्दिया ।
‘पुत्रे शाप दिछेन गोसाञि वासा ना पा ञा’ ॥22॥
cc-antya-12.22.translation: Crying, his wife informed him, "Lord Nityānanda has cursed our sons to die because His quarters have not been provided."

lines: maruka āmāra tina putra tāṅra bālāi lañā"
devanagari: तेंहो कहे ,_“बाउलि, केने मरिस् कान्दिया? ।
मरुक आमार तिन पुत्र ताँर बालाइ लञा” ॥23॥
cc-antya-12.23.translation: Śivānanda Sena replied, "You crazy woman! Why are you needlessly crying? Let my three sons die for all the inconvenience we have caused Nityānanda Prabhu."

lines: uṭhi' tāṅre lāthi māilā prabhu nityānanda
devanagari: एत बलि’ प्रभु - पाशे गेला शिवानन्द ।
उठि’ ताँरे लाथि माइला प्रभु नित्यानन्द ॥24॥
cc-antya-12.24.translation: After saying this, Śivānanda Sena went to Nityānanda Prabhu, who then stood up and kicked him.

devanagari: आनन्दि त हैला शिवाइ पाद - प्रहार पा ञा ।
शीघ्र वासा - घर कैला गौड़ - घरे गिया ॥25॥
cc-antya-12.25.translation: Very pleased at being kicked, Śivānanda Sena quickly arranged for a milkman's house to be the Lord's residence.

lines: caraṇe dhariyā prabhure vāsāya lañā gelā
vāsā diyā hṛṣṭa hañā kahite lāgilā
devanagari: चरणे धरिया प्रभुरे वासाय लञा गेला ।
वासा दिया हृष्ट ह ञा कहिते लागिला ॥26॥
cc-antya-12.26.translation: Śivānanda Sena touched the lotus feet of Nityānanda Prabhu and led Him to His residence. After giving the Lord His quarters, Śivānanda Sena, being very pleased, spoke as follows.

lines: yemana aparādha bhṛtyera, yogya phala dilā
devanagari: “आजि मोरे भृत्य करि’ अङ्गीकार कैला ।
येमन अपराध भृत्येर, योग्य फल दिला ॥27॥
cc-antya-12.27.translation: "Today You have accepted me as Your servant and have properly punished me for my offense.

lines: trijagate tomāra caritra bujhe kon janā?
devanagari: ‘शास्ति’ - छले कृपा कर, - ए तोमार ‘करुणा’ ।
त्रिजगते तोमार चरित्र बुझे कोन् जना? ॥28॥
cc-antya-12.28.translation: "My dear Lord, Your chastising me is Your causeless mercy. Who within the three worlds can understand Your real character?

lines: hena caraṇa-sparśa pāila mora adhama tanu
devanagari: ब्रह्मार दुर्लभ तोमार श्री - चरण - रेणु ।
हेन चरण - स्पर्श पाइल मोर अधम तनु ॥29॥
cc-antya-12.29.translation: "The dust of Your lotus feet is not attainable even by Lord Brahmā, yet Your lotus feet have touched my wretched body.

devanagari: जयाद्वैत - चन्द्र जय करुणा - सागर ।
जय गौर - भक्त - गण कृपा - पूर्णान्तर ॥3॥
cc-antya-12.3.translation: All glories to Advaita Ācārya, who is also an ocean of mercy! All glories to all the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, whose hearts are always filled with mercy!

lines: āji mora saphala haila janma, kula, karma
āji pāinu kṛṣṇa-bhakti, artha, kāma, dharma"
devanagari: आजि मोर सफल हैल जन्म, कुल, कर्म ।
आजि पाइनु कृष्ण - भक्ति, अर्थ, काम, धर्म” ॥30॥
cc-antya-12.30.translation: "Today my birth, my family and my activities have all become successful. Today I have achieved the fulfillment of religious principles, economic development, satisfaction of the senses and ultimately devotional service to Lord Kṛṣṇa."

devanagari: शुनि’ नित्यानन्द - प्रभुर आनन्दित मन ।
उठि’ शिवानन्दे कैला प्रेम - आलिङ्गन ॥31॥
cc-antya-12.31.translation: When Lord Nityānanda heard this, He was very happy. He rose and embraced Śivānanda Sena in great love.

devanagari: आनन्दित शिवानन्द करे समाधान ।
आचार्यादि - वैष्णवेरे दिला वासा - स्थान ॥32॥
cc-antya-12.32.translation: Being very pleased by Nityānanda Prabhu's behavior, Śivānanda Sena began to arrange residential quarters for all the Vaiṣṇavas, headed by Advaita Ācārya.

lines: kruddha hañā lāthi māri' kare tāra hita
devanagari: नित्यानन्द - प्रभुर सब चरित्र - ’विपरीत’ ।
क्रुद्ध हञा लाथि मा रि’ करे तार हित ॥33॥
cc-antya-12.33.translation: One of Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu's characteristics is His contradictory nature. When He becomes angry and kicks someone, it is actually to his benefit.

devanagari: शिवानन्देर भागिना , - - श्रीकान्त - सेन नाम ।
मामार अगोचरे कहे क रि’ अभिमान ॥34॥
cc-antya-12.34.translation: Śivānanda Sena's nephew, Śrīkānta, the son of his sister, felt offended, and he commented on the matter when his uncle was absent.

devanagari: चैतन्येर पारिषद मोर मातुलेर ख्याति ।
‘ठाकुराली’ करेन गोसाञि, ताँरे मारे लाथि” ॥35॥
cc-antya-12.35.translation: "My uncle is well known as one of the associates of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, but Lord Nityānanda Prabhu asserts His superiority by kicking him."

lines: eta bali' śrīkānta, bālaka āge cali' yāna
saṅga chāḍi' āge gelā mahāprabhura sthāna
devanagari: एत बलि’ श्रीकान्त, बालक आगे चलि’ यान ।
सङ्ग छाड़ि’ आगे गेला महाप्रभुर स्थान ॥36॥
cc-antya-12.36.translation: After saying this, Śrīkānta, who was only a boy, left the group and traveled on alone to the residence of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: पेटाङ्गि - गाय करे दण्डवत् नमस्कार ।
गोविन्द कहे , - ‘श्रीकान्त, आगे पेटाङ्गि उतार’ ॥37॥
cc-antya-12.37.translation: When Śrīkānta offered obeisances to the Lord, he was still wearing his shirt and coat. Therefore Govinda told him, "My dear Śrīkānta, first take off these garments."

lines: kichu nā baliha, karuka, yāte ihāra sukha"
devanagari: प्रभु कहे,_“श्रीकान्त आसियाछे पाञा मनो - दुःख ।
किछु ना बलिह, करुक, ग्राते इहार सुख” ॥38॥
cc-antya-12.38.translation: As Govinda was warning Śrīkānta, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "Don't bother him. Let Śrīkānta do whatever he likes, for he has come here in a distressed state of mind."

lines: eke eke sabāra nāma śrīkānta jānāilā
devanagari: वैष्णवेर समाचार गोसाञि पुछिला ।
एके एके सबार नाम श्रीकान्त जानाइला ॥39॥
cc-antya-12.39.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu inquired from Śrīkānta about all the Vaiṣṇavas, and the boy informed the Lord about them, naming them one after another.

devanagari: अतःपर महाप्रभुर विषण्ण - अन्तर ।
कृष्णेर वियोग - दशा स्फुरे निरन्तर ॥4॥
cc-antya-12.4.translation: The mind of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was always morose because of a continuously manifested feeling of separation from Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: ‘दुःख पाञा आसियाछे’ - एइ प्रभुर वाक्य शुनि’।
जानिला ‘सर्वज्ञ प्रभु’ - एत अनुमानि’ ॥40॥
cc-antya-12.40.translation: When Śrīkānta Sena heard the Lord say, "He is distressed," he could understand that the Lord is omniscient.

devanagari: शिवानन्दे लाथि मारिला , - इहा ना कहिला ।
एथा सब वैष्णव - गण आसिया मिलिला ॥41॥
cc-antya-12.41.translation: As he described the Vaiṣṇavas, therefore, he did not mention Lord Nitya-nanda's kicking Śivānanda Sena. Meanwhile, all the devotees arrived and went to meet the Lord.

lines: strī-saba dūra ha-ite kailā prabhura daraśana
devanagari: पूर्ववत् प्रभु कैला सबार मिलन ।
स्त्री - सब दूर ह - इते कैला प्रभुर दरशन ॥42॥
cc-antya-12.42.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu received them all, just as He had in previous years. The women, however, saw the Lord from a distance.

devanagari: वासा - घर पूर्ववत् सबारे देओयाइला ।
महाप्रसाद - भोजने सबारे बोलाइला ॥43॥
cc-antya-12.43.translation: The Lord again arranged for the residential quarters of all the devotees and thereafter called them to partake of the remnants of food offered to Lord Jagannātha.

devanagari: शिवानन्द तिन - पुत्रे गोसाञि रे मिलाइला ।
शिवानन्द - सम्बन्धे सबाय बहु - कृपा कैला ॥44॥
cc-antya-12.44.translation: Śivānanda Sena introduced his three sons to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Because they were his sons, the Lord showed the boys great mercy.

devanagari: छोट - पुत्रे देखि’ प्रभु नाम पुछिला ।
‘परमानन्द - दास’ - नाम सेन जानाइला ॥45॥
cc-antya-12.45.translation: Lord Caitanya asked the youngest son's name, and Śivānanda Sena informed the Lord that his name was Paramānanda dāsa.

devanagari: पूर्वे यबे शिवानन्द प्रभु - स्थाने आइला ।
तबे महाप्रभु ताँरे कहिते लागिला ॥46॥
cc-antya-12.46-47.translation: Once before when Śivānanda Sena had visited Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu at His residence, the Lord had told him, "When this son is born, give him the name Purī dāsa."

lines: tabe māyera garbhe haya sei ta' kumāra
śivānanda ghare gele, janma haila tāra
devanagari: तबे मायेर ग र्भे हय सेइ त’ कुमार ।
शिवानन्द घरे गेले, जन्म हैल तार ॥48॥
cc-antya-12.48.translation: The son was in the womb of his wife, and when he returned home the son was born.

devanagari: प्रभु - आज्ञाय धरिला नाम ‘परमानन्द - दास’ ।
‘पुरी - दास’ करि’ प्रभु करेन उपहास ॥49॥
cc-antya-12.49.translation: The child was named Paramānanda dāsa in accordance with the Lord's order, and the Lord jokingly called him Purī dāsa.

devanagari: ‘हाहा कृष्ण प्राण - नाथ व्रजेन्द्र - नन्दन! ।
काहाँ याङ काहाँ पाङ, मुरली - वदन!’ ॥5॥
cc-antya-12.5.translation: The Lord would cry, "O My Lord Kṛṣṇa, My life and soul! O son of Mahārāja Nanda, where shall I go? Where shall I attain You? O Supreme Personality who plays with Your flute to Your mouth!"

devanagari: शिवानन्द यबे सेइ बालके मिलाइला ।
महाप्रभु पादाङ्गुष्ठ तार मुखे दिला ॥50॥
cc-antya-12.50.translation: When Śivānanda Sena introduced the child to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the Lord put His toe in the child's mouth.

devanagari: शिवानन्देर भाग्य - सिन्धु के पाइबे पार? ।
याँर सब गोष्ठी के प्रभु कहे ‘आपनार’ ॥51॥
cc-antya-12.51.translation: No one can cross over the ocean of Śivānanda Sena's good fortune, for the Lord considered Śivānanda's whole family His own.

lines: tabe saba bhakta lañā karilā bhojana
devanagari: तबे सब भक्त लञा करिला भोजन ।
गोविन्देरे आज्ञा दिला क रि’ आचमन ॥52॥
cc-antya-12.52.translation: The Lord ate lunch in the company of all the other devotees, and after washing His hands and mouth He gave an order to Govinda.

devanagari: शिवानन्देर ‘प्रकृति’, पुत्र - यावतेथाय ।
आमार अवशेष - पात्र तारा येन पाय” ॥53॥
cc-antya-12.53.translation: "As long as Śivānanda Sena's wife and children stay in Jagannātha Purī," He said, "they must be given the remnants of My food."

lines: modaka vece, prabhura vāṭīra nikaṭa tāra ghara
devanagari: नदीया - वासी मोदक, तार नाम ‘परमेश्वर’ ।
मोदक वेचे, प्रभुर वाटीर निकट तार घर ॥54॥
cc-antya-12.54.translation: There was a resident of Nadia named Parameśvara, who was a confectioner living near the home of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: bālaka-kāle prabhu tāra ghare bāra bāra yā'na
dugdha, khaṇḍa modaka deya, prabhu tāhā khā'na
devanagari: बालक - काले प्रभु तार घरे बार बार या’ न ।
दुग्ध, खण्ड मोदक देय, प्रभु ताहा खा’ न ॥55॥
cc-antya-12.55.translation: When the Lord was a boy, He would visit the house of Parameśvara Modaka again and again. The confectioner would supply the Lord milk and sweetmeats, and the Lord would eat them.

lines: se vatsara seha āila prabhure dekhite
devanagari: प्रभु - विषये स्नेह तार बालक - काल हैते ।
से वत्सर सेह आइल प्रभुरे देखिते ॥56॥
cc-antya-12.56.translation: Parameśvara Modaka had been affectionate toward the Lord since His childhood, and he was one of those who came that year to see the Lord at Jagannātha Purī.

lines: tāre dekhi' prabhu prīte tāhāre puchila
devanagari: ‘परमेश्वरा मुञि’ बलि’ दण्डवत् कैल।
तारे दे खि’ प्रभु प्रीते ताहारे पुछिल ॥57॥
cc-antya-12.57.translation: When he offered his obeisances to the Lord, he said, "I am the same Parameśvara." Upon seeing him, the Lord asked him questions with great affection.

devanagari: ‘परमेश्वर कुशल हओ, भाल हैल, आइला’ ।
‘मुकुन्दार माता आसियाछे’ सेह प्रभुरे कहिला ॥58॥
cc-antya-12.58.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "Parameśvara, may you be blessed. It is very good that you have come here." Parameśvara then informed the Lord, "Mukundāra Mātā has also come."

lines: mukundāra mātāra nāma śuni' prabhu saṅkoca hailā
tathāpi tāhāra prīte kichu nā balilā
devanagari: मुकुन्दार मातार नाम शुनि’ प्रभु सङ्कोच हैला ।
तथापि ताहार प्रीते किछु ना बलिला ॥59॥
cc-antya-12.59.translation: Hearing the name of Mukundāra Mātā, Lord Caitanya hesitated, but because of affection for Parameśvara, He did not say anything.

lines: rātri-dina ei daśā svasti nāhi mane
devanagari: रात्रि - दिन एइ दशा स्वस्ति नाहि मने ।
कष्टे रात्रि गोडाय स्वरूप - रामानन्द - सने ॥6॥
cc-antya-12.6.translation: This was His situation day and night. Unable to find peace of mind, He passed His nights with great difficulty in the company of Svarūpa Dāmodara and Rāmānanda Rāya.

lines: antare sukhī hailā prabhu tāra sei guṇe
devanagari: प्रश्रय - पागल शुद्ध - वैदग्धी ना जाने ।
अन्तरे सुखी हैला प्रभु तार सेइ गुणे ॥60॥
cc-antya-12.60.translation: An intimate relationship sometimes makes a person overstep formal etiquette. Thus Parameśvara actually pleased the Lord in His heart by his simple and affectionate behavior.

devanagari: पूर्ववत् सबा लञा गुण्डिचा - मार्जन ।
रथ - आगे पूर्ववत् करिला नर्तन ॥61॥
cc-antya-12.61.translation: All the devotees engaged in the cleansing ceremony of the Guṇḍicā temple and danced in front of the Ratha-yātrā chariot, just as they had done in the past.

devanagari: चातुर्मास्य सब यात्रा कैला दरशन ।
मालिनी - प्रभृति प्रभुरे कैला निमन्त्रण ॥62॥
cc-antya-12.62.translation: For four consecutive months, the devotees observed all the festivals. The wives, such as Mālinī, extended invitations for lunch to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: prabhura priya nānā dravya āniyāche deśa haite
sei vyañjana kari' bhikṣā dena ghara-bhāte
devanagari: प्रभुर प्रिय नाना द्रव्य आनियाछे देश हैते ।
सेइ व्यञ्जन क रि’ भिक्षा देन घर - भाते ॥63॥
cc-antya-12.63.translation: From Bengal the devotees had brought varieties of Bengali food that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu liked. They also cooked various grains and vegetables in their homes and offered them to the Lord.

lines: dine nānā krīḍā kare lañā bhakta-gaṇa
devanagari: दिने नाना क्रीड़ा करे लञा भक्त - गण ।
रात्र्ये कृष्ण - विच्छेदे प्रभु करेन रोदन ॥64॥
cc-antya-12.64.translation: During the day, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu engaged in various activities with His devotees, but at night He felt great separation from Kṛṣṇa and used to cry.

lines: gauḍa-deśe yāite tabe bhakte ājñā dila
devanagari: एइ - मत नाना - लीलाय चातुर्मास्य गेल ।
गौड़ - देशे याइते तबे भक्ते आज्ञा दिल ॥65॥
cc-antya-12.65.translation: In this way the Lord spent the four months of the rainy season in various pastimes, and then He ordered the Bengali devotees to return to their homes.

devanagari: सब भक्त करेन महाप्रभुर निमन्त्रण ।
सर्व - भक्ते कहेन प्रभु मधुर वचन ॥66॥
cc-antya-12.66.translation: All the devotees from Bengal would regularly invite Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu for lunch, and the Lord would speak to them in very sweet words.

devanagari: “प्रति - वर्षे आइस सबे आमारे देखिते ।
आसिते याइते दुःख पाओ बहु - मते ॥67॥
cc-antya-12.67.translation: "All of you come to see Me every year," the Lord said. "To come here and then return must certainly give you great trouble.

devanagari: तोमा - सबार दुःख जानि’ चाहि निषेधिते ।
तोमा - सबार सङ्ग - सुखे लोभ बाड़े चित्ते ॥68॥
cc-antya-12.68.translation: "I would like to forbid you to do this, but I enjoy your company so much that My desire for your association only increases.

lines: ājñā laṅghi' āilā, ki pāri balite?
devanagari: नित्यानन्दे आज्ञा दि लुँ गौड़ेते रहिते ।
आज्ञा लङ्घि’ आइला, कि पारि बलिते ? ॥69॥
cc-antya-12.69.translation: "I ordered Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu not to leave Bengal, but He has transgressed My order and come to see Me. What can I say?

devanagari: एथा गौड़ - देशे प्रभुर यत भक्त - गण ।
प्रभु देखिबारे सबे करिला गमन ॥7॥
cc-antya-12.7.translation: Meanwhile, all the devotees journeyed from their homes in Bengal to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: prema-ṛṇe baddha āmi, śudhite nā pāri
devanagari: आइलेन आचार्य - गोसाञि मोरे कृपा करि’ ।
प्रेम - ऋणे बद्ध आमि, शुधिते ना पारि ॥70॥
cc-antya-12.70.translation: "Out of His causeless mercy upon Me, Advaita Ācārya has also come here. I am indebted to Him for His affectionate behavior. This debt is impossible for Me to liquidate.

lines: nānā durgama patha laṅghi' āisena dhāñā
devanagari: मोर ला गि’ स्त्री - पुत्र गृहादि छाड़िया ।
नाना दुर्गम पथ लङ्घि’ आइसेन धा ञा ॥71॥
cc-antya-12.71.translation: "All My devotees come here just for Me. Leaving aside their homes and families, they travel by very difficult paths to come here in great haste.

lines: āmi ei nīlācale rahi ye vasiyā
pariśrama nāhi mora tomā sabāra lāgiyā
devanagari: आमि एइ नीलाचले रहि ये वसिया ।
परिश्रम नाहि मोर तोमा सबार लागिया ॥72॥
cc-antya-12.72.translation: "There is no fatigue or trouble for Me, for I stay here at Nīlācala, Jagannātha Purī, and do not move at all. This is the favor of all of you.

lines: sannyāsī mānuṣa mora, nāhi kona dhana
ki diyā tomāra ṛṇa karimu śodhana?
devanagari: सन्यासी मानुष मोर, नाहि कोन धन ।
कि दिया तोमार ऋण करिमु शोधन? ॥73॥
cc-antya-12.73.translation: "I am a mendicant and have no money. How can I clear My debt for the favor you have shown Me?

lines: tāhāṅ vikāi, yāhāṅ vecite tomāra mana"
devanagari: देह - मात्र धन तोमाय कैलुँ समर्पण ।
ताहाँ विकाइ, याहाँ वेचिते तोमार मन” ॥74॥
cc-antya-12.74.translation: "I have only this body, and therefore I surrender it unto you. Now, if you wish, you may sell it anywhere you like. It is your property."

devanagari: प्रभुर वचने सबार द्रवी - भूत मन ।
अझोर - नयने सबै करेन क्रन्दन ॥75॥
cc-antya-12.75.translation: When all the devotees heard these sweet words of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, their hearts melted, and they began to shed incessant tears.

lines: prabhu sabāra galā dhari' karena rodana
devanagari: प्रभु सबार गला धरि’ करेन रोदन ।
कान्दिते कान्दिते सबाय कैला आलिङ्गन ॥76॥
cc-antya-12.76.translation: Catching hold of His devotees, the Lord embraced them all and began to cry and cry.

devanagari: सबाइ रहिल, केह चलिते नारिल ।
आर दिन पाँच - सात एइ - मते गेल ॥77॥
cc-antya-12.77.translation: Unable to leave, everyone remained there, and five to seven more days thus passed by.

devanagari: अद्वैत अवधूत किछु कहे प्रभु - पाय ।
“सहजे तोमार गुणे जगत् विकाय ॥78॥
cc-antya-12.78.translation: Advaita Prabhu and Lord Nityānanda Prabhu submitted these words at the lotus feet of the Lord: "The entire world is naturally obligated to You for Your transcendental attributes.

lines: tomā chāḍi' kebā kāhāṅ yāibāre pāre?"
devanagari: आबार ताते बान्ध’ - ऐछे कृपा - वाक्य - डोरे ।
तोमा छा ड़ि’ केबा काहाँ याइबारे पारे ?” ॥79॥
cc-antya-12.79.translation: "Yet You bind Your devotees again with Your sweet words. Under these circumstances, who can go anywhere?"

lines: navadvīpe saba bhakta hailā eka ṭhāñi
devanagari: शिवानन्द - सेन आर आचार्य - गोसा ञि ।
नवद्वीपे सब भक्त हैला एक ठाञि ॥8॥
cc-antya-12.8.translation: Headed by Śivānanda Sena, Advaita Ācārya and others, all the devotees assembled in Navadvīpa.

devanagari: तबे प्रभु सबाकारे प्रबोध करिया ।
सबारे विदाय दिला सुस्थिर हञा ॥80॥
cc-antya-12.80.translation: Then Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu peacefully calmed them all and bade each of them farewell.

devanagari: नित्यानन्दे कहिला - “तुमि ना आसिह बार - बार ।
तथाइ आमार सङ्ग ह - इबे तोमार” ॥81॥
cc-antya-12.81.translation: The Lord specifically advised Nityānanda Prabhu, "You should not come here again and again. You will have My association in Bengal."

devanagari: चले सब भक्त - गण रोदन करिया ।
महाप्रभु रहिला घरे विषण्ण हञा ॥82॥
cc-antya-12.82.translation: The devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu began their journey crying, while the Lord remained morosely at His residence.

devanagari: निज - कृपा - गुणे प्रभु बान्धिला सबारे ।
महाप्रभुर कृपा - ऋण के शोधिते पारे ? ॥83॥
cc-antya-12.83.translation: The Lord bound everyone by His transcendental mercy. Who can repay his debt for the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu?

lines: yāre yaiche nācāya prabhu svatantra īśvara
tāte tāṅre chāḍi' loka yāya deśāntara
devanagari: यारे यैछे नाचाय प्रभु स्वतन्त्र ईश्वर ।
ताते ताँरे छाड़ि’ लोक याय देशान्तर ॥84॥
cc-antya-12.84.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is the fully independent Personality of Godhead and makes everyone dance as He likes. Leaving His company, therefore, all the devotees returned to their homes in different parts of the country.

devanagari: काष्ठेर पुतली येन कुहके नाचाय ।
ईश्वर - चरित्र किछु बुझन ना याय ॥85॥
cc-antya-12.85.translation: As a wooden doll dances to the will of a puppeteer, everything is accomplished by the will of the Lord. Who can understand the characteristics of the Supreme Personality of Godhead?

devanagari: पूर्व - वर्षे जगदानन्द ‛आइ’ देखिबारे ।
प्रभु - आज्ञा लञा आइला नदीया - नगरे ॥86॥
cc-antya-12.86.translation: The previous year, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita, following the Lord's order, had returned to the city of Nadia to see Śacīmātā.

devanagari: आइर चरण याइ’ करिला वन्दन ।
जगन्नाथेर वस्त्र - प्रसाद कैला निवेदन ॥87॥
cc-antya-12.87.translation: When he arrived, he offered prayers at her lotus feet and then offered her the cloth and prasāda of Lord Jagannātha.

devanagari: प्रभुर नामे मातारे दण्डवत् कैला ।
प्रभुर विनति - स्तुति मातारे कहिला ॥88॥
cc-antya-12.88.translation: He offered obeisances to Śacīmātā in the name of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu and informed her of all the Lord's submissive prayers to her.

lines: teṅho prabhura kathā kahe, śune rātri-dine
devanagari: जगदानन्दे पाञा माता आनन्दित मने ।
तेंहो प्रभुर कथा कहे, शुने रात्रि - दिने ॥89॥
cc-antya-12.89.translation: Jagadānanda's coming pleased mother Śacī very much. As he talked of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu, she listened day and night.

devanagari: कुलीन - ग्राम - वासी आर व्रत खण्ड - वासी ।
एकत्र मिलिला सब नवद्वीपे आ सि’ ॥9॥
cc-antya-12.9.translation: The inhabitants of Kulīna-grāma and Khaṇḍa village also assembled at Navadvīpa.

lines: tomāra ethā āsi' prabhu karena bhojane
devanagari: जगदानन्द कहे , - “माता, कोन कोन दिने ।
तोमार एथा आ सि’ प्रभु करेन भोजने ॥90॥
cc-antya-12.90.translation: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita said, "My dear mother, sometimes the Lord comes here and eats all the food you have offered.

devanagari: भोजन करिया कहे आनन्दित ह ञा ।
माता आजि खाओयाइला आकण्ठ पूरिया ॥91॥
cc-antya-12.91.translation: "After eating the food, the Lord says, 'Today, mother has fed Me up to My neck.

lines: āmi yāi' bhojana kari—mātā nāhi jāne
sākṣāte khāi āmi' teṅho 'svapna' hena māne"
devanagari: आमि याइ’ भोजन करि - माता नाहि जाने ।
साक्षाते खाइ आमि’ तेंहो ‘स्वप्न’ हेन माने” ॥92॥
cc-antya-12.92.translation: "I go there and eat the food My mother offers, but she cannot understand that I am eating it directly. She thinks that this is a dream.' "

lines: nimāñi ihāṅ khāya,—icchā haya mora mana
devanagari: माता कहे , - “कत रान्धि उत्तम व्यञ्जन ।
निमाञि इहाँ खाय , - इच्छा हय मोर मन ॥93॥
cc-antya-12.93.translation: Śacīmātā said, "I wish Nimāi would eat all the nice vegetables I cook. That is my desire.

devanagari: निमाञि खाञाछे, - ऐछे हय मोर मन ।
पाछे ज्ञान हय , - मुञि देखिनु ‘स्वपन’” ॥94॥
cc-antya-12.94.translation: "Sometimes I think that Nimāi has eaten them, but afterwards I think that I was only dreaming."

devanagari: एइ - मत जगदानन्द शचीमाता - सने ।
चैतन्येर सुख - कथा कहे रात्रि - दिने ॥95॥
cc-antya-12.95.translation: In this way, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita and mother Śacī talked day and night about the happiness of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: नदीयार भक्त - गणे सबारे मिलिला ।
जगदानन्दे पा ञा सबे आनन्दित हैला ॥96॥
cc-antya-12.96.translation: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita met all the other devotees in Nadia. They were all very happy to have him present.

devanagari: आचार्य मिलिते तबे गेला जगदानन्द ।
जगदानन्दे पा ञा हैल आचार्य आनन्द ॥97॥
cc-antya-12.97.translation: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita thereafter went to meet Advaita Ācārya, who also was very happy to have him.

lines: ānande rākhilā ghare, nā dena chāḍiyā
devanagari: वासुदेव, मुरारि - गुप्त जगदानन्दे पाञा ।
आनन्दे राखिला घरे, ना देन छाड़िया ॥98॥
cc-antya-12.98.translation: Vāsudeva Datta and Murāri Gupta were so pleased to see Jagadānanda Paṇḍita that they kept him at their homes and would not allow him to leave.

devanagari: चैतन्येर मर्म - कथा शुने ताँर मुखे ।
आपना पासरे सबे चैतन्य - कथा - सुखे ॥99॥
cc-antya-12.99.translation: They heard confidential narrations about Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu from the mouth of Jagadānanda Paṇḍita and forgot themselves in the great happiness of hearing about the Lord.

devanagari: कृष्ण - विच्छेद - जाता र्त्या क्षीणे चापि मनस्तनू ।
दधाते फुल्लतां भावैर्यस्य तं गौरमाश्रये ॥1॥
cc-antya-13.1.translation: Let me take shelter at the lotus feet of Lord Gauracandra. His mind became exhausted and His body very thin from the pain of separation from Kṛṣṇa, but when He felt ecstatic love for the Lord, He again became fully developed.

devanagari: शयनेर काले स्वरूप ताहाङि रहिला ।
तूली - बालिस दे खि’ प्रभु क्रोधाविष्ट ह - इला ॥10॥
cc-antya-13.10.translation: When it was time for the Lord to go to bed, Svarūpa Dāmodara stayed nearby, but when Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu saw the quilt and pillow, He was immediately very angry.

devanagari: एइ - मते रघुनाथ आइला नीलाचले ।
प्रभुर चरणे याञा मिलिला कुतूहले ॥100॥
cc-antya-13.100.translation: Traveling in this way, Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa soon arrived at Jagannātha Purī. There, with great delight, he met Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and fell at His lotus feet.

devanagari: दण्ड - परणाम क रि’ भट्ट पड़िला चरणे ।
प्रभु ‘रघुनाथ’ जानि कैला आलिङ्गने ॥101॥
cc-antya-13.101.translation: Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa fell straight as a rod at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Then the Lord embraced him, knowing well who he was.

devanagari: मिश्र आर शेखरेर दण्डवत् जानाइला ।
महाप्रभु ताँ - सबार वार्ता पुछिला ॥102॥
cc-antya-13.102.translation: Raghunātha offered respectful obeisances to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu on behalf of Tapana Miśra and Candraśekhara, and the Lord also inquired about them.

lines: āji āmāra ethā karibā prasāda bhojana"
devanagari: “भाल ह - इल आइला, देख‘कमल - लोचन’ ।
आजि आमार एथा करिबा प्रसाद भोजन” ॥103॥
cc-antya-13.103.translation: "It is very good that you have come here," the Lord said. "Now go see the lotus-eyed Lord Jagannātha. Today you will accept prasāda here at My place."

devanagari: गोविन्देरे कहि’ एक वासा देओयाइला ।
स्वरूपादि भक्त - गण - सने मिलाइला ॥104॥
cc-antya-13.104.translation: The Lord asked Govinda to arrange for Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa's accommodations and then introduced him to all the devotees, headed by Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī.

lines: dine dine prabhura kṛpāya bāḍaye ullāsa
devanagari: एइ - मत प्रभु - सङ्गे रहिला अष्ट - मास ।
दिने दिने प्रभुर कृपाय बाड़ये उल्लास ॥105॥
cc-antya-13.105.translation: Thus Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa lived with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu continuously for eight months, and by the Lord's mercy he felt increased transcendental happiness every day.

devanagari: मध्ये मध्ये महाप्रभुर करेन निमन्त्रण ।
घर - भात करेन, आर विविध व्यञ्जन ॥106॥
cc-antya-13.106.translation: He would periodically cook rice with various vegetables and invite Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to his home.

lines: yei rāndhe, sei haya amṛtera sama
devanagari: रघुनाथ - भट्ट - पाके अति सुनिपुण ।
येइ रान्धे, सेइ हय अमृतेर सम ॥107॥
cc-antya-13.107.translation: Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa was an expert cook. Whatever he prepared tasted just like nectar.

devanagari: परम सन्तोषे प्रभु करेन भोजन ।
प्रभुर अवशिष्ट - पात्र भट्टेर भक्षण ॥108॥
cc-antya-13.108.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would accept with great satisfaction all the food he prepared. After the Lord was satisfied, Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa would eat His remnants.

lines: mahāprabhu adhika tāṅre kṛpā nā karilā
devanagari: रामदास यदि प्रथम प्रभुरे मिलिला ।
महाप्रभु अधिक ताँरे कृपा ना करिला ॥109॥
cc-antya-13.109.translation: When Rāmadāsa Viśvāsa met Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the Lord did not show him any special mercy, although this was their first meeting.

lines: jagadānandera nāma śuni' saṅkoca haila mana
devanagari: गोविन्देरे पुछेन, ‘इहा कराइल को जन ?’ ।
जगदानन्देर नाम शुनि’ सङ्कोच हैल मन ॥11॥
cc-antya-13.11.translation: The Lord inquired from Govinda, "Who has made this?" When Govinda named Jagadānanda Paṇḍita, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was somewhat fearful.

devanagari: अन्तरे मुमुक्षु तेंहो, विद्या - गर्ववान् ।
सर्व - चित्त - ज्ञाता प्रभु - सर्वज्ञ भगवान् ॥110॥
cc-antya-13.110.translation: Within his heart, Rāmadāsa Viśvāsa was an impersonalist who desired to merge into the existence of the Lord, and he was very proud of his learning. Being the omniscient Supreme Personality of Godhead, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu can understand the heart of everyone, and thus He knew all these things.

devanagari: रामदास कैला तबे नीलाचले वास ।
पट्टनायक - गोष्ठीके पड़ाय’ काव्य - प्रकाश’ ॥111॥
cc-antya-13.111.translation: Rāmadāsa Viśvāsa then took up residence in Jagannātha Purī and taught the Kāvya-prakāśa to the Paṭṭanāyaka family [the descendants of Bhavānanda Rāya].

lines: aṣṭa-māsa rahi' prabhu bhaṭṭe vidāya dilā
devanagari: अष्ट - मास रहि’ प्रभु भट्ट विदाय दिला ।
‘विवाह ना करिह’ बलि’ निषेध करिला ॥112॥
cc-antya-13.112.translation: After eight months, when Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu bade farewell to Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa, the Lord flatly forbade him to marry. "Do not marry," the Lord said.

devanagari: वृद्ध माता - पितार याइ’ करह सेवन ।
वैष्णव - पाश भागवत कर अध्ययन ॥113॥
cc-antya-13.113.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said to Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa, "When you return home, serve your aged father and mother, who are devotees, and try to study Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam from a pure Vaiṣṇava who has realized God."

lines: eta bali' kaṇṭha-mālā dilā tāṅra gale
devanagari: पुनरपि एक - बार आसिह नीलाचले” ।
एत बलि’ कण्ठ - माला दिला ताँर गले ॥114॥
cc-antya-13.114.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu concluded, "Come again to Nīlācala [Jagannātha Purī]." After saying this, the Lord put His own neck beads on Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa's neck.

lines: āliṅgana kari' prabhu vidāya tāṅre dilā
preme gara gara bhaṭṭa kāndite lāgilā
devanagari: आलिङ्गन करि’ प्रभु विदाय ताँरे दिला ।
प्रेमे गर गर भट्ट कान्दिते लागिला ॥115॥
cc-antya-13.115.translation: Then the Lord embraced him and bade him farewell. Overwhelmed with ecstatic love, Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa began to cry due to imminent separation from Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: vārāṇasī āilā bhaṭṭa prabhura ājñā pāñā
devanagari: स्वरूप - आदि भक्त - ठाञि आज्ञा मागिया ।
वाराणसी आइला भट्ट प्रभुर आज्ञा पाञा ॥116॥
cc-antya-13.116.translation: After taking permission from Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and all the devotees, headed by Svarūpa Dāmodara, Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa returned to Vārāṇasī.

devanagari: चारि - वत्सर घरे पिता - मातार सेवा कैला ।
वैष्णव - पण्डित - ठाञि भागवत पड़िला ॥117॥
cc-antya-13.117.translation: In accordance with the instructions of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, he continuously rendered service to his mother and father for four years. He also regularly studied the Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam from a self-realized Vaiṣṇava.

lines: punaḥ prabhura ṭhāñi āilā gṛhādi chāḍiyā
devanagari: पिता - माता काशी पाइले उदासीन ह ञा ।
पुनः प्रभुर ठाञि आइला गृहादि छाड़िया ॥118॥
cc-antya-13.118.translation: Then his parents died at Kāśī [Vārāṇasī], and he became detached. He therefore returned to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, giving up all relationships with his home.

lines: aṣṭa-māsa rahi' punaḥ prabhu ājñā dilā
devanagari: पूर्ववत् अष्ट - मास प्रभु - पाश छिला ।
अष्ट - मास रहि’ पुनः प्रभु आज्ञा दिला ॥119॥
cc-antya-13.119.translation: As previously, Raghunātha remained continuously with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu for eight months. Then the Lord gave him the following order.

lines: govindere kahi' sei tūli dūra kailā
devanagari: गोविन्देरे कहि’ सेइ तूलि दूर कैला ।
कलार शरला - उपर शयन करिला ॥12॥
cc-antya-13.12.translation: After asking Govinda to put aside the quilt and pillow, the Lord lay down on the dry plantain bark.

devanagari: “आमार आज्ञाय, रघुनाथ, याह वृन्दावने ।
ताहाँ याञा रह रूप - सनातन - स्थाने ॥120॥
cc-antya-13.120.translation: "My dear Raghunātha, go to Vṛndāvana, following My instructions, and place yourself under the care of Rūpa and Sanātana Gosvāmīs.

devanagari: भागवत पड़, सदा लह कृष्ण - नाम ।
अचिरे करिबेन कृपा कृष्ण भगवान्” ॥121॥
cc-antya-13.121.translation: "In Vṛndāvana you should chant the Hare Kṛṣṇa mantra twenty-four hours a day and read Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam continuously. Kṛṣṇa, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, will very soon bestow His mercy upon you."

lines: eta bali' prabhu tāṅre āliṅgana kailā
devanagari: एत बलि’ प्रभु ताँरे आलिङ्गन कैला ।
प्रभुर कृपाते कृष्ण - प्रेमे मत्त हैला ॥122॥
cc-antya-13.122.translation: After saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu embraced Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa, and by the Lord's mercy Raghunātha was enlivened with ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: चौद्द - हात जगन्नाथेर तुलसीर माला ।
छुटा - पान - विड़ा महोत्सवे पाञाछिला ॥123॥
cc-antya-13.123.translation: At a festival Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had been given some unspiced betel and a garland of tulasī leaves fourteen cubits long. The garland had been worn by Lord Jagannātha.

lines: sei mālā, chuṭā pāna prabhu tāṅre dilā
devanagari: सेइ माला, छुटा पान प्रभु ताँरे दिला ।
‘इष्ट - देव’ करि’ माला धरिया राखिला ॥124॥
cc-antya-13.124.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu gave the garland and betel to Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa, who accepted them as a worshipable Deity, preserving them very carefully.

lines: prabhura ṭhāñi ājñā lañā gelā vṛndāvane
devanagari: प्रभुर ठाञि आज्ञा ल ञा गेला वृन्दावने ।
आश्रय करिला आ सि’ रूप - सनातने ॥125॥
cc-antya-13.125.translation: Taking permission from Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa then departed for Vṛndāvana. When he arrived there, he put himself under the care of Rūpa and Sanātana Gosvāmīs.

lines: bhāgavata paḍite preme āulāya tāṅra mana
devanagari: रूप - गोसाञि र सभाय करेन भागवत - पठन ।
भागवत पड़िते प्रेमे आउलाय ताँर मन ॥126॥
cc-antya-13.126.translation: When reciting Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam in the company of Rūpa and Sanātana, Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa would be overwhelmed with ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa.

lines: netra kaṇṭha rodhe bāṣpa, nā pāre paḍite
devanagari: अश्रु, कम्प, गद्गद प्रभुर कृपाते ।
नेत्र कण्ठ रोधे बाष्प, ना पारे पड़िते ॥127॥
cc-antya-13.127.translation: By the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, he experienced the symptoms of ecstatic love-tears, trembling, and faltering of the voice. His eyes filled with tears, his throat became choked, and thus he could not recite Śrīmad Bhāgavatam.

devanagari: पिक - स्वर - कण्ठ, ताते रागेर विभाग ।
एक - श्लोक पड़िते फिराय तिन - चारि राग ॥128॥
cc-antya-13.128.translation: His voice was as sweet as a cuckoo's, and he would recite each verse of Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam in three or four tunes. Thus his recitations were very sweet to hear.

lines: premete vihvala tabe, kichui nā jāne
devanagari: कृष्णेर सौन्दर्य - माधुर्य यबे पड़े, शुने ।
प्रेमेते विह्वल तबे, किछुइ ना जाने ॥129॥
cc-antya-13.129.translation: When he recited or heard about the beauty and sweetness of Kṛṣṇa, he would be overwhelmed with ecstatic love and become oblivious to everything.

lines: svarūpa kahe,—'tomāra icchā, ki kahite pāri?
śayyā upekṣile paṇḍita duḥkha pābe bhārī'
devanagari: स्वरूप कहे , - ‘तोमार इच्छा, कि कहिते पारि ? ।
शय्या उपेक्षिले पण्डित दुःख पाबे भारी’ ॥13॥
cc-antya-13.13.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara said to the Lord, "I cannot contradict Your supreme will, my Lord, but if You do not accept the bedding, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita will feel great unhappiness."

devanagari: गोविन्द - चरणे कैला आत्म - समर्पण ।
गोविन्द - चरणारविन्द - याँर प्राण - धन ॥130॥
cc-antya-13.130.translation: Thus Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa surrendered fully at the lotus feet of Lord Govinda, and those lotus feet became his life and soul.

lines: nija śiṣye kahi' govindera mandira karāilā
devanagari: निज शिष्ये कहि’ गोविन्देर मन्दिर कराइला ।
वंशी, मकर कुण्डलादि ‘भूषण’ करि’ दिला ॥131॥
cc-antya-13.131.translation: Subsequently Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa ordered his disciples to construct a temple for Govinda. He prepared various ornaments for Govinda, including a flute and earrings shaped like sharks.

lines: grāmya-vārtā nā śune, nā kahe jihvāya
devanagari: ग्राम्य - वार्ता ना शुने, ना कहे जिह्वाय ।
कृष्ण - कथा - पूजादिते अष्ट - प्रहर याय ॥132॥
cc-antya-13.132.translation: Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa would neither hear nor speak about anything of the material world. He would simply discuss Kṛṣṇa and worship the Lord day and night.

devanagari: वैष्णवेर निन्द्य - कर्म नाहि पाडे काणे ।
सबे कृष्ण भजन करे, - एइ - मात्र जाने ॥133॥
cc-antya-13.133.translation: He would not listen to blasphemy of a Vaiṣṇava, nor would he listen to talk of a Vaiṣṇava's misbehavior. He knew only that everyone was engaged in Kṛṣṇa's service; he did not understand anything else.

devanagari: महाप्रभुर दत्त माला मननेर काले ।
प्रसाद - कड़ार सह बान्धि लेन गले ॥134॥
cc-antya-13.134.translation: When Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī was absorbed in remembrance of Lord Kṛṣṇa, he would take the tulasī garland and the prasāda of Lord Jagannātha given to him by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, bind them together and wear them on his neck.

devanagari: महाप्र भुर कृपाय कृष्ण - प्रेम अनर्गल ।
एइ त’ कहिलुँ ताते चैतन्य - कृपा - फल ॥135॥
cc-antya-13.135.translation: Thus I have described the powerful mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, by which Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī remained constantly overwhelmed with ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: जगदानन्देर कहि लुँ वृन्दावन - गमन ।
तार मध्ये देव - दासीर गान - श्रवण ॥136॥
cc-antya-13.136-137.translation: In this chapter I have spoken about three topics: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita's visit to Vṛndāvana, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's listening to the song of the deva-dāsī at the temple of Jagannātha, and how Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī achieved ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa by the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: ye ei-sakala kathā śune śraddhā kari'
devanagari: ये एइ - सकल कथा शुने श्रद्धा करि’ ।
ताँरे कृष्ण - प्रेम - धन देन गौरहरि ॥138॥
cc-antya-13.138.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu [Gaurahari] bestows ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa upon anyone who hears all these topics with faith and love.

devanagari: श्री - रूप - रघुनाथ - पदे यार आश ।
चैतन्य - चरितामृत कहे कृष्णदास ॥139॥
cc-antya-13.139.translation: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.

devanagari: प्रभु कहेन, - “खाट एक आनह पाड़िते ।
जगदानन्द चाहे आमाय विषय भुञ्जाइते ॥14॥
cc-antya-13.14.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "You should bring a bedstead here for Me to lie on. Jagadānanda wants Me to enjoy material happiness.

devanagari: सन्यासी मानुष आमार भूमिते शयन ।
आमारे खाट - तूलि - बालिस मस्तक - मुण्डन” ॥15॥
cc-antya-13.15.translation: "I am in the renounced order, and therefore I must lie on the floor. For Me to use a bedstead, quilt or pillow would be very shameful."

devanagari: स्वरूप - गोसाञि आसि’ पण्डिते कहिला ।
शुनि’ जगदानन्द मने महा - दुःख पाइला ॥16॥
cc-antya-13.16.translation: When Svarūpa Dāmodara returned and related all these incidents, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita felt very unhappy.

devanagari: स्वरूप - गोसाञि तबे सृजिला प्रकार ।
कदलीर शुष्क - पत्र आनिला अपार ॥17॥
cc-antya-13.17.translation: Then Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī devised another method. First he secured a large quantity of dry banana leaves.

lines: nakhe ciri' ciri' tāhā ati sūkṣma kailā
prabhura bahirvāsa duite se saba bharilā
devanagari: नखे चि रि’ चिरि’ ताहा अति सूक्ष्म कैला ।
प्रभुर बहिर्वास दुइते से सब भरिला ॥18॥
cc-antya-13.18.translation: He then tore the leaves into very fine fibers with his nails and filled two of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's outer garments with the fibers.

devanagari: एइ - मत दुइ कैला ओड़न - पाड़ने ।
अङ्गीकार कैला प्रभु अनेक यतने ॥19॥
cc-antya-13.19.translation: In this way, Svarūpa Dāmodara made some bedding and a pillow, and after much endeavor by the devotees, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu accepted them.

devanagari: जय जय श्री - चैतन्य जय नित्यानन्द ।
जयाद्वैत - चन्द्र जय गौर - भक्त - वृन्द ॥2॥
cc-antya-13.2.translation: All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu! All glories to Nityānanda Prabhu! All glories to Advaita Ācārya! And all glories to the devotees of the Lord!

lines: tāte śayana karena prabhu,—dekhi' sabe sukhī
devanagari: ताते शयन करेन प्रभु, - देखि’ सबे सुखी ।
जगदानन्द - भितरे क्रोध बाहिरे महा - दुःखी ॥20॥
cc-antya-13.20.translation: Everyone was happy to see the Lord lie down on that bed, but Jagadānanda was inwardly angry, and externally he appeared very unhappy.

lines: prabhu ājñā nā dena tāṅre, nā pāre calite
devanagari: पूर्वे जगदानन्देर इच्छा वृन्दावन याइते ।
प्रभु आज्ञा ना देन ताँरे, ना पारे चलिते ॥21॥
cc-antya-13.21.translation: Formerly, when Jagadānanda Paṇḍita had desired to go to Vṛndāvana, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had not given His permission, and therefore he could not go.

devanagari: भितरेर क्रोध - दुख प्रकाश ना कैल ।
मथुरा याइते प्रभु - स्थाने आज्ञा मागिल ॥22॥
cc-antya-13.22.translation: Now, concealing his anger and unhappiness, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita again asked Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu for permission to go to Mathurā.

lines: prabhu kahe,—"mathurā yāibā āmāya krodha kari'
āmāya doṣa lāgāñā tumi ha-ibā bhikhāri"
devanagari: प्रभु कहे,_“मथुरा याइबा आमाय क्रोध क रि’ ।
आमाय दोष लागा ञा तुमि ह - इबा भिखारी” ॥23॥
cc-antya-13.23.translation: With great affection, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "If you are angry with Me when you go to Mathurā, you will merely become a beggar and criticize Me."

devanagari: जगदानन्द कहे प्रभुर धरिया चरण ।
पूर्व हैते इच्छा मोर याइते वृन्दावन ॥24॥
cc-antya-13.24.translation: Grasping the Lord's feet, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita then said, "For a long time I have desired to go to Vṛndāvana.

lines: prabhu-ājñā nāhi, tāte nā pāri yāite
ebe ājñā deha', avaśya yāimu niścite"
devanagari: प्रभु - आज्ञा नाहि, ताते ना पारि याइते ।
एबे आज्ञा देह’, अवश्य याइमु निश्चिते” ॥25॥
cc-antya-13.25.translation: "I could not go without Your Lordship's permission. Now You must give me permission, and I shall certainly go there."

lines: prabhu prīte tāṅra gamana nā karena aṅgīkāra
teṅho prabhura ṭhāñi ājñā māge bāra bāra
devanagari: प्रभु प्रीते ताँर गमन ना करेन अङ्गीकार ।
तेंहो प्रभुर ठाञि आज्ञा मागे बार बार ॥26॥
cc-antya-13.26.translation: Because of affection for Jagadānanda Paṇḍita, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would not permit him to depart, but Jagadānanda Paṇḍita repeatedly insisted that the Lord give him permission to go.

devanagari: स्वरूप - गोसाञि रे पण्डित कैला निवेदन ।
“पूर्व हैते वृन्दावन याइते मोर मन ॥27॥
cc-antya-13.27.translation: He then submitted a plea to Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī. "For a very long time," he said, "I have wanted to go to Vṛndāvana.

lines: prabhu-ājñā vinā tāhāṅ yāite nā pāri
ebe ājñā nā dena more, 'krodhe yāha' bali
devanagari: प्रभु - आज्ञा विना ताहाँ याइते ना पारि ।
एबे आज्ञा ना देन मोरे, ‘क्रोधे याह’ बलि ॥28॥
cc-antya-13.28.translation: "I cannot go there, however, without the Lord's permission, which at present He denies me. He says, 'You are going because you are angry at Me.'

lines: sahajei mora tāhāṅ yāite mana haya
devanagari: सहजेइ मोर ताहाँ याइते मन हय ।
प्रभु - आज्ञा लञा देह’, करिये विन य” ॥29॥
cc-antya-13.29.translation: "Naturally I have a desire to go to Vṛndāvana; therefore please humbly request Him to grant His permission."

devanagari: हेन - मते महाप्रभु जगदानन्द - सङ्गे ।
नाना - मते आस्वादय प्रेमेर तरङ्गे ॥3॥
cc-antya-13.3.translation: In the company of Jagadānanda Paṇḍita, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would taste various transcendental relationships of pure love.

devanagari: तबे स्वरूप - गोसाञि कहे प्रभुर चरणे ।
“जगदानन्देर इच्छा बड़ याइते वृन्दावने ॥30॥
cc-antya-13.30.translation: Thereafter, Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī submitted this appeal at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. "Jagadānanda Paṇḍita intensely desires to go to Vṛndāvana.

lines: tomāra ṭhāñi ājñā teṅho māge bāra bāra
devanagari: तोमार ठाञि आज्ञा तेंहो मागे बार बार ।
आज्ञा देह’, - मथुरा देखि’ आइसे एक - बार ॥31॥
cc-antya-13.31.translation: "He begs for Your permission again and again. Therefore, please permit him to go to Mathurā and then return.

devanagari: आइरे देखिते यैछे गौड़ - देशे याय ।
तैछे एक - बार वृन्दावन देखि’ आय” ॥32॥
cc-antya-13.32.translation: "You permitted him to go see mother Śacī in Bengal, and You may similarly permit him to go see Vṛndāvana and then return here."

devanagari: स्वरूप - गोसाञि र बोले प्रभु आज्ञा दिला ।
जगदानन्दे बोला ञा ताँरे शिखाइला ॥33॥
cc-antya-13.33.translation: At the request of Svarūpa Dāmodara, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu granted Jagadānanda Paṇḍita permission to go. The Lord sent for him and instructed him as follows.

devanagari: “वाराणसी पन्त स्वच्छन्दे याइबा पथे ।
आगे सावधाने याइबा क्षत्रियादि - साथे ॥34॥
cc-antya-13.34.translation: "You may go as far as Vārāṇasī without encountering disturbances, but beyond Vārāṇasī you should be very careful to travel on the path in the company of the kṣatriyas.

lines: saba luṭi' bāṅdhi' rākhe, yāite virodhe
devanagari: केवल गौड़िया पाइले ‘बाटपा ड़’ करि’ बान्धे ।
सब लुटि’ बाँधि’ राखे, याइते विरोधे ॥35॥
cc-antya-13.35.translation: "As soon as the plunderers on the road see a Bengali traveling alone, they take everything from him, arrest him and do not let him go.

devanagari: मथुरा गेले सनातन - सङ्गेइ रहिबा ।
मथुरार स्वामी सबेर चरण वन्दिबा ॥36॥
cc-antya-13.36.translation: "When you reach Mathurā, you should remain with Sanātana Gosvāmī and offer respectful obeisances to the feet of all the leading men there.

lines: dūre rahi' bhakti kariha saṅge nā rahibā
devanagari: दूरे रहि’ भक्ति करिह सङ्गे ना रहिबा ।
ताँ - सबार आचार - चेष्टा ल - इते नारिबा ॥37॥
cc-antya-13.37.translation: "Do not mix freely with the residents of Mathurā; show them respect from a distance. Because you are on a different platform of devotional service, you cannot adopt their behavior and practices.

devanagari: सनातन - सड़े करिह वन दरशन ।
सनातनेर सङ्ग ना छाड़िबा एक - क्षण ॥38॥
cc-antya-13.38.translation: "Visit all twelve forests of Vṛndāvana in the company of Sanātana Gosvāmī. Do not leave his association for even a moment.

lines: śīghra āsiha, tāhāṅ nā rahiha cira-kāla
devanagari: शीघ्र आसिह, ताहाँ ना रहिह चिर - काल ।
गोवर्धने ना चड़िह देखिते ‘गोपाल’ ॥39॥
cc-antya-13.39.translation: "You should remain in Vṛndāvana for only a short time and then return here as soon as possible. Also, do not climb Govardhana Hill to see the Gopāla Deity.

devanagari: कृष्ण - विच्छेदे दुःखे क्षीण मन - काय ।
भावावेशे प्रभु कभु प्रफुल्लित हय ॥4॥
cc-antya-13.4.translation: The unhappiness of separation from Kṛṣṇa exhausted the Lord's mind and reduced the structure of His body, but when He felt emotions of ecstatic love, He again became developed and healthy.

lines: āmāra tare eka-sthāna yena kare vṛndāvane"
devanagari: आमिह आसितेछि , - कहिह सनातने ।
आमार तरे एक - स्थान येन करे वृन्दावने” ॥40॥
cc-antya-13.40.translation: "Inform Sanātana Gosvāmī that I am coming to Vṛndāvana for a second time and that he should therefore arrange a place for Me to stay."

devanagari: एत बलि’ जगदानन्दे कैला आलिङ्गन ।
जगदानन्द चलिला प्रभुर वन्दिया चरण ॥41॥
cc-antya-13.41.translation: After saying this, the Lord embraced Jagadānanda Paṇḍita, who then worshiped the Lord's lotus feet and started for Vṛndāvana.

devanagari: सब भक्त - गण - ठाञि आज्ञा मागिला ।
वन - पथे चलि’ चलि’ वाराणसी आइला ॥42॥
cc-antya-13.42.translation: He took permission from all the devotees and then departed. Traveling on the forest path, he soon reached Vārāṇasī.

lines: tāṅra ṭhāñi prabhura kathā sakala-i śunilā
devanagari: तपन - मिश्र, चन्द्रशेखर , - दोंहारे मिलिला ।
ताँर ठाञि प्रभुर कथा सकल - इ शुनिला ॥43॥
cc-antya-13.43.translation: When he met Tapana Miśra and Candraśekhara in Vārāṇasī, they both heard from him about topics concerning Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: मथुराते आसि’ मिलिला सनातने ।
दुइ - जनेर सङ्गे पुँहे आनन्दित मने ॥44॥
cc-antya-13.44.translation: Finally Jagadānanda Paṇḍita reached Mathurā, where he met Sanātana Gosvāmī. They were very pleased to see each other.

lines: sanātana karāilā tāṅre dvādaśa vana daraśana
devanagari: सनातन कराइला ताँरे द्वादश वन दरशन ।
गोकुले रहिला दुँहे देखि’ महावन ॥45॥
cc-antya-13.45.translation: After Sanātana Gosvāmī had taken Jagadānanda to see all twelve forests of Vṛndāvana, concluding with Mahāvana, they both remained in Gokula.

devanagari: सनातनेर गोफाते दुँहे रहे एक - ठाञि ।
पण्डित पाक करेन देवालये याइ’ ॥46॥
cc-antya-13.46.translation: They stayed in Sanātana Gosvāmī's cave, but Jagadānanda Paṇḍita would go cook for himself at a nearby temple.

devanagari: सनातन भिक्षा करेन याइ’ महावने ।
कभु देवालये, कभु ब्राह्मण - सदने ॥47॥
cc-antya-13.47.translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī would beg alms from door to door in the vicinity of Mahāvana. Sometimes he would go to a temple and sometimes to a brāhmaṇa's house.

devanagari: सनातन पण्डितेर करे समाधान ।
महावने देन आ नि’ मागि’ अन्न - पान ॥48॥
cc-antya-13.48.translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī attended to all of Jagadānanda Paṇḍita's needs. He begged in the area of Mahāvana and brought Jagadānanda all kinds of things to eat and drink.

devanagari: एक - दिन सनातने पण्डित निमन्त्रिला ।
नित्य - कृत्य करि’ तेंह पाक चड़ाइला ॥49॥
cc-antya-13.49.translation: One day Jagadānanda Paṇḍita, having invited Sanātana to the nearby temple for lunch, finished his routine duties and began to cook.

lines: kalāra śaralāte, śayana, ati kṣīṇa kāya
śaralāte hāḍa lāge, vyathā haya gāya
devanagari: कलार शरलाते, शयन, अति क्षीण काय ।
शरलाते हाड़ लागे, व्यथा हय गाय ॥5॥
cc-antya-13.5.translation: Because He was very thin, when He lay down to rest on the dry bark of plantain trees, it caused Him pain in His bones.

devanagari: ‘मुकुन्द सरस्वती’ नाम सन्यासी महाजने ।
एक बहिर्वास तेंहो दिल सनातने ॥50॥
cc-antya-13.50.translation: Previously, a great sannyāsī named Mukunda Sarasvatī had given Sanātana Gosvāmī an outer garment.

devanagari: सनातन सेइ वस्त्र मस्तके बान्धिया ।
जगदानन्देर वासा - द्वारे वसिला आसिया ॥51॥
cc-antya-13.51.translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī was wearing this cloth bound about his head when he came to Jagadānanda Paṇḍita's door and sat down.

lines: rātula vastra dekhi' paṇḍita premāviṣṭa ha-ilā
devanagari: रातुल वस्त्र देखि’ पण्डित प्रेमाविष्ट ह - इला ।
‘महाप्रभुर प्रसाद’ जानि’ ताँहारे पुछिला ॥52॥
cc-antya-13.52.translation: Assuming the reddish cloth to be a gift from Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita was overwhelmed with ecstatic love. Thus he questioned Sanātana Gosvāmī.

devanagari: “काहाँ पाइला तुमि एइ रातुल वसन?” ।
‘मुकुन्द - सरस्वती’ दिल, - कहे सनातन ॥53॥
cc-antya-13.53.translation: "Where did you get that reddish cloth on your head?" Jagadānanda asked. Sanātana Gosvāmī replied, "Mukunda Sarasvatī gave it to me."

lines: bhātera hāṇḍi hāte lañā mārite āila
devanagari: शुनि’ पण्डितेर मने क्रोध उपजिल ।
भातेर हाण्डि हाते लञा मारिते आइल ॥54॥
cc-antya-13.54.translation: Hearing this, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita was immediately very angry and took a cooking pot in his hand, intending to beat Sanātana Gosvāmī.

lines: balite lāgilā paṇḍita hāṇḍi culāte dharilā
devanagari: सनातन ताँरे जानि’ लज्जित ह - इला ।
बलिते लागिला पण्डित हाण्डि चुलाते धरिला ॥55॥
cc-antya-13.55.translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī, however, knew Jagadānanda Paṇḍita very well and was consequently somewhat ashamed. Jagadānanda therefore left the cooking pot on the stove and spoke as follows.

devanagari: तुमि महाप्रभुर हओ पार्षद - प्रधान ।
तोमा - सम महाप्रभुर प्रिय नाहि आन ॥56॥
cc-antya-13.56.translation: "You are one of the chief associates of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Indeed, no one is dearer to Him than you.

lines: anya sannyāsīra vastra tumi dhara śire
devanagari: अन्य सन्यासीर वस्त्र तुमि धर शिरे ।
कोन् ऐछे हय , - इहा पारे सहिबारे ?” ॥57॥
cc-antya-13.57.translation: "Still, you have bound your head with a cloth given to you by another sannyāsī. Who can tolerate such behavior?"

devanagari: सनातन कहे _“साधु पण्डित - महाशय! ।
तोमा - सम चैतन्येर प्रिय केह नय ॥58॥
cc-antya-13.58.translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī said, "My dear Jagadānanda Paṇḍita, you are a greatly learned saint. No one is dearer to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu than you.

lines: tumi nā dekhāile ihā śikhiba ke-mate?
devanagari: ऐछे चैतन्य - निष्ठा योग्य तोमाते ।
तुमि ना देखाइले इहा शिखिब के - मते? ॥59॥
cc-antya-13.59.translation: "This faith in Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu fits you quite well. Unless you demonstrate it, how could I learn such faith?

devanagari: देखि’ सब भक्त - गण महा - दुख पाय ।
सहिते नारे जगदानन्द, सृजिला उपाय ॥6॥
cc-antya-13.6.translation: All the devotees felt very unhappy to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu in pain. Indeed, they could not tolerate it. Then Jagadānanda Paṇḍita devised a remedy.

lines: sei apūrva prema ei pratyakṣa dekhila
devanagari: याहा देखिबारे वस्त्र मस्तके बान्धिल ।
सेइ अपूर्व प्रेम एइ प्रत्यक्ष देखिल ॥60॥
cc-antya-13.60.translation: "My purpose in binding my head with the cloth has now been fulfilled because I have personally seen your uncommon love for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: kona pravāsīre dimu, ki kāya uhāya?
devanagari: रक्त - वस्त्र ‘वैष्णवेर’ परिते ना युयाय ।
कोन प्रवासीरे दिमु, कि काय उहाय ? ॥61॥
cc-antya-13.61.translation: "This saffron cloth is unfit for a Vaiṣṇava to wear; therefore I have no use for it. I shall give it to a stranger."

devanagari: पाक क रि’ जगदानन्द चैतन्ये समर्पिला ।
दुइ - जन व सि’ तबे प्रसाद पाइला ॥62॥
cc-antya-13.62.translation: When Jagadānanda Paṇḍita finished cooking, he offered the food to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Then he and Sanātana Gosvāmī sat down and ate the prasāda.

devanagari: प्रसाद पाइ अन्योन्ये कैला आलिङ्गन ।
चैतन्य विरहे दुँहे करिला क्रन्दन ॥63॥
cc-antya-13.63.translation: After eating the prasāda, they embraced each other and cried due to separation from Lord Caitanya.

devanagari: एइ - मत मास दुइ रहिला वृन्दावने ।
चैतन्य - विरह - दुःख ना याय सहने ॥64॥
cc-antya-13.64.translation: They passed two months in Vṛndāvana in this way. Finally they could no longer tolerate the unhappiness of separation from Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: महाप्रभुर सन्देश कहिला सनातने ।
‘आमिह आसितेछि, रहिते करिह एक - स्थाने’ ॥65॥
cc-antya-13.65.translation: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita therefore gave Sanātana Gosvāmī the message from the Lord: "I am also coming to Vṛndāvana; please arrange a place for Me to stay."

devanagari: जगदानन्द - पण्डित तबे आज्ञा मागिला ।
सनातन प्रभुरे किछु भेट - वस्तु दिला ॥66॥
cc-antya-13.66.translation: When Sanātana Gosvāmī granted permission for Jagadānanda to return to Jagannātha Purī, he gave Jagadānanda some gifts for Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: रास - स्थलीर वालु आर गोवर्धनेर शिला ।
शुष्क पक्क पीलु - फल आर गुञ्जा - माला ॥67॥
cc-antya-13.67.translation: The gifts consisted of some sand from the site of the rāsa-līlā, a stone from Govardhana Hill, dry ripened pīlu fruits and a garland of small conchshells.

lines: vyākula hailā sanātana tāṅre vidāya diyā
devanagari: जगदानन्द - पण्डित चलिला सब लञा ।
व्याकुल हैला सनातन ताँरे विदाय दिया ॥68॥
cc-antya-13.68.translation: Thus Jagadānanda Paṇḍita, bearing all these gifts, started on his journey. Sanātana Gosvāmī, however, was very agitated after bidding him farewell.

devanagari: प्रभुर निमित्त एक - स्थान मने विचारिल ।
द्वादशादित्य - टिलाय एक ‘मठ’ पाइल ॥69॥
cc-antya-13.69.translation: Soon afterward, Sanātana Gosvāmī selected a place where Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu could stay while in Vṛndāvana. It was a temple in the highlands named Dvādaśāditya-ṭilā.

lines: sūkṣma vastra āni' gaurika diyā rāṅgāilā
devanagari: सूक्ष्म वस्त्र आ नि’ गौरिक दिया राङ्गाइला ।
शिमुलीर तूला दिया ताहा पूराइला ॥7॥
cc-antya-13.7.translation: He acquired some fine cloth and colored it with red oxide. Then he filled it with cotton from a śimula tree.

lines: sei sthāna rākhilā gosāñi saṁskāra kariyā
maṭhera āge rākhilā eka chāuni bāndhiyā
devanagari: सेइ स्थान राखिला गोसाञि संस्कार करिया ।
मठेर आगे राखिला एक छाउनि बान्धिया ॥70॥
cc-antya-13.70.translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī kept the temple very clean and in good repair. In front of it he erected a small hut.

lines: bhakta saha gosāñi hailā parama ānanda
devanagari: शीघ्र चलि’ नीलाचले गेला जगदानन्द ।
भक्त सह गोसाञि हैला परम आनन्द ॥71॥
cc-antya-13.71.translation: Meanwhile, traveling very quickly, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita soon arrived in Jagannātha Purī, much to the joy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His devotees.

devanagari: प्रभुर चरण वन्दि’ सबारे मिलिला ।
महाप्रभु ताँरे दृढ़ आलिङ्गन कैला ॥72॥
cc-antya-13.72.translation: After offering prayers at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita greeted everyone. Then the Lord embraced Jagadānanda very strongly.

lines: rāsa-sthalīra dhūli ādi saba bheṭa dilā
devanagari: सनातनेर नामे पण्डित दण्डवत् कैला ।
रास - स्थलीर धूलि आदि सब भेट दिला ॥73॥
cc-antya-13.73.translation: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita also offered obeisances to the Lord on behalf of Sanātana Gosvāmī. Then he gave the Lord the dust from the site of the rāsa dance and the other gifts.

lines: saba dravya rākhilena, pīlu dilena bāṅṭiyā
devanagari: सब द्रव्य राखिलेन, पीलु दिलेन बाँटिया ।
‘वृन्दावनेर फल’ बलि’ खाइला हष्ट हञा ॥74॥
cc-antya-13.74.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu kept all the gifts except the pīlu fruits, which He distributed to the devotees. Because the fruits were from Vṛndāvana, everyone ate them with great happiness.

lines: ye keha jāne, āṅṭi cuṣite lāgila
ye nā jāne gauḍiyā pīlu cāvāñā khāila
devanagari: ये केह जाने, आँटि चुषिते लागिल ।
ये ना जाने गौड़िया पीलु चावाजा खाइल ॥75॥
cc-antya-13.75.translation: Those devotees who were familiar with pīlu fruits sucked on the seeds, but the Bengali devotees who did not know what they were chewed the seeds and swallowed them.

lines: mukhe tāra jhāla gela, jihvā kare jvālā
devanagari: मुखे तार झाल गेल, जिह्वा करे ज्वाला ।
वृन्दावनेर ‘पीलु’ खाइते एइ एक लीला ॥76॥
cc-antya-13.76.translation: The hot chili-like taste burned the tongues of those who chewed the seeds. The eating of pīlu fruits from Vṛndāvana was a pastime for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: जगदानन्देर आगमने सबार उल्लास ।
एइ - मते नीलाचले प्रभुर विलास ॥77॥
cc-antya-13.77.translation: When Jagadānanda Paṇḍita returned from Vṛndāvana, everyone was jubilant. Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu enjoyed His pastimes while residing at Jagannātha Purī.

devanagari: एक - दिन प्रभु यमेश्वर - टोटा याइते ।
सेइ - काले देव - दासी लागिला गाइते ॥78॥
cc-antya-13.78.translation: One day when the Lord was going to the temple of Yameśvara, a female singer began to sing in the Jagannātha temple.

devanagari: गुज्जरी - रागिणी ल ञा सुमधुर स्वरे ।
‘गीत - गोविन्द’ - पद गाय जग - मन हरे ॥79॥
cc-antya-13.79.translation: She sang a gujjarī tune in a very sweet voice, and because the subject was Jayadeva Gosvāmī's Gīta-govinda, the song attracted the attention of the entire world.

devanagari: एक तूली - बालिस गोविन्देर हाते दिला ।
‘प्रभुरे शोयाइह इहाय’ - ताहारे कहिला ॥8॥
cc-antya-13.8.translation: In this way he made a quilt and a pillow, which he then gave to Govinda, saying, "Ask the Lord to lie on this."

lines: dūre gāna śuni' prabhura ha-ila āveśa
strī, puruṣa, ke gāya,—nā jāne viśeṣa
devanagari: दूरे गान शुनि’ प्रभुर ह - इल आवेश ।
स्त्री, पुरुष, के गाय , - ना जाने विशेष ॥80॥
cc-antya-13.80.translation: Hearing the song from a distance, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu immediately became ecstatic. He did not know whether it was a man or a woman singing.

devanagari: तारे मिलिबारे प्रभु आवेशे धाइला ।
पथे ‘सिजेर बा ड़ि’ हय, फुटिया चलिला ॥81॥
cc-antya-13.81.translation: As the Lord ran in ecstasy to meet the singer, thorny hedges pricked His body.

lines: aṅge kāṅṭā lāgila, kichu nā jānila!
devanagari: अङ्गे काँटा लागिल, किछु ना जानिला! ।
आस्ते - व्यस्ते गोविन्द ताँर पाछेते धाइला ॥82॥
cc-antya-13.82.translation: Govinda ran very quickly behind the Lord, who did not feel any pain from the pricking of the thorns.

lines: dhāñā yāyena prabhu, strī āche alpa dūre
strī gāya' bali' govinda prabhure kailā kole
devanagari: धाञा यायेन प्रभु, स्त्री आछे अल्प दूरे ।
स्त्री गा य’ बलि’ गोविन्द प्रभुरे कैला कोले ॥83॥
cc-antya-13.83.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was running very rapidly, and the girl was only a short distance away. Just then Govinda caught the Lord in his arms and cried, "It is a woman singing!"

devanagari: स्त्री - नाम शुनि’ प्रभुर बाह्य ह - इला ।
पुनरपि सेइ पथे बाहुड़ि’ चलिला ॥84॥
cc-antya-13.84.translation: As soon as He heard the word "woman," the Lord became externally conscious and turned back.

devanagari: प्रभु कहे,_“गोविन्द, आजि राखिला जीवन ।
स्त्री - परश हैले आमार ह - इत मरण ॥85॥
cc-antya-13.85.translation: "My dear Govinda," He said, "you have saved My life. If I had touched the body of a woman, I would certainly have died.

lines: govinda kahe,—jagannātha rākhena mui kon chāra'?
devanagari: ए - ऋण शोधिते आमि नारिमु तोमार” ।
गोविन्द कहे , - जगन्नाथ राखेन मुइ को छार’? ॥86॥
cc-antya-13.86.translation: "I shall never be able to repay My debt to you." Govinda replied, "Lord Jagannātha has saved You. I am insignificant."

lines: yāhāṅ tāhāṅ mora rakṣāya sāvadhāna ha-ibā"
devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - “गोविन्द, मोर सङ्गे रहिबा ।
याहाँ ताहाँ मोर रक्षाय सावधान ह - इबा” ॥87॥
