cc-antya-13.87.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "My dear Govinda, you should stay with Me always. There is danger anywhere and everywhere; therefore you should protect Me very carefully."

lines: eta bali' leuṭi' prabhu gelā nija-sthāne
devanagari: एत बलि’ लेउटि’ प्रभु गेला निज - स्थाने ।
शुनि’ महा - भय ह - इल स्वरूपादि - मने ॥88॥
cc-antya-13.88.translation: After saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned home. When Svarūpa Gosvāmī and His other attendants heard about the incident, they were very afraid.

lines: prabhure dekhite calilā chāḍi' sarva kārya
devanagari: एथा तप न - मिश्र - पुत्र रघुनाथ - भट्टाचार्य ।
प्रभुरे देखिते चलिला छाड़ि’ सर्व कार्य ॥89॥
cc-antya-13.89.translation: During this time, Raghunātha Bhaṭṭācārya, the son of Tapana Miśra, gave up all his duties and left home, intending to meet Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: स्वरूप - गोसाञि के कहे जगदानन्द ।
‘आजि आपने या ञा प्रभुरे कराइह शयन’ ॥9॥
cc-antya-13.9.translation: Jagadānanda said to Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, "Today please personally persuade Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to lie down on the bed."

lines: kāśī haite calilā teṅho gauḍa-patha diyā
saṅge sevaka cale tāṅra jhāli vahiyā
devanagari: काशी हैते चलिला तेंहो गौड़ - पथ दिया ।
सङ्गे सेवक चले ताँर झालि वहिया ॥90॥
cc-antya-13.90.translation: Accompanied by one servant carrying his baggage, Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa started from Vārāṇasī and traveled along the path leading through Bengal.

devanagari: पथे तारे मिलिला विश्वास - रामदास ।
विश्वास - खानार कायस्थ तेंहो राजार विश्वास ॥91॥
cc-antya-13.91.translation: In Bengal he met Rāmadāsa Viśvāsa, who belonged to the kāyastha caste. He was one of the king's secretaries.

devanagari: सर्व - शास्त्रे प्रवीण, काव्य - प्रकाश - अध्यापक ।
परम - वैष्णव, रघुनाथ - उपासक ॥92॥
cc-antya-13.92.translation: Rāmadāsa Viśvāsa was very learned in all the revealed scriptures. He was a teacher of the famous book Kāvya-prakāśa and was known as an advanced devotee and worshiper of Raghunātha [Lord Rāmacandra].

devanagari: अष्ट - प्रहर राम - नाम जपेन रात्रि - दिने ।
सर्व त्यजि’ चलिला जगन्नाथ - दरशने ॥93॥
cc-antya-13.93.translation: Rāmadāsa had renounced everything and was going to see Lord Jagannātha. While traveling, he chanted the holy name of Lord Rāma twenty-four hours a day.

lines: bhaṭṭera jhāli māthe kari' vahiyā calilā
devanagari: रघुनाथ - भट्टेर सने पथेते मिलिला ।
भट्टेर झालि माथे क रि’ वहिया चलिला ॥94॥
cc-antya-13.94.translation: When he met Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa on the way, he took Raghunātha's baggage on his head and carried it.

devanagari: नाना सेवा क रि’ करे पाद - सम्वाहन ।
ताते रघुनाथेर हय सङ्कचित मन ॥95॥
cc-antya-13.95.translation: Rāmadāsa served Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa in various ways, even massaging his legs. Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa felt some hesitation in accepting all this service.

lines: sevā nā kariha, sukhe cala mora sāthe"
devanagari: “तुमि बड़ लोक, पण्डित, महा - भागवते ।
सेवा ना करिह, सुखे चल मोर साथे” ॥96॥
cc-antya-13.96.translation: "You are a respectable gentleman, a learned scholar and a great devotee," he said. "Please do not try to serve me. Just come with me in a happy mood."

devanagari: रामदास कहे , - ”आमि शूद्र अधम! ।
‘ब्राह्मणेर से वा’, - एइ मोर निज - धर्म ॥97॥
cc-antya-13.97.translation: Rāmadāsa replied, "I am a śūdra, a fallen soul. To serve a brāhmaṇa is my duty and religious principle.

lines: tomāra sevā karile haya hṛdaye ullāsa"
devanagari: सङ्कोच ना कर तुमि, आमि - तोमार ‘दास’ ।
तोमार सेवा करिले हय हृदये उल्लास” ॥98॥
cc-antya-13.98.translation: "Therefore please do not be hesitant. I am your servant, and when I serve you my heart becomes jubilant."

lines: eta bali' jhāli vahena, karena sevane
devanagari: एत बलि’ झालि वहेन, करेन सेवने ।
रघुनाथेर तारक - मन्त्र जपेन रात्रि - दिने ॥99॥
cc-antya-13.99.translation: Thus Rāmadāsa carried the baggage of Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa and served him sincerely. He constantly chanted the holy name of Lord Rāmacandra day and night.

devanagari: कृष्ण - विच्छेद - विभ्रान्त्या मनसा वपुषा धिया ।
यद् यद्व्यधत्त गौराङ्गस्तल्लेशः कथ्यतेऽधुना ॥1॥
cc-antya-14.1.translation: I shall now describe a very small portion of the activities performed by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu with His mind, intelligence and body when He was bewildered by strong feelings of separation from Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: स्वरूप - सूत्र - कर्ता’, रघुनाथ - ‘वृत्तिकार’ ।
तार बाहुल्य वर्णि - पाँजि - टीका - व्यवहार ॥10॥
cc-antya-14.10.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara wrote short codes, whereas Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī wrote elaborate descriptions. I shall now describe Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's activities more elaborately, as if fluffing out compressed cotton.

lines: śītala jale kare prabhura aṅga sammārjane
devanagari: उच्च सङ्कीर्तन करे प्रभुर श्रवणे ।
शीतल जले करे प्रभुर अङ्ग सम्मार्जने ॥100॥
cc-antya-14.100.translation: The devotees loudly chanted the Hare Kṛṣṇa mantra near Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and washed His body with cold water.

devanagari: एइ - मत बहु - बार कीर्तन करिते ।
‘हरि - बोल’ बलि’ प्रभु उठे आचम्बिते ॥101॥
cc-antya-14.101.translation: After the devotees had been chanting for a long time, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu suddenly stood up, shouting, "Hari bol!"

devanagari: सानन्दे सकल वैष्णव बले ‘हरि’ ‘हरि’ ।
उठिल मङ्गल - ध्वनि चतुर्दिक्भरि’ ॥102॥
cc-antya-14.102.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stood up, all the Vaiṣṇavas loudly chanted, "Hari! Hari!" in great jubilation. The auspicious sound filled the air in all directions.

lines: uṭhi' mahāprabhu vismita, iti uti cāya
ye dekhite cāya, tāhā dekhite nā pāya
devanagari: उठि’ महाप्रभु विस्मित, इति उति चाय ।
ये देखते चाय, ताहा देखिते ना पाय ॥103॥
cc-antya-14.103.translation: Astonished, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stood up and began looking here and there, trying to see something. But He could not catch sight of it.

devanagari: ‘वैष्णव’ देखिया प्रभुर अर्ध - बाह्य ह - इल ।
स्वरूप - गोसा ञिरे किछु कहिते लागिल ॥104॥
cc-antya-14.104.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu saw all the Vaiṣṇavas, He returned to partial external consciousness and spoke to Svarūpa Dāmodara.

lines: pāñā kṛṣṇera līlā dekhite nā pāila
devanagari: “गोवर्धन हैते मोरे के इहाँ आनिल ? ।
पाञा कृष्णेर लीला देखिते ना पाइल” ॥105॥
cc-antya-14.105.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "Who has brought Me here from Govardhana Hill? I was seeing Lord Kṛṣṇa's pastimes, but now I cannot see them.

lines: ihāṅ haite āji mui genu govardhane
devanagari: इहाँ हैते आजि मुइ गेनु गोवर्धने ।
देखों, यदि कृष्ण करेन गोधन - चारणे ॥106॥
cc-antya-14.106.translation: "Today I went from here to Govardhana Hill to find out if Kṛṣṇa were tending His cows there.

devanagari: गोवर्धने च ड़ि’ कृष्ण बाजाइला वेणु ।
गोवर्धनेर चौदिके चरे सब धेनु ॥107॥
cc-antya-14.107.translation: "I saw Lord Kṛṣṇa climbing Govardhana Hill and playing His flute, surrounded on all sides by grazing cows.

devanagari: वेणु - नाद शुनि’ आइला राधा - ठाकुराणी ।
सब सखी - गण - सड़े करिया साजनि ॥108॥
cc-antya-14.108.translation: "Hearing the vibration of Kṛṣṇa's flute, Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī and all Her gopī friends came there to meet Him. They were all very nicely dressed.

devanagari: राधा लञा कृष्ण प्रवेशिला कन्दराते ।
सखी - गण कहे मोरे फूल उठाइते ॥109॥
cc-antya-14.109.translation: "When Kṛṣṇa and Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī entered a cave together, the other gopīs asked Me to pick some flowers.

lines: tāte viśvāsa kari' śuna bhāvera varṇana
devanagari: ताते विश्वास क रि’ शुन भावेर वर्णन ।
ह - इबे भावेर ज्ञान, पाइबा प्रेम - धन ॥11॥
cc-antya-14.11.translation: Please hear faithfully this description of Caitanya Mahāprabhu's ecstatic emotions. Thus you will come to know of His ecstatic love, and ultimately you will achieve love of Godhead.

lines: tāhāṅ haite dhari' more ihāṅ lañā āilā
devanagari: हेन - काले तुमि - सब कोलाहल कैला ।
ताहाँ हैते ध रि’ मोरे इहाँ लञा आइला ॥110॥
cc-antya-14.110.translation: "Just then, all of you made a tumultuous sound and carried Me from there to this place.

lines: kene vā ānilā more vṛthā duḥkha dite
pāñā kṛṣṇera līlā, nā pāinu dekhite
devanagari: केने वा आनिला मोरे वृथा दुःख दिते ।
पाञा कृष्णेर लीला, ना पाइनु देखिते” ॥111॥
cc-antya-14.111.translation: "Why have you brought Me here, causing Me unnecessary pain? I had a chance to see Kṛṣṇa's pastimes, but I could not see them."

lines: tāṅra daśā dekhi' vaiṣṇava karena rodana
devanagari: एत बलि’ महाप्रभु करेन क्रन्दन ।
ताँर दशा दे खि’ वैष्णव करेन रोदन ॥112॥
cc-antya-14.112.translation: Saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu began to weep. When all the Vaiṣṇavas saw the Lord's condition, they also wept.

devanagari: हेन - काले आइला पुरी, भारती , - दुइ - जन ।
दुँहे देखि’ महाप्रभुर ह - इल सम्भ्रम ॥113॥
cc-antya-14.113.translation: At that time, Paramānanda Purī and Brahmānanda Bhāratī arrived. Seeing them, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu became somewhat respectful.

devanagari: निपट्ट - बाह्य ह - इले प्रभु दुँहारे वन्दिला ।
महाप्रभुरे दुइ - जन प्रेमालिङ्गन कैला ॥114॥
cc-antya-14.114.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to complete external consciousness and immediately offered prayers to them. Then these two elderly gentlemen both embraced the Lord with loving affection.

lines: prabhu kahe,—'duṅhe kene āilā eta dūre'?
devanagari: प्रभु कहे,‘दुँहे केने आइला एत दूरे’? ।
पुरी - गोसाञि कहे, - ‘तोमार नृत्य देखिबारे’ ॥115॥
cc-antya-14.115.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said to Purī Gosvāmī and Brahmānanda Bhāratī, "Why have you both come so far?" Purī Gosvāmī replied, "Just to see Your dancing."

devanagari: लज्जित ह - इला प्रभु पुरीर वचने ।
समुद्र - घाट आइला सब वैष्णव - सने ॥116॥
cc-antya-14.116.translation: When He heard this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was somewhat ashamed. Then He went to bathe in the sea with all the Vaiṣṇavas.

devanagari: स्नान क रि’ महाप्रभु घरेते आइला ।
सबा लञा महा - प्रसाद भोजन करिला ॥117॥
cc-antya-14.117.translation: After bathing in the sea, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to His residence with all the devotees. Then they all lunched on the remnants of food offered to Lord Jagannātha.

devanagari: एइ त’ कहिलुँ प्रभुर दिव्योन्माद - भाव ।
ब्रह्माओ कहिते नारे याहार प्रभाव ॥118॥
cc-antya-14.118.translation: Thus I have described the transcendental ecstatic emotions of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Even Lord Brahmā cannot describe their influence.

devanagari: ‘चटक’ - गिरि - गमन - लीला रघुनाथ - दास ।
‘गौराङ्ग - स्तव - कल्पवृक्षे’ करियाछेन प्रकाश ॥119॥
cc-antya-14.119.translation: In his book Gaurāṅga-stava-kalpavṛkṣa, Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī has very vividly described Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's pastime of running toward the Caṭaka-parvata sand dune.

lines: kṛṣṇa mathurāya gele, gopīra ye daśā haila
devanagari: कृष्ण मथुराय गेले, गोपीर ये दशा हैल ।
कृष्ण - विच्छेदे प्रभुर से दशा उपजिल ॥12॥
cc-antya-14.12.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu felt separation from Kṛṣṇa, His condition exactly corresponded to the condition of the gopīs in Vṛndāvana after Kṛṣṇa's departure for Mathurā.

lines: vrajann asmīty uktvā pramada iva dhāvann avadhṛto
gaṇaiḥ svair gaurāṅgo hṛdaya udayan māṁ madayati
devanagari: समीपे नीलाद्रेश्चटक - गिरि - राजस्य कलनाद् अये गोष्ठे गोवर्धन - गिरि - पतिं लोकितुमितः ।
व्रजन्नस्मीत्युक्त्वा प्रमद इव धावन्नवधृतो गणैः स्वै र्गौराङ्गड़ो हृदय उदयन्मां मदयति ॥120॥
cc-antya-14.120.translation: "Near Jagannātha Purī was a great sand dune known as Caṭaka-parvata. Seeing that hill, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, 'Oh, I shall go to the land of Vraja to see Govardhana Hill.' Then He began running madly toward it, and all the Vaiṣṇavas ran after Him. This scene awakens in my heart and maddens me."

lines: ke varṇite pāre sei mahāprabhura khelā?
devanagari: एबे प्रभु यत कैला अलौकिक - लीला ।
के वर्णिते पारे सेइ महाप्रभुर खेला? ॥121॥
cc-antya-14.121.translation: Who can properly describe all the uncommon pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu? They are all simply His play.

lines: yei ihā śune, pāya kṛṣṇera caraṇa
devanagari: सङ्क्षेपे कहिया करि दिक् दरशन ।
येइ इहा शुने, पाय कृष्णेर चरण ॥122॥
cc-antya-14.122.translation: I have briefly described them just to give an indication of His transcendental pastimes. Nevertheless, anyone who hears this will certainly attain the shelter of Lord Kṛṣṇa's lotus feet.

devanagari: श्री - रूप - रघुनाथ - पदे यार आश ।
चैतन्य - चरितामृत कहे कृष्णदास ॥123॥
cc-antya-14.123.translation: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.

lines: krame krame haila prabhura se unmāda-vilāpa
devanagari: उद्धव - दर्शने यैछे राधार विलाप ।
क्रमे क्रमे हैल प्रभुर से उन्माद - विलाप ॥13॥
cc-antya-14.13.translation: The lamentation of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī when Uddhava visited Vṛndāvana gradually became a feature of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's transcendental madness.

devanagari: राधिकार भावे प्रभुर सदा ‘अभिमा न’ ।
सेइ भावे आपनाके हय ‘राधा’ - ज्ञान ॥14॥
cc-antya-14.14.translation: Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's emotions after seeing Uddhava exactly correspond to those of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. He always conceived of Himself in Her position and sometimes thought that He was Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī Herself.

lines: divyonmāde aiche haya, ki ihā vismaya?
devanagari: दिव्योन्मादे ऐछे हय, कि इहा विस्मय ? ।
अधिरूढ़ - भावे दिव्योन्माद - प्रलाप हय ॥15॥
cc-antya-14.15.translation: Such is the state of transcendental madness. Why is it difficult to understand? When one is highly elevated in love of Kṛṣṇa, he becomes transcendentally mad and talks like a madman.

devanagari: एतस्य मोहनाख्यस्य
गतिं कामप्युपेयुषः
भ्रमाभा कापि वैचित्री
दिव्योन्माद इतीर्यते
उद्भूर्णा - चित्र - जल्पाद्यास्
तद्भेदा बहवो मताः ॥16॥
cc-antya-14.16.translation: "When the ecstatic emotion of enchantment gradually progresses, it becomes similar to bewilderment. Then one reaches the stage of astonishment [vaicitrī], which awakens transcendental madness. Udghūrṇā and citra-jalpa are two among the many divisions of transcendental madness."

devanagari: एक - दिन महाप्रभु करियाछेन शयन ।
कृष्ण रास - लीला करे , - देखिला स्वपन ॥17॥
cc-antya-14.17.translation: One day while He was resting, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu dreamed He saw Kṛṣṇa performing His rāsa dance.

devanagari: त्रिभङ्ग - सुन्दर - देह, मुरली - वदन ।
पीताम्बर, वन - माला, मदन मोहन ॥18॥
cc-antya-14.18.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu saw Lord Kṛṣṇa standing with His beautiful body curved in three places, holding His flute to His lips. Wearing yellow garments and garlands of forest flowers, He was enchanting even to Cupid.

devanagari: मण्डली - बन्धे गोपी - गण करेन नर्तन ।
मध्ये राधा - सह नाचे व्रजेन्द्र - नन्दन ॥19॥
cc-antya-14.19.translation: The gopīs were dancing in a circle, and in the middle of that circle, Kṛṣṇa, the son of Mahārāja Nanda, danced with Rādhārāṇī.

devanagari: जय जय श्री - चैतन्य स्वयं भगवान् ।
जय जय गौरचन्द्र भक्त - गण - प्राण ॥2॥
cc-antya-14.2.translation: All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the Supreme Personality of Godhead! All glories to Lord Gauracandra, the life and soul of His devotees.

lines: dekhi' prabhu sei rase āviṣṭa hailā
devanagari: देखि’ प्रभु सेइ रसे आविष्ट हैला ।
‘वृन्दावने कृष्ण पाइनु’ - एइ ज्ञान कैला ॥20॥
cc-antya-14.20.translation: Seeing this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was overwhelmed with the transcendental mellow of the rāsa dance, and He thought, "Now I am with Kṛṣṇa in Vṛndāvana."

devanagari: प्रभुर विलम्ब देखि’ गोविन्द जागाइला ।
जागिले ‘स्वप्न’ - ज्ञान हैल, प्रभु दुःखी हैला ॥21॥
cc-antya-14.21.translation: When Govinda saw that the Lord had not yet risen, he awakened Him. Understanding that He had only been dreaming, the Lord was somewhat unhappy.

devanagari: देहाभ्यासे नित्य - कृत्य करि’ समापन ।
काले याइ’ कैला जगन्नाथ दरशन ॥22॥
cc-antya-14.22.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu performed His customary daily duties, and at the usual time He went to see Lord Jagannātha in the temple.

lines: yāvat kāla darśana karena garuḍera pāche
prabhura āge darśana kare loka lākhe lākhe
devanagari: यावत् काल दर्शन करेन गरुड़ेर पाछे ।
प्रभुर आगे दर्शन करे लोक लाखे लाखे ॥23॥
cc-antya-14.23.translation: As He viewed Lord Jagannātha from behind the Garuḍa column, hundreds and thousands of people in front of Him were seeing the Deity.

lines: uḍiyā eka strī bhīḍe darśana nā pāñā
garuḍe caḍi' dekhe prabhura skandhe pada diyā
devanagari: उड़िया एक स्त्री भीड़े दर्शन ना पा ञा ।
गरुड़े च ड़ि’ देखे प्रभुर स्कन्धे पद दिया ॥24॥
cc-antya-14.24.translation: Suddenly, a woman from Orissa, unable to see Lord Jagannātha because of the crowd, climbed the column of Garuḍa, placing her foot on Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's shoulder.

devanagari: देखिया गोविन्द आस्ते - व्यस्ते स्त्रीके वर्जिला ।
तारे नामाइते प्रभु गोविन्दे निषेधिला ॥25॥
cc-antya-14.25.translation: When he saw this, Caitanya Mahāprabhu's personal secretary, Govinda, hastily got her down from her position. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, however, chastised him for this.

devanagari: ‘आदि - वस्या’ एइ स्त्रीरे ना कर वर्जन ।
करुक यथेष्ट जगन्नाथ दरशन ॥26॥
cc-antya-14.26.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said to Govinda, "O ādi-vasyā [uncivilized man], do not forbid this woman to climb the Garuḍa-stambha. Let her see Lord Jagannātha to her satisfaction."

devanagari: आस्ते - व्यस्ते से इ नारी भूमेते नामिला ।
महाप्रभुरे देखि’ ताँर चरण वन्दिला ॥27॥
cc-antya-14.27.translation: When the woman came to her senses, however, she quickly climbed back down to the ground and, seeing Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, immediately begged at His lotus feet for forgiveness.

lines: tāra ārti dekhi' prabhu kahite lāgilā
devanagari: तार आर्ति दे खि’ प्रभु कहिते लागिला ।
“एत आर्ति जगन्नाथ मोरे नाहि दिला! ॥28॥
cc-antya-14.28.translation: Seeing the woman's eagerness, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "Lord Jagannātha has not bestowed so much eagerness upon Me.

lines: mora skandhe pada diyāche, tāho nāhi jāne
devanagari: जगन्नाथे आविष्ट इहार तनु - मन - प्राणे ।
मोर स्कन्धे पद दियाछे, ताहो नाहि जाने ॥29॥
cc-antya-14.29.translation: "She has fully absorbed her body, mind and life in Lord Jagannātha. Therefore she was unaware that she was putting her foot on My shoulder.

devanagari: जय जय नित्यानन्द चैतन्य - जीवन ।
जयाद्वैताचार्य जय गौर - प्रियतम ॥3॥
cc-antya-14.3.translation: All glories to Lord Nityānanda, who is Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's very life. And all glories to Advaita Ācārya, who is extremely dear to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: aho bhāgyavatī ei, vandi ihāra pāya
ihāra prasāde aiche ārti āmāra vā haya"
devanagari: अहो भाग्यवती एइ, वन्दि इहार पाय ।
इहार प्रसादे ऐछे आर्ति आमार वा ह य” ॥30॥
cc-antya-14.30.translation: "Alas! How fortunate this woman is! I pray at her feet that she favor Me with her great eagerness to see Lord Jagannātha."

lines: pūrve āsi' yabe kailā jagannātha daraśana
devanagari: पूर्वे आसि’ यबे कैला जगन्नाथ दरशन ।
जगन्नाथे देखे - साक्षात् व्रजेन्द्र - नन्दन ॥31॥
cc-antya-14.31.translation: Just previously, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had been seeing Lord Jagannātha as the son of Mahārāja Nanda, Kṛṣṇa, in person.

devanagari: स्वप्नेर दर्शनावे शे तद्रूप हैल मन ।
याहाँ ताहाँ देखे सर्वत्र मुरली - वदन ॥32॥
cc-antya-14.32.translation: Becoming fully absorbed in that vision, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had assumed the mood of the gopīs, so much so that everywhere He looked He saw Kṛṣṇa standing with His flute to His lips.

lines: ebe yadi strīre dekhi' prabhura bāhya haila
devanagari: एबे यदि स्त्रीरे दे खि’ प्रभुर बाह्य हैल ।
जगन्नाथ - सुभद्रा - बलरामेर स्वरूप देखिल ॥33॥
cc-antya-14.33.translation: After seeing the woman, the Lord's external consciousness returned, and He saw the original Deity forms of Lord Jagannātha, Subhadrā and Lord Balarāma.

lines: kurukṣetre dekhi' kṛṣṇe aiche haila mana
devanagari: कुरुक्षेत्रे देखि’ कृष्णे ऐछे हैल मन ।
‘काहाँ कुरुक्षेत्रे आइलाङ, काहाँ वृन्दावन?’ ॥34॥
cc-antya-14.34.translation: When He saw the Deities, Lord Caitanya thought He was seeing Kṛṣṇa in Kurukṣetra. He wondered, "Have I come to Kurukṣetra? Where is Vṛndāvana?"

devanagari: प्राप्त - रत्न हारा ञा ऐछे व्यग्र ह - इला ।
विषण्ण ह ञा प्रभु निज - वासा आइला ॥35॥
cc-antya-14.35.translation: Lord Caitanya grew very agitated, like a person who has just lost a recently acquired jewel. Then He became very morose and returned home.

lines: bhūmira upara vasi' nija-nakhe bhūmi likhe
aśru-gaṅgā netre vahe, kichui nā dekhe
devanagari: भूमिर उपर वसि’ निज - नखे भूमि लिखे ।
अश्रु - गङ्गा नेत्रे वहे, किछुइ ना देखे ॥36॥
cc-antya-14.36.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sat down on the ground and began to mark it with His nails. He was blinded by tears, which flowed from His eyes like the Ganges.

lines: ke mora nileka kṛṣṇa? kāhāṅ mui āinu'?
devanagari: ‘पाइलुँ वृन्दावन - नाथ, पुनः हाराइलुँ ।
के मोर निलेक कृष्ण? काहाँ मुइ आइनु’? ॥37॥
cc-antya-14.37.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "I found Kṛṣṇa, the Lord of Vṛndāvana, but I have lost Him again. Who has taken My Kṛṣṇa? Where have I come?"

lines: svapnāveśe preme prabhura gara gara mana
devanagari: स्वप्नावेशे प्रेमे प्रभुर गर गर मन ।
बाह्य हैले हय - येन हाराइल धन ॥38॥
cc-antya-14.38.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu dreamed of the rāsa dance, He was fully absorbed in transcendental bliss, but when His dream broke, He thought He had lost a precious jewel.

devanagari: उन्मत्तेर प्राय प्रभु करेन गान - नृत्य ।
देहेर स्वभावे करेन स्नान - भोजन - कृत्य ॥39॥
cc-antya-14.39.translation: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would chant and dance, always absorbed in the bliss of transcendental madness. He carried out the necessities of the body, such as eating and bathing, merely out of habit.

devanagari: जय स्वरूप, श्रीवासादि प्रभु - भक्त - गण ।
शक्ति देह’ , - करि येन चैतन्य - वर्णन ॥4॥
cc-antya-14.4.translation: All glories to Svarūpa Dāmodara and the devotees, headed by Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura. Please give me the strength to describe the character of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: रात्रि हैले स्वरूप - रामानन्दे ल ञा ।
आपन मनेर भाव कहे उघाड़िया ॥40॥
cc-antya-14.40.translation: At night, Lord Caitanya would reveal to Svarūpa Dāmodara and Rāmānanda Rāya the ecstatic feelings of His mind.

devanagari: प्राप्त - प्रणष्टाच्युत - वित्त आत्मा ययौ विषादोज्झित - देह - गेहः ।
गृहीत - कापालिक - धर्मको मे वृन्दावनं सेन्द्रिय - शिष्य - वृन्दः ॥41॥
cc-antya-14.41.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "At first My mind somehow achieved the treasure of Kṛṣṇa, but it again lost Him. Therefore it gave up My body and home because of lamentation and accepted the religious principles of a kāpālika-yogī. Then My mind went to Vṛndāvana with its disciples, My senses."

lines: rāya-svarūpera kaṇṭha dhari', kahe 'hāhā hari hari',
devanagari: प्राप्त - रत्न हाराञा, तार गुण सडरिया,
महाप्रभु सन्तापे विह्वल ।
राय - स्वरूपेर कण्ठ ध रि’, कहे ‘हाहा हरि ह रि’,
धैर्य गेल, ह - इला चपल ॥42॥
cc-antya-14.42.translation: Having lost His acquired gem, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu became overwhelmed with lamentation by remembering its attributes. Then, grasping the necks of Rāmānanda Rāya and Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, He cried, "Alas, where is My Lord Hari? Where is Hari?" Finally He became restless and lost all patience.

lines: yāra lobhe mora mana, chāḍi' loka-veda-dharma,
devanagari: “शुन, बान्धव, कृष्णेर माधुरी
यार लोभे मोर मन, छाड़ि’ लोक - वेद - धर्म, ।
योगी ह ञा ह - इल भिखारी ॥43॥
cc-antya-14.43.translation: "My dear friends," He said, "please hear of Kṛṣṇa's sweetness. Because of a great desire for that sweetness, My mind has given up all social and Vedic religious principles and taken to the profession of begging, exactly like a mystic yogī.

lines: sei kuṇḍala kāṇe pari', tṛṣṇā-lāu-thālī dhari',
devanagari: कृष्ण - लीला - मण्डल, शुद्ध शङ्ख - कुण्डल
गड़ियाछे शुक कारिकर ।
सेइ कुण्डल काणे परि’, तृष्णा - लाउ - थाली ध रि’
आशा - झुलि कान्धेर उपर ॥44॥
cc-antya-14.44.translation: "The ring of Kṛṣṇa's rāsa-līlā, manufactured by Śukadeva Gosvāmī, the most auspicious craftsman, is as pure as an earring made from a conchshell. The yogī of My mind is wearing that earring upon his ear. From a gourd he has carved out the bowl of My aspirations, and he has taken the bag of My expectations on his shoulder.

lines: udvega dvādaśa hāte, lobhera jhulani māthe,
devanagari: चिन्ता - कान्था उढ़ि गाय, धूलि - विभूति - मलिन - काय
‘हाहा कृष्ण’ प्रलाप - उत्तर ।
उद्वेग द्वादश हाते, लोभेर झुलनि माथे
भिक्षाभावे क्षीण कलेवर ॥45॥
cc-antya-14.45.translation: "The yogī of My mind wears the torn quilt of anxiety on his dirty body, which is covered with dust and ashes. His only words are,'Alas! Kṛṣṇa!' He wears twelve bangles of distress on his wrist and a turban of greed on his head. Because he has not eaten anything, he is very thin.

lines: vyāsa, śukādi yogi-gaṇa, kṛṣṇa ātmā nirañjana,
devanagari: व्यास, शुकादि योगि - गण, कृष्ण आत्मा निरञ्जन,
व्रजे ताँर यत लीला - गण ।
भागवतादि शास्त्र - गणे, करियाछे वर्णने ,
सेइ तर्जा पड़े अनुक्षण ॥46॥
cc-antya-14.46.translation: "The great yogī of My mind always studies the poetry and discussions of Lord Kṛṣṇa's Vṛndāvana pastimes. In the Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam and other scriptures, great saintly yogīs like Vyāsadeva and Śukadeva Gosvāmī have described Lord Kṛṣṇa as the Supersoul, beyond all material contamination.

devanagari: दशेन्द्रिये शिष्य क रि’, ‘महा - बाउल’ नाम ध रि’
शिष्य लञा करिल गमन ।
मोर देह स्व - सदन, विषय - भोग महा - धन
सब छा ड़ि’ गेला वृन्दावन ॥47॥
cc-antya-14.47.translation: "The mystic yogī of My mind has assumed the name Mahābāula and made disciples of My ten senses. Thus My mind has gone to Vṛndāvana, leaving aside the home of My body and the great treasure of material enjoyment.

devanagari: वृन्दावने प्रजा - गण, यत स्थावर - जङ्गम
वृक्ष - लता गृहस्थ - आश्रमे ।
तार घरे भिक्षाटन, फल - मूल - पत्राशन
एइ वृत्ति करे शिष्य - सने ॥48॥
cc-antya-14.48.translation: "In Vṛndāvana, he goes from door to door begging alms with all his disciples. He begs from both the moving and the inert inhabitants—the citizens, the trees and the creepers. In this way he lives on fruits, roots and leaves.

devanagari: कृष्ण - गुण - रूप - रस, गन्ध, शब्द, परश,
से सुधा आस्वादे गोपी - गण ।
ता - सबार ग्रास - शेषे, आनि’ पञ्चेन्द्रिय शिष्ये ,
से भिक्षाय राखेन जीवन ॥49॥
cc-antya-14.49.translation: "The gopīs of Vrajabhūmi always taste the nectar of Kṛṣṇa's attributes, His beauty, His sweetness, His aroma, the sound of His flute and the touch of His body. My mind's five disciples, the senses of perception, gather the remnants of that nectar from the gopīs and bring them to the yogī of My mind. The senses maintain their lives by eating those remnants.

lines: bujhite nā pāre keha, yadyapi haya 'dhīra'
devanagari: प्रभुर विरहोन्माद - भाव गम्भीर ।
बुझिते ना पारे केह, यद्यपि ह य’ धीर’ ॥5॥
cc-antya-14.5.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's emotion of transcendental madness of separation from Kṛṣṇa is very deep and mysterious. Even though one is very advanced and learned, he cannot understand it.

lines: kṛṣṇa ātmā nirañjana, sākṣāt dekhite mana,
devanagari: शून्य - कुञ्ज - मण्डप - कोणे, योगाभ्यास कृष्ण - ध्याने
ताहाँ रहे लञा शिष्य - गण ।
कृष्ण आत्मा निरञ्जन, साक्षात् देखिते मन
ध्याने रात्रि करे जागरण ॥50॥
cc-antya-14.50.translation: "There is a solitary garden where Kṛṣṇa enjoys His pastimes, and in one corner of a pavilion in that garden, the yogī of My mind, along with his disciples, practices mystic yoga. Wanting to see Kṛṣṇa directly, this yogī remains awake throughout the night, meditating on Kṛṣṇa who is the Supersoul, uncontaminated by the three modes of nature.

lines: mana kṛṣṇa-viyogī, duḥkhe mana haila yogī,
se daśāya vyākula hañā, mana gela palāñā,
devanagari: मन कृष्ण - वियोगी, दुःखे मन हैल योगी
से वियोगे दश दशा हय ।
से दशाय व्याकुल हञा, मन गेल पला ञा
शून्य मोर शरीर आल य” ॥51॥
cc-antya-14.51.translation: "When My mind lost the association of Kṛṣṇa and could no longer see Him, he became depressed and took up mystic yoga. In the void of separation from Kṛṣṇa, he experienced ten transcendental transformations. Agitated by these transformations, My mind fled, leaving My body, his place of residence, empty. Thus I am completely in trance."

lines: kṛṣṇera viyoge gopīra daśa daśā haya
sei daśa daśā haya prabhura udaya
devanagari: कृष्णेर वियोगे गोपीर दश दशा हय ।
सेइ दश दशा हय प्रभुर उदय ॥52॥
cc-antya-14.52.translation: When the gopīs felt separation from Kṛṣṇa, they experienced ten kinds of bodily transformations. These same symptoms appeared on the body of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: चिन्तात्र जागरोद्वेगौ तानवं मलिनाङ्गता ।
प्रलापो व्याधिरुन्मादो मोहो मृत्युर्दशा दश ॥53॥
cc-antya-14.53.translation: "The ten bodily transformations resulting from separation from Kṛṣṇa are anxiety, wakefulness, mental agitation, thinness, uncleanliness, talking like a madman, disease, madness, illusion and death."

lines: kabhu kona daśā uṭhe, sthira nahe mane
devanagari: एइ दश - दशाय प्रभु व्याकुल रात्रि - दिने ।
कभु कोन दशा उठे, स्थिर नहे मने ॥54॥
cc-antya-14.54.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was overwhelmed night and day by these ten ecstatic conditions. Whenever such symptoms arose, His mind became unsteady.

devanagari: एत कहि’ महाप्रभु मौन करिला ।
रामानन्द - राय श्लोक पड़िते लागिला ॥55॥
cc-antya-14.55.translation: After speaking in this way, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu fell silent. Then Rāma-nanda Rāya began to recite various verses.

lines: dui jane kichu kailā prabhura bāhya jñāna
devanagari: स्वरूप - गोसाञि करे कृष्ण - लीला गान ।
दुइ जने किछु कैला प्रभुर बाह्य ज्ञान ॥56॥
cc-antya-14.56.translation: Rāmānanda Rāya recited verses from Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, and Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī sang of Kṛṣṇa's pastimes. In this way, they brought Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to external consciousness.

devanagari: एइ - मत अर्ध - रात्रि कैला निर्यापण ।
भितर - प्रकोष्ठे प्रभुरे कराइला शयन ॥57॥
cc-antya-14.57.translation: After half the night had passed in this way, Rāmānanda Rāya and Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī made Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu lie down on His bed in the inner room.

devanagari: रामानन्द - राय तबे गेला निज घरे ।
स्वरूप - गोविन्द दुँहे शुइलेन द्वारे ॥58॥
cc-antya-14.58.translation: Then Rāmānanda Rāya returned home, and Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, along with Govinda, lay down in front of the door to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's room.

devanagari: सब रात्रि महाप्रभु करे जागरण ।
उच्च क रि’ कहे कृष्ण - नाम - सङ्कीर्तन ॥59॥
cc-antya-14.59.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu remained awake throughout the entire night, chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa mantra very loudly.

lines: bujhite nā pāri yāhā, varṇite ke pāre?
sei bujhe, varṇe, caitanya śakti dena yāṅre
devanagari: बुझिते ना पारि याहा, वणिते के पारे ? ।
सेइ बुझे, वर्णे, चैतन्य शक्ति देन याँ रे ॥6॥
cc-antya-14.6.translation: How can one describe unfathomable subject matters? It is possible only if Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu gives him the capability.

lines: śabda nā pāñā svarūpa kapāṭa kailā dūre
tina-dvāra deoyā āche, prabhu nāhi ghare!
devanagari: शब्द ना पाञा स्वरूप कपाट कैला दूरे ।
तिन - द्वार देओया आछे, प्रभु नाहि घरे! ॥60॥
cc-antya-14.60.translation: After some time, Svarūpa Dāmodara could no longer hear Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu chanting. When he entered the room, he found the three doors locked, but Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had gone.

lines: cintita ha-ila sabe prabhure nā dekhiyā
prabhu cāhi' bule sabe deuṭī jvāliyā
devanagari: चिन्तित ह - इल सबे प्रभुरे ना देखिया ।
प्रभु चाहि’ बुले सबे देउटी ज्वालिया ॥61॥
cc-antya-14.61.translation: All the devotees were very anxious when they saw that the Lord was not in His room. They wandered about searching for Him with a warning lamp.

devanagari: सिंह - द्वारेर उत्तर - दिशाय आछे एक ठाञि ।
तार मध्ये प ड़ि’ आछेन चैतन्य - गोसाञि ॥62॥
cc-antya-14.62.translation: After searching for some time, they came upon Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu lying in a corner by the northern side of the Siṁha-dvāra gate.

lines: prabhura daśā dekhi' punaḥ cintite lāgilā
devanagari: देखि’ स्वरूप - गोसाञि - आदि आनन्दित हैला ।
प्रभुर दशा देखि’ पुनः चिन्तिते लागिला ॥63॥
cc-antya-14.63.translation: At first they were overjoyed to see Him, but when they saw His condition, all the devotees, headed by Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, were very anxious.

lines: prabhu paḍi' āchena dīrgha hāta pāṅca-chaya
acetana deha, nāsāya śvāsa nāhi vaya
devanagari: प्रभु पड़ि’ आछेन दीर्घ हात पाँच - छय ।
अचेतन देह, नासाय श्वास नाहि वय ॥64॥
cc-antya-14.64.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was lying unconscious, and His body had become elongated to five or six cubits [eight or nine feet]. There was no breath from His nostrils.

lines: asthi-granthi bhinna, carma āche mātra tāta
devanagari: एक एक हस्त - पाद - दीर्घ तिन तिन - हात ।
अस्थि - ग्रन्थि भिन्न, चर्म आछे मात्र तात ॥65॥
cc-antya-14.65-66.translation: Each of His arms and legs had become three cubits long; only skin connected the separated joints. The Lord's body temperature, indicating life, was very low. All the joints in His arms, legs, neck and waist were separated by at least six inches.

lines: carma-mātra upare, sandhi āche dīrgha hañā
devanagari: चर्म - मात्र उपरे, सन्धि आछे दीर्घ ह ञा ।
दुःखित ह - इला सबे प्रभुरे देखिया ॥67॥
cc-antya-14.67.translation: It appeared that only skin covered His elongated joints. Seeing the Lord's condition, all the devotees were very unhappy.

lines: dekhiyā sakala bhaktera deha chāḍe prāṇa
devanagari: मुखे लाला - फेन प्रभुर उत्तान - नयान ।
देखिया सकल भक्तेर देह छाड़े प्राण ॥68॥
cc-antya-14.68.translation: They almost died when they saw Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu with His mouth full of saliva and foam and His eyes turned upward.

lines: prabhura kāṇe kṛṣṇa-nāma kahe bhakta-gaṇa lañā
devanagari: स्वरूप - गोसाञि तबे उच्च करिया ।
प्रभुर काणे कृष्ण - नाम कहे भक्त - गण लञा ॥69॥
cc-antya-14.69.translation: When they saw this, Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī and all the other devotees began to chant the holy name of Kṛṣṇa very loudly into Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's ear.

devanagari: स्वरूप - गोसाञि आर रघुनाथ - दास ।
एइ दुइर कड़चाते ए - लीला प्रकाश ॥7॥
cc-antya-14.7.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī and Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī recorded all these transcendental activities of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu in their notebooks.

devanagari: बहु - क्षणे कृष्ण - नाम हृदये पशिला ।
‘हरि - बोल’ बलि’ प्रभु गर्जिया उठिला ॥70॥
cc-antya-14.70.translation: After they chanted in this way for a long time, the holy name of Kṛṣṇa entered the heart of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and He suddenly arose with a loud shout of "Hari bol."

devanagari: चेतन पाइते अस्थि - सन्धि लागिल ।
पूर्व - प्राय यथावत् शरीर ह - इल ॥71॥
cc-antya-14.71.translation: As soon as the Lord returned to external consciousness, all His joints contracted, and His entire body returned to normal.

devanagari: एइ लीला महाप्रभुर रघुनाथ - दास ।
‘गौराङ्ग - स्तव - कल्पवृक्षे’ करियाछे प्रकाश ॥72॥
cc-antya-14.72.translation: Śrīla Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī has described these pastimes elaborately in his book Gaurāṅga-stava-kalpavṛkṣa.

lines: rudan śrī-gaurāṅgo hṛdaya udayan māṁ madayati
devanagari: क्वचिन्मिश्रावा से व्रज - पति - सुतस्योरु - विरहात् श्लथच्छ्री - सन्धित्वाद्दधदधिक - दैर्ध्य भुज - पदोः ।
लुठभूमौ काक्वा विकल - विकलं गद्गद - वचा रुदन्श्री - गौराङ्गो हृदय उदयन्मां मदयति ॥73॥
cc-antya-14.73.translation: "Sometimes Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would go to the house of Kāśī Miśra. There He would be greatly aggrieved, feeling separation from Kṛṣṇa. The joints of His transcendental body would slacken, and His arms and legs would become elongated. Rolling on the ground, the Lord would cry out in distress in a faltering voice and weep very sorrowfully. The appearance of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, awakening in my heart, maddens me."

devanagari: सिंह - द्वारे दे खि’ प्रभुर विस्मय ह - इला ।
‘काँहा कर कि’ - एइ स्वरूपे पुछिला ॥74॥
cc-antya-14.74.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was very astonished to find Himself in front of the Siṁha-dvāra. He asked Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, "Where am I? What am I doing here?"

devanagari: स्वरूप कहे, - ‘उठ, प्रभु, चल निज - घरे ।
तथाइ तोमारे सब करिमु गोचरे’ ॥75॥
cc-antya-14.75.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara said, "My dear Lord, please get up. Let us go to Your place. There I shall tell You everything that has happened."

lines: eta bali' prabhure dhari' ghare lañā gelā
devanagari: एत बलि’ प्रभुरे धरि’ घरे लञा गेला ।
ताँहार अवस्था सब कहते लागिला ॥76॥
cc-antya-14.76.translation: Thus all the devotees carried Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu back to His residence. Then they all described to Him what had happened.

devanagari: शुनि’ महाप्रभु बड़ हैला चमत्कार ।
प्रभु कहे, - ‘किछु स्मृति नाहिक आमार ॥77॥
cc-antya-14.77.translation: Hearing the description of His condition while lying near the Siṁha-dvāra, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was very astonished. He said, "I do not remember any of these things.

devanagari: सबे देखि - हय मोर कृष्ण विद्यमान ।
विद्युत्प्राय देखा दिया हय अन्तर्धान’ ॥78॥
cc-antya-14.78.translation: "I can only remember that I saw My Kṛṣṇa, but only for an instant. He appeared before Me, and then, like lightning, immediately disappeared."

devanagari: हेन - काले जगन्नाथेर पाणि - शङ्ख बाजिला ।
स्नान क रि’ महाप्रभु दरशने गेला ॥79॥
cc-antya-14.79.translation: Just then, everyone heard the blowing of the conchshell at the Jagannātha temple. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu immediately took His bath and went to see Lord Jagannātha.

devanagari: से - काले ए - दुइ रहेन महाप्रभुर पाशे ।
आर सब कड़चा - कर्ता रहेन दूर - देशे ॥8॥
cc-antya-14.8.translation: In those days, Svarūpa Dāmodara and Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī lived with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, whereas all other commentators lived far away from Him.

lines: ei ta' kahiluṅ prabhura adbhuta vikāra
devanagari: एइ त कहि लुँ प्रभुर अद्भुत विकार ।
याहार श्रवणे लोके लागे चमत्कार ॥80॥
cc-antya-14.80.translation: Thus I have described the uncommon transformations of the body of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. When people hear about this, they are very astonished.

lines: loke nāhi dekhi aiche, śāstre nāhi śuni
devanagari: लोके नाहि देखि ऐछे, शास्त्रे नाहि शुनि ।
हेन भाव व्यक्त करे न्यासि - चूड़ामणि ॥81॥
cc-antya-14.81.translation: No one has witnessed such bodily changes elsewhere, nor has anyone read of them in the revealed scriptures. Yet Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the supreme sannyāsī, exhibited these ecstatic symptoms.

devanagari: शास्त्र - लोकातीत येइ येइ भाव हय ।
इतर - लोकेर ताते ना हय निश्चय ॥82॥
cc-antya-14.82.translation: These ecstasies are not described in the śāstras, and they are inconceivable to common men. Therefore people in general do not believe in them.

lines: tāṅra mukhe śuni' likhi kariyā pratīti
devanagari: रघुनाथ - दासेर सदा प्रभु - सङ्गे स्थिति ।
ताँर मुखे शुनि’ लिखि करिया प्रतीति ॥83॥
cc-antya-14.83.translation: Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī lived continuously with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. I am simply recording whatever I have heard from him. Although common men do not believe in these pastimes, I believe in them totally.

devanagari: एक - दिन महाप्रभु समुद्रे याइते ।
‘चटक’ - पर्वत देखिलेन आचम्बिते ॥84॥
cc-antya-14.84.translation: One day, while Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was going to the sea to bathe, He suddenly saw a sand dune named Caṭaka-parvata.

devanagari: गोवर्धन - शैल - ज्ञाने आविष्ट ह - इला ।
पर्वत - दिशाते प्रभु धाञा चलिला ॥85॥
cc-antya-14.85.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu mistook the sand dune for Govardhana Hill and ran toward it.

devanagari: हन्तायमद्रिरबला हरि - दास - वर्यो यद्राम - कृष्ण - चरण - स्परश - प्रमोदः ।
मानं तनोति सह - गो - गणयोस्तयोर्यत् पानीय - सूयवस - कन्दर - कन्द - मूलैः ॥86॥
cc-antya-14.86.translation: "Of all the devotees, this Govardhana Hill is the best! O My friends, this hill supplies Kṛṣṇa and Balarāma, as well as Their calves, cows and cowherd friends, with all kinds of necessities-water for drinking, very soft grass, caves, fruits, flowers and vegetables. In this way the hill offers respect to the Lord. Being touched by the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa and Balarāma, Govardhana Hill appears very jubilant."

lines: ei śloka paḍi' prabhu calena vāyu-vege
govinda dhāila pāche, nāhi pāya lāge
devanagari: एइ श्लोक प ड़ि’ प्रभु चलेन वायु - वेगे ।
गोविन्द धाइल पाछे, नाहि पाय लागे ॥87॥
cc-antya-14.87.translation: Reciting this verse, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu ran toward the sand dune as fast as the wind. Govinda ran after Him, but he could not approach Him.

lines: yei yāhāṅ chila sei uṭhiyā dhāila
devanagari: फुकार पड़िल, महा - कोलाहल ह - इल ।
येइ याहाँ छिल सेइ उठिया धाइल ॥88॥
cc-antya-14.88.translation: First one devotee shouted loudly, and then a tumultuous uproar arose as all the devotees stood up and began to run after the Lord.

devanagari: स्वरूप, जगदानन्द, पण्डित - गदाधर ।
रामाइ, नन्दाइ, आर पण्डित शङ्कर ॥89॥
cc-antya-14.89.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita, Gadādhara Paṇḍita, Rāmāi, Nandāi and Śaṅkara Paṇḍita are some of the devotees who ran after Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: क्षणे क्षणे अनुभवि’ एइ दुइ - जन ।
सङ्क्षेपे बाहुल्ये करेन कड़चा - ग्रन्थन ॥9॥
cc-antya-14.9.translation: These two great personalities [Svarūpa Dāmodara and Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī] recorded the activities of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu moment by moment. They described these activities briefly as well as elaborately in their notebooks.

devanagari: पुरी - भारती - गोसाञि आइला सिन्धु - तीरे ।
भगवानाचार्य खञ्ज चलिला धीरे धीरे ॥90॥
cc-antya-14.90.translation: Paramānanda Purī and Brahmānanda Bhāratī also went toward the beach, and Bhagavān Ācārya, who was lame, followed them very slowly.

lines: stambha-bhāva pathe haila, calite nāhi śakti
devanagari: प्रथमे चलिला प्रभु, - येन वायु - गति ।
स्तम्भ - भाव पथे हैल, चलिते नाहि शक्ति ॥91॥
cc-antya-14.91.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was running with the speed of the wind, but He suddenly became stunned in ecstasy and lost all strength to proceed further.

devanagari: प्रति - रोम - कूपे मांस - व्रणेर आकार ।
तार उपरे रोमोद्गम - कदम्ब - प्रकार ॥92॥
cc-antya-14.92.translation: The flesh at each of His pores erupted like pimples, and His hair, standing on end, appeared like kadamba flowers.

devanagari: प्रति - रोमे प्रस्वेद पड़े रुधिरेर धार ।
कण्ठे घर्धर, नाहि वर्णेर उच्चार ॥93॥
cc-antya-14.93.translation: Blood and perspiration flowed incessantly from every pore of His body, and He could not speak a word but simply produced a gargling sound within His throat.

lines: dui netre bhari' aśru vahaye apāra
devanagari: दुइ नेत्रे भरि’ अश्रु वहये अपार ।
समुद्रे मिलिला येन गङ्गा - यमुना - धार ॥94॥
cc-antya-14.94.translation: The Lord's eyes filled up and overflowed with unlimited tears, like the Ganges and Yamunā meeting in the sea.

devanagari: वैवण् र्ये शङ्ख - प्राय श्वेत हैल अङ्ग ।
तबे कम्प उठे , - येन समुद्रे तरङ्ग ॥95॥
cc-antya-14.95.translation: His entire body faded to the color of a white conchshell, and then He began to quiver, like the waves in the ocean.

lines: tabe ta' govinda prabhura nikaṭe āilā
devanagari: काँपिते काँपिते प्रभु भूमेते पड़िला ।
तबे त’ गोविन्द प्रभुर निकटे आइला ॥96॥
cc-antya-14.96.translation: While quivering in this way, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu fell down on the ground. Then Govinda approached Him.

devanagari: करङ्गेर जले करे सर्वाङ्ग सिञ्चन ।
बहिर्वास लञा करे अङ्ग संवीजन ॥97॥
cc-antya-14.97.translation: Govinda sprinkled water from a karaṅga waterpot all over the Lord's body, and then, taking His own outer garment, he began to fan Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: स्वरूपादि - गण ताहाँ आसिया मिलिला ।
प्रभुर अवस्था देखि’ कान्दिते लागिला ॥98॥
cc-antya-14.98.translation: When Svarūpa Dāmodara and the other devotees reached the spot and saw the condition of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, they began to cry.

devanagari: प्रभुर अङ्गे देखे अष्ट - सात्त्विक विकार ।
आश्चर्य सात्त्विक दे खि’ हैला चमत्कार ॥99॥
cc-antya-14.99.translation: All eight kinds of transcendental transformations were visible in the Lord's body. All the devotees were struck with wonder to see such a sight.

devanagari: दुर्गमे कृष्ण - भावाब्धौ निमग्नोन्मग्न - चेतसा ।
गौरेण हरिणा प्रेम - मर्यादा भूरि दर्शिता ॥1॥
cc-antya-15.1.translation: The ocean of ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa is very difficult to understand, even for such demigods as Lord Brahmā. By enacting His pastimes, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu submerged Himself in that ocean, and His heart was absorbed in that love. Thus He exhibited in various ways the exalted position of transcendental love for Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: हेन - काले ईश्वरेर उपल - भोग सरिल ।
भक्त - गण महाप्रभुरे घरे लञा आइल ॥10॥
cc-antya-15.10.translation: Just then, the upala-bhoga ceremony of Lord Jagannātha concluded, and the devotees who had accompanied Lord Caitanya to the temple brought Him back home.

devanagari: स्वरूप, रामानन्द , - एइ दुइ - जन लञा ।
विलाप करेन दुँहार कण्ठेते धरिया ॥11॥
cc-antya-15.11.translation: That night, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was attended by Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī and Rāmānanda Rāya. Keeping His hands around their necks, the Lord began to lament.

devanagari: कृष्णेर वियोगे राधार उत्कण्ठित मन ।
विशाखारे कहे आपन उत्कण्ठा - कारण ॥12॥
cc-antya-15.12.translation: When Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī was very agitated due to feeling great separation from Kṛṣṇa, She spoke a verse to Viśākhā explaining the cause of Her great anxiety and restlessness.

lines: sei śloka paḍi' āpane kare manastāpa
ślokera artha śunāya duṅhāre kariyā vilāpa
devanagari: सेइ श्लोक प ड़ि’ आपने करे मनस्ताप ।
श्लोकेर अर्थ शुनाय दुँहारे करिया विलाप ॥13॥
cc-antya-15.13.translation: Reciting that verse, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu expressed His burning emotions. Then, with great lamentation, He explained the verse to Svarūpa Dāmodara and Rāmānanda Rāya.

lines: śrī-gopendra-sutaḥ sa karṣati balāt pañcendriyāṇy āli me
devanagari: सौन्दर्यामृत - सिन्धु - भङ्ग ललना - चित्ताद्रि - सम्प्लावकः कर्णानन्द - सनर्म - रम्य - वचनः कोटीन्दु - शीताङ्गकः ।
सौरभ्यामृत - सम्प्लवावृत - जगत्पीयूष - रम्याधरः श्री - गोपेन्द्र - सुतः स कर्षति बलात्पञ्चेन्द्रियाण्यालि मे ॥14॥
cc-antya-15.14.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said:" 'Though the hearts of the gopīs are like high-standing hills, they are inundated by the waves of the nectarean ocean of Kṛṣṇa's beauty. His sweet voice enters their ears and gives them transcendental bliss. The touch of His body is cooler than millions and millions of moons together, and the nectar of His bodily fragrance overfloods the entire world. O My dear friend, that Kṛṣṇa, who is the son of Nanda Mahārāja and whose lips are exactly like nectar, is attracting My five senses by force.'

lines: dekhi' lobhe pañca-jana, eka aśva—mora mana,
devanagari: कृष्ण - रूप - शब्द - स्पर्श, सौरभ्य - अधर - रस
यार माधुर्य कहन ना याय ।
देखि लोभे पञ्च - जन, एक अश्व - मोर मन
चड़ि’ पञ्च पाँच - दिके धाय ॥15॥
cc-antya-15.15.translation: "Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa's beauty, the sound of His words and the vibration of His flute, His touch, His fragrance and the taste of His lips are full of an indescribable sweetness. When all these features attract My five senses at once, My senses all ride together on the single horse of My mind but want to go in five different directions.

lines: sakhi he, śuna mora duḥkhera kāraṇa
devanagari: सखि हे, शुन मोर दुःखेर कारण
मोर पञ्चेन्द्रिय - गण, महा - लम्पट दस्यु - गण, ।
सबे कहे , - हर’ पर - धन ॥16॥
cc-antya-15.16.translation: "O My dear friend, please hear the cause of My misery. My five senses are actually extravagant rogues. They know very well that Kṛṣṇa is the Supreme Personality of Godhead, but they still want to plunder Kṛṣṇa's property.

lines: eka aśva eka-kṣaṇe, pāṅca pāṅca dike ṭāne,
eka-kāle sabe ṭāne, gela ghoḍāra parāṇe,
devanagari: एक अश्व एक - क्षणे, पाँच पाँच दिके टाने
एक मन कोन्दिके याय? ।
एक - काले सबै टाने, गेल घोड़ार पराणे
एइ दुःख सहन ना याय ॥17॥
cc-antya-15.17.translation: "My mind is just like a single horse being ridden by the five senses of perception, headed by sight. Each sense wants to ride that horse, and thus they pull My mind in five directions simultaneously. In what direction will it go? If they all pull at one time, certainly the horse will lose its life. How can I tolerate this atrocity?

lines: indriye nā kari roṣa, iṅhā-sabāra kāhāṅ doṣa,
rūpādi pāṅca pāṅce ṭāne, gela ghoḍāra parāṇe,
devanagari: इन्द्रिये ना करि रोष, इँहा - सबार काहाँ दोष
कृष्ण - रूपादिर महा आकर्षण ।
रूपादि पाँच पाँचे टाने, गेल घोड़ार पराणे
मोर देहे ना रहे जीवन ॥18॥
cc-antya-15.18.translation: "My dear friend, if you say, 'Just try to control Your senses,' what shall I say? I cannot become angry at My senses. Is it their fault? Kṛṣṇa's beauty, sounds, touch, fragrance and taste are by nature extremely attractive. These five features are attracting My senses, and each wants to drag My mind in a different direction. Thus the life of My mind is in great danger, just like a horse ridden in five directions at once. Thus I am also in danger of dying.

devanagari: कृष्ण - रूपामृत - सिन्धु, ताहार तरङ्ग - बिन्दु
एक - बिन्दु जगत् डुबाय ।
त्रिजगते यत नारी, तार चित्त - उच्च - गिरि
ताहा डुबाइ आगे उठि’ धाय ॥19॥
cc-antya-15.19.translation: "The consciousness of each woman within the three worlds is certainly like a high hill, but the sweetness of Kṛṣṇa's beauty is like an ocean. Even a drop of water from that ocean can flood the entire world and submerge all the high hills of consciousness.

devanagari: जय जय श्री कृष्ण - चैतन्य अधीश्वर ।
जय नित्यानन्द पूर्णानन्द - कलेवर ॥2॥
cc-antya-15.2.translation: All glories to Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya, the Supreme Personality of Godhead! All glories to Lord Nityānanda, whose body is always filled with transcendental bliss!

lines: jagatera nārīra kāṇe, mādhurī-guṇe bāndhi' ṭāne,
devanagari: कृष्णेर वचन - माधुरी, नाना - रस - नर्म - धारी
तार अन्याय कथन ना याय ।
जगतेर नारीर काणे, माधुरी - गुणे बान्धि’ टाने
टानाटानि काणेर प्राण याय ॥20॥
cc-antya-15.20.translation: "The sweetness of Kṛṣṇa's joking words plays indescribable havoc with the hearts of all women. His words bind a woman's ear to the qualities of their sweetness. Thus there is a tug-of-war, and the life of the ear departs.

lines: kṛṣṇa-aṅga suśītala, ki kahimu tāra bala,
saśaila nārīra vakṣa, tāhā ākarṣite dakṣa,
devanagari: कृष्ण - अङ्ग सुशीतल, कि कहिमु तार बल
छटाय जिने कोटीन्दु - चन्दन ।
सशैल नारीर वक्ष, ताहा आकर्षिते दक्ष
आकर्षये नारी - गण - मन ॥21॥
cc-antya-15.21.translation: "Kṛṣṇa's transcendental body is so cool that it cannot be compared even to sandalwood pulp or to millions upon millions of moons. It expertly attracts the breasts of all women, which resemble high hills. Indeed, the transcendental body of Kṛṣṇa attracts the minds of all women within the three worlds.

lines: jagat-nārīra nāsā, tāra bhitara pāte vāsā,
devanagari: कृष्णाङ्ग - सौरभ्य - भर, मृग - मद - मद - हर
नीलोत्पलेर हरे गर्व - धन ।
जगत् नारीर नासा, तार भितर पाते वासा
नारी - गणे करे आकर्षण ॥22॥
cc-antya-15.22.translation: "The fragrance of Kṛṣṇa's body is more maddening than the aroma of musk, and it surpasses the fragrance of the bluish lotus flower. It enters the nostrils of all the women of the world and, making a nest there, thus attracts them.

lines: anyatra chāḍāya lobha, nā pāile mane kṣobha,
devanagari: कृष्णेर अधरामृत, ताते कर्पूर मन्द - स्मित
स्व - माधुर्ये हरे नारीर मन ।
अन्यत्र छाड़ाय लोभ, ना पाइले मने क्षोभ
व्रज - नारी - गणेर मूल - धन” ॥23॥
cc-antya-15.23.translation: "Kṛṣṇa's lips are so sweet when combined with the camphor of His gentle smile that they attract the minds of all women, forcing them to give up all other attractions. If the sweetness of Kṛṣṇa's smile is unobtainable, great mental difficulties and lamentation result. That sweetness is the only wealth of the gopīs of Vṛndāvana."

lines: eta kahi' gaurahari, dui-janāra kaṇṭha dhari',
kāhāṅ karoṅ, kāhāṅ yāṅa, kāhāṅ gele kṛṣṇa pāṅa,
devanagari: एत कहि’ गौरहरि, दुइ - जनार कण्ठ ध रि’,
कहे, - ‘शुन, स्वरूप - रामराय ।
काहाँ करों, काहाँ याङ काहाँ गेले कृष्ण पाङ
दुँहे मोरे कह से उपा य’ ॥24॥
cc-antya-15.24.translation: After speaking in this way, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu caught hold of the necks of Rāmānanda Rāya and Svarūpa Dāmodara. Then the Lord said, "My dear friends, please listen to Me. What shall I do? Where shall I go? Where can I go to get Kṛṣṇa? Please, both of you, tell Me how I can find Him."

devanagari: एइ - मत गौर - प्रभु प्रति दिने - दिने ।
विलाप करेन स्वरूप - रामानन्द - सने ॥25॥
cc-antya-15.25.translation: Thus absorbed in transcendental pain, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu lamented day after day in the company of Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī and Rāmānanda Rāya.

lines: svarūpa gāya, rāya kare śloka paṭhana
devanagari: सेइ दुइ - जन प्रभुरे करे आश्वासन ।
स्वरूप गाय, राय करे श्लोक पठन ॥26॥
cc-antya-15.26.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī would sing appropriate songs, and Rāmānanda Rāya would recite suitable verses to enhance the ecstatic mood of the Lord. In this way they were able to pacify Him.

devanagari: कर्णामृत, विद्यापति, श्री - गीत - गोविन्द ।
इहार श्लोक - गीते प्रभुर कराय आनन्द ॥27॥
cc-antya-15.27.translation: The Lord especially liked to hear Bilvamaṅgala Ṭhākura's Kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛta, the poetry of Vidyāpati and Śrī Gīta-govinda by Jayadeva Gosvāmī. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu felt great pleasure in His heart when His associates chanted verses from these books.

devanagari: एक - दिन महाप्रभु समुद्र - तीरे याइते ।
पुष्पेर उद्यान तथा देखेन आचम्बिते ॥28॥
cc-antya-15.28.translation: One day, while going to the beach by the sea, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu suddenly saw a flower garden.

devanagari: वृन्दावन - भ्रमे ताहाँ पशिला धाञा ।
प्रेमावेशे बुले ताहाँ कृष्ण अन्वेषिया ॥29॥
cc-antya-15.29.translation: Lord Caitanya mistook that garden for Vṛndāvana and very quickly entered it. Absorbed in ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa, He wandered throughout the garden, searching for Him.

devanagari: जयाद्वैताचार्य कृष्ण - चैतन्य - प्रियतम ।
जय श्रीवास - आदि प्रभुर भक्त - गण ॥3॥
cc-antya-15.3.translation: All glories to Śrī Advaita Ācārya, who is very dear to Lord Caitanya! And all glories to the devotees of the Lord, headed by Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura!

lines: rāse rādhā lañā kṛṣṇa antardhāna kailā
devanagari: रासे राधा लञा कृष्ण अन्तर्धान कैला ।
पाछे सखी - गण यैछे चाहि’ बेड़ाइला ॥30॥
cc-antya-15.30.translation: After Kṛṣṇa disappeared with Rādhārāṇī during the rāsa dance, the gopīs wandered in the forest looking for Him. In the same way, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu wandered in that garden by the sea.

lines: śloka paḍi' paḍi' cāhi' bule yathā tathā
devanagari: सेइ भावावेशे प्रभु प्रति - तरु - लता ।
श्लोक प ड़ि’ पड़ि’ चाहि’ बुले यथा तथा ॥31॥
cc-antya-15.31.translation: Absorbed in the ecstatic mood of the gopīs, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu wandered here and there. He began to inquire after Kṛṣṇa by quoting verses to all the trees and creepers.

devanagari: चूत - प्रियाल - पनसासन - कोविदार - जम्ब्वकर् - बिल्व - बकुलाम्र - कदम्ब - नीपाः ।
येऽन्ये परार्थ - भवका यमुनोपकूलाः शंसन्तु कृष्ण - पदवीं रहितात्मनां नः ॥32॥
cc-antya-15.32.translation: "(The gopīs said:) 'O cūta tree, priyāla tree, panasa, āsana and kovidāra! O jambu tree, O arka tree, O bel, bakula and mango! O kadamba tree, O nīpa tree and all other trees living on the bank of the Yamunā for the welfare of others, please let us know where Kṛṣṇa has gone. We have lost our minds and are almost dead.

devanagari: कच्चित्तुलसि कल्याणि गोविन्द - चरण - प्रिये ।
सह त्वालि - कुलैर्बिभ्रहृष्टस्तेऽति - प्रियोऽच्युतः ॥33॥
cc-antya-15.33.translation: “ 'O all-auspicious tulasī plant, you are very dear to Govinda's lotus feet, and He is very dear to you. Have you seen Kṛṣṇa walking here wearing a garland of your leaves, surrounded by a swarm of bumblebees?

devanagari: मालत्यदर्शि वः कच्चिन्मल्लिके जाति यूथिके ।
प्रीतिं वो जनयन् यातः कर - स्पर्शेन माधवः ॥34॥
cc-antya-15.34.translation: “ 'O plants of mālatī flowers, mallikā flowers, jātī and yūthikā flowers, have you seen Kṛṣṇa passing this way, touching you with His hand to give you pleasure?' "

devanagari: आम्र, पनस, पियाल, जम्बु, कोविदार ।
तीर्थ - वासी सबे, कर पर - उपकार ॥35॥
cc-antya-15.35.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu continued: " 'O mango tree, O jackfruit tree, O piyāla, jambu and kovidāra trees, you are all inhabitants of a holy place. Therefore kindly act for the welfare of others.

lines: kṛṣṇa tomāra ihāṅ āilā, pāilā daraśana?
devanagari: कृष्ण तोमार इहाँ आइला, पाइला दरशन ? ।
कृष्णेर उद्देश कहि’ राखह जीवन ॥36॥
cc-antya-15.36.translation: “ 'Have you seen Kṛṣṇa coming this way? Kindly tell us which way He has gone and save our lives.'

lines: uttara nā pāñā punaḥ kare anumāna
devanagari: उत्तर ना पाञा पुनः करे अनुमान ।
एइ सब - पुरुष - जाति, कृष्णेर सखार समान ॥37॥
cc-antya-15.37.translation: "When the trees did not reply, the gopīs guessed,'Since all of these trees belong to the male class, all of them must be friends of Kṛṣṇa.

lines: e kene kahibe kṛṣṇera uddeśa āmāya?
devanagari: ए केने कहिबे कृष्णेर उद्देश आमाय ? ।
ए - स्त्री - जाति लता, आमार सखी - प्राय ॥38॥
cc-antya-15.38.translation: “ 'Why should the trees tell us where Kṛṣṇa has gone? Let us rather inquire from the creepers; they are female and therefore are like friends to us.

devanagari: अवश्य कहिबे , - पाञा छे कृष्णेर दर्शने ।
एत अनुमानि’ पुछे तुलस्यादि - गणे ॥39॥
cc-antya-15.39.translation: “ 'They will certainly tell us where Kṛṣṇa has gone, since they have seen Him personally.' Guessing in this way, the gopīs inquired from the plants and creepers, headed by tulasī.

devanagari: एइ - मत महाप्रभु रात्रि - दिवसे ।
आत्म - स्फूर्ति नाहि कृष्ण - भावावेशे ॥4॥
cc-antya-15.4.translation: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu forgot Himself throughout the entire day and night, being merged in an ocean of ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa.

lines: tomāra priya kṛṣṇa āilā tomāra antike?
devanagari: “तुलसि, मालति, यूथि, माधवि, मल्लिके ।
तोमार प्रिय कृष्ण आइला तोमार अन्तिके? ॥40॥
cc-antya-15.40.translation: “ 'O tulasī! O mālatī! O yūthī, mādhavī and mallikā! Kṛṣṇa is very dear to you. Therefore He must have come near you.

devanagari: तुमि - सब - हओ आमार सखीर समान ।
कृष्णोद्देश कहि’ सबे राखह पराण” ॥41॥
cc-antya-15.41.translation: “ 'You are all just like dear friends to us. Kindly tell us which way Kṛṣṇa has gone and save our lives.'

lines: uttara nā pāñā punaḥ bhāvena antare
devanagari: उत्तर ना पाञा पुनः भावेन अन्तरे ।
‘एह - कृष्ण - दासी, भये ना कहे आमारे ॥42॥
cc-antya-15.42.translation: "When they still received no reply, the gopīs thought, 'These plants are all Kṛṣṇa's maidservants, and out of fear they will not speak to us.'

lines: tāra mukha dekhi' puchena nirṇaya kariyā
devanagari: आगे मृगी - गण दे खि’ कृष्णाङ्ग - गन्ध पाञा ।
तार मुख देखि’ पुछेन निर्णय करिया ॥43॥
cc-antya-15.43.translation: "The gopīs then came upon a group of she-deer. Smelling the aroma of Kṛṣṇa's body and seeing the faces of the deer, the gopīs inquired from them to ascertain if Kṛṣṇa was nearby.

lines: tanvan dṛśāṁ sakhi sunirvṛtim acyuto vaḥ
devanagari: अप्येण - पत्न्युपगतः प्रिययेह गात्रैस् तन्वन्दृशां सखि सु - निवृतिमच्युतो वः ।
कान्ताङ्ग - सङ्ग - कुच - कुङ्कम - रञ्जितायाः कुन्द - स्रजः कुल - पतेरिह वाति गन्धः ॥44॥
cc-antya-15.44.translation: “ 'O wife of the deer, Lord Kṛṣṇa has been embracing His beloved, and thus the kuṅkuma powder on Her raised breasts has covered His garland of kunda flowers. The fragrance of this garland is flowing here. O my dear friend, have you seen Kṛṣṇa passing this way with His dearmost companion, increasing the pleasure of the eyes of all of you?'

lines: tomāya sukha dite āilā? nāhika anyathā
devanagari: “कह, मृग, राधा - सह श्री कृष्ण सर्वथा ।
तोमाय सुख दिते आइला? नाहिक अन्यथा ॥45॥
cc-antya-15.45.translation: “ 'O dear doe, Śrī Kṛṣṇa is always very pleased to give you pleasure. Kindly inform us whether He passed this way in the company of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī. We think They must certainly have come this way.

lines: dūra haite jāni tāra yaiche aṅga-gandha
devanagari: राधा - प्रिय - सखी आमरा, नहि बहिरङ्ग ।
दूर हैते जानि तार यैछे अङ्ग - गन्ध ॥46॥
cc-antya-15.46.translation: “ 'We are not outsiders. Being very dear friends of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, we can perceive the bodily fragrance of Kṛṣṇa from a distance.

devanagari: राधा - अङ्ग - सङ्गे कुच - कुङ्कुम - भूषित ।
कृष्ण - कुन्द - माला - गन्धे वायु - सुवासित ॥47॥
cc-antya-15.47.translation: “ 'Kṛṣṇa has been embracing Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, and the kuṅkuma powder on Her breasts has mixed with the garland of kunda flowers decorating His body. The fragrance of the garland has scented the entire atmosphere.

lines: kibā uttara dibe ei—nā śune kāhinī"
devanagari: कृष्ण इहाँ छाड़ि’ गेला, इहों - विरहिणी ।
किबा उत्तर दिबे एइ - ना शुने काहिनी” ॥48॥
cc-antya-15.48.translation: “ 'Lord Kṛṣṇa has left this place, and therefore the deer are feeling separation. They do not hear our words; therefore how can they reply?'

devanagari: आगे वृक्ष - गण देखे पुष्प - फल - भरे ।
शाखा सब पड़ियाछे पृथिवी - उपरे ॥49॥
cc-antya-15.49.translation: "The gopīs then came upon many trees so laden with fruits and flowers that their branches bent down to the ground.

devanagari: कभु भावे मग्न, कभु अर्ध - बाह्य - स्फूर्ति ।
कभु बाह्य - स्फूर्ति, - तिन रीते प्रभु - स्थिति ॥5॥
cc-antya-15.5.translation: The Lord would maintain Himself in three kinds of consciousness: sometimes He merged totally in ecstatic emotion, sometimes He was in partial external consciousness and sometimes in full external consciousness.

lines: kṛṣṇe dekhi' ei saba karena namaskāra
devanagari: कृष्णे देखि’ एइ सब करेन नमस्कार ।
कृष्ण - गमन पुछे तारे करिया निर्धार ॥50॥
cc-antya-15.50.translation: "The gopīs thought that because all the trees must have seen Kṛṣṇa pass by they were offering respectful obeisances to Him. To be certain, the gopīs inquired from the trees.

devanagari: बाहुं प्रियांस उपधाय गृहीत - पद्मो रामानुजस्तुलसिकालि - कुलैर्मदान्धैः ।
अन्वीयमान इह वस्तरवः प्रणाम किं वाभिनन्दति चरन्प्रणयावलोकैः ॥51॥
cc-antya-15.51.translation: “ 'O trees, kindly tell us whether Balarāma's younger brother, Kṛṣṇa, welcomed your obeisances with loving glances as He passed this way, resting one hand on the shoulder of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, holding a lotus flower in the other, and being followed by a swarm of bumblebees maddened by the fragrance of tulasī leaves.'

devanagari: प्रिया - मुखे भृङ्ग पड़े, ताहा निवारिते ।
लीला - पद्म चालाइते हैल अन्य - चित्ते ॥52॥
cc-antya-15.52.translation: “ 'To stop the bumblebees from landing on the face of His beloved, He whisked them away with the lotus flower in His hand, and thus His mind was slightly diverted.

devanagari: तोमार प्रणामे कि कैराछेन अवधान ? ।
किबा नाहि करेन, कह वचन - प्रमाण ॥53॥
cc-antya-15.53.translation: “ 'Did He or did He not pay attention while You offered Him obeisances? Kindly give evidence supporting your words.

lines: kibā uttara dibe? ihāra nāhika samvit"
devanagari: कृष्णेर वियोगे एइ सेवक दुःखित ।
किबा उत्तर दिले ? इहार नाहिक सम्वित्” ॥54॥
cc-antya-15.54.translation: “ 'Separation from Kṛṣṇa has made these servants very unhappy. Having lost consciousness, how can they answer us?'

lines: eta bali' āge cale yamunāra kūle
devanagari: एत बलि’ आगे चले यमुनार कूले ।
देखे, - ताहाँ कृष्ण हय कदम्बेर तले ॥55॥
cc-antya-15.55.translation: "Saying this, the gopīs stepped onto the beach by the Yamunā River. There they saw Lord Kṛṣṇa beneath a kadamba tree.

devanagari: कोटि - मन्मथ - मोहन मुरली - वदन ।
अपार सौन्दर्ये हरे जगन्नेत्र - मन ॥56॥
cc-antya-15.56.translation: "Standing there with His flute to His lips, Kṛṣṇa, who enchants millions upon millions of Cupids, attracted the eyes and minds of all the world with His unlimited beauty."

lines: saundarya dekhiyā bhūme paḍe mūrcchā pāñā
devanagari: सौन्दर्य देखिया भूमे पड़े मूर्च्छा पाञा ।
हेन - काले स्वरूपादि मिलिला आसिया ॥57॥
cc-antya-15.57.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu saw the transcendental beauty of Kṛṣṇa, He fell down on the ground unconscious. At that time, all the devotees, headed by Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, joined Him in the garden.

devanagari: पूर्ववत्सर्वाङ्गे सात्त्विक - भाव - सकल ।
अन्तरे आनन्द - आस्वाद, बाहिरे विह्वल ॥58॥
cc-antya-15.58.translation: Just as before, they saw all the symptoms of transcendental ecstatic love manifested in the body of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Although externally He appeared bewildered, He was tasting transcendental bliss within.

devanagari: पूर्ववत्सबे मिलि’ कराइला चेतन ।
उठिया चौदिके प्रभु करेन दर्शन ॥59॥
cc-antya-15.59.translation: Once again all the devotees brought Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu back to consciousness by a concerted effort. Then the Lord got up and began wandering here and there, looking all around.

devanagari: स्नान, दर्शन, भोजन देह - स्वभावे हय ।
कुमारेर चाक येन सतत फिरय ॥6॥
cc-antya-15.6.translation: Actually, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was always merged in ecstatic emotion, but just as a potter's wheel turns without the potter's touching it, the Lord's bodily activities, like bathing, going to the temple to see Lord Jagannātha, and taking lunch, went on automatically.

devanagari: “काहाँ गेला कृष्ण? एखनि पाइनु दरशन! ।
ताँहार सौन्दर्य मोर हरिल नेत्र - मन! ॥60॥
cc-antya-15.60.translation: Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "Where has My Kṛṣṇa gone? I saw Him just now, and His beauty has captured My eyes and mind.

devanagari: पुनः केने ना देखिये मुरली - वदन! ।
ताँहार दर्शन - लोभे भ्रमय नयन” ॥61॥
cc-antya-15.61.translation: "Why can't I again see Kṛṣṇa holding His flute to His lips? My eyes are wandering in hopes of seeing Him once more."

devanagari: विशाखारे राधा यैछे श्लोक कहिला ।
सेइ श्लोक महाप्रभु पड़िते लागिला ॥62॥
cc-antya-15.62.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then recited the following verse, which was spoken by Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī to Her dear friend Viśākhā.

lines: sa me madana-mohanaḥ sakhi tanoti netra-spṛhām
devanagari: नवाम्बुद - लसद्द्युतिर्नव - तड़िमनोज्ञाम्बरः सुचित्र - मुरली - स्फुरच्छरदमन्द - चन्द्राननः ।
मयूर - दल - भूषितः सुभग - तार - हार - प्रभः स मे मदन - मोहनः सखि तनोति नेत्र - स्पृहाम् ॥63॥
cc-antya-15.63.translation: "My dear friend, the luster of Kṛṣṇa's body is more brilliant than a newly formed cloud, and His yellow dress is more attractive than newly arrived lightning. A peacock feather decorates His head, and on His neck hangs a lovely necklace of brilliant pearls. As He holds His charming flute to His lips, His face looks as beautiful as the full autumn moon. By such beauty, Madana-mohana, the enchanter of Cupid, is increasing the desire of my eyes to see Him."

devanagari: नव - घन - स्निग्ध - वर्ण, दलिताञ्जन - चिक्कण
इन्दीवर - निन्दि सुकोमल ।
जिनि’ उपमान - गण, हरे सबार नेत्र - मन
कृष्ण - कान्ति परम प्रबल ॥64॥
cc-antya-15.64.translation: Caitanya Mahāprabhu continued: "Śrī Kṛṣṇa's complexion is as polished as powdered eye ointment. It surpasses the beauty of a newly formed cloud and is softer than a blue lotus flower. Indeed, His complexion is so pleasing that it attracts the eyes and mind of everyone, and it is so powerful that it defies all comparison.

devanagari: कह, सखि, कि करि उपाय ?
कृष्णाद्भुत बलाहक, मोर नेत्र - चातक, ।
ना देखि’ पियासे म रि’ याय ॥65॥
cc-antya-15.65.translation: "My dear friend, please tell me what I should do. Kṛṣṇa is as attractive as a wonderful cloud, and My eyes are just like cātaka birds, which are dying of thirst because they do not see such a cloud.

devanagari: सौदामिनी पीताम्बर, स्थिर नहे निरन्तर
मुक्ता - हार बक - पाँति भाल ।
इन्द्र - धनु शिखि - पाखा, उपरे दियाछे देखा
आर धनु वैजयन्ती - माल ॥66॥
cc-antya-15.66.translation: "Kṛṣṇa's yellow dress looks exactly like restless lightning in the sky, and the pearl necklace on His neck appears like a line of ducks flying below a cloud. Both the peacock feather on His head and His vaijayantī garland [containing flowers of five colors] resemble rainbows.

devanagari: मुरलीर कल - ध्वनि, मधुर गर्जन शुनि’
वृन्दावने नाचे मयूर - चय ।
अकलङ्क पूर्ण - कल, लावण्य - ज्योत्स्ना झलमल
चित्र - चन्द्रेर ताहाते उदय ॥67॥
cc-antya-15.67.translation: "The luster of Kṛṣṇa's body is as beautiful as a spotless full moon that has just risen, and the vibration of His flute sounds exactly like the sweet thundering of a newly formed cloud. When the peacocks in Vṛndāvana hear that vibration, they all begin to dance.

devanagari: लीलामृत - वरिषणे, सिञ्चे चौद्द भुवने,
हेन मेघ यबे देखा दिल ।
दुर्दैव - झञ्झा - पवने, मेघे निल अन्य - स्थाने ,
मरे चातक, पिते ना पाइल ॥68॥
cc-antya-15.68.translation: "The cloud of Kṛṣṇa's pastimes is drenching the fourteen worlds with a shower of nectar. Unfortunately, when that cloud appeared, a whirlwind arose and blew it away from Me. Being unable to see the cloud, the cātaka bird of My eyes is almost dead from thirst."

lines: punaḥ kahe,—'hāya hāya, paḍa paḍa rāma-raya',
rāmānanda paḍe śloka, śuni' prabhura harṣa-śoka,
devanagari: पुनः कहे, - ‘हाय हाय, पड़ पड़ राम - रय’,
कहे प्रभु गद्गद आख्याने ।
रामानन्द पड़े श्लोक, शुनि’ प्रभुर हर्ष - शोक,
आपने प्रभु करेन व्याख्याने ॥69॥
cc-antya-15.69.translation: In a faltering voice, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu again said, "Alas, go on reading, Rāma Rāya." Thus Rāmānanda Rāya began to read a verse. While listening to this verse, the Lord was sometimes very jubilant and sometimes overcome by lamentation. Afterwards the Lord personally explained the verse.

devanagari: एक - दिन करेन प्रभु जगन्नाथ दरशन ।
जगन्नाथे देखे साक्षात्व्रजेन्द्र - नन्दन ॥7॥
cc-antya-15.7.translation: One day, while Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was looking at Lord Jagannātha in the temple, Lord Jagannātha appeared to be personally the son of Nanda Mahārāja, Śrī Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: वीक्ष्यालकावृत - मुखं तव कुण्डल - श्री - गण्ड - स्थलाधर - सुधं हसितावलोकम् ।
दत्ताभयं च भुज - दण्ड - युगं विलोक्य वक्षः श्रियैक - रमणं च भवाम दास्यः ॥70॥
cc-antya-15.70.translation: "Dear Kṛṣṇa, by seeing Your beautiful face decorated with tresses of hair, by seeing the beauty of Your earrings falling on Your cheeks, and by seeing the nectar of Your lips, the beauty of Your smiling glances, Your two arms, which assure complete fearlessness, and Your broad chest, whose beauty arouses conjugal attraction, we have simply surrendered ourselves to becoming Your maidservants.'

lines: kṛṣṇa jini' padma-cānda, pātiyāche mukha phānda,
vraja-nārī āsi' āsi', phānde paḍi' haya dāsī,
devanagari: कृष्ण जिनि’ पद्म - चान्द, पातियाछे मुख फान्द
ताते अधर - मधु - स्मित चार ।
व्रज - नारी आ सि’ आसि’, फान्दे पड़ि’ हय दासी
छाड़ि’ लाज - पति - घर - द्वार ॥71॥
cc-antya-15.71.translation: "After conquering the moon and the lotus flower, Kṛṣṇa wished to capture the doelike gopīs. Thus He spread the noose of His beautiful face, and within that noose He placed the bait of His sweet smile to misguide the gopīs. The gopīs fell prey to that trap and became Kṛṣṇa's maidservants, giving up their homes, families, husbands and prestige.

devanagari: बान्धव कृष्ण करे व्याधेर आचार
नाहि माने धर्माधर्म, हरे नारी - मृगी - मर्म, ।
करे नाना उपाय ताहार ॥72॥
cc-antya-15.72.translation: "My dear friend, Kṛṣṇa acts just like a hunter. This hunter does not care for piety or impiety; He simply creates many devices to conquer the cores of the hearts of the doelike gopīs.

devanagari: गण्ड - स्थल झलमल, नाचे मकर - कुण्डल
सेइ नृत्ये हरे नारी - चय ।
सस्मित कटाक्ष - बाणे, ता - सबार हृदये हाने
नारी - वधे नाहि किछु भय ॥73॥
cc-antya-15.73.translation: "The earrings dancing on Kṛṣṇa's cheeks are shaped like sharks, and they shine very brightly. These dancing earrings attract the minds of all women. Over and above this, Kṛṣṇa pierces the hearts of women with the arrows of His sweetly smiling glances. He is not at all afraid to kill women in this way.

devanagari: अति उच्च सुविस्तार, लक्ष्मी - श्रीवत्स - अलङ्कार
कृष्णेर ये डाकातिया वक्ष ।
व्रज - देवी लक्ष लक्ष, ता - सबार मनो - वक्ष
हरि - दासी करिबारे दक्ष ॥74॥
cc-antya-15.74.translation: "On Kṛṣṇa's chest are the ornaments of Śrīvatsa and the mark indicating the residence of the goddess of fortune. His chest, which is as broad as a plunderer's, attracts thousands upon thousands of damsels of Vraja, conquering their minds and breasts by force. Thus they all become maidservants of the Supreme Personality of Godhead.

lines: dui śaila-chidre paiśe, nārīra hṛdaye daṁśe,
devanagari: सुललित दीर्घार्गल, कृष्णेर भुज - युगल,
भुज नहे, - कृष्ण - सर्प - काय ।
दुइ शैल - छिद्रे पैशे, नारीर हृदये दंशे,
मरे नारी से विष - ज्वालाय ॥75॥
cc-antya-15.75.translation: "The two very beautiful arms of Kṛṣṇa are just like long bolts. They also resemble the bodies of black snakes that enter the space between the two hill- The Transcendental Madness of Lord Caitanya like breasts of women and bite their hearts. The women then die from the burning poison.

devanagari: कृष्ण - कर - पद - तल, कोटि - चन्द्र - सुशीतल
जिनि’ कर्पूर - वेणा - मूल - चन्दन ।
एक - बार यार स्पर्शे, स्मर - ज्वाला - विष नाशे
यार स्पर्शे लुब्ध नारी - मन ॥76॥
cc-antya-15.76.translation: "The combined cooling effect of camphor, roots of khasakhasa and sandalwood is surpassed by the coolness of Kṛṣṇa's palms and the soles of His feet, which are cooler and more pleasing than millions upon millions of moons. If women are touched by them even once, their minds are enticed, and the burning poison of lusty desire for Kṛṣṇa is immediately vanquished."

lines: sei śloka paḍi' rādhā, viśākhāre kahe bādhā,
devanagari: एतेक विलाप क रि’ प्रेमावेशे गौरहरि ,
एइ अर्थे पड़े एक श्लोक ।
सेइ श्लोक प ड़ि’ राधा, विशाखारे कहे बाधा ,
उघाड़िया हृदयेर शोक ॥77॥
cc-antya-15.77.translation: Lamenting in ecstatic love, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then recited the following verse, which was spoken by Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī while exposing the lamentation of Her heart to Her friend Śrīmatī Viśākhā.

lines: sa me madana-mohanaḥ sakhi tanoti vakṣaḥ-spṛhām
devanagari: हरिमणि - कवाटिका - प्रतत - हारि - वक्षः - स्थलः स्मरार्त - तरुणी - मनः - कलुष - हारि - दोरर्गलः ।
सुधांशु - हरि - चन्दनोत्पल - सिताभ्र - शीताङ्गकः स मे मदन - मोहनः सखि तनोति वक्षः - स्पृहाम् ॥78॥
cc-antya-15.78.translation: "My dear friend, Kṛṣṇa's chest is as broad and attractive as a door made of indranīla gems, and His two arms, strong as bolts, can relieve the mental anguish of young girls distressed by lusty desires for Him. His body is cooler than the moon, sandalwood, the lotus flower and camphor. In this way, Madana-mohana, the attractor of Cupid, is increasing the desire of My breasts."

devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - “कृष्ण मुञि एखन - इ पाइनु ।
आपनार दुर्दैवे पुनः हाराइनु ॥79॥
cc-antya-15.79.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then said, "I just now had Kṛṣṇa, but unfortunately I have lost Him again.

devanagari: एक - बारे स्फुरे प्रभुर कृष्णेर पञ्च - गुण ।
पञ्च - गुणे करे पञ्चेन्द्रिय आकर्षण ॥8॥
cc-antya-15.8.translation: When He realized Lord Jagannātha to be Kṛṣṇa Himself, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's five senses were immediately absorbed in attraction for the five attributes of Lord Kṛṣṇa.

lines: dekhā diyā mana hari' kare antardhāne
devanagari: चञ्चल - स्वभाव कृष्णेर, ना रय एक - स्थाने ।
देखा दिया मन ह रि’ करे अन्तर्धाने ॥80॥
cc-antya-15.80.translation: "By nature, Kṛṣṇa is very restless; He does not stay in one place. He meets with someone, enchants his mind and then disappears.

devanagari: तासां तत्सौभग - मदं वीक्ष्य मानं च केशवः ।
प्रशमाय प्रसादाय तत्रैवान्तरधीयते ॥81॥
cc-antya-15.81.translation: “ 'The gopīs became proud of their great fortune. To subdue their sense of superiority and show them special favor, Keśava, the subduer of even Lord Brahmā and Lord Śiva, disappeared from the rāsa dance.' "

devanagari: स्वरूप - गोसाञि रे कहेन ,_“गाओ एक गीत ।
याते आमार हृदयेर हये त’ ‘सम्वित् ॥82॥
cc-antya-15.82.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then said to Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī: "Please sing a song that will bring consciousness to My heart."

devanagari: स्वरूप - गोसाञि तबे मधुर करिया ।
गीत - गोविन्देर पद गाय प्रभुरे शुनाञा ॥83॥
cc-antya-15.83.translation: Thus for the pleasure of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī began very sweetly singing the following verse from Gīta-govinda.

devanagari: रासे हरिमिह विहित - विलासम् ।
स्मरति मनो मम कृत - परिहासम् ॥84॥
cc-antya-15.84.translation: "Here in the arena of the rāsa dance, I remember Kṛṣṇa, who is always fond of joking and performing pastimes."

devanagari: स्वरूप - गोसाञि यबे एइ पद गाहिला ।
उठि’ प्रेमावेशे प्रभु नाचिते लागिला ॥85॥
cc-antya-15.85.translation: When Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī sang this special song, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu immediately got up and began to dance in ecstatic love.

devanagari: ‘अष्ट - सात्त्विक’ भाव अङ्गे प्रकट ह - इल ।
हर्षादि व्यभिचारी’ सब उथलिल ॥86॥
cc-antya-15.86.translation: At that time, all eight kinds of spiritual transformations became manifest in Lord Caitanya's body. The thirty-three symptoms of vyabhicārī-bhāva, beginning with lamentation and jubilation, became prominent as well.

devanagari: भावोदय, भाव - सन्धि, भाव - शाबल्य ।
भावे - भावे महा - युद्धे सबार प्राबल्य ॥87॥
cc-antya-15.87.translation: All the ecstatic symptoms, such as bhāvodaya, bhāva-sandhi and bhāva-śābalya, awakened in the body of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. A great fight arose between one emotion and another, and each of them became prominent.

lines: sei pada punaḥ punaḥ karāya gāyana
devanagari: सेइ पद पुनः पुनः कराय गायन ।
पुनः पुनः आस्वादये, करेन नर्तन ॥88॥
cc-antya-15.88.translation: Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu had Svarūpa Dāmodara sing the same verse again and again. Each time he sang it, the Lord tasted it anew, and thus He danced again and again.

devanagari: एइ - मत नृत्य यदि ह - इल बहु - क्षण ।
स्वरूप - गोसाञि पद कैला समापन ॥89॥
cc-antya-15.89.translation: After the Lord had been dancing for a long time, Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī stopped singing the verse.

devanagari: एक - मन पञ्च - दिके पञ्च - गुण टाने ।
टानाटानि प्रभुर मन हैल अगेयाने ॥9॥
cc-antya-15.9.translation: Just as in a tug-of-war, the single mind of Lord Caitanya was attracted in five directions by the five transcendental attributes of Lord Kṛṣṇa. Thus the Lord became unconscious.

lines: nā gāya svarūpa-gosāñi śrama dekhi' tāṅra
devanagari: ‘बल्’ ‘बल्’ बलि’ प्रभु कहेन बार - बार ।
ना गाय स्वरूप - गोसाञि श्रम दे खि’ ताँर ॥90॥
cc-antya-15.90.translation: Over and over again Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "Go on! Sing! Sing!" But Svarūpa Dāmodara, seeing the Lord's fatigue, did not resume singing.

devanagari: ‘बल्’ ‘बल्’ प्रभु बलेन, भक्त - गण शुनि’ ।
चौदिकेते सबे मेलि’ करे हरि - ध्वनि ॥91॥
cc-antya-15.91.translation: When the devotees heard Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu say, "Go on singing!" they all gathered around Him and began to chant the holy name of Hari in unison.

devanagari: रामानन्द - राय तबे प्रभुरे वसाइला ।
वीजनादि क रि’ प्रभुर श्रम घुचाइला ॥92॥
cc-antya-15.92.translation: At that time, Rāmānanda Rāya made the Lord sit down and dissipated His fatigue by fanning Him.

lines: prabhure lañā gelā sabe samudrera tīre
snāna karāñā punaḥ tāṅre lañā āilā ghare
devanagari: प्रभुरे लञा गेला सबे समुद्रेर तीरे ।
स्नान करा ञा पुनः ताँरे लञा आइला घरे ॥93॥
cc-antya-15.93.translation: Then all the devotees took Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to the beach and bathed Him. Finally they brought Him back home.

devanagari: भोजन करा ञा प्रभुरे कराइला शयन ।
रामानन्द - आदि सबे गेला निज - स्थान ॥94॥
cc-antya-15.94.translation: After they fed Him lunch, they made Him lie down. Then all the devotees, headed by Rāmānanda Rāya, returned to their respective homes.

devanagari: एइ त’ कहिलुँ प्रभुर उद्यान - विहार ।
वृन्दावन - भ्रमे याहाँ प्रवेश ताँहार ॥95॥
cc-antya-15.95.translation: Thus I have described Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's pastimes in the garden, which He entered, mistaking it for Vṛndāvana.

devanagari: प्रलाप सहित एइ उन्माद - वर्णन ।
श्री - रूप - गोसाञि इहा करियाछेन वर्णन ॥96॥
cc-antya-15.96.translation: There He exhibited transcendental madness and ecstatic ravings, which Śrī Rūpa Gosvāmī has described very nicely in his Stava-mālā as follows.

lines: sa caitanyaḥ kiṁ me punarapi dṛśor yāsyati padam
devanagari: पयो - राशेस्तीरे स्फुरदुपवनाली - कलनया मुहुर्वृन्दारण्य - स्मरण - जनित - प्रेम - विवशः ।
क्वचित्कृष्णावृत्ति - प्रचल - रसनो भक्ति - रसिकः स चैतन्यः किं मे पुनरपि दृशोर्यास्यति पदम् ॥97॥
cc-antya-15.97.translation: "Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is the topmost of all devotees. Sometimes, while walking on the beach, He would see a beautiful garden nearby and mistake it for the forest of Vṛndāvana. Thus He would be completely overwhelmed by ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa and begin to dance and chant the holy name. His tongue worked incessantly as He chanted, 'Kṛṣṇa! Kṛṣṇa!' Will He again become visible before the path of My eyes?"

devanagari: अनन्त चैतन्य - लीला ना याय लिखन।
दिंकू - मात्र देखाजा ताहा करिये सूचन ॥98॥
cc-antya-15.98.translation: The pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu are unlimited; it is not possible to write of them properly. I can only give an indication of them as I try to introduce them.

devanagari: श्री - रूप - रघुनाथ - पदे यार आश ।
चैतन्य चरितामृत कहे कृष्णदास ॥99॥
