विना - मूल्ये देय गन्ध, गन्ध दिया करे अन्ध
घर याइते पथ नाहि पा य” ॥98॥
cc-antya-19.98.translation: "The dramatic actor Madana-mohana has opened a shop of scents that attract the women of the world to be His customers. He delivers the scents freely, but they make the women all so blind they cannot find the path returning home."

lines: ei-mata gaurahari, gandhe kaila mana curi,
devanagari: एइ - मत गौरहरि, गन्धे कैल मन चुरि,
भृङ्ग - प्राय इति - उति धाय ।
याय वृक्ष - लता - पाशे, कृष्ण स्फुरे सेइ आशे,
कृष्ण ना पाय, गन्ध - मात्र पाय ॥99॥
cc-antya-19.99.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, His mind thus stolen by that scent, ran here and there like a bumblebee. He ran to the trees and plants, hoping that Lord Kṛṣṇa would appear, but instead He found only the scent of Kṛṣṇa's body.

devanagari: प्रेमोद्भावित - हर्षेर्ष्योद्वेग - दैन्यार्ति - मिश्रितम् ।
लपितं गौरचन्द्रस्य भाग्यवद्भिर्निषेव्यते ॥1॥
cc-antya-20.1.translation: Only the most fortunate will relish the mad words of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, which mixed with jubilation, envy, agitation, submissiveness and grief, all produced by ecstatic loving emotions.

devanagari: कृष्ण - वर्णं त्विषाकृष्णं साङ्गोपाङ्गात्र - पार्षदम् ।
यज्ञैः सङ्कीर्तन - प्रायैर्यजन्ति हि सु - मेधसः ॥10॥
cc-antya-20.10.translation: “ 'In the age of Kali, intelligent persons perform congregational chanting to worship the incarnation of Godhead who constantly sings the name of Kṛṣṇa. Although His complexion is not blackish, He is Kṛṣṇa Himself. He is accompanied by His associates, servants, weapons and confidential companions.'

lines: dambha kari bali' śrotā, nā kariha roṣa
devanagari: ना कहिले हय मोर कृत - घ्नता - दोष ।
दम्भ करि बलि’ श्रोता, ना करिह रोष ॥100॥
cc-antya-20.100.translation: If I did not disclose this fact, I would be guilty of ingratitude to the Lord. Therefore, my dear readers, please do not consider me too proud and be angry at me.

lines: tāte caitanya-līlā haila ye kichu likhana
devanagari: तोमा - सबार चरण - धूलि करिनु वन्दन ।
ताते चैतन्य - लीला हैल ये किछु लिखन ॥101॥
cc-antya-20.101.translation: It is because I have offered my prayers unto the lotus feet of all of you that whatever I have written about Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu has been possible.

devanagari: एबे अन्त्य - लीला - गणेर करि अनुवाद ।
‘अनुवाद’ कैले पाइ लीलार ‘आस्वाद’ ॥102॥
cc-antya-20.102.translation: Now let me repeat all the pastimes of the Antya-līlā, for if I do so I shall taste the pastimes again.

devanagari: प्रथम परिच्छेदे - रूपेर द्वितीय - मिलन ।
तार मध्ये दुइ - नाटकेर विधान - श्रवण ॥103॥
cc-antya-20.103.translation: The First Chapter describes how Rūpa Gosvāmī met Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu for the second time and how the Lord heard his two dramas [Vidagdha-mādhava and Lalita-mādhava].

lines: prabhu tāre kṛṣṇa kahāñā mukta karilā
devanagari: तार मध्ये शिवानन्द - सङ्गे कुक्कुर आइला ।
प्रभु तारे कृष्ण कहाञा मुक्त करिला ॥104॥
cc-antya-20.104.translation: That chapter also describes the incident of Śivānanda Sena's dog, who was induced by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to chant the holy name of Kṛṣṇa and was thus liberated.

devanagari: द्वितीये - छोट - हरिदासे कराइला शिक्षण ।
तार मध्ये शिवानन्देर आश्चर्य दर्शन ॥105॥
cc-antya-20.105.translation: In the Second Chapter the Lord instructively punished Junior Haridāsa. Also in that chapter is the wonderful vision of Śivānanda Sena.

devanagari: तृतीये - हरिदासेर महिमा प्रचण्ड ।
दामोदर - पण्डित कैला प्रभुरे वाक्य - दण्ड ॥106॥
cc-antya-20.106.translation: In the Third Chapter is a description of the forceful glories of Haridāsa Ṭhākura. That chapter also mentions how Dāmodara Paṇḍita spoke words of criticism to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: प्रभु ‘नाम’ दिया कैला ब्रह्माण्ड - मोचन ।
हरिदास करिला नामेर महिमा - स्थापन ॥107॥
cc-antya-20.107.translation: The Third Chapter also tells how Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu delivered everyone by bestowing upon the universe the holy name of the Lord, and it describes how Haridāsa Ṭhākura established the glories of the holy name by his practical example.

devanagari: चतुर्थे - श्री - सनातनेर द्वितीय - मिलन ।
देह - त्याग हैते ताँर करिला रक्षण ॥108॥
cc-antya-20.108.translation: The Fourth Chapter describes Sanātana Gosvāmī's second visit with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and how the Lord saved him from committing suicide.

devanagari: ज्यैष्ठ - मासेर धूपे ताँरे कैला परीक्षण ।
शक्ति सञ्चारिया पुनः पाठाइला वृन्दावन ॥109॥
cc-antya-20.109.translation: The Fourth Chapter also tells how Sanātana Gosvāmī was tested in the sunshine of Jyaiṣṭha [May and June] and was then empowered and sent back to Vṛndāvana.

devanagari: नाम - सङ्कीर्तन हैते सर्वानर्थ - नाश ।
सर्व - शुभोदय, कृष्ण - प्रेमेर उल्लास ॥11॥
cc-antya-20.11.translation: "Simply by chanting the holy name of Lord Kṛṣṇa, one can be freed from all undesirable habits. This is the means of awakening all good fortune and initiating the flow of waves of love for Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: पञ्चमे - प्रद्युम्न - मिश्रे प्रभु कृपा करिला ।
राय - द्वारा कृष्ण - कथा ताँरे शुनाइला ॥110॥
cc-antya-20.110.translation: In the Fifth Chapter, the Lord showed His favor to Pradyumna Miśra and made him hear topics of Kṛṣṇa from Rāmānanda Rāya.

devanagari: तार मध्ये ‘बाङ्गाल’ - कविर नाटक - उपेक्षण ।
स्वरूप - गोसाञि कैला विग्रहेर महिमा - स्थापन ॥111॥
cc-antya-20.111.translation: Also in that chapter, Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī rejected the drama of a poet from Bengal and established the glories of the Deity.

devanagari: षष्ठे - रघुनाथ - दास प्रभुरे मिलिला ।
नित्यानन्द - आज्ञाय चिड़ा - महोत्सव कैला ॥112॥
cc-antya-20.112.translation: The Sixth Chapter describes how Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī met Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and performed the chipped rice festival in accordance with Nityānanda Prabhu's order.

devanagari: दामोदर - स्वरूप - ठाञि ताँरे समर्पिल ।
cc-antya-20.113.translation: The Lord entrusted Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī to the care of Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī and gave Raghunātha dāsa the gift of a stone from Govardhana Hill and a garland of small conchshells.

devanagari: सप्तम - परिच्छेदे वल्लभ भट्टर मिलन ।
नाना - मते कैला ताँर गर्व खण्डन ॥114॥
cc-antya-20.114.translation: The Seventh Chapter tells how Śrī Caitanya met Vallabha Bhaṭṭa and dismantled his false pride in various ways.

lines: tāṅra bhaye kailā prabhu bhikṣā saṅkocana
devanagari: अष्टमे - रामचन्द्र - पुरीर आगमन ।
ताँर भये कैला प्रभु भिक्षा सङ्कोचन ॥115॥
cc-antya-20.115.translation: The Eighth Chapter describes the arrival of Rāmacandra Purī and how Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu minimized His eating due to fear of him.

devanagari: नवमे - गोपीनाथ - पट्टनायक - मोचन ।
त्रिजगतेर लोक प्रभुर पाइल दरशन ॥116॥
cc-antya-20.116.translation: In the Ninth Chapter is a description of how Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka was delivered and how the people of the three worlds were able to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: दशमे - कहिलुँ भक्त - दत्त - आस्वादन ।
राघव - पण्डितेर ताहाँ झालिर साजन ॥117॥
cc-antya-20.117.translation: In the Tenth Chapter I have described how Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu tasted the food given by His devotees, and I have also described the assortments in the bags of Rāghava Paṇḍita.

devanagari: तार मध्ये गोविन्देर कैला परीक्षण ।
तार मध्ये परिमुण्डा - नृत्येर वर्णन ॥118॥
cc-antya-20.118.translation: Also in that chapter is a description of how the Lord examined Govinda and how He danced in the temple.

devanagari: एकादशे - हरिदास - ठाकुरेर निर्याण ।
भक्त - वात्सल्य याहाँ देखाइला गौर भगवान् ॥119॥
cc-antya-20.119.translation: The Eleventh Chapter describes the disappearance of Haridāsa Ṭhākura and how Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, showed His affection for His devotees.

devanagari: चेतो - दर्पण - मार्जनं भव - महा - दावाग्नि - निर्वापणं श्रेयः - कैरव - चन्द्रिका - वितरणं विद्या - वधू - जीवनम् ।
आनन्दाम्बुधि - वर्धनं प्रति - पदं पूर्णामृतास्वादनं सर्वात्म - स्नपनं परं विजयते श्री - कृष्ण - सङ्कीर्तनम् ॥12॥
cc-antya-20.12.translation: "Let there be all victory for the chanting of the holy name of Lord Kṛṣṇa, which can cleanse the mirror of the heart and stop the miseries of the blazing fire of material existence. That chanting is the waxing moon that spreads the white lotus of good fortune for all living entities. It is the life and soul of all education. The chanting of the holy name of Kṛṣṇa expands the blissful ocean of transcendental life. It gives a cooling effect to everyone and enables one to taste full nectar at every step.

devanagari: द्वादशे - जगदानन्देर तैल - भञ्जन ।
नित्यानन्द कैला शिवानन्देरे ताड़न ॥120॥
cc-antya-20.120.translation: In the Twelfth Chapter are descriptions of how Jagadānanda Paṇḍita broke a pot of oil and how Lord Nityānanda chastised Śivānanda Sena.

devanagari: त्रयोदशे - जगदानन्द मथुरा याइ’ आइला ।
महाप्रभु देव - दासीर गीत शुनिला ॥121॥
cc-antya-20.121.translation: In the Thirteenth Chapter, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita went to Mathurā and returned, and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu by chance heard a song sung by a deva-dāsī dancing girl.

lines: prabhu tāṅre kṛpā kari' pāṭhāilā vṛndāvana
devanagari: रघुनाथ - भट्टाचार ताहाङिमिलन ।
प्रभु ताँरे कृपा करि’ पाठाइला वृन्दावन ॥122॥
cc-antya-20.122.translation: Also in the Thirteenth Chapter, Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa met Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who by His causeless mercy sent him to Vṛndāvana.

devanagari: चतुर्दशे - दिव्योन्माद - आरम्भ वर्णन ।
‘शरीर’ एथा प्रभुर, ‘मन’ गेला वृन्दावन ॥123॥
cc-antya-20.123.translation: The Fourteenth Chapter describes the beginning of the Lord's spiritual trance, in which His body was at Jagannātha Purī but His mind was in Vṛndāvana.

devanagari: तार मध्ये प्रभुर सिंह - द्वारे पतन ।
अस्थि - सन्धि - त्याग, अनुभावेर उद्गम ॥124॥
cc-antya-20.124.translation: Also in that chapter is a description of how Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu fell down in front of the Siṁha-dvāra gate of Jagannātha temple, His bones separated at the joints, and how various transcendental symptoms awakened.

devanagari: चटक - पर्वत दे खि’ प्रभुर धावन ।
तार मध्ये प्रभुर किछु प्रलाप - वर्णन ॥125॥
cc-antya-20.125.translation: Also in that chapter there is a description of how Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu ran toward Caṭaka-parvata and spoke like a madman.

devanagari: पञ्चदश - परिच्छेदे - उद्यान - विलासे ।
वृन्दावन - भ्रमे याहाँ करिला प्रवेशे ॥126॥
cc-antya-20.126.translation: In the Fifteenth Chapter is a description of how Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu entered a garden on the shore of the sea, mistaking the garden for Vṛndāvana.

devanagari: तार मध्ये प्रभुर पञ्चेन्द्रिय - आकर्षण ।
तार मध्ये करिला रासे कृष्ण - अन्वेषण ॥127॥
cc-antya-20.127.translation: Also in that chapter is a description of the attraction of Lord Caitanya's five senses to Kṛṣṇa and how He searched for Kṛṣṇa in the rāsa dance.

devanagari: षोड़शे - कालिदासे प्रभु कृपा करिला ।
वैष्णवोच्छिष्ट खाइबार फल देखाइला ॥128॥
cc-antya-20.128.translation: The Sixteenth Chapter tells how Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu showed His mercy to Kālidāsa and thus demonstrated the result of eating the remnants of the food of Vaiṣṇavas.

devanagari: शिवानन्देर बालके श्लोक कराइला ।
सिंह - द्वारे द्वारी प्रभुरे कृष्ण देखाइला ॥129॥
cc-antya-20.129.translation: It also describes how Śivānanda's son composed a verse and how the doorkeeper of the Siṁha-dvāra showed Kṛṣṇa to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: सङ्कीर्तन हैते पाप - संसार - नाशन ।
चित्त - शुद्धि, सर्व - भक्ति - साधन - उद्गम ॥13॥
cc-antya-20.13.translation: "By performing congregational chanting of the Hare Kṛṣṇa mantra, one can destroy the sinful condition of material existence, purify the unclean heart and awaken all varieties of devotional service.

devanagari: महा - प्रसादेर ताहाँ महिमा वर्णिला ।
कृष्णाधरामृतेर फल - श्लोक आस्वादिला ॥130॥
cc-antya-20.130.translation: Also in that chapter, the glories of mahā-prasāda are explained, and a verse is tasted describing the effect of nectar from the lips of Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: सप्तदशे - गाभी - मध्ये प्रभुर पतन ।
कूर्माकार - अनुभावेर ताहाडि उद्गम ॥131॥
cc-antya-20.131.translation: In the Seventeenth Chapter, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu fell among the cows and assumed the form of a tortoise as His ecstatic emotions awakened.

lines: "kā stry aṅga te" ślokera artha āveśe karilā
devanagari: कृष्णेर शब्द - गुणे प्रभुर मन आकर्षिला ।
“का स्त्रयङ्ग ते” श्लोकेर अर्थ आवेशे करिला ॥132॥
cc-antya-20.132.translation: Also in the Seventeenth Chapter, the attributes of Kṛṣṇa's sound attracted the mind of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who described in ecstasy the meaning of the "kā stry aṅga te" verse.

devanagari: भाव - शाबल्ये पुनः कैला प्रलपन ।
कर्णामृत - श्लोकेर अर्थ कैला विवरण ॥133॥
cc-antya-20.133.translation: Due to the conjunction of various ecstatic emotions, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu again began speaking like a madman and described in detail the meaning of a verse from Kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛta.

devanagari: अष्टाद श परिच्छेदे - समुद्रे पतन ।
कृष्ण - गोपी - जल - केलि ताहाँ दरशन ॥134॥
cc-antya-20.134.translation: In the Eighteenth Chapter, the Lord fell into the ocean, and in ecstasy He saw the pastimes of the water fight between Kṛṣṇa and the gopīs.

devanagari: ताहाङिदेखिला कृष्णेर वन्य - भोजन ।
जालिया उठाइल, प्रभु आइला स्व - भवन ॥135॥
cc-antya-20.135.translation: In that dream, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu saw Kṛṣṇa's picnic in the forest. As Lord Caitanya floated in the sea, a fisherman caught Him, and then the Lord returned to His own residence.

devanagari: ऊनविंशे - भित्त्ये प्रभुर मुख - सङ्घर्षण ।
कृष्णेर विरह - स्फूर्ति - प्रलाप - वर्णन ॥136॥
cc-antya-20.136.translation: In the Nineteenth Chapter is a description of how Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu rubbed His face against the walls and spoke like a madman because of separation from Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: वसन्त - रजनीते पुष्पोद्याने विहरण ।
कृष्णेर सौरभ्य - श्लोकेर अर्थ - विवरण ॥137॥
cc-antya-20.137.translation: That chapter also describes Kṛṣṇa's wandering in a garden on a spring night, and it fully describes the meaning of a verse about the scent of Kṛṣṇa's body.

devanagari: विंश - परिच्छेदे - निज - ‘शिक्षाष्टक’ पड़िया ।
तार अर्थ आस्वादिला प्रेमाविष्ट हञा ॥138॥
cc-antya-20.138.translation: In the Twentieth Chapter, Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu recited His own eight stanzas of instruction and tasted their meaning in ecstatic love.

devanagari: भक्ते शिखाइते येइ शिक्षाष्टक कहिला ।
सेइ श्लोकाष्टकेर अर्थ पुनः आस्वादिला ॥139॥
cc-antya-20.139.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu composed those eight stanzas to instruct the devotees, but He also personally tasted their meaning.

devanagari: कृष्ण - प्रेमोद्गम, प्रेमामृत - आस्वादन ।
कृष्ण - प्राप्ति, सेवामृत - समुद्रे मज्जन ॥14॥
cc-antya-20.14.translation: "The result of chanting is that one awakens his love for Kṛṣṇa and tastes transcendental bliss. Ultimately, one attains the association of Kṛṣṇa and engages in His devotional service, as if immersing himself in a great ocean of love."

devanagari: मुख्य - मुख्य - लीलार अर्थ करि लुँ कथन ।
‘अनुवाद’ हैते स्मरे ग्रन्थ - विवरण ॥140॥
cc-antya-20.140.translation: I have thus described the principal pastimes and their meaning, for by such repetition one can remember the descriptions in the book.

lines: mukhya-mukhya kahiluṅ, kathā nā yāya vistāra
devanagari: एक एक परिच्छेदेर कथा - अनेक - प्रकार ।
मुख्य - मुख्य कहिलुँ, कथा ना याय विस्तार ॥141॥
cc-antya-20.141.translation: In every chapter there are various topics, but I have selected only those that are principal, for not all of them could be described again.

devanagari: श्री - राधा - सह ‘श्री - मदन - मोहन’ ।
श्री - राधा - सह ‘श्री - गोविन्द’ - चरण ॥142॥
cc-antya-20.142-143.translation: The Vṛndāvana Deities of Madana-mohana with Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, Govinda with Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, and Gopīnātha with Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī are the life and soul of the Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇavas.

devanagari: श्रीकृष्ण - चैतन्य, श्री - युत नित्यानन्द ।
श्री - अद्वैत - आचार्य, श्री - गौर - भक्त - वृन्द ॥144॥
cc-antya-20.144-146.translation: So that my desires may be fulfilled, I place the lotus feet of these personalities on my head: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, with Lord Nityānanda, Advaita Ācārya and Their devotees, as well as Śrī Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, Śrī Rūpa Gosvāmī, Śrī Sanātana Gosvāmī, Śrī Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī, who is my spiritual master, and Śrīla Jīva Gosvāmī.

devanagari: सबार चरण - कृपा - ‘गुरु उपाध्यायी’ ।
मोर वाणी - शिष्या, तारे बहुत नाचाइ ॥147॥
cc-antya-20.147.translation: The mercy of their lotus feet is my spiritual master, and my words are my disciples that I have made dance in various ways.

lines: śiṣyāra śrama dekhi' guru nācāna rākhilā
devanagari: शिष्यार श्रम दे खि’ गुरु नाचान राखिला ।
‘कृपा’ ना नाचाय, ‘वाणी’ वसिया रहिला ॥148॥
cc-antya-20.148.translation: Seeing the fatigue of the disciples, the spiritual master has stopped making them dance, and because that mercy no longer makes them dance, my words now sit silently.

lines: anipuṇā vāṇī āpane nācite nā jāne
devanagari: अनिपुणा वाणी आपने नाचिते ना जाने ।
यत नाचाइला, नाचि’ करिला विश्रामे ॥149॥
cc-antya-20.149.translation: My inexperienced words do not know how to dance by themselves. The mercy of the guru made them dance as much as possible, and now, after dancing, they have taken rest.

lines: yāhāra artha śuni' saba yāya duḥkha-śoka
devanagari: उठिल विषाद, दैन्य, - पड़े आपन - श्लोक ।
याहार अर्थ शुनि’ सब याय दुःख - शोक ॥15॥
cc-antya-20.15.translation: Lamentation and humility awoke within Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and He began reciting another of His own verses. By hearing the meaning of that verse, one can forget all unhappiness and lamentation.

devanagari: सब श्रोता - गणेर करि चरण वन्दन ।
याँ - सबार चरण - कृपा - शुभेर कारण ॥150॥
cc-antya-20.150.translation: I now worship the lotus feet of all my readers, for by the mercy of their lotus feet there is all good fortune.

lines: tāṅra caraṇa dhuñā karoṅ muñi pāne
devanagari: चैतन्य - चरितामृत येइ जन शुने ।
ताँर चरण धुञा करों मुञि पाने ॥151॥
cc-antya-20.151.translation: If one hears the pastimes of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu as described in Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, I wash his lotus feet and drink the water.

lines: tomarā e-amṛta pile saphala haila śrama
devanagari: श्रोतार पद - रेणु करों मस्तक - भूषण ।
तोमरा ए - अमृत पिले सफल हैल श्रम ॥152॥
cc-antya-20.152.translation: I decorate my head with the dust of the lotus feet of my audience. Now you have all drunk this nectar, and therefore my labor is successful.

devanagari: श्री - रूप - रघुनाथ - पदे यार आश ।
चैतन्य - चरितामृत कहे कृष्णदास ॥153॥
cc-antya-20.153.translation: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.

devanagari: तदमल - पद - पद्ये भृङ्गतामेत्य सोऽयं ।
रसयति रसमुच्चैः प्रेम - माध्वीक - पूरम् ॥154॥
cc-antya-20.154.translation: Caitanya-caritāmṛta is filled with the activities of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who is the Supreme Personality of Godhead Himself. It invokes all good fortune and destroys everything inauspicious. If one tastes the nectar of Caitanya-caritāmṛta with faith and love, I become like a bumblebee tasting the honey of transcendental love from his lotus feet.

devanagari: श्रीमन्म दन - गोपाल - गोविन्ददेव तुष्टये ।
चैतन्यार्पितमस्त्वेतच्चैतन्य - चरितामृतम् ॥155॥
cc-antya-20.155.translation: Since this book, Caitanya-caritāmṛta, is now complete, having been written for the satisfaction of the most opulent Deities Madana-mohanajī and Govindajī, let it be offered at the lotus feet of Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanyadeva.

devanagari: परिमल - वासित - भुवनं स्व - रसोन्मादित - रसज्ञ - रोलम्बम् ।
गिरिधर - चरणाम्भो जं कः खलु रसिकः समीहते हातुम् ॥156॥
cc-antya-20.156.translation: Realized devotees are like bumblebees maddened by their own mellows at Kṛṣṇa's lotus feet. The scent of those lotus feet perfumes the entire world. Who is the realized soul that could give them up?

devanagari: शाके सिन्ध्वग्नि - वाणेन्दौ ज्यैष्ठे वृन्दावनान्तरे ।
सूर्याहेऽसित - पञ्चम्यां ग्रन्थोऽयं पूर्णतां गतः ॥157॥
cc-antya-20.157.translation: In Vṛndāvana in the year 1537, Śakābda Era, in the month of Jyaiṣṭha [May-June], on Sunday, the fifth day of the waning moon, this Caitanya-caritāmṛta has been completed.

devanagari: नाम्ना मकारि बहुधा निज - सर्व - शक्तिस् तत्रार्पिता नियमि तः स्मरणे न कालः ।
एतादृशी तव कृपा भगवन्ममापि दुर्दैवमीदृशमिहाजनि नानुरागः ॥16॥
cc-antya-20.16.translation: "My Lord, O Supreme Personality of Godhead, in Your holy name there is all good fortune for the living entity, and therefore You have many names, such as Kṛṣṇa and Govinda, by which You expand Yourself. You have invested all Your potencies in those names, and there are no hard and fast rules for remembering them. My dear Lord, although You bestow such mercy upon the fallen, conditioned souls by liberally teaching Your holy names, I am so unfortunate that I commit offenses while chanting the holy name, and therefore I do not achieve attachment for chanting.

devanagari: अनेक - लोकेर वाञ्छा - अनेक - प्रकार ।
कृपाते करिल अनेक - नामेर प्रचार ॥17॥
cc-antya-20.17.translation: "Because people vary in their desires, You have distributed various holy names by Your mercy.

lines: khāite śuite yathā tathā nāma laya
devanagari: खाइते शुइते यथा तथा नाम लय ।
काल - देश - नियम नाहि, सर्व सिद्धि हय ॥18॥
cc-antya-20.18.translation: "Regardless of time or place, one who chants the holy name, even while eating or sleeping, attains all perfection.

devanagari: “सर्व - शक्ति नामे दिला करिया विभाग।
आमार दुर्दैव, - नामे नाहि अनुराग!!” ॥19॥
cc-antya-20.19.translation: "You have invested Your full potencies in each individual holy name, but I am so unfortunate that I have no attachment for chanting Your holy names."

devanagari: जय जय गौरचन्द्र जय नित्यानन्द ।
जयाद्वैत - चन्द्र जय गौर - भक्त - वृन्द ॥2॥
cc-antya-20.2.translation: All glories to Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu! All glories to Lord Nityānanda! All glories to Advaitacandra! And all glories to all the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu!

devanagari: ये - रूपे लइले नाम प्रेम उपजय ।
ताहार लक्षण शुन, स्वरूप - राम - राय ॥20॥
cc-antya-20.20.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu continued, "O Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī and Rāmānanda Rāya, hear from Me the symptoms of how one should chant the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra to awaken very easily one's dormant love for Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: तृणादपि सु - नीचेन तरोरिव सहिष्णुना ।
अमानिना मान - देन कीर्तनीयः सदा हरिः ॥21॥
cc-antya-20.21.translation: "One who thinks himself lower than the grass, who is more tolerant than a tree, and who does not expect personal honor but is always prepared to give all respect to others can very easily always chant the holy name of the Lord.

devanagari: उत्तम ह ञा आपनाके माने तृणाधम ।
दुइ - प्रकारे सहिष्णुता करे वृक्ष - सम ॥22॥
cc-antya-20.22.translation: "These are the symptoms of one who chants the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra. Although he is very exalted, he thinks himself lower than the grass on the ground, and like a tree, he tolerates everything in two ways.

lines: vṛkṣa yena kāṭileha kichu nā bolaya
śukāñā maileha kāre pānī nā māgaya
devanagari: वृक्ष येन काटिलेह किछु ना बोलय ।
शुकाञा मैलेह कारे पानी ना मागय ॥23॥
cc-antya-20.23.translation: "When a tree is cut down, it does not protest, and even when drying up, it does not ask anyone for water.

lines: yei ye māgaye, tāre deya āpana-dhana
devanagari: येइ ये मागये, तारे देय आपन - धन ।
घर्म - वृष्टि सहे, आनेर करये रक्षण ॥24॥
cc-antya-20.24.translation: "The tree delivers its fruits, flowers and whatever it possesses to anyone and everyone. It tolerates scorching heat and torrents of rain, yet it still gives shelter to others.

devanagari: उत्तम ह ञा वैष्णव हबे निरभिमान ।
जीवे सम्मान दिले जा नि’ ‘कृष्ण’ - अधिष्ठान ॥25॥
cc-antya-20.25.translation: "Although a Vaiṣṇava is the most exalted person, he is prideless and gives all respect to everyone, knowing everyone to be the resting place of Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: एइ - मत ह ञा येइ कृष्ण - नाम लय ।
श्री कृष्ण - चरणे ताँर प्रेम उपजय ॥26॥
cc-antya-20.26.translation: "If one chants the holy name of Lord Kṛṣṇa in this manner, he will certainly awaken his dormant love for Kṛṣṇa's lotus feet."

devanagari: कहिते कहिते प्रभुर दैन्य बाड़िला ।
‘शुद्ध - भक्ति’ कृष्ण - ठाञि मागिते लागिला ॥27॥
cc-antya-20.27.translation: As Lord Caitanya spoke in this way, His humility increased, and He began praying to Kṛṣṇa that He could discharge pure devotional service.

devanagari: प्रेमेर स्वभाव - याहाँ प्रेमेर सम्बन्ध ।
सेइ माने , - ’कृष्णे मो र नाहि प्रेम - गन्ध’ ॥28॥
cc-antya-20.28.translation: Wherever there is a relationship of love of Godhead, its natural symptom is that the devotee does not think himself a devotee. Instead, he always thinks that he has not even a drop of love for Kṛṣṇa.

lines: na dhanaṁ na janaṁ na sundarīṁ
devanagari: न धनं न जनं न सुन्दरीं कवितां वा जगदीश कामये ।
मम जन्मनि जन्मनीश्वरे भवताद्भक्तिरहैतुकी त्वयि ॥29॥
cc-antya-20.29.translation: "O Lord of the universe, I do not desire material wealth, materialistic followers, a beautiful wife or fruitive activities described in flowery language. All I want, life after life, is unmotivated devotional service to You.

devanagari: एइ - मत महाप्रभु वैसे नीलाचले ।
रजनी - दिवसे कृष्ण - विरहे विह्वले ॥3॥
cc-antya-20.3.translation: While Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu thus resided at Jagannātha Purī [Nīlācala], He was continuously overwhelmed, night and day, by separation from Kṛṣṇa.

lines: dhana, jana nāhi māgoṅ, kavitā sundarī
devanagari: “धन, जन नाहि मागों, कविता सुन्दरी ।
‘शुद्ध - भक्ति’ देह’ मोरे, कृष्ण कृपा करि” ॥30॥
cc-antya-20.30.translation: "My dear Lord Kṛṣṇa, I do not want material wealth from You, nor do I want followers, a beautiful wife or the results of fruitive activities. I only pray that by Your causeless mercy You give Me pure devotional service to You, life after life.

devanagari: अति - दैन्ये पुनः मागे दास्य - भक्ति - दान ।
आपनारे करे संसारी जीव - अभिमान ॥31॥
cc-antya-20.31.translation: In great humility, considering Himself a conditioned soul of the material world, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu again expressed His desire to be endowed with service to the Lord.

devanagari: अयि नन्द - तनुज किङ्करं पतितं मां विषमे भवाम्बुधौ ।
कृपया तव पाद - पङ्कज - स्थित - धूली - सदृशं विचिन्तय ॥32॥
cc-antya-20.32.translation: "Oh, My Lord, O Kṛṣṇa, son of Mahārāja Nanda, I am Your eternal servant, but because of My own fruitive acts, I have fallen in this horrible ocean of nescience. Now please be causelessly merciful to Me. Consider Me a particle of dust at Your lotus feet.

devanagari: “तोमार नित्य - दास मुइ, तोमा पासरिया ।
पड़ियाछों भवार्णवे माया - बद्ध हञा ॥33॥
cc-antya-20.33.translation: "I am Your eternal servant, but I forgot Your Lordship. Now I have fallen in the ocean of nescience and have been conditioned by the external energy.

devanagari: कृपा करि’ कर मोरे पद - धूलि - सम ।
तोमार सेवक करों तोमार सेवन” ॥34॥
cc-antya-20.34.translation: "Be causelessly merciful to Me by giving Me a place with the particles of dust at Your lotus feet so that I may engage in the service of Your Lordship as Your eternal servant."

devanagari: पुनः अति - उत्कण्ठा, दैन्य ह - इल उद्गम ।
कृष्ण - ठाञि मागे प्रेम - नाम - सङ्कीर्तन ॥35॥
cc-antya-20.35.translation: Natural humility and eagerness then awoke in Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. He prayed to Kṛṣṇa to be able to chant the mahā-mantra in ecstatic love.

devanagari: नयनं गलदश्रु - धारया वदनं गद्गद - रुद्धया गिरा ।
पुलकैर्निचितं वपुः कदा तव नाम - ग्रहणे भविष्यति ॥36॥
cc-antya-20.36.translation: "My dear Lord, when will My eyes be beautified by filling with tears that constantly glide down as I chant Your holy name? When will My voice falter and all the hairs on My body stand erect in transcendental happiness as I chant Your holy name?

devanagari: “प्रेम - धन विना व्यर्थ दरिद्र जीवन ।
‘दास’ करि’ वेतन मोरे देह प्रेम - धन” ॥37॥
cc-antya-20.37.translation: "Without love of Godhead, My life is useless. Therefore I pray that You accept Me as Your servant and give Me the salary of ecstatic love of God."

devanagari: रसान्तरावेशे ह - इल वियोग - स्फुरण ।
उद्वेग, विषाद, दैन्ये करे प्रलपन ॥38॥
cc-antya-20.38.translation: Separation from Kṛṣṇa awoke various mellows of distress, lamentation and humility. Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu spoke like a crazy man.

devanagari: युगायितं निमेषेण चक्षुषा प्रावृषायितम् ।
शून्यायितं जगत्सर्वं गोविन्द - विरहेण मे ॥39॥
cc-antya-20.39.translation: "My Lord Govinda, because of separation from You, I consider even a moment a great millennium. Tears flow from My eyes like torrents of rain, and I see the entire world as void.

devanagari: स्वरूप, रामानन्द , - एइ दुइजन - सने ।
रात्रि - दिने रस - गीत - श्लोक आस्वादने ॥4॥
cc-antya-20.4.translation: Day and night He tasted transcendental blissful songs and verses with two associates, namely Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī and Rāmānanda Rāya.

devanagari: उद्वेगे दिवस ना याय, ‘क्षण’ हैल ‘युग’ - सम ।
वर्षार मेघ - प्राय अश्रु वरिषे नयन ॥40॥
cc-antya-20.40.translation: "In My agitation, a day never ends, for every moment seems like a millennium. Pouring incessant tears, My eyes are like clouds in the rainy season.

devanagari: गोविन्द - विरहे शून्य ह - इल त्रिभुवन ।
तुषानले पोड़े, - येन ना याय जीवन ॥41॥
cc-antya-20.41.translation: "The three worlds have become void because of separation from Govinda. I feel as if I were burning alive in a slow fire.

devanagari: कृष्ण उदासीन ह - इला करिते परीक्षण ।
सखी सब कहे , - ’कृष्णे कर उपेक्षण’ ॥42॥
cc-antya-20.42.translation: "Lord Kṛṣṇa has become indifferent to Me just to test My love, and My friends say,'Better to disregard Him.' "

devanagari: एतेक चिन्तिते राधार निर्मल हृदय ।
स्वाभाविक प्रेमार स्वभाव करिल उदय ॥43॥
cc-antya-20.43.translation: While Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī was thinking in this way, the characteristics of natural love became manifest because of Her pure heart.

devanagari: ईर्ष्या, उत्कण्ठा, दैन्य, प्रौढ़ि, विनय ।
एत भाव एक - ठाञि करिल उदय ॥44॥
cc-antya-20.44.translation: The ecstatic symptoms of envy, great eagerness, humility, zeal and supplication all became manifest at once.

lines: eta bhāve rādhāra mana asthira ha-ilā
devanagari: एत भावे राधार मन अस्थिर ह - इला ।
सखी - गण - आगे प्रौढ़ि - श्लोक ये पड़िला ॥45॥
cc-antya-20.45.translation: In that mood, the mind of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī was agitated, and therefore She spoke a verse of advanced devotion to Her gopī friends.

lines: sei bhāve prabhu sei śloka uccārilā
devanagari: सेइ भावे प्रभु सेइ श्लोक उच्चारिला ।
श्लोक उच्चारिते तद्रूप आपने ह - इला ॥46॥
cc-antya-20.46.translation: In the same spirit of ecstasy, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu recited that verse, and as soon as He did so, He felt like Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī.

devanagari: आश्लिष्य वा पाद - रतां पिनष्टु माम् अदर्शनान्मर्म - हतां करोतु वा ।
यथा तथा वा विदधातु लम्पटो मत्प्राण - नाथस्तु स एव नापरः ॥47॥
cc-antya-20.47.translation: "Let Kṛṣṇa tightly embrace this maidservant, who has fallen at His lotus feet. Let Him trample Me or break My heart by never being visible to Me. He is a debauchee, after all, and can do whatever He likes, but He is still no one other than the worshipable Lord of My heart.

lines: kibā nā deya daraśana, jārena mora tanu-mana,
devanagari: “आमि - कृष्ण - पद - दासी, तेंहो - रस - सुख - राशि
आलिङ्गिया करे आत्म - साथ ।
किबा ना देय दरशन, जारेन मोर तनु - मन
तबु तेंहो - मोर प्राण - नाथ ॥48॥
cc-antya-20.48.translation: "I am a maidservant at the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa. He is the embodiment of transcendental happiness and mellows. If He likes He can tightly embrace Me and make Me feel oneness with Him, or by not giving Me His audience, He may corrode My mind and body. Nevertheless, it is He who is the Lord of My life.

lines: sakhi he, śuna mora manera niścaya
kibā anurāga kare, kibā duḥkha diyā māre,
devanagari: सखि हे, शुन मोर मनेर निश्चय
किबा अनुराग करे, किबा दुःख दिया मारे, ।
मोर प्राणेश्वर कृष्ण - अन्य नय ॥49॥
cc-antya-20.49.translation: "My dear friend, just hear the decision of My mind. Kṛṣṇa is the Lord of My life in all conditions, whether He shows Me affection or kills Me by giving Me unhappiness.

lines: nānā-bhāva uṭhe prabhura harṣa, śoka, roṣa
devanagari: नाना - भाव उठे प्रभुर हर्ष, शोक, रोष ।
दैन्योद्वेग - आर्ति उत्कण्ठा, सन्तोष ॥5॥
cc-antya-20.5.translation: He relished the symptoms of various transcendental emotions such as jubilation, lamentation, anger, humility, anxiety, grief, eagerness and satisfaction.

lines: chāḍi' anya nārī-gaṇa, mora vaśa tanu-mana,
tā-sabāre deya pīḍā, āmā-sane kare krīḍā,
devanagari: छाड़ि’ अन्य नारी - गण, मोर वश तनु - मन
मोर सौभाग्य प्रकट करिया ।
ता - सबारे देय पीड़ा, आमा - सने करे क्रीड़ा
सेइ नारी - गणे देखा ञा ॥50॥
cc-antya-20.50.translation: "Sometimes Kṛṣṇa gives up the company of other gopīs and becomes controlled, mind and body, by Me. Thus He manifests My good fortune and gives others distress by performing His loving affairs with Me.

lines: kibā teṅho lampaṭa, śaṭha, dhṛṣṭa, sakapaṭa,
more dite manaḥ-pīḍā, mora āge kare krīḍā,
devanagari: किबा तेंहो लम्पट, शठ, धृष्ट, सकपट ,
अन्य नारी - गण क रि’ साथ।
मोरे दिते मनः - पीड़ा, मोर आगे करे क्रीड़ा ,
तबु तेंहो - मोर प्राण - नाथ ॥51॥
cc-antya-20.51.translation: "Or, since after all He is a very cunning, obstinate debauchee with a propensity to cheat, He takes to the company of other women. He then indulges in loving affairs with them in front of Me to give distress to My mind. Nevertheless, He is still the Lord of My life.

lines: nā gaṇi āpana-duḥkha, sabe vāñchi tāṅra sukha,
more yadi diyā duḥkha, tāṅra haila mahā-sukha,
devanagari: ना गणि आपन - दुःख, सबे वाञ्छि ताँर सुख
ताँर सुख - आमार तात्पर्य ।
मोरे यदि दिया दुःख, ताँर हैल महा - सुख
सेइ दुःख - मोर सुख - वर्यं ॥52॥
cc-antya-20.52.translation: "I do not mind My personal distress. I only wish for the happiness of Kṛṣṇa, for His happiness is the goal of My life. However, if He feels great happiness in giving Me distress, that distress is the best of My happiness.

lines: ye nārīre vāñche kṛṣṇa, tāra rūpe satṛṣṇa,
mui tāra pāya paḍi', lañā yāṅa hāte dhari',
devanagari: ये नारीरे वाञ्छे कृष्ण, तार रूपे सतृष्ण
तारे ना पाञा हय दुःखी ।
मुइ तार पाय पड़ि’, लञा याङ हाते ध रि’
क्रीड़ा करा ञा ताँरे करों सुखी ॥53॥
cc-antya-20.53.translation: "If Kṛṣṇa, attracted by the beauty of some other woman, wants to enjoy with her but is unhappy because He cannot get her, I fall down at her feet, catch her hand and bring her to Kṛṣṇa to engage her for His happiness.

lines: kāntā kṛṣṇe kare roṣa, kṛṣṇa pāya santoṣa,
yathā-yogya kare māna, kṛṣṇa tāte sukha pāna,
devanagari: कान्ता कृष्णे करे रोष, कृष्ण पाय सन्तोष
सुख पाय ताड़न - भर्सने ।
यथा - योग्य करे मान, कृष्ण ताते सुख पान
छाड़े मान अल्प - साधने ॥54॥
cc-antya-20.54.translation: "When a beloved gopī shows symptoms of anger toward Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa is very satisfied. Indeed, He is pleased when chastised by such a gopī. She shows her pride suitably, and Kṛṣṇa enjoys that attitude. Then she gives up her pride with a little endeavor.

lines: sei nārī jīye kene, kṛṣṇa-marma vyathā jāne,
nija-sukhe māne kāja, paḍuka tāra śire vāja,
devanagari: सेइ नारी जीये केने, कृष्ण - मर्म व्यथा जाने
तबु कृष्णे करे गाढ़ रोष ।
निज - सुखे माने काज, पडुक तार शिरे वाज
कृष्णेर मात्र चाहिये सन्तोष ॥55॥
cc-antya-20.55.translation: "Why does a woman continue to live who knows that Kṛṣṇa's heart is unhappy but who still shows her deep anger toward Him? She is interested in her own happiness. I condemn such a woman to be struck on the head with a thunderbolt, for we simply want the happiness of Kṛṣṇa.

lines: ye gopī mora kare dveṣe, kṛṣṇera kare santoṣe,
mui tāra ghare yāñā, tāre sevoṅ dāsī hañā,
devanagari: ये गोपी मोर करे द्वेषे, कृष्णेर करे सन्तोषे
कृष्ण यारे करे अभिलाष ।
मुइ तार घरे याञा, तारे सेवों दासी ह ञा
तबे मोर सुखेर उल्लास ॥56॥
cc-antya-20.56.translation: "If a gopī envious of Me satisfies Kṛṣṇa and Kṛṣṇa desires her, I shall not hesitate to go to her house and become her maidservant, for then My happiness will be awakened.

lines: stambhila sūryera gati, jīyāila mṛta pati,
devanagari: कुष्ठी - विप्रेर रमणी, पतिव्रता - शिरोमणि
पति ला गि’ कैला वेश्यार सेवा ।
स्तम्भिल सूर्येर गति, जीयाइल मृत पति
तुष्ट कैल मुख्य तिन - देवा ॥57॥
cc-antya-20.57.translation: "The wife of a brāhmaṇa suffering from leprosy manifested herself as the topmost of all chaste women by serving a prostitute to satisfy her husband. She thus stopped the movement of the sun, brought her dead husband back to life and satisfied the three principal demigods [Brahmā, Viṣṇu and Maheśvara].

lines: hṛdaya-upare dharoṅ, sevā kari' sukhī karoṅ,
devanagari: “कृष्ण - मोर जीवन, कृष्ण - मोर प्राण - धन
कृष्ण - मोर प्राणेर पराण ।
हृदय - उपरे धरों, सेवा क रि’ सुखी करों
एइ मोर सदा रहे ध्यान ॥58॥
cc-antya-20.58.translation: "Kṛṣṇa is My life and soul. Kṛṣṇa is the treasure of My life. Indeed, Kṛṣṇa is the very life of My life. I therefore keep Him always in My heart and try to please Him by rendering service. That is My constant meditation.

devanagari: मोर सुख - सेवने, कृष्णेर सुख - सङ्गमे
अतएव देह देङदान ।
कृष्ण मोरे ‘कान्ता’ करि’, कहे मोरे ‘प्राणेश्व रि’
मोर हय ‘दासी’ - अभिमान ॥59॥
cc-antya-20.59.translation: "My happiness is in the service of Kṛṣṇa, and Kṛṣṇa's happiness is in union with Me. For this reason, I give My body in charity to the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa, who accepts Me as His loved one and calls Me His most beloved. It is then that I consider Myself His maidservant.

devanagari: सेइ सेइ भावे निज - श्लोक पड़िया ।
श्लोकेर अर्थ आस्वादये दुइ - बन्धु लञा ॥6॥
cc-antya-20.6.translation: He would recite His own verses, expressing their meanings and emotions, and thus enjoy tasting them with these two friends.

devanagari: कान्त - सेवा - सुख - पूर, सङ्गम हैते सुमधुर
ताते साक्षी लक्ष्मी ठाकुराणी ।
नारायण - हृदि स्थिति, तबु पाद - सेवाय मति
सेवा करे ‘दासी’ - अभिमानी ॥60॥
cc-antya-20.60.translation: "Service to My lover is the home of happiness and is more sweet than direct union with Him. The goddess of fortune is evidence of this, for although she constantly lives on the heart of Nārāyaṇa, she wants to render service to His lotus feet. She therefore considers herself a maidservant and serves Him constantly."

lines: bhāve mana nahe sthira, sāttvike vyāpe śarīra,
devanagari: एइ राधार वचन, विशुद्ध - प्रेम - लक्षण
आस्वादये श्री - गौर - राय ।
भावे मन नहे स्थिर, सात्त्विके व्यापे शरीर
मन - देह धरण ना याय ॥61॥
cc-antya-20.61.translation: These statements by Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī show the symptoms of pure love for Kṛṣṇa tasted by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. In that ecstatic love, His mind was unsteady. Transformations of transcendental love spread throughout His entire body, and He could not sustain His body and mind.

lines: se prema jānā'te loke, prabhu kailā ei śloke,
devanagari: व्रजेर विशुद्ध - प्रेम, - येन जाम्बू - नद हेम
आत्म - सुखेर याहाँ नाहि गन्ध ।
से प्रेम जाना’ते लोके, प्रभु कैला एइ श्लोके
पदे कैला अर्थेर निर्बन्ध ॥62॥
cc-antya-20.62.translation: The pure devotional service in Vṛndāvana is like the golden particles in the River Jāmbū. In Vṛndāvana there is not a trace of personal sense gratification. It is to advertise such pure love in this material world that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu has written the previous verse and explained its meaning.

devanagari: एइ - मत महाप्रभु भावाविष्ट हञा ।
प्रलाप करिला तत् तत् श्लोक पड़िया ॥63॥
cc-antya-20.63.translation: Thus overwhelmed by ecstatic love, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu spoke like a madman and recited suitable verses.

lines: pūrve aṣṭa-śloka kari' loke śikṣā dilā
devanagari: पूर्वे अष्ट - श्लोक क रि’ लोके शिक्षा दिला ।
सेइ अष्ट - श्लोकेर अर्थ आपने आस्वादिला ॥64॥
cc-antya-20.64.translation: The Lord had formerly composed these eight verses to teach people in general. Now He personally tasted the meaning of the verses, which are called the Śikṣāṣṭaka.

devanagari: प्रभुर ‘शिक्षाष्टक’ - श्लोक येइ पड़े, शुने ।
कृष्णे प्रेम - भक्ति तार बाड़े दिने - दिने ॥65॥
cc-antya-20.65.translation: If anyone recites or hears these eight verses of instruction by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, his ecstatic love and devotion for Kṛṣṇa increase day by day.

devanagari: यद्यपिह प्रभु कोटी - समुद्र - गम्भीर ।
नाना - भाव - चन्द्रोदये हयेन अस्थिर ॥66॥
cc-antya-20.66.translation: Although Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is as deep and grave as millions of oceans, when the moon of His various emotions rises, He becomes restless.

devanagari: येइ येइ श्लोक जयदेव, भागवते ।
रायेर नाटके, येइ आर कर्णामृते ॥67॥
cc-antya-20.67-68.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu read the verses of Jayadeva's Gīta-govinda, of Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, of Rāmānanda Rāya's drama Jagannātha-vallabha-nāṭaka and of Bilvamaṅgala Ṭhākura's Kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛta, He was overwhelmed by the various ecstatic emotions of those verses. Thus He tasted their purports.

devanagari: द्वादश वत्सर ऐछे दशा - रात्रि - दिने ।
कृष्ण - रस आस्वादये दुइ - बन्धु - सने ॥69॥
cc-antya-20.69.translation: For twelve years, Śrī Caitanya remained in that state day and night. With His two friends, He tasted the meaning of those verses, which consist of nothing but the transcendental bliss and mellows of Kṛṣṇa consciousness.

devanagari: कोन दिने कोन भावे श्लोक - पठन ।
सेइ श्लोक आस्वादिते रात्रि - जागरण ॥7॥
cc-antya-20.7.translation: Sometimes the Lord would be absorbed in a particular emotion and would stay awake all night reciting related verses and relishing their taste.

devanagari: सेइ सब लीला - रस आपने अनन्त ।
सहस्र - वदने वर्णि’ नाहि पान अन्त ॥70॥
cc-antya-20.70.translation: Even Anantadeva, who has thousands of faces, could not reach the end of describing the transcendental bliss of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's pastimes.

lines: jīva kṣudra-buddhi kon tāhā pāre varṇite?
tāra eka kaṇā sparśi āpanā śodhite
devanagari: जीव क्षुद्र - बुद्धि को ताहा पारे वर्णिते?।
तार एक कणा स्प र्शि आपना शोधिते ॥71॥
cc-antya-20.71.translation: How, then, could an ordinary living being with very little intelligence describe such pastimes? Nevertheless, I am trying to touch but a particle of them just to rectify my own self.

lines: sei saba varṇite grantha haya suvistāra
devanagari: यत चेष्टा, यत प्रलाप , - नाहि पारावार ।
सेइ सब वर्णिते ग्रन्थ हय सुविस्तार ॥72॥
cc-antya-20.72.translation: There is no limit to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's activities and His words of madness. Therefore describing them all would greatly increase the size of this book.

devanagari: वृन्दावन - दास प्रथम ये लीला वर्णिल ।
सेइ - सब लीलार आमि सूत्र - मात्र कैल ॥73॥
cc-antya-20.73.translation: Whatever pastimes Śrīla Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura has first described I have merely summarized.

devanagari: ताँर त्यक्त ‘अवशेष’ सङ्क्षेपे कहिल ।
लीलार बाहुल्ये ग्रन्थ तथापि बाड़िल ॥74॥
cc-antya-20.74.translation: I have only very briefly described the pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu not described by Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura. Nevertheless, because those transcendental pastimes are so numerous, the size of this book has increased.

lines: ataeva sei-saba līlā nā pāri varṇibāre
devanagari: अतएव सेइ - सब लीला ना पारि वर्णिबारे ।
समाप्ति करिलुँ लीलाके क रि’ नमस्कारे ॥75॥
cc-antya-20.75.translation: It is impossible to describe all the pastimes elaborately. I shall therefore end this description and offer them my respectful obeisances.

devanagari: ये किछु करिलुँ एइ दिग्दरशन ।
एइ अनुसारे हबे तार आस्वादन ॥76॥
cc-antya-20.76.translation: What I have described gives merely an indication, but by following this indication one may obtain a taste of all the pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: buddhi-praveśa nāhi tāte, nā pāri varṇite
devanagari: प्रभुर गम्भीर - लीला ना पारि बुझिते ।
बुद्धि - प्रवेश नाहि ताते, ना पारि वर्णिते ॥77॥
cc-antya-20.77.translation: I cannot understand the very deep, meaningful pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. My intelligence cannot penetrate them, and therefore I could not properly describe them.

devanagari: सब श्रोता वैष्णवेर वन्दिया चरण ।
चैतन्य - चरित्र - वर्णन कैलुँ समापन ॥78॥
cc-antya-20.78.translation: After offering my respectful obeisances to the lotus feet of all my Vaiṣṇava readers, I shall therefore end this description of the characteristics of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: yāra yata śakti, tata kare ārohaṇa
devanagari: आकाश - अनन्त, ताते यैछे पक्षि - गण ।
यार यत शक्ति, तत करे आरोहण ॥79॥
cc-antya-20.79.translation: The sky is unlimited, but many birds fly higher and higher according to their own abilities.

devanagari: हर्षे प्रभु कहेन, - “शुन स्वरूप - राम - राय ।
नाम - सङ्कीर्तन - कलौ परम उपाय ॥8॥
cc-antya-20.8.translation: In great jubilation, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "My dear Svarūpa Dāmodara and Rāmānanda Rāya, know from Me that chanting of the holy names is the most feasible means of salvation in this age of Kali.

devanagari: ऐछे महाप्रभुर लीला - नाहि ओर - पार ।
‘जीव’ हञा केबा सम्यक् पारे वर्णिबार? ॥80॥
cc-antya-20.80.translation: The pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu are like the unlimited sky. How, then, can an ordinary living being describe them all?

lines: samudrera madhye yena eka kaṇa chuṅiluṅ
devanagari: यावत् बुद्धिर गति, ततेक वर्णि लुँ ।
समुद्रेर मध्ये येन एक कण छुडिलुँ ॥81॥
cc-antya-20.81.translation: I have tried to describe them as far as my intelligence allows, as if trying to touch a drop in the midst of a great ocean.

devanagari: नित्यानन्द - कृपा - पात्र - वृन्दावन - दास ।
चैतन्य - लीलाय तेंहो हयेन ‘आदि - व्यास’ ॥82॥
cc-antya-20.82.translation: Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura is Lord Nityānanda's favorite devotee, and therefore he is the original Vyāsadeva in describing the pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: tāṅra āge yadyapi saba līlāra bhāṇḍāra
devanagari: ताँर आगे यद्यपि सब लीलार भाण्डार ।
तथापि अल्प वर्णिया छाड़िलेन आर ॥83॥
cc-antya-20.83.translation: Although Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura has within his jurisdiction the full store of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's pastimes, he has left aside most of them and described but a small portion.

lines: ye kichu varṇiluṅ, seha saṅkṣepa kariyā
likhite nā pārena, tabu rākhiyāchena likhiyā
devanagari: ये किछु वर्णिलुँ, सेह सङ्क्षेप करिया ।
लिखिते ना पारेन, तबु राखियाछेन लिखिया ॥84॥
cc-antya-20.84.translation: What I have described was left aside by Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura, but although he could not describe these pastimes, he gave us a synopsis.

devanagari: चैतन्य - मङ्गले तेंहो लिखियाछे स्थाने - स्थाने ।
सेइ वचन शुन, सेइ परम - प्रमाणे ॥85॥
cc-antya-20.85.translation: In his book named Caitanya-maṅgala [Caitanya-bhāgavata], he has described these pastimes in many places. I request my readers to hear that book, for that is the best evidence.

lines: saṅkṣepe kahiluṅ, vistāra nā yāya kathane
devanagari: सङ्क्षेपे कहिलुँ, विस्तार ना याय कथने ।
विस्तारिया वेद - व्यास करिब वर्णने ॥86॥
cc-antya-20.86.translation: I have described the pastimes very briefly, for it is impossible for me to describe them in full. In the future, however, Vedavyāsa will describe them elaborately.

devanagari: चैतन्य - मङ्गले इहा लिखियाछे स्थाने - स्थाने ।
सत्य कहेन , - ‘आगे व्यास करिब वर्णने’ ॥87॥
cc-antya-20.87.translation: In Caitanya-maṅgala, Śrīla Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura has stated in many places the factual truth that in the future Vyāsadeva will describe them elaborately.

lines: tṛṣṇānurūpa jhārī bhari' teṅho kailā pāna
devanagari: चैतन्य - लीलामृत - सिन्धु - दुग्धाब्धि - समान ।
तृष्णानुरूप झारी भरि’ तेंहो कैला पान ॥88॥
cc-antya-20.88.translation: The ocean of nectarean pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is like the ocean of milk. According to his thirst, Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura filled his pitcher and drank from that ocean.

lines: tateke bharila peṭa, tṛṣṇā mora gelā
devanagari: ताँर झारी - शेषामृत किछु मोरे दिला ।
ततेके भरिल पेट, तृष्णा मोर गेला ॥89॥
cc-antya-20.89.translation: Whatever remnants of milk Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura has given me are sufficient to fill my belly. Now my thirst is completely satiated.

lines: sei ta' sumedhā pāya kṛṣṇera caraṇa
devanagari: सङ्कीर्तन - यज्ञे कलौ कृष्ण - आराधन ।
सेइ त’ सुमेधा पाय कृष्णेर चरण ॥9॥
cc-antya-20.9.translation: "In this age of Kali, the process of worshiping Kṛṣṇa is to perform sacrifice by chanting the holy name of the Lord. One who does so is certainly very intelligent, and he attains shelter at the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa.

lines: se yaiche tṛṣṇāya piye samudrera pānī
devanagari: अमि - अति - क्षुद्र जीव, पक्षी राङ्गा - टुनि ।
से यैछे तृष्णाय पिये समुद्रेर पानी ॥90॥
cc-antya-20.90-91.translation: I am a very insignificant living being, like a small red-beaked bird. Just as such a bird drinks the water of the sea to quench its thirst, so I have touched only a drop of the ocean of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's pastimes. From this example, you may all understand how expansive are the pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: ‘आमि लि खि’, - एह मिथ्या करि अनुमान ।
आमार शरीर काष्ठ - पुतली - समान ॥92॥
cc-antya-20.92.translation: I infer that "I have written" is a false understanding, for my body is like a wooden doll.

lines: hasta hāle, manobuddhi nahe mora sthira
devanagari: वृद्ध जरातुर आमि अन्ध, बधिर ।
हस्त हाले, मनो - बुद्धि नहे मोर स्थिर ॥93॥
cc-antya-20.93.translation: I am old and troubled by invalidity. I am almost blind and deaf, my hands tremble, and my mind and intelligence are unsteady.

devanagari: नाना - रोग - ग्रस्त, - चलिते वसिते ना पारि ।
पञ्च - रोग - पीड़ा - व्याकुल, रात्रि - दिने मरि ॥94॥
cc-antya-20.94.translation: I am infected by so many diseases that I can neither properly walk nor properly sit. Indeed, I am always exhausted by five kinds of disease. I may die at any time of the day or night.

devanagari: पूर्वे ग्रन्थे इहा करियाछि निवेदन ।
तथापि लिखिये, शुन इहार कारण ॥95॥
cc-antya-20.95.translation: I have previously given an account of my inabilities. Please hear the reason why I nevertheless still write.

devanagari: श्री गोविन्द, श्री - चैतन्य, श्री - नित्यानन्द ।
श्री - अद्वैत, श्री - भक्त, आर श्री - श्रोतृ - वृन्द ॥96॥
cc-antya-20.96-98.translation: I am writing this book by the mercy of the lotus feet of Śrī Govindadeva, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Lord Nityānanda, Advaita Ācārya, other devotees and the readers of this book, as well as Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, Śrī Rūpa Gosvāmī, Śrī Sanātana Gosvāmī, Śrī Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī, who is my spiritual master, and Śrī Jīva Gosvāmī. I have also been specifically favored by another Supreme Personality.

lines: kahite nā yuyāya, tabu rahite nā pāri
devanagari: श्री - मदन - गोपाल मोरे लेखाय आज्ञा क रि’ ।
कहिते ना युयाय, तबु रहिते ना पारि ॥99॥
cc-antya-20.99.translation: Śrī Madana-mohana Deity of Vṛndāvana has given the order that is making me write. Although this should not be disclosed, I disclose it because I am unable to remain silent.
